twi: Adam Set, Enos,
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

twi: Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared,
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

twi: Henok, Metusela, Lamek, Noah.
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.

twi: Noa mma ne, Sem, Ham, ne Yafet.
english:
The sons of Noah:
Shem, Ham and Japheth.

twi: Yafet AsefoNa Yafet asefo ne Gomer, Magog, Media, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras.
english:
The sons of Japheth:
Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

twi: Na Gomer asefo ne Askenas, Rifat ne Togarma.
english:
The sons of Gomer:
Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

twi: Na Yawan asefo ne Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Rodanim.
english:
The sons of Javan:
Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

twi: Ham AsefoNa Ham asefo ne Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan.
english:
The sons of Ham:
Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

twi: Na Kus asefo ne Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka. Na Raama asefo yɛ Saba ne Dedan.
english:
The sons of Cush:
Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka.
The sons of Raamah:
Sheba and Dedan.

twi: Kus woo Nimrod. Na Nimrod bɛyɛɛ ɔkofo kɛse wɔ asase so.
english:
Cush was the father of
Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.

twi: Na Misraim wooLudfo, Anamfo, Lehabfo, Naftuhfo,
english:
Egypt was the father of
the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

twi: Patrusfo, Kasluhfo ne Kaftorfo a wɔn ase na Filistifo fi.
english: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

twi: Na Kanaan woo nʼabakanSidon ne Het,
english:
Canaan was the father of
Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

twi: Yebusifo, Amorifo, Girgasifo,
english: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

twi: Hewifo, Arkifo, Sinifo,
english: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

twi: Arwadfo, Semarifo ne Hamatifo tete agya.
english: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.

twi: Sem AsefoNa Sem asefo yɛ Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud ne Aram.Aram asefo ne Us, Hul, Geter ne Mas.
english:
The sons of Shem:
Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.
The sons of Aram:
Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

twi: Na Arfaksad woo Sela na Sela woo Eber.
english:
Arphaxad was the father of Shelah,
and Shelah the father of Eber.

twi: Eber woo mmabarima baanu. Wɔtoo ɔbaako din Peleg a ase kyerɛ Nkyekyɛmu, efisɛ nʼawobere mu na kasa ahorow nti, nnipa a wɔwɔ asase so mu kyekyɛe ma wɔhwetee. Na wɔtoo ne nua a ɔka ne ho no din Yoktan.
english:
Two sons were born to Eber:
One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

twi: Yoktan woo Almodada, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera,
english:
Joktan was the father of
Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

twi: Hadoram, Usal, Dikla,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

twi: Obal, Abimael, Seba,
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

twi: Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Yoktan asefo.
english: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

twi: Ɛno nti, eyi ne anato a efi Sem: Arfaksad, Selah,
english: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

twi: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

twi: Serug, Nahor, Tera,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah

twi: ne Abram a akyiri no, wɔfrɛɛ no Abraham no.
english: and Abram (that is, Abraham).

twi: Abraham AsefoAbraham mmabarima yɛ Isak ne Ismael.
english:
The sons of Abraham:
Isaac and Ishmael.

twi: Na Ismael mmabarima nso neNebaiot a ɔyɛ nʼabakan, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
english:
These were their descendants:
Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

twi: Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

twi: Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema.Eyinom ne Ismael mmabarima.
english: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

twi: Na Abraham mpena Ketura mmabarima ne Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak ne Sua.Na Yoksan asefo yɛ Seba ne Dedan.
english:
The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine:
Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
The sons of Jokshan:
Sheba and Dedan.

twi: Midian woo Efa, Efer, Henok, Abida ne Eldaa.Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Ketura asefo.
english:
The sons of Midian:
Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah.
All these were descendants of Keturah.

twi: Isak AsefoAbraham woo Isak. Isak mmabarima yɛ Esau ne Israel.
english:
Abraham was the father of Isaac.
The sons of Isaac:
Esau and Israel.

twi: Esau AsefoNa Esau mmabarima yɛ Elifas, Reuel, Yeus, Yalam ne Kora.
english:
The sons of Esau:
Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

twi: Na Elifas mmabarima yɛ Teman, Omar, Sefi, Gatam, Kenas, Timna ne Amalek.
Na Reuel mmabarima yɛ Nahat, Serah, Sama ne Misa.
english:
The sons of Reuel:
Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

twi: Edomfo AbɔseNa Seir mmabarima yɛ Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan.
english:
The sons of Seir:
Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.

twi: Na Lotan mmabarima yɛ Hori ne Homam. Na Lotan nuabea din de Timna.
english:
The sons of Lotan:
Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

twi: Na Sobal mmabarima yɛ Alian, Manahat, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam.Sibeon mmabarima yɛ Aya ne Ana.
english:
The sons of Shobal:
Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
The sons of Zibeon:
Aiah and Anah.

twi: Na Ana babarima yɛ Dison.Na Dison mma yɛ Hemdan, Esban, Yitran ne Keran.
english:
The son of Anah:
Dishon.
The sons of Dishon:
Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

twi: Na Eser mmabarima yɛ Bilhan, Saawan ne Akan.Na Disan mmabarima yɛ Us ne Aran.
english:
The sons of Ezer:
Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
The sons of Dishan:
Uz and Aran.

twi: Edom SodifoEyinom ne ahemfo a wodii Edom so ansa na Israelfo renya ahemfo:Beor babarima Bela, a ɔtenaa kuropɔn Dinhaba so dii hene.
english:
These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:
Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.

twi: Na Bela wui no, Serah babarima Yobab a ofi Bosra bedii nʼade sɛ ɔhene.
english: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

twi: Na Yobab wui no, Husam a ofi Teman asase so bedii nʼade sɛ ɔhene.
english: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

twi: Husam wu akyi no, Hadad a ɔyɛ Bedad babarima a okodii Midian so nkonim wɔ Moab asase so no na odii nʼade sɛ ɔhempɔn. Wɔtoo nʼahenkurow no din Hawit.
english: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

twi: Hadad wui no, Samla a ofi Masreka kuropɔn mu bɛyɛɛ ɔhene.
english: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

twi: Samla wui no, Saulo a ofi Rehobot a ɛda asu Eufrate ho no bedii hene.
english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

twi: Na Saulo wui no, Akbor babarima Baal-Hanan bedii hene.
english: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.

twi: Baal-Hanan wui no, Hadad tenaa kuropɔn Pai mu dii hene. Na ne yere a wɔfrɛ no Mehetabel no yɛ Matred babea ne Me-Sahab nso nena.
english: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

twi: Na Hadad nso wui.Na Edom mmusua no ntuanofo neTimna, Alia, Yetet,
english:
Hadad also died.
The chiefs of Edom were:
Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

twi: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,
english: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

twi: Kenas, Teman, Mibsar,
english: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

twi: Magdiel ne Iram.Eyinom na na wɔyɛ Edom mmusua ntuanofo.
english: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

twi: Israel Awo NtoatoasoIsrael mmabarima yɛ Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Sebulon,
english:
These were the sons of Israel:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

twi: Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad ne Aser.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

twi: Yuda AsefoYuda ne Kanaannibea Bat-Sua woo mmabarima baasa.Na wɔn din de Er, Onan ne Sela.Nanso na abakan Er no yɛ omumɔyɛfo nti, Awurade kum no.
english:
The sons of Judah:
Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

twi: Akyiri no, Yuda ne nʼase kunafo Tamar woo nta. Na wɔn din de Peres ne Serah.Enti Yuda woo mmabarima baanum.
english: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.

twi: Na Peres mmabarima din deHesron ne Hamul.
english:
The sons of Perez:
Hezron and Hamul.

twi: Serah mmabarima din deSimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol ne Dara; wɔyɛ baanum.
english:
The sons of Zerah:
Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda—five in all.

twi: Akar a ɔyɛ Karmi babarima ne Serah asefo no mu baako nam fa a ɔfaa asade a wogyaw maa Awurade no so, de amanehunu baa Israelfo so.
english:
The son of Karmi:
Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.

twi: Na Etan babarima neAsaria.
english:
The son of Ethan:
Azariah.

twi: Efi Yuda Nana Barima Hesron So Kosi Dawid SoHesron mmabarima din de Yerahmeel, Ram ne Kaleb.
english:
The sons born to Hezron were:
Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.

twi: Ram yɛ Aminadab agya.Aminadab yɛ Nahson a na ɔyɛ Yuda ntuanoni no agya.
english:
Ram was the father of
Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.

twi: Nahson yɛ Salma agya.Na Salma nso yɛ Boas agya.
english: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,

twi: Boas yɛ Obed agya.Obed yɛ Yisai agya.
english: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.

twi: Yisai abakan yɛ Eliab nea ɔto so abien yɛ Abinadab na nea ɔto so abiɛsa yɛ Simea.
english:
Jesse was the father of
Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,

twi: Na nea ɔto so anan yɛ Netanel na Radai to so anum.
english: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,

twi: Ne babarima a ɔto so asia no din de Osem na Dawid na na ɔto so ason.
english: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.

twi: Na wɔn nuabeanom din de Seruia ne Abigail.Na Seruia woo mmabarima baasa a wɔn din yɛ Abisai, Yoab ne Asahel.
english: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.

twi: Abigail waree ɔbarima bi a ne din de Yeter a ɔyɛ Ismaelni na wɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no din Amasa.
english: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

twi: Hesron Babarima Kaleb AsefoNa Hesron babarima Kaleb wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔne Asuba ne Yeriot. Na Asuba mmabarima din de Yeser, Sobab ne Ardon.
english: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.

twi: Asuba wu akyi no, Kaleb waree Efrata. Wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no din Hur.
english: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

twi: Hur woo Uri. Uri nso woo Besaleel.
english: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.

twi: Bere a Hesron dii mfe aduosia no, ɔwaree Gilead nuabea a na ɔyɛ Makir babea. Wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no din Segub.
english: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.

twi: Segub woo Yair a odii nkurow aduonu abiɛsa so wɔ Gilead asase so no.
english: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.

twi: (Akyiri no, Gesur ne Aram gyee Yair nkurow, san gyee Kenat ne ne nkuraa aduosia a atwa ho ahyia no nyinaa.)Na eyinom nyinaa yɛ Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead agya no asefo.
english: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.

twi: Hesron wuu wɔ kurow Kaleb-Efrata mu akyi no, ne yere Abia woo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no din Asur (Tekoa agya).
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

twi: Hesron Ba Yerahmeel AsefoHesron abakan Yerahmeel mmabarima a ɔwoo wɔn no din yɛRam (abakan), Buna, Oren, Osem ne Ahiya.
english:
The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.

twi: Na Yerahmeel wɔ ɔyere a ɔto so abien a wɔfrɛ no Atara, na ɔno na ɔwoo Onam.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

twi: Ram a ɔyɛ Yerahmeel abakan no mmabarima yɛMaas, Yamin ne Eker.
english:
The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel:
Maaz, Jamin and Eker.

twi: Onam mmabarima yɛSamai ne Yada.Na Samai mmabarima yɛNadab ne Abisur.
english:
The sons of Onam:
Shammai and Jada.
The sons of Shammai:
Nadab and Abishur.

twi: Na Abisur ne ne yere Abihail mmabarima yɛ Ahban ne Molid.
english: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

twi: Na Nadab mmabarima yɛSeled ne Apaim. Seled wui a wanwo mma;
english:
The sons of Nadab:
Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

twi: na Apaim de, ɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔfrɛ no Yisi.Na Yisi woo Sesan. Na Sesan nyaa nʼaseni bi a wɔfrɛ no Ahlai.
english:
The son of Appaim:
Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan.
Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.

twi: Na Samai nuabarima Yada wooYeter ne Yonatan. Na Yeter wui a wanwo ba biara,
english:
The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother:
Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

twi: nanso Yonatan woo mmabarima baanu a na wɔfrɛ wɔnPelet ne Sasa.Na eyinom nyinaa yɛ Yerahmeel asefo.
english:
The sons of Jonathan:
Peleth and Zaza.
These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

twi: Na Sesan annya mmabarima, onyaa mmabea.Na ɔwɔ Misraimni somfo bi a ne din de Yarha.
english:
Sheshan had no sons—only daughters.
He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

twi: Sesan de ne mmabea no mu baako maa Yarha aware na wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no din Atai.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.

twi: Atai woo Natanna Natan woo Sabad.
english:
Attai was the father of Nathan,
Nathan the father of Zabad,

twi: Sabad woo Efial.Efial woo Obed.
english:
Zabad the father of Ephlal,
Ephlal the father of Obed,

twi: Obed woo Yehuna Yehu woo Asaria.
english:
Obed the father of Jehu,
Jehu the father of Azariah,

twi: Asaria woo Heles.Heles woo Eleasa.
english:
Azariah the father of Helez,
Helez the father of Eleasah,

twi: Eleasa woo Sisemaina Sisemai woo Salum.
english:
Eleasah the father of Sismai,
Sismai the father of Shallum,

twi: Salum woo Yekamia,na Yekamia woo Elisama.
english:
Shallum the father of Jekamiah,
and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.

twi: Hesron Babarima Kaleb AsefoYerahmeel nua Kalebbabarima piesie ne Mesa a ɔyɛ Sif agya.Na Kaleb babarima a ɔto so abien din de Maresa a ɔyɛ Hebron agya.
english:
The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel:
Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.

twi: Na Hebron mmabarima yɛKora, Tapua, Rekem ne Sema.
english:
The sons of Hebron:
Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.

twi: Na Sema woo Raham.Raham woo Yorkeam.Na Rekem woo Samai.
english: Shema was the father of Raham, and Raham the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

twi: Na Samai woo Maon.Maon woo Bet-Sur.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

twi: Na Kaleb mpena Efa wooHaran, Mosa ne Gases.Na Haran woo Gases.
english: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

twi: Na Yahdai mmabarima yɛRegem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelet, Efa ne Saaf.
english:
The sons of Jahdai:
Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah and Shaaph.

twi: Kaleb mpena foforo bi a wɔfrɛ no Maaka wooSeber ne Tirhana.
english: Caleb’s concubine Maakah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

twi: Ɔsan woo Saaf a na ɔyɛ Madmana agyane Sewa a na ɔyɛ Makbena ne Gibea agya.Na Kaleb woo ɔbabea a ne din de Aksa.
english: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Makbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Aksah.

twi: Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Kaleb asefo.Kaleb Babarima Hur AsefoKaleb yere Efrata abakan Hur mmabarima yɛSobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-Yearim agya
english:
These were the descendants of Caleb.
The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:
Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

twi: Salma a ɔyɛ Betlehem agya ne Haref a ɔyɛ Bet-Gader agya.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

twi: Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-Yearim agya no mmabarima yɛHaroe a ne fa yɛ Manahatini
english:
The descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were:
Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

twi: na ne fa a aka no fi Kiriat-Yearim mmusua mu. Sobal asefo a wɔka ho ne Yitrifo, Putifo, Sumatifo ne Misraimfo, wɔn mu na Sorafo ne Estaolfo fi.
english: and the clans of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.

twi: Salma asefo yɛBetlehem, Netofafo, Atrot-Bet-Yoabfo, Manahatafo fa bi, Sorifo,
english:
The descendants of Salma:
Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

twi: ne akyerɛwfo mmusua a wɔte Yabes no, Tirafo, Simeafo ne Sukatfo. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Kenifo, Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab agya no asefo.
english: and the clans of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the Rekabites.

twi: Dawid AsefoEyinom ne mmabarima a wɔwowoo wɔn maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.Na nʼabakan din de Amnon a ne na a na ofi Yesreel no din de Ahinoam.Ne ba a ɔto so abien no, na ne din de Daniel. Na ne na a ofi Karmel no din de Abigail.
Ne ba a ɔto so abiɛsa no, na wɔfrɛ no Absalom. Na ne na din de Maaka a na ɔyɛ Gesurhene Talmai babea.Ne ba a ɔto so anan din de Adoniya a ne na din de Hagit.
english:
the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

twi: Ne ba a ɔto so anum no, na wɔfrɛ no Sefatia. Na wɔfrɛ ne na Abital.Ne ba a ɔto so asia no din de Yitream a na wɔfrɛ ne na Egla.
english:
the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
and the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.

twi: Wɔwowoo mmabarima baasia yi nyinaa maa Dawid wɔ Hebron. Odii ade wɔ hɔ mfirihyia ason ne fa.Dawid yii kuropɔn no kɔɔ Yerusalem, na odii ade mfirihyia aduasa abiɛsa wɔ hɔ.
english:
These six were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months.
David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,

twi: Mmabarima a wɔwowoo wɔn maa Dawid wɔ Yerusalem no ne:Simea, Sobab, Natan ne Salomo. Amiel babea Batseba na ɔwoo saa mmarima yi.
english:
and these were the children born to him there:
Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.

twi: Wɔsan wowoo mmabarima baakron bi maa Dawid. Wɔne Yibhar, Elisua, Elifelet,
english: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

twi: Noga, Nefeg, Yafia,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

twi: Elisama, Eliada ne Elifelet.
english: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.

twi: Eyinom ne Dawid mmabarima a ne mpena mma nka ho. Na Dawid wɔ ɔbabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Tamar.
english: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.

twi: Salomo AsefoNa Salomo asefo yɛRehoboam, Abia, Asa, Yehosafat,
english:
Solomon’s son was Rehoboam,
Abijah his son,
Asa his son,
Jehoshaphat his son,

twi: Yoram, Ahasia, Yoas,
english:
Jehoram his son,
Ahaziah his son,
Joash his son,

twi: Amasia, Asaria, Yotam,
english:
Amaziah his son,
Azariah his son,
Jotham his son,

twi: Ahas, Hesekia, Manase,
english:
Ahaz his son,
Hezekiah his son,
Manasseh his son,

twi: Amon ne Yosia.
english:
Amon his son,
Josiah his son.

twi: Na Yosia mmabarima neYohanan a ɔyɛ abakan,Yehoiakim to so abien,Sedekia to so abiɛsa,na Salum to so anan.
english:
The sons of Josiah:
Johanan the firstborn,
Jehoiakim the second son,
Zedekiah the third,
Shallum the fourth.

twi: Yehoiakim babarima Yehoiakyin na odii nʼade,na ɔno nso ne wɔfa Sedekia bedii nʼade.
english:
The successors of Jehoiakim:
Jehoiachin his son,
and Zedekiah.

twi: Yehoiakyin AsefoYehoiakyin a Babiloniafo kyeree no kɔtoo afiase nommabarima ne Sealtiel,
english:
The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive:
Shealtiel his son,

twi: Malkiram, Pedaia, Senasar, Yekamia, Hosama ne Nedabia.
english: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

twi: Na Pedaia mmabarima yɛSerubabel ne Simei.Na Serubabel mmabarima yɛMesulam ne Hanania. Na ɔwɔ ɔbabea nso a ne din de Selomit.
english:
The sons of Pedaiah:
Zerubbabel and Shimei.
The sons of Zerubbabel:
Meshullam and Hananiah.
Shelomith was their sister.

twi: Na ne mmabarima baanum bi nso din ne Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia ne Yusab-Hesed.
english:
There were also five others:
Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.

twi: Na Hanania mmabarima din dePelatia ne Yesaia. Na Yesaia babarima din de Refaia. Na Refaia babarima din de Arnan. Na Arnan babarima din de Obadia. Na Obadia babarima din de Sekania.
english:
The descendants of Hananiah:
Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.

twi: Na Sekania asefo yɛSemaia ne ne mmabarima Hatus, Igal, Baria, Nearia ne Safat. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ baasia.
english:
The descendants of Shekaniah:
Shemaiah and his sons:
Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.

twi: Na Nearia mmabarima din deElioenai, Hiskia ne Asrikam. Na wɔyɛ baasa.
english:
The sons of Neariah:
Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.

twi: Na Elioenai mmabarima din deHodawia, Eliasib, Pelaia, Akub, Yohanan, Delaia ne Anani. Na wɔyɛ baason.
english:
The sons of Elioenai:
Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.

twi: Yuda Asefo NkaeYuda asefo no bi din dePeres, Hesron, Karmi, Hur ne Sobal.
english:
The descendants of Judah:
Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.

twi: Sobal babarima Reaia na ɔwoo Yahat. Yahat woo Ahumai ne Lahad. Eyinom na na wɔyɛ Sorafo mmusua.
english: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

twi: Na Etam asefo no neYesreel, Yisma, Yidbas ne Haslelponi a na ɔyɛ ne babea,
english:
These were the sons of Etam:
Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.

twi: Penuel a na ɔyɛ Gedor agya ne Eser a na ɔyɛ Husa agya. Eyinom na na wɔyɛ Hur a na ɔyɛ Efrata abakan ne Betlehem agya no asefo.
english:
Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah.
These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.

twi: Na Tekoa agya a ne din de Ashur no wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔfrɛ wɔn Hela ne Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

twi: Naara woo Ahusam, Hefer, Temeni ne Ahastari.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

twi: Hela wooSeret, Sohar, Etnan,
english:
The sons of Helah:
Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,

twi: ne Kos a nʼasefo ne Anub, Hasobeba ne Harum babarima Aharhel, Harum ne ne mmusua nyinaa.
english: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.

twi: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Yabes a ɔyɛɛ ɔkɛse sen ne nuabarimanom nyinaa. Ne na too no din Yabes, efisɛ onyaa ɔyaw wɔ nʼawo mu.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “I gave birth to him in pain.”

twi: Yabes ne obi a ɔbɔɔ mpae kyerɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn se, “Ao, hyira me na trɛw mʼahye mu. Mesrɛ wo, ka me ho wɔ nea mɛyɛ biara mu, na yi me fi ɔhaw ne ɔyaw nyinaa mu.” Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ nʼabisade no maa no.
english: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, “Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted his request.

twi: Suba nuabarima Kelub woo Mehir. Mehir woo Eston.
english: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

twi: Eston woo Bet-Rafa, Paseah ne Tehina. Tehina woo Ir-Nahas. Eyinom ne Reka asefo.
english: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.

twi: Kenas mmabarima neOtniel ne Seraia.Otniel mmabarima neHatat ne Meonotai.
english:
The sons of Kenaz:
Othniel and Seraiah.
The sons of Othniel:
Hathath and Meonothai.

twi: Meonotai woo Ofra.Na Seraia woo Yoaba ofii Adwumfo Bon ase, efisɛ na adwumfo pii tete hɔ.
english:
Meonothai was the father of Ophrah.
Seraiah was the father of Joab,
the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.

twi: Na Yefune babarima Kaleb mmabarima yɛIru, Ela ne Naam.Na Ela babarima yɛKenas.
english:
The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh:
Iru, Elah and Naam.
The son of Elah:
Kenaz.

twi: Yehalelel mmabarima neSif ne Sifa, Tiria ne Asarel.
english:
The sons of Jehallelel:
Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

twi: Ɛsra mmabarima yɛYeter, Mered, Efer ne Yalon.Mered waree Misraimnibea ma ɔwoo Miriam, Samai ne Yisba a ɔbɛyɛɛ Estemoa agya no.
english:
The sons of Ezrah:
Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

twi: Mered nso waree ɔbea a ofi Yuda.Ɔno nso woo Yered a ɔbɛyɛɛ Gedor agya, Heber a ɔyɛ Soko agya, ne Yekutiel a ɔyɛ Sanoa agya. Na wɔfrɛ Mered yere Misraimni no se Bitia a na ɔyɛ Misraimhene babea.
english: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.

twi: Na Hodia yere yɛ Naham nuabea.Ne mmabarima no mu baako na ɔwoo Keila a ɔyɛ Garmini na ɔbaako nso woo Estemoa a ɔyɛ Maakatni.
english:
The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham:
the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.

twi: Simon mmabarima neAmnon, Rina, Ben-Hanan ne Tilon.Na Yisi asefo no neSohet ne Ben-Sohet.
english:
The sons of Shimon:
Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon.
The descendants of Ishi:
Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.

twi: Yuda Babarima Sela AsefoNa Sela yɛ Yuda mma no mu baako.Na Sela asefo no ne Er a ɔwoo Leka, Lada a ɔwoo Maresa a na wɔyɛ nweratam ho adwuma wɔ Bet-Asbea,
english:
The sons of Shelah son of Judah:
Er the father of Lekah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth Ashbea,

twi: Yokim, Kosebafo, Yoas, ne Saraf a na wodi Moab ne Yasubi-Lehem so no. Saa din yi nyinaa, wonya fii tete nkyerɛw a na wɔakyerɛw agu hɔ mu.
english: Jokim, the men of Kozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)

twi: Na wɔyɛ nkukunwemfo a na wɔte Netaim ne Gedera. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ nnwuma ma ɔhene.
english: They were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.

twi: Simeon AsefoNa Simeon mmabarima no din deNemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serah ne Saulo.
english:
The descendants of Simeon:
Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul;

twi: Na Saulo asefo yɛ Salum, Mibsam ne Misma.
english: Shallum was Shaul’s son, Mibsam his son and Mishma his son.

twi: Na Misma asefo yɛHamuel, Sakur ne Simei.
english:
The descendants of Mishma:
Hammuel his son, Zakkur his son and Shimei his son.

twi: Simei woo mmabarima dunsia ne mmabea baasia. Ne nuabarimanom de, na wɔn mu biara nni abusua kɛse saa. Ɛno nti, Simeon abusua annɔ te sɛ Yuda abusua no.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children; so their entire clan did not become as numerous as the people of Judah.

twi: Wɔtenaa Beer-Seba, Molada ne Hasar-Sual,
english: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual,

twi: Bilha, Esem ne Tolad,
english: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

twi: Betuel, Horma ne Siklag,
english: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

twi: Bet-Markabot, Hasar-Susim, Bet-Biri ne Saaraim. Na saa nkurow yi nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn ase kosii ɔhene Dawid bere so.
english: Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri and Shaaraim. These were their towns until the reign of David.

twi: Wɔn asefo nso tenaa Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token ne Asan a ɛyɛ nkurow anum yi so,
english: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan—five towns—

twi: ne ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no kosii Baal.Na wɔn atenae ni, na wɔahyehyɛ saa din yi nyinaa wɔ wɔn anato nkrataa mu.
english: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.

twi: Wɔn a wɔka Simeon asefo ho no bi nso ne Mesobab, Yamlekne Amasia babarima Yosa,
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,

twi: Yoel,Yosibia babarima Yehu a ɔyɛ Seraia babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Asiel babarima,
english: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

twi: Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yesohaia, Asaia, Adiel, Yesimiel ne Benaia,
english: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

twi: Sifi babarima Sisa a nʼagya yɛ Alon babarima, na ɔno yɛ Yedaia babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Simri babarima a nʼagya yɛ Semaia.
english: and Ziza son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.

twi: Din a yɛabobɔ yi yɛ ntuanofo a wɔdeda Simeon mmusuakuw a wɔyɛ adefo no ano no bi.
english: The men listed above by name were leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,

twi: Wɔkɔɔ Gedor fam a na ɛwɔ obon no apuei fam sɛ wɔrekɔpɛ asase pa ama wɔn mmoa adidi so.
english: and they went to the outskirts of Gedor to the east of the valley in search of pasture for their flocks.

twi: Wonyaa mmoa adidibea pa wɔ hɔ. Na asase no so dwo na basabasayɛ biara nni hɔ. Na Ham asefo no bi akɔtena Gedor fa mu hɔ dedaw.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.

twi: Yudahene Hesekia bere so no, Simeon ntuanofo no ko dii hɔ so, sɛee Ham ne Meunifo afi pasaa. Wokum obiara a na ɔte hɔ, faa asase no, efisɛ, na wɔpɛ sɛ wonya mmoa didibea pa no.
english: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.

twi: Akofo no mu ahannum a wofi Simeon abusuakuw mu no kɔɔ bepɔw Seir so, a na Pelatia, Nearia, Refaia ne Usiel a wɔn nyinaa yɛ Yisi mmabarima no na na wodi wɔn anim.
english: And five hundred of these Simeonites, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, invaded the hill country of Seir.

twi: Amalekfo kakra a wɔkae no, wokunkum wɔn nyinaa, faa hɔ, na wɔtenaa hɔ.
english: They killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.

twi: Ruben AsefoNa Israel babarima panyin ne Ruben. Nanso esiane sɛ wammu nʼagya, na ɔne nʼagya mpenanom no mu baako kɔdae no nti, ɔde nʼabakanyɛ maa ne nua Yosef mmabarima. Esiane saa asɛm yi nti, wɔamfa Ruben din anka anato no ho sɛ abakan.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father’s marriage bed, his rights as firstborn were given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel; so he could not be listed in the genealogical record in accordance with his birthright,

twi: Yuda asefo na wɔyɛɛ abusuakuw a wɔwɔ tumi pa ara; ne saa nti woyii ɔman no sodifo fii wɔn mu, nanso mpanyinni no de, na ɛyɛ Yosef dea.
english: and though Judah was the strongest of his brothers and a ruler came from him, the rights of the firstborn belonged to Joseph)—

twi: Israel abakan Ruben no mmabarima ne:Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi.
english:
the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel:
Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.

twi: Yoel asefo neSemaia, Gog, Simei,
english:
The descendants of Joel:
Shemaiah his son, Gog his son,
Shimei his son,

twi: Mika, Reaia, Baal,
english:
Micah his son,
Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

twi: ne Beera. Bere a Asiriahene Tilgat-Pilneser de Rubenfo kɔɔ nnommumfa mu no, Beera na na odi Rubenfo no anim.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.

twi: Wɔakyerɛw Beera nkurɔfo din sɛnea wɔn mmusua ne abusua no te: Yeiel ne wɔn ntuanoni, na Sakaria
english:
Their relatives by clans, listed according to their genealogical records:
Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,

twi: ne Asas babarima Bela a ɔyɛ Sema babarima a ɔyɛ Yoel babarima.Saa Rubenfo yi tenaa beae a efi Aroer de kosi Nebo ne Baal-Meon.
english: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in the area from Aroer to Nebo and Baal Meon.

twi: Esiane sɛ na wɔwɔ anantwi bebree wɔ Gilead asase so no nti, wodidi kɔɔ apuei fam wɔ nweatam a ɛtrɛw kɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate no ho.
english: To the east they occupied the land up to the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in Gilead.

twi: Ɔhene Saulo bere so, Rubenfo dii Hagarfo so nkonim wɔ ɔko mu. Enti wotu kɔɔ Hagarfo atenae a ɛwɔ Gilead apuei fam hɔ no.
english: During Saul’s reign they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands; they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the entire region east of Gilead.

twi: Gad AsefoBasan asase so no, na Gad asefo na wɔtete asase a edi Rubenfo de no so. Wɔtrɛw kɔɔ apuei fam kosii Saleka.
english: The Gadites lived next to them in Bashan, as far as Salekah:

twi: Na Yoel na otua wɔn ano wɔ Basan asase so. Na Safam, Yanai ne Safat yɛ nʼaboafo.
english: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat, in Bashan.

twi: Na wɔn abusuafo a wɔyɛ ntuanofo ma mmusua afoforo ason din ne:Mikael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Sia ne Eber.
english:
Their relatives, by families, were:
Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia and Eber—seven in all.

twi: Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Huri babarima Abihail a ɔyɛ Yaroa babarima, Gilead babarima, Mikael babarima, Yesisai babarima Yahdo babarima, Bus babarima.
english: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

twi: Abdiel babarima Ahi, Guni babarima no na na ɔyɛ wɔn mmusua no ntuano.
english: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.

twi: Gadfo no tenaa Gilead asase a ɛwɔ Basan ne ne nkuraa ne Saron tataw no nyinaa so.
english: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.

twi: Yudahene Yotam ne Israelhene Yeroboam bere so na wɔkyerɛw eyinom nyinaa guu abusuadua nkrataa mu.
english: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

twi: Yordan Apuei Fam MmusuakuwNa akofo akɛse a wɔwɔ Ruben, Gad mmusua ne Manase abusua fa mu no ano si mpem aduanan anan ahanson ne aduosia. Wokurakura nkatabo, mfoa ne agyan, na wɔn nyinaa akwadaw wɔ akodi mu.
english: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.

twi: Wɔko tiaa Hagarfo, Yeturfo, Nafisfo ne Nodabfo.
english: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.

twi: Wosu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔko no mu, na otiee wɔn mpaebɔ, efisɛ wɔde wɔn ho too ne so. Enti wodii Hagarfo no ne wɔn dɔm nyinaa so nkonim.
english: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.

twi: Asade a wɔfa fii Hagarfo no nkyɛn no yɛ yoma mpem aduonum, nguan mpem ahannu aduonum, mfurum mpenu ne nneduafo mpem ɔha.
english: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,

twi: Wokunkum Hagarfo no bebree wɔ ɔko no mu, efisɛ na Onyankopɔn reko tia wɔn. Enti wɔtenaa wɔn asase so kosii sɛ wotwaa wɔn asu.
english: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.

twi: Manase abusua fa no trɛw wɔ asase no so fi Basan kosii Baal-Hermon, Senir ne bepɔw Hermon ho. Na wɔdɔɔso yiye.
english: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).

twi: Eyinom ne wɔn mmusua no ntuanofo: Efer, Yisi, Eliel, Asriel, Yeremia, Hodawia ne Yahdiel. Na wɔn mu biara agye din sɛ ɔkofo kɛse ne ɔkannifo.
english: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.

twi: Nanso na wonni nokware, na wobuu wɔn agyanom ne Onyankopɔn apam no so. Wɔsom aman a Onyankopɔn sɛee wɔn no anyame.
english: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

twi: Enti Israel Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ Asiriahene Pul (a na wɔsan frɛ no Tilgat-Pilneser) koma mu sɛ ɔnko mfa asase no, na ɔnkyekyere Rubenfo, Gadfo ne Manasefo abusua fa sɛ nneduafo. Asiriafo no twaa wɔn asu kɔɔ Halah, Habor, Hara ne Asubɔnten Gosan ho a wɔda so te hɔ besi nnɛ.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.

twi: Asɔfo Awo NtoatoasoNa Lewi mmabarima yɛ:Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
english:
The sons of Levi:
Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

twi: Na Kohat asefo nso yɛ:Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel.
english:
The sons of Kohath:
Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

twi: Na Amram mma yɛ:Aaron, Mose ne Miriam.Na Aaron mmabarima yɛ:Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.
english:
The children of Amram:
Aaron, Moses and Miriam.
The sons of Aaron:
Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

twi: Eleasar woo Pinehas.Pinehas woo Abisua.
english:
Eleazar was the father of Phinehas,
Phinehas the father of Abishua,

twi: Abisua woo Buki,na Buki woo Usi.
english:
Abishua the father of Bukki,
Bukki the father of Uzzi,

twi: Usi woo Serahia. Serahia woo Meraiot.
english:
Uzzi the father of Zerahiah,
Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,

twi: Meraiot woo Amaria,na Amaria woo Ahitub.
english:
Meraioth the father of Amariah,
Amariah the father of Ahitub,

twi: Ahitub woo Sadok,na Sadok woo Ahimaas.
english:
Ahitub the father of Zadok,
Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,

twi: Ahimaas woo Asaria.Asaria woo Yohanan.
english:
Ahimaaz the father of Azariah,
Azariah the father of Johanan,

twi: Yohanan woo Asaria aɔno na na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfopanyin wɔ asɔredan a Salomo sii wɔ Yerusalem no mu.
english: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),

twi: Asaria woo Amaria.Amaria woo Ahitub.
english:
Azariah the father of Amariah,
Amariah the father of Ahitub,

twi: Ahitub woo Sadok.Sadok woo Salum.
english:
Ahitub the father of Zadok,
Zadok the father of Shallum,

twi: Salum woo Hilkia.Hilkia woo Asaria.
english:
Shallum the father of Hilkiah,
Hilkiah the father of Azariah,

twi: Asaria woo Seraia.Seraia woo Yehosadak.
english:
Azariah the father of Seraiah,
and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.

twi: Wotwaa Yehosadak asu bere a Awurade de Yudafo ne Yerusalemfo kɔɔ nnommum mu a na wɔhyɛ Nebukadnessar ase no.
english: Jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

twi: Lewifo MmusuaNa Lewi mmabarima din deGersom, Kohat ne Merari.
english:
The sons of Levi:
Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

twi: Na Libni ne Simei ka Gersom asefo ho.
english:
These are the names of the sons of Gershon:
Libni and Shimei.

twi: Na Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usielka Kohat asefo no ho.
english:
The sons of Kohath:
Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

twi: Na Mahli ne Musika Merari asefo no ho.Eyinom ne Lewifo mmusua sɛnea wɔn mpanyimfo nnidiso te.
english:
The sons of Merari:
Mahli and Mushi.
These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:

twi: Na Gerson asefo yɛ:Libni, Yahat,Sima,
english:
Of Gershon:
Libni his son, Jahath his son,
Zimmah his son,

twi: Yoa,Ido, Serahne Yeaterai.
english:
Joah his son,
Iddo his son, Zerah his son
and Jeatherai his son.

twi: Na Kohat asefo neAminadab, Kora,Asir,
english:
The descendants of Kohath:
Amminadab his son, Korah his son,
Assir his son,

twi: Elkana,Ebiasaf, Asir,
english:
Elkanah his son,
Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

twi: Tahat, Uriel,Usia ne Saulo.
english:
Tahath his son, Uriel his son,
Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.

twi: Na Elkana asefo ne:Amasai, Ahimot,
english:
The descendants of Elkanah:
Amasai, Ahimoth,

twi: Sofai, Nahat,
english:
Elkanah his son, Zophai his son,
Nahath his son,

twi: Eliab,Yeroham, Elkana ne Samuel.
english:
Eliab his son,
Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son
and Samuel his son.

twi: Na Samuel mmabarima din ne:Yoel a ɔyɛ ɔpanyinne Abiya a ɔto so abien no.
english:
The sons of Samuel:
Joel the firstborn
and Abijah the second son.

twi: Na Merari mma ne:Mahli, Libni,Simei, Usa,
english:
The descendants of Merari:
Mahli, Libni his son,
Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

twi: Simea, Hagiane Asaia.
english:
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son
and Asaiah his son.

twi: Asɔredan Mu Nnwom Ho NimdefoDawid maa saa nnipa a wɔn din didi so yi dii Awurade fi nnwom anim, bere a wɔde Apam Adaka no sii hɔ no.
english: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the Lord after the ark came to rest there.

twi: Wɔde nnwom kaa wɔn som ho wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu hɔ kosii sɛ Salomo sii Awurade asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem. Afei, wɔnam mmara a wɔde maa wɔn so dii wɔn dwuma wɔ hɔ.
english: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.

twi: Saa mmarima yi na wɔne wɔn mma som wɔ hɔ no.Heman, dwom ho nimdefo no, na ofi Kohat abusua mu.Wɔto nʼabusua ana fiYoel, Samuel,
english:
Here are the men who served, together with their sons:
From the Kohathites:
Heman, the musician,
the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

twi: Elkana, Yeroham,Eliel, Yoa,
english:
the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham,
the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

twi: Suf, Elkana,Mahat, Amasai
english:
the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah,
the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

twi: Elkana, Yoel,Asaria, Sefania,
english:
the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel,
the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

twi: Tahat, Asir,Ebiasaf, Kora,
english:
the son of Tahath, the son of Assir,
the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

twi: Ishar, Kohat,Lewi ne Israel ase.
english:
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath,
the son of Levi, the son of Israel;

twi: Herman abediakyiri a odi kan no din de Asaf, a na ofi Gerson abusua mu.Wɔto Asaf abusua ana fi Berekia, Simea,
english:
and Heman’s associate Asaph, who served at his right hand:
Asaph son of Berekiah, the son of Shimea,

twi: Mikael, Baaseia,Malkia,
english:
the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah,
the son of Malkijah,

twi: Etni,Serah, Adaia,
english:
the son of Ethni,
the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

twi: Etan, Sima,Simei,
english:
the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah,
the son of Shimei,

twi: Yahat, Gersom ne Lewi ase.
english:
the son of Jahath,
the son of Gershon, the son of Levi;

twi: Herman abediakyiri a ɔto so abien no din de Etan, a na ofi Merari abusua mu.Wɔto Etan abusua ana fi Kisi, Abdi,Maluk,
english:
and from their associates, the Merarites, at his left hand:
Ethan son of Kishi, the son of Abdi,
the son of Malluk,

twi: Hasabia,Amasia, Hilkia,
english:
the son of Hashabiah,
the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

twi: Amsi, Bani, Semer,
english:
the son of Amzi, the son of Bani,
the son of Shemer,

twi: Mahli,Musi, Merari ne Lewi ase.
english:
the son of Mahli,
the son of Mushi, the son of Merari,
the son of Levi.

twi: Aaron AsefoWɔmaa wɔn abusuafo a wɔyɛ Lewifo no nso dwuma ahorow bi dii wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan a ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn fi no mu.
english: Their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.

twi: Aaron ne nʼasefo nko na wɔsom sɛ asɔfo. Na wɔde afɔrebɔde gu ɔhyew afɔremuka ne ohuam afɔremuka so, na wodi dwuma biara a ɛfa kronkron mu kronkron hɔ ho. Wɔnam mmara a Onyankopɔn somfo Mose de maa wɔn no so, yɛɛ mpata maa Israel.
english: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

twi: Na Aaron asefo yɛ:Eleasar, Pinehas, Abisua,
english:
These were the descendants of Aaron:
Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son,
Abishua his son,

twi: Buki, Usi, Serahia,
english:
Bukki his son,
Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

twi: Meraiot, Amaria, Ahitub,
english:
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son,
Ahitub his son,

twi: Sadok ne Ahimaas.
english:
Zadok his son
and Ahimaaz his son.

twi: Eyi ne abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nkurow ne asase a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so de maa Aaron ne nʼasefo a wofi Kohat abusua mu no.
english: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):

twi: Na Hebron ne mmoa adidibea nsase a atwa ho ahyia wɔ Yuda no ka ho.
english: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.

twi: Nanso mfuw ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no de, wɔde maa Yefune babarima Kaleb.
english: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

twi: Enti saa nkurow yi a mmoa adidibea atwa biara ho ahyia na wɔde maa Aaron asefo: Hebron, a ɛyɛ guankɔbea kurow, Libna, Yatir, Estemoa,
english: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,

twi: Hilen, Debir,
english: Hilen, Debir,

twi: Asan, Yuta ne Bet-Semes.
english: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.

twi: Na wɔmaa wɔn Gibeon, Geba, Alemet ne Anatot fii Benyamin asase mu a mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.Enti nkurow dumiɛnsa na wɔde maa Aaron asefo.
english:
And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands.
The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.

twi: Na Kohat asefo a wɔkae no nso, wonyaa nkurow du a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so fii Manase abusua fa no asase so.
english: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.

twi: Gerson asefo nam ntontobɔ kronkron so nyaa nkurow dumiɛnsa fii Isakar, Aser ne Naftali nsase so. Wonyaa bi nso fii Basan pɔw mu a ɛyɛ Manase de, a ɛwɔ Yordan apuei fam no.
english: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.

twi: Merari asefo nam ntontobɔ kronkron so, nyaa nkurow dumien fii Ruben, Gad ne Sebulon nsase so.
english: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

twi: Enti Israelfo de saa nkurow yi ne mmoa adidibea yi nyinaa maa Lewifo.
english: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.

twi: Wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so na wɔde nkurow a ɛwowɔ Yuda, Simeon ne Benyamin nsase so mae sɛnea wɔaka dedaw no.
english: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.

twi: Saa nkurow yi ne ɛho mmoa adidibea na Kohat asefo nya fii Efraim asase so:
english: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

twi: Sekem (guankɔbea kurow) a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔw asase no so, Geser,
english: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,

twi: Yokmeam, Bet-Horon,
english: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,

twi: Ayalon ne Gat-Rimon.
english: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.

twi: Kohat asefo nkae no, wɔde saa nkurow a efi Manase abusua fa no mu na ɛmaa wɔn: Aner ne Bileam a emu biara mmoa adidibea ka ho.
english: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

twi: Gerson asefo nyaa kurow a wɔfrɛ no Golan a ɛwɔ Basan no fii Manase abusua fa asase so a Astarot ka ho, a ne nyinaa mmoa adidibea da ho.
Isakar asase so nso, wɔmaa wɔn Kedes, Daberat,
english:
from the tribe of Issachar
they received Kedesh, Daberath,

twi: Ramot ne Anem a wɔn mmoa adidibea ka ho.
english: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;

twi: Aser asase so, wonyaa Masal, Abdon,
english:
from the tribe of Asher
they received Mashal, Abdon,

twi: Hukok ne Rehob a na emu biara mmoa adidibea ka ho.
english: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;

twi: Naftali asase so, wɔde Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea, Hamon ne Kiriataim maa wɔn, a na mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.
english:
and from the tribe of Naphtali
they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.

twi: Merari asefo nkae no nyaa Yokneam, Karta, Rimon ne Tabor nkurow, fi Sebulon asase so, a na mmoa adidibea ka biara ho.
Ruben asase a ɛda Asubɔnten Yordan apuei fam a ɛne Yeriko di nhwɛanim no nso, wonyaa Beser a ɛyɛ nweatam kurow, Yahas,
english:
from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho
they received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,

twi: Kedemot ne Mefaat a mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.
english: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;

twi: Na Gad asase so nso, wonyaa Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead, Mahanaim,
english:
and from the tribe of Gad
they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

twi: Hesbon ne Yaser a mmoa adidibea ka biara ho.
english: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.

twi: Isakar AsefoNa Isakar mmabarima baanan no din deTola, Pua, Yasub ne Simron.
english:
The sons of Issachar:
Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron—four in all.

twi: Tola mmabarima no ne:Usi, Refaia, Yeriel, Yahmai, Yibsam ne Samuel. Na wɔn mu biara yɛ wɔn agyanom mmusua ntuanofo. Ɔhene Dawid bere so no, na mmarima dodow a wɔwɔ saa mmusua yi mu a wɔyɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien ne ahansia (,).
english:
The sons of Tola:
Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel—heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.

twi: Na Usi babarima din de:Yisrahia.Na Yisrahia mmabarima din de:Mikael, Obadia, Yoel ne Yisia a na wɔn baanum tuatua mmusua ano.
english:
The son of Uzzi:
Izrahiah.
The sons of Izrahiah:
Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Ishiah. All five of them were chiefs.

twi: Mmarima dodow a na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduasa asia. Na wɔn baanum no nyinaa yerenom ne wɔn mmabarima yɛ bebree.
english: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ hɔ a wofi Isakar mmusua no nyinaa mu a wɔyɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduɔwɔtwe ason (,). Wɔkyerɛw wɔn nyinaa din nnidiso nnidiso guu wɔn anato krataa mu.
english: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.

twi: Benyamin AsefoNa Benyamin mmabarima baasa no din de:Bela. Beker ne Yediael.
english:
Three sons of Benjamin:
Bela, Beker and Jediael.

twi: Na Bela mmabarima yɛ:Esbon, Usi, Usiel, Yerimot ne Iri. Na saa akofo baanum yi yɛ mmusua ntuanofo. Nnipa a wofi wɔn asefo mu yɛɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien ne aduasa anan (,). Wɔkyerɛw wɔn nyinaa din guu wɔn anato krataa mu.
english:
The sons of Bela:
Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families—five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.

twi: Na Beker mmabarima din de:Semira, Yoas, Elieser, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abia, Anatot ne Alemet.
english:
The sons of Beker:
Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.

twi: Sɛnea na wɔn anato kyerɛ no, na wɔn abusua ntuanofo akyi no, wɔn asefo mpem aduonu ne ahannu (,) wɔ hɔ a wotumi yɛ asraafo.
english: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.

twi: Na Yediael babarima ne:Bilhan.Na Bilhan mmabarima ne:Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Setan, Tarsis ne Ahisahar.
english:
The son of Jediael:
Bilhan.
The sons of Bilhan:
Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.

twi: Na wɔyɛ Yediael mmusua no mu ntuanofo a wɔn asefo a na wɔka wɔn ho a wotumi yɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem dunson ne ahannu (,).
english: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.

twi: Na Ir mmabarima ne Supim, ne Hupim. Aher na ɔwoo Husim.
english: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.

twi: Naftali AsefoNa Naftali mmabarima yɛ:Yahsiel, Guni, Yeser ne Silum. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Yakob yere Bilha asefo.
english:
The sons of Naphtali:
Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem—the descendants of Bilhah.

twi: Manase AsefoManase mmabarima a ɔne ne mpena Aramni wowoo wɔn ne Asriel ne Makir. Makir na ɔwoo Gilead.
english:
The descendants of Manasseh:
Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.

twi: Makir pɛɛ ɔyerenom maa Hupim ne Supim. Na wɔfrɛ Makir nuabea se Maaka. Na Makir asefo no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Selofehad wowoo mmabea nko ara.
english:
Makir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. His sister’s name was Maakah.
Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

twi: Makir yere Maaka woo ɔbabarima a ɔtoo no din Peres. Na ne nuabarima din de Seres. Peres mmabarima din de Ulam ne Rekem.
english: Makir’s wife Maakah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

twi: Na Ulam babarima din de:Bedan.Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Gileadfo a wɔyɛ Manase babarima Makir asefo.
english:
The son of Ulam:
Bedan.
These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.

twi: Makir nuabea Moleket woo Is-Hod, Abieser ne Mahla.
english: His sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah.

twi: Na Semida mmabarima yɛ:Ahian, Sekem, Likhi ne Aniam.
english:
The sons of Shemida were:
Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.

twi: Efraim AsefoEfraim asefo ne:Sutela, Bered, Tahat, Elada,Tahat,
english:
The descendants of Ephraim:
Shuthelah, Bered his son,
Tahath his son, Eleadah his son,
Tahath his son,

twi: Sabad ne Sutela.Wokunkum Efraim mmabarima Eser ne Elad wɔ Gat, efisɛ wɔpɛe sɛ wowia nyɛmmoa fi akuafo a wɔbɛn hɔ no.
english:
Zabad his son
and Shuthelah his son.
Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.

twi: Wɔn agya Efraim suu wɔn kyɛe yiye, na nʼabusuafo bɛkyekyee ne werɛ.
english: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

twi: Ɛno akyi no, Efraim kɔɔ ne yere ho, na onyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima. Efraim too no din Beria esiane abɛbrɛsɛ a nʼabusuafo faa mu no nti.
english: Then he made love to his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.

twi: Efraim woo ɔbabea too no din Seer. Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree nkurow Bet-Horon Anafo, Atifi ne Usen-Seera.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon as well as Uzzen Sheerah.

twi: Efraim asefo nnidiso ne Refa, Resef, Tela, Tahan,
english:
Rephah was his son, Resheph his son,
Telah his son, Tahan his son,

twi: Ladan, Amihud, Elisama,
english:
Ladan his son, Ammihud his son,
Elishama his son,

twi: Nun ne Yosua.
english:
Nun his son
and Joshua his son.

twi: Efraim asefo no tenaa asase Bet-El ne ne nkurow a atwa afa anafo fam, Naaran a ɛda apuei fam, Geser ne ne nkuraa a ɛda atɔe fam ne Sekem ne ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia, kɔfa atifi fam, de kosi Aya a nkuraa ka ho no so.
english: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.

twi: Manase hye so no, na nkurow a ɛdeda hɔ yɛ Bet-Sean, Taanak, Megido, Dor ne wɔn nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no. Israel ba Yosef asefo tenaa saa nkurow yi so.
english: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.

twi: Aser AsefoNa Aser mmabarima yɛ:Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi ne Beria. Na wɔwɔ onuabea a ne din de Sera.
english:
The sons of Asher:
Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.

twi: Na Beria mmabarima din de:Heber ne Malkiel a ɔwoo Birsait no.
english:
The sons of Beriah:
Heber and Malkiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

twi: Na Heber mmabarima din de Yaflet, Somer ne Hotam. Na wɔwɔ onuabea a ne din de Sua.
english: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua.

twi: Yɛrekyerɛw mo afa Nkwa Asɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ fi mfiase; nea yɛate, nea yɛde yɛn ani ahu, nea yɛhwɛe na yɛde yɛn nsa kae, eyi ne Nkwa Asɛm a yɛreka ho asɛm no.
english: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched—this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.

twi: Nkwa no daa ne ho adi; yɛahu na yɛadi ho adanse, na yɛka nkwa a enni awiei a na ɛwɔ Agya no nkyɛn na wɔada no adi akyerɛ yɛn no kyerɛ mo.
english: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.

twi: Yɛkaa nea yehui na yɛtee no kyerɛɛ mo nso, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mo ne yɛn bɛyɛ adedifo wɔ ɔdɔ a yɛne Agya no ne Ɔba Yesu Kristo wɔ no mu.
english: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

twi: Yɛrekyerɛw eyi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yɛn anigye bewie pɛyɛ.
english: We write this to make our joy complete.

twi: Onyankopɔn Yɛ HannAfei, eyi ne asɛm a yɛate afi ne Ba no nkyɛn a yɛrebɔ mo amanneɛ. Onyankopɔn yɛ hann a sum nni ne mu koraa.
english: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

twi: Na sɛ afei yɛka se yɛne no wɔ ayɔnkofa na saa bere koro no ara mu yɛte sum mu a, na yɛredi atoro wɔ yɛn nsɛm ne yɛn nneyɛe mu.
english: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.

twi: Na sɛ yɛte hann mu sɛnea ɔte hann mu no a, ɛno de na yɛne yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ ayɔnkofa, na ne Ba Yesu no mogya tew yɛn ho fi bɔne nyinaa ho.
english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

twi: Sɛ yɛka se yenni bɔne a, na yɛdaadaa yɛn ho, na nokware no nni yɛn mu.
english: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

twi: Sɛ yɛka yɛn bɔne kyerɛ Onyankopɔn a, ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo ne ɔtreneeni sɛ ɔde yɛn bɔne bɛkyɛ yɛn, na watew yɛn ho afi nea ɛnte nyinaa ho.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

twi: Sɛ yɛka se yɛnyɛɛ bɔne a, yɛma Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔtorofo a nʼAsɛm no nni yɛn mu.
english: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

twi: Kristo, Yɛn BoafoMe mma, merekyerɛw eyi abrɛ mo na moanyɛ bɔne; na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a, yɛwɔ Yesu Kristo ɔtreneeni no a ɔsrɛ wɔ Agya no hɔ ma yɛn.
english: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have an advocate with the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

twi: Na Kristo no ankasa ne yɛn bɔne ho mpata na ɛnyɛ yɛn bɔne nko, na nnipa nyinaa bɔne.
english: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

twi: Sɛ yedi Onyankopɔn mmara so a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ yenim no.
english: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.

twi: Sɛ obi ka se, “Minim no,” nanso onni ne mmara so a, saa onipa no yɛ ɔtorofo a nokware nni ne mu.
english: Whoever says, “I know him,” but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

twi: Na sɛ obi tie nʼasɛm a, na nokware dɔ a ɔde dɔ Onyankopɔn no wie pɛyɛ wɔ ne mu. Eyi na ɛma yehu sɛ yɛte ne mu.
english: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:

twi: Na ɛsɛ sɛ nea ose ɔte ne mu no biara di Yesu Kristo anammɔn akyi.
english: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.

twi: Mmara FoforoAnuanom, saa mmara a merekyerɛw abrɛ mo yi nyɛ asɛm foforo. Ɛyɛ mmara dedaw a moate fi mfiase pɛɛ no. Mmara dedaw no yɛ ade a moate ho asɛm dedaw.
english: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.

twi: Nanso mmara a merekyerɛw abrɛ mo yi yɛ foforo na mu nokware no da adi wɔ Kristo ne mo mu. Sum no retwa mu na hann papa no gu so rehyerɛn.
english: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.

twi: Obiara a ɔka se ɔwɔ hann no mu, nanso ɔtan ne nua no wɔ sum mu besi saa dɔnhwerew yi mu.
english: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.

twi: Obiara a ɔdɔ ne nua no te hann mu, enti biribiara nni ne mu a ɛbɛma obi foforo ayɛ bɔne.
english: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.

twi: Nanso obiara a ɔtan ne nua no te sum mu. Ɔnam mu a onnim faako a ɔrekɔ, efisɛ sum no afura nʼani.
english: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.

twi: Me mma, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ esiane Kristo din nti, wɔde mo bɔne akyɛ mo.
english:
I am writing to you, dear children,
    because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

twi: Agyanom, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ munim nea ɔte ase fi mfiase no.Mmabun, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ moadi ɔbonsam so.
english:
I am writing to you, fathers,
    because you know him who is from the beginning.
I am writing to you, young men,
    because you have overcome the evil one.

twi: Mma, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ munim Agya no.Agyanom, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ munim nea ɔte ase fi mfiase no.Mmabun, merekyerɛw mo,efisɛ mowɔ ahoɔden.Onyankopɔn asɛm no te mo muna moadi ɔbonsam so.
english:
I write to you, dear children,
    because you know the Father.
I write to you, fathers,
    because you know him who is from the beginning.
I write to you, young men,
    because you are strong,
    and the word of God lives in you,
    and you have overcome the evil one.

twi: Monnnɔ wiase anaasɛ biribiara a ɛyɛ wiase de. Sɛ modɔ wiase a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ monnnɔ Agya a ɔwɔ mo mu no.
english: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.

twi: Biribiara a ɛyɛ wiase de; ɔhonam akɔnnɔ, nea nnipa hu na wɔn kɔn dɔ, biribiara a ɛwɔ wiase a nnipa hoahoa wɔn ho wɔ ho no, mu biara mfi Agya no. Ne nyinaa fi wiase.
english: For everything in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—comes not from the Father but from the world.

twi: Wiase ne mu akɔnnɔde retwa mu, nanso nea ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn apɛde no tena hɔ daa.
english: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

twi: Kristo AtamfoMe mma, awiei no abɛn. Wɔka kyerɛɛ mo se Kristo Tamfo no bɛba, nanso mprempren, Kristo atamfo bebree ada wɔn ho adi, enti yɛahu sɛ ampa awiei no abɛn.
english: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.

twi: Nokware, na saa nnipa yi nka yɛn ho na ɛno nti na wogyaw yɛn hɔ no. Na sɛ wɔka yɛn ho a, anka wɔne yɛn tenae. Nanso wogyaw yɛn hɔ, sɛnea wubehu no pefee sɛ wɔnka yɛn ho.
english: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.

twi: Mo de, Kristo ahwie Honhom Kronkron no agu mo so, enti mo nyinaa nim nokware no.
english: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

twi: Ɛnyɛ sɛ munnim nokware no nti na makyerɛw saa krataa yi, na mmom munim na munim nso sɛ, atoro biara mfi nokware mu mma.
english: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.

twi: Afei hena ne ɔtorofo? Ɛyɛ obi a ɔka se Yesu nyɛ Kristo no. Oyi ne Kristo tamfo. Ɔpo Agya no ne Ɔba no nyinaa.
english: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.

twi: Obiara nni hɔ a ɔpo Ɔba no na ɔwɔ Agya no; nea ogye Ɔba no to mu biara wɔ Agya no nso.
english: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

twi: Mommɔ mmɔden mfa asɛm a motee mfiase no nsie mo koma mu. Sɛ mode asɛm a motee mfiase no sie a, mo ne Ɔba no ne Agya no benya ayɔnkofa.
english: As for you, see that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

twi: Na eyi na Kristo no ankasa ahyɛ yɛn ho bɔ no, nkwa a enni awiei no.
english: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.

twi: Mekyerɛw mo fa wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdaadaa mo no ho.
english: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

twi: Na mo de, Kristo ahwie ne Honhom Kronkron no agu mo so. Mmere dodow a ne Honhom no te mo mu no, ɛho nhia sɛ obi foforo bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo. Efisɛ ne Honhom no kyerɛkyerɛ mo biribiara. Na nea ɔkyerɛ no nso yɛ nokware; ɛnyɛ atoro. Muntie Kristo nkyerɛkyerɛ no na montena ne mu.
english: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit—just as it has taught you, remain in him.

twi: Me mma, montena ne mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a sɛ ɔba a, yebenya akokoduru na yɛmfa aniwu nkohintaw da a ɔbɛba no.
english: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

twi: Munim sɛ Kristo yɛ ɔtreneeni. Na ɛsɛ sɛ muhu sɛ obiara a ɔyɛ ade trenee no yɛ Onyankopɔn ba.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

twi: Onyankopɔn MmaMonhwɛ ɔdɔ a Agya no dɔ yɛn. Ne dɔ a ɔdɔ yɛn no mu den nti wɔfrɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn mma. Na ɛyɛ nokware nso. Ne saa nti wiase nnim yɛn efisɛ ennim Onyankopɔn.
english: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

twi: Me nuanom, mprempren yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn mma, nanso nea daakye yɛbɛyɛ de, yennim. Nanso yenim sɛ Kristo ba a, yɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔno, efisɛ yebehu no sɛnea ɔte.
english: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

twi: Obiara a ɔwɔ saa anidaso yi wɔ Kristo mu no yɛ ne ho kronkron sɛnea Kristo yɛ kronkron no.
english: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

twi: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no bu Onyankopɔn mmara so, efisɛ bɔne yɛ mmara sobu.
english: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

twi: Munim sɛ Kristo bae se ɔrebɛfa nnipa bɔne, efisɛ ɔno de, bɔne nni ne mu.
english: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

twi: Enti obiara a ɔtena Kristo mu no nkɔ so nyɛ bɔne. Na obiara a ɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne no nhuu no, na onnim no.
english: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

twi: Mommma obi nnaadaa mo, me mma. Obiara a ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ no yɛ ɔtreneeni sɛnea Kristo yɛ ɔtreneeni no.
english: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

twi: Nea ɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne no yɛ ɔbonsam de, efisɛ ɔbonsam fi mfiase pɛe, na ɔyɛɛ bɔne. Saa asɛm yi nti na Onyankopɔn Ba no bae. Ɔbaa sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe ɔbonsam nnwuma.
english: The one who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work.

twi: Obiara a ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn Ba no nkɔ so nyɛ bɔne, efisɛ Onyankopɔn su wɔ ne mu, na esiane sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ nʼAgya nti, ontumi nkɔ so nyɛ bɔne.
english: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.

twi: Nsonoe a ɛda Onyankopɔn mma ne ɔbonsam mma ntam ne sɛ, obi a ɔnyɛ papa anaa ɔnnɔ ne nua no nyɛ Onyankopɔn ba.
english: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother and sister.

twi: Monnodɔ Mo Ho Mo HoNsɛm a motee mfiase no kyerɛ sɛ, monnodɔ mo ho.
english: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ sɛ Kain. Na ɔyɛ ɔbonsam de. Enti okum nʼankasa ne nua. Adɛn nti na Kain kum no? Efisɛ nneɛma a ɔyɛe no yɛ bɔne, nanso ne nua no de, ɔyɛɛ papa.
english: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.

twi: Enti anuanom, sɛ wiasefo tan mo a, mommma ɛnyɛ mo nwonwa.
english: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

twi: Yenim sɛ yɛafi owu mu aba nkwa mu. Yenim saa, efisɛ yɛdɔ yɛn nuanom.
english: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

twi: Obi a ɔtan ne nua no yɛ owudifo na munim nso sɛ owudifo nni nkwa a enni awiei wɔ ne mu.
english: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.

twi: Eyi na ɛma yehu sɛnea ɔdɔ te. Kristo de ne nkwa maa yɛn. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nso yɛde yɛn nkwa ma yɛn nuanom.
english: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

twi: Sɛ obi yɛ ɔdefo na ohu sɛ biribi ho hia ne nua na wanhu no mmɔbɔ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na watumi aka se ɔdɔ Onyankopɔn wɔ ne koma mu?
english: If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but has no pity on them, how can the love of God be in that person?

twi: Me mma, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛn dɔ no yɛ kasa hunu. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ɔdɔ turodoo a ɛnam nneyɛe so da ne ho adi.
english: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

twi: Eyi na ɛbɛma yɛahu sɛ yɛwɔ nokware no. Eyi na ɛbɛma yɛn koma anya gyidi wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
english: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:

twi: Sɛ yɛn koma bu yɛn fɔ mpo a, yenim sɛ Onyankopɔn so sen yɛn koma, na onim biribiara.
english: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

twi: Enti anuanom adɔfo, sɛ yɛn koma ammu yɛn fɔ a, yɛwɔ akokoduru wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
english: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

twi: Biribiara a yebisa no no, yɛn nsa ka, efisɛ yedi ne mmara so na yɛyɛ nʼapɛde nso.
english: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.

twi: Ne mmara no ka se, yennye ne Ba Yesu Kristo no din nni na yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho sɛnea Kristo hyɛɛ yɛn no.
english: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.

twi: Obiara a odi Onyankopɔn mmara so no te Onyankopɔn mu na Onyankopɔn nso te ne mu. Na eyi na ɛma yehu sɛ Onyankopɔn te yɛn mu. Yenim no saa esiane Honhom a wama yɛn no nti.
english: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.

twi: Nkyerɛkyerɛ Pa Ne Nkyerɛkyerɛ BɔneMe nuanom adɔfo, munnnye honhom no nyinaa nni. Mmom monsɔ honhom no nhwɛ sɛ efi Onyankopɔn ana. Efisɛ atoro adiyifo bebree ahwete wɔ wiase.
english: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

twi: Ɔkwan a wubetumi afa so ahu sɛ obi wɔ Onyankopɔn Honhom no ne sɛ, ɔbɛpae mu aka se, nokwarem Yesu Kristo baa onipa tebea mu.
english: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

twi: Na nea ɔnka saa mfa Yesu ho no nni honhom a efi Onyankopɔn. Saa honhom no yɛ Kristo tamfo. Motee sɛ saa na ɛbɛba, nanso ɛwɔ wiase ha dedaw.
english: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

twi: Me mma, mufi Onyankopɔn mu na moadi atoro adiyifo no so, efisɛ Honhom a ɛwɔ mo mu no wɔ tumi sen honhom a ɛwɔ wiase yi mu.
english: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

twi: Wɔka nsɛm a ɛfa wiase ho ma wiase tie, efisɛ wɔyɛ wiasefo.
english: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

twi: Nanso yɛn de, yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo. Obiara a onim Onyankopɔn no tie yɛn. Na obiara a ɔnyɛ Onyankopɔn nipa no ntie yɛn. Eyi nko ara ne ɔkwan a yɛnam so de hu nokware Honhom ne atoro honhom mu.
english: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

twi: Onyankopɔn Yɛ ƆdɔAnuanom, momma yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho efisɛ ɔdɔ fi Onyankopɔn. Obi a ɔwɔ ɔdɔ no yɛ Onyankopɔn ba na onim Onyankopɔn nso.
english: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

twi: Obi a onni ɔdɔ no nnim Onyankopɔn efisɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔdɔ.
english: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

twi: Ɔkwan a Onyankopɔn nam so da ne dɔ adi kyerɛ yɛn ne sɛ, ɔsomaa ne Ba koro no baa wiase sɛnea yɛbɛfa ne so anya nkwa.
english: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

twi: Eyi ne ɔdɔ. Ɛnkyerɛ sɛ yɛdɔ Onyankopɔn, na mmom, ɔno na ɔdɔ yɛn nti ɔsomaa ne Ba sɛ yɛmfa ne so nya yɛn bɔne ho mpata.
english: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

twi: Anuanom adɔfo, sɛ saa na Onyankopɔn dɔ yɛn a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho.
english: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

twi: Obiara nhuu Onyankopɔn da. Sɛ yɛdodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho a, na Onyankopɔn te yɛn mu na ne dɔ no awie pɛyɛ wɔ yɛn mu.
english: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

twi: Eyi na ɛma yehu pefee sɛ yɛte Onyankopɔn mu na ɔno nso te yɛn mu. Wama yɛn ne Honhom.
english: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

twi: Na yɛahu, na yɛaka akyerɛ afoforo se Agya no somaa ne Ba ma ɔbɛyɛɛ wiase Agyenkwa.
english: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

twi: Obiara a ɔpae mu ka se Yesu yɛ Onyankopɔn Ba no, na Onyankopɔn te ne mu na ɔno nso te Onyankopɔn mu.
english: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.

twi: Na yɛn ankasa nim, na yegye Onyankopɔn dɔ a ɔde dɔ yɛn no di.Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔdɔ na obiara a ɔte ɔdɔ mu no te Onyankopɔn mu, na Onyankopɔn nso te ne mu.
english:
And so we know and rely on the love God has for us.
God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdɔ yɛ pɛ wɔ yɛn mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yebenya akokoduru wɔ atemmu da no. Na yebenya saa akokoduru no nso, efisɛ yɛn abrabɔ wɔ wiase ha no te sɛ Kristo de ara pɛ.
english: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.

twi: Ehu nni ɔdɔ mu. Ɔdɔ ankasa pam hu nyinaa. Ehu ne asotwe na ɛnam. Enti nea ɔyɛ ohufo no nwie pɛyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
english: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

twi: Yɛwɔ ɔdɔ, efisɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔdɔɔ yɛn kan.
english: We love because he first loved us.

twi: Sɛ obi ka se, “Medɔ Onyankopɔn” na ɔtan ne nua a, ɔyɛ ɔtorofo. Na nea ɔnnɔ ne nua a ohu no no, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na obetumi adɔ Onyankopɔn a onhu no.
english: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.

twi: Eyi ne mmara a Kristo hyɛ maa yɛn. Nea ɔdɔ Onyankopɔn no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdɔ ne nua nso.
english: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

twi: Sɛnea Nhyehyɛe No BɛyɛObiara a ogye di sɛ Yesu yɛ Agyenkwa no yɛ Onyankopɔn ba. Na obiara a ɔdɔ Agya no dɔ ne mma no nso.
english: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

twi: Eyi na ɛma yehu sɛ yɛdɔ Onyankopɔn mma; sɛ yɛbɛdɔ Onyankopɔn na yɛadi nʼahyɛde so.
english: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

twi: Ɔdɔ a yɛdɔ Onyankopɔn no kyerɛ di a yedi nʼahyɛde so. Na nʼahyɛde no nso sodi nyɛ den mma yɛn,
english: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

twi: efisɛ Onyankopɔn ba biara tumi di wiase so. Yɛnam yɛn gyidi so di wiase so nkonim.
english: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

twi: Hena na obetumi adi wiase so? Obi a ogye di sɛ Yesu yɛ Onyankopɔn Ba no nko ara.
english: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

twi: Yesu Kristo Ho AdansediYesu Kristo yɛ obi a ɔnam nsu ne mogya so bae. Ɛnyɛ nsu nko so na ɔnam bae na mmom, nsu ne mogya. Na ɛyɛ Honhom no na edi ho adanse efisɛ Honhom no ne nokware no.
english: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

twi: Nnansefo baasa na wɔwɔ hɔ.
english: For there are three that testify:

twi: Honhom no, nsu no ne mogya no. Saa nnansefo yi adwene hyia.
english: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

twi: Yegye adanse a nnipa di no di; nanso adanse a Onyankopɔn di no mu yɛ den yiye. Na saa adanse no na Onyankopɔn adi afa ne Ba no ho.
