english: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the food they eat.

twi: Anuanom munnnyae papayɛ da.
english: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.

twi: Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔrentie nhoma a yɛakyerɛw abrɛ mo yi mu nsɛm. Sɛ muhu obi saa a, monhwɛ no yiye na montwe mo ho mfi ne ho na nʼani nwu.
english: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.

twi: Nanso mommfa saa onipa no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔtamfo na mmom mommɔ no kɔkɔ sɛ mo nua.
english: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.

twi: Na ɔno asomdwoe Awurade no ara mma mo asomdwoe daa ade nyinaa mu. Awurade ne mo nyinaa ntena.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

twi: Me ara me Paulo, me nsa ano nkyerɛw a menam so rekyia mo ni. Saa ɔkwan yi ara so na mefa kyerɛw nhoma.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

twi: Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo nyinaa.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

twi: Me, Asɔre panyin,Mekyerɛw kɔma me dɔfo pa Gaio.
english:
The elder,
To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

twi: Mʼadamfo pa, mebɔ mpae sɛ biribiara nkɔ so yiye mma wo, na nya ahoɔden sɛnea minim sɛ wowɔ ahoɔden wɔ honhom fa mu no.
english: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

twi: Anuanom bi baa ha bɛka kyerɛɛ me se, woanya nokware no mu gyidi no, na woda so kura nokware no mu no, ɛyɛɛ me anigye yiye.
english: It gave me great joy when some believers came and testified about your faithfulness to the truth, telling how you continue to walk in it.

twi: Biribiara nyɛ me anigye nkyɛn sɛ mɛte sɛ me mma no te nokware mu.
english: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

twi: Mʼadamfo pa, wudi nokware yiye wɔ adwuma a woyɛ ma anuanom no a ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔyɛ ahɔho mpo.
english: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers to you.

twi: Wɔaka ɔdɔ a wodɔ asafo a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho asɛm. Mesrɛ wo, boa wɔn wɔ wɔn akwantu no mu ma ɛnsɔ Onyankopɔn ani.
english: They have told the church about your love. Please send them on their way in a manner that honors God.

twi: Efisɛ wɔretu wɔn kwan wɔ Awurade din mu a wɔmpɛ mmoa biara mfi wɔn a wɔnyɛ agyidifo no nkyɛn.
english: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.

twi: Yɛn Kristofo na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛboa saa nnipa no sɛnea yɛne wɔn bɛyɛ nokware no ho adwuma.
english: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.

twi: DiotrefeMekyerɛw krataa tiaa bi kɔmaa asafo no, nanso Diotrefe a nʼani gye sɛ ɔyɛ wɔn panyin no ntie nea meka no.
english: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not welcome us.

twi: Sɛ meba a, mede biribiara a ɔreyɛ no ho asɛm bɛto mo anim. Mɛka nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu a ɔka fa yɛn ho ne atoro a otwa nyinaa no ho asɛm. Nanso ɛno nko ara nye mma no. Sɛ anuanom afoforo ba a, onnye wɔn, na osiw wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wogye wɔn no nso kwan, san apam wɔn fi asafo no mu.
english: So when I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, spreading malicious nonsense about us. Not satisfied with that, he even refuses to welcome other believers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

twi: Mʼadamfo pa, munnsua ade bɔne, na mmom munsua ade pa. Obiara a ɔyɛ papa no yɛ Onyankopɔn de. Na obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no nhuu Onyankopɔn ɛ.
english: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

twi: Obiara ka Demetrio ho asɛm pa, na mpo nokware no ankasa ka ne ho asɛm pa. Na yɛn nso yedi ne ho adanse pa, na munim sɛ nea yɛka no yɛ nokware.
english: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone—and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.

twi: Mewɔ nsɛm bebree ka kyerɛ mo, nanso meremfa krataa ne kyerɛwdua so nka.
english: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.

twi: Ɛrenkyɛ biara mehu mo na me ne mo akasa.
english: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.

twi: Asomdwoe nka mo.Mo nnamfonom nyinaa kyiakyia mo. Kyiakyia yɛn nnamfonom nyinaa.
english: Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.

twi: Asafo No MfiaseMʼadamfo pa Teofilo, me nhoma a edi kan a mekyerɛw wo no mu no, mekaa Yesu nnwuma a ɔyɛe ne ne nkyerɛkyerɛ
english: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach

twi: kosi bere a Onyankopɔn bɛfaa no kɔɔ ɔsoro no ho asɛm. Ansa na wɔrebɛfa no akɔ ɔsoro no, ɔnam Honhom Kronkron tumi so kyerɛkyerɛɛ nʼasuafo no.
english: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

twi: Ne wusɔre akyi no, ɔtenaa asase so adaduanan, yii ne ho adi mpɛn pii kyerɛɛ nʼasuafo no de kyerɛɛ wɔn se, ampa, ɔte ase. Ɔkaa Onyankopɔn ahenni ho asɛm nso kyerɛɛ wɔn.
english: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

twi: Da bi a ɔne wɔn redidi no ɔhyɛɛ wɔn se, “Mummfi Yerusalem, na montwɛn akyɛde a mʼAgya ahyɛ mo ho bɔ a maka ho asɛm akyerɛ mo no.
english: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.

twi: Yohane de, ɔde nsu na ɛbɔɔ asu, nanso mo de ɛrenkyɛ, wɔde Honhom Kronkron no bɛbɔ mo asu.”
english: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”

twi: Yesu SorokɔAsuafo no nyinaa ne Yesu hyiaa mu no, wobisaa no se, “Awurade, bere yi mu na wode ahenni no bɛba Israel ana?”
english: Then they gathered around him and asked him, “Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?”

twi: Yesu buaa wɔn se, “Ɛho nhia sɛ mubehu bere a Agya no nam ne tumi so ahyehyɛ ato hɔ no.
english: He said to them: “It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.

twi: Na sɛ Honhom Kronkron no ba mo so a, mubenya tumi na moayɛ me nnansefo wɔ Yerusalem ne Yudea nyinaa ne Samaria de kosi asase ano.”
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”

twi: Ɔkasa wiee no asuafo no huu no sɛ ɔnam omununkum mu rekɔ ɔsoro na wɔanhu no bio.
english: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

twi: Wogu so rehwɛ wim no, amono mu hɔ ara mmarima baanu bi a wɔhyehyɛ ntade fitafitaa begyinaa wɔn nkyɛn,
english: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

twi: kae se, “Mo mmarima a mufi Galilea, adɛn nti na mugyina ha rehwɛ wim? Yesu a wɔafa no afi mo nkyɛn kɔ ɔsoro no, sɛnea osi kɔɔ ɔsoro no, saa ara na ɔbɛsan aba.”
english: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven.”

twi: Woyi Matia Sɛ Yuda NanmusinEyi akyi no, asuafo no fii Ngo Bepɔw no so baa Yerusalem. Efi Ngo Bepɔw no so ba Yerusalem no bɛyɛ kilomita baako ne fa.
english: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.

twi: Woduu hɔ no, wɔkɔɔ ɔdan bi a na ɛwɔ aban a na wɔte so mu. Nnipa a na wɔwɔ hɔ no ne:Petro, Yohane, Yakobo ne Andrea;Filipo, Toma,Bartolomeo, Mateo,Alfeo ba Yakobo, Simon Seloteni ne Yakobo ba Yuda.
english: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

twi: Na saa asuafo yi nyinaa taa ne mmea bi te sɛ Yesu ne na Maria ne Yesu nuabarimanom hyia bɔ mpae.
english: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

twi: Nna kakraa bi akyi no gyidifo no a wɔn dodow bɛyɛ sɛ ɔha aduonu no hyiae na Petro sɔre kasae se:
english: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)

twi: Me nuanom, ɛsɛ sɛ nkɔm a Honhom Kronkron no nam Dawid so hyɛ faa Yuda ho sɛ ɛnam ne so na wɔbɛkyere Yesu no ba mu.
english: and said, “Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.

twi: Yɛn a Yesu yii yɛn no, na Yuda nso ka yɛn ho wɔ ɔsom no mu.
english: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry.”

twi: (Sika a Yuda nya fii ade bɔne a ɔyɛe no mu no, wɔde tɔɔ asase wɔ faako a owui hɔ. Ɔtew bɛhwee fam ma ne mu pae maa ne nsono tu guu so.
english: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.

twi: Nnipa a na wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa tee saa asɛm no, wɔtoo asase no din wɔ wɔn ankasa kasa mu se Hekeldama a nkyerɛase ne, Mogya Asase.)
english: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)

twi: Petro toaa so kae se, “Wɔakyerɛw wɔ Dawid nhoma mu se,“ ‘Ne fi nyɛ amamfo,na ɔfoforo nsi nʼanan mu.’
english:
“For,” said Peter, “it is written in the Book of Psalms:
“‘May his place be deserted;
    let there be no one to dwell in it,’
and,
“‘May another take his place of leadership.’

twi: Enti ɛsɛ sɛ yeyi nnipa a yɛne wɔn nantew bere a na Yesu ne yɛn di akɔneaba no nyinaa,
english: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus was living among us,

twi: fi Yohane asubɔ adwuma no so de kosi bere a wɔfaa Yesu fii yɛn nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro no, efisɛ ɛsɛ sɛ saa nnipa no mu baako bɛka yɛn ho ne yɛn di Yesu wusɔre no ho adanse.”
english: beginning from John’s baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

twi: Woyii nnipa baanu. Ɔbaako din de Yosef a na wɔfrɛ no Barsaba, na wɔtaa frɛ no Yusto nso. Nea na ɔka ho no nso din de Matia.
english: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

twi: Afei asuafo no bɔɔ mpae se, “Awurade, wunim obiara koma mu. Ɛno nti kyerɛ yɛn nnipa baanu yi mu nea woayi no
english: Then they prayed, “Lord, you know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen

twi: sɛ ommesi Yuda a wanya ne baabi kɔ no anan mu mmɛyɛ asomafodwuma no.”
english: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs.”

twi: Afei asuafo no bɔɔ wɔn so ntonto maa esii Matia. Enti wɔfaa no kaa asomafo dubaako no ho.
english: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

twi: Pentekoste DaPentekoste da no duu no, na asuafo no nyinaa ahyia wɔ faako.
english: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

twi: Amono mu hɔ ara, nne bi te sɛ ahum a ɛretu fi ɔsoro ba bɛhyɛɛ ofi a na wɔwɔ mu no ma.
english: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

twi: Ogya a ɛredɛw a ɛte sɛ tɛkrɛma besisii wɔn so mmaako mmaako.
english: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

twi: Honhom Kronkron no hyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ma, na wɔkaa kasa foforo, sɛnea Honhom no maa wɔn ho kwan no.
english: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

twi: Saa bere no na Yudafo bi a wɔfɛre Nyame fi mmeaemmeae aba Yerusalem.
english: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

twi: Wɔtee nea ɛrekɔ so no, wɔbɔɔ twi behyiae, na ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwonwa ne ahodwiriw, efisɛ obiara tee sɛ wɔreka ne kurom kasa.
english: When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard their own language being spoken.

twi: Enti wobisae se, “Na saa nnipa yi a wɔrekasa yi nyɛ Galileafo ana?
english: Utterly amazed, they asked: “Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?

twi: Na adɛn nti na yɛte sɛ wɔreka Onyankopɔn anwonwadwuma ho asɛm wɔ yɛn a yɛyɛ
english: Then how is it that each of us hears them in our native language?

twi: Partifo, Mediafo ne Elamfo, ne wɔn a wɔte Mesopotamia ne Yudea ne Kapadokia, Ponto, Asia,
english: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

twi: Frigia ne Pamfilia, Misraim ne Libia fa a ɛbɛn Kirene ne ahɔho a wofi Roma, Yudafo ne wɔn a wɔasakra aba Yudasom mu,
english: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome

twi: ne Kretafo ne Arabfo mu biara kasa mu yi?”
english: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”

twi: Wɔde ahodwiriw bisae se, “Eyi ase ne dɛn?”
english: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”

twi: Afoforo nso dii wɔn ho fɛw se, “Saa nnipa yi abobow nsa.”
english: Some, however, made fun of them and said, “They have had too much wine.”

twi: Petro Kasa Kyerɛ Dɔm NoPetro ne asomafo dubaako no sɔre gyinaa hɔ na ɔkasaa denneennen kyerɛɛ nnipa no se, “Me nuanom Yudafo ne mo a mote Yerusalem nyinaa, muntie asɛm a mereka yi.
english: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: “Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

twi: Saa nnipa yi mmow nsa sɛnea mususuw no, efisɛ ade nnya nkyee a ɛsɛ sɛ obi nom nsa bow.
english: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!

twi: Asɛm a asi yi na odiyifo Yoel hyɛɛ ho nkɔm se:
english: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

twi: “ ‘Onyankopɔn kae se, nna a edi akyiri no,mehwie me Honhom no agu nnipa nyinaa so.Mo mmabarima ne mo mmabea bɛhyɛ nkɔm,mo mmerante nso ahu anisoade.Na mo mpanyin nso asoso adae.
english:
“‘In the last days, God says,
    I will pour out my Spirit on all people.
Your sons and daughters will prophesy,
    your young men will see visions,
    your old men will dream dreams.

twi: Saa mmere no mu no,mehwie me Honhom agu mʼasomfo mpo so,mmarima ne mmea, ama wɔahyɛ nkɔm.
english:
Even on my servants, both men and women,
    I will pour out my Spirit in those days,
    and they will prophesy.

twi: Mede mogya ne ogya ne wusiw kumɔnnbɛyɛ anwonwade ne nsɛnkyerɛnnewɔ ɔsoro ne asase so.
english:
I will show wonders in the heavens above
    and signs on the earth below,
    blood and fire and billows of smoke.

twi: Ansa na Awurade da kɛse no bɛba no,owia beduru sumna ɔsram nso ayɛ sɛ mogya.
english:
The sun will be turned to darkness
    and the moon to blood
    before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.

twi: Na obiara a ɔbɛbɔAwurade din no benya nkwa.’
english:
And everyone who calls
    on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

twi: “Israelfo, muntie! Yesu Nasareni no yɛ ɔbarima bi a ne dwuma kronkron a obedii no daa adi wɔ tumi ne anwonwade ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a Onyankopɔn nam ne so yɛe a mo ankasa di ho adanse no mu.
english: “Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.

twi: Onyankopɔn ankasa fi ne pɛ ne ne nhumu mu sii gyinae yii Yesu maa mo, na mode no maa nnebɔneyɛfo ma wɔbɔɔ no asennua mu kum no.
english: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.

twi: Nanso Onyankopɔn nyan no fii owu mu ma oyii no fii owuyaw mu, efisɛ owu antumi anni ne so.”
english: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

twi: Asɛm a Dawid ka faa ne ho ne sɛ,“Mihu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa.Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa nti,merenhinhim da.
english:
David said about him:
“‘I saw the Lord always before me.
    Because he is at my right hand,
    I will not be shaken.

twi: Ɛno nti me kra ani gye, na me tɛkrɛma di ahurusi.Me nipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoe mu.
english:
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices;
    my body also will rest in hope,

twi: Efisɛ worennyaw me awufo mu.Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔw.
english:
because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead,
    you will not let your holy one see decay.

twi: Woakyerɛ me nkwagye kwan;na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim.
english:
You have made known to me the paths of life;
    you will fill me with joy in your presence.’

twi: “Anuanom, ɛsɛ sɛ meda mʼadwene adi pefee wɔ yɛn panyin Dawid ho. Owui na wosiee no, na ne nna da so wɔ hɔ besi nnɛ.
english: “Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.

twi: Na ɔyɛ odiyifo a onim bɔ bi a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ no no. Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ bɔ se ɔbɛyɛ Dawid asefo no mu baako ɔhene, sɛnea Dawid yɛ ɔhene no ara pɛ.
english: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.

twi: Dawid huu nea Onyankopɔn rebɛyɛ no ɔkasa faa owusɔre a ɛfa Agyenkwa no ho se, ‘Wɔannyaw no awufo mu. Ne honam nso amporɔw.’
english: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.

twi: Onyankopɔn anyan saa Yesu yi afi owu mu, na yɛn nyinaa yɛ saa asɛm yi ho nnansefo.
english: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.

twi: Wɔahyɛ no anuonyam de no akɔtena Onyankopɔn nifa so ma ne nsa aka Honhom Kronkron no a Agya no hyɛɛ no ho bɔ no; ɛno na wahwie agu yɛn so, na ɛho nsɛnkyerɛnne na muhu na mote yi.
english: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

twi: Dawid ankasa de, wankɔ ɔsoro, na mmom ɔkae se,“ ‘Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me wura se,“Tena me nsa nifa so ha,
english:
For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said,
“‘The Lord said to my Lord:
    “Sit at my right hand

twi: kosi sɛ mede wʼatamfobɛyɛ wʼanan ntiaso.” ’
english:
until I make your enemies
    a footstool for your feet.”’

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Israel nyinaa hu sɛ, mo na mobɔɔ saa Yesu yi a Onyankopɔn ayɛ no Awurade ne Agyenkwa no asennua mu.”
english: “Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah.”

twi: Bere a nnipa no tee saa asɛm yi, ɛhaw wɔn yiye. Enti wobisaa Petro ne asomafo a wɔaka no se, “Anuanom, dɛn na yɛnyɛ?”
english: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

twi: Petro ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Monsakra mo adwene na momma wɔmmɔ mo asu wɔ Yesu Kristo din mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde mo bɔne bɛkyɛ mo na moanya Onyankopɔn akyɛde a ɛyɛ Honhom Kronkron no.
english: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

twi: Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Honhom Kronkron yi ho bɔ maa mo ne mo mma ne wɔn a wɔtete akyirikyiri ne wɔn a Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛfrɛ wɔn aba ne nkyɛn no nyinaa.”
english: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call.”

twi: Petro kaa nsɛm bebree kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Munnye mo ho mfi asotwe a ɛreba saa nnebɔneyɛfo yi so no mu.”
english: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, “Save yourselves from this corrupt generation.”

twi: Wɔn mu dodow no ara gyee asɛm no di ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu. Saa da no, nnipa bɛyɛ mpensa na wɔbɛkaa agyidifo no ho.
english: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.

twi: Asafo No AsetenaDaa na wɔde wɔn adagyew nyinaa sua asomafo no nkyerɛkyerɛ. Wɔne wɔn nyaa ayɔnkofa, hyia didi bɔɔ mu ne wɔn bɔɔ mpae.
english: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

twi: Asomafo no yɛɛ anwonwade ahorow bebree ma obiara a ohuu no ho dwiriw no.
english: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.

twi: Gyidifo no nyinaa kɔɔ so tenaa ase sɛ nnipa koro, na wɔkyekyɛɛ wɔn ahode mu memaa wɔn ho wɔn ho.
english: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

twi: Wɔtɔn wɔn ahode kyekyɛɛ sika a wonya fii mu no maa wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛnea ɛho hia obiara.
english: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.

twi: Daa na wɔbɔ mu hyia wɔ asɔredan mu de anigye ne koma pa bɔ mu didi wɔ wɔn afi mu. Wɔkamfoo Onyankopɔn, nyaa anuonyam wɔ nnipa anim.
english: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,

twi: Da biara na Awurade de wɔn a ogye wɔn nkwa no bɛka wɔn ho.
english: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

twi: Obubuafo Bi AyaresaDa bi Petro ne Yohane kɔɔ asɔredan mu awia nnɔnabiɛsa a na ɛyɛ bere a wɔde bɔ mpae.
english: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.

twi: Wɔreyɛ adu asɔredan pon a wɔfrɛ no Ɔpon Fɛfɛ ano no, wohuu obubuafo bi sɛ ɔda hɔ. Na wɔsoa saa obubuafo yi de no bɛto ɔpon yi ano da biara ma ɔsrɛsrɛ sika fi wɔn a wɔrekɔ asɔredan no mu no nkyɛn.
english: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.

twi: Bere a ohuu sɛ Petro ne Yohane rekɔ mu no, ɔsrɛɛ wɔn se wɔmma no biribi.
english: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.

twi: Wɔhwɛɛ nʼanim dinn na Petro ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Hwɛ yɛn!”
english: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, “Look at us!”

twi: Ɔhwɛɛ wɔn susuw sɛ wɔbɛma no biribi.
english: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.

twi: Nanso Petro ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Sika de, minni bi; na nea mewɔ a mede bɛma wo ne sɛ Yesu Kristo Nasareni din mu, sɔre nantew!”
english: Then Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.”

twi: Afei Petro de ne nsa nifa soo no mu maa no so gyinaa hɔ. Prɛko pɛ, nʼanan mu yɛɛ den.
english: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.

twi: Ohuruw gyinaa nʼanan so na ofii ase nantewee. Afei ɔne wɔn nyinaa kɔɔ asɔredan no mu a ɔrehuruhuruw, rekamfo Onyankopɔn.
english: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.

twi: Nnipa no nyinaa huu no sɛ ɔnam reyi Onyankopɔn ayɛ.
english: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

twi: Wohuu no no, wohuu sɛ ɔno ne ɔsrɛsrɛni a na ɔda asɔredan pon a wɔfrɛ no Ɔpon Fɛfɛ no ano no, wɔn ho dwiriw wɔn.
english: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

twi: Petro Kasa Kyerɛ Nnipa NoBere a nnipa no huu sɛ ɔbarima no ne Petro ne Yohane nam no, wɔn ho dwiriw wɔn; enti wotuu mmirika kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn wɔ baabi a wɔfrɛ no Salomo Abrannaa no so hɔ.
english: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.

twi: Bere a Petro huu nnipadɔm no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Israelfo, adɛn na eyi yɛ mo nwonwa? Adɛn nti na mohwɛ yɛn, susuw sɛ yɛnam yɛn tumi anaa yɛn som pa so na asa ɔbarima yi yare?
english: When Peter saw this, he said to them: “Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

twi: Abraham, Isak ne Yakob Nyankopɔn ne yɛn nenanom Nyankopɔn ama ne somfo Yesu ɔsoro anuonyam. Mode no maa atumfo; na bere a Pilato yɛɛ sɛ obegyaa no no mpo, mopoo no wɔ nʼanim.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.

twi: Na ɔyɛ Kronkron, ɔteɛ; nanso mopoo no na mosrɛɛ Pilato sɛ ɔmfa odwotwafo mma mo.
english: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.

twi: Enti mukum obi a ogye nnipa kɔ nkwa mu. Nanso Onyankopɔn nyan no fii awufo mu na yɛyɛ eyi ho nnansefo.
english: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

twi: Tumi a ɛwɔ ne din mu no na ɛmaa saa obubuafo yi nyaa ahoɔden. Gyidi a yɛwɔ wɔ ne din mu no na ɛma yetumi yɛɛ saa anwonwade a muhu yi. Gyidi a yɛwɔ wɔ Yesu din mu no na ama ne ho atɔ no a ogyina mo anim mprempren yi.
english: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.

twi: “Afei me nuanom, minim sɛ nea mo ne mo mpanyimfo yɛɛ Yesu no, na onim na munnim.
english: “Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

twi: Tete no, Onyankopɔn nam nʼadiyifo so kae se Agyenkwa no behu amane. Na ɔnam saa kwan yi so ma ɛbaa mu.
english: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.

twi: Monsakra mo adwene na momfa mo ho mma Onyankopɔn na wɔbɛpepa mo bɔne, na moanya foforoyɛ mmere afi Awurade hɔ,
english: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

twi: na wasoma Yesu a ɔyɛ Agyenkwa a wɔayi no ama mo no.
english: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.

twi: Sɛnea Onyankopɔn nam nʼadiyifo akronkron so aka dedaw no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtena ɔsoro kosi sɛ nneɛma nyinaa bɛyɛ foforo.
english: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.

twi: Na Mose kae se, ‘Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn bɛsoma odiyifo aba mo nkyɛn sɛnea ɔsomaa me a mifi mo mu no. Ɛsɛ sɛ mutie asɛm biara a ɔbɛka akyerɛ mo.
english: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.

twi: Obiara a wantie nea odiyifo no bɛka no, wobeyi no afi Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ho na wɔasɛe no.’
english: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’

twi: “Samuel ne adiyifo a akyiri no wɔbae no nyinaa nso aka asɛm a asi nnɛ yi ho asɛm pɛn.
english: “Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.

twi: Onyankopɔn bɔ a ɔnam adiyifo so hyɛe no yɛ mo dea. Saa ara nso na mowɔ kyɛfa wɔ apam a Onyankopɔn ne mo agyanom pam no mu. Sɛnea ɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham se, ‘Wʼasefo so na menam behyira wiasefo nyinaa.’
english: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’

twi: Enti Onyankopɔn dii kan yii ne somfo somaa no baa mo nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɛdom mo na mo nyinaa nnan mfi mo akwammɔne no so.”
english: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”

twi: Petro Ne Yohane Gyina AsenniiBere a Petro ne Yohane gu so rekasa akyerɛ nkurɔfo no, asɔfo ne ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ awɛmfo a wɔhwɛ asɔredan no so no ne Sadukifo baa wɔn nkyɛn.
english: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.

twi: Wɔn bo fuw yiye, efisɛ na saa asomafo yi rekyerɛkyerɛ nnipa no sɛ Yesu asɔre afi owu mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ awufo tumi nyan ba nkwa mu.
english: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

twi: Wɔkyeree asomafo no, nanso esiane sɛ na ade asa nti, wɔde wɔn guu afiase kosii adekyee.
english: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.

twi: Nanso nnipa a wɔtee asɛm no mu dodow no ara bɛyɛ sɛ mpem anum gyee asɛm no dii.
english: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.

twi: Ade kyee no, Yudafo mpanyin, mpanyimfo ne Kyerɛwsɛm no akyerɛkyerɛfo hyiaa wɔ Yerusalem.
english: The next day the rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.

twi: Wohyiaa Ɔsɔfopanyin Anas ne Kaiafa ne Yohane ne Aleksandro ne afoforo a wofi Ɔsɔfopanyin no abusua mu.
english: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and others of the high priest’s family.

twi: Wɔma wɔde asomafo baanu yi baa wɔn anim bisaa wɔn se, “Tumi bɛn anaa hena din na mode yɛɛ eyi?”
english: They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”

twi: Petro a Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ no ma no buae se, “Ɔman mpanyimfo ne atitiriw.
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: “Rulers and elders of the people!

twi: Sɛ nnɛ mugyina ha bisa yɛn ade pa a yɛyɛ maa obubuafo no maa ne ho tɔɔ no no a,
english: If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a man who was lame and are being asked how he was healed,

twi: ɛno de ɛsɛ sɛ mo ne Israelfo nyinaa hu sɛ saa onipa a ogyina ha yi, ɛnam Yesu Kristo a ofi Nasaret a mobɔɔ no asennua mu na Onyankopɔn nyan no fii awufo mu no tumi mu na ne ho ayɛ no den.”
english: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

twi: Yesu ne onipa a Kyerɛwsɛm ka fa ne ho se,“ ‘Ɔbo a mo adansifo poe no naabɛyɛ tweatibo.’
english:
Jesus is
“‘the stone you builders rejected,
    which has become the cornerstone.’

twi: Ɔno nko ara mu na nkwagye wɔ; efisɛ din biara nni wiase ha a nnipa nam so benya nkwagye.”
english: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.”

twi: Ɛyɛɛ agyinatufo no ahodwiriw sɛ Petro ne Yohane a wonsuaa nhoma da na wɔyɛ nnipa teta no tumi kasaa akokoduru so saa. Wohuu sɛ saa asomafo yi ne Yesu nantewee.
english: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.

twi: Nnipa no antumi anka asɛm biara bio, efisɛ wohuu sɛ ɔbarima a na ne ho atɔ no no ne Petro ne Yohane gyina hɔ.
english: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.

twi: Wɔma wofii asennii hɔ ma wodwinnwen asɛm no ho.
english: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.

twi: Wobisabisaa wɔn ho wɔn ho se, “Dɛn na yɛnyɛ saa nnipa yi? Obiara a ɔwɔ Yerusalem ha ate sɛ saa nnipa yi ayɛ anwonwade a yɛrentumi ntwa ho nkontompo.
english: “What are we going to do with these men?” they asked. “Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.

twi: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a saa nnipa yi remma saa asɛm yi ntrɛw nkɔ afoforo nkyɛn no, momma yɛmfrɛ wɔn, mmɔ wɔn kɔkɔ, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔremmɔ Yesu din nkyerɛ obiara bio.”
english: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them to speak no longer to anyone in this name.”

twi: Wɔfrɛɛ asomafo baanu yi bae, hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wonni ho kwan biara sɛ wɔbɔ Yesu Kristo din anaa wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ne din mu.
english: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

twi: Petro ne Yohane buaa wɔn se, “Sɛ yebetie Onyankopɔn anaa yebetie mo no, emu nea ɛwɔ he na eye? Mo ara mummua mfa.
english: But Peter and John replied, “Which is right in God’s eyes: to listen to you, or to him? You be the judges!

twi: Nea yɛahu ne nea yɛate de, yɛrentumi nnyae ho asɛnka.”
english: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard.”

twi: Agyinatufo no bɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ bio gyaa wɔn, efisɛ wɔannya biribiara annyina so antwe wɔn aso; afei nso na nnipa no nyinaa rekamfo Onyankopɔn wɔ asɛm a asi no ho.
english: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.

twi: Na ɔbarima a wɔnam anwonwakwan so saa no yare no adi boro mfe aduanan.
english: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.

twi: Agydifo No MpaebɔWogyaa Petro ne Yohane pɛ na wɔkɔɔ agyidifo a wɔaka no nkyɛn kɔkaa nea asɔfo mpanyin ne mpanyimfo no kae no kyerɛɛ wɔn.
english: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

twi: Bere a wɔtee saa asɛm no, wɔn nyinaa bɔɔ mu bɔɔ mpae se, “Owura, Ɔbɔade a wobɔɔ ɔsoro, asase ne po ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu,
english: When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “you made the heavens and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.

twi: wonam Honhom Kronkron so nam yɛn nena Dawid a ɔyɛ wʼakoa no so ma ɔkae se,“Adɛn nti na amanaman no hyehyɛ bɔne ho,na nnipa no bɔ pɔw hunu yi?
english:
You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David:
“‘Why do the nations rage
    and the peoples plot in vain?

twi: Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyinana atumfo bɔ mu tu agyinatia Awuradene Agyenkwa no.
english:
The kings of the earth rise up
    and the rulers band together
against the Lord
    and against his anointed one.’

twi: Ampa ara Herode ne Pontio Pilato ne amanamanmufo ne Israelfo hyiaa wɔ kurow kɛse yi mu sɔre tiaa Yesu a ɔyɛ Ɔsomfo Kronkron a woatew ne ho no.
english: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

twi: Wohyia yɛɛ biribiara a wonam wo tumi ne wo pɛ so ahyɛ ato hɔ sɛ ɛbɛba mu no.
english: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.

twi: Afei Awurade, hwɛ ahunahuna a wɔrehunahuna yɛn yi na ma yɛn a yɛyɛ wʼasomfo yi mfa akokoduru nka wʼasɛm yi.
english: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.

twi: Ma wo nsa so fa sa nyarewa, na fa wo somfo Kronkron Yesu Kristo din so yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade.”
english: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus.”

twi: Wɔbɔɔ mpae wiee no, faako a wohyiaa hɔ wosowee. Honhom Kronkron bɛhyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ma ma na wofii ase de akokoduru kaa Onyankopɔn asɛm.
english: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

twi: Agyidifo No AsetenaAgyidifo no nyinaa tenaa ase sɛ nnipa koro. Wɔn mu bi anka se nʼankasa ahode bi yɛ ɔno nko ara de; biribiara a wɔwɔ no, wɔn nyinaa kyekyɛɛ mu pɛ fae.
english: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.

twi: Asomafo no nam tumi a emu yɛ den so dii Awurade Yesu wusɔre no ho adanse na Onyankopɔn hyiraa wɔn nyinaa.
english: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all

twi: Biribiara ho anhia obiara a ɔfra kuw no mu, efisɛ wɔn a na wɔwɔ nsase ne afi no tontɔnee, de sika a wonya fii mu no
english: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales

twi: brɛɛ asomafo no ma wɔkyekyɛɛ sɛnea ɛho hia obiara.
english: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.

twi: Yosef a na ɔyɛ Lewini a ofi Kipro a na asomafo no frɛ no Barnaba, a ne nkyerɛase ne “Nkuranhyɛ Ba” no,
english: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means “son of encouragement”),

twi: tɔn nʼasase de sika a onyae no brɛɛ asomafo no.
english: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.

twi: Anania Ne SafiraƆbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Anania ne ne yere Safira kɔtɔn wɔn agyapade bi.
english: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.

twi: Ɔne ne yere yi yɛɛ adwene de sika a wonyae no bi siei, na wɔde nkae no brɛɛ asomafo no.
english: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.

twi: Petro bisaa no se, “Anania, adɛn nti na woama ɔbonsam ho kwan ama wabɛhyɛ wo mu na woadi atoro akyerɛ Honhom Kronkron no na wode sika a wunyaa no bi asie?
english: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?

twi: Ansa na worebɛtɔn agyapade no na ɛnyɛ wʼankasa wo de; wotɔn wiee no nso sika a wunyae no, na ɛnyɛ wo de; na adɛn nti na woyɛɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛyɛ nea woayɛ yi? Ɛnyɛ nnipa na woadi atoro akyerɛ wɔn, na mmom woadi atoro akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.”
english: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God.”

twi: Anania tee saa asɛm yi ara pɛ, otwa hwee fam wui; na ehu kaa obiara a ɔtee saa asɛm no.
english: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

twi: Wɔn mu mmerante no ba bɛkyekyeree amu no fii adi kosiee no.
english: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew abiɛsa akyi no, ne yere a na onnim asɛm a asi no baa hɔ.
english: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

twi: Petro bisaa no se, “Wo ne wo kunu, motɔn mo asase no, sika a munyae nyinaa ara ni? Ka kyerɛ me.”Obuaa se, “Yiw ne nyinaa ne no.”
english:
Peter asked her, “Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?”
“Yes,” she said, “that is the price.”

twi: Petro ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Adɛn nti na wo ne wo kunu penee so sɛ mobɛsɔ Onyankopɔn Honhom ahwɛ? Hwɛ! Nnipa a wokosiee wo kunu no gyina ɔpon yi akyi, na saa ara na wo nso, wɔbɛsoa wo akosie wo.”
english: Peter said to her, “How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”

twi: Amono mu hɔ ara, otwa hwee Petro anim wui. Mmerante no behuu sɛ wawu no, wɔsoaa no kosiee no wɔ ne kunu nkyɛn.
english: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

twi: Ehu kɛse bɔɔ asafo no nyinaa ne nnipa a wɔtee saa asɛm no.
english: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.

twi: Asomafo No Sa NyarewaNa asomafo no taa hyia wɔ asɔredan no fa baabi a wɔfrɛ no “Salomo Abrannaa” so hɔ. Sɛ wohyia wɔ hɔ saa a, wɔyɛ anwonwade ahorow pii.
english: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na nnipa a wɔnka wɔn ho no di wɔn ho adanse pa de, nanso wɔn mu biara antumi amfa wɔn ho ankɔbɔ asomafo no ho.
english: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.

twi: Akyiri no, nnipa dodow a wogyee Awurade dii no bɛkaa agyidifo no ho.
english: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.

twi: Esiane anwonwade a na asomafo no reyɛ no nti, wɔsoaa ayarefo baa mmɔnten so de wɔn totoo mpa ne akɛtɛ so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Petro sunsuma bɛtɔ wɔn mu bi so kɛkɛ.
english: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.

twi: Nkurɔfo a wofifi nkurow a atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no de wɔn ayarefo ne wɔn a ahonhommɔne wɔ wɔn mu no ba ma wɔsaa wɔn nyinaa yare.
english: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.

twi: Wɔtaa Asomafo NoƆsɔfopanyin ne ne dɔm ne Sadukifo no ani beree asomafo no so yiye enti wɔyɛɛ adwene sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn aso.
english: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.

twi: Ɛno nti, wɔkyeree asomafo no de wɔn koguu afiase.
english: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

twi: Da no ara anadwo, Awurade bɔfo behiɛɛ afiase apon no dii asomafo no anim ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se,
english: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.

twi: “Monkɔ asɔredan mu nkɔka nkwa foforo yi ho asɛm nkyerɛ nnipa no.”
english: “Go, stand in the temple courts,” he said, “and tell the people all about this new life.”

twi: Asomafo no dii asɛm a ɔbɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no so; enti anɔpahema no wɔkɔɔ asɔredan mu hɔ kofii ase kyerɛkyerɛe.Ɔsɔfopanyin no ne ne dɔm no frɛɛ Yudafo mpanyin ma wɔyɛɛ nhyiamu kɛse bi; afei wɔsoma ma wɔkɔɔ afiase hɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfa asomafo no mmra wɔn anim.
english:
At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people.
When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.

twi: Nanso, bere a nnipa no duu afiase hɔ no, wɔanhu asomafo no; enti wɔsan ba bɛbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ se,
english: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,

twi: “Bere a yeduu afiase hɔ no, yehuu sɛ wɔatoto afiase apon no nyinaa mu petee a awɛmfo no gyinagyina ano. Nanso yebuebuee apon no, yɛanhu obiara wɔ mu.”
english: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”

twi: Bere a ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ asɔredan mu awɛmfo no so ne asɔfo mpanyin no tee saa asɛm no, wɔn adwene mu yɛɛ wɔn naa, efisɛ na wonhu asɛm a asi.
english: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.

twi: Ankyɛ koraa na ɔbarima bi baa hɔ bɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Nnipa a mode wɔn guu afiase no gyinagyina asɔredan no mu rekyerɛkyerɛ nnipa no.”
english: Then someone came and said, “Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people.”

twi: Awɛmfo no so panyin no tee asɛm no, ɔne ne nkurɔfo no kɔkyeree asomafo no de wɔn bae. Awɛmfo no so panyin no ne awɛmfo no amfa asomafo no amma ɔhyɛ so, efisɛ na wonim sɛ, sɛ wɔyɛ saa a, nnipa no besiw wɔn abo.
english: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.

twi: Wɔde asomafo no begyinaa agyinatufo no anim ma Ɔsɔfopanyin no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se,
english: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.

twi: “Yɛhyɛɛ mo sɛ monnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Yesu din mu, nanso moantie. Mode mo nkyerɛkyerɛ yi afa Yerusalem baabiara, na mopɛ sɛ mokyerɛ sɛ, yɛn na yekum saa ɔbarima no!”
english: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood.”

twi: Petro ne asomafo a wɔka ne ho no buaa wɔn se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ yetie Onyankopɔn na ɛnyɛ nnipa,
english: Peter and the other apostles replied: “We must obey God rather than human beings!

twi: efisɛ mobɔɔ Yesu asennua mu, kum no no, yɛn agyanom Nyankopɔn nyan no fii owu mu.
english: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.

twi: Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no anuonyam de no tenaa ne nsa nifa so sɛ Ɔhene ne Agyenkwa a ɛnam no so bɛma Israelfo asakra wɔn adwene na wɔde wɔn bɔne akyɛ wɔn.
english: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.

twi: Yɛne Honhom Kronkron a ɛyɛ akyɛde a Awurade de ma wɔn a wotie no no di eyi ho adanse.”
english: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

twi: Agyinatufo no tee asɛm no, wɔn bo fuwii, na wɔkae se wobekum asomafo no.
english: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.

twi: Nanso wɔn mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Gamaliel a ɔyɛ Farisini na ɔsan yɛ Kyerɛwsɛm no kyerɛkyerɛfo a na nnipa bu no no sɔre gyina hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa asomafo no mfi adi.
english: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.

twi: Afei, ɔkasa kyerɛɛ agyinatufo no se, “Me nuanom Israel mmarima, munnwen nea mopɛ sɛ moyɛ saa nnipa yi ho yiye.
english: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: “Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.

twi: Ɛnkyɛe biara na ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Teuda sɔre kaa se ɔyɛ onipa titiriw bi maa nnipa bɛyɛ ahannan tu dii nʼakyi. Nanso wokum no maa nʼakyidifo no nyinaa bɔɔ ahwete.
english: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

twi: Nʼakyi na Yuda a ofi Galilea nso sɔree nnipakan bere no mu. Ɔno nso nnipa pii dii nʼakyi. Saa ara na ɔno nso wokum no maa nʼakyidifo no bɔɔ ahwete.
english: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

twi: Ɛno nti mitu mo fo se, munnyaa saa nnipa yi ma wɔnkɔ wɔn baabi. Sɛ wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wɔn nnwuma yi fi onipa a, ebegu.
english: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.

twi: Nanso sɛ efi Onyankopɔn a, morentumi nsiw wɔn kwan. Mubehu sɛ moreko atia Onyankopɔn.”
english: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God.”

twi: Agyinatufo no tiee Gamaliel afotu no. Wɔma wɔde asomafo no ba ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn mmaa hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmmɔ Yesu din mfa nkyerɛkyerɛ bio. Afei wogyaa wɔn.
english: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

twi: Esiane sɛ asomafo no huu sɛ ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wohu amane wɔ Yesu din mu no nti, wɔde anigye na efii asennii hɔ.
english: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.

twi: Wɔannyae Yesu Kristo ho asɛmpa no ka ne nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ hyiadan ne afi mu da.
english: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.

twi: Woyi Asafo No Mu AsomfoBere bi akyi a na asuafo no redɔɔso no, akasakasa sii Hebrifo a wɔka Arameike ne Hebrifo a wɔka Hela kasa no ntam. Na Hebrifo a wɔka Hela no asɛm ne sɛ, Hebrifo a wɔka Arameike no nhwɛ wɔn akunafo yiye.
english: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

twi: Enti asomafo dumien no frɛɛ asuafo no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Ɛnsɛ sɛ yegyae Onyankopɔn asɛnka kɔkyɛ aduan.
english: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, “It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.

twi: Enti anuanom, munyi mo mu nnipa baason a Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ wɔn ma na wonim nyansa na wɔahwɛ aka saa asɛm no.
english: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them

twi: Yɛn ankasa de, yɛde yɛn adagyew nyinaa bɛbɔ mpae aka Asɛmpa no.”
english: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word.”

twi: Nnipa no nyinaa penee adwene a asomafo no de bae no so. Enti, woyii Stefano a na gyidi ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ no ma no, ne Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanor, Timon, Pamina ne Nikolao a ofi Antiokia a na anka ɔwɔ Yudasom mu no.
english: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

twi: Wɔde saa nnipa yi kyerɛɛ asuafo no ma wɔbɔɔ mpae de wɔn nsa guu wɔn so.
english: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

twi: Nnipa pii gyee asɛm no di maa wɔn mu dodow no ara bɛkaa wɔn ho. Yudafo no mu pii nso gyee wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ no dii.
english: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.

twi: Wɔkyere StefanoStefano a Onyankopɔn adom ne tumi ahyɛ no ma no yɛɛ anwonwade ahorow bebree wɔ asafo no mu.
english: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

twi: Nanso da koro bi, nnipa bi a wofi Yudafo hyiadan bi a wɔfrɛ no “Ahofadifo Hyiadan” no mu a wɔyɛ Yudafo a wofi Kirene ne Aleksandria ne wɔn a wofi Kilikia ne Asia no ne Stefano gyee akyinnye.
english: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.

twi: Nanso Honhom no maa Stefano nyansa ma ɔde kasae a obiara antumi anka hwee.
english: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.

twi: Ɛno nti wɔka hyɛɛ nkurɔfo bi ano se, “Yɛtee sɛ ɔreka abususɛm atia Mose ne Onyankopɔn.”
english: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, “We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God.”

twi: Wɔnam saa ɔkwan yi so maa nnipa no ne mpanyin no ne Kyerɛwsɛm no akyerɛkyerɛfo no sɔre tiaa Stefano. Wɔbɛkyeree Stefano de no kɔɔ baguafo anim.
english: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.

twi: Afei, wɔde nnipa ba bedii adansekurum tiaa Stefano se, “Saa onipa yi ka abususɛm tia yɛn asɔredan kronkron no ne Mose Mmara no daa.
english: They produced false witnesses, who testified, “This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

twi: Yɛtee mpo sɛ ɔreka se, saa Yesu Nasareni no bedwiriw yɛn asɔredan no agu na wasesa yɛn amanne a Mose de gyaw yɛn no!”
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us.”

twi: Nnipa a na wɔte bagua mu hɔ no nyinaa hwɛɛ Stefano anim, na wohuu sɛ nʼanim ayɛ te sɛ ɔsoro ɔbɔfo anim.
english: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

twi: Stefano Yi Ne Ho AnoƆsɔfopanyin no bisaa Stefano se, “Nsɛm a wɔaka agu wo so no nyinaa yɛ nokware ana?”
english: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”

twi: Stefano buae se, “Anuanom ne agyanom, muntie me! Ansa na yɛn agya Abraham rebefi Mesopotamia akɔtena Haran no, Onyankopɔn daa nʼanuonyam adi kyerɛɛ no,
english: To this he replied: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.

twi: ka kyerɛɛ no se, ‘Fi wʼabusuafo nkyɛn ne wʼasase so kɔ baabi a mɛkyerɛ wo no.’
english: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’

twi: “Enti ofii Kaldea asase so kɔtenaa Haran. Abraham agya wu akyi no Onyankopɔn ma ɔbɛtenaa asase a mote so mprempren yi so.
english: “So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.

twi: Onyankopɔn amfa asase no fa baabiara ankyɛ Abraham sɛ nʼankasa de. Nanso Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no bɔ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɔne nʼasefo nyinaa dea. Bere a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Abraham bɔ yi na onni mma.
english: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.

twi: Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham se, ‘Wʼasefo bɛtena ananafo asase so ayɛ nkoa wɔ hɔ na wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade mfe ahannan.
english: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.

twi: Na mɛtwe ɔman a wɔbɛsom wɔn no aso; na ɛno akyi wobefi saa ɔman no mu abɛsom me wɔ ha.’
english: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’

twi: Onyankopɔn ne Abraham yɛɛ apam na wɔde twetiatwa yɛɛ apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnne. Eyi nti wɔwoo Isak nnaawɔtwe akyi na wotwaa no twetia; Isak nso twaa Yakob twetia, saa ara na Yakob twitwaa agyanom mpanyin dumien no nso twetia.
english: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

twi: “Agyanom mpanyin no ani beree Yosef enti wɔtɔn no ma ɔkɔyɛɛ akoa wɔ Misraim. Nanso esiane sɛ na Onyankopɔn wɔ nʼafa nti
english: “Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him

twi: oyii no fii ne haw nyinaa mu. Ɔmaa Yosef nyansa na Misraimhene Farao pɛɛ nʼasɛm. Eyi maa Farao yɛɛ Yosef ɔman no so amrado ne ahemfi hɔ nyinaa sohwɛfo.
english: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.

twi: “Saa bere no mu na ɔkɔm kɛse ne ahohia sii Misraim ne Kanaan asase nyinaa so a na yɛn agyanom nnya aduan mpo nni.
english: “Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.

twi: Enti bere a Yakob tee sɛ aduan wɔ Misraim no, ɔsomaa ne mma a wɔyɛ yɛn agyanom ma wɔkɔɔ hɔ nea edi kan.
english: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.

twi: Wɔkɔɔ ne mprenu so no, Yosef daa ne ho adi kyerɛɛ ne nuanom, na ɛnam so ma Farao huu Yosef abusuafo.
english: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.

twi: Yosef kraa nʼagya Yakob se ɔne nʼabusuafo nyinaa mmra Misraim. Na wɔn nyinaa dodow yɛ aduɔson anum.
english: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.

twi: Afei, Yakob kɔtenaa Misraim na ɛhɔ na ɔne yɛn agyanom nyinaa wuwui.
english: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.

twi: Wɔde wɔn amu no kɔɔ Sekem kosiee wɔn wɔ Abraham asiei bi a ɔtɔ fii Hamor abusua mu no hɔ.
english: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.

twi: “Bɔ a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Abraham no bere redu no, na yɛn nkurɔfo a wɔwɔ Misraim no ase atrɛw.
english: “As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.

twi: Akyiri no, ɔhene foforo bi bedii ade wɔ Misraim a na onnim Yosef ho asɛm.
english: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’

twi: Saa ɔhene yi de atirimɔden dii yɛn agyanom so, hyɛɛ wɔn ma wɔtotow wɔn mma gui sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobewuwu.
english: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.

twi: “Saa bere yi mu na wɔwoo Mose a na okura Onyankopɔn anuonyam no. Wɔhwɛɛ no wɔ nʼagya fi asram abiɛsa,
english: “At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.

twi: na woyii no fii hɔ no, Farao babea kɔfaa no de no baa ne fi hwɛɛ no sɛ nʼankasa ne ba.
english: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.

twi: Wɔtetew no wɔ Misraimfo nimdeɛ mu ma ɔyɛɛ den wɔ ɔkasa ne nneyɛe mu.
english: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.

twi: “Mose dii mfe aduanan no, ɔyɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔrekɔsra ne nuanom Israelfo.
english: “When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.

twi: Oduu hɔ no ohuu sɛ Misraimni bi resisi ne nuanom mu baako bi. Mose kɔboaa ne nua no ma Mose kum Misraimni no.
english: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.

twi: Mose susuw sɛ nʼankasa nkurɔfo behu sɛ Onyankopɔn nam ne so bɛma wɔade wɔn ho nanso wɔante ase.
english: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.

twi: Ade kyee no, ohuu sɛ Israelfo baanu bi reko enti ɔkɔɔ hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔpata. Obisaa wɔn se, ‘Adɛn nti na moatwa mo ho reko? Munnim sɛ moyɛ anuanom ana?’
english: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’

twi: “Nea ɔresisi ne yɔnko no sum Mose bisaa no se, ‘Hena na ɔyɛɛ wo yɛn so panyin ne otemmufo?
english: “But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?

twi: Wopɛ sɛ wukum me sɛnea nnɛra wukum Misraimni no ana?’
english: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

twi: Mose tee saa no, otu fii Misraim kɔtenaa Midian asase so. Ɛhɔ na ɔwoo mmabarima baanu.
english: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.

twi: “Mfe aduanan akyi no, ɔbɔfo nam wura bi gyaframa mu yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ sare bi a ɛbɛn bepɔw Sinai no so.
english: “After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

twi: Nea Mose huu no maa ne ho dwiriw no enti otwiw bɛn ho pɛɛ sɛ ɔhwɛ no yiye. Ɔtee Awurade nne se,
english: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:

twi: ‘Mene wo agyanom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob Nyankopɔn.’ Ehu kaa Mose nti wantumi anhwɛ.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.

twi: “Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, ‘Worɔw wo mpaboa, efisɛ faako a wugyina no yɛ asase kronkron.
english: “Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

twi: Mahwɛ na mahu atirimɔden a wɔde yɛ me manfo a wɔwɔ Misraim no. Mate apini a wɔresi no nyinaa na maba sɛ merebegye wɔn. Yɛ ntɛm na mensoma wo nkɔ Misraim.’
english: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’

twi: “Saa Mose yi ne obi a Israelfo poo no bere a wobisaa no se, ‘Hena na ɔyɛɛ wo yɛn so panyin ne otemmufo no?’ Ɔno na Onyankopɔn nam ɔbɔfo a oyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no wɔ nwura a ɛrehyew no gyaframa mu no, yɛɛ no ɔpanyin ne ogyefo.
english: “This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

twi: Ɔno na ɔnam anwonwade ne nsɛnkyerɛnne so yii Israelfo fii Misraim de wɔn twaa Po Kɔkɔɔ no, dii wɔn anim wɔ sare so mfe aduanan no.
english: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.

twi: “Mose yi ara na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfo se, sɛnea Onyankopɔn somaa me no, saa ara na obeyi odiyifo a ɔte sɛ me afi mo mu aba mo nkyɛn.
english: “This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’

twi: Ɔno ne obi a ɔne Israelfo yɛɛ nhyiamu wɔ sare no so hɔ; ɔne yɛn agyanom ne ɔbɔfo a ɔkasa kyerɛɛ wɔn wɔ Sinai Bepɔw no so no. Ne nsa kaa Onyankopɔn asɛm a nkwa wɔ mu no de brɛɛ yɛn.
english: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.

twi: “Nanso yɛn agyanom antie no. Wɔpoo no pɛɛ sɛ wɔsan kɔ Misraim asase so bio.
english: “But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

twi: Enti wɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron se, ‘Yɛ ahoni bi a wobedi yɛn anim ma yɛn, efisɛ yennim asɛm a ato saa Mose a oyii yɛn fii Misraim asase so no!’
english: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’

twi: Wɔyɛɛ nantwi ba sɛso honi bi bɔɔ afɔre maa no, gyee wɔn ani sɛnea ɛsɛ.
english: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.

twi: Onyankopɔn twee ne ho fii wɔn ho ma wɔsom ɔsoro nsoromma sɛnea wɔakyerɛw wɔ adiyifo nhoma mu se,“ ‘Israelfo, ɛnyɛ me na mode afɔrebɔde ne ayɛyɛde brɛɛ memfe aduanan wɔ sare so ana?
english:
But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets:
“‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings
    forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

twi: Mode mo ho nyinaa ato Molek nyame,ne mo honi Rɛfan so;wɔyɛ ahoni a moayɛ sɛ mobɛsom wɔn.Saa nti mɛpam mo akogu Babilonia akyi.’
english:
You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek
    and the star of your god Rephan,
    the idols you made to worship.
Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.

twi: “Saa bere no na ntamadan a edi adanse sɛ Onyankopɔn ka ne manfo ho no ka yɛn agyanom ho wɔ sare so hɔ. Mose sii ntamadan yi sɛnea Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no sɛ onsi no no ara pɛ.
english: “Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

twi: Akyiri no, yɛn agyanom a Yosua dii wɔn anim no de ntamadan no baa asase a Onyankopɔn pam so nnipa de maa wɔn no so. Esii hɔ ara kosii Dawid bere so.
english: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,

twi: Onyankopɔn hyiraa Dawid enti obisaa Onyankopɔn se ɔmma onsi asɔredan mma Yakob Nyankopɔn.
english: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

twi: Nanso Salomo na osii dan no maa Onyankopɔn.
english: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.

twi: “Nanso ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn nte ɔdan a nnipa asi mu, sɛnea odiyifo no ka se,
english: “However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:

twi: “ ‘Ɔsoro yɛ mʼahengua,Awurade na ose.Na asase yɛ mʼanan ntiaso.Ɔdan bɛn na wubesi ama me?Na mʼahomegyebea wɔ he?
english:
“‘Heaven is my throne,
    and the earth is my footstool.
What kind of house will you build for me?
says the Lord.
    Or where will my resting place be?

twi: Ɛnyɛ mʼankasa na meyɛɛ eyinom nyinaa?’
english: Has not my hand made all these things?’

twi: “Mo asoɔdenfo, mo a mo koma apirim na muntie Onyankopɔn asɛm. Mote sɛ mo agyanom pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mo nso daa musiw Honhom Kronkron no ho kwan.
english: “You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!

twi: Odiyifo bi wɔ hɔ a mo agyanom antaa no ana? Wokum Onyankopɔn asomafo a wodii kan bɔɔ ɔtreneeni a ɔbɛba no ho dawuru. Saa ara nso na moapa no, akum no.
english: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—

twi: Mo ara ne nnipa a monam abɔfo so nyaa Onyankopɔn mmara no, nanso moanni so.”
english: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it.”

twi: Wosiw Stefano AboAgyinatufo no tee asɛm a Stefano kae no, wɔn bo fuw yiye.
english: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.

twi: Nanso Stefano a Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ no ma no maa nʼani so hwɛɛ ɔsoro huu Onyankopɔn anuonyam ne Yesu Kristo sɛ ogyina Onyankopɔn nsa nifa so.
english: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

twi: Stefano kae se, “Mihu sɛ ɔsoro abue na Onipa Ba no gyina Onyankopɔn nsa nifa so!”
english: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”

twi: Wɔteɛteɛɛ mu de wɔn nsa sisiw wɔn aso. Afei wɔn nyinaa bɔɔ twi kɔtow hyɛɛ no so,
english: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,

twi: twee no kɔɔ kurotia kosiw no abo. Wɔn a wosiw no abo no yiyii wɔn ntama de maa aberante bi a wɔfrɛ no Saulo sɛ ɔnhwɛ so.
english: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.

twi: Wɔresiw Stefano abo no nyinaa na ɔrebɔ mpae se, “Awurade Yesu, wo nsam na mede me honhom hyɛ!”
english: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”

twi: Afei obuu nkotodwe teɛɛ mu dennen se, “Awurade, fa wɔn bɔne kyɛ wɔn.” Ɔkaa saa no, owui.
english: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

twi: Wɔtaa Akyidifo No Ma Wɔbɔ AhweteSaulo penee kum a wokum Stefano no so. Saa da no ara, wɔtaa agyidifo a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no maa wɔn nyinaa bɔɔ ahwete kɔɔ Yudea ne Samaria nsase so ma ɛkaa asomafo no nko ara.
english:
And Saul approved of their killing him.
On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

twi: Onyamesurofo bi kɔfaa Stefano kosiee no. Wosuu no yiye.
english: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.

twi: Esiane sɛ na Saulo pɛ sɛ ogu asafo no nti ɔkɔɔ afi mu kɔkyekyeree agyidifo mmarima ne mmea de wɔn guu afiase.
english: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.

twi: Filipo Ka Asɛmpa No Wɔ SamariaAgyidifo a na wɔabɔ ahwete no kaa asɛmpa no wɔ baabiara a wɔkɔe.
english: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.

twi: Filipo kɔɔ Samaria kurow bi mu kɔkaa Agyenkwa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nnipa a na wɔwɔ hɔ no.
english: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.

twi: Bere a nnipakuw no tee asɛm a Filipo reka na wohuu anwonwade a ɔyɛe no, wɔn nyinaa tiee no.
english: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.

twi: Ahonhommɔne de nteɛteɛmu fii nnipa bebree mu. Saa ara na mmubuafo ne mpakye nso sɔre nantewee.
english: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.

twi: Eyi nti anigye baa Samaria.
english: So there was great joy in that city.

twi: Simon Nkonyaayifo NoNa ɔbarima bi te saa kurow yi mu a wɔfrɛ no Simon a ɔyɛ nkonyaayifo a esiane ne nkonyaayi no nti Samariafo pii gye no di. Na ɔyɛ obi a ɔhoahoa ne ho sɛ odi mu.
english: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,

twi: Eyi maa nnipa a wɔwɔ kurow no mu no nyinaa gyee no too mu kae se, “Saa onipa yi ne Onyankopɔn tumi a wɔfrɛ no Ɔkɛse no.”
english: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, “This man is rightly called the Great Power of God.”

twi: Esiane ne nkonyaa a na oyi no nti, ɛmaa nnipa no nyinaa tu dii nʼakyi.
english: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.

twi: Bere a saa nnipa yi gyee asɛmpa a Filipo ka faa Onyankopɔn ahenni ne Yesu Kristo din no ho dii no, wɔbɔɔ mmarima ne mmea nyinaa asu.
english: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

twi: Simon nso gye dii ma wɔbɔɔ no asu. Baabiara a Filipo kɔe no, Simon dii nʼakyi. Anwonwade a ohuu no maa ne ho dwiriw no.
english: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.

twi: Bere a asomafo a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no tee sɛ Samariafo agye Onyankopɔn asɛm no adi no, wɔsomaa Petro ne Yohane kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn.
english: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.

twi: Woduu hɔ no, wɔbɔɔ mpae maa agyidifo no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Honhom Kronkron bɛba wɔn so,
english: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,

twi: efisɛ saa bere no na asu kɛkɛ na wɔnam Awurade Yesu din so abɔ. Na Honhom Kronkron nnya mmaa wɔn so ɛ.
english: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

twi: Afei Petro ne Yohane de wɔn nsa guguu wɔn so maa Honhom Kronkron baa wɔn so.
english: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

twi: Simon huu sɛ asomafo no nsa a wɔde guguu wɔn so no na ɛma wonyaa Honhom Kronkron no, ɔmaa Petro ne Yohane sika srɛɛ sɛ,
english: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money

twi: “Momma me saa tumi yi bi na obiara a mede me nsa begu no so no anya Honhom Kronkron no bi.”
english: and said, “Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”

twi: Petro ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Nnome nka wo ne wo sika nyinaa, efisɛ wususuw sɛ wubetumi de sika atɔ Onyankopɔn akyɛde no.
english: Peter answered: “May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

twi: Wunni kyɛfa biara wɔ yɛn dwumadi yi mu, efisɛ wo koma mu ntew wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
english: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.

twi: Sakra wʼadwene fi wo bɔne yi ho na bɔ mpae srɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔmfa wo bɔne nkyɛ wo.
english: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.

twi: Mihu sɛ anibere bɔne ahyɛ wo koma mu ama bɔne afa wo nnommum.”
english: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin.”

twi: Simon srɛɛ Petro ne Yohane se, “Mommɔ mpae mma me na saa nnome yi mu biara amma me so.”
english: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”

twi: Ansa na Petro ne Yohane redu Yerusalem no, wɔkaa asɛmpa no wɔ Samaria nkuraa bebree ase.
english: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.

twi: Filipo Ne Etiopiani NoAwurade bɔfo ka kyerɛɛ Filipo se, “Sɔre siesie wo ho kɔ anafo kwan a efi Yerusalem kɔ Gasa no so.”
english: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”

twi: Bere a Filipo rekɔ no, ohyiaa Etiopiani piamni bi a ɔyɛ Etiopiahemmea Kandake dabeni. Na saa onipa yi akɔ asɔre wɔ Yerusalem,
english: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means “queen of the Ethiopians”). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

twi: a na ɔte ne teaseɛnam mu resan akɔ fie. Na ɔrekenkan Odiyifo Yesaia nhoma no.
english: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.

twi: Honhom Kronkron ka kyerɛɛ Filipo se, “Twiw bɛn no.”
english: The Spirit told Philip, “Go to that chariot and stay near it.”

twi: Filipo yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ teaseɛnam no ho na ɔtee sɛ ɔrekenkan Odiyifo Yesaia nhoma no, obisaa se, “Wote nea worekenkan yi ase ana?”
english: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.

twi: Piamni no buaa no se, “Mɛyɛ dɛn na mate ase? Gye sɛ obi kyerɛ me ase.” Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ Filipo se ɔmforo mmɛtena ne nkyɛn wɔ ne teaseɛnam no mu.
english: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone explains it to me?” So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

twi: Na piamni no rekenkan saa Kyerɛwsɛm yi:“Ɔte sɛ oguamma a wɔrekokum no.Sɛnea oguamma yɛ komm wɔ ne nwitwitwafo anim no,saa ara na wammue nʼano.
english:
This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading:
“He was led like a sheep to the slaughter,
    and as a lamb before its shearer is silent,
    so he did not open his mouth.

twi: Nʼanimguase mu, wannya odimafo.Na hena na ɔbɛka nʼasefo ho asɛm?Efisɛ woyii no fii asase yi so.”
english:
In his humiliation he was deprived of justice.
    Who can speak of his descendants?
    For his life was taken from the earth.”

twi: Piamni no bisaa Filipo se, “Odiyifo no reka nʼankasa ho asɛm anaa obi foforo ho asɛm?”
english: The eunuch asked Philip, “Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”

twi: Filipo nam saa asɛm no so kaa nsɛmpa a ɛfa Yesu ho no kyerɛɛ no.
english: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

twi: Wɔrekɔ no woduu asu bi ho. Piamni no ka kyerɛɛ Filipo se, “Nsu ni. Dɛn na esiw wo kwan sɛ wobɔ me asu?”
english: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, “Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?”

twi: Filipo ka kyerɛ no se, “Sɛ wufi wo koma mu gye di a, mɛbɔ wo asu.” Piamni no buaa no se, “Migye di. Migye di sɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ Onyankopɔn Ba.”
Piamni no hyɛ maa teaseɛnam no gyinae. Ɔne Filipo kɔɔ asu no ho ma ɔbɔɔ no asu.
english: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

twi: Wofi nsu no mu no, Onyankopɔn Honhom hwim Filipo fii piamni no nkyɛn kɔe. Wanhu Filipo bio de, nanso ɔde anigye toaa nʼakwantu no so.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.

twi: Filipo kopuee Asoto kɔɔ so kaa asɛmpa no wɔ nkurow no mu kosii sɛ okoduu Kaesarea.
english: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

twi: Saulo AdwensakraSaa bere no na Saulo ani abere sɛ ɔbɛtɔre Kristo akyidifo no ase.
english: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest

twi: Ɔkɔɔ Ɔsɔfopanyin no nkyɛn kogyee adansedi krataa a ɛbɛma no tumi ama wakɔ hyiadan mu wɔ Damasko akɔkyekyere Yesu akyidifo, mmea ne mmarima, na ɔde wɔn akɔ Yerusalem.
english: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

twi: Ɔreyɛ abɛn Damasko no, prɛko pɛ na hann bi fi ɔsoro twa faa ne ho
english: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

twi: ma otwa hwee fam. Afei, ɔtee nne bi se, “Saulo! Adɛn nti na wotaa me?”
english: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

twi: Saulo bisae se, “Ɛyɛ wo hena, Owura?”Nne no buae se, “Ɛyɛ me Yesu a wotaa me no.”
english:
“Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked.
“I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” he replied.

twi: Nne no kae se, “Sɔre na kɔ kurow no mu na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ.”
english: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”

twi: Nnipa a wɔne Saulo nam no gyinae a wɔantumi anka hwee; wɔtee nne no, nanso wɔanhu obiara.
english: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.

twi: Afei Saulo sɔre fii fam hɔ buee nʼani, nanso na onhu ade. Enti wokurakura no nkakrankakra de no kɔɔ Damasko.
english: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

twi: Nnansa a odii wɔ Damasko no na onhu hwee. Na onnidi na ɔnnom nso.
english: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.

twi: Na osuani bi wɔ Damasko a wɔfrɛ no Anania. Awurade frɛɛ no anisoadehu mu se, “Anania!”Ogyee so se, “Awurade!”
english:
In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, “Ananias!”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Kɔ Yuda fi a ɛwɔ Ɔtempɔn Tee no so na kobisa ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Saulo a ofi Tarso no ase; ɔrebɔ mpae.
english: The Lord told him, “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.

twi: Anisoadehu mu na ohuu ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Anania a ɔde ne nsa too no so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔbɛsan ahu ade.”
english: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”

twi: Anania buae se, “Awurade, mate saa ɔbarima yi ho nsɛm bebree, ne haw a ɔhaw wʼakyidifo wɔ Yerusalem no.
english: “Lord,” Ananias answered, “I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.

twi: Wakɔ asɔfo mpanyin nkyɛn akogye adansedi krataa a ɛbɛma no tumi na ɔde akyere obiara a ɔbɔ wo din wɔ ha no.”
english: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name.”

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Anania se, “Kɔ! Efisɛ ɔno na mayi no a menam ne so bɛma amanamanmufo ne ahemfo ne Israelfo nyinaa ate me din.
english: But the Lord said to Ananias, “Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.

twi: Na mɛkyerɛ no amane a esiane me din nti obehu.”
