english: Then he gave them these instructions: “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

twi: Ɛno ne ɔboda ne afuw a ɛwɔ Makpela, a ɛbɛn Mamrɛ a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase so no. Abraham tɔɔ saa ɔboda no fii Hetini Efron nkyɛn, de yɛɛ amusiei.
english: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.

twi: Saa ɔboda no mu na wosiee Abraham ne ne yere Sara. Ɛhɔ ara nso na wosiee Isak ne ne yere Rebeka, na misiee Lea nso.
english: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.

twi: Me nena Abraham tɔɔ afuw no ne ɔboda a ɛka ho no nyinaa fii Hetifo no nkyɛn.”
english: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites.”

twi: Bere a Yakob kasa kyerɛɛ ne mma no wiee no, ɔmaa ne nan so guu ne mpa so wui. Wokosiee no wɔ ne mpanyimfo nkyɛn.
english: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

twi: Wosie Yakob Wɔ KanaanYosef tow ne ho hwee nʼagya so suu no, na ofew nʼano.
english: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.

twi: Ɛno akyi no, Yosef maa ne duruyɛfo bɛhyɛɛ nʼagya Israel akyenkyennuru, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔrensɛe. Enti oduruyɛfo no hyɛɛ no akyenkyennuru.
english: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,

twi: Wɔde adaduanan na ɛhyɛɛ Israel akyenkyennuru no, efisɛ saa nna dodow no na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde hyɛ no aduru no. Misraimfo suu no nnafua aduɔson.
english: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

twi: Wosuu no wiee no, Yosef kasa kyerɛɛ Farao fifo se, “Sɛ manya mo anim anuonyam a, monka nkyerɛ Farao mma me se,
english: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,

twi: ‘Mʼagya ma mekaa ntam,’ na ɔkae se: Hwɛ, aka kakra na mawu. Enti sɛ miwu a, ɔboda a mʼankasa mitwaa wɔ Kanaan asase so no mu na munkosie me. ‘Enti momma me kwan mma minkosie mʼagya, na mɛsan aba.’ ”
english: ‘My father made me swear an oath and said, “I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’”

twi: Farao penee akwansrɛ no so, kae se, “Kɔ na kosie wʼagya, sɛnea ɔmaa wo kaa no ntam no.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”

twi: Enti Yosef kɔ kosiee nʼagya. Farao asomfo nyinaa ne ne mpanyimfo ne nʼatenankongua ne Misraim nnipa titiriw nyinaa kogyaa Yosef ayi
english: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh’s officials accompanied him—the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt—

twi: kaa Yosef fifo nyinaa a ne nuabarimanom ne nʼagya fifo no ho. Wɔn mma ne wɔn nguan ne wɔn anantwi nko ara na wogyaw wɔn wɔ Gosen asase so hɔ.
english: besides all the members of Joseph’s household and his brothers and those belonging to his father’s household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.

twi: Nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefo nso kaa wɔn ho kɔɔ ayi no bi. Nnipadɔm pa ara na wɔkɔe.
english: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

twi: Woduu Atad a ne nkyerɛase ne baabi a wɔpo atoko, a ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Yordan no, wɔde nnanson twaa agyaadwo, yɛɛ Yosef agya Israel ayi kɛse wɔ hɔ.
english: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.

twi: Bere a Kanaanfo a na wɔte asase no so huu sɛnea wosi yɛɛ ayi no wɔ Atad no, wɔkae se, “Eyi yɛ ayi kɛse bi a Misraimfo ayɛ.” Ɛno nti, Kanaanfo a wɔte asase no so no too hɔ din Abel-Misraim, a ne nkyerɛase ne Misraimfo reyɛ ayi kɛse.
english: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning.” That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.

twi: Enti Yakob mmabarima no yɛɛ sɛnea wɔn agya kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:

twi: Wɔsoaa no, de no kɔɔ Kanaan asase so, kosiee no wɔ ɔboda a ɛwɔ Makpela a ɛbɛn Mamrɛ afuw a na Abraham atɔ afi Hetini Efron nkyɛn de ayɛ amusiei no mu.
english: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.

twi: Yosef siee nʼagya wiee no, ɔne ne nuanom ne wɔn a wokogyaa no ayi no nyinaa san baa Misraim.
english: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.

twi: Yosef De Ne Nuanom Bɔne Kyɛ WɔnYosef agya wu akyi no, ne nuanom no de ehu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho se, “Sɛ ɛba sɛ Yosef da so wɔ yɛn ho menasepɔw, na otua yɛn bɔne ahorow a yɛayɛ no nyinaa so ka a, na yɛreyɛ no dɛn?”
english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?”

twi: Enti wotuu nnipa kɔɔ Yosef hɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Wʼagya kaa saa asɛm yi ansa na ɔrewu.
english: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Your father left these instructions before he died:

twi: ‘Asɛm yi na ɛsɛ sɛ moka kyerɛ Yosef: Mesrɛ wo, fa bɔne ahorow a wo nuanom ayɛ wo no nyinaa kyɛ wɔn.’ Enti afei mesrɛ wo, fa Onyankopɔn a wʼagya som no no nkoa bɔne kyɛ wɔn.” Bere a Yosef tee asɛm a ne nuanom no kae no, osui.
english: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.’ Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.

twi: Yosef nuabarimanom no bɛtotow wɔn ho guguu nʼanim, kae se, “Yɛyɛ wo nkoa.”
english: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. “We are your slaves,” they said.

twi: Nanso Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Munnsuro me! Meyɛ Onyankopɔn a metumi abu mo atɛn, atwe mo aso ana?
english: But Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ moyɛɛ mo adwene sɛ mobɛyɛ me bɔne de, nanso na Onyankopɔn adwene ne sɛ, ɛbɛdan ade pa, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi agye nnipa dodow nkwa, sɛnea ɔreyɛ no nnɛ yi.
english: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

twi: Enti munnsuro! Mʼankasa mede biribiara a ehia mo ne mo mma nyinaa bɛma mo.” Yosef nam saa kasakyerɛ yi so hyɛɛ wɔn bɔ sɛ, ɔrenyɛ wɔn bɔne biara.
english: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children.” And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.

twi: Yosef WuYosef ankasa ne ne nuanom ne nʼagya abusuafo nyinaa tenaa Misraim asase so. Odii mfe ɔha ne du ansa na ɔrewu.
english: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years

twi: Yosef huu Efraim mma nena ne Manase ba Makir mma nso. Wɔwoo wɔn guu ne srɛ so.
english: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.

twi: Na, Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne nuabarimanom no se, “Ɛrenkyɛ biara na mawu. Nanso Onyankopɔn bɛboa mo, ayi mo afi saa asase yi so, de mo akɔ bɔhyɛ asase a ɔkaa ho ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma Abraham, Isak ne Yakob no so.”
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.”

twi: Yosef maa Israel mmabarima no kaa ntam, na Yosef kae se, “Nokware, Onyankopɔn bedi aboa mo. Sɛ miwu nso a, monsoa me nnompe mfi ha nkɔ Kanaan asase so.”
english: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, “God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”

twi: Yosef dii mfe ɔha ne du, na owui. Wɔhyɛɛ no akyenkyennuru de no too funnaka mu wɔ Misraim.
english: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.

twi: Asɔredansi Ho NkaebɔƆsram a ɛto so asia no da a edi kan wɔ Ɔhene Dario adedi afe a ɛto so abien so no, Awurade nam Odiyifo Hagai so, de asɛm maa Sealtiel babarima ne Yuda amrado Serubabel ne Ɔsɔfopanyin Yehosadak babarima Yosua.
english: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest:

twi: Asɛm a Asafo Awurade ka ni: “Nnipa no reka se, ‘Bere no nya nnuu sɛ wosi Awurade fi no.’ ”
english: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the Lord’s house.’”

twi: Afei, Awurade de saa asɛm yi faa Odiyifo Hagai so:
english: Then the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

twi: “Saa bere yi a me fi yi abubu yi na mo de, motete mo afi a wɔaduradura mu yi ana?”
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?”

twi: Asɛm a, Asafo Awurade ka ni: “Munnwen mo akwan ho yiye.
english: Now this is what the Lord Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.

twi: Muduaa bebree, nanso mutwaa kakraa bi. Mudidi, nanso mommee. Monom, nanso osukɔm de mo ara. Mohyɛ ntade, nanso ɛnka mo hyew. Munya akatua, na mode gu sika nkotoku a wɔatutu mu atokuru mu.”
english: You have planted much, but harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it.”

twi: Asɛm a Asafo Awurade ka ni: “Munnwen mo akwan ho yiye.
english: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.

twi: Afei momforo nkɔ nkoko no atifi, na momfa nnua mmra mmesi me fi no. Na mʼani begye ho, na wɔahyɛ me anuonyam.” Saa na Awurade ka.
english: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build my house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored,” says the Lord.

twi: “Mo ani daa bebree so, nanso ɛyɛɛ kakraa bi. Na mode baa fie no, mihuw gui. Dɛn ntia?” Efisɛ, “me fi abubu.” Saa na Asafo Awurade ka, “bere a mo ani abere resisi mo afi no.
english: “You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?” declares the Lord Almighty. “Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with your own house.

twi: Mo nti na ɔsoro akyere obosu agyina, na asase nso akyere mo nnɔbae.
english: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.

twi: Mahyɛ ɔpɛ sɛ, ensi mo mfuw ne nkoko so; ɔpɛ a ɛbɛhyew mo atoko ne mo bobe ne mo ngodua ne mo nnɔbae, ɛbɛyɛ ɔpɛ a ebesi mo ne mo anantwi mu, na asɛe dwuma biara a mode mo nsa adi.”
english: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil and everything else the ground produces, on people and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands.”

twi: Nkaebɔ No SodiNa Sealtiel babarima Serubabel, Ɔsɔfopanyin Yehosadak babarima Yosua ne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo nkae no tiee asɛm a efi Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, ne Odiyifo Hagai a Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, asoma no no. Na nnipa no de osuro maa Awurade.
english: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the Lord their God had sent him. And the people feared the Lord.

twi: Na Hagai, Awurade somafo no, de saa asɛm yi a efi Awurade nkyɛn maa nkurɔfo no: “Meka mo ho.” Saa na Awurade se.
english: Then Haggai, the Lord’s messenger, gave this message of the Lord to the people: “I am with you,” declares the Lord.

twi: Ɛno nti, Awurade kanyan Sealtiel babarima Serubabel a ɔyɛ Yuda amrado, Ɔsɔfopanyin Yehosadak babarima Yosua ne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo nkae no nyinaa. Wobefii wɔn adwuma a ɛwɔ Asafo Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, fi no ase,
english: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,

twi: wɔ Ɔhene Dario adedi afe a ɛto so abien no, ɔsram a ɛto so asia no da a ɛto so aduonu anan no.
english:
on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month.
In the second year of King Darius,

twi: Asɔredan No AnuonyamDa a ɛto so aduonu baako wɔ ɔsram a ɛto so ason no, Awurade de asɛm faa Odiyifo Hagai so se:
english: on the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

twi: “Ka eyi kyerɛ Sealtiel babarima Serubabel a ɔyɛ Yuda amrado ne Ɔsɔfopanyin Yehosadak babarima Yosua ne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo nkae a wɔwɔ asase no so hɔ no. Bisa wɔn se,
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

twi: ‘Mo a moaka yi mu hena na ohuu saa ofi yi anuonyam sɛnea na ɛte kan no? Muhu no dɛn nnɛ? Ɛnyɛ mo sɛ ɛnsɛ hwee mprempren ana?
english: ‘Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?

twi: Enti Serubabel, nya akokoduru mprempren.’ Saa na Awurade se, ‘Ɔsɔfopanyin Yehosadak babarima Yosua, nya akokoduru. Mo nnipa a mowɔ asase no so mprempren no, munnya akokoduru. Awurade na ose. Munnya akokoduru na monyɛ adwuma, efisɛ, meka mo ho.’ Saa na Asafo Awurade ka.
english: But now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ declares the Lord. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ declares the Lord, ‘and work. For I am with you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

twi: ‘Eyi ne apam a me ne mo yɛe bere a mufii Misraim. Me Honhom ka mo ho. Ɛno nti munnsuro.’
english: ‘This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.’

twi: “Eyi ne asɛm a Asafo Awurade ka. ‘Ɛrenkyɛ biara, mɛwosow ɔsoro ne asase bio. Mɛwosow po tamaa ne asase kesee nso.
english: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

twi: Mɛwosow aman nyinaa, na aman nyinaa anidaso bɛba, na mede anuonyam bɛhyɛ saa ofi yi ma.’ Saa na Asafo Awurade se.
english: I will shake all nations, and what is desired by all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the Lord Almighty.

twi: ‘Dwetɛ no yɛ me de. Na sikakɔkɔɔ yɛ me de.’ Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se.
english: ‘The silver is mine and the gold is mine,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

twi: ‘Saa ofi yi anuonyam bɛkorɔn asen nʼanuonyam a atwa mu no.’ Saa na Asafo Awurade ka. ‘Na mɛma asomdwoe aba ha.’ Me, Asafo Awurade na makasa.”
english: ‘The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,’ says the Lord Almighty. ‘And in this place I will grant peace,’ declares the Lord Almighty.”

twi: Osetie Mu Nhyira Ho BɔhyɛƆhene Dario adedi mfe abien mu, ɔsram a ɛto so akron no da a ɛto so aduonu anan, Awurade kaa saa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Odiyifo Hagai.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Haggai:

twi: “Asɛm a Asafo Awurade ka ni: ‘Mummisa asɔfo no nea mmara no ka.
english: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Ask the priests what the law says:

twi: Sɛ nam kronkron bi hyɛ obi atade mmuano mu, na sɛ ho kɔka brodo anaa abɔmu, nsa anaa ngo anaa aduan foforo bi a, ɛno nso bɛyɛ kronkron ana?’ ”Asɔfo no buae se: “Dabi.”
english:
If someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of their garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, olive oil or other food, does it become consecrated?’”
The priests answered, “No.”

twi: Na Hagai bisae se, “Na sɛ obi nso de ne ho ka funu de gu ne ho fi, na ɔde ne ho twitwiw nneɛma a wɔabobɔ din yi bi ho a na wɔagu ho fi ana?”Na asɔfo no buae se, “Yiw.”
english:
Then Haggai said, “If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?”
“Yes,” the priests replied, “it becomes defiled.”

twi: Afei, Hagai kae se, “ ‘Saa ara na nnipa no ne saa ɔman yi te.’ Saa na Awurade se. ‘Biribiara a wɔyɛ ne biribiara a wɔde ba no ho agu fi.
english: Then Haggai said, “‘So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,’ declares the Lord. ‘Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.

twi: “ ‘Enti efi nnɛ, munnwen saa ade yi ho yiye. Monkae sɛnea na nneɛma te, ansa na moreto Awurade asɔredan no fapem no.
english: “‘Now give careful thought to this from this day on—consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the Lord’s temple.

twi: Bere a modwene sɛ mubenya nnɔbae susukoraa aduonu no, munyaa du pɛ. Bere a mode mo ani buu sɛ mubenya galɔn aduonum afi nsakyibea no, munyaa aduonu pɛ.
english: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.

twi: Memaa ɔyare a ɛsɛe nnɔbae, ɛbɔ ne mparuwbo bɛsɛee mo nsa ano nnwuma nyinaa. Nanso moampɛ sɛ mobɛsan aba me nkyɛn. Saa na Awurade se.
english: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not return to me,’ declares the Lord.

twi: Efi ɔsram a ɛto so akron, da a ɛto so aduonu anan no, munnwen da a wɔtoo Awurade asɔredan fapem no ho yiye.
english: ‘From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid. Give careful thought:

twi: Aba bi aka asan no so ana? Ebesi nnɛ, bobe, borɔdɔma, atoaa ne ngodua asow wɔn aba ana?“ ‘Efi saa da yi rekɔ no, mehyira mo.’ ”
english:
Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit.
“‘From this day on I will bless you.’”

twi: Bɔ A Wɔahyɛ SerubabelAwurade asɛm baa Hagai nkyɛn ne mprenu so wɔ ɔsram no da a ɛto so aduonu anan:
english: The word of the Lord came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Serubabel a ɔyɛ Yuda amrado no se, merebɛwosow ɔsoro ne asase.
english: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.

twi: Mebutuw ahengua, na masɛe ananafo aheman no tumi. Mɛdan wɔn nteaseɛnam ne wɔn a wɔka no abutuw. Apɔnkɔ akafo no mfoa bɛbobɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho ama wɔatotɔ.
english: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.

twi: “ ‘Da no’ Asafo Awurade na ɔka, ‘Mɛfa wo, Sealtiel babarima, me somfo Serubabel, mɛfa wo sɛ nsɔwano kaa, efisɛ mayi wo.’ Me Asafo Awurade, na makasa.”
english: “‘On that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.”

twi: Bere a Usia, Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia yɛ ahemfo wɔ Yuda, na Yoas babarima Yeroboam di hene wɔ Israel no, Awurade de saa nsɛm yi baa Beeri babarima Hosea nkyɛn.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel:

twi: Hosea Yere Ne Ne MmaBere a Awurade dii kan kasa faa Hosea so no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Kɔware oguamanfo, na wo ne no nwo, efisɛ ɔman no di aguamammɔ ho fɔ na wɔnam so atetew wɔne Onyankopɔn ntam.”
english: When the Lord began to speak through Hosea, the Lord said to him, “Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord.”

twi: Enti, ɔwaree Diblaim babea Gomer, na onyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima maa no.
english: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

twi: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no se, “To ne din Yesreel, efisɛ, merebɛtwe ɔhene Yehufi aso, de atua awu a odii wɔ Yesreel no so ka. Na mede Israel ahenni bɛba awiei.
english: Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

twi: Saa da no, mebubu Israel tadua wɔ Yesreel bon no mu.”
english: In that day I will break Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel.”

twi: Gomer nyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabea. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Hosea se, “To ne din Lo-ruhama efisɛ, merenna me dɔ adi nkyerɛ Israelfo bio, na meremfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn koraa.
english: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call her Lo-Ruhamah (which means “not loved”), for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

twi: Nanso meyi me dɔ akyerɛ Yudafo. Me Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn, mede me tumi begye wɔn afi wɔn atamfo nsam a meremfa tadua, afoa anaa ɔko anaa apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔsotefo.”
english: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them.”

twi: Bere a Gomer twaa Lo-ruhama nufu akyi no, ɔwoo ɔba barima foforo.
english: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.

twi: Na Awurade kae se, “To ne din Lo-ami, efisɛ monnyɛ me nkurɔfo na mennyɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
english: Then the Lord said, “Call him Lo-Ammi (which means “not my people”), for you are not my people, and I am not your God.

twi: “Nanso Israelfo bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano nwea a wontumi nkan wɔn. Faako a wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, ‘Monnyɛ me nkurɔfo’ no, wɔbɛka se, ‘Moyɛ Onyankopɔn teasefo no mma.’
english: “Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘children of the living God.’

twi: Na Yudafo ne Israelfo bɛka abɔ mu bio, na wobeyi ɔkwankyerɛfo baako ama wɔn, na wɔn nyinaa bɛsan afi nnommum no mu aba. Saa da no bɛyɛ da kɛse ama Yesreel.”
english: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together; they will appoint one leader and will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

twi: “Frɛ wo nuabarimanom, ‘Me nkurɔfo’ na frɛ wo nuabeanom, ‘Mʼadɔfo.’ ”
english: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

twi: Wɔtwe Israel Aso, Gye No To Mu Bio“Ka wo na anim, ka nʼanim,na ɔnyɛ me yerena menyɛ ne kunu.Ma ɔnsesa nʼanim a ayɛ aguaman anim nona onnyae awaresɛe a ɔde ne nufu yɛ no.
english:
“Rebuke your mother, rebuke her,
    for she is not my wife,
    and I am not her husband.
Let her remove the adulterous look from her face
    and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

twi: Anyɛ saa a mɛpa ne ho ntamana wada adagyaw te sɛ da a wɔwoo no no;mɛma wayɛ sɛ nweatam,mɛdan no asase a awo woseena mama osukɔm akum no.
english:
Otherwise I will strip her naked
    and make her as bare as on the day she was born;
I will make her like a desert,
    turn her into a parched land,
    and slay her with thirst.

twi: Merennɔ ne mma,efisɛ wɔyɛ aguaman mma.
english:
I will not show my love to her children,
    because they are the children of adultery.

twi: Wɔn na anyɛ ɔnokwafona onyinsɛnee wɔn wɔ animguase mu.Ɔkae se, ‘Medi mʼadɔfo akyi,wɔn a wɔma me aduan ne nsu,ne kuntu ne nwera, ngo ne nsa.’
english:
Their mother has been unfaithful
    and has conceived them in disgrace.
She said, ‘I will go after my lovers,
    who give me my food and my water,
    my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.’

twi: Eyi nti, mede nsɔe besiw no kwan;mɛto ɔfasu afa ne ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔrenhu kwan.
english:
Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes;
    I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

twi: Obetiw nʼadɔfo, nanso ɔrento wɔn;ɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso ɔrenhu wɔn.Afei, ɔbɛka se,‘Mɛsan akɔ me kunu nkyɛn, te sɛ kan no,efisɛ, saa bere no na eye ma me sen mprempren.’
english:
She will chase after her lovers but not catch them;
    she will look for them but not find them.
Then she will say,
    ‘I will go back to my husband as at first,
    for then I was better off than now.’

twi: Ɔnkae sɛ me namemaa no aduan, nsa foforo ne ngo,nea ɔmaa sikakɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ buu no soma wɔde kɔsom Baal no.
english:
She has not acknowledged that I was the one
    who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil,
who lavished on her the silver and gold—
    which they used for Baal.

twi: “Enti sɛ mʼaduan no du twabere a mɛfa mʼade,ne me nsa foforo no nso saa ara.Megye me kuntu ne me nwera,a anka mepɛ sɛ ɔde kata nʼadagyaw so no.
english:
“Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens,
    and my new wine when it is ready.
I will take back my wool and my linen,
    intended to cover her naked body.

twi: Enti afei mɛbɔ no adagyawwɔ nʼadɔfo anim;obiara rentumi nnye no mfi me nsam.
Metwa nʼafahyɛ nyinaa so:nʼafirihyia afahyɛ, Ɔsram Foforo afahyɛHomeda afahyɛ ne nʼafahyɛ ahorow nyinaa.
english:
I will stop all her celebrations:
    her yearly festivals, her New Moons,
    her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.

twi: Mɛsɛe ne bobe ne borɔdɔma nnua,nea ɔka se nʼadɔfo de tuaa no ka no;mɛyɛ ne nyinaa nkyɛkyerɛ,ama wuram mmoa awe.
english:
I will ruin her vines and her fig trees,
    which she said were her pay from her lovers;
I will make them a thicket,
    and wild animals will devour them.

twi: Mɛtwe nʼaso wɔ nna aɔhyew aduhuam maa Baal no ho;ɔde nkaa ne agude hyehyɛɛ ne ho,tu dii nʼadɔfo akyi,me de, ne werɛ fii me,”nea Awurade se ni.
english:
I will punish her for the days
    she burned incense to the Baals;
she decked herself with rings and jewelry,
    and went after her lovers,
    but me she forgot,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Enti merekɔdaadaa no;mede no bɛkɔ nweatam sona makasa bɔkɔɔ akyerɛ no wɔ hɔ.
Mɛsan de ne bobe mfuw ama no.Mɛyɛ no Sɛkyɛ Bon,anidaso pon.Ɛhɔ na ɔbɛto dwom sɛnea na ɔyɛ ne mmabun bere mu none bere a ofii Misraim no.
english:
There I will give her back her vineyards,
    and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope.
There she will respond as in the days of her youth,
    as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

twi: “Saa da no,” sɛɛ na Awurade se,“Wobɛfrɛ me ‘me kunu’;na woremfrɛ me ‘me wura’ bio.
Meyi Baal ahorow din no afi nʼano;na ɔrenkankye wɔ wɔn din mu bio.
english:
I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips;
    no longer will their names be invoked.

twi: Saa da no, mɛyɛ apam ama wɔn,wɔne wuram mmoa ne wim nnomaane mmoa a wɔwea wɔ asase so.Tadua, mpeaw ne ɔko,mɛbra wɔ asase no so,sɛnea wɔn nyinaa bɛtena ase asomdwoe mu.
english:
In that day I will make a covenant for them
    with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky
    and the creatures that move along the ground.
Bow and sword and battle
    I will abolish from the land,
    so that all may lie down in safety.

twi: Mɛware wo afebɔɔ;mɛda trenee ne atɛntrenee,ahummɔbɔ ne ayamhyehye adi akyerɛ wo.
Mɛware wo nokware mu,ama woahu Awurade.
english:
I will betroth you in faithfulness,
    and you will acknowledge the Lord.

twi: “Saa da no, megye wo so,”nea Awurade se ni.“Megye ɔsoro so,na ɔsoro de osu begye asase so,
english:
“In that day I will respond,”
    declares the Lord—
“I will respond to the skies,
    and they will respond to the earth;

twi: na asase nso begye nnɔbae so:bobe foforo ne ngodua,na wɔn nso agye so se ‘Yesreel’, ‘Onyankopɔn na wadua.’
english:
and the earth will respond to the grain,
    the new wine and the olive oil,
    and they will respond to Jezreel.

twi: Mede Israel bedua asase no so ama me ho;mɛda me dɔ adi akyerɛ nea mekae se, ‘wonyɛ me dɔfo’ no.Mɛka akyerɛ wɔn a misee wɔn sɛ ‘monyɛ me nkurɔfo’ no se‘moyɛ me nkurɔfo,’na wɔn nso aka se, ‘Wone me Nyankopɔn.’”

Hosea Ne Ne Yere NkabomNa Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Kɔ na kɔfa wo yere no bio. Fa no san bra wo nkyɛn, na dɔ no. Ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔfoforo bi dɔ no anaa sɛ ɔyɛ ɔwaresɛefo. Dɔ no, sɛnea Awurade da so dɔ Israel, a mpo, nnipa no dan wɔn ho kɔ anyame afoforo nkyɛn, na wɔma wɔn bobe aba tetare no.”
english: The Lord said to me, “Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes.”

twi: Enti mede gram ɔha aduoson baako () ne atoko lita ɔha aduɔwɔtwe abien () ne atoko lita aduɔkron baako kɔpataa no.
english: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.

twi: Na meka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ wo ne me tena nna bebree, na wugyae wʼaguamammɔ no; wo ne ɔbarima biara nyɛ nnamfo. Me ne wo bɛtena, nanso me ne wo renna.”
english: Then I told her, “You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you.”

twi: Na ɔman Israel bɛwɔ hɔ nna tenten bi a ɔhene anaa ɔheneba nni mu, na wɔremmɔ afɔre. Wɔrenhu ɔbosom dum anaa asɔfotade anaa ahoni nso wɔ hɔ.
english: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods.

twi: Akyiri yi, Israelfo bɛsan akɔhwehwɛ Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, ne Dawid a ɔyɛ wɔn hene no. Wɔde ahopopo bɛba Awurade nkyɛn na wobenya ne nhyira wɔ nna a edi akyiri no mu.
english: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings in the last days.

twi: Wɔbɔ Israel KwaaduMuntie Awurade asɛm, mo Israelfoefisɛ Awurade wɔ kwaadu de bɔmo a mote asase no so:“Nokware, ɔdɔ, anaa Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ nni asase no so.
english:
Hear the word of the Lord, you Israelites,
    because the Lord has a charge to bring
    against you who live in the land:
“There is no faithfulness, no love,
    no acknowledgment of God in the land.

twi: Nnome nko ara, atorotwa ne awudi,akrɔmmɔ, ne aguamammɔna moyɛ ma ɛtra so,na mogyahwiegu ba ntoatoaso.
english:
There is only cursing, lying and murder,
    stealing and adultery;
they break all bounds,
    and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

twi: Eyi nti asase no di awerɛhowna wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa wuwu;wuram mmoa, wim nnomaane po mu nam rewuwu.
english:
Because of this the land dries up,
    and all who live in it waste away;
the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky
    and the fish in the sea are swept away.

twi: “Mma obiara mmɔ kwaadu,mma obiara mmɔ ɔfoforo sobo.Na mmom, mo asɔfomo na me ne mo anya.
english:
“But let no one bring a charge,
    let no one accuse another,
for your people are like those
    who bring charges against a priest.

twi: Muhintiw awia ne anadwo,na adiyifo no ne mo hintiw.Ɛno nti mɛsɛe mo man.
english:
You stumble day and night,
    and the prophets stumble with you.
So I will destroy your mother—

twi: Nimdeɛ a me nkurɔfo nni nti wɔresɛe.“Sɛ moapo nimdeɛ nti,me nso mapo mo sɛ mʼasɔfo;sɛ moabu mo ani agu mo Nyankopɔn mmara so nti,me nso mabu mʼani agu mo mma so.
english:
my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge.
“Because you have rejected knowledge,
    I also reject you as my priests;
because you have ignored the law of your God,
    I also will ignore your children.

twi: Asɔfo no redɔɔso nona bɔne a ɛboro so na wɔyɛ tia me.Wɔde wɔn Anuonyam asesa nea ɛyɛ animguase.
Wodidi me nkurɔfo bɔne hoɛno nti wɔn ani gye atirimɔdensɛm ho.
english:
They feed on the sins of my people
    and relish their wickedness.

twi: Sɛnea nnipa no te no, saa ara na asɔfo no nso te.Mɛtwe wɔn nyinaa aso wɔ wɔn akwan hona matua wɔn wɔn nneyɛe so ka.
english:
And it will be: Like people, like priests.
    I will punish both of them for their ways
    and repay them for their deeds.

twi: “Wobedidi, nanso wɔremmee.Wɔbɛbɔ aguaman, nanso wɔn ase remfɛe,efisɛ, wɔagyaw Awurade hɔ,de wɔn ho ama
english:
“They will eat but not have enough;
    they will engage in prostitution but not flourish,
because they have deserted the Lord
    to give themselves

twi: aguamammɔ,nsa dedaw ne foforo,a ɛma me nkurɔfo
ntease tu yera.Wɔkɔ abisa wɔ ahoni a wɔde nnua asen nkyɛnna duasin bi ama wɔn mmuae.Aguamammɔ honhom rema wɔn ayera kwan;wonni wɔn Nyankopɔn nokware.
english:
My people consult a wooden idol,
    and a diviner’s rod speaks to them.
A spirit of prostitution leads them astray;
    they are unfaithful to their God.

twi: Wɔbɔ afɔre wɔ mmepɔw atifina wɔhyew afɔrebɔde wɔ nkoko so:odum, duafufu ne odupɔn ase,nea onwini yɛ fɔmm hɔ.Ɛno nti, wo mmabea dan aguamammɔfona mo nsemmea nso yɛ nguamanfo.
english:
They sacrifice on the mountaintops
    and burn offerings on the hills,
under oak, poplar and terebinth,
    where the shade is pleasant.
Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution
    and your daughters-in-law to adultery.

twi: “Merentwe mo mmabea asosɛ wɔadan aguamammɔfo,anaa mo nsemmea asosɛ wɔasɛe aware.Efisɛ mo mmarima, mo nso mote saa ara.Mo ne mmabea ne nsɔreso nguamanfofa ayɔnko.Nnipa a wonni ntease no bɛkɔ ɔsɛe mu!
english:
“I will not punish your daughters
    when they turn to prostitution,
nor your daughters-in-law
    when they commit adultery,
because the men themselves consort with harlots
    and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes—
    a people without understanding will come to ruin!

twi: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ woyɛ ɔwaresɛefo de, Israel,nanso, mma Yuda nni ho fɔ.“Nkɔ Gilgal;na mforo nkɔ Bet-Awen.Na nka ntam se, ‘Sɛ Awurade te ase yi!’
english:
“Though you, Israel, commit adultery,
    do not let Judah become guilty.
“Do not go to Gilgal;
    do not go up to Beth Aven.
    And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!’

twi: Israelfo yɛ asoɔdenfote sɛ nantwi ba a ɔyɛ asowuiɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Awurade ahwɛ wɔn sosɛ nguantenmma a wɔwɔ adidibea?
english:
The Israelites are stubborn,
    like a stubborn heifer.
How then can the Lord pasture them
    like lambs in a meadow?

twi: Efraim de ne ho abɔ ahoni ho;Gyaa no!
english:
Ephraim is joined to idols;
    leave him alone!

twi: Sɛ wɔn nsa sa koraa a,wɔtoa wɔn aguamammɔ so;wɔn sodifo ani gye aniwude ho yiye.
Mfɛtɛ bɛpra wɔn akɔ,na wɔn afɔrebɔ de animguase bɛbrɛ wɔn.
english:
A whirlwind will sweep them away,
    and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

twi: Atemmu A Etia Israel“Muntie, mo asɔfo!Monhyɛ eyi nso, mo Israelfo!Monyɛ asow, adehyefi!Saa atemmu yi tia mo:Moayɛ afiri wɔ Mispa,ne asau a wɔagu no Tabor so.
english:
“Hear this, you priests!
    Pay attention, you Israelites!
Listen, royal house!
    This judgment is against you:
You have been a snare at Mizpah,
    a net spread out on Tabor.

twi: Atuatewfo adɔ mogyahwiegu mu asukɔ.Mɛtwe wɔn nyinaa aso.
english:
The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter.
    I will discipline all of them.

twi: Minim Efraim ho nsɛm nyinaa;wɔmfaa Israel nhintaw me ɛ.Efraim, mprempren de wobɔ aguaman;na Israel aporɔw.
“Wɔn nneyɛe mma wɔ kwanmma wɔnnkɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Aguamammɔ honhom wɔ wɔn koma mu;wonnye Awurade nto mu.
english:
“Their deeds do not permit them
    to return to their God.
A spirit of prostitution is in their heart;
    they do not acknowledge the Lord.

twi: Israel ahantan di tia no.Israelfo no, mpo Efraim hintihintiw wɔ wɔn amumɔyɛ mu;Yuda nso ne wɔn hintiw saa ara.
Sɛ wɔne wɔn nguan ne wɔn anantwikɔhwehwɛ Awurade aWɔrenhu no,efisɛ watwe ne ho afi wɔn ho.
english:
When they go with their flocks and herds
    to seek the Lord,
they will not find him;
    he has withdrawn himself from them.

twi: Wɔanni Awurade nokware.Wɔwowoo aguaman mma.Sɛ wodi wɔn Ɔsram Foforo Afahyɛ a,ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nsase.
english:
They are unfaithful to the Lord;
    they give birth to illegitimate children.
When they celebrate their New Moon feasts,
    he will devour their fields.

twi: “Hyɛn torobɛnto no wɔ Gibea.Hyɛn mmɛn no wɔ Rama.Momma ɔko nteɛmu so wɔ Bet Awen;Benyamin, monsɔre nni anim.
english:
“Sound the trumpet in Gibeah,
    the horn in Ramah.
Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven;
    lead on, Benjamin.

twi: Efraim bɛda mpanwɔ akontaabu da.Israel mmusuakuw no mu nomepae mu ka nea ɛwɔ mu.
english:
Ephraim will be laid waste
    on the day of reckoning.
Among the tribes of Israel
    I proclaim what is certain.

twi: Yuda sodifo no te sɛwɔn a woyiyi ahye so abo.Mehwie mʼabufuw agu wɔn sote sɛ nsuyiri.
english:
Judah’s leaders are like those
    who move boundary stones.
I will pour out my wrath on them
    like a flood of water.

twi: Wɔhyɛ Efraim so,wotiatia ne so wɔ atemmu mu,wasi nʼadwene pi sɛ obedi ahoni akyi.
english:
Ephraim is oppressed,
    trampled in judgment,
    intent on pursuing idols.

twi: Mɛyɛ sɛ nwewee ama Efraimna mayɛ Yudafo sɛ dua a aporɔw.
english:
I am like a moth to Ephraim,
    like rot to the people of Judah.

twi: “Bere a Efraim huu ne yare,na Yuda nso huu nʼakuru no,Efraim de nʼani kyerɛɛ Asiria.Ɔsoma kɔɔ ɔhenkɛse no hɔ kɔpɛɛ mmoa.Nanso wantumi ansa no yare,na akuru no nso anwuwu.
english:
“When Ephraim saw his sickness,
    and Judah his sores,
then Ephraim turned to Assyria,
    and sent to the great king for help.
But he is not able to cure you,
    not able to heal your sores.

twi: Enti mɛyɛ sɛ gyata ama Efraimna mayɛ sɛ gyata hoɔdenfo ama Yuda.Mɛtetew wɔn mu nketenkete, na makɔ;Mɛsoa wɔn akɔ, na obiara rentumi nnye wɔn.
english:
For I will be like a lion to Ephraim,
    like a great lion to Judah.
I will tear them to pieces and go away;
    I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

twi: Afei mɛsan akɔ me nkyikosi sɛ wobenya ahonu.Na wɔbɛhwehwɛ mʼakyi kwan;wɔn awerɛhow mu, wɔbɛhwehwɛ me anibere so.”
english:
Then I will return to my lair
    until they have borne their guilt
    and seek my face—
in their misery
    they will earnestly seek me.”

twi: Israel Nni Ahonu“Mommra, momma yɛnsan nkɔ Awurade nkyɛn.Watetew yɛn mu asinasinnanso ɔbɛsa yɛn yare.Wapirapira yɛnnanso ɔbɛkyekyere yɛn apirakuru.
english:
“Come, let us return to the Lord.
He has torn us to pieces
    but he will heal us;
he has injured us
    but he will bind up our wounds.

twi: Nnaanu akyi, ɔbɛma yɛanya ahoɔden;nansa so, ɔde yɛn besi yɛn sibeana yɛanya nkwa wɔ nʼanim.
Momma yennye Awurade nto mu;momma yɛnkɔ so nnye no nto mu.Sɛnea owia pue da biara no, obepue;ɔbɛba yɛn nkyɛn te sɛ osu a ɛtɔ awɔwbere muanaa asusow bere mu su a ɛfɔw asase.”
“Dɛn na metumi de wo ayɛ, Efraim?Dɛn na metumi de wo ayɛ, Yuda?Mo dɔ te sɛ anɔpa bɔ,ɛte sɛ anɔpa bosu a etu yera.
english:
“What can I do with you, Ephraim?
    What can I do with you, Judah?
Your love is like the morning mist,
    like the early dew that disappears.

twi: Mede mʼadiyifo twitwaa mo mu asinasin,mede mʼanom nsɛm kunkum mo;mʼatemmu baa mo so sɛ anyinam.
english:
Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets,
    I killed you with the words of my mouth—
    then my judgments go forth like the sun.

twi: Mepɛ ahummɔbɔ na ɛnyɛ afɔrebɔ,mepɛ Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ sen ɔhyew afɔre.
english:
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice,
    and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

twi: Wɔabu apam no so sɛnea Adam yɛe.Wɔanni me nokware wɔ hɔ.
english:
As at Adam, they have broken the covenant;
    they were unfaithful to me there.

twi: Gilead yɛ atirimɔdenfo kuropɔna mogya anammɔn akeka hɔ.
english:
Gilead is a city of evildoers,
    stained with footprints of blood.

twi: Sɛnea akwamukafo ka kwan mu nosaa ara na asɔfokuw no nso yɛ;wodi awu wɔ Sekem tempɔn so,yɛ nnebɔne a ɛyɛ animguase.
english:
As marauders lie in ambush for a victim,
    so do bands of priests;
they murder on the road to Shechem,
    carrying out their wicked schemes.

twi: Mahu ahodwiriwde wɔ Israelfi.Ɛhɔ, Efraim kɔ aguamammɔ muIsrael gu ne ho fi.
english:
I have seen a horrible thing in Israel:
    There Ephraim is given to prostitution,
    Israel is defiled.

twi: “Na wo Yuda nso,wɔahyɛ otwa bere ama wo.“Bere biara a mede me nkurɔfo siade bɛsan ama wɔn no,
english:
“Also for you, Judah,
    a harvest is appointed.
“Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people,

twi: bere biara a mɛsa Israel yare no,Efraim nnebɔne da adi.Samaria awurukasɛm nso da adi.Wɔyɛ nnaadaafoakorɔmfo a wobubu adan ani kɔ afi mu,ne akwamukafo a wɔbɔ korɔn wɔ mmɔnten so.
english:
whenever I would heal Israel,
the sins of Ephraim are exposed
    and the crimes of Samaria revealed.
They practice deceit,
    thieves break into houses,
    bandits rob in the streets;

twi: Na wonhu sɛmekae wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa.Wɔn bɔne bunkam wɔn so;egu mʼanim bere biara.
english:
but they do not realize
    that I remember all their evil deeds.
Their sins engulf them;
    they are always before me.

twi: “Wɔde atirimɔdensɛm gyigye ɔhene no ani,na wɔde atoro nso gyigye ahenemma no ani.
english:
“They delight the king with their wickedness,
    the princes with their lies.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ aguamammɔfoa akɔnnɔ redɛw wɔ wɔn mu.Wɔte sɛ fononoo a wɔasɔ mu gyabere a brodotofo ahyɛ ase refɔtɔw nʼasikresiam.
english:
They are all adulterers,
    burning like an oven
whose fire the baker need not stir
    from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

twi: Da a ɔhene rehyɛ fa noahenemma bow nsa,na ɔhene no fɛwdifo ne wɔn bɔ mu goru.
english:
On the day of the festival of our king
    the princes become inflamed with wine,
    and he joins hands with the mockers.

twi: Wɔn koma te sɛ fononoo;wɔde atirimpɔw bɔne kɔ ɔhene anim.Wɔn nsusuwii bɔne no dɛɛdɛɛ anadwo mu nyinaa;anɔpa, ɛdɛw te sɛ ogyatannaa.
Wɔn nyinaa ayɛ hyew sɛ fononoo.Wokunkum wɔn sodifo.Wɔn ahemfo nyinaa hwehwe asena wɔn mu biara nsu mfrɛ me.
english:
All of them are hot as an oven;
    they devour their rulers.
All their kings fall,
    and none of them calls on me.

twi: “Efraim ne aman no adi afra;Efraim yɛ ɔfam a anyinya a wonkisae.
english:
“Ephraim mixes with the nations;
    Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.

twi: Ananafo twe nʼahoɔden,nanso onhu.Dwen aba ne ti so,nanso nʼani mmaa so ɛ.
english:
Foreigners sap his strength,
    but he does not realize it.
His hair is sprinkled with gray,
    but he does not notice.

twi: Israel ahantan di adanse tia no,nanso eyi nyinaa akyi noɔnnsan nkɔ Awurade ne Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,na ɔnhwehwɛ no nso.
english:
Israel’s arrogance testifies against him,
    but despite all this
he does not return to the Lord his God
    or search for him.

twi: “Efraim te sɛ aborɔnoma,wotumi daadaa no na onni adwene.Ɔfrɛ Misraim,na wadan akɔ Asiria.
english:
“Ephraim is like a dove,
    easily deceived and senseless—
now calling to Egypt,
    now turning to Assyria.

twi: Sɛ wɔkɔ a, mɛtow mʼasau agu wɔn so;atwe wɔn aba fam te sɛ wim nnomaa.Sɛ mete sɛ wɔretu abɔ mu a,mɛkyere wɔn.
english:
When they go, I will throw my net over them;
    I will pull them down like the birds in the sky.
When I hear them flocking together,
    I will catch them.

twi: Nnome nka wɔn,efisɛ wɔatwe wɔn ho afi me ho!Ɔsɛe mmra wɔn soefisɛ wɔatew me so atua!anka mepɛ sɛ migye wɔnnanso wutwa atoro fa me ho.
english:
Woe to them,
    because they have strayed from me!
Destruction to them,
    because they have rebelled against me!
I long to redeem them
    but they speak about me falsely.

twi: Wommfi wɔn koma mu nsu mfrɛ me,mmom wotwa adwo wɔ wɔn mpa so.Wɔboaboa wɔn ho ano kɔhwehwɛ aduan ne nsa foforo,nanso wɔtwe wɔn ho fi me ho.
english:
They do not cry out to me from their hearts
    but wail on their beds.
They slash themselves, appealing to their gods
    for grain and new wine,
    but they turn away from me.

twi: Metetew wɔn, hyɛɛ wɔn den,nanso wɔbɔ pɔw bɔne tia me.
english:
I trained them and strengthened their arms,
    but they plot evil against me.

twi: Wɔnhwehwɛ Ɔsorosoroni no;wɔte sɛ tadua a asɛe,wɔn ntuanofo bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa anoefisɛ, wɔnkasa obu so.Eyi nti wobedi wɔn ho fɛwwɔ Misraim asase so.
english:
They do not turn to the Most High;
    they are like a faulty bow.
Their leaders will fall by the sword
    because of their insolent words.
For this they will be ridiculed
    in the land of Egypt.

twi: Israel Betwa Mfɛtɛ Aba“Monhyɛn torobɛnto!Ɔkɔre bi wɔ Awurade fifo soefisɛ nnipa no abu mʼapam sona wɔasɔre atia me mmara.
english:
“Put the trumpet to your lips!
    An eagle is over the house of the Lord
because the people have broken my covenant
    and rebelled against my law.

twi: Afei Israel su frɛ me se,‘Yɛn Nyankopɔn, yegye wo to mu!’
english:
Israel cries out to me,
    ‘Our God, we acknowledge you!’

twi: Nanso Israel apo nea eye;ɔtamfo bɛtaa no.
english:
But Israel has rejected what is good;
    an enemy will pursue him.

twi: Wosisi ahemfo a minnim ho hwee,wɔpaw ahenemma wɔ bere a mempenee so ɛ.Wɔde wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sikakɔkɔɔ yɛ ahoni ma wɔn hode sɛe wɔn ankasa ho.
english:
They set up kings without my consent;
    they choose princes without my approval.
With their silver and gold
    they make idols for themselves
    to their own destruction.

twi: Tow wo nantwi ba ohoni no kyene, Samaria!Mʼabufuwhyew reba wɔn so.Wɔbɛtena nea ɛho ntew mu akosi da bɛn?
english:
Samaria, throw out your calf-idol!
    My anger burns against them.
How long will they be incapable of purity?

twi: Wofi Israel!Saa nantwi ba yi, odwumfo bi na osenii;ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn!Wobebubu mu asinasin,saa Samaria nantwi ba no.
english:
They are from Israel!
This calf—a metalworker has made it;
    it is not God.
It will be broken in pieces,
    that calf of Samaria.

twi: “Wodua mframana wotwa mfɛtɛ.Awi a egyina hɔ no nni ti;nti wɔrennya siam mfi mu.Sɛ ɛsow aduan mpo a,ahɔho na wobedi.
english:
“They sow the wind
    and reap the whirlwind.
The stalk has no head;
    it will produce no flour.
Were it to yield grain,
    foreigners would swallow it up.

twi: Wɔamene Israel;afei ɔfra aman no mute sɛ ade a so nni mfaso biara.
Na wɔakɔ Asiriate sɛ wuram afurum a ɔno nko ara nenam.Efraim nso atɔn ne ho ama adɔfo.
english:
For they have gone up to Assyria
    like a wild donkey wandering alone.
    Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu, wɔatɔn wɔn ho wɔ amanaman no mu de,nanso mɛboaboa wɔn ano.Wɔn so befi ase atewwɔ ɔhene kɛse bi nhyɛso ase.
english:
Although they have sold themselves among the nations,
    I will now gather them together.
They will begin to waste away
    under the oppression of the mighty king.

twi: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ Efraim sisii afɔremuka bebree a wɔbɔ bɔnefakyɛ afɔre wɔ so de,ɛno nti abɛyɛ afɔremuka a wɔyɛ bɔne wɔ so.
english:
“Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings,
    these have become altars for sinning.

twi: Mekyerɛw me mmara a ɛfa nneɛma bebree ho maa wɔn,nanso wɔfaa no sɛ ananafo ade.
english:
I wrote for them the many things of my law,
    but they regarded them as something foreign.

twi: Wɔde mʼayɛyɛde bɔ afɔrena wɔwe nam no,nanso wɔnsɔ Awurade ani.Afei ɔbɛkae wɔn atirimɔdensɛmna wɔatwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho:Wɔbɛsan akɔ Misraim.
english:
Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to me,
    and though they eat the meat,
    the Lord is not pleased with them.
Now he will remember their wickedness
    and punish their sins:
    They will return to Egypt.

twi: Israel werɛ afi ne yɛfona wasisi ahemfi akɛseakɛse;Yuda abɔ nkurow bebree ho ban.Nanso mɛto ne nkuropɔn mu gyaa ɛbɛhyew wɔn aban.”
english:
Israel has forgotten their Maker
    and built palaces;
    Judah has fortified many towns.
But I will send fire on their cities
    that will consume their fortresses.”

twi: Israel AsotweNni ahurusi, Israel;nsɛpɛw wo ho te sɛ aman a aka no.Efisɛ woanni wo Nyankopɔn nokware,wʼani gye aguamammɔ howɔ awiporowbea nyinaa so.
Awiporowbea ne nsakyiamoa rentumi mma nnipa no aduan;nsa foforo nso bɛbɔ wɔn.
english:
Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people;
    the new wine will fail them.

twi: Wɔrentena Awurade asase no so bio;Efraim bɛsan akɔ Misraimna wadi aduan a ɛho ntew wɔ Asiria.

Wɔremmɔ ahwiesa afɔre mma Awurade,na wɔn afɔrebɔ nso nsɔ nʼani.Saa afɔrebɔ yi bɛyɛ sɛ asufo brodo de ama wɔn;wɔn a wodi nyinaa ho begu fi.Saa aduan no bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa deana wɔrentumi mmfa nkɔ Awurade asɔredan mu.
Dɛn na mobɛyɛ wɔ mo aponto da none Awurade afahyɛnna no nso?
english:
What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals,
    on the feast days of the Lord?

twi: Mpo sɛ woguan fi ɔsɛe mu aMisraim bɛboaboa wɔn ano,na Memfis besie wɔn.Wɔn dwetɛ ahonyade befuw wura,na wɔn ntamadan adan nsɔe.
english:
Even if they escape from destruction,
    Egypt will gather them,
    and Memphis will bury them.
Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers,
    and thorns will overrun their tents.

twi: Asotwe nna no reba,akontaabu nna no adu;ma Israel nhu eyi.Esiane mo bɔne bebrebene mo akokoakoko a adɔɔso ntimofa no sɛ odiyifo yɛ kwasea,na nea honhom akanyan no no yɛ ɔbɔdamfo.
english:
The days of punishment are coming,
    the days of reckoning are at hand.
    Let Israel know this.
Because your sins are so many
    and your hostility so great,
the prophet is considered a fool,
    the inspired person a maniac.

twi: Odiyifo no ne me Nyankopɔnyɛ Efraim so wɛmfo,nanso wɔasum no afiri wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa so,na ɔtan ahyɛ ne Nyankopɔn fi ma.
english:
The prophet, along with my God,
    is the watchman over Ephraim,
yet snares await him on all his paths,
    and hostility in the house of his God.

twi: Wɔadu porɔwee bun mu,sɛnea na ɛte wɔ Gibea nna no mu.Onyankopɔn bɛkae wɔn atirimɔdenna watwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho.
english:
They have sunk deep into corruption,
    as in the days of Gibeah.
God will remember their wickedness
    and punish them for their sins.

twi: “Bere a mihuu Israel no,na ɛte sɛ nea mahu bobe wɔ nweatam so;bere a mihuu mo agyanom no,na ɛte sɛ nea mahu borɔdɔma aba a edi kan wɔ ne dua so.Nanso bere a wɔbaa Baal-Peor nkyɛn nowodwiraa wɔn ho maa ohoni nimguaseni no.Wɔn ho yɛɛ nwini te sɛ ohoni a wɔdɔ no no ara.
english:
“When I found Israel,
    it was like finding grapes in the desert;
when I saw your ancestors,
    it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree.
But when they came to Baal Peor,
    they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol
    and became as vile as the thing they loved.

twi: Efraim anuonyam betu akɔ sɛ anomaa,nyinsɛn ne awo nni ne mu.
english:
Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird—
    no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

twi: Mpo sɛ wɔtetew mmofra a,mɛma mmofra no awuwu wɔ wɔn nsa mu.Wonnue,sɛ miyi mʼani fi wɔn so a!
english:
Even if they rear children,
    I will bereave them of every one.
Woe to them
    when I turn away from them!

twi: Mahu Efraim te sɛ Tiro,a ɛda baabi a eye.Nanso Efraim de ne mmabɛbrɛ okumfo no.”
english:
I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre,
    planted in a pleasant place.
But Ephraim will bring out
    their children to the slayer.”

twi: Fa ma wɔn, Awurade,dɛn na wode bɛma wɔn?Ma wɔn ɔyafunu a ɛpɔnne nufu a nufusu nni mu.
english:
Give them, Lord—
    what will you give them?
Give them wombs that miscarry
    and breasts that are dry.

twi: “Wɔn atirimɔdensɛm nyinaa a wodii wɔ Gilgal nti,mefaa wɔn ho tan wɔ hɔ.Wɔn nnebɔne ntimɛpam wɔn afi me fi.Merennɔ wɔn bio;efisɛ wɔn ntuanofo nyinaa yɛ atuatewfo.
english:
“Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal,
    I hated them there.
Because of their sinful deeds,
    I will drive them out of my house.
I will no longer love them;
    all their leaders are rebellious.

twi: Efraim agyigya,wɔn ntin akisa,nti wɔnsow aba.Sɛ wɔwo mma mpo a,mekunkum wɔn mma a wɔdɔ wɔn no.”
english:
Ephraim is blighted,
    their root is withered,
    they yield no fruit.
Even if they bear children,
    I will slay their cherished offspring.”

twi: Me Nyankopɔn bɛpo wɔn,efisɛ, wɔanyɛ osetie amma no;Wobekyinkyin aman no mu.
Israel yɛɛ bobe a ɛtrɛtrɛw;ɔsow aba maa ne ho.Bere a nʼaba redɔɔso no,osisii afɔremuka bebree;nʼasase rekɔ so yɛ yiye noosiesie nʼabosom dum kronkron no.
Nnaadaasɛm wɔ wɔn koma mu,nti ɛsɛ sɛ wonya wɔn afɔdi so asotwe.Awurade bebubu wɔn afɔremuka,na wasɛe wɔn abosom dum kronkron no.
english:
Their heart is deceitful,
    and now they must bear their guilt.
The Lord will demolish their altars
    and destroy their sacred stones.

twi: Afei, wɔbɛka se, “Yenni ɔhene,efisɛ, yɛamfa nidi amma Awurade.Mpo sɛ na yɛwɔ ɔhene koraa a,dɛn na anka obetumi ayɛ ama yɛn?”
english:
Then they will say, “We have no king
    because we did not revere the Lord.
But even if we had a king,
    what could he do for us?”

twi: Wɔhyɛ bɔ ahorow bebree,wɔka ntamhununa wɔyɛ apam ahorow;ɛno nti mansotwe sɔresɔrete sɛ wura a bɔre wɔ mua afifi asase a wɔafuntum so so.
english:
They make many promises,
    take false oaths
    and make agreements;
therefore lawsuits spring up
    like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

twi: Nnipa a wɔte Samaria no suro maBet-Awen nantwi ba ohoni no.Ne nkurɔfo besu.Saa ara na nʼakɔmfo nso bɛyɛ,wɔn a wogyee wɔn ani wɔ nʼanuonyam ho no.Efisɛ wɔafa no afi wɔn nkyɛn kɔ nnommum mu.
english:
The people who live in Samaria fear
    for the calf-idol of Beth Aven.
Its people will mourn over it,
    and so will its idolatrous priests,
those who had rejoiced over its splendor,
    because it is taken from them into exile.

twi: Wɔde no bɛkɔ Asiria,de akɔhyɛ ɔhene kɛse no anuonyam.Ebegu Efraim anim ase;na Israel ani bewu wɔ ne nnua ahoni ho.
english:
It will be carried to Assyria
    as tribute for the great king.
Ephraim will be disgraced;
    Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.

twi: Samaria na ne hene bɛsen akɔte sɛ abaa a ɛtɛn nsu ani.
english:
Samaria’s king will be destroyed,
    swept away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

twi: Wɔbɛsɛe abosonnan a wodi awurukasɛm ne bɔne wɔ mu no.Nsɔe ne nnɛnkyɛnse befifi hɔ,na akata wɔn afɔremuka so.Afei wɔbɛka akyerɛ mmepɔw se, “Mommɛkata yɛn so!”na wase nkoko se, “Munnwiriw ngu yɛn so!”
english:
The high places of wickedness will be destroyed—
    it is the sin of Israel.
Thorns and thistles will grow up
    and cover their altars.
Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!”
    and to the hills, “Fall on us!”

twi: “Efi Gibea bere so, woayɛ bɔne, Israel,na hɔ na woaka.Na ɔko rentwiw amfaamumɔyɛfo a wɔwɔ Gibea no so ana?
english:
“Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel,
    and there you have remained.
Will not war again overtake
    the evildoers in Gibeah?

twi: Bere a mepɛ no, mɛtwe wɔn aso;aman bɛboaboa wɔn ho ano atia wɔn.Wɔde mpokyerɛ begu wɔn wɔ wɔn bɔne dodow ho.
Efraim yɛ nantwi ba a wɔayɛn no,a ɔpɛ awiporowbea adwuma,enti mede konnuabɛto ne kɔn fɛɛfɛ mu.Mɛkyerɛ Efraim ɔkwan,ɛsɛ sɛ Yuda funtum asase no,na Yakob nso siesie so.
english:
Ephraim is a trained heifer
    that loves to thresh;
so I will put a yoke
    on her fair neck.
I will drive Ephraim,
    Judah must plow,
    and Jacob must break up the ground.

twi: Dua trenee aba ma wo ho,twa ɔdɔ aba a ɛtena hɔ daa,siesie wʼasase a womfuntumii so no;na bere adu sɛ wohwehwɛ Awurade,kosi sɛ ɔbɛbaabɛpete trenee agu wo so.
Nanso woadua atirimɔden aba,na woatwa aba bɔne.Woadi nnaadaa aba.Efisɛ wode wo ho ato wʼahoɔdenne wʼakofo bebrebe no so,
english:
But you have planted wickedness,
    you have reaped evil,
    you have eaten the fruit of deception.
Because you have depended on your own strength
    and on your many warriors,

twi: ɔko mu huuyɛ bɛsɔre atia wo nkurɔfo,na wʼaban nyinaa bɛsɛe,sɛnea Salman sɛee Bet Arbel ɔko da no,da a wɔde ɛnanom ne wɔn mma hwehwee fam no.
english:
the roar of battle will rise against your people,
    so that all your fortresses will be devastated—
as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle,
    when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

twi: Saa ara na ɛbɛba wo so, Bet-El,efisɛ wʼatirimɔdensɛm no dɔɔso.Sɛ da no du a,Wɔbɛsɛe Israelhene no koraa.
english:
So will it happen to you, Bethel,
    because your wickedness is great.
When that day dawns,
    the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

twi: Onyankopɔn Dɔ A Ɔdɔ Israel“Bere a Israel yɛ abofra no, na medɔ no,na Misraim na mefrɛɛ me babarima fii.
english:
“When Israel was a child, I loved him,
    and out of Egypt I called my son.

twi: Nanso mpɛn dodow a mefrɛɛ Israel no,saa ara na woguan fii me nkyɛn.Wɔbɔɔ afɔre maa Baal ahoni,na wɔhyew nnuhuam maa nsɛsode.
english:
But the more they were called,
    the more they went away from me.
They sacrificed to the Baals
    and they burned incense to images.

twi: Me na migyigyee Efraim taataa,turuu wɔn wɔ me basa so;nanso wɔnkae sɛme na mesaa wɔn yare.
english:
It was I who taught Ephraim to walk,
    taking them by the arms;
but they did not realize
    it was I who healed them.

twi: Me de ayamye hamane ɔdɔ dii wɔn anim;miyii konnua no fii wɔn kɔn muna mekotow maa wɔn aduan dii.
english:
I led them with cords of human kindness,
    with ties of love.
To them I was like one who lifts
    a little child to the cheek,
    and I bent down to feed them.

twi: “Wɔbɛsan akɔ Misraim,na Asiria adi wɔn so,esiane sɛ wɔannu wɔn ho nti.
english:
“Will they not return to Egypt
    and will not Assyria rule over them
    because they refuse to repent?

twi: Afoa bedi ahim wɔ wɔn kuropɔn muna ɛbɛsɛe wɔn apon akyi adabanna wɔn nhyehyɛe to betwa.
Me nkurɔfo asi no pi sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi me nkyɛn.Sɛ mpo wosu frɛ me Onyankopɔn Ɔsorosoroni no mpo ameremma wɔn so ɔkwan biara so.
english:
My people are determined to turn from me.
    Even though they call me God Most High,
    I will by no means exalt them.

twi: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na meyi wo ama, Efraim?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn ma meyi wo ama, Israel?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mɛyɛ wo sɛ Adma?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mɛyɛ wo sɛ Seboim?Me koma asakra wɔ me mu;na mʼahummɔbɔ ahwanyan.
english:
“How can I give you up, Ephraim?
    How can I hand you over, Israel?
How can I treat you like Admah?
    How can I make you like Zeboyim?
My heart is changed within me;
    all my compassion is aroused.

twi: Merenyɛ mʼabufuwhyew so ade,na merennan me ho nsɛe Efraim bio.Meyɛ Onyankopɔn na menyɛ onipa.Meyɛ Ɔkronkronni a ɔwɔ mo mu.Meremma wɔ abufuw mu.
english:
I will not carry out my fierce anger,
    nor will I devastate Ephraim again.
For I am God, and not a man—
    the Holy One among you.
    I will not come against their cities.

twi: Wobedi Awurade akyi.Ɔbɛbobɔ mu te sɛ gyata.Na sɛ ɔbobɔ mu a,ne mma de ahopopo befi atɔe aba.
english:
They will follow the Lord;
    he will roar like a lion.
When he roars,
    his children will come trembling from the west.

twi: Wɔde ahopopo bɛbate sɛ nnomaa a wofi Misraim,te sɛ mmorɔnoma a wofi Asiria.Mɛbɔ wɔn atenase wɔ wɔn afi mu,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
english:
They will come from Egypt,
    trembling like sparrows,
    from Assyria, fluttering like doves.
I will settle them in their homes,”
    declares the Lord.

twi: Israel BɔneEfraim de atoro atwa me ho ahyia,Israelfi nso wɔde nnaadaa.Yuda abɔ Onyankopɔn so kompo ɔde tia Ɔkronkronni nokwafo no.
english:
Ephraim has surrounded me with lies,
    Israel with deceit.
And Judah is unruly against God,
    even against the faithful Holy One.

twi: Efraim de mframa ayɛ aduan;odi apuei mframa akyi daana odi atoro yɛ akakabensɛm bebree.Ɔne Asiria yɛ apamna ɔde ngo kɔ Misraim.
english:
Ephraim feeds on the wind;
    he pursues the east wind all day
    and multiplies lies and violence.
He makes a treaty with Assyria
    and sends olive oil to Egypt.

twi: Awurade wɔ sobo de bɔ Yuda;ɔbɛtwe Yakob aso wɔ nʼakwan hona watua no ne nneyɛe so ka.
Ɔyafunu mu na osoo ne nua nantin;onyinii no, ɔne Onyankopɔn peperee so.
english:
In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel;
    as a man he struggled with God.

twi: Ɔne ɔbɔfo tentam dii ne so nkonim;ɔde nusu srɛɛ ne nkyɛn adom.Ohuu no wɔ Bet-Elne no kasaa wɔ hɔ.
english:
He struggled with the angel and overcame him;
    he wept and begged for his favor.
He found him at Bethel
    and talked with him there—

twi: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn,Awurade ne ne din a ahyeta!
english:
the Lord God Almighty,
    the Lord is his name!

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wosan kɔ wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Tena ɔdɔ ne trenee mu,na twɛn wo Nyankopɔn daa.
Oguadini de asisi nsania yɛ nʼadwuma;nʼani gye asisi ho.
english:
The merchant uses dishonest scales
    and loves to defraud.

twi: Efraim hoahoa ne ho sɛ,“Meyɛ ɔdefo; manya me ho.Mʼahonya nyinaa mu wɔrenhuamumɔyɛ biara wɔ me ho.”
english:
Ephraim boasts,
    “I am very rich; I have become wealthy.
With all my wealth they will not find in me
    any iniquity or sin.”

twi: “Mene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn,a miyii wo fii Misraim.Mɛma woakɔtena ntamadan mu biosɛnea na woyɛ wɔ wʼaponto afahyɛ nna mu no.
english:
“I have been the Lord your God
    ever since you came out of Egypt;
I will make you live in tents again,
    as in the days of your appointed festivals.

twi: Mekasa kyerɛɛ adiyifo,memaa wɔn anisoadehu bebreena mefaa wɔn so kaa mmebusɛm.”
english:
I spoke to the prophets,
    gave them many visions
    and told parables through them.”

twi: Gilead yɛ otirimɔdenfo ana?Emu nnipa no yɛ ahuhufo!Wɔde anantwi bɔ afɔre wɔ Gilgal ana?Wɔn afɔremuka bɛyɛ te sɛ aboa wɔahɔre no siw wɔ asase a wɔafuntum so.
english:
Is Gilead wicked?
    Its people are worthless!
Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal?
    Their altars will be like piles of stones
    on a plowed field.

twi: Yakob guan kɔɔ Aramfo asase so;Israel som de nyaa ɔyere,ɔhwɛɛ nguan de tuaa ti nsa.
Awurade nam odiyifo soyii Israel fii Misraim,ɔnam odiyifo so hwɛɛ no.
english:
The Lord used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt,
    by a prophet he cared for him.

twi: Nanso Efraim ahyɛ no abufuw yayaayaw;nʼAwurade bɛma ne mogyahwiegu ho afɔdi ada no sona obetua nʼanimtiaabu no so ka.
Awurade Abufuw A Etia IsraelSɛ Efraim kasa a, na nnipa ho popo;wɔma no so wɔ Israelman mu.Nanso Baalsom nti, onyaa afɔbu na owui.
Afei wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne ara;wɔde wɔn dwetɛ yɛ ahoni ma wɔn ho,nsɛsode no nyinaa no.Adwumfo no nam nyansakwan so na ayeyɛ.Wɔka nnipa yi ho asɛm se,“Wɔde nnipa bɔ afɔrena wofew nantwimma ahoni ano.”
english:
Now they sin more and more;
    they make idols for themselves from their silver,
cleverly fashioned images,
    all of them the work of craftsmen.
It is said of these people,
    “They offer human sacrifices!
    They kiss calf-idols!”

twi: Ɛno nti, wɔbɛyɛ sɛ anɔpa omununkumsɛ anɔpa bosu a etu yera,sɛ ntɛtɛ a ehuw fi awiporowbeasɛ wusiw a ɛfa mfɛnsere mu kɔ.
english:
Therefore they will be like the morning mist,
    like the early dew that disappears,
    like chaff swirling from a threshing floor,
    like smoke escaping through a window.

twi: “Nanso mene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn,a miyii wo fii Misraim.Nnye Onyankopɔn biara nto mu sɛ me,anaa Ogyefo biara sɛ me.
english:
“But I have been the Lord your God
    ever since you came out of Egypt.
You shall acknowledge no God but me,
    no Savior except me.

twi: Mehwɛɛ wo wɔ nweatam so,asase a so yɛ hyew yiye no so.
english:
I cared for you in the wilderness,
    in the land of burning heat.

twi: Memaa wɔn aduan no, wodi mee;wɔmee no, wɔyɛɛ ahantan;na wɔn werɛ fii me.
Enti mɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so sɛ gyata,mɛtɛw wɔn wɔ akwan ho sɛ ɔsebɔ.
english:
So I will be like a lion to them,
    like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

twi: Mɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so na matetew wɔn mute sɛ sisi bi a wɔawia ne mma.Mɛwe wɔn te sɛ gyata;wuram aboa besunsuan wɔn mu.
english:
Like a bear robbed of her cubs,
    I will attack them and rip them open;
like a lion I will devour them—
    a wild animal will tear them apart.

twi: “Wɔasɛe wo, Israel,efisɛ woasɔre atia me,me a meyɛ wo boafo.
english:
“You are destroyed, Israel,
    because you are against me, against your helper.

twi: Wo hene wɔ he na wabegye wo?Wo sodifo a wɔwɔ wo nkurow nyinaa so no wɔ he,wɔn a wokaa faa wɔn ho se,‘Ma me ɔhene ne ahenemma’ no?
english:
Where is your king, that he may save you?
    Where are your rulers in all your towns,
of whom you said,
    ‘Give me a king and princes’?

twi: Enti mʼabufuw mu, memaa wo ɔhene,na mʼanibere mu no, miyii no hɔ.
english:
So in my anger I gave you a king,
    and in my wrath I took him away.

twi: Efraim afɔdi no wɔaboaboa anowɔakyerɛw ne bɔne agu hɔ.
english:
The guilt of Ephraim is stored up,
    his sins are kept on record.

twi: Ɔbɛte ɔyaw te sɛ ɔbea a ɔreko awo,na abofra no nnim nyansa nti;sɛ bere no du a,ɔmma awotwaa no ano.
english:
Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him,
    but he is a child without wisdom;
when the time arrives,
    he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.

twi: “Mɛpata agye wɔn afi ɔda tumi mu.Megye wɔn afi owu nsam.Owu, wo nwowɔe wɔ he?Asaman, wo sɛe wɔ he?“Merennya ayamhyehye biara,
english:
“I will deliver this people from the power of the grave;
    I will redeem them from death.
Where, O death, are your plagues?
    Where, O grave, is your destruction?
“I will have no compassion,

twi: mpo sɛ ɔyɛ yiye wɔ ne nuanom mu a.Apuei mframa a efi Awurade hɔ bɛba,ɛbɛbɔ afi nweatam so;osu rentɔ asusowberena nʼabura bɛyow.Wɔbɛfom ne koradan mu nneɛmanea ɛsom bo no nyinaa.
english:
even though he thrives among his brothers.
An east wind from the Lord will come,
    blowing in from the desert;
his spring will fail
    and his well dry up.
His storehouse will be plundered
    of all its treasures.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Samaria gye wɔn afɔdi to mu,efisɛ wɔayɛ dɔm atia wɔn Nyankopɔn.Wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano;wɔbɛtotow wɔn mmofra ahwehwe fam,wɔn mmaa a wɔanyinsɛn nso wɔbɛpaapae wɔn mu.”
english:
The people of Samaria must bear their guilt,
    because they have rebelled against their God.
They will fall by the sword;
    their little ones will be dashed to the ground,
    their pregnant women ripped open.”

twi: Ahonu De Nhyira BaIsrael, san wʼakyi kɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Wʼasehwe fi wo bɔne!
english:
Return, Israel, to the Lord your God.
    Your sins have been your downfall!

twi: Fa wo nsɛm a wowɔsan kɔ Awurade nkyɛn.Ka kyerɛ no se,“Fa yɛn bɔne nyinaa kyɛ yɛn,na fa ahummɔbɔ gye yɛn,na yɛatumi ayi wo ayɛ.
english:
Take words with you
    and return to the Lord.
Say to him:
    “Forgive all our sins
and receive us graciously,
    that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

twi: Asiria rentumi nnye yɛn;yɛrentena akofo apɔnkɔ so.Yɛrenka bio da se, ‘Yɛn anyame’nkyerɛ nea yɛn ara de yɛn nsa ayɛ,na wo mu na ayisaa nya mmɔborɔhunu.”
english:
Assyria cannot save us;
    we will not mount warhorses.
We will never again say ‘Our gods’
    to what our own hands have made,
    for in you the fatherless find compassion.”

twi: “Mɛsa wɔn asoɔden yare.Mefi me koma mu adɔ wɔn,efisɛ mʼabufuw nni wɔn so bio.
english:
“I will heal their waywardness
    and love them freely,
    for my anger has turned away from them.

twi: Mɛyɛ sɛ obosu ama Israel.Ɔbɛfefɛw ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ sukooko.Te sɛ Lebanon sida no,ɔde ne ntin betim fam;
ne mman bɛdennan.Nʼahoɔfɛ bɛyɛ sɛ ngodua,na ne hua ayɛ sɛ Lebanon sida.
english:
his young shoots will grow.
His splendor will be like an olive tree,
    his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

twi: Nnipa bɛtena ne nwini ase bio.Obenyin ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ aburow.Ɔbɛfefɛw ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ bobe,na ne din a ahyeta bɛyɛ sɛ nsa a efi Lebanon.
english:
People will dwell again in his shade;
    they will flourish like the grain,
they will blossom like the vine—
    Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.

twi: Efraim dɛn na me ne ahoni wɔ yɛ bio?Megye no so na mʼani aku ne ho.Mete sɛ dua a nʼahaban mpo;sɛ wobɛsow aba a, egyina me so.”
english:
Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols?
    I will answer him and care for him.
I am like a flourishing juniper;
    your fruitfulness comes from me.”

twi: Hena ne onyansafo? Obehu eyinom mu.Hena na ɔwɔ nhumu? Ɔbɛte eyinom ase.Awurade akwan teɛ.Atreneefo nantew so,nanso asoɔdenfo hintiw wɔ mu.
english:
Who is wise? Let them realize these things.
    Who is discerning? Let them understand.
The ways of the Lord are right;
    the righteous walk in them,
    but the rebellious stumble in them.

twi: Saa anisoadehu a ɛfa Yuda ne Yerusalem ho no baa Amos babarima Yesaia so wɔ Yuda ahemfo Usia, Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia mmere so.
english: The vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

twi: AtuatewmanƆsoro, muntie! Asase, yɛ aso!Na Awurade akasa:“Matetew mma ama wɔanyinyin,nanso wɔatew me so atua.
english:
Hear me, you heavens! Listen, earth!
    For the Lord has spoken:
“I reared children and brought them up,
    but they have rebelled against me.

twi: Nantwi nim ne wura,afurum nso nim ne wura mmoa adididaka,nanso Israel nnim,me nkurɔfo nte ase.”
english:
The ox knows its master,
    the donkey its owner’s manger,
but Israel does not know,
    my people do not understand.”

twi: Nnome nka, amumɔyɛ man,ɔman a wɔn afɔdi so,nnebɔneyɛfo kuw,mma a porɔwee ahyɛ wɔn ma!Wɔatwe wɔn ho afi Awurade ho;wɔapo Israel Kronkronni no,wɔadan wɔn akyi akyerɛ no.
english:
Woe to the sinful nation,
    a people whose guilt is great,
a brood of evildoers,
    children given to corruption!
They have forsaken the Lord;
    they have spurned the Holy One of Israel
    and turned their backs on him.

twi: Adɛn nti na mopɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so boro mo?Adɛn nti na moda so tew atua?Wɔapira mo ti,na mo koma nso di yaw.
english:
Why should you be beaten anymore?
    Why do you persist in rebellion?
Your whole head is injured,
    your whole heart afflicted.

twi: Efi mo nan ase kosi mo ti so,ahomeka biara nni mu,apirakuru ne ahonhon nko araakuru a anim deda hɔna wɔnhohoro so anaa wɔnkyekyereeanaa wɔmfaa ngo nsrasraa so ɛ.
english:
From the sole of your foot to the top of your head
    there is no soundness—
only wounds and welts
    and open sores,
not cleansed or bandaged
    or soothed with olive oil.

twi: Mo man ada mpan,wɔde ogya ahyehyew mo nkuropɔn;ananafo regye mo mfuwa mo ani tua,na asɛe sɛnea ɛyɛɛ bere a ahɔho tuu mo gui no.
english:
Your country is desolate,
    your cities burned with fire;
your fields are being stripped by foreigners
    right before you,
    laid waste as when overthrown by strangers.

twi: Wɔagyaw Ɔbabea Sionte sɛ bobeturo mu sesete sɛ akuraa a esi ɛfere afuw mu,te sɛ kuropɔn a atamfo atwa ho ahyia.
english:
Daughter Zion is left
    like a shelter in a vineyard,
like a hut in a cucumber field,
    like a city under siege.

twi: Sɛ Asafo Awuradeannyaw yɛn asefo a,anka yɛayɛ sɛ Sodom,na yɛadan ayɛ sɛ Gomora.
english:
Unless the Lord Almighty
    had left us some survivors,
we would have become like Sodom,
    we would have been like Gomorrah.

twi: Muntie Awurade asɛm,mo Sodom sodifo;muntie yɛn Nyankopɔn mmara,mo Gomorafo!
english:
Hear the word of the Lord,
    you rulers of Sodom;
listen to the instruction of our God,
    you people of Gomorrah!

twi: “Mo afɔrebɔ ahorow bebree no,dɛn na ɛyɛ ma me?”Sɛnea Awurade se ni.“Mewɔ ɔhyew afɔrebɔde ma ɛboro so,nea ɛyɛ adwennini ne mmoa a wɔadɔ srade;mʼani nnyeanantwinini, nguantenmma ne mpapo mogya ho.
english:
“The multitude of your sacrifices—
    what are they to me?” says the Lord.
“I have more than enough of burnt offerings,
    of rams and the fat of fattened animals;
I have no pleasure
    in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

twi: Sɛ moba mʼanim ahena na obisa eyi fi mo hɔ,sɛ mutiatia me fi yi?
english:
When you come to appear before me,
    who has asked this of you,
    this trampling of my courts?

twi: Munnyae afɔrebɔde a ɛmfra a mode ba no!Mo aduhuam yɛ me tan.Ɔsram foforo, homenna ne nhyiamu ahorow,mo nhyiamu hunu no afono me.
english:
Stop bringing meaningless offerings!
    Your incense is detestable to me.
New Moons, Sabbaths and convocations—
    I cannot bear your worthless assemblies.

twi: Mo ɔsram foforo afahyɛ ne mo aponto a moahyehyɛ,me kra kyi.Ayɛ adesoa ama me;masoa abrɛ.
english:
Your New Moon feasts and your appointed festivals
    I hate with all my being.
They have become a burden to me;
    I am weary of bearing them.

twi: Sɛ momema mo nsa so bɔ mpae a,meyi mʼani ato nkyɛn.Sɛ mobɔ mpae bebree mpo amerentie.“Mogya bebree agu mo nsa ho fi.
english:
When you spread out your hands in prayer,
    I hide my eyes from you;
even when you offer many prayers,
    I am not listening.
Your hands are full of blood!

twi: “Munnwira mo ho na mo ho ntew.Munnyi mo nnebɔne mfi mʼani so!Munnyae bɔneyɛ,
Monyɛ papa! Monhwehwɛ atɛntrenee.Monhyɛ wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nkuranMunni mma ayisaa,monka akunafo nsɛm mma wɔn.
english:
Learn to do right; seek justice.
    Defend the oppressed.
Take up the cause of the fatherless;
    plead the case of the widow.

twi: “Afei mommra na yennwen mmɔ mu,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.“Sɛ mo bɔne te sɛ ɔkɔben a,ɛbɛyɛ fitaa sɛ sukyerɛmma;mpo sɛ ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ te sɛ mogya aɛbɛyɛ fitaa sɛ asaawa mfuturu.
english:
“Come now, let us settle the matter,”
    says the Lord.
“Though your sins are like scarlet,
    they shall be as white as snow;
though they are red as crimson,
    they shall be like wool.

twi: Sɛ mopene so na moyɛ osetie a,mubedi asase no so nnepa.
english:
If you are willing and obedient,
    you will eat the good things of the land;

twi: Na sɛ moampene na motew atua a,afoa bedi mo nam.”Awurade na wakasa.
english:
but if you resist and rebel,
    you will be devoured by the sword.”
For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea kuropɔn nokwafo noadan oguamanfo.Bere bi, na atɛntrenee ahyɛ no mana anka trenee te ne mu,nanso mprempren, awudifo ahyɛ mu ma!
english:
See how the faithful city
    has become a prostitute!
She once was full of justice;
    righteousness used to dwell in her—
    but now murderers!

twi: Wo dwetɛ adan ade a so nni mfaso,wɔde nsu afra wo nsa papa mu.
english:
Your silver has become dross,
    your choice wine is diluted with water.

twi: Wo sodifo yɛ atuatewfo,akorɔmfo yɔnkonom;wɔn nyinaa pɛ adanmude,na wɔpere akyɛde ho.Wonni mma ayisaa;na akunafo nsɛm nkɔ wɔn anim.
Enti, Awurade, Asafo Awurade,nea ɔyɛ Ɔkɛse ma Israel no ka se,“Aa, menya ahomegye afi mʼatamfo hɔna matɔ wɔn so were.
english:
Therefore the Lord, the Lord Almighty,
    the Mighty One of Israel, declares:
“Ah! I will vent my wrath on my foes
    and avenge myself on my enemies.

twi: Mɛma me nsa so, atia mo;mɛhohoro mo ho fi korakorana mayi mo ho nkekae nyinaa.
Mɛma mo atemmufo bio sɛ kan no,ne mo afotufo sɛnea na ɛte, mfiase no.Eyi akyi no, wɔbɛfrɛ woKuropɔn Trenee,Kuropɔn Nokwafo.”
english:
I will restore your leaders as in days of old,
    your rulers as at the beginning.
Afterward you will be called
    the City of Righteousness,
    the Faithful City.”

twi: Wɔde atɛntrenee begye Sion bio,na wɔn a wonu wɔn ho no, wɔde trenee begye wɔn.
english:
Zion will be delivered with justice,
    her penitent ones with righteousness.

twi: Nanso atuatewfo ne nnebɔneyɛfo de, wɔbɛdwerɛw wɔn abɔ mu,na wɔn a wɔpa Awurade akyi bɛyera.
english:
But rebels and sinners will both be broken,
    and those who forsake the Lord will perish.

twi: “Mo ani bewu, esiane odum anyame amunyaa wɔn mu anigye no;wobegu mo anim ase, esiane nturoa mosom abosom wɔ mu no nti.
english:
“You will be ashamed because of the sacred oaks
    in which you have delighted;
you will be disgraced because of the gardens
    that you have chosen.

twi: Mobɛyɛ sɛ odum a ne nhaban apo,ne turo a ennya nsu.
english:
You will be like an oak with fading leaves,
    like a garden without water.

twi: Ɔhoɔdenfo bɛyɛ sɛ ade a ɛhyew ntɛmnʼadwuma bɛyɛ sɛ ogya a aturuw;abien no bɛhyew abɔ mu,a obiara rentumi nnum.”
english:
The mighty man will become tinder
    and his work a spark;
both will burn together,
    with no one to quench the fire.”

twi: Awurade Bepɔw NoEyi ne nea Amos babarima Yesaia hui, a ɛfa Yuda ne Yerusalem ho.
english: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:

twi: Nna a edi akyi no mu no,Awurade asɔredan bepɔw no betimsɛ mmepɔw no nyinaa ti;ebegye din aboro nkoko nyinaa sona aman nyinaa bɛbɔ yuu akɔ hɔ.
english:
In the last days
the mountain of the Lord’s temple will be established
    as the highest of the mountains;
it will be exalted above the hills,
    and all nations will stream to it.

twi: Aman bebree bɛba abɛka se,“Mommra mma yɛnkɔ Awurade bepɔw no so,nkɔ Yakob Nyankopɔn fi.Ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ yɛn nʼakwansɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yɛbɛnantew nʼatempɔn so.”Mmara no befi Sion aba,na Awurade asɛm afi Yerusalem.
english:
Many peoples will come and say,
“Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord,
    to the temple of the God of Jacob.
He will teach us his ways,
    so that we may walk in his paths.”
The law will go out from Zion,
    the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

twi: Obebu amanaman ntam atɛnna obesiesie nnipa bebree ntam asɛm.Wɔde wɔn afoa bɛbobɔ nsɔwna wɔde wɔn mpeaw ayɛ asosɔw.Ɔman bi rentwe ɔman foforo so afoa,na wɔrenyɛ ahoboa biara mma ɔko bio.
english:
He will judge between the nations
    and will settle disputes for many peoples.
They will beat their swords into plowshares
    and their spears into pruning hooks.
Nation will not take up sword against nation,
    nor will they train for war anymore.

twi: Mommra. Yakob fifo,momma yɛnnantew Awurade hann mu.
english:
Come, descendants of Jacob,
    let us walk in the light of the Lord.

twi: Awurade Da NoAwurade, woagyaw wo nkurɔfo,Yakob fifo.Gyidihunu a efi apuei fam ahyɛ wɔn ma;wɔhyɛ nkɔm sɛ Filistifona wɔne abosonsomfo fa ayɔnko.
english:
You, Lord, have abandoned your people,
    the descendants of Jacob.
They are full of superstitions from the East;
    they practice divination like the Philistines
    and embrace pagan customs.

twi: Dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahyɛ wɔn asase no so ma;wɔn ademude dɔɔso bebree.Apɔnkɔ ayɛ wɔn asase no so ma;na wɔn nteaseɛnam dodow nni ano.
Ahoni ahyɛ wɔn asase no so ma;wɔkotow sɔre wɔn ankasa nsa ano adwuma,nea wɔn nsateaa ayɛ.
Enti, Awurade bɛbrɛ onipa asena wama adesamma abotow,mfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn.
english:
So people will be brought low
    and everyone humbled—
    do not forgive them.

twi: Kɔhyɛn abotan no mu,fa wo ho kosie asase no mu esiane Awurade ho hune nʼanuonyam kɛseyɛ nti!
english:
Go into the rocks, hide in the ground
    from the fearful presence of the Lord
    and the splendor of his majesty!

twi: Wɔbɛbrɛ ɔhantanni ase,na wɔde nnipa ahomaso ahwe fam;Awurade nko ara na wɔbɛma no so da no.
Asafo Awurade ahyɛ da biama ahomasofo nyinaane nea ɛma ne ho so nyinaa(wɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ase),
english:
The Lord Almighty has a day in store
    for all the proud and lofty,
for all that is exalted
    (and they will be humbled),

twi: Lebanon sida nyinaa, atenten ne nea ɛkorɔn,ne Basan odum nnua no,
english:
for all the cedars of Lebanon, tall and lofty,
    and all the oaks of Bashan,

twi: mmepɔw atenten nyinaane nkoko a ɛwowaree nyinaa,
english:
for all the towering mountains
    and all the high hills,

twi: ne abantenten a ɛkorɔnne ɔfasu biara a ɛyɛ den,
english:
for every lofty tower
    and every fortified wall,

twi: aguadi hyɛn biarane hyɛn kɛse fɛfɛ biara.
english:
for every trading ship
    and every stately vessel.

twi: Wɔbɛbrɛ ɔhantanni ase,na wɔde nnipa ahomaso ahwe fam;Awurade nko ara na wɔbɛma no so da no,
na ahoni no bɛyera korakora.
english: and the idols will totally disappear.

twi: Nnipa beguan akɔhyɛ abodan a ɛwɔ abotan mune ntokuru a ɛdeda asase muesiane Awurade ho hune nʼanuonyam kɛseyɛ nti,bere a ɔbɛsɔre awosow asase.
english:
People will flee to caves in the rocks
    and to holes in the ground
from the fearful presence of the Lord
    and the splendor of his majesty,
    when he rises to shake the earth.

twi: Saa da no, nnipa bɛtowwɔn dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahonia wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛsom noagu ama akisi ne mpan.
english:
In that day people will throw away
    to the moles and bats
their idols of silver and idols of gold,
    which they made to worship.

twi: Wobeguan akɔhyɛ abotan mu ntokuru mune abotan mpaapae muesiane Awurade ho hune nʼanuonyam kɛseyɛ nti,bere a ɔbɛsɔre awosow asase.
english:
They will flee to caverns in the rocks
    and to the overhanging crags
from the fearful presence of the Lord
    and the splendor of his majesty,
    when he rises to shake the earth.

twi: Munnyae sɛ mode mo ho to nnipa,a wɔwɔ ɔhome kɛkɛ so.Wɔyɛ dɛn koraa?
english:
Stop trusting in mere humans,
    who have but a breath in their nostrils.
