    Why hold them in esteem?

twi: Yerusalem Ne Yuda AtemmuAfei hwɛ, Awurade,Asafo Awurade,rebegyae nea ɔde mawɔ Yerusalem ne Yuda nyinaa:aduan ne nsu a ɔde ma wɔn nyinaa.
english:
See now, the Lord,
    the Lord Almighty,
is about to take from Jerusalem and Judah
    both supply and support:
all supplies of food and all supplies of water,

twi: Dɔmmarima ne akofo,otemmufo ne odiyifo,nkɔmhyɛni ne ɔpanyin,
english:
the hero and the warrior,
the judge and the prophet,
    the diviner and the elder,

twi: aduonum so panyin ne nea ɔwɔ dibea,ɔfotufo, odwumfo nyansafo ne nkaberekyerefo onifirifo.
english:
the captain of fifty and the man of rank,
    the counselor, skilled craftsman and clever enchanter.

twi: “Mede mmerantewa bɛyɛ wɔn nnwuma so mpanyimfo;na mmofra adi wɔn so.”
english:
“I will make mere youths their officials;
    children will rule over them.”

twi: Nnipa bɛhyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho so,ɔbarima betia ɔbarima, ɔyɔnko betia ne yɔnko.Mmabun bɛsɔre atia wɔn mpanyimfo,apapahwekwa betia onuonyamfo.
english:
People will oppress each other—
    man against man, neighbor against neighbor.
The young will rise up against the old,
    the nobody against the honored.

twi: Ɔbarima beso ne nuanom mu baako muwɔ nʼagya fi aka se,“Wowɔ atade, bɛyɛ yɛn dikanfo;wɔ kurow a adan mmubui siw yi so.”
english:
A man will seize one of his brothers
    in his father’s house, and say,
“You have a cloak, you be our leader;
    take charge of this heap of ruins!”

twi: Nanso da no ɔbɛteɛ mu se,“Minni nea mede bɛyɛ.Minni aduan anaa ntama wɔ me fi;mfa me nyɛ nnipa no so kannifo.”
english:
But in that day he will cry out,
    “I have no remedy.
I have no food or clothing in my house;
    do not make me the leader of the people.”

twi: Yerusalem retɔ ntintan,Yuda rehwe ase;wɔn nsɛm ne nneyɛe tia Awurade.Wommu nʼanuonyam a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no.
english:
Jerusalem staggers,
    Judah is falling;
their words and deeds are against the Lord,
    defying his glorious presence.

twi: Sɛnea wɔn anim te no di adanse tia wɔn;wɔda wɔn bɔne adi te sɛ Sodom;wɔmmfa nsie.Nnome nka wɔn!Wɔakɔfa amanehunu aba wɔn ho so.
Ka kyerɛ atreneefo se ebesi wɔn yiye,efisɛ wobedi wɔn nneyɛe so aba.
english:
Tell the righteous it will be well with them,
    for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds.

twi: Nnome nka amumɔyɛfo!Amanehunu wɔ wɔn so!Wobetua wɔn neawɔn nsa ayɛ no so ka.
english:
Woe to the wicked!
    Disaster is upon them!
They will be paid back
    for what their hands have done.

twi: Mmabun hyɛ me nkurɔfo so,mmea di wɔn so.Me nkurɔfo, mo akwankyerɛfo ma moyera;wɔma moman fi ɔtempɔn no so.
english:
Youths oppress my people,
    women rule over them.
My people, your guides lead you astray;
    they turn you from the path.

twi: Awurade tena ase wɔ nʼasennii.Ɔma ne mu so bu nkurɔfo no atɛn.
english:
The Lord takes his place in court;
    he rises to judge the people.

twi: Awurade bu atɛnde tia ne nkurɔfo mpanyimfo ne akannifo se,“Mo na moasɛe me bobeturo;apoobɔde a efi ahiafo nkyɛn wɔ mo afi mu.
english:
The Lord enters into judgment
    against the elders and leaders of his people:
“It is you who have ruined my vineyard;
    the plunder from the poor is in your houses.

twi: Ase ne dɛn nti na modwerɛw me nkurɔfona mode ahiafo anim twitwiw fam?”Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
english:
What do you mean by crushing my people
    and grinding the faces of the poor?”
declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

twi: Awurade kasa se,“Sion mmabea yɛ ahantan;wɔnantew toto wɔn kɔn,wɔdeda wɔn ani akyi,wotutu wɔn anammɔn ntiantia,na wɔn anan ase nkaa gyigye.
english:
The Lord says,
    “The women of Zion are haughty,
walking along with outstretched necks,
    flirting with their eyes,
strutting along with swaying hips,
    with ornaments jingling on their ankles.

twi: Enti Awurade bɛma tikuru abegu Sion mmea ti ho.Awurade bɛma wɔn ti so apa.”
english:
Therefore the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion;
    the Lord will make their scalps bald.”

twi: Da no Awurade beyiyi wɔn afɛfɛde: nkaa, ntamabamma ne kɔnmuade,
english: In that day the Lord will snatch away their finery: the bangles and headbands and crescent necklaces,

twi: asokaa, nkapo ne nkataanim,
english: the earrings and bracelets and veils,

twi: Wɔn mmotiri, anan ase ntweaban, nkyekyeremu, nnuhuam ntoa ne nkabere,
english: the headdresses and anklets and sashes, the perfume bottles and charms,

twi: nsɔwano mpɛtea ne hwenem nkaa,
english: the signet rings and nose rings,

twi: ntade atenten pa, nguguso tiaa a enni nsa, ntade yuu ne sika nkotoku;
english: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses

twi: nhwehwɛ, sirikyi ntade, tinwi so nkaa ne mmati so nguguso.
english: and mirrors, and the linen garments and tiaras and shawls.

twi: Nkabɔne besi nea ɛyɛ huam anan mu;ntampehama besi nkatakɔnmu anan mu;ti a ɛso apa besi tinwi a wɔasiesie anan mu;atweaatam besi ntama pa anan mu;honam ani atwaatwa besi ahoɔfɛ anan mu.
Wo mmarima bɛtotɔ afoa ano,wʼakofo wɔ ɔko mu.
english:
Your men will fall by the sword,
    your warriors in battle.

twi: Sion apon betwa adwo, adi awerɛhow;onnibi, ɔbɛtena fam.
english:
The gates of Zion will lament and mourn;
    destitute, she will sit on the ground.

twi: Saa da no, mmea baasonbeso ɔbarima baako mu aka se,“Yɛbɛbɔ yɛn ho akɔnhamana yɛn ankasa apɛ yɛn adurade;ma wo din nna yɛn so kɛkɛ.Yi ahohora fi yɛn so!”
english:
In that day seven women
    will take hold of one man
and say, “We will eat our own food
    and provide our own clothes;
only let us be called by your name.
    Take away our disgrace!”

twi: Awurade Baa NoSaa da no Awurade Baa no bɛyɛ fɛ na anya anuonyam, na asase no so aba bɛyɛ ahohoahoa ne anuonyam ama Israel nkae no.
english: In that day the Branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of the survivors in Israel.

twi: Wɔn a wɔaka wɔ Sion, a wɔte Yerusalem no, wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn kronkron, wɔn a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din aka ateasefo ho wɔ Yerusalem nyinaa.
english: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

twi: Awurade bɛhohoro Sion mmea ho fi; ɔde atemmu honhom ne ogya honhom bɛpepa mogya nkekae a ɛwɔ Yerusalem.
english: The Lord will wash away the filth of the women of Zion; he will cleanse the bloodstains from Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.

twi: Afei, Bepɔw Sion ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn ano wɔ hɔ nyinaa, Awurade de wusiw mununkum bɛkata wɔn so awia, na ɔde ogya a ɛdɛw akata wɔn so anadwo; ntama kyinii bɛkata anuonyam yi nyinaa so.
english: Then the Lord will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who assemble there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night; over everything the glory will be a canopy.

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ hintabea ne onwini wɔ awia anoden mu, na osu ne ahum mu nso, ɛbɛyɛ guankɔbea ne hintabea.
english: It will be a shelter and shade from the heat of the day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.

twi: Bobe Turo Ho DwomMɛto dwom ama me dɔfodwom a ɛfa ne bobeturo ho:Na me dɔfo wɔ bobe turo biwɔ asasebere bi a ɛda bepɔw ani.
english:
I will sing for the one I love
    a song about his vineyard:
My loved one had a vineyard
    on a fertile hillside.

twi: Ofuntum asase no, yiyii mu abo,na oduaa bobe a ɛyɛ papa wɔ so.Osii ɔwɛn aban wɔ mfimfinina otuu nsakyiamoa nso.Afei ɔhwɛɛ anim sɛ obetwa bobe aba pa,nanso ɛsow aba bɔne.
english:
He dug it up and cleared it of stones
    and planted it with the choicest vines.
He built a watchtower in it
    and cut out a winepress as well.
Then he looked for a crop of good grapes,
    but it yielded only bad fruit.

twi: “Afei mo a motete Yerusalem ne Yuda mmarima,mummu me ne me bobeturo ntam atɛn.
english:
“Now you dwellers in Jerusalem and people of Judah,
    judge between me and my vineyard.

twi: Dɛn bio na anka ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ ma me bobeturoboro nea mayɛ yi so?Bere a merehwɛ anim sɛ minya bobe a eye noadɛn nti na ɛsow aba bɔne?
english:
What more could have been done for my vineyard
    than I have done for it?
When I looked for good grapes,
    why did it yield only bad?

twi: Afei mɛkanea merebɛyɛ me bobeturo no akyerɛ wo:Meyi ho ban no afi hɔ,na wɔbɛsɛe no;mebubu ho ɔfasu,na wobetiatia so.
english:
Now I will tell you
    what I am going to do to my vineyard:
I will take away its hedge,
    and it will be destroyed;
I will break down its wall,
    and it will be trampled.

twi: Mɛma ayɛ asase a ɛda mpana worenyiyi mu na wɔnyɛ so adwuma,ohwirem ne nsɔe benyin wɔ so.Mɛhyɛ omununkumna wantɔ osu angu so.”
english:
I will make it a wasteland,
    neither pruned nor cultivated,
    and briers and thorns will grow there.
I will command the clouds
    not to rain on it.”

twi: Asafo Awurade bobeturo noyɛ Israelfi,na Yuda mmarima yɛ turo a nʼani gye ho.Ɔpɛɛ atɛntrenee nanso ohuu mogyahwiegu;ɔpɛɛ trenee nanso ɔtee mmɔborɔsu.
english:
The vineyard of the Lord Almighty
    is the nation of Israel,
and the people of Judah
    are the vines he delighted in.
And he looked for justice, but saw bloodshed;
    for righteousness, but heard cries of distress.

twi: Nnome Ne AtemmuNnome nka mo a mode ofi ka ofi hona mugyigye mfuw bobɔ sokosi sɛ asase no bɛsana ɛka mo nko ara wɔ asase no so.
english:
Woe to you who add house to house
    and join field to field
till no space is left
    and you live alone in the land.

twi: Asafo Awurade apae mu aka ama mate:“Nokwarem, afi akɛse no bɛda mpan,na aban afɛɛfɛ no, obiara rentena mu.
english:
The Lord Almighty has declared in my hearing:
“Surely the great houses will become desolate,
    the fine mansions left without occupants.

twi: Bobeturo kɛse pa ara nonsa kakraa bi na ebefi mu.Aba lita aduonu baako a wodua nowobenya so lita aduonu abien pɛ.”
english:
A ten-acre vineyard will produce only a bath of wine;
    a homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain.”

twi: Wonnue, wɔn a wɔsɔre anɔpahemakɔhwehwɛ wɔn nsa akyi kwanwɔn a wosii pɛ anadwokosi sɛ nsa bɛbow wɔn.
english:
Woe to those who rise early in the morning
    to run after their drinks,
who stay up late at night
    till they are inflamed with wine.

twi: Wɔbɔ sankuten ne bɛnta wɔ wɔn aponto ase,akasae, ne atɛntɛbɛn ne nsa,nanso wotwiri nea Awurade ayɛ,na wommu ne nsa ano adwuma.
english:
They have harps and lyres at their banquets,
    pipes and timbrels and wine,
but they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord,
    no respect for the work of his hands.

twi: Ɛno nti, me nkurɔfo bɛkɔ nnommum mu,efisɛ wonni ntease;ɔkɔm bekum wɔn mu atitiriwna osukɔm betware wɔn mu bebree.
english:
Therefore my people will go into exile
    for lack of understanding;
those of high rank will die of hunger
    and the common people will be parched with thirst.

twi: Enti Owu bae nʼabogye muna obue nʼanom bayaa;na mu na atitiriw ne dɔm no bɛkɔwɔne wɔn a wɔsaw na wogye wɔn ani no.
english:
Therefore Death expands its jaws,
    opening wide its mouth;
into it will descend their nobles and masses
    with all their brawlers and revelers.

twi: Enti wɔbɛbrɛ onipa asena wama adesamma abotow.Wɔbɛbrɛ ɔhantanni ase,
english:
So people will be brought low
    and everyone humbled,
    the eyes of the arrogant humbled.

twi: nanso Asafo Awurade atɛntrenee bɛma no so,na Ɔkronkron Nyankopɔn de ne trenee bɛda ne ho adi sɛ Ɔkronkronni.
english:
But the Lord Almighty will be exalted by his justice,
    and the holy God will be proved holy by his righteous acts.

twi: Afei nguan bɛkɔ adidi te sɛnea wɔwɔ wɔn adidibea;nguantenmma bedidi wɔ asikafo amamfo so.
english:
Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture;
    lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.

twi: Munnue, mo a mode nnaadaa nhoma twetwe bɔne,na mode nteaseɛnam ntampehama twetwe amumɔyɛ.
english:
Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit,
    and wickedness as with cart ropes,

twi: Munnue, mo a moka se, “Onyankopɔn nyɛ ntɛm,ɔnyɛ nʼadwuma ntɛmsɛnea yebehu.Ma ɛmmɛn,Israel Ɔkronkronni no nhyehyɛe no mmra,sɛnea yebehu.”
Munnue, mo a mofrɛ bɔne sɛ papana papa nso sɛ bɔne,mo a mode sum si hann anan muna hann si sum anan mu,mo a mofrɛ nweenwen se dɛɛdɛne dɛɛdɛ se nweenwen.
english:
Woe to those who call evil good
    and good evil,
who put darkness for light
    and light for darkness,
who put bitter for sweet
    and sweet for bitter.

twi: Munnue, mo a mubu mo ho anyansafo, mo ankasa ani sone anitewfo mo ankasa ani so.
english:
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes
    and clever in their own sight.

twi: Munnue mo a wɔfrɛ mo akatakyi wɔ nsanom mune ahoɔdenfo wɔ nsa afrafra mu.
english:
Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine
    and champions at mixing drinks,

twi: Mo a mugye adanmude, na mugyaa nea odi fɔna mubu nea odi bem no fɔ.
english:
who acquit the guilty for a bribe,
    but deny justice to the innocent.

twi: Enti sɛnea ogyaframa hyew nwuraguaneena sare a awo yera wɔ ogyaframa mu no,saa ara na mo ntin bɛporɔw,na mo nhwiren nso atu akɔ sɛ mfutuma;efisɛ moapo Asafo Awurade mmarana moatwiri Israel Kronkronni no asɛm.
english:
Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw
    and as dry grass sinks down in the flames,
so their roots will decay
    and their flowers blow away like dust;
for they have rejected the law of the Lord Almighty
    and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Enti Awurade abufuw aba ne nkurɔfo so,wama ne nsa so, na ɔde rebɔ wɔn ahwe fam.Mmepɔw no wosow,na afunu ayɛ sɛ mmɔnten so nwura.Nanso eyi nyinaa akyi, ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
english:
Therefore the Lord’s anger burns against his people;
    his hand is raised and he strikes them down.
The mountains shake,
    and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets.
Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

twi: Ɔma frankaa so ma akyirikyiri aman,ɔhyɛn abɛn de frɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ asase ano.Wɔn na wɔreba no,afrɛ so ne ntɛm so!
english:
He lifts up a banner for the distant nations,
    he whistles for those at the ends of the earth.
Here they come,
    swiftly and speedily!

twi: Wɔn mu biara mmmrɛ na onhintiw,obiara ntɔ nko na ɔnna;abɔso biara mu nnwow wɔ asen muna mpaboa hama biara nso rentew.
english:
Not one of them grows tired or stumbles,
    not one slumbers or sleeps;
not a belt is loosened at the waist,
    not a sandal strap is broken.

twi: Wɔn agyan ano yɛ nnam,na wɔn tadua nyinaa ayɛ krado;wɔn apɔnkɔ tɔte te sɛ ɔtwɛrebo,wɔn nteaseɛnam nkyimii te sɛ mfɛtɛ.
english:
Their arrows are sharp,
    all their bows are strung;
their horses’ hooves seem like flint,
    their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.

twi: Wɔn mmobɔmu te sɛ gyata de,na wɔbobɔ mu sɛ gyatamma;wɔbobɔ mu kyere wɔn hanamna wɔde no kɔ a ogyefo biara nni hɔ.
english:
Their roar is like that of the lion,
    they roar like young lions;
they growl as they seize their prey
    and carry it off with no one to rescue.

twi: Da no wɔbɛbobɔ mu agu no sosɛnea po woro so no.Na sɛ obi hwɛ asase no a,obehu sum kabii ne ahohiahia;omununkum bɛma hann aduru sum.
english:
In that day they will roar over it
    like the roaring of the sea.
And if one looks at the land,
    there is only darkness and distress;
    even the sun will be darkened by clouds.

twi: Yesaia SomaAfe a ɔhene Usia wui mu no, mihuu Awurade sɛ ɔte ahengua a ɛkorɔn na wapagyaw so na nʼatade mmuano ayɛ hyiadan mu hɔ ma.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple.

twi: Na Serafim a wɔn mu biara wɔ ntaban asia wɔ nʼatifi. Wɔde ntaban no abien kata wɔn anim, na wɔde abien nso kata wɔn nan ho na wɔde abien nso tu.
english: Above him were seraphim, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

twi: Na obiara teɛ mu kyerɛ ne yɔnko se,“Kronkron! Kronkron! Kronkron ne Asafo Awurade;Nʼanuonyam ahyɛ asase nyinaa so ma!”
Wɔn nne nnyigyei maa apon ne abobow ano wosowee, na wusiw yɛɛ hyiadan mu hɔ ma.
english: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.

twi: Meteɛɛ mu kae se, “Minnue! Memfata! Meyɛ onipa a mʼano ho ntew, na mete nnipa a wɔn ano ho ntew mu, na mʼani ahu Ɔhene, Awurade Asafo no yi.”
english: “Woe to me!” I cried. “I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Almighty.”

twi: Na Serafim no mu baako a okura nnyansramma, a ɔde ɔdaban kɔfa fii afɔremuka no so tu baa me nkyɛn.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.

twi: Ɔde eyi kaa mʼano kae se, “Hwɛ, eyi aka wʼanofafa, wɔayi wʼafɔdi na wɔatua wo bɔne so ka.”
english: With it he touched my mouth and said, “See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for.”

twi: Afei, metee Awurade nne a ɛrebisa se, “Hena na mensoma no? Na hena na ɔbɛkɔ ama yɛn?”Na mekae se, “Mini. Soma me!”
english:
Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?”
And I said, “Here am I. Send me!”

twi: Na ɔkae se, “Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ saa nkurɔfo yi se,“ ‘Ɔte de mobɛte, nanso morente ase;Ɔhwɛ de mobɛhwɛ, nanso morenhu.’
Efisɛ mo, moapirim mo koma;moasisiw mo aso,akatakata mo ani.Ɛnyɛ saa a, anka mo ani behu ade,na mo koma ate asɛm ase,na moanu mo ho asan aba me nkyɛn, na masa mo yare.”
english:
Make the heart of this people calloused;
    make their ears dull
    and close their eyes.
Otherwise they might see with their eyes,
    hear with their ears,
    understand with their hearts,
and turn and be healed.”

twi: Na mekae se, “Enkosi da bɛn, Awurade?”Na obuae se,“Enkosi sɛ nkuropɔn no bɛyɛ amamfoa nnipa ntete so,enkosi sɛ afi no bɛyɛ afituwna mfuw no asɛe ayɛ pasaa,
english:
Then I said, “For how long, Lord?”
And he answered:
“Until the cities lie ruined
    and without inhabitant,
until the houses are left deserted
    and the fields ruined and ravaged,

twi: enkosi sɛ, Awurade bɛpam obiara akɔ akyirikyirina asase no ada mpan.
english:
until the Lord has sent everyone far away
    and the land is utterly forsaken.

twi: Mpo, sɛ nkyɛmu du mu baako ka asase no so awɔbɛsɛe no bio.Nso sɛnea dupɔn anaa odumgyaw dunsin, bere a wɔatwa ato fam no,saa ara na aba kronkron no bɛyɛ dunsin wɔ asase no so.”
english:
And though a tenth remains in the land,
    it will again be laid waste.
But as the terebinth and oak
    leave stumps when they are cut down,
    so the holy seed will be the stump in the land.”

twi: Immanuel Ho NsɛnkyerɛnneBere a Usia babarima Yotam babarima Ahas bedii Yudaman so hene no, Aramhene Resin ne Remalia babarima Peka a ɔyɛ Israelhene baa Yerusalem ne wɔn bɛkoe, nanso wɔantumi anni ne so.
english: When Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.

twi: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawidfi se, “Aram ne Efraim ayɛ apam;” Enti Ahas ne ne nkurɔfo ho wosow sɛnea kwaennua wosow wɔ mframa ano no.
english: Now the house of David was told, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim”; so the hearts of Ahaz and his people were shaken, as the trees of the forest are shaken by the wind.

twi: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia se, “Wo ne wo babarima Sear-Yasub nkohyia Ahas wɔ Atifi Tare no subon a ɛwɔ Ntamahorofo Afuw no kwan so.
english: Then the Lord said to Isaiah, “Go out, you and your son Shear-Jashub, to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.

twi: Ka kyerɛ no se, ‘Hwɛ yiye, yɛ komm na nsuro. Mma wo koma ntu wɔ saa nnyentia abien a ɛrefi wusiw yi ho; wɔ Resin Aramhene ne Remalia babarima abufuwhyew no nti.
english: Say to him, ‘Be careful, keep calm and don’t be afraid. Do not lose heart because of these two smoldering stubs of firewood—because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.

twi: Aram, Efraim ne Remalia babarima abɔ wo sɛe ho pɔw se,
english: Aram, Ephraim and Remaliah’s son have plotted your ruin, saying,

twi: “Momma yɛntow nhyɛ Yuda so, na yɛntetew wɔn mu na yɛnkyɛ mfa, na yensi Tabeel babarima hene wɔ so.”
english: “Let us invade Judah; let us tear it apart and divide it among ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king over it.”

twi: Nanso nea Asafo Awurade se ni:“ ‘Ɛremma so,na ɛrensi da,
english:
Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says:
“‘It will not take place,
    it will not happen,

twi: Aram ti ne Damasko,na Resin pɛ na ɛyɛ Damasko ti.Mfirihyia aduosia anum mu noEfraim mu bɛtetew koraa a ɛrentumi nnyɛ ɔman.
english:
for the head of Aram is Damascus,
    and the head of Damascus is only Rezin.
Within sixty-five years
    Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.

twi: Efraim ti ne SamariaRemalia babarima pɛ ne Samaria ti.Sɛ woannyina pintinn wɔ wo gyidi mu a,worennyina koraa.’ ”
english:
The head of Ephraim is Samaria,
    and the head of Samaria is only Remaliah’s son.
If you do not stand firm in your faith,
    you will not stand at all.’”

twi: Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ Ahas bio se,
english: Again the Lord spoke to Ahaz,

twi: “Bisa Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn hɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne, sɛ ɛwɔ bun ase tɔnn anaa ɔsorosoro nohɔ.”
english: “Ask the Lord your God for a sign, whether in the deepest depths or in the highest heights.”

twi: Nanso Ahas buae se, “Meremmisa, merensɔ Awurade nhwɛ.”
english: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask; I will not put the Lord to the test.”

twi: Na Yesaia kae se, “Muntie Dawidfi! Ɛnso mma mo sɛ mobɛsɔ nnipa ntoboase ahwɛ? Na mobɛsɔ me Nyankopɔn nso ntoboase ahwɛ ana?
english: Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, you house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of humans? Will you try the patience of my God also?

twi: Ɛno de, Onyankopɔn ankasa bɛma mo nsɛnkyerɛnne; ɔbabun no benyinsɛn, na wawo ɔbabarima, na wɔbɛfrɛ no Immanuel.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.

twi: Obedi nufusu ani srade ne ɛwo, bere a wahu nea ɛbɛma watumi apo bɔne na wafa nea eye no.
english: He will be eating curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right,

twi: Nanso ansa na abarimaa no behu nea ɛbɛma watumi apo bɔne na wafa nea eye no, wɔbɛma ahemfo abien a wusuro wɔn no nsase ada mpan.
english: for before the boy knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.

twi: Awurade de bere bi bɛba wo ne wo nkurɔfo ne wʼagya fi so a ɛso bi mmaa da, efi bere a Efraim tew ne ho fii Yuda ho; ɔde Asiriahene bɛba.”
english: The Lord will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since Ephraim broke away from Judah—he will bring the king of Assyria.”

twi: Da no, Awurade bɛhyɛn abɛn afrɛ nwansena afi nsuwansuwa a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri wɔ Misraim ne nnowa a wofi Asiria asase so.
english: In that day the Lord will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa bɛba abegu aku a mu dɔ ne ntokuru a ɛwɔ abotan mu, nkyɛkyerɛ ne suka mu.
english: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.

twi: Da no, Awurade de oyiwan a obegye wɔ Asubɔnten no agya nohɔ wɔ Asiriahene nkyɛn, no beyi mo ti so ne mo anan ho nwi na wayi mo abogyesɛ nso.
english: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your head and private parts, and to cut off your beard also.

twi: Saa da no, obiara bɛyɛn nantwi ba baako ne mmirekyi abien.
english: In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.

twi: Na esiane nufusu dodow a wɔbɛma nti, obenya nufusu ani srade adi. Wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔ asase no so nyinaa bedi nufusu ani srade ne ɛwo.
english: And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.

twi: Saa da no, baabiara a na anka bobe apem a ne bo yɛ dwetɛ kilogram dubaako ne fa wɔ no, wobehu nnɛnkyɛnse ne nsɔe.
english: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.

twi: Nnipa de agyan ne tadua bɛkɔ hɔ, efisɛ nnɛnkyɛnse ne nsɔe agye hɔ.
english: Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.

twi: Nkoko a na anka kan no wɔde nsɔw yɛ so adwuma, nnɛnkyɛnse ne nsɔe ho hu nti wɔrenkɔ hɔ bio; ɛbɛdan mmeaemmeae a wogyaa anantwi ne nguan ma wɔkɔ.
english: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.

twi: Asiria, Awurade Nsa Mu DadeAwurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Fa nhoma mmobɔwee kɛse no na fa kyerɛwdua biara kyerɛw so.
english: The Lord said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.”

twi: Na mɛfrɛ ɔsɔfo Uria ne Yeberekia babarima Sakaria sɛ me dansefo nokwafo aba.”
english: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.

twi: Afei mekɔɔ nkɔmhyɛnibea no ho, na onyinsɛnee, woo ɔbabarima. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Frɛ no Maher-Salal-Has-Bas.
english: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

twi: Ansa na abarimaa no betumi aka, ‘Mʼagya’ anaasɛ ‘me na’ no, Asiriahene bɛba abɛfa Damasko ahode ne Samaria asade nyinaa akɔ.”
english: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”

twi: Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ me bio se,
english: The Lord spoke to me again:

twi: “Esiane sɛ saa nkurɔfo yi apoSiloa nsu a ɛsen brɛoona wodi ahurusi wɔ Resinne Remalia babarima no ho nti,
english:
“Because this people has rejected
    the gently flowing waters of Shiloah
and rejoices over Rezin
    and the son of Remaliah,

twi: Awurade reyɛ de Asubɔnten noyiri kɛse no atia wɔn,Asiriahene ne ne kɛseyɛ nyinaa.Ebeyiri afa nʼabon nyinaa mu,na abu afa ne konkɔn so
english:
therefore the Lord is about to bring against them
    the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates—
    the king of Assyria with all his pomp.
It will overflow all its channels,
    run over all its banks

twi: na apra abɛfa Yuda, akɔntɔn afa ho,ateɛ afa mu abɛdeda kɔn mu.Na atrɛtrɛw akata asase no nyinaa soImmanuel.”
english:
and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it,
    passing through it and reaching up to the neck.
Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land,
    Immanuel!”

twi: Momma ɔko nteɛmu so, mo aman na wɔnnwerɛw mo!Muntie mo akyirikyiri aman.Munsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔnnwerɛw mo!Munsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔnnwerɛw mo!
english:
Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered!
    Listen, all you distant lands.
Prepare for battle, and be shattered!
    Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

twi: Hwehwɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so, nanso wɔbɛsɛe no;da wo nsusuwii adi, nanso ɛrennyina,efisɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ.
Suro OnyankopɔnAwurade de ne nsa dennen no too me so, ka kyerɛ me, bɔɔ me kɔkɔ se mennantew saa nkurɔfo yi kwan so. Ɔkae se,
english: This is what the Lord says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:

twi: “Mommfrɛ no tirisopambiribiara a saa nkurɔfo yi frɛ no tirisopam no;Munnsuro nea wosuro,na momma ɛmmɔ mo hu.
english:
“Do not call conspiracy
    everything this people calls a conspiracy;
do not fear what they fear,
    and do not dread it.

twi: Asafo Awurade nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wubu no ɔkronkron,ɔno na ɛsɛ sɛ wusuro no,ɔno na ne ho yɛ hu,
english:
The Lord Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy,
    he is the one you are to fear,
    he is the one you are to dread.

twi: ɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea:nanso Israel ne Yuda de,ɔbɛyɛ hintibone ɔbotan a ɛma wɔhwe ase.Na ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Yerusalem de,ɔbɛyɛ afiri a ebeyi wɔn.
english:
He will be a holy place;
    for both Israel and Judah he will be
a stone that causes people to stumble
    and a rock that makes them fall.
And for the people of Jerusalem he will be
    a trap and a snare.

twi: Wɔn mu bebree bɛwatiri;wɔbɛhwe ase a wɔrensɔre bio,wobesum wɔn afiri na ayi wɔn.”
Kyekyere kɔkɔbɔ adanse nosɔw mmara no ano ma mʼasuafo.
english:
Bind up this testimony of warning
    and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.

twi: Mɛtwɛn Awuradea wayi nʼani afi Yakobfi somede me werɛ bɛhyɛ ne mu.
english:
I will wait for the Lord,
    who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob.
I will put my trust in him.

twi: Me ne mma a Awurade de wɔn ama me no ni. Yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne agyiraehyɛde wɔ Israel, na yefi Asafo Awurade a ɔte Sion Bepɔw so no nkyɛn.
english: Here am I, and the children the Lord has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the Lord Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.

twi: Sɛ nnipa tu mo fo sɛ monkohu samanfrɛfo ne nnunsifo a wɔkasa aso mu na emu ntew a, adɛn nti na wommmisa wɔn Nyankopɔn? Adɛn nti na mubisa ade wɔ awufo nkyɛn ma ateasefo?
english: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

twi: Sɛ wɔannyina mmara ne adanse yi so anka asɛm yi a, wunni adekyee mu hann.
english: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

twi: Wɔde ahohiahia ne ɔkɔm bɛnantenantew asase no so; na sɛ wɔtɔ beraw a, wɔn bo befuw na wɔbɛma wɔn ani so adome wɔn hene ne wɔn Nyankopɔn.
english: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.

twi: Afei wɔbɛhwɛ asase no so, na wubehu ahohiahia ne sum a ɛyɛ hu, na wɔde wɔn bɛhyɛn sum kabii mu.
english: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.

twi: Wɔawo Akokoaa Ama YɛnNanso wɔn a na wɔwɔ ahohiahia mu no renni awerɛhow bio. Kan no ɔbrɛɛ Sebulon ne Naftali nsase no ase, nanso daakye bi ɔbɛhyɛ Galilea a ɛyɛ amanamanmufo man na ne kwan da Yordan ne po ntam no anuonyam.
english: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—

twi: Nnipa a wɔnam sum muahu Hann kɛse;wɔn a wɔte asase a so sum kabii no,hann bi apue wɔn so.
english:
The people walking in darkness
    have seen a great light;
on those living in the land of deep darkness
    a light has dawned.

twi: Woatrɛw ɔman no muwoama wɔn ani agye mmorosowodi ahurusi wɔ wʼanimsɛnea nnipa di ahurusi otwabere,sɛnea nnipa ho sɛpɛw wɔnwɔ bere a wɔrekyɛ asade no.
english:
You have enlarged the nation
    and increased their joy;
they rejoice before you
    as people rejoice at the harvest,
as warriors rejoice
    when dividing the plunder.

twi: Te sɛ da a Midian dii nkogu no,woadwerɛw konnua a ɛda wɔn so no,abaa a ɛda wɔn mmati,wɔn nhyɛsofo pema.
english:
For as in the day of Midian’s defeat,
    you have shattered
the yoke that burdens them,
    the bar across their shoulders,
    the rod of their oppressor.

twi: Ɔkofo mpaboa a wɔhyɛ de kɔ sane atade biara a mogya akeka mu,wobegyaw agu hɔ na wɔahyew;ɛbɛyɛ nea ɛma ogya dɛw.
english:
Every warrior’s boot used in battle
    and every garment rolled in blood
will be destined for burning,
    will be fuel for the fire.

twi: Na wɔawo akokoaa ama yɛn,wɔama yɛn ɔbabarima,na amammui no bɛda ne mmati so.Na wɔbɛfrɛ noƆfotufo Nwonwani, Otumfo Nyankopɔn,Daa Agya, Asomdwoe Wura.
english:
For to us a child is born,
    to us a son is given,
    and the government will be on his shoulders.
And he will be called
    Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God,
    Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

twi: Nʼamammui no nkɔso ne Nʼasomdwoebɛtena hɔ daa.Ɔbɛtena Dawid ahengua soabu Nʼahenni,Ɔde atɛntrenee ne treneeyɛbefi ase na wama atimafi saa bere no akosi daa apem.Asafo Awurade mmɔdemmɔbɛyɛ eyi.
english:
Of the greatness of his government and peace
    there will be no end.
He will reign on David’s throne
    and over his kingdom,
establishing and upholding it
    with justice and righteousness
    from that time on and forever.
The zeal of the Lord Almighty
    will accomplish this.

twi: Awurade Abufuw A Etia IsraelAwurade ama Yakob nkra a etia no,na ɛbɛka Israel.
english:
The Lord has sent a message against Jacob;
    it will fall on Israel.

twi: Nnipa no nyinaa behu,Efraim ne wɔn a wɔtete Samariaa wɔde ahohoahoane ahomaso koma kasa no,
english:
All the people will know it—
    Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria—
who say with pride
    and arrogance of heart,

twi: “Ntayaa no abubu agu famnanso yɛde abo a wɔatwa bɛto bio.Wɔabubu borɔdɔma nnua nonanso yɛde sida besi anan mu.”
english:
“The bricks have fallen down,
    but we will rebuild with dressed stone;
the fig trees have been felled,
    but we will replace them with cedars.”

twi: Nanso Awurade ahyɛ Resin atamfo den atia wɔn,na ɔhyɛ wɔn atamfo no nkuran.
english:
But the Lord has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them
    and has spurred their enemies on.

twi: Aramfo a wofi apuei fam,Filistifo a wofi atɔe fam,abue wɔn anom amene Israel.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
english:
Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west
    have devoured Israel with open mouth.
Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

twi: Nanso nnipa no nsan nkɔɔ nea ɔtwee wɔn aso no nkyɛn,na wɔnhwehwɛɛ Asafo Awurade no akyi kwan nso.
english:
But the people have not returned to him who struck them,
    nor have they sought the Lord Almighty.

twi: Enti Awurade betwa eti ne dua afi Israel hona berɛw ne demmire nso, ɔde da koro pɛ;
english:
So the Lord will cut off from Israel both head and tail,
    both palm branch and reed in a single day;

twi: mpanyimfo ne akunini no ne eti no,na atoro adiyifo no ne dua no.
english:
the elders and dignitaries are the head,
    the prophets who teach lies are the tail.

twi: Wɔn a wɔkyerɛ nnipa yi kwan no, nkyerɛ wɔn ɔkwan pa,na wɔn a wonya akwankyerɛ no nso, fom kwan.
english:
Those who guide this people mislead them,
    and those who are guided are led astray.

twi: Enti Awurade ani rennye mmerante no ho,na ɔrenhu ayisaa ne akunafo mmɔbɔefisɛ, obiara nni nyamesu na wɔyɛ amumɔyɛfo,ano biara ka ahuhusɛm.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
english:
Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men,
    nor will he pity the fatherless and widows,
for everyone is ungodly and wicked,
    every mouth speaks folly.
Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

twi: Nokware, atirimɔden hye te sɛ ogya;ɛhyew nnɛnkyɛnse ne nsɔe,ɛde ogya to kwaeberentuw mu hyew no,na ɛnam wusiw kumɔnn mu foro kɔ soro.
english:
Surely wickedness burns like a fire;
    it consumes briers and thorns,
it sets the forest thickets ablaze,
    so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.

twi: Ɛnam Asafo Awurade abufuw so,asase no bɛkyenna nnipa bɛyɛ mmabaa ama ogya no;na obiara remfa ne nua ho nkyɛ no.
english:
By the wrath of the Lord Almighty
    the land will be scorched
and the people will be fuel for the fire;
    they will not spare one another.

twi: Nifa so, wɔbɛfom aduan adi,nanso ɔkɔm bɛde wɔn;benkum so wobedidi,nanso wɔremmee.Obiara bɛwe ne ba nam.
english:
On the right they will devour,
    but still be hungry;
on the left they will eat,
    but not be satisfied.
Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring:

twi: Manase bɛdan Efraim na Efraim adan Manasena wɔbɛbɔ mu atia Yuda.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
english:
Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh;
    together they will turn against Judah.
Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

twi: Wonnue, wɔn a wɔhyɛ mmara a ɛmfa ne kwan mu,wɔn a wɔhyɛ mmara dennen a ɛde nhyɛso ba,
english:
Woe to those who make unjust laws,
    to those who issue oppressive decrees,

twi: de siw ahiafo ahofadi ho kwan,de atɛntrenee bɔ me nkurɔfo a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no atirimɔden.Wɔma akunafo yɛ amanehunufona wɔbɔ ayisaa korɔn.
english:
to deprive the poor of their rights
    and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people,
making widows their prey
    and robbing the fatherless.

twi: Dɛn na mobɛyɛ wɔ akontaabu da no,bere a amanehunu fi akyirikyiri reba?Hena nkyɛn na mubeguan akɔpɛ mmoa?Ɛhefa na mubegyaw mo ahode?
english:
What will you do on the day of reckoning,
    when disaster comes from afar?
To whom will you run for help?
    Where will you leave your riches?

twi: Ɛrenka mo hwee sɛ mobɛfra nneduafo muanaasɛ mobɛtotɔ wɔ atɔfo mu.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
english:
Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives
    or fall among the slain.
Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

twi: Asiria Atemmu A Efi Onyankopɔn“Nnome nka Asiriani no, mʼabufuw abaa,nea okura mʼabufuwhyew pema no!
english:
“Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger,
    in whose hand is the club of my wrath!

twi: Mesoma no akɔ ɔman a wonnim Onyankopɔn somigya no kwan ma wakɔ nnipa a wɔhyɛ me abufuw sosɛ wonkogye akorɔnne abran so na wonhuam afowde,na wontiatia wɔn so sɛ dɔte wɔ mmɔnten so.
english:
I send him against a godless nation,
    I dispatch him against a people who anger me,
to seize loot and snatch plunder,
    and to trample them down like mud in the streets.

twi: Nanso ɛnyɛ eyi ne nea ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛnyɛ eyi ne nea ɛwɔ nʼadwene mu;ne botae ne sɛ ɔbɛsɛe,sɛ ɔde aman bebree bɛba wɔn awiei.
english:
But this is not what he intends,
    this is not what he has in mind;
his purpose is to destroy,
    to put an end to many nations.

twi: Na obisa se, ‘Ahemfo nyinaa nyɛ mʼasahene ana?
english: ‘Are not my commanders all kings?’ he says.

twi: Kalno nyɛɛ sɛ Karkemis ana?Hamat nte sɛ Arpadna Samaria nte sɛ Damasko ana?
english:
‘Has not Kalno fared like Carchemish?
Is not Hamath like Arpad,
    and Samaria like Damascus?

twi: Sɛnea migyee ahoni ahenni ahorow abran so,ahenni a wɔn nsɛsode sen nea ɛwɔ Yerusalem ne Samaria no.
english:
As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols,
    kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria—

twi: Merentumi ne Yerusalem ne ne nsɛsode nni,sɛnea me ne Samaria ne nʼahoni dii no?’ ”
english:
shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images
    as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?’”

twi: Sɛ Awurade wie nʼadwuma a etia Bepɔw Sion ne Yerusalem nyinaa a, ɔbɛka se, “Mɛtwe Asiriahene aso wɔ ne komapirim ne nʼani a ɛnsɔ ade no ho.
english: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.

twi: Efisɛ ɔka se,“ ‘Mede mʼahoɔden na ayɛ eyi,na mifi me nyansa mu, efisɛ mewɔ nimdeɛ.Mesɛee aman aman ahye,mefow wɔn ademude;mebrɛɛ wɔn ahemfo ase te sɛ ɔbran.
english:
For he says:
“‘By the strength of my hand I have done this,
    and by my wisdom, because I have understanding.
I removed the boundaries of nations,
    I plundered their treasures;
    like a mighty one I subdued their kings.

twi: Sɛnea obi teɛ ne nsa hyɛ berebuw mu no,saa ara nso na mɛteɛ me nsa wɔ amanaman no ahonyade so;sɛnea wɔtase nkesua a wɔagyaw hɔ no,saa ara na mɛboaboa amanaman no nyinaa ano;obiara ammɔ ne ntaban mu,na wammue nʼano ansu.’ ”
Abonnua ma ne ho so tra nea ɔtow,anaasɛ ɔwan hoahoa ne ho kyɛn nea ɔde no yɛ adwuma ana?Ayɛ te sɛnea abaa tumi dannan nea ɔmaa no so,anaasɛ poribaa tumi hinhim nea ɔnyɛ dua!
english:
Does the ax raise itself above the person who swings it,
    or the saw boast against the one who uses it?
As if a rod were to wield the person who lifts it up,
    or a club brandish the one who is not wood!

twi: Afei Awurade, Asafo Awurade,de ɔyaredɔm bɛbɔ nʼakofo ahoɔdenfo no;ne kɛseyɛ mu wobefita ogya mu ama adɛwte sɛ gyaframa.
english:
Therefore, the Lord, the Lord Almighty,
    will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors;
under his pomp a fire will be kindled
    like a blazing flame.

twi: Israel Hann no bɛdan ogya.Wɔn Kronkronni no bɛyɛ ogya a ɛdɛw;ɔde da koro bɛhyew na wasɛene nsɔe ne nnɛnkyɛnse.
english:
The Light of Israel will become a fire,
    their Holy One a flame;
in a single day it will burn and consume
    his thorns and his briers.

twi: Ne kwae ne nʼasasebere anuonyam no,ɛbɛsɛe pasapasate sɛ ɔyarefo a ɔrefɔn.
english:
The splendor of his forests and fertile fields
    it will completely destroy,
    as when a sick person wastes away.

twi: Nnua a ɛbɛka wɔ ne kwae mu bɛyɛ kakraa bia abofra betumi akyerɛ ne dodow.
english:
And the remaining trees of his forests will be so few
    that a child could write them down.

twi: Israel NkaefoDa no, Israel nkae,Yakob fifo a wɔbɛka no,remfa wɔn ho nto no so bionea ɔbɔɔ wɔn hwee fam no;na mmom wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Awurade so nokware mu,Israel Kronkronni no.
english:
In that day the remnant of Israel,
    the survivors of Jacob,
will no longer rely on him
    who struck them down
but will truly rely on the Lord,
    the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Nkae bi bɛsan aba, Yakob nkae bibɛsan aba Otumfo Onyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
english:
A remnant will return, a remnant of Jacob
    will return to the Mighty God.

twi: Israel, ɛwɔ mu sɛ wo nkurɔfo dɔɔso sɛ mpoano nwea de,nanso nkae bi pɛ na wɔbɛsan.Wɔahyɛ ɔsɛe ho mmara dennena ebebunkam so na ɛteɛ.
english:
Though your people be like the sand by the sea, Israel,
    only a remnant will return.
Destruction has been decreed,
    overwhelming and righteous.

twi: Awurade, Asafo Awurade de ɔsɛea wɔahyɛ ho mmara ketee na ɛbɛba asase no so nyinaa.
english:
The Lord, the Lord Almighty, will carry out
    the destruction decreed upon the whole land.

twi: Enti sɛɛ na Awurade, Asafo Awurade se,“Me nkurɔfo a mote Sion,munnsuro Asiriafo no,wɔn a wɔde mmaa hwe mona wɔma kontibaa so tia mo, sɛnea Misraim yɛe no.
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says:
“My people who live in Zion,
    do not be afraid of the Assyrians,
who beat you with a rod
    and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.

twi: Ɛrenkyɛ koraa mʼabufuw a etia mo no ano bedwona mʼanibere bɛkɔ wɔn sɛe so.”
english:
Very soon my anger against you will end
    and my wrath will be directed to their destruction.”

twi: Asafo Awurade de mpire bɛhwe wɔn,sɛnea ɔbɔɔ Midian hwee fam wɔ Oreb Ɔbotan ho no;na ɔbɛteɛ ne pema wɔ nsu no so,sɛnea ɔyɛɛ wɔ Misraim no.
english:
The Lord Almighty will lash them with a whip,
    as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb;
and he will raise his staff over the waters,
    as he did in Egypt.

twi: Da no wobeyi wɔn adesoa no afi wɔn mmati sowɔn konnua afi wo kɔn mu;wobubu konnua noefisɛ woayɛ ɔbran yiye.
english:
In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders,
    their yoke from your neck;
the yoke will be broken
    because you have grown so fat.

twi: Wɔhyɛn Ayat;wɔfa Migron;na wɔkora wɔn nneɛma wɔ Mikmas.
Wɔfaa ɔtempɔn no so, na wɔka se,“Yɛbɛwɛn wɔ Geba anadwo yi.”Rama ho popo;Saulo kurow Gibea nso guan.
english:
They go over the pass, and say,
    “We will camp overnight at Geba.”
Ramah trembles;
    Gibeah of Saul flees.

twi: Teɛ mu, Galim Babea!Tie, Laisa!Anatot Mmɔborɔni!
english:
Cry out, Daughter Gallim!
    Listen, Laishah!
    Poor Anathoth!

twi: Madmena reguan;Gebimfo kɔtetɛw.
english:
Madmenah is in flight;
    the people of Gebim take cover.

twi: Nnɛ ara wobegyina wɔ Nob;wobehim wɔn nsawɔ Ɔbabea Sion bepɔw no so,wɔ Yerusalem koko no so.
english:
This day they will halt at Nob;
    they will shake their fist
at the mount of Daughter Zion,
    at the hill of Jerusalem.

twi: Hwɛ, Awurade, Asafo Awurade no,ɔde tumi kɛse betwitwa dua mman no.Wobebubu nnua atenten no agu famnea ɛwowaree no bɛba fam.
english:
See, the Lord, the Lord Almighty,
    will lop off the boughs with great power.
The lofty trees will be felled,
    the tall ones will be brought low.

twi: Ɔde abonnua betwitwa kwaedɔtɔ agu famLebanon bɛhwe ase wɔ Ɔkɛse no anim.
english:
He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax;
    Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.

twi: Yisai Ase DubaaDua foforo bi befifi wɔ Yisai dunsin ho;efi ne ntin mu na Dubaa bi bɛsow aba.
english:
A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse;
    from his roots a Branch will bear fruit.

twi: Awurade Honhom bɛtena ne so,nyansa ne ntease Honhom,afotu ne tumi Honhom,nimdeɛ ne Awurade suro Honhom,
english:
The Spirit of the Lord will rest on him—
    the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding,
    the Spirit of counsel and of might,
    the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the Lord—

twi: Na nʼani begye wɔ Awurade suro mu.Ɛnyɛ nea ɔde nʼani hu so na obegyina abu atɛn,anaa nea ɔde nʼaso bɛte so na obegyina asi gyinae;
na mmom ɔde trenee bebu mmɔborɔfo atɛn,ɔde atɛntrenee besi gyinae ama asase so ahiafo.Ɔde nʼano abaa na ɛbɛbɔ asase;ɔde nʼanofafa home bekunkum amumɔyɛfo.
english:
but with righteousness he will judge the needy,
    with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth.
He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth;
    with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.

twi: Trenee bɛyɛ nʼabɔsona nokwaredi ayɛ nʼabɔso.
english:
Righteousness will be his belt
    and faithfulness the sash around his waist.

twi: Pataku ne oguamma bɛtena,ɔsebɔ ne abirekyi bɛda,nantwi ba ne gyata ne ne ba bɛbɔ mu;na abofra ketewa bi adi wɔn anim.
english:
The wolf will live with the lamb,
    the leopard will lie down with the goat,
the calf and the lion and the yearling together;
    and a little child will lead them.

twi: Nantwi ne sisi bɛbɔ mu adidi,wɔn mma bɛdeda faako,na gyata bɛwe wura te sɛ nantwi.
english:
The cow will feed with the bear,
    their young will lie down together,
    and the lion will eat straw like the ox.

twi: Akokoaa bedi agoru abɛn ɔprammiri amoa ano,na abofra ketewa de ne nsa ahyɛ ahurutoa bon mu.
english:
The infant will play near the cobra’s den,
    and the young child will put its hand into the viper’s nest.

twi: Wɔrenyɛ obi bɔne na wɔrensɛe adewɔ me bepɔw Kronkron nyinaa so,na Awurade ho nimdeɛ bɛyɛ asase so masɛnea nsu ayɛ po ma no.
english:
They will neither harm nor destroy
    on all my holy mountain,
for the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the Lord
    as the waters cover the sea.

twi: Na da no, Yisai aseni bɛsɔre; nea ɔbɛsɔre abedi aman aman no so; ɔno na wɔn ani bɛda ne so, na nʼahomegyebea benya anuonyam.
english: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his resting place will be glorious.

twi: Saa da no, Awurade bɛma ne nsa so ne mprenu so de agye ne nkurɔfo a wɔaka afi Asiria, Misraim anafo fam, Misraim atifi fam, Kus, Elam, Babilonia, Hamat ne Po so asupɔw.
english: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the surviving remnant of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the Mediterranean.

twi: Ɔbɛma frankaa so ama aman nona wɔaboaboa Israelfo a wɔatwa wɔn asu no ano;Ɔbɛboaboa Yudafo a wɔahwete no anoafi asase ntwea anan no so.
english:
He will raise a banner for the nations
    and gather the exiles of Israel;
he will assemble the scattered people of Judah
    from the four quarters of the earth.

twi: Efraim anibere betu ayera,na wɔbɛsɛe Yuda atamfo.Efraim ani remmere Yuda bio,na Yuda nso rentan Efraim ani.
english:
Ephraim’s jealousy will vanish,
    and Judah’s enemies will be destroyed;
Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah,
    nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.

twi: Wobetwiw afa Filistia asiansian ahorow no so akɔ atɔe fam;na wɔbɛbɔ mu afow nnipa akɔ apuei fam.Wɔbɛfa Edom ne Moab,na Amonfo bɛhyɛ wɔn ase.
english:
They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west;
    together they will plunder the people to the east.
They will subdue Edom and Moab,
    and the Ammonites will be subject to them.

twi: Awurade bɛma nsua ɛwɔ Misraim Po no mu ayow korakora;ɔbɛma ne nsa mu mframa a mu yɛ hyewabɔ afa Asubɔnten Eufrate so.Ɔbɛpaapae mu ayɛ no nsuwansuwa asonsɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obiara betumi ahyɛ mpaboa atwa.
english:
The Lord will dry up
    the gulf of the Egyptian sea;
with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand
    over the Euphrates River.
He will break it up into seven streams
    so that anyone can cross over in sandals.

twi: Ɔtempɔn bi bɛda hɔ ama ne nkurɔfo nkaea wɔaka Asiria,sɛnea bi daa hɔ maa Israelbere a wofi Misraim bae no.
english:
There will be a highway for the remnant of his people
    that is left from Assyria,
as there was for Israel
    when they came up from Egypt.

twi: Ayeyi NnwomSaa da no, wobɛka se:“Mɛkamfo wo, Awurade!Ɛwɔ mu wo bo fuw me de,nanso afei wʼabufuw ano adwo.Na woakyekye me werɛ.
english:
In that day you will say:
“I will praise you, Lord.
    Although you were angry with me,
your anger has turned away
    and you have comforted me.

twi: Nokware, Onyankopɔn ne mʼagyenkwa;mede me ho bɛto no so, na merensuro.Awurade, Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne me dwom;na wabɛyɛ me nkwagye.”
Wode anigye bɛsaw nsuafi nkwagye mmura mu.
english:
With joy you will draw water
    from the wells of salvation.

twi: Saa da no wobɛka se,“Da Awurade ase, bɔ ne dinma amanaman nhu nea wayɛ,na pae mu ka se wɔama ne din so.
english:
In that day you will say:
“Give praise to the Lord, proclaim his name;
    make known among the nations what he has done,
    and proclaim that his name is exalted.

twi: To dwom ma Awurade, efisɛ, wayɛ nea ɛwɔ anuonyam bebree.Da eyi adi kyerɛ wiase nyinaa.
english:
Sing to the Lord, for he has done glorious things;
    let this be known to all the world.

twi: Momma mo nne so nto dwom anigye somo a mowɔ Sion,efisɛ Israel Kronkronni a ɔte mo mu no yɛ ɔkɛse.”
english:
Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion,
    for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.”

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia BabiloniaAmos babarima Yesaia adehu a ɛfa Babilonia ho ni:
english: A prophecy against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:

twi: Ma frankaa so wɔ bepɔw a hwee nni so no atifi,teɛ mu frɛ wɔn:nyama wɔnma wɔnhyɛn atitiriw no apon mu.
english:
Raise a banner on a bare hilltop,
    shout to them;
beckon to them
    to enter the gates of the nobles.

twi: Mahyɛ mʼahotewfo;mafrɛ mʼakofo sɛ wɔnna mʼabufuwhyew adi,wɔn a wodi me nkonimdi ho ahurusi.
Tie huuyɛ bi a ɛwɔ mmepɔw no sote sɛ dɔm kɛse bi de!Tie akasakasa a ɛwɔ ahenni ahorow mu,te sɛ amanaman a wɔreboaboa wɔn ho ano!Asafo Awurade reboa dɔm ano akɔ ɔko.
english:
Listen, a noise on the mountains,
    like that of a great multitude!
Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms,
    like nations massing together!
The Lord Almighty is mustering
    an army for war.

twi: Wofifi akyirikyiri aman so,wofifi ɔsoro ahye so,Awurade ne nʼakode a ɛyɛ nʼabufuwhyew;bɛsɛe ɔman no nyinaa.
english:
They come from faraway lands,
    from the ends of the heavens—
the Lord and the weapons of his wrath—
    to destroy the whole country.

twi: Twa adwo, na Awurade da no abɛn;ɛbɛba te sɛ ɔsɛe a efi Otumfo no.
english:
Wail, for the day of the Lord is near;
    it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

twi: Eyi nti, nsa nyinaa bedwudwo,obiara koma bɛbotow.
english:
Because of this, all hands will go limp,
    every heart will melt with fear.

twi: Wɔbɛbɔ hu,ɔyaw ne apinisi bekita wɔn;wobebubu wɔn mu te sɛ ɔbea a awo aka no.Wɔde ahodwiriw bɛhwɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho anim,a wɔn ani asosɔ gya.
english:
Terror will seize them,
    pain and anguish will grip them;
    they will writhe like a woman in labor.
They will look aghast at each other,
    their faces aflame.

twi: Hwɛ, Awurade da no rebada bɔne a abufuw ne abufuwhyew wɔ mu,ɛrebɛsɛe asase nona asɛe abɔnefo a wɔte so no.
english:
See, the day of the Lord is coming
    —a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger—
to make the land desolate
    and destroy the sinners within it.

twi: Ɔsoro nsoromma ne wɔn akuw renhyerɛn.Sum beduru owia a ɛrepuena ɔsram nso renhyerɛn.
english:
The stars of heaven and their constellations
    will not show their light.
The rising sun will be darkened
    and the moon will not give its light.

twi: Mɛtwe wiase aso, ne bɔne nti,ne amumɔyɛfo wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.Metwa ahantanfo ahomaso somɛbrɛ nea odi awurukasɛm no ahantan ase.
english:
I will punish the world for its evil,
    the wicked for their sins.
I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty
    and will humble the pride of the ruthless.

twi: Mɛma onipa ho ayɛ na asen sika kɔkɔɔ ankasaɔbɛsen Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ.
english:
I will make people scarcer than pure gold,
    more rare than the gold of Ophir.

twi: Enti mɛma ɔsoro awosow;na asase ahinhim wɔ ne sibeawɔ Asafo Awurade abufuwhyew anonʼabufuwhyewda no.
english:
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble;
    and the earth will shake from its place
at the wrath of the Lord Almighty,
    in the day of his burning anger.

twi: Te sɛ ɔwansan a ɔbɔmmɔfo rehwehwɛ no akum no,te sɛ nguan a wonni ɔhwɛfo,obiara bɛkɔ ne nkurɔfo mu,obiara beguan akɔ nʼasase so.
english:
Like a hunted gazelle,
    like sheep without a shepherd,
they will all return to their own people,
    they will flee to their native land.

twi: Obiara a wɔbɛfa no dedua no, wobehwirew no afoa akum no;wɔn a wɔbɛkyere wɔn no nyinaa bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano.
english:
Whoever is captured will be thrust through;
    all who are caught will fall by the sword.

twi: Wɔbɛtotow nkokoaa ahwehwe fam wɔ wɔn anim:wɔbɛfom wɔn afi mu nneɛma na wɔato wɔn yerenom mmonnaa.
english:
Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes;
    their houses will be looted and their wives violated.

twi: Hwɛ mɛhwanyan Mediafo atia wɔn,wɔn na wɔmfa dwetɛ nyɛ hweena wɔn ani nnye sikakɔkɔɔ ho.
english:
See, I will stir up against them the Medes,
    who do not care for silver
    and have no delight in gold.

twi: Wɔn tadua bɛbobɔ mmerante ahwehwe fam;wɔrenhu nkokoaa mmɔbɔna wɔrennya ayamhyehye mma mmofra.
Babilonia, ahenni ahorow mu ɔbohemaa,anuonyam a Babiloniafo de hoahoa wɔn ho noOnyankopɔn bɛdan abutuwte sɛ Sodom ne Gomora.
english:
Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms,
    the pride and glory of the Babylonians,
will be overthrown by God
    like Sodom and Gomorrah.

twi: Nnipa rentena hɔ bioawo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu;Arabni biara rensi ne ntamadan wɔ hɔoguanhwɛfo biara remfa ne nguan nkɔhome wɔ hɔ.
english:
She will never be inhabited
    or lived in through all generations;
there no nomads will pitch their tents,
    there no shepherds will rest their flocks.

twi: Nanso sare so mmoa bɛda hɔ.Sakraman bɛyɛ nʼafi no mu ma;hɔ na mpatu bɛtena,hɔ na wura mu mmirekyi nso bedi agoru.
english:
But desert creatures will lie there,
    jackals will fill her houses;
there the owls will dwell,
    and there the wild goats will leap about.

twi: Mpataku bɛtena nʼabandennen mu,adompo bɛyɛ nʼahemfi fɛfɛ no mu ma.Ne bere aso,na wɔrentwe ne nna mu.
english:
Hyenas will inhabit her strongholds,
    jackals her luxurious palaces.
Her time is at hand,
    and her days will not be prolonged.

twi: Awurade behu Yakob mmɔbɔ;ɔbɛsan afa Israelna ɔbɛbɔ wɔn atenase wɔ wɔn ankasa asase so.Ananafo bɛba abɛka wɔn hona wɔne Yakobfi aka abɔ mu.
english:
The Lord will have compassion on Jacob;
    once again he will choose Israel
    and will settle them in their own land.
Foreigners will join them
    and unite with the descendants of Jacob.

twi: Amanaman bɛfa wɔnde wɔn aba wɔn ankasa atenae.Na Israelfi bɛfa amanaman no ayɛ wɔn desɛ nkoa ne mfenaa wɔ Awurade asase so.Wɔbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ wɔn nnommumfo no nnommumna wobedi wɔn sohwɛfo so.
english:
Nations will take them
    and bring them to their own place.
And Israel will take possession of the nations
    and make them male and female servants in the Lord’s land.
They will make captives of their captors
    and rule over their oppressors.

twi: Na da a Awurade bɛma mo ɔhome afi amanehunu, ahoyeraw ne nkoasom dennen mu no,
english: On the day the Lord gives you relief from your suffering and turmoil and from the harsh labor forced on you,

twi: mubedi Babiloniahene ho fɛw se:hwɛ sɛnea sohyɛfo no aba nʼawie!ne sɛnea nʼabufuw nso to atwa!
english:
you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon:
How the oppressor has come to an end!
    How his fury has ended!

twi: Awurade abubu otirimɔdenfo no abaa mu,sodifo ahempema no,
english:
The Lord has broken the rod of the wicked,
    the scepter of the rulers,

twi: nea abufuw mu no ɔde bobɔɔ wɔntoatoaa so hwehwee fam,na abufuwhyew mu otintim wɔn so a ahomegye nni mude brɛɛ amanaman no ase no.
english:
which in anger struck down peoples
    with unceasing blows,
and in fury subdued nations
    with relentless aggression.

twi: Nsase no nyinaa rehome wɔ asomdwoe mu;na wɔto dwom.
english:
All the lands are at rest and at peace;
    they break into singing.

twi: Mpo, ɔpepaw nnua ne Lebanon sidanya ho anigye na wɔka se,“Afei a wɔabrɛ wo ase yi,duatwafo biara remmetwa yɛn.”
english:
Even the junipers and the cedars of Lebanon
    gloat over you and say,
“Now that you have been laid low,
    no one comes to cut us down.”

twi: Awufo nna a ɛwɔ ase no rekeka ne hoabehyia wo kwan;ɛkanyan wɔn a wɔafi mu no honhomsɛ wɔmmɛma wo akwaaba,wɔn a na wɔyɛ akannifo wɔ wiaseɛma wɔsɔre fi wɔn nhengua so,wɔn a na wɔyɛ ahemfo wɔ amanaman so.
Wɔn nyinaa begye so,wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo se,“Wo nso woayɛ mmerɛw sɛ yɛn;woayɛ sɛ yɛn ara.”
english:
They will all respond,
    they will say to you,
“You also have become weak, as we are;
    you have become like us.”

twi: Wo kɛseyɛ nyinaa wɔde aba ɔda mu,ne huuyɛ a efi wo asanku no;wɔde nsaammoa asɛw kɛtɛ ama wona asunson akata wo so.
english:
All your pomp has been brought down to the grave,
    along with the noise of your harps;
maggots are spread out beneath you
    and worms cover you.

twi: Sɛnea wufi ɔsoro abɛhwe fam,anɔpa nsoromma, adekyee babarima!Wɔato wo abɛhwe asase so,wo a na kan no wobrɛ amanaman ase!
english:
How you have fallen from heaven,
    morning star, son of the dawn!
You have been cast down to the earth,
    you who once laid low the nations!

twi: Wokaa no wo koma mu se,“Mɛforo akɔ ɔsoro;mɛma mʼahengua soasi Onyankopɔn nsoromma atifi;mɛtena ase adi hene wɔ ahyiae bepɔw so,nea ɛkorɔn pa ara wɔ bepɔw kronkron no so.
Mɛforo atra omununkum atifi;mɛyɛ me ho sɛ Ɔsorosoroni no.”
english:
I will ascend above the tops of the clouds;
    I will make myself like the Most High.”

twi: Nanso wɔde wo abɛto ɔda mu,amoa donkudonku ase tɔnn.
english:
But you are brought down to the realm of the dead,
    to the depths of the pit.

twi: Wɔn a wuhu wo no hwɛ wo haw,wodwen nea ato wo no ho bisa se,“Ɛnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔwosow asasena ɔmaa ahenni ho popoe,
english:
Those who see you stare at you,
    they ponder your fate:
“Is this the man who shook the earth
    and made kingdoms tremble,

twi: ɔbarima a ɔmaa wiase dan nweatam,nea ɔdan ne nkuropɔn butuwiina wamma ne nneduafo ankɔ wɔn nkyi no ni?”
english:
the man who made the world a wilderness,
    who overthrew its cities
    and would not let his captives go home?”

twi: Amanaman ahemfo no nyinaa wɔadeda wɔnobiara wɔ ne da mu.
english:
All the kings of the nations lie in state,
    each in his own tomb.

twi: Nanso wɔapam wo afi wo da mute sɛ dubaa a wɔapo;wɔde wɔn a wɔatotɔ akata wo so,wɔn a wɔtɔɔ wɔ afoa ano,wɔn a wosian kɔ abo amoa mu,te sɛ funu a wɔatiatia so,
english:
But you are cast out of your tomb
    like a rejected branch;
you are covered with the slain,
    with those pierced by the sword,
    those who descend to the stones of the pit.
Like a corpse trampled underfoot,

twi: Wɔrensie wo nka wɔn ho,efisɛ woasɛe wʼasasena wakunkum wo nkurɔfo.Otirimɔdenfo asefo nowɔrenkae wɔn bio. Wo babarima renni wʼade sɛ ɔhene.
english:
you will not join them in burial,
for you have destroyed your land
    and killed your people.
Let the offspring of the wicked
    never be mentioned again.

twi: Siesie faako a wobekunkum ne mmabarimawɔ wɔn agyanom bɔne nti;ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsɔre di asase no sona wɔde wɔn nkuropɔn pete so.
english:
Prepare a place to slaughter his children
    for the sins of their ancestors;
they are not to rise to inherit the land
    and cover the earth with their cities.

twi: “Mɛsɔre atia wɔn,”Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.“Metwa ne din ne ne nkae,ne mma ne ne nenanom afi Babilonia ho,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
english:
“I will rise up against them,”
    declares the Lord Almighty.
“I will wipe out Babylon’s name and survivors,
    her offspring and descendants,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Mɛdan no ayɛ faako a mpatu wɔne ɔwora;mede ɔsɛeprae bɛpra no,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
english:
“I will turn her into a place for owls
    and into swampland;
I will sweep her with the broom of destruction,”
    declares the Lord Almighty.

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia AsiriaAsafo Awurade aka ntam se,“Nokware, sɛnea mahyehyɛ no, saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ,na sɛnea masusuw no, ɛrensesa.
english:
The Lord Almighty has sworn,
“Surely, as I have planned, so it will be,
    and as I have purposed, so it will happen.

twi: Mɛsɛe Asiria pasaa wɔ mʼasase so;metiatia no so me mmepɔw so.Obeyi ne konnua afi me nkurɔfo so,na nʼadesoa nso afi wɔn so.”
english:
I will crush the Assyrian in my land;
    on my mountains I will trample him down.
His yoke will be taken from my people,
    and his burden removed from their shoulders.”

twi: Eyi ne nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama wiase nyinaa;eyi ne nsa a wɔateɛ wɔ aman nyinaa so.
english:
This is the plan determined for the whole world;
    this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

twi: Na sɛ Asafo Awurade ayɛ nʼadwene a hena na obesiw no kwan?Na sɛ wateɛ ne nsa, hena na obesianka no?
english:
For the Lord Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him?
    His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia FilistifoSaa adehu yi baa afe a ɔhene Ahas wui no:
english: This prophecy came in the year King Ahaz died:

twi: Munnni ahurusi, mo Filistifo,sɛ abaa a ɛbɔɔ mo no mu abubu;saa ɔwɔ no ase na ahurutoa befi aba,na nʼaba bɛyɛ ɔwɔ a ne ho yɛ hare na nʼano wɔ bɔre.
Ahiafo mu hiani benya didibea,na mmɔborɔni bɛda asomdwoe mu.Nanso wʼasefo de, mede ɔkɔm bɛtɔre wɔn ase;ebekunkum wo nkae no.
english:
The poorest of the poor will find pasture,
    and the needy will lie down in safety.
But your root I will destroy by famine;
    it will slay your survivors.

twi: Twa adwo, kurow pon! Su teɛ mu kuropɔn!munguan, mo Filistifo!Wusiw kumɔnn bi fi atifi fam reba,na obiara ntwentwɛn ne nan ase wɔ wɔn mu.
english:
Wail, you gate! Howl, you city!
    Melt away, all you Philistines!
A cloud of smoke comes from the north,
    and there is not a straggler in its ranks.

twi: Mmuae bɛn na wɔde bɛmasaa ɔman no ananmusifo?“Awurade de Sion atim hɔ,ne mu na nʼamanehunufo benya guankɔbea.”
english:
What answer shall be given
    to the envoys of that nation?
“The Lord has established Zion,
    and in her his afflicted people will find refuge.”

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia MoabAdehu a ɛfa Moab ho:Wɔasɛe Ar a ɛwɔ MoabDa koro anadwo bi,wɔasɛe Kir a ɛwɔ Moabda koro anadwo bi!
english:
A prophecy against Moab:
Ar in Moab is ruined,
    destroyed in a night!
Kir in Moab is ruined,
    destroyed in a night!

twi: Dibon foro kɔ nʼasɔredan mu,ɔkɔ ne sorɔnsorɔmmea kosu;Moab twa adwo wɔ Nebo ne Medeba ho.Wɔayi eti biara so nwina abogyesɛ biara nso wɔatwitwa.
english:
Dibon goes up to its temple,
    to its high places to weep;
    Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba.
Every head is shaved
    and every beard cut off.

twi: Wofurafura atweaatam wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔ adan atifi ne ɔman ahyiaewɔn nyinaa retwa adwo,wɔdeda fam na wosu.
english:
In the streets they wear sackcloth;
    on the roofs and in the public squares
they all wail,
    prostrate with weeping.

twi: Hesbon ne Eleale teɛ mu su,wɔte wɔn nne kodu Yahas nohɔ.Enti Moab mmarima akofo teɛ mu su,na wɔbotobotow.
english:
Heshbon and Elealeh cry out,
    their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz.
Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out,
    and their hearts are faint.

twi: Midi Moab ho awerɛhow wɔ me koma mu;nʼaguanfo guan kodu Soar,ne Eglat Selisiya.Wɔforo kɔ Luhit,wɔrekɔ nyinaa na wɔresu;Horonaim kwan so nsowodi wɔn sɛe ho awerɛhow.
english:
My heart cries out over Moab;
    her fugitives flee as far as Zoar,
    as far as Eglath Shelishiyah.
They go up the hill to Luhith,
    weeping as they go;
on the road to Horonaim
    they lament their destruction.

twi: Nimrim nsuwansuwa ayoyowna sare no ahyewafifide nyinaa ayerana ɛnkaa wura biara a ɛyɛ amono.
english:
The waters of Nimrim are dried up
    and the grass is withered;
the vegetation is gone
    and nothing green is left.

twi: Enti ahonyade a wɔapɛ agu hɔ nowɔsoa de kotwa mpampuro bon.
english:
So the wealth they have acquired and stored up
    they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.

twi: Wɔn nkekawmu gyigye wɔ Moab ahye so;wɔn agyaadwotwa kodu Eglaimna wɔn abubuwbɔ kodu Beer Elim.
Dimon nsu ayɛ mogya nko arananso mɛkɔ so ne no adigyata bɛba Moab aguanfo sone wɔn a wɔbɛka asase no so no so.
english:
The waters of Dimon are full of blood,
    but I will bring still more upon Dimon—
a lion upon the fugitives of Moab
    and upon those who remain in the land.

twi: Momfa nguantenmma sɛ sonkahirinkɔma asase no sodifo,efi Sela fa nweatam no so,kɔka Ɔbabea Sion bepɔw no so.
english:
Send lambs as tribute
    to the ruler of the land,
from Sela, across the desert,
    to the mount of Daughter Zion.

twi: Te sɛ nnomaa a wɔaka wɔn afi berebuw muna wotu nenam wim nosaa na Moabfo mmea tewɔ Arnon asutwabea.
english:
Like fluttering birds
    pushed from the nest,
so are the women of Moab
    at the fords of the Arnon.

twi: Moab ka se, “Munsi mo adwene pi,monna mo gyinaesi adi.Monyɛ mo sunsuma sɛ anadwo,awia ketee.Momfa aguanfo no nhintawmunnyi atubrafo no mma.
english:
“Make up your mind,” Moab says.
    “Render a decision.
Make your shadow like night—
    at high noon.
Hide the fugitives,
    do not betray the refugees.

twi: Momma Moabfo aguanfo no ne mo ntena;monyɛ wɔn bammɔ wɔ ɔsɛefo no ho.”Ɔhyɛsoni no bɛba nʼawiena adesɛe to betwa;opoobɔfo no bɛyera wɔ asase no so.
Ɔdɔ mu na Onyankopɔn besi ahengua bi;ɔbarima bi de nokwaredi bɛtena so,obi a ofi Dawid fi,nea atemmu mu no ɔpɛ atɛntreneena ɔntwentwɛn adetreneeyɛ ho.
english:
In love a throne will be established;
    in faithfulness a man will sit on it—
    one from the house of David—
one who in judging seeks justice
    and speeds the cause of righteousness.

twi: Yɛate Moab ahantan a ɔyɛ,nʼani a atra ne ntɔn mmoroso,nʼahomaso ne nʼasoɔdennanso hwee nni nʼahomaso no mu.
english:
We have heard of Moab’s pride—
    how great is her arrogance!—
of her conceit, her pride and her insolence;
    but her boasts are empty.

twi: Enti Moabfo twa adwo,wɔbɔ mu su ma Moab.Wodi awerɛhow na wɔbɔ abubuw,ma Kir Hereset bobe aba ɔfam.
english:
Therefore the Moabites wail,
    they wail together for Moab.
Lament and grieve
    for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth.

twi: Hesbon mfuw no hyew,Sibma bobe mfuw nso saa ara.Aman sodifo no atiatia bobe papa no so,nea kan na wɔde kɔ Yaserna ɛtrɛtrɛw kɔ nweatam so no.Wɔn mman trɛtrɛw kɔka mpoano pɛɛ.
english:
The fields of Heshbon wither,
    the vines of Sibmah also.
The rulers of the nations
    have trampled down the choicest vines,
which once reached Jazer
    and spread toward the desert.
Their shoots spread out
    and went as far as the sea.

twi: Enti misu sɛnea Yaser su,de ma Sibma bobe mfuw.Hesbon ne Eleale,mede misu fɔw mo!Mo aduaba a abere ho ahurusine otwabere de no aka.
english:
So I weep, as Jazer weeps,
    for the vines of Sibmah.
Heshbon and Elealeh,
    I drench you with tears!
The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit
    and over your harvests have been stilled.

twi: Ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nni mfikyifuw no mu;obiara nto dwom, na ɔnteɛteɛ mu wɔ bobeturo mu;obiara nkyi nsa wɔ nsakyiamoa so,efisɛ mede nteɛteɛmu aba nʼawiei.
Misi apini wɔ me koma mu wɔ Moab hote sɛ sankuten so kwadwom;na me yam hyehye me ma Kir Hereset.
english:
My heart laments for Moab like a harp,
    my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.

twi: Sɛ Moab kɔ ne sorɔnsorɔmmea aɔhaw ne ho kwa;sɛ ɔkɔ nʼabosonnan mu kɔbɔ mpae a,ɛrenkosi hwee.
english:
When Moab appears at her high place,
    she only wears herself out;
when she goes to her shrine to pray,
    it is to no avail.

twi: Eyi ne asɛm a Awurade aka dedaw afa Moab ho.
english: This is the word the Lord has already spoken concerning Moab.

twi: Nanso mprempren Awurade ka se, “Mfe abiɛsa mu, sɛnea akoa a nhyehyɛe kyekyere no no bebu nna no, wobebu Moab anuonyam ne ne nkurɔfo dodow no nyinaa animtiaa, na ne nkae no bɛyɛ kakraa bi a wonni ahoɔden.”
english: But now the Lord says: “Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab’s splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble.”

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia DamaskoNkɔmhyɛ a ɛfa Damasko ho:“Hwɛ, Damasko renyɛ kuropɔn bioɛbɛdan ayɛ nnwiriwii siw.
english:
A prophecy against Damascus:
“See, Damascus will no longer be a city
    but will become a heap of ruins.

twi: Aroer nkuropɔn bɛdan amamfona wɔagyaw ama nguankuw ama wɔadeda hɔ,a obiara renyi wɔn hu.
english:
The cities of Aroer will be deserted
    and left to flocks, which will lie down,
    with no one to make them afraid.

twi: Kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban bɛyera wɔ Efraim,adehyetumi nso befi Damasko;Aram nkae bɛyɛIsraelfo anuonyam,”Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
english:
The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim,
    and royal power from Damascus;
the remnant of Aram will be
    like the glory of the Israelites,”
declares the Lord Almighty.

twi: “Da no Yakob anuonyam bɛpa;na ne mu srade bɛsa.
english:
“In that day the glory of Jacob will fade;
    the fat of his body will waste away.

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ sɛnea nnɔbaetwafo twa aburow a egyina afuw sona ɔde ne nsa penpan,sɛ bere a obi redi mpɛpɛwawɔ Refaim Bon mu.
english:
It will be as when reapers harvest the standing grain,
    gathering the grain in their arms—
as when someone gleans heads of grain
    in the Valley of Rephaim.

twi: Nanso mpɛpɛwa no mu bi bɛka,sɛnea wɔwosow ngodua a ɛyɛ no,ɛka aba no abien anaa abiɛsa wɔ atifi mman no so,ne anan anaa anum wɔ mman a ɛso no so,”sɛnea Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se ni.
english:
Yet some gleanings will remain,
    as when an olive tree is beaten,
leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches,
    four or five on the fruitful boughs,”
declares the Lord, the God of Israel.

twi: Saa da no, nnipa de wɔn ani bɛto wɔn Yɛfo sona wɔadan wɔn ani ahwɛ Israel Ɔkronkronni no.
english:
In that day people will look to their Maker
    and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Wɔremfa wɔn ho nto afɔremuka aɛyɛ wɔn nsa ano adwuma no so,na wobebu Asera nnua ne nnuhuam afɔremukaa wɔde wɔn nsateaa ayɛ no animtiaa.
english:
They will not look to the altars,
    the work of their hands,
and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles
    and the incense altars their fingers have made.

twi: Da no wɔn nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ dennen, a Israelfo nti wogyaw hɔ no, bɛyɛ sɛ mmeaemmeae a wɔagyaw ama nnɔtɔ ne nwura. Ne nyinaa bɛda mpan.
english: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.

twi: Mo werɛ afi Onyankopɔn, mo Agyenkwa,na monkaee Ɔbotan no, mo abandennen no.Enti ɛwɔ mu sɛ mopɛ nnua papana mudua bobe a moatɔ afi amannɔne,
english:
You have forgotten God your Savior;
    you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress.
Therefore, though you set out the finest plants
    and plant imported vines,

twi: ɛwɔ mu, da a muduae no, moma enyiniianɔpa a muduae no, moma eguu nhwiren,nanso otwa no renyɛ hwee sɛɔyare ne ɔyaw a wontumi nsa.
english:
though on the day you set them out, you make them grow,
    and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud,
yet the harvest will be as nothing
    in the day of disease and incurable pain.

twi: Nnome nka aman dodow a wohuru so no,wohuru so te sɛ po a ɛrebɔ asorɔkye!Nnome nka nnipa dodow a wɔworo so,wɔworo so sɛ asu akɛse!
english:
Woe to the many nations that rage—
    they rage like the raging sea!
Woe to the peoples who roar—
    they roar like the roaring of great waters!

twi: Ɛwɔ mu, nnipa dodow woro so te sɛ, asu a ɛresen mmirika so,sɛ ɔka wɔn anim a woguan kɔ akyirikyiri,te sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu wɔ bepɔw sote sɛ nweatam so nwura a mframaden rebɔ no.
english:
Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters,
    when he rebukes them they flee far away,
driven before the wind like chaff on the hills,
    like tumbleweed before a gale.

twi: Anwummere, wɔbɔ yɛn hu awerɛfiri muansa na ade bɛkyɛ no na wɔkɔ dedaw!wɔn a wɔfow yɛn nneɛma,ne wɔn a wɔbɔ yɛn korɔn kyɛfa ni.
english:
In the evening, sudden terror!
    Before the morning, they are gone!
This is the portion of those who loot us,
    the lot of those who plunder us.

twi: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia KusDue asase a ntaban nnyigyei wɔ sowɔ Kus nsubɔnten ho,
english:
Woe to the land of whirring wings
    along the rivers of Cush,

twi: ɔsoma ananmusifo a wɔnam po sowɔde paparɔso akorow fa nsu ani.Monkɔ, asomafo ahoɔharefo,monkɔ nnipa a wɔwoware na wɔn honam yɛ trontrom,nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ hu wɔ mmaa nyinaa,anuɔdenfo man a yɛnte wɔn kasa,na nsubɔnten akyekyɛ nʼasase mu no nkyɛn.
english:
which sends envoys by sea
    in papyrus boats over the water.
Go, swift messengers,
to a people tall and smooth-skinned,
    to a people feared far and wide,
an aggressive nation of strange speech,
    whose land is divided by rivers.

twi: Mo wiasefo nyinaa,mo a motete asase so,sɛ wɔma frankaa so wɔ bepɔw no so a,mubehusɛ wɔhyɛn torobɛnto a,mobɛte.
english:
All you people of the world,
    you who live on the earth,
when a banner is raised on the mountains,
    you will see it,
and when a trumpet sounds,
    you will hear it.

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade ka kyerɛ me,“Mɛtena mʼatenae, na mahwɛ biribiara dinn.Mɛyɛ dinn te sɛ owia a ɛrebɔ,te sɛ bɔ a esi wɔ otwabere mu.”
english:
This is what the Lord says to me:
    “I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place,
like shimmering heat in the sunshine,
    like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

twi: Ennya nnuu twabere, a nhwiren bere atwam nona nhwiren no anyin adan bobe no,wɔde asosɔw betwitwa mman no,wobetwitwa mman a ɛredennan no akɔ.
english:
For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone
    and the flower becomes a ripening grape,
he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives,
    and cut down and take away the spreading branches.

twi: Wobegyaw wɔn nyinaa ama bepɔw so nnomaaa wokum mmoa we ne wuram mmoa;nnomaa no bedi wɔn nam wɔ ahuhuru bere mu.Wuram mmoa bɛwe wɔn nam wɔ awɔw bere mu.
english:
They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey
    and to the wild animals;
the birds will feed on them all summer,
    the wild animals all winter.

twi: Saa bere no, wɔde akyɛde bɛbrɛ Asafo Awuradeebefi nnipa a wɔwoware na wɔn honam yɛ trontrom hɔ,nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ hu wɔ mmaa nyinaa,aniɔdenfo man a yɛnte wɔn kasa,na nsubɔnten akyekyɛ nʼasase mu,wɔde akyɛde bɛba Sion Bepɔw so, faako a Asafo Awurade din atim no.
Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛfa MisraimNkɔmhyɛ a ɛfa Misraim ho:Monhwɛ! Awurade nam ahoɔhare omununkum muna ɔreba Misraim.Misraim ahoni ho popo wɔ nʼanim,na Misraimfo koma botow wɔ wɔn mu.
english:
A prophecy against Egypt:
See, the Lord rides on a swift cloud
    and is coming to Egypt.
The idols of Egypt tremble before him,
    and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.

twi: “Mɛma Misraimfo atwa wɔn ho ako,onua bɛko atia onua,ɔyɔnko atia ɔyɔnko,kuropɔn atia kuropɔn,ahenni atia ahenni.
english:
“I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian—
    brother will fight against brother,
    neighbor against neighbor,
    city against city,
    kingdom against kingdom.

twi: Misraimfo no rennya abodwo,na mɛma wɔn nhyehyɛe ayɛ ɔkwa.Wɔbɛkɔ abisa wɔ ahoni, ne awufo ahonhom,samanfrɛfo ne nkonyaayifo nkyɛn.
english:
The Egyptians will lose heart,
    and I will bring their plans to nothing;
they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead,
    the mediums and the spiritists.

twi: Mede Misraim bɛhyɛowura tirimuɔdenfo tumi ase,na ɔhene a ɔyɛ keka bedi wɔn so,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
english:
I will hand the Egyptians over
    to the power of a cruel master,
and a fierce king will rule over them,”
    declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

twi: Nsubɔnten mu nsu bɛyow,na konkɔn bɛwo ayɛ wosee.
english:
The waters of the river will dry up,
    and the riverbed will be parched and dry.

twi: Nsuka beyi hua;na nsuwa a ɛwɔ Misraim bɛtwe na ayow.Demmire ne sare bekisakisa,
Nil nsunoa nnua nso,nea ɛwɔ asubɔnten no abɔe no.Nil nsunoa so mfuw nyinaabɛwo wosee na awu koraa.
english:
also the plants along the Nile,
    at the mouth of the river.
Every sown field along the Nile
    will become parched, will blow away and be no more.

twi: Apopofo nyinaa besi apini atwa adwo,wɔn a wɔto darewa wɔ Nil mu nyinaa;wɔn a wogu asau wɔ nsu no sobedi awerɛhow.
english:
The fishermen will groan and lament,
    all who cast hooks into the Nile;
those who throw nets on the water
    will pine away.

twi: Wɔn a wɔde asaawa yɛ adwuma aba mu bebu,wɔn a wɔnwen nwera no anidaso bɛsa.
english:
Those who work with combed flax will despair,
    the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.

twi: Wɔn a wɔyɛ ntama ho adwuma bɛyɛ mmɔbɔna wɔn a wogye akatua nyinaa koma bɛbotow.
english:
The workers in cloth will be dejected,
    and all the wage earners will be sick at heart.

twi: Soan adwumayɛfo nka hwee sɛ nkwaseafo;Farao agyinatufo anyansafo ma afotu bɔne.Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woaka akyerɛ Farao se,“Meyɛ anyansafo no mu baako,tete ahemfo no kyidifo?”
english:
The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools;
    the wise counselors of Pharaoh give senseless advice.
How can you say to Pharaoh,
    “I am one of the wise men,
    a disciple of the ancient kings”?

twi: Wʼanyansafo no wɔ he afei?Ma wɔnkyerɛ wo na ma wonhunea Asafo Awuradeahyehyɛ atia Misraim.
english:
Where are your wise men now?
    Let them show you and make known
what the Lord Almighty
    has planned against Egypt.

twi: Soan adwumayɛfo abɛyɛ nkwaseafo,wɔadaadaa Memfis akwankyerɛfone nnipa no ntuanoama Misraim afom kwan.
english:
The officials of Zoan have become fools,
    the leaders of Memphis are deceived;
the cornerstones of her peoples
    have led Egypt astray.

twi: Awurade ahwieanisobiri honhom agu wɔn mu;wɔma Misraim tɔ ntintan wɔ biribiara a ɔyɛ mu,te sɛ nea ɔsabowfo tɔ ntintan wɔ ne fe ho no.
english:
The Lord has poured into them
    a spirit of dizziness;
they make Egypt stagger in all that she does,
    as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.

twi: Biribiara nni hɔ a Misraim betumi ayɛ,sɛ eti anaa ɛto, abɛ anaa demmire.
english:
There is nothing Egypt can do—
    head or tail, palm branch or reed.

twi: Saa da no, Misraimfo bɛyɛ sɛ mmea, Asafo Awurade nsa a wama so atia wɔn no bɛma wɔn abɔ hu na wɔn ho apopo.
english: In that day the Egyptians will become weaklings. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the Lord Almighty raises against them.

twi: Na Yuda asase no bɛma Misraimfo abɔ hu, obiara a ɔbɛte Yuda din no besuro, esiane nea Asafo Awurade rehyehyɛ atia wɔn nti.
english: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the Lord Almighty is planning against them.

twi: Saa da no, Misraim nkurɔpɔn anum bɛka Kanaan kasa na wɔaka Asafo Awurade ntam. Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn mu ɔbaako se Ɔsɛe Kuropɔn.
