    flee from the Babylonians!
Announce this with shouts of joy
    and proclaim it.
Send it out to the ends of the earth;
    say, “The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob.”

twi: Osukɔm anne wɔn bere a odii wɔn anim, wɔ nweatam ahorow so no,ɔmaa nsu fii ɔbotan mu ba maa wɔn;ɔpaee ɔbotan no mu, maa nsu tue fii mu.
“Asomdwoe nni hɔ mma amumɔyɛfo.” Sɛɛ na Awurade se.
english: “There is no peace,” says the Lord, “for the wicked.”

twi: Awurade Somfo NoMuntie me, mo mpoano aman;monyɛ aso mo akyirikyiri amanansa na wɔrebɛwo me no, Awurade frɛɛ meɔbɔɔ me din ansa na wɔrewo me.
Ɔyɛɛ mʼano sɛ afoa nnamnam,Ɔde me hintaw ne nsa ase nwini mu;ɔde me yɛɛ agyan a ano yɛ nnamna ɔde me hyɛɛ ne boha mu.
english:
He made my mouth like a sharpened sword,
    in the shadow of his hand he hid me;
he made me into a polished arrow
    and concealed me in his quiver.

twi: Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woyɛ me somfo,Israel, wo mu na mɛda mʼanuonyam adi.”
english:
He said to me, “You are my servant,
    Israel, in whom I will display my splendor.”

twi: Nanso mekae se, “Mabrɛ agumasɛe mʼahoɔden kwa, mannya mu hweenanso nea ɛwɔ me wɔ Awurade nsamna mʼakatua wɔ me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.”
english:
But I said, “I have labored in vain;
    I have spent my strength for nothing at all.
Yet what is due me is in the Lord’s hand,
    and my reward is with my God.”

twi: Na afei, Awurade kasa se,nea ɔnwen me wɔ awotwaa mu sɛ memmɛyɛ ne somfosɛ memfa Yakob nsan mmra ne nkyɛnna me mmoaboa Israel ano mma no no,wahyɛ me anuonyam wɔ Awurade ani sona me Nyankopɔn ayɛ mʼahoɔden.
english:
And now the Lord says—
    he who formed me in the womb to be his servant
to bring Jacob back to him
    and gather Israel to himself,
for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord
    and my God has been my strength—

twi: Ɔka se,“Ɛyɛ ade ketewa bi ma wo sɛ wobɛyɛ me somfosɛ wode Yakob mmusuakuw bɛsan abana wode Israelfo a mede wɔn asie bɛsan aba.Mɛma moayɛ amanamanmufo nyinaa kanea,ɛnam mo so na wobegye wiasefo nyinaa nkwa.”
english:
he says:
“It is too small a thing for you to be my servant
    to restore the tribes of Jacob
    and bring back those of Israel I have kept.
I will also make you a light for the Gentiles,
    that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se,Ogyefo ne Israel ɔkronkronni node kɔma nea aman buu no animtiaa na wokyii no,ahemfo somfo no;“Ahene behu wo na wɔasɔreahenemma behu wo na wɔakotow woesiane Awurade a ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo,Israel ɔkronkronni a wayi wo no nti.”
english:
This is what the Lord says—
    the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel—
to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation,
    to the servant of rulers:
“Kings will see you and stand up,
    princes will see and bow down,
because of the Lord, who is faithful,
    the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

twi: Israel Si Ne Dedaw MuSɛɛ na Awurade se:“Bere a ɛsɛ mu no, mebua wo,na nkwagyeda no, mɛboa wo;mɛkora wo na mede wo ayɛapam ama nkurɔfo no,de agye asase no asi hɔakyekyɛ agyapade ahorow a asɛe no bio,
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“In the time of my favor I will answer you,
    and in the day of salvation I will help you;
I will keep you and will make you
    to be a covenant for the people,
to restore the land
    and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

twi: wobɛka akyerɛ nneduafo se, ‘Mumfi mmra!’ne wɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu se, ‘Momfa mo ho nni!’“Wobedidi wɔ akwan howobenya adidibea wɔ koko kesee biara so.
english:
to say to the captives, ‘Come out,’
    and to those in darkness, ‘Be free!’
“They will feed beside the roads
    and find pasture on every barren hill.

twi: Ɔkɔm renne wɔn na osukɔm nso renne wɔn;nweatam so hyew ne owia ano hyew renka wɔn,nea ɔwɔ ayamhyehye ma wɔn no bɛkyerɛ wɔn kwanna ɔde wɔn akɔ nsuaniwa ho.
english:
They will neither hunger nor thirst,
    nor will the desert heat or the sun beat down on them.
He who has compassion on them will guide them
    and lead them beside springs of water.

twi: Mɛyɛ me mmepɔw nyinaa akwan,na mʼatempɔn nso mɛma akrɔn.
english:
I will turn all my mountains into roads,
    and my highways will be raised up.

twi: Hwɛ, wufi akyirikyiri bɛbaebinom befi atifi fam, ebinom befi atɔe famebinom nso befi Sinin mantam mu.”
english:
See, they will come from afar—
    some from the north, some from the west,
    some from the region of Aswan.”

twi: Momfa anigye nteɛ mu, ɔsoro;di ahurusi, asase;mompae mu nnwonto mu, mmepɔw!Na Awurade kyekye ne nkurɔfo werɛ,na obehu nʼamanehunufo mmɔbɔ.
Nanso Sion kae se, “Awurade agyaw me hɔ,Awurade werɛ afi me.”
english:
But Zion said, “The Lord has forsaken me,
    the Lord has forgotten me.”

twi: “Ɛna werɛ betumi afi ne ba a otua nufu anoa ɔrennya ayamhyehye mma ɔba a waturu no no ana?Ebia ne werɛ befi,na me werɛ remfi wo!
english:
“Can a mother forget the baby at her breast
    and have no compassion on the child she has borne?
Though she may forget,
    I will not forget you!

twi: Hwɛ, makurukyerɛw wo din agu me nsa yamwʼafasu wɔ mʼani so daa.
english:
See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands;
    your walls are ever before me.

twi: Mo mmabarima resan aba ntɛm so;na wɔn a wɔsɛe mo no refi mo nkyɛn akɔ.
english:
Your children hasten back,
    and those who laid you waste depart from you.

twi: Momma mo ani so nhwɛ mo ho nhyia;mo mmabarima nyinaa reboa wɔn ho ano aba mo nkyɛn.Sɛ mete ase yi” sɛnea Awurade se,“mode wɔn bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde ama mo homubefura wɔn sɛ ayeforokunu.
“Ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔsɛee mo yɛɛ mo pasaamaa mo asase daa mpan,afei nnipa bɛhyɛ wo so ma, ama aboro wo so,na wɔn a wɔsɛee wo no bɛkɔ akyirikyiri.
english:
“Though you were ruined and made desolate
    and your land laid waste,
now you will be too small for your people,
    and those who devoured you will be far away.

twi: Mmofra a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ mo nna bɔne mu nobɛka ama moate sɛ,‘Ɛha sua ma yɛn dodo;momma yɛn asase no bi nka ho na yɛntena so.’
english:
The children born during your bereavement
    will yet say in your hearing,
‘This place is too small for us;
    give us more space to live in.’

twi: Na wobɛka wɔ wo koma mu se,‘Hena na ɔwoo eyinom maa me?Na meyɛ ɔwerɛhowni ne obonin;wotuu me kɔɔ asase foforo so na wɔpoo me.Hena na ɔtetew eyinom?Wogyaw me nko arana eyinom, he na wofi bae?’ ”
english:
Then you will say in your heart,
    ‘Who bore me these?
I was bereaved and barren;
    I was exiled and rejected.
    Who brought these up?
I was left all alone,
    but these—where have they come from?’”

twi: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Hwɛ, menyama amanamanmufo,mɛma me frankaa no so akyerɛ nkurɔfo nowobeturu wo mmabarima wɔ wɔn nsa so abana wɔbɛsoa wo mmabea wɔ wɔn mmati so.
english:
This is what the Sovereign Lord says:
“See, I will beckon to the nations,
    I will lift up my banner to the peoples;
they will bring your sons in their arms
    and carry your daughters on their hips.

twi: Ahemfo bɛyɛ mo agyanom nsiananmu,na wɔn ahemmea ayɛ ɛnanom a wɔbɛhwɛ mo.Wɔbɛkotow mo a wɔn anim butubutuw fam;wɔbɛtaforo mo nan ase mfutuma.Afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade.Wɔn a wɔn ani da me so no, merenni wɔn huammɔ.”
Wobetumi agye asade afi akofo nsam;anaa wobetumi agye nnommumfo afi otirimɔdenfo nsam?
english:
Can plunder be taken from warriors,
    or captives be rescued from the fierce?

twi: Nanso, sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Yiw, wobegye nnommumfo afi akofo nsamna wɔagye asade afi otirimɔdenfo nsam;me ne wɔn a wɔne wo nya no benyana megye wo mma nkwa.
english:
But this is what the Lord says:
“Yes, captives will be taken from warriors,
    and plunder retrieved from the fierce;
I will contend with those who contend with you,
    and your children I will save.

twi: Mema wɔn a wɔhyɛ wo so no awe wɔn ankasa honam;wɔn mogya bɛbow wɔn sɛnea wɔanom nsa.Afei adesamma nyinaa behusɛ me, Awurade, me ne wʼAgyenkwa no,wo Gyefo, Yakob Tumfo No.”
english:
I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh;
    they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine.
Then all mankind will know
    that I, the Lord, am your Savior,
    your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

twi: Israel Amumɔyɛ Ne Ɔsomfo No SetieSɛɛ na Awurade se:“Ɛhe na awaregyae ho adansedi nhoma,nea migyinaa so gyaa no kwan no wɔ?Anaa sɛ mʼadefirifo mu henana metɔn wo maa no?Wo bɔne nti na wɔtɔn wo;Wʼamumɔyɛ nti na wɔpam wo na.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce
    with which I sent her away?
Or to which of my creditors
    did I sell you?
Because of your sins you were sold;
    because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

twi: Mebae no, adɛn nti na na obiara nni hɔ?Mefrɛe no, adɛn nti na obiara annye so?Na me nsa yɛ tia dodo sɛ ebegye wo ana?Minni ahoɔden a mede begye wo ana?Mede mʼanimka kɛkɛ no ma po yow,medan nsubɔnten nweatammu mpataa porɔw esiane nsu a wonnya ntina osukɔm kum wɔn.
english:
When I came, why was there no one?
    When I called, why was there no one to answer?
Was my arm too short to deliver you?
    Do I lack the strength to rescue you?
By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea,
    I turn rivers into a desert;
their fish rot for lack of water
    and die of thirst.

twi: Mede sum fura ɔsorona mema atweaatam yɛ ne nkataho.”
english:
I clothe the heavens with darkness
    and make sackcloth its covering.”

twi: Asafo Awurade ama me nkyerɛkyerɛ tɛkrɛmasɛ ɛnka asɛm a ɛhyɛ ɔbrɛfo den.Onyan me anɔpa biara,na obue mʼaso ma mitie sɛ obi a ɔregye nkyerɛkyerɛ.
english:
The Sovereign Lord has given me a well-instructed tongue,
    to know the word that sustains the weary.
He wakens me morning by morning,
    wakens my ear to listen like one being instructed.

twi: Otumfo Awurade abue mʼasona menyɛɛ otuatewfo ɛ;na mensan mʼakyi ɛ.
Mede mʼakyi maa wɔn a wɔboro me,ne mʼafono maa wɔn a wotutu mʼabogyesɛ.Mamfa mʼanim anhintaw wɔnfɛwdi ne ntasu ho.
english:
I offered my back to those who beat me,
    my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard;
I did not hide my face
    from mocking and spitting.

twi: Esiane sɛ, Asafo Awurade boa me nti,wɔrengu mʼanim ase.Enti na mayɛ mʼanim sɛ ɔtwɛrebo,na minim sɛ mʼanim rengu ase.
english:
Because the Sovereign Lord helps me,
    I will not be disgraced.
Therefore have I set my face like flint,
    and I know I will not be put to shame.

twi: Nea obu me bem no abɛn.Enti hena na ɔbɛbɔ me kwaadu?Ɔmma yenhyia mu!Hena na ɔbɔ me sobo?Ma ɔnka nsi mʼanim!
english:
He who vindicates me is near.
    Who then will bring charges against me?
    Let us face each other!
Who is my accuser?
    Let him confront me!

twi: Asafo Awurade na ɔboa me.Hena ne nea obebu me fɔ?Wɔn nyinaa bɛtetew sɛ atade;nnwewemmoa bɛwe wɔn.
english:
It is the Sovereign Lord who helps me.
    Who will condemn me?
They will all wear out like a garment;
    the moths will eat them up.

twi: Mo mu hena na osuro Awurade,na odi ne somfo asɛm so?Ma nea ɔnam sum munea onni hann no,onnye Awurade din nnina ɔmfa ne ho nto ne Nyankopɔn so.
english:
Who among you fears the Lord
    and obeys the word of his servant?
Let the one who walks in the dark,
    who has no light,
trust in the name of the Lord
    and rely on their God.

twi: Na afei, mo a mososɔ ogya nyinaana moyɛ ogyatɛn ma mo ho,monkɔ, nkɔnantew mo gya hann no,ne ogyatɛn a wɔasɔ ano no mu.Eyi ne nea mubenya afi me nsa mu;mobɛdeda fam wɔ ɔyaw mu.
english:
But now, all you who light fires
    and provide yourselves with flaming torches,
go, walk in the light of your fires
    and of the torches you have set ablaze.
This is what you shall receive from my hand:
    You will lie down in torment.

twi: Sion Daapem Nkwagye“Muntie me, mo a mopɛ trenee akyi kwan;na mohwehwɛ Awurade;Monhwɛ ɔbotan a wotwaa mo fii mu none abopaebea a wotuu mo fii hɔ no;
english:
“Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness
    and who seek the Lord:
Look to the rock from which you were cut
    and to the quarry from which you were hewn;

twi: Monhwɛ Abraham, mo agya,ne Sara a ɔwoo mo no.Bere a mefrɛɛ no no, na ɔyɛ ɔbaakofo,na mihyiraa no maa nʼase trɛwee.
english:
look to Abraham, your father,
    and to Sarah, who gave you birth.
When I called him he was only one man,
    and I blessed him and made him many.

twi: Awurade bɛkyekye Sion werɛ ampa arana ne yam bɛhyehye no wɔ ne nnwiriwii no ho;ɔbɛyɛ ne nweatam ahorow sɛ Eden,nʼasase a ada mpan bɛyɛ sɛ Awurade turo.Wobehu anigye ne ahosɛpɛw,aseda ne nnwonto wɔ ne mu.
english:
The Lord will surely comfort Zion
    and will look with compassion on all her ruins;
he will make her deserts like Eden,
    her wastelands like the garden of the Lord.
Joy and gladness will be found in her,
    thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

twi: “Muntie me, me nkurɔfo;monyɛ aso mma me, me man:Mmara no befi me nkyɛn akɔ;na mʼatɛntrenee bɛyɛ hann ama aman no.
Me trenee reba ntɛm so,me nkwagye nam kwan so,na me basa de atɛntrenee bɛbrɛ aman no.Asupɔw no bɛhwɛ mena wɔde anidaso bɛtwɛn me basa.
english:
My righteousness draws near speedily,
    my salvation is on the way,
    and my arm will bring justice to the nations.
The islands will look to me
    and wait in hope for my arm.

twi: Momma mo ani so nhwɛ ɔsorosoro,monhwɛ asase wɔ fam;ɔsorosoro betu ayera sɛ wusiwna asase bɛtetew sɛ atadena wɔn a wɔte so bewuwu sɛ nwansena.Nanso me nkwagye bɛtena hɔ daa,me trenee to rentwa da.
english:
Lift up your eyes to the heavens,
    look at the earth beneath;
the heavens will vanish like smoke,
    the earth will wear out like a garment
    and its inhabitants die like flies.
But my salvation will last forever,
    my righteousness will never fail.

twi: “Muntie me, mo a munim nea ɛteɛ,mo a me mmara wɔ mo koma mu:Munnsuro nnipa animkaanaa momma wɔn ahohora ntu mo koma.
english:
“Hear me, you who know what is right,
    you people who have taken my instruction to heart:
Do not fear the reproach of mere mortals
    or be terrified by their insults.

twi: Na nnwewemmoa bɛwe wɔn te sɛnea wɔwe atade;asunson bɛsɛe wɔn te sɛnea wɔsɛe kuntu.Nanso me trenee bɛtena hɔ daa,me nkwagye befi awo ntoatoaso akosi awo ntoatoaso so.”
english:
For the moth will eat them up like a garment;
    the worm will devour them like wool.
But my righteousness will last forever,
    my salvation through all generations.”

twi: Nyan, nyan! Awurade basa,hyɛ ahoɔden adurade;nyan te sɛ nna a atwa mu no,te sɛ tete awo ntoatoaso mu no.Ɛnyɛ wo na wutwitwaa Rahab mu asinasin no,na wuhwirew asuboa kɛse no mu no?
english:
Awake, awake, arm of the Lord,
    clothe yourself with strength!
Awake, as in days gone by,
    as in generations of old.
Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces,
    who pierced that monster through?

twi: Ɛnyɛ wo na womaa po yowee,asubun mu nsu no,nea ɔpaee kwan wɔ po bun mu nosɛnea wɔn a wɔagye wɔn no betumi atwa?
english:
Was it not you who dried up the sea,
    the waters of the great deep,
who made a road in the depths of the sea
    so that the redeemed might cross over?

twi: Wɔn a Awurade apata ama wɔn bɛsan aba.Wɔde nnwonto bɛhyɛn Sion;anigye a ɛnsa da bɛyɛ wɔn abotiri,anigye ne ahosɛpɛw bɛboro wɔn so,awerɛhow ne apinisi betu ayera.
english:
Those the Lord has rescued will return.
    They will enter Zion with singing;
    everlasting joy will crown their heads.
Gladness and joy will overtake them,
    and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

twi: “Me, me ara, mene wo werɛkyekyefo.Hena ne wo a wusuro ɔdesani,nnipa mma a wɔyɛ sare yi.
english:
“I, even I, am he who comforts you.
    Who are you that you fear mere mortals,
    human beings who are but grass,

twi: Na wo werɛ afi Awurade, wo yɛfonea ɔtrɛw ɔsorosoro muna ɔhyɛɛ asase ase no,a da biara na woabɔ huɔhyɛsoni no abufuw nti,nea ɔde ɔsɛe asi nʼani so no ana?Na ɔhyɛsoni no abufuw wɔ he?
english:
that you forget the Lord your Maker,
    who stretches out the heavens
    and who lays the foundations of the earth,
that you live in constant terror every day
    because of the wrath of the oppressor,
    who is bent on destruction?
For where is the wrath of the oppressor?

twi: Ɛrenkyɛ, wobegyaa nneduafo ahufo no;wɔrenwuwu wɔ afiase amoa mu,na aduan remmɔ wɔn.
Na mene Awurade, wo Nyankopɔnnea ɔhwanyan po, ma nʼasorɔkye woro so.Asafo Awurade ne ne din.
english:
For I am the Lord your God,
    who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—
    the Lord Almighty is his name.

twi: Mede me nsɛm ahyɛ wʼanom,na mede me nsa ase nwini akata wo so.Me a mede ɔsorosoro sii hɔna mehyɛɛ asase ase,na meka kyerɛ Sion se, ‘Moyɛ me nkurɔfo.’ ”
english:
I have put my words in your mouth
    and covered you with the shadow of my hand—
I who set the heavens in place,
    who laid the foundations of the earth,
    and who say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

twi: Awurade Abufuwhyew Kuruwa NoNyan, nyan!Sɔre, Yerusalem!Wo a woanom afi Awurade nsamnʼabufuw kuruwa no,wo a woanom apɔɔdɔ mu nsa atu puwnea ɛma nnipa tɔ ntintan no.
english:
Awake, awake!
    Rise up, Jerusalem,
you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord
    the cup of his wrath,
you who have drained to its dregs
    the goblet that makes people stagger.

twi: Ne mma a ɔwoo wɔn nyinaa noobiara nni hɔ a ɔkyerɛ no kwan;mma a ɔtetew wɔn nyinaa noobiara nni hɔ a oso ne nsa mu.
english:
Among all the children she bore
    there was none to guide her;
among all the children she reared
    there was none to take her by the hand.

twi: Saa ɔhaw prenu yi aba wo so,hena na ɔbɛkyekye wo werɛ?Nnwiriwii ne ɔsɛe, ɔkɔm ne afoa,hena na ɔbɛhyɛ wo den?
english:
These double calamities have come upon you—
    who can comfort you?—
ruin and destruction, famine and sword—
    who can console you?

twi: Wo mma atotɔ beraw;wɔdeda mmɔnten so baabiara,te sɛ ɔtwe a afiri ayi no.Awurade abufuw aba wɔn so,wo Nyankopɔn animka no.
english:
Your children have fainted;
    they lie at every street corner,
    like antelope caught in a net.
They are filled with the wrath of the Lord,
    with the rebuke of your God.

twi: Enti tie eyi, wo a worehu amanewoabow, nanso ɛnyɛ nsa na abow wo.
english:
Therefore hear this, you afflicted one,
    made drunk, but not with wine.

twi: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se,wo Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfo ho ban:Hwɛ, magye afi wo nsa mu,kuruwa a ɛma wotɔɔ ntintan no,kuruwa a ɛyɛ mʼabufuw pɔɔdɔ no,worennom bio.
Mede bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔhaw mo no nsa mu,wɔn a wɔka kyerɛɛ mo se,“Butuw fam na yɛnnantew wo sona wode wʼakyi yɛɛ fam,te sɛ abɔnten sɛ wɔnnantew so no.”
english:
I will put it into the hands of your tormentors,
    who said to you,
    ‘Fall prostrate that we may walk on you.’
And you made your back like the ground,
    like a street to be walked on.”

twi: Nyan, nyan, Sion,hyɛ ahoɔden adurade no.Hyɛ wo ntade fɛɛfɛ noYerusalem kuropɔn kronkron no.Momonotofo ne wɔn a wɔn ho agu firenwura wʼapon mu bio.
english:
Awake, awake, Zion,
    clothe yourself with strength!
Put on your garments of splendor,
    Jerusalem, the holy city.
The uncircumcised and defiled
    will not enter you again.

twi: Poroporow wo ho mfutuma.Sɔre, tena ahengua so, Yerusalem.Yiyi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no fi wo kɔn mu,Ɔbabea Sion a wɔafa wo nnommum.
english:
Shake off your dust;
    rise up, sit enthroned, Jerusalem.
Free yourself from the chains on your neck,
    Daughter Zion, now a captive.

twi: Na sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Wɔantɔn wo annye hwee,na ɛnyɛ sika na wɔde begye wo.”
english:
For this is what the Lord says:
“You were sold for nothing,
    and without money you will be redeemed.”

twi: Na sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“Bere bi me nkurɔfo kɔɔ Misraim kɔtenaa hɔ;akyiri no Asiria bɛhyɛɛ wɔn so.
“Na mprempren dɛn na mewɔ wɔ ha?” Sɛɛ na Awurade se.“Wɔafa me nkurɔfo kɔ kwa,na wɔn sodifo di fɛw,”Awurade na ose.“Da mu no nyinaawɔkɔ so gu me din ho fi.
english:
“And now what do I have here?” declares the Lord.
“For my people have been taken away for nothing,
    and those who rule them mock,”
declares the Lord.
“And all day long
    my name is constantly blasphemed.

twi: Enti me nkurɔfo behu me din;enti da no wobehu sɛɛyɛ me na mehyɛɛ ho nkɔm.Yiw, ɛyɛ me.”
english:
Therefore my people will know my name;
    therefore in that day they will know
that it is I who foretold it.
    Yes, it is I.”

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔn a wɔde asɛmpa no rebaanammɔn si yɛ fɛ wɔ mmepɔw no so,wɔn a wɔpae mu ka asomdwoesɛm,wɔn a wɔbɔ amanneɛdɛ,wɔn a wɔpae mu ka nkwagye ho asɛmna wɔka kyerɛ Sion se,“Mo Nyankopɔn di hene.”
english:
How beautiful on the mountains
    are the feet of those who bring good news,
who proclaim peace,
    who bring good tidings,
    who proclaim salvation,
who say to Zion,
    “Your God reigns!”

twi: Muntie! Mo awɛmfo ma wɔn nne so;wɔbɔ mu de anigye teɛ mu.Sɛ Awurade san ba Sion a,wɔde wɔn ani behu.
english:
Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices;
    together they shout for joy.
When the Lord returns to Zion,
    they will see it with their own eyes.

twi: Mommɔ mu ntue anigye nnwonto,mo Yerusalem nnwiriwii,efisɛ, Awurade akyekye ne nkurɔfo werɛwagye Yerusalem.
english:
Burst into songs of joy together,
    you ruins of Jerusalem,
for the Lord has comforted his people,
    he has redeemed Jerusalem.

twi: Awurade beyi ne basa kronkron no howɔ amanaman nyinaa animna asase ano nyinaa behu yɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye.
english:
The Lord will lay bare his holy arm
    in the sight of all the nations,
and all the ends of the earth will see
    the salvation of our God.

twi: Monkɔ. Mumfi hɔ nkɔ!Mommfa mo ho nnka biribiara a ho ntew.Mumfi ho na mo ho ntew,mo a mukurakura Awurade nkuruwa.
english:
Depart, depart, go out from there!
    Touch no unclean thing!
Come out from it and be pure,
    you who carry the articles of the Lord’s house.

twi: Morentutu mmirika mfi haanaa morenguan;efisɛ Awurade bedi mo anim,Israel Nyankopɔn bɛbɔ mo kyidɔm.
Ɔsomfo No Amanehunu Ne NʼanuonyamHwɛ, me somfo bedi yiyewɔbɛma no so ayɛ no ɔkɛse.
english:
See, my servant will act wisely;
    he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

twi: Nea ɛmaa dodow a wohuu no ho dwiriw wɔn no,wɔsɛee nʼanim a ansɛ onipa biara dena nʼabɔsu sɛe a ɛnsɛ ɔdesani de,
english:
Just as there were many who were appalled at him—
    his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any human being
    and his form marred beyond human likeness—

twi: saa ara na ɔbɛma aman bebree ho adwiriw wɔnna ahemfo bemuamua wɔn ano, ne nti.Wɔn a wɔnkaa ne ho asɛm nkyerɛɛ wɔn no behu,na wɔn a wɔntee no nso bɛte ase.
english:
so he will sprinkle many nations,
    and kings will shut their mouths because of him.
For what they were not told, they will see,
    and what they have not heard, they will understand.

twi: Hena na wagye yɛn asɛm no adi?na Awurade abasa no, hena so na ada adi?
english:
Who has believed our message
    and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

twi: Onyin wɔ nʼanim te sɛ dua amono ketewa bi,te sɛ ntin a efi asase wosee mu.Onni ahoɔfɛ anaa anuonyam a ɛbɛtwetwe yɛn akɔ ne nkyɛn.Ne tebea mu nni biribiara a ɛbɛma yɛapɛ no.
english:
He grew up before him like a tender shoot,
    and like a root out of dry ground.
He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him,
    nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.

twi: Nnipa bɔɔ no ahohora na wɔpoo no,Ɔwerɛhowni a onim ɔyaw.Te sɛ obi a nnipa de wɔn anim hintaw nowobuu no animtiaa na yɛammu no.
english:
He was despised and rejected by mankind,
    a man of suffering, and familiar with pain.
Like one from whom people hide their faces
    he was despised, and we held him in low esteem.

twi: Ampa ara ɔfaa yɛn mmerɛwyɛ,na ɔsoaa yɛn awerɛhow,nanso yebuu no sɛ Onyankopɔn na watwe nʼaso.Yebuu no sɛ, Onyankopɔn na wabɔ no na wadwerɛw no.
english:
Surely he took up our pain
    and bore our suffering,
yet we considered him punished by God,
    stricken by him, and afflicted.

twi: Nanso yɛn mmarato nti na wopiraa no,yɛn amumɔyɛ nti na wɔdwerɛw no;asotwe a ɛde asomdwoe brɛɛ yɛn no daa no so,na nʼapirakuru mu na yenya ayaresa.
english:
But he was pierced for our transgressions,
    he was crushed for our iniquities;
the punishment that brought us peace was on him,
    and by his wounds we are healed.

twi: Yɛn nyinaa ayerayera te sɛ nguan,yɛn mu biara afa ne kwan;na Awurade de yɛn nyinaaamumɔyɛ ato no so.
english:
We all, like sheep, have gone astray,
    each of us has turned to our own way;
and the Lord has laid on him
    the iniquity of us all.

twi: Wɔhyɛɛ no so, yɛɛ no ayayade,nanso wammue nʼano;wɔde no kɔɔ te sɛ oguamma a wɔrekokum no.Sɛnea oguamma yɛ komm wɔ ne nwitwitwafo anim no,saa ara na wammue nʼano.
english:
He was oppressed and afflicted,
    yet he did not open his mouth;
he was led like a lamb to the slaughter,
    and as a sheep before its shearers is silent,
    so he did not open his mouth.

twi: Wɔnam nhyɛso ne atemmu so faa no kɔe.Na hena na obetumi aka nʼasefo ho asɛm?Efisɛ woyii no fii asase yi so;me nkurɔfo mmarato nti wɔtwee nʼaso.
english:
By oppression and judgment he was taken away.
    Yet who of his generation protested?
For he was cut off from the land of the living;
    for the transgression of my people he was punished.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ ne da wɔ abɔnefo mu,na ne wu mu wɔde no too adefo muɛwɔ mu, wanyɛ akakabensɛm biara,na obiara ante atosɛm biara amfi nʼano.
english:
He was assigned a grave with the wicked,
    and with the rich in his death,
though he had done no violence,
    nor was any deceit in his mouth.

twi: Nanso ɛyɛɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔbɛdwerɛw no ama no ahu amanempo ɔde ne nkwa yɛ afɔdi afɔrebɔde,obehu nʼasefo na ne nna bɛware,na Awurade pɛ bɛkɔ so wɔ ne nsam.
english:
Yet it was the Lord’s will to crush him and cause him to suffer,
    and though the Lord makes his life an offering for sin,
he will see his offspring and prolong his days,
    and the will of the Lord will prosper in his hand.

twi: Ne kra amanehunu akyi,obehu nkwa hann, na ne koma atɔ ne yam;na ne suahu mu me somfo treneeni no bebu bebree bem,na wasoa wɔn amumɔyɛ.
english:
After he has suffered,
    he will see the light of life and be satisfied;
by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many,
    and he will bear their iniquities.

twi: Enti mɛma no kyɛfa wɔ atitiriw mu,na ɔne ahoɔdenfo bɛkyɛ asadeefisɛ ɔde ne nkwa too hɔ maa owu,na wɔkan no fraa mmaratofo.Ɔsoaa nnipa bebree bɔne,na odi maa mmaratofo.
english:
Therefore I will give him a portion among the great,
    and he will divide the spoils with the strong,
because he poured out his life unto death,
    and was numbered with the transgressors.
For he bore the sin of many,
    and made intercession for the transgressors.

twi: Sion Daakye Anuonyam“To nnwom, obonin,wo a wonwoo da;pae mu to nnwom, teɛ mu di ahurusi,wo a awo nkaa wo da;efisɛ ɔbea a wannya awo da no mmadɔɔso sen nea ɔwɔ kunu,”Awurade na ose.
english:
“Sing, barren woman,
    you who never bore a child;
burst into song, shout for joy,
    you who were never in labor;
because more are the children of the desolate woman
    than of her who has a husband,”
says the Lord.

twi: “Trɛw wo ntamadan no mu;twe wo ntamadan ntwamu no mu,nnyae yɛ;toa wo ntampehama no so,bobɔ wo nnyinaso no so ma entim yiye.
english:
“Enlarge the place of your tent,
    stretch your tent curtains wide,
    do not hold back;
lengthen your cords,
    strengthen your stakes.

twi: Efisɛ wobɛtrɛw akɔ nifa ne benkum;wʼasefo begye aman afana wɔatena wɔn nkuropɔn amamfo so.
“Nsuro; wʼanim rengu ase.Nsuro aniwu; wɔremmrɛ wo ase.Wo werɛ befi wo mmabun mu aniwuna wo kunayɛ mu ahohora nso worenkae bio.
english:
“Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame.
    Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated.
You will forget the shame of your youth
    and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

twi: Na wo Bɔfo yɛ wo kunuAsafo Awurade ne ne din,Israel Kronkronni no yɛ wo Gyefo.Wɔfrɛ no asase nyinaa so Nyankopɔn.
english:
For your Maker is your husband—
    the Lord Almighty is his name—
the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer;
    he is called the God of all the earth.

twi: Awurade bɛsan afrɛ wote sɛ ɔyere a woagyaa no na odi yaw wɔ ne koma mu,ɔyere a ɔwaree mmabaabere muna wogyaa no mpofirim,” wo Nyankopɔn na ose.
english:
The Lord will call you back
    as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit—
a wife who married young,
    only to be rejected,” says your God.

twi: “Migyaw wo bere tiaa bi mu,nanso mifi ayamhyehye a mu dɔ mu bɛsan de wo aba.
english:
“For a brief moment I abandoned you,
    but with deep compassion I will bring you back.

twi: Abufuw mmoroso mu,mede mʼani hintaw wo mmere tiaa bi,nanso mʼayamye a ɛnsa da nti,mehu wo mmɔbɔ,”nea Awurade, wo Gyefo se ni.
english:
In a surge of anger
    I hid my face from you for a moment,
but with everlasting kindness
    I will have compassion on you,”
    says the Lord your Redeemer.

twi: “Eyi te sɛ Noa mmere so a mekaa ntam semeremma nsuyiri nkata asase ani bio.Enti afei maka ntam se meremma me bo mfuw wo bio,na merenka wʼanim bio.
english:
“To me this is like the days of Noah,
    when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth.
So now I have sworn not to be angry with you,
    never to rebuke you again.

twi: Sɛ mmepɔw wosow,na nkoko tutu a,me dɔ a ɛnsa da a mewɔ ma wo no renhinhimna mʼasomdwoe apam no rentwa mu,”sɛɛ na Awurade a ɔwɔ ahummɔbɔ ma mo no se.
english:
Though the mountains be shaken
    and the hills be removed,
yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken
    nor my covenant of peace be removed,”
    says the Lord, who has compassion on you.

twi: “Kuropɔn a ahum abubu wo na wɔnkyekyee wo werɛ ɛ,mede abo anintɔnka besiesie wo,na mede aboɔdemmo bibiri ayɛ wo fapem.
english:
“Afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted,
    I will rebuild you with stones of turquoise,
    your foundations with lapis lazuli.

twi: Mede bogyabo bɛto wʼabantifi afasu,na mede abohemaa a ɛhyerɛn ayɛ wʼapon,na mede aboɔdemmo ayɛ wʼafasu nyinaa.
english:
I will make your battlements of rubies,
    your gates of sparkling jewels,
    and all your walls of precious stones.

twi: Awurade bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo mmabarima nyinaa,na wo mma asomdwoe bɛdɔɔso.
english:
All your children will be taught by the Lord,
    and great will be their peace.

twi: Wubetim wɔ trenee mu:Wo ne nhyɛsotraso ntam kwan bɛwareworensuro biribiara.Ahupoo bɛkɔ akyirikyiri,na ɛremmɛn wo.
Sɛ obi tow hyɛ wo so a, na emfi me;na nea ɔtow hyɛ wo so no de ne ho bɛma wo.
english:
If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing;
    whoever attacks you will surrender to you.

twi: “Hwɛ, ɛyɛ me na mebɔɔ ɔtomfoa ofita nnyansramma mu ma ɛdɛwna ɔde ahoɔden bɔ akode a ɛfata ne dwumadi.Na ɛyɛ me na mabɔ ɔsɛefo sɛ ɔmmɛsɛe ade;
english:
“See, it is I who created the blacksmith
    who fans the coals into flame
    and forges a weapon fit for its work.
And it is I who have created the destroyer to wreak havoc;

twi: akode biara a wɔabɔ atia wo no rennyinana tɛkrɛma biara a ɛbɛbɔ wo sobo no wobɛbɔ agu.Eyi ne Awurade nkoa agyapade,ne wɔn bembu a efi me,”Awurade na ose.
english:
no weapon forged against you will prevail,
    and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.
This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord,
    and this is their vindication from me,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Osukɔm Ho Ɔfrɛ“Mommra, mo a osukɔm de mo nyinaa,mommra nsu no ho;na mo a munni sika,mommra mmɛtɔ na munni!Mommra mmɛtɔ nsa ne nufusua munntua hwee.
english:
“Come, all you who are thirsty,
    come to the waters;
and you who have no money,
    come, buy and eat!
Come, buy wine and milk
    without money and without cost.

twi: Adɛn nti na mosɛe sika wɔ nea ɛnyɛ aduan hone mo ahoɔden wɔ nea ɛmmee ho?Muntie, muntie me na munni nea eye,na mo kra ani begye nnepa a ɛwɔ akatua pa ho.
english:
Why spend money on what is not bread,
    and your labor on what does not satisfy?
Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good,
    and you will delight in the richest of fare.

twi: Monyɛ aso, na mommra me nkyɛn;muntie me, na mo kra anya nkwa.Me ne mo bɛyɛ apam a ɛte hɔ daa,me dɔ a to ntwa da a mede hyɛɛ Dawid bɔ no.
english:
Give ear and come to me;
    listen, that you may live.
I will make an everlasting covenant with you,
    my faithful love promised to David.

twi: Hwɛ, mede no ayɛ adansedi ama nnipa no,wɔn kannifo ne ɔsahene.
english:
See, I have made him a witness to the peoples,
    a ruler and commander of the peoples.

twi: Ampa ara mobɛfrɛ aman a munnim wɔn,na aman a munnim no bɛyɛ ntɛm aba mo nkyɛn,Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn nti,Israel Ɔkronkronni no,efisɛ wahyɛ mo anuonyam.”
english:
Surely you will summon nations you know not,
    and nations you do not know will come running to you,
because of the Lord your God,
    the Holy One of Israel,
    for he has endowed you with splendor.”

twi: Monhwehwɛ Awurade bere a mubehu no.Momfrɛ no bere a ɔbɛn.
english:
Seek the Lord while he may be found;
    call on him while he is near.

twi: Ma omumɔyɛfo ntwe ne ho mfi nʼakwan hona ɔbɔnefo nso mfi ne nsusuwii ho.Ma ɔnnan nkɔ Awurade nkyɛn, na obehu no mmɔbɔ,ɔnnan nkɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔde ne ho bɛkyɛ no.
english:
Let the wicked forsake their ways
    and the unrighteous their thoughts.
Let them turn to the Lord, and he will have mercy on them,
    and to our God, for he will freely pardon.

twi: “Na mʼadwene nyɛ mo adwene,na mo akwan nso nyɛ mʼakwan,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
english:
“For my thoughts are not your thoughts,
    neither are your ways my ways,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Sɛnea ɔsoro korɔn sen asase no,saa ara na mʼakwan korɔn sen mo akwanna mʼadwene nso korɔn sen mo adwene.
english:
“As the heavens are higher than the earth,
    so are my ways higher than your ways
    and my thoughts than your thoughts.

twi: Sɛnea osu ne sukyerɛmmatɔ fi soro gu fam,na wɔnnsan nkɔ hɔ biowɔ bere a ɛmfɔw asasemma enguu nhwiren mpaee,sɛnea ɛbɛsow aba ama ogufo ne aduan ama odifo no,
english:
As the rain and the snow
    come down from heaven,
and do not return to it
    without watering the earth
and making it bud and flourish,
    so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,

twi: saa ara na mʼasɛm a efi mʼanom no te:Ɛrensan mma me nkyɛn kwa.Mmom ɛbɛyɛ nea mepɛna awie botae a ɛno nti mesomaa no.
english:
so is my word that goes out from my mouth:
    It will not return to me empty,
but will accomplish what I desire
    and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.

twi: Mode ahosɛpɛw bepuena wɔagya mo kwan asomdwoe mu;mmepɔw ne nkokobetue nnwonto wɔ mo anim,na mfuw so nnua nyinaabɛbɔ wɔn nsam.
english:
You will go out in joy
    and be led forth in peace;
the mountains and hills
    will burst into song before you,
and all the trees of the field
    will clap their hands.

twi: Nsɔe anan mu ɔpepaw befifi,na nnɛnkyɛnse anan mu ohuam dua befifi.Eyi bɛyɛ nea ɛhyɛ Awurade anuonyam,ɛbɛyɛ daapem nsɛnkyerɛnne,a ɛrentwa mu da.
english:
Instead of the thornbush will grow the juniper,
    and instead of briers the myrtle will grow.
This will be for the Lord’s renown,
    for an everlasting sign,
    that will endure forever.”

twi: Afoforo NkwagyeSɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monkɔ so mmu atɛntreneena monyɛ nea eye,efisɛ me nkwagye abɛnna ɛrenkyɛ me trenee bɛda adi.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Maintain justice
    and do what is right,
for my salvation is close at hand
    and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

twi: Nhyira nka onipa a ɔyɛ eyi,onipa a okura mu dennen,nea ɔkae Homeda na ɔyɛ no kronkron,na ɔkame ne ho fi bɔneyɛ ho.”
english:
Blessed is the one who does this—
    the person who holds it fast,
who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it,
    and keeps their hands from doing any evil.”

twi: Mma ɔnanani a ɔde ne ho ama Awurade nka se,“Ampa ara Awurade renkan me mfra ne nkurɔfo mu.”Na piamni biara nso nwiinwii sɛ,“Meyɛ duwui.”
english:
Let no foreigner who is bound to the Lord say,
    “The Lord will surely exclude me from his people.”
And let no eunuch complain,
    “I am only a dry tree.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se,“Piamfo a wɔkae me homenna,wɔn a wɔyɛ nea ɛsɔ mʼanina wokura mʼapam mu dennen,
english:
For this is what the Lord says:
“To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths,
    who choose what pleases me
    and hold fast to my covenant—

twi: mɛma wɔn, wɔ mʼasɔredan ne ho afasu nonkae ade ne din a,ɛkyɛn mmabarima ne mmabea;mɛma wɔn din a ɛbɛtena hɔ afebɔɔdin a ɛrentwa mu.
english:
to them I will give within my temple and its walls
    a memorial and a name
    better than sons and daughters;
I will give them an everlasting name
    that will endure forever.

twi: Na ananafo a wɔde wɔn ho bata Awurade hosɛ wɔbɛsom no,sɛ wɔbɛdɔ Awurade din,na wɔasɔre no,wɔn a wɔkae Homeda na wɔyɛ no kronkron nyinaana wokura mʼapam mu dennen,
english:
And foreigners who bind themselves to the Lord
    to minister to him,
to love the name of the Lord,
    and to be his servants,
all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it
    and who hold fast to my covenant—

twi: eyinom na mede wɔn bɛba me bepɔw kronkron no sona mama wɔn anigye wɔ me mpaebɔfi.Wɔn ɔhyew afɔrebɔde ne afɔrebɔ ahorow nomegye wɔ mʼafɔremuka so;na wɔbɛfrɛ me fiaman nyinaa mpaebɔfi.”
english:
these I will bring to my holy mountain
    and give them joy in my house of prayer.
Their burnt offerings and sacrifices
    will be accepted on my altar;
for my house will be called
    a house of prayer for all nations.”

twi: Otumfo Awurade,nea ɔboaboa Israelfo a wɔatwa wɔn asu ano no ka se:“Mɛkɔ so aboaboa afoforo ano aka wɔn hoaka wɔn a maboa wɔn ano dedaw no ho.”
english:
The Sovereign Lord declares—
    he who gathers the exiles of Israel:
“I will gather still others to them
    besides those already gathered.”

twi: Onyankopɔn Sobo A Etia AmumɔyɛfoMommra, mo wuram mmoadoma nyinaa,mummedidi, mo kwae mu mmoa nyinaa!
english:
Come, all you beasts of the field,
    come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!

twi: Israel awɛmfo yɛ anifuraefo,wɔn mu biara nni nimdeɛ;wɔn nyinaa yɛ akraman mum,wontumi mmobɔ mu;wɔdeda hɔ na wɔsoso dae,nna yɛ wɔn dɛ.
Wɔyɛ akraman a wɔpɛ aduan yiye;wonnidi mmee da.Wɔyɛ nguanhwɛfo a wonni ntease;wɔn nyinaa fa wɔn kwan,obiara pɛ nʼankasa mfaso.
“Mommra,” obiara teɛ mu se, “momma me nsa!Momma yɛnnom bobesa mmow!Na ɔkyena bɛyɛ sɛ nnɛ,ebia ɛbɛsen nnɛ koraa.”
english:
“Come,” each one cries, “let me get wine!
    Let us drink our fill of beer!
And tomorrow will be like today,
    or even far better.”

twi: Atreneefo wu,na obiara nnwen ho wɔ ne koma mu;wɔfa nyamesurofo kɔ,na obiara nte asesɛ wɔfa atreneefo kɔsɛnea wobeyi wɔn afi bɔne mu.
english:
The righteous perish,
    and no one takes it to heart;
the devout are taken away,
    and no one understands
that the righteous are taken away
    to be spared from evil.

twi: Wɔn a wɔnantew tee nowɔhyɛn asomdwoe mu;wonya ahomegye bere a wɔadeda sɛ awufo.
“Nanso mo, mommra ha, mo ɔbayifo mma,mo nguaman ne mmea nguamanfo mma!
english:
“But you—come here, you children of a sorceress,
    you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

twi: Hena na moreserew no?Hena na moredi ne ho fɛwna morebɔ no adapaa yi?Monnyɛ atuatewfo fekuwne atorofo asefo ana?
english:
Who are you mocking?
    At whom do you sneer
    and stick out your tongue?
Are you not a brood of rebels,
    the offspring of liars?

twi: Mode ɔpɛ mmoroso bɔ afɔre wɔ adum mune dua biara a adennan ase;mode mo mma bɔ afɔre wɔ aku a mu dɔ mune abotan mpaapae ase.
english:
You burn with lust among the oaks
    and under every spreading tree;
you sacrifice your children in the ravines
    and under the overhanging crags.

twi: Anyame a wɔyɛ abo trontrom, a ɛwɔ aku a mu dɔ mu no,wɔyɛ mo kyɛfa. Wɔn na mopɛ.Yiw, moahwie nsa afɔrebɔde agu wɔn sona mode aduan afɔrebɔde ama wɔn.Eyinom nyinaa akyi, mingow me nsam ana?
english:
The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion;
    indeed, they are your lot.
Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings
    and offered grain offerings.
    In view of all this, should I relent?

twi: Moasiesie mo nnabea wɔ koko a ɛkorɔn so;ɛhɔ na mokɔ kɔbɔ afɔre.
english:
You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill;
    there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

twi: Mo apon ne apongua akyina mo de mo abosonsom nsɛsode asisi.Mufii mʼakyi koyii mo mpa so ntama,mokɔdaa so na motrɛw mu;mo ne wɔn a modɔ wɔn mpa yɛɛ apam,na mohwɛɛ wɔn adagyaw mu.
english:
Behind your doors and your doorposts
    you have put your pagan symbols.
Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed,
    you climbed into it and opened it wide;
you made a pact with those whose beds you love,
    and you looked with lust on their naked bodies.

twi: Mode ngo kɔɔ Molek nkyɛnna momaa mo nnuhuam dɔɔso.Mosomaa mo ananmusifo kɔɔ akyirikyiri;mosian kɔɔ ɔda mu ankasa!
english:
You went to Molek with olive oil
    and increased your perfumes.
You sent your ambassadors far away;
    you descended to the very realm of the dead!

twi: Mo nneyɛe maa mo ɔbrɛ,nanso moanka da se, ‘Yenni anidaso.’Mopɛɛ ahoɔden foforoenti moantɔ piti.
english:
You wearied yourself by such going about,
    but you would not say, ‘It is hopeless.’
You found renewal of your strength,
    and so you did not faint.

twi: “Hena na wama mo koma atu na wabɔ mo hu sɛɛa enti moanni me nokware,na moankae meanaa moannwene eyi ho wɔ mo koma mu yi?So ɛnyɛ komm a mayɛ akyɛ no ntina munsuro me no ana?
english:
“Whom have you so dreaded and feared
    that you have not been true to me,
and have neither remembered me
    nor taken this to heart?
Is it not because I have long been silent
    that you do not fear me?

twi: Mɛda mo trenee ne mo nnwuma adi,na so remma mo mfaso.
english:
I will expose your righteousness and your works,
    and they will not benefit you.

twi: Sɛ moteɛ mu pɛ mmoa a,momma mo ahoni a moaboa ano no nnye mo!Mframa bɛbɔ wɔn nyinaa akɔ,home kɛkɛ bɛfa wɔn.Nanso onipa a ɔde me yɛ ne guankɔbea nobedi asase no sona wafa me bepɔw kronkron no.”
english:
When you cry out for help,
    let your collection of idols save you!
The wind will carry all of them off,
    a mere breath will blow them away.
But whoever takes refuge in me
    will inherit the land
    and possess my holy mountain.”

twi: Koma A Abubu No AwerɛkyekyeNa wɔbɛka se:“Monyɛ, monyɛ, munsiesie ɔkwan no!Munyiyi akwanside mfi me nkurɔfo akwan mu.”
english:
And it will be said:
“Build up, build up, prepare the road!
    Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people.”

twi: Na oyi ne nea ɔkorɔn no,nea ɔte ase daa a ne din yɛ kronkron no se:“Mete beae a ɛkorɔn na ɛyɛ kronkron,mene nea ɔwɔ ahonu na ɔyɛ honhom mu hiani nso te,sɛ mɛkanyan honhom mu hiani no honhom,na makanyan ne koma a abubu no.
english:
For this is what the high and exalted One says—
    he who lives forever, whose name is holy:
“I live in a high and holy place,
    but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit,
to revive the spirit of the lowly
    and to revive the heart of the contrite.

twi: Meremmɔ sobo afebɔɔ,na me bo remfuw daa,sɛ anyɛ saa a onipa honhom bɛtɔ beraw wɔ mʼanim,onipa ahome a me na mabɔ no.
english:
I will not accuse them forever,
    nor will I always be angry,
for then they would faint away because of me—
    the very people I have created.

twi: Ne nnebɔne adifudepɛ maa me bo fuwii;metwee nʼaso, na mede abufuw yii mʼani,nso ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ nea ne koma pɛ.
Mahu ne nneyɛe, nanso mɛsa no yare.Mɛkyerɛ no kwan na makyekye ne werɛ,
english:
I have seen their ways, but I will heal them;
    I will guide them and restore comfort to Israel’s mourners,

twi: na mama ayeyi aba wɔn a wɔredi awerɛhow wɔ Israel no ano.Asomdwoe, asomdwoe mmra wɔn a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri ne wɔn a wɔbɛn so,”sɛɛ na Awurade se. “Na mɛsa wɔn yare.”
english:
creating praise on their lips.
Peace, peace, to those far and near,”
    says the Lord. “And I will heal them.”

twi: Na amumɔyɛfo te sɛ po a ɛrehuru,entumi nyɛ komm,nʼasorɔkye yiyi dontori ne fi.
english:
But the wicked are like the tossing sea,
    which cannot rest,
    whose waves cast up mire and mud.

twi: “Amumɔyɛfo nni asomdwoe.” Sɛɛ na me Nyankopɔn se.
english: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”

twi: Nokware Mmuadadi“Monteɛ mu dennen, monnnyae.Momma mo nne so sɛ torobɛnto.Mompae mu nka me nkurɔfo atuatew nkyerɛ wɔnna monka Yakobfi nso nnebɔne nkyerɛ no.
english:
“Shout it aloud, do not hold back.
    Raise your voice like a trumpet.
Declare to my people their rebellion
    and to the descendants of Jacob their sins.

twi: Da biara da wɔhwehwɛ me;ayɛ sɛ wɔpere sɛ wobehu mʼakwan,te sɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ nea ɛteɛna wɔmpoo ne Nyankopɔn ahyɛde.Wobisa me hɔ gyinae a ɛteɛna ayɛ sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛn wɔn.
english:
For day after day they seek me out;
    they seem eager to know my ways,
as if they were a nation that does what is right
    and has not forsaken the commands of its God.
They ask me for just decisions
    and seem eager for God to come near them.

twi: Wɔka se, ‘Adɛn nti na yɛadi mmuadana woanhu yi?Adɛn nti na yɛabrɛ yɛn ho ase,na woanhwɛ yi?’“Nanso mo mmuada da no, moyɛ nea mopɛna musisi mo adwumayɛfo nyinaa.
english:
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say,
    ‘and you have not seen it?
Why have we humbled ourselves,
    and you have not noticed?’
“Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please
    and exploit all your workers.

twi: Ntɔkwaw ne akasakasa na mode wie mo mmuadadi,ne akuturuku a mode bobɔ mo ho.Morentumi nni mmuada sɛnea moyɛ no nnɛ yina moahwɛ anim sɛ wɔbɛte mo nne wɔ ɔsoro.
english:
Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife,
    and in striking each other with wicked fists.
You cannot fast as you do today
    and expect your voice to be heard on high.

twi: Eyi ne mmuadadi a mepɛ ana?Da koro pɛ a onipa de brɛ ne ho ase no ana?Ɛne sɛ obi si ne ti ase te sɛ mfeana ɔtena atweaatam so ne nsõ mu nko ara ana?Eyi na mofrɛ no mmuadadi,da a ɛsɔ Awurade ani yi ni ana?
english:
Is this the kind of fast I have chosen,
    only a day for people to humble themselves?
Is it only for bowing one’s head like a reed
    and for lying in sackcloth and ashes?
Is that what you call a fast,
    a day acceptable to the Lord?

twi: “Saa mmuadadi yi na mepɛ:sɛ mubeyiyi ntɛnkyew nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔnna moasan konnua ahama,sɛ mubegyaa wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn sona moabubu konnua biara.
english:
“Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen:
to loose the chains of injustice
    and untie the cords of the yoke,
to set the oppressed free
    and break every yoke?

twi: So ɛnsɛ sɛ mo ne wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn kyɛ mo aduanna moma ohiani a ɔnenam no baabi tena;na muhu nea ɔda adagyaw a mumfura no ntamana munnyi mo ani mfi mo ankasa mo nkurɔfo ne mo abusuafo so ana?
english:
Is it not to share your food with the hungry
    and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter—
when you see the naked, to clothe them,
    and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?

twi: Ɛno na mo hann bepue te sɛ ahemadakye,na mo ayaresa aba ntɛm so;afei mo trenee bedi mo anim,na Awurade anuonyam bɛbɔ mo kyidɔm.
english:
Then your light will break forth like the dawn,
    and your healing will quickly appear;
then your righteousness will go before you,
    and the glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.

twi: Afei mobɛfrɛ, na Awurade begye mo so;mobɛteɛ mu ahwehwɛ mmoa, na ɔbɛka se: Mini.“Sɛ muyi nhyɛso konnua,nsa a moteɛ wɔ nnipa so ne ntwatoso fi hɔ,
english:
Then you will call, and the Lord will answer;
    you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I.
“If you do away with the yoke of oppression,
    with the pointing finger and malicious talk,

twi: na sɛ mohaw mo ho ma wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔnna moma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no nea ehia wɔn a,ɛno de, mo akanea bɛhyerɛn wɔ sum mu,na mo anadwo bɛyɛ sɛ owigyinae.
english:
and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry
    and satisfy the needs of the oppressed,
then your light will rise in the darkness,
    and your night will become like the noonday.

twi: Awurade bɛkyerɛ mo kwan bere biara;ɔbɛma mo nea ehia mo wɔ asase wosee sona ɔbɛhyɛ mo nipadua den.Mobɛyɛ sɛ turo a wogugu so nsu yiye,sɛ asuwa a mu nsu nyow da.
english:
The Lord will guide you always;
    he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land
    and will strengthen your frame.
You will be like a well-watered garden,
    like a spring whose waters never fail.

twi: Mo nkurɔfo bɛsan asi teteete nnwiriwii no,na wɔato fapem a akyɛ no;wɔbɛfrɛ mo Nea Osiesie Afasu a Abubu no,Nea Ogye Atenae Si Hɔ.
english:
Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins
    and will raise up the age-old foundations;
you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls,
    Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.

twi: “Sɛ mohwɛ mo anammɔntu so yiye Homedana moanyɛ nea mopɛ wɔ me da kronkron no,sɛ mofrɛ Homeda no anigye dana mudi Awurade da kronkron no nina moamfa mo ara mo akwan sona moanyɛ nea mopɛ anaa moanka nsɛnhunu a,
english:
“If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath
    and from doing as you please on my holy day,
if you call the Sabbath a delight
    and the Lord’s holy day honorable,
and if you honor it by not going your own way
    and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

twi: ɛno de mubenya anigye wɔ Awurade muna mɛma mo anantew asase no sorɔnsorɔmmea sona moato pon wɔ mo agya Yakob agyapade so.”Awurade na waka.
english:
then you will find your joy in the Lord,
    and I will cause you to ride in triumph on the heights of the land
    and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob.”
For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.

twi: Bɔne, Bɔneka Ne OgyeAmpa ara Awurade nsa nyɛ tiaa sɛ ɛrennye nkwa,na nʼasom nyɛ den sɛ ɛrente asɛm.
english:
Surely the arm of the Lord is not too short to save,
    nor his ear too dull to hear.

twi: Nanso mo amumɔyɛ na atetewmo ne mo Nyankopɔn ntam;mo bɔne ama nʼanim ahintaw mo,a enti ɔrente.
english:
But your iniquities have separated
    you from your God;
your sins have hidden his face from you,
    so that he will not hear.

twi: Na mogya akeka mo nsa ho,afɔdi asra mo nsateaa ho.Mo ano akeka atosɛm,mo tɛkrɛma de amumɔyɛsɛm di nseku.
english:
For your hands are stained with blood,
    your fingers with guilt.
Your lips have spoken falsely,
    and your tongue mutters wicked things.

twi: Obiara nhwehwɛ atɛntrenee;obiara mfa nokwaredi mmɔ ne nkurow.Wɔde wɔn ho to nsɛnhuhuw so na wotwa nkontompo;wonyinsɛn ɔhaw na wɔwo bɔne.
Wosow nhurutoa nkesuana wɔnwen ananse ntontan.Nea odi wɔn nkesua biara bewu,mu baako nso bɔ a, ɛpae ahurutoa.
english:
They hatch the eggs of vipers
    and spin a spider’s web.
Whoever eats their eggs will die,
    and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.

twi: Wɔn ntontan nye mma adurade;wɔrentumi mfa nea wɔyɛ nkata wɔn ho.Wɔn nneyɛe yɛ nneyɛe bɔne,na wodi akakabensɛm.
english:
Their cobwebs are useless for clothing;
    they cannot cover themselves with what they make.
Their deeds are evil deeds,
    and acts of violence are in their hands.

twi: Wotu mmirika kɔyɛ bɔne;wɔnkyɛ opira ne awudi ho.Baabiara a wɔbɛkɔ no, wɔsɛe hɔ pasaa.
Asomdwoe kwan no, wonnim;atɛntrenee nni wɔn akwan so.Wɔadan wɔn akwan kɔntɔnkyeobiara a ɔnantew so no rennya asomdwoe.
Enti atɛntrenee ne yɛn ntam aware,na adetrenee mmɛn yɛn.Yɛhwehwɛ hann, nanso ne nyinaa yɛ sum;nea ɛhyerɛn, nanso yɛnam sum kabii mu.
english:
So justice is far from us,
    and righteousness does not reach us.
We look for light, but all is darkness;
    for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.

twi: Te sɛ anifuraefo no, yɛkeka wɔ afasu hohwehwɛ ɔkwan te sɛ nnipa a wonni ani.Owigyinae no yehintihintiw sɛnea onwini adwo;yedu ahoɔdenfo mu a yɛte sɛ awufo.
english:
Like the blind we grope along the wall,
    feeling our way like people without eyes.
At midday we stumble as if it were twilight;
    among the strong, we are like the dead.

twi: Yɛn nyinaa woro so te sɛ sisi;yɛde awerɛhow kurum sɛ mmorɔnoma.Yɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee nso yenhu bi;ogye, nanso ɛwɔ akyirikyiri.
Efisɛ, yɛn mfomso adɔɔso wɔ wʼani so,na yɛn bɔne di adanse tia yɛn.Yɛn mfomso da yɛn anim daa,na yegye yɛn amumɔyɛ to mu:
english:
For our offenses are many in your sight,
    and our sins testify against us.
Our offenses are ever with us,
    and we acknowledge our iniquities:

twi: atuatew ne nkontompo a etia Awurade,yɛn akyi a yɛdan kyerɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn,nhyɛso ne atuatew a yɛfoa so,atosɛm a efi koma mu a yɛka.
english:
rebellion and treachery against the Lord,
    turning our backs on our God,
inciting revolt and oppression,
    uttering lies our hearts have conceived.

twi: Enti wɔapam atɛntrenee kɔ nʼakyi,na adetrenee akogyina baabi;nokware ahwe ase wɔ mmɔnten sonokwaredi ntumi mma mu.
english:
So justice is driven back,
    and righteousness stands at a distance;
truth has stumbled in the streets,
    honesty cannot enter.

twi: Nokware nni baabiara,obiara a ɔtwe ne ho fi bɔne ho no bɛyɛ ɔtamfo.Awurade hwɛe na ansɔ nʼanisɛ atɛntrenee nni hɔ.
english:
Truth is nowhere to be found,
    and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey.
The Lord looked and was displeased
    that there was no justice.

twi: Ohuu sɛ obiara nni hɔ,ɛyɛɛ no nwonwa sɛ obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata;enti ɔno ankasa basa dii nkwagye ho dwuma maa no,na ne trenee wowaw no.
english:
He saw that there was no one,
    he was appalled that there was no one to intervene;
so his own arm achieved salvation for him,
    and his own righteousness sustained him.

twi: Ɔhyɛɛ trenee sɛ nkatabo,ne nkwagye dadekyɛw wɔ ne ti so.Ɔhyɛɛ aweretɔ ntadena ofuraa mmɔdemmɔ sɛ ntama.
english:
He put on righteousness as his breastplate,
    and the helmet of salvation on his head;
he put on the garments of vengeance
    and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

twi: Obegyina nea wɔayɛ soatua so kanʼatamfo benya nʼabufuwhyewwɔn a wɔne no ayɛ dɔm benya so akatua;nsupɔw no nso obetua wɔn ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.
english:
According to what they have done,
    so will he repay
wrath to his enemies
    and retribution to his foes;
    he will repay the islands their due.

twi: Efi atɔe fam, nnipa besuro Awurade dinna efi apuei, wɔde nidi bɛma nʼanuonyam.Na ɔbɛba sɛ asu a ayiri tɛnnna Awurade ahomegu repia no.
english:
From the west, people will fear the name of the Lord,
    and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory.
For he will come like a pent-up flood
    that the breath of the Lord drives along.

twi: “Ogyefo no bɛba Sion,na obeyi amumɔyɛsɛm nyinaa afi Yakob asefo mu,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.
english:
“The Redeemer will come to Zion,
    to those in Jacob who repent of their sins,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Me de, eyi yɛ me ne wɔn apam,” sɛnea Awurade se ni. “Me Honhom a ɔwɔ mo so, ne me nsɛm a mede ahyɛ mo anom, remfi mo anom, anaa mo mma, ne mo mma asefo anom, efi saa bere yi kosi daa apem,” sɛɛ na Awurade se.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the Lord. “My Spirit, who is on you, will not depart from you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will always be on your lips, on the lips of your children and on the lips of their descendants—from this time on and forever,” says the Lord.

twi: Sion Anuonyam“Sɔre, hyerɛn, na wo hann aba,na Awurade anuonyam apue wo so.
english:
“Arise, shine, for your light has come,
    and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.

twi: Hwɛ, sum akata asase sona sum kabii akata aman no so,nanso Awurade apue wo sona nʼanuonyam ada adi wɔ wo so.
english:
See, darkness covers the earth
    and thick darkness is over the peoples,
but the Lord rises upon you
    and his glory appears over you.

twi: Amanaman bɛba wo hann no mu,na Ahemfo bɛba wo adekyee hann no mu.
english:
Nations will come to your light,
    and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

twi: “Ma wʼani so na hwɛ wo ho hyia:wɔn nyinaa aboa wɔn ho ano reba wo nkyɛn;wo mmabarima fifi akyirikyiri,na wokura wo mmabea wɔ abasa so.
english:
“Lift up your eyes and look about you:
    All assemble and come to you;
your sons come from afar,
    and your daughters are carried on the hip.

twi: Afei wobɛhwɛ na wʼanim atew,wo koma bɛbɔ na anigye ahyɛ no ma;ahonya a ɛwɔ po so, wɔde bɛbrɛ wo,na amanaman no ahode nso bɛba wo nkyɛn.
english:
Then you will look and be radiant,
    your heart will throb and swell with joy;
the wealth on the seas will be brought to you,
    to you the riches of the nations will come.

twi: Yoma akuwakuw bɛyɛ wʼasase so ma,yomaforo a wufi Midian ne Efa.Na wɔn a wofi Seba nyinaa bɛba,wɔsoso sika kɔkɔɔ ne nnuhuamna wɔpae mu ka Awurade ayeyi.
english:
Herds of camels will cover your land,
    young camels of Midian and Ephah.
And all from Sheba will come,
    bearing gold and incense
    and proclaiming the praise of the Lord.

twi: Wɔbɛboaboa Kedar nguankuw nyinaa ano abrɛ wo,Nebaiot adwennini bɛsom wo;wobegye wɔn sɛ afɔrebɔde wɔ mʼafɔremuka so,na mɛhyɛ mʼasɔredan kronkron no anuonyam.
english:
All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you,
    the rams of Nebaioth will serve you;
they will be accepted as offerings on my altar,
    and I will adorn my glorious temple.

twi: “Henanom ne eyinom a wotu sɛ omununkum,te sɛ mmorɔnoma a wɔrekɔ wɔn berebuw mu yi?
english:
“Who are these that fly along like clouds,
    like doves to their nests?

twi: Ampa ara asupɔw no ani da me so;Tarsis ahyɛn na wodi anim,wɔde wo mmabarima fifi akyirikyiri reba,wɔsoso wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sikakɔkɔɔ,de rebɛhyɛ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn anuonyam,Israel Kronkronni No,efisɛ wahyɛ wo anuonyam.
english:
Surely the islands look to me;
    in the lead are the ships of Tarshish,
bringing your children from afar,
    with their silver and gold,
to the honor of the Lord your God,
    the Holy One of Israel,
    for he has endowed you with splendor.

twi: “Ananafo bɛto wʼafasu no bio,na wɔn ahemfo bɛsom wo.Ɛwɔ mu, mede abufuw asɛe wo de,nanso menam adom so behu wo mmɔbɔ.
english:
“Foreigners will rebuild your walls,
    and their kings will serve you.
Though in anger I struck you,
    in favor I will show you compassion.

twi: Wo apon ano bɛdeda hɔ bere biara,wɔrentoto mu awia anaa anadwo,sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nkurɔfo de amanaman no ahonya bɛbrɛ wo,wɔn ahemfo dii nkonimdi santen no anim.
english:
Your gates will always stand open,
    they will never be shut, day or night,
so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations—
    their kings led in triumphal procession.

twi: Na ɔman anaa ahenni a wɔrensom wo no bɛyera,wɔbɛsɛe no pasaa.
english:
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish;
    it will be utterly ruined.

twi: “Lebanon anuonyam bɛba wo nkyɛn,ɔpepaw, ɔsɛsɛ ne kwabɔhɔre bɛbɔ mu,abesiesie me kronkronbea hɔ;na mɛhyɛ beae a me nan sisi no anuonyam.
english:
“The glory of Lebanon will come to you,
    the juniper, the fir and the cypress together,
to adorn my sanctuary;
    and I will glorify the place for my feet.

twi: Wo nhyɛsofo mmabarima bɛba abɛkotow wo;wɔn a wobu wo animtiaa nyinaa bɛkotow wʼanan asena wɔbɛfrɛ wo Awurade Kuropɔn,Israel Kronkronni, Sion.
english:
The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you;
    all who despise you will bow down at your feet
and will call you the City of the Lord,
    Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

twi: “Ɛwɔ mu, wɔapa wʼakyi atan wo,a obiara ntu kwan mfa wo mu,nanso mɛyɛ wo ahohoahoade a ɛte hɔ daane awo ntoatoaso nyinaa anigyede.
english:
“Although you have been forsaken and hated,
    with no one traveling through,
I will make you the everlasting pride
    and the joy of all generations.

twi: Wobɛnom amanaman nufusu nona woanum adehye nufu.Afei wubehu sɛ me Awurade, me ne wo Agyenkwa,wo gyefo, Yakob Tumfo no.
english:
You will drink the milk of nations
    and be nursed at royal breasts.
Then you will know that I, the Lord, am your Savior,
    your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

twi: Mede sikakɔkɔɔ besi kɔbere anan mu abrɛ wo,na dwetɛ asi dade anan mu.Mede kɔbere besi dua anan mu abrɛ wo,na dade asi abo anan mu.Mede asomdwoe bɛyɛ wo so amradona trenee ayɛ wo sodifo.
english:
Instead of bronze I will bring you gold,
    and silver in place of iron.
Instead of wood I will bring you bronze,
    and iron in place of stones.
I will make peace your governor
    and well-being your ruler.

twi: Wɔrente awurukasɛm wɔ wʼasase so bio,anaa nnwiriwii ne ɔsɛe wɔ wʼahye sommom wobɛfrɛ wʼafasu se Nkwagyene wʼapon se Ayeyi.
english:
No longer will violence be heard in your land,
    nor ruin or destruction within your borders,
but you will call your walls Salvation
    and your gates Praise.

twi: Owia renyɛ wo hann adekyee mu biona ɔsram hann renhyerɛn wo so,efisɛ Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,na wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ wo anuonyam.
english:
The sun will no more be your light by day,
    nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you,
for the Lord will be your everlasting light,
    and your God will be your glory.

twi: Wo wia rentɔ bio,wo sram rennum bio,Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,na wʼawerɛhownna to betwa.
english:
Your sun will never set again,
    and your moon will wane no more;
the Lord will be your everlasting light,
    and your days of sorrow will end.

twi: Na afei wo nkurɔfo nyinaa bɛyɛ atreneefona wɔbɛfa asase no adi so afebɔɔ.Wɔyɛ ade a madua na afefɛwme nsa ano adwuma aɛbɛda mʼanuonyam adi.
english:
Then all your people will be righteous
    and they will possess the land forever.
They are the shoot I have planted,
    the work of my hands,
    for the display of my splendor.

twi: Mo mu akumaa koraa bɛdɔ ayɛ apem,na aketewa no ayɛ ɔman kɛse.Mene Awurade;na ne bere mu, mɛyɛ eyi ntɛm so.”
english:
The least of you will become a thousand,
    the smallest a mighty nation.
I am the Lord;
    in its time I will do this swiftly.”

twi: Awurade Adom AfeOtumfo Awurade Honhom wɔ me so,efisɛ, wɔafrɛ mesɛ memmɛka asɛmpa nkyerɛ ahiafo.Wasoma me se, menkɔkyekye wɔn a wɔn koma abubu werɛ,se mempae mu nka ahofadi nkyerɛ nnommumna wonyi nneduafo mfi sum mu,
english:
The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me,
    because the Lord has anointed me
    to proclaim good news to the poor.
He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted,
    to proclaim freedom for the captives
    and release from darkness for the prisoners,

twi: se mempae mu nka Awurade adom no ho asɛm,ne yɛn Nyankopɔn aweretɔ da.Wasoma me se, menkyekye wɔn a wodi awerɛhow nyinaa werɛ,
english:
to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor
    and the day of vengeance of our God,
to comfort all who mourn,

twi: na memma wɔn a wodi awerɛhow wɔ Sion no nea wohia,na menhyɛ wɔn ahenkyɛw fɛfɛnsi nsõ anan mu,anigye ngonsi awerɛhowdi anan mu,ayeyi atadensi abasamtu honhom anan mu.Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn trenee adumnea Awurade aduade ada nʼanuonyam adi.
english:
and provide for those who grieve in Zion—
to bestow on them a crown of beauty
    instead of ashes,
the oil of joy
    instead of mourning,
and a garment of praise
    instead of a spirit of despair.
They will be called oaks of righteousness,
    a planting of the Lord
    for the display of his splendor.

twi: Wobesi tete mmubui no bio,na wɔasiesie mmeaemmeae a asɛe dedaada no;wɔbɛyɛ nkuropɔn a asɛe no foforonea asɛe awo ntoatoaso bebree no.
english:
They will rebuild the ancient ruins
    and restore the places long devastated;
they will renew the ruined cities
    that have been devastated for generations.

twi: Ananafo bɛhwɛ mo nguankuw;ahɔho bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mo mfuw ne bobeturo mu.
english:
Strangers will shepherd your flocks;
    foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.

twi: Na wɔbɛfrɛ mo Awurade asɔfo,wɔbɛto mo din sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn asomfo.Amanaman no ahonya no na mubedina wɔn ahode na mode bɛhoahoa mo ho.
english:
And you will be called priests of the Lord,
    you will be named ministers of our God.
You will feed on the wealth of nations,
    and in their riches you will boast.

twi: Wɔn animguase anan mume nkurɔfo benya anuonyam mmɔho,na ahohora anan muwɔbɛsɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ wɔn adedi mu;ne saa nti wɔn asase no so kyɛfa bɛyɛ mmɔho,na anigye a enni awiei bɛyɛ wɔn dea.
english:
Instead of your shame
    you will receive a double portion,
and instead of disgrace
    you will rejoice in your inheritance.
And so you will inherit a double portion in your land,
    and everlasting joy will be yours.

twi: “Na me Awurade, mepɛ atɛntrenee.Mikyi korɔn ne nnebɔne.Me nokware mu, mɛbɔ wɔn aba sona me ne wɔn ayɛ apam a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.
english:
“For I, the Lord, love justice;
    I hate robbery and wrongdoing.
In my faithfulness I will reward my people
    and make an everlasting covenant with them.

twi: Wɔn asefo begye din wɔ amanaman no mune wɔn mma wɔ nkurɔfo no mu.Wɔn a wohu wɔn nyinaa begye ato mu sɛwɔyɛ nnipa a Awurade ahyira wɔn.”
english:
Their descendants will be known among the nations
    and their offspring among the peoples.
All who see them will acknowledge
    that they are a people the Lord has blessed.”

twi: Awurade mu na me ho sɛpɛw me mmoroso,me Nyankopɔn mu na me kra di ahurusi.Efisɛ, ɔde nkwagye ntama afura mena ɔde trenee atade yuu awura me,sɛnea ayeforokunu siesie me ti so sɛ ɔsɔfo,ne sɛnea ayeforo de nnwinne hyehyɛ ne ho no.
english:
I delight greatly in the Lord;
    my soul rejoices in my God.
For he has clothed me with garments of salvation
    and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness,
as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest,
    and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

twi: Na sɛnea asase ma afifide puena turo nso ma aba nyin no,saa ara na Otumfo Awurade bɛma trenee ne ayeyiapue wɔ amanaman anim.
english:
For as the soil makes the sprout come up
    and a garden causes seeds to grow,
so the Sovereign Lord will make righteousness
    and praise spring up before all nations.

twi: Sion Din FoforoSion nti, merenyɛ komm,Yerusalem nti, merenyɛ dinn,kosi sɛ ne trenee bɛhyerɛn sɛ adekyee,na ne nkwagye adɛw sɛ ogyatɛn.
english:
For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent,
    for Jerusalem’s sake I will not remain quiet,
till her vindication shines out like the dawn,
    her salvation like a blazing torch.

twi: Amanaman no behu wo trenee,na ahemfo nyinaa ahu wʼanuonyam;wɔbɛfrɛ wo din foforoa Awurade de bɛto wo no.
english:
The nations will see your vindication,
    and all kings your glory;
you will be called by a new name
    that the mouth of the Lord will bestow.

twi: Wobɛyɛ anuonyam ahenkyɛw wɔ Awurade nsam,ne adehye anuonyam abotiri wɔ wo Nyankopɔn nsam.
english:
You will be a crown of splendor in the Lord’s hand,
    a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

twi: Wɔremfrɛ wo amamfo bio,anaa wʼasase sɛ amamfo.Na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Hefsiba anaa anisɔ Kuropɔnne wʼasase sɛ Beula anaa ɔwarefoefisɛ Awurade ani begye wo ho,na ɔbɛware wʼasase.
Sɛnea aberante ware ababaa no,saa ara na wo mmabarima bɛware wo;sɛ ayeforokunu ani gye nʼayeforo ho no,saa ara na wo Nyankopɔn ani begye wo ho.
english:
As a young man marries a young woman,
    so will your Builder marry you;
as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride,
    so will your God rejoice over you.

twi: Mede awɛmfo agyinagyina wʼafasu so, Yerusalem;wɔremmua wɔn ano awia anaa anadwo.Mo a musu frɛ Awurade no,monnhome koraa,
english:
I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem;
    they will never be silent day or night.
You who call on the Lord,
    give yourselves no rest,

twi: na mommma onnye nʼahome kosi sɛ, ɔbɛma Yerusalem atimna wayɛ no nea asase nyinaa bɛkamfo.
english:
and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem
    and makes her the praise of the earth.

twi: Awurade de ne basa nifa aka ntamne basa a ɛyɛ den no se,“Meremfa mo awimma mo atamfo sɛ wɔn aduan bio,na ananafo rennom nsa foforoa moabrɛ ho no bio;
english:
The Lord has sworn by his right hand
    and by his mighty arm:
“Never again will I give your grain
    as food for your enemies,
and never again will foreigners drink the new wine
    for which you have toiled;

twi: wɔn a wotwa no na wobedina wɔakamfo Awurade,na wɔn a wɔboaboa bobe ano no bɛnomwɔ me kronkronbea adiwo.”
english:
but those who harvest it will eat it
    and praise the Lord,
and those who gather the grapes will drink it
    in the courts of my sanctuary.”

twi: Momfa mu, momfa kuropɔn apon no mu!Munsiesie ɔkwan no mma nkurɔfo no.Mompae, mompae ɔtempɔn no!Munyiyi so abo no.Munsi frankaa mma amanaman no.
english:
Pass through, pass through the gates!
    Prepare the way for the people.
Build up, build up the highway!
    Remove the stones.
Raise a banner for the nations.

twi: Awurade abɔ no dawuruakosi nsase ano se,“Monka nkyerɛ Ɔbabea Sion se,‘Hwɛ, wo Agyenkwa reba!Hwɛ nʼakatua ka ne ho,na nʼanamuhyɛde nso ka ne ho.’ ”
english:
The Lord has made proclamation
    to the ends of the earth:
“Say to Daughter Zion,
    ‘See, your Savior comes!
See, his reward is with him,
    and his recompense accompanies him.’”

twi: Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn Nnipa Kronkron,wɔn a Awurade Agye Wɔn;na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Nea Wɔrehwehwɛ Nʼakyi Kwan,Kuropɔn a Ɛrenyɛ Amamfo Bio.
english:
They will be called the Holy People,
    the Redeemed of the Lord;
and you will be called Sought After,
    the City No Longer Deserted.

twi: Onyankopɔn Aweretɔ Ne Ogye Da NoHena ne oyi a ofi Edom reba,nea ofi Bosra a nkekae kɔkɔɔ wɔ nʼatade mu yi?Hena ne oyi a wɔahyehyɛ no kɔsɔɔ yi,a ɔde nʼahoɔden kɛse retutu taataa yi?“Ɛyɛ me a, mekasa wɔ trenee mu,nea otumi gye nkwa no.”
english:
Who is this coming from Edom,
    from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson?
Who is this, robed in splendor,
    striding forward in the greatness of his strength?
“It is I, proclaiming victory,
    mighty to save.”

twi: Adɛn nti na mo ntade bere kɔɔ,te sɛ obi a ɔretiatia nsakyiamoa so de yi?
english:
Why are your garments red,
    like those of one treading the winepress?

twi: “Me nko ara atiatia nsakyiamoa so,na amanaman no mu obiara anka me ho.Mitiatia wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuw muna mimiaa wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuwhyew mu;wɔn mogya bɔ petee me ntade mu,maa nkekae yɛɛ mʼadurade nyinaa mu.
Na aweretɔda wɔ me koma muna me gye afe aba.
english:
It was for me the day of vengeance;
    the year for me to redeem had come.

twi: Mehwɛe, nanso na ɔboafo biara nni hɔ,ɛyɛɛ me ahodwiriw sɛ obiara anso me mu;enti mʼankasa abasa yɛɛ nkwagyedwuma maa me,na mʼabufuw wowaw me.
english:
I looked, but there was no one to help,
    I was appalled that no one gave support;
so my own arm achieved salvation for me,
    and my own wrath sustained me.

twi: Mitiatiaa amanaman no so wɔ mʼabufuw mu;mema wɔbobowee wɔ mʼabufuwhyew muna mihwiee wɔn mogya guu fam.”

Ayeyi Ne MpaebɔMɛka Awurade ayamye ho asɛm,ne nneyɛe a enti ɔsɛ ayeyi,wɔ nea Awurade ayɛ ama yɛn nyinaa hoYiw, wɔ nneɛma pa bebree a wayɛama Israelfifo.Wɔ nʼayamhyehye ne ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso no nti.
english:
I will tell of the kindnesses of the Lord,
    the deeds for which he is to be praised,
    according to all the Lord has done for us—
yes, the many good things
    he has done for Israel,
    according to his compassion and many kindnesses.

twi: Ɔkae se, “Ampa ara wɔyɛ me nkurɔfo,mmabarima a wɔrenni me huammɔ;”ɛno nti ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn Agyenkwa.
Wɔn amanehunu nyinaa mu, ɔno nso huu amane,na ɔbɔfo a ɔka ne ho no nso gyee wɔn.Ne dɔ ne ne mmɔborɔhunu mu, ogyee wɔn;ɔmaa wɔn so na ɔsoaa wɔnmfe a atwa mu no nyinaa mu.
english:
In all their distress he too was distressed,
    and the angel of his presence saved them.
In his love and mercy he redeemed them;
    he lifted them up and carried them
    all the days of old.

twi: Nanso wɔtew atuade how ne Honhom Kronkron werɛ.Enti ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn tamfona ɔno ankasa ko tiaa wɔn.
english:
Yet they rebelled
    and grieved his Holy Spirit.
So he turned and became their enemy
    and he himself fought against them.

twi: Afei ne nkurɔfo kae tete nna no,Mose ne ne nkurɔfo nna no.Ɛhe na nea ɔde wɔn faa po mu no wɔ?Ɔne ne nguan no hwɛfo no?Ɛhe na nea ɔmaa ne Honhom Kronkron notenaa wɔn mu no wɔ,
english:
Then his people recalled the days of old,
    the days of Moses and his people—
where is he who brought them through the sea,
    with the shepherd of his flock?
Where is he who set
    his Holy Spirit among them,

twi: nea ɔsomaa nʼanuonyam basa a ɛwɔ tumisɛ ommegyina Mose nsa nifa so no,nea ɔpaee asu no mu wɔ wɔn anim,de gyee din maa ne ho afebɔɔ no,
english:
who sent his glorious arm of power
    to be at Moses’ right hand,
who divided the waters before them,
    to gain for himself everlasting renown,

twi: nea odii wɔn anim faa bun musɛnea ɔpɔnkɔ fa asase tamaa so,wɔanhintiw;
te sɛ anantwi a wɔkɔ sare so,Awurade Honhom ma wɔhomee.Sɛnea wokyerɛɛ wo nkurɔfo kwande gyee anuonyam abodin maa wo ho ni.
english:
like cattle that go down to the plain,
    they were given rest by the Spirit of the Lord.
This is how you guided your people
    to make for yourself a glorious name.

twi: Brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ famfi wʼahengua a ɛkorɔn, ɛyɛ kronkron na ho wɔ nyam no so.Mo mmɔdemmɔ ne mo ahoɔden wɔ he?Wɔayi wʼayamhyehye ne wʼahummɔbɔ afi yɛn so.
english:
Look down from heaven and see,
    from your lofty throne, holy and glorious.
Where are your zeal and your might?
    Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.

twi: Nanso wo ara wo ne yɛn Agyaɛwɔ mu, Abraham nnim yɛnna Israel nso nnye yɛn nto mu de;nanso wo, Awurade, wo ne yɛn Agya;efi tete, wo din ne; Yɛn Gyefo.
english:
But you are our Father,
    though Abraham does not know us
    or Israel acknowledge us;
you, Lord, are our Father,
    our Redeemer from of old is your name.

twi: Adɛn, Awurade, na woma yɛkwati wʼakwanna wupirim yɛn koma enti ɛmma yenni wo ni?San bra, esiane wʼasomfo,mmusuakuw a wɔyɛ wʼagyapade no nti.
english:
Why, Lord, do you make us wander from your ways
    and harden our hearts so we do not revere you?
Return for the sake of your servants,
    the tribes that are your inheritance.

twi: Bere tiaa bi mu wo nkurɔfo faa wo kronkronbeananso mprempren yɛn atamfo atiatia so.
english:
For a little while your people possessed your holy place,
    but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.

twi: Enti yɛyɛ wo de fi tete,nanso wɔn de, wunnii wɔn so henena wɔmmɔɔ wo din mfrɛɛ wɔn da.
Ao, sɛ anka wubesunsuane ɔsorosoro mu, asian aba fam a,ɛno na anka mmepɔw no ho bɛpopo wɔ wʼanim!
english:
Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down,
    that the mountains would tremble before you!

twi: Sɛnea ogya ma mmabaa dɛwna ɛma nsu huru no,sian bra fam na ma wʼatamfo nhu wo din,na ma amanaman no ho mpopo wɔ wʼanim!
english:
As when fire sets twigs ablaze
    and causes water to boil,
come down to make your name known to your enemies
    and cause the nations to quake before you!

twi: Na bere a woyɛɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa a yɛanhwɛ anim no,wusian baa fam na mmepɔw no ho popoo wɔ wʼanim.
english:
For when you did awesome things that we did not expect,
    you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.

twi: Efi teteete obiara ntee,entwaa obiara aso mu,ani biara nhuu Onyankopɔn bi sɛ wo,nea odi dwuma ma wɔn a wɔtwɛn no no.
english:
Since ancient times no one has heard,
    no ear has perceived,
no eye has seen any God besides you,
    who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.

twi: Woboa wɔn a wɔde anigye yɛ nea ɛteɛ,wɔn a wɔkae wʼakwan.Nanso yɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa wɔn no,wo bo fuwii.Na afei ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woagye yɛn nkwa?
english:
You come to the help of those who gladly do right,
    who remember your ways.
But when we continued to sin against them,
    you were angry.
    How then can we be saved?

twi: Yɛn nyinaa ayɛ sɛ obi a ne ho ntew,na yɛn trenee nneyɛe nyinaa te sɛ ntamagow fi;yɛn nyinaa akisa te sɛ ahaban,na yɛn bɔne pra yɛn kɔ te sɛ mframa.
english:
All of us have become like one who is unclean,
    and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags;
we all shrivel up like a leaf,
    and like the wind our sins sweep us away.

twi: Obiara mmɔ wo din,na obiara mpere sɛ obeso wo mu;efisɛ wode wʼanim ahintaw yɛnna yɛn bɔne nti woama yɛasɛe.
english:
No one calls on your name
    or strives to lay hold of you;
for you have hidden your face from us
    and have given us over to our sins.

twi: Nanso wo, Awurade, ne yɛn Agya.Yɛyɛ dɔte, na wo ne ɔnwemfo no;yɛn nyinaa yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.
Mma wo bo mfuw ntra so, Awurade;nkae yɛn bɔne da biara da.Ao, brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ yɛn, yɛsrɛ wo,efisɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛ wo nkurɔfo.
english:
Do not be angry beyond measure, Lord;
    do not remember our sins forever.
Oh, look on us, we pray,
    for we are all your people.

twi: Wo nkuropɔn kronkron no adan nweatam;Sion mpo ayɛ nweatam, Yerusalem ada mpan.
english:
Your sacred cities have become a wasteland;
    even Zion is a wasteland, Jerusalem a desolation.

twi: Yɛn asɔredan kronkron a ɛwɔ anuonyam, faako a yɛn nenanom yii wo ayɛ no,wɔde ogya ahyew,na nea ɛsom bo ma yɛn no, abubu.
english:
Our holy and glorious temple, where our ancestors praised you,
    has been burned with fire,
    and all that we treasured lies in ruins.

twi: Eyi nyinaa akyi, Awurade, wode wo ho bɛkame yɛn ana?Wobɛkɔ so ayɛ komm atwe yɛn aso aboro so ana?
english:
After all this, Lord, will you hold yourself back?
    Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?

twi: Atemmu Ne Nkwagye“Medaa me ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔammisa mʼase;wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛ me no huu me.Ɔman a wonsu mfrɛ me no,meka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, ‘Mini, Mini.’
english:
“I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me;
    I was found by those who did not seek me.
To a nation that did not call on my name,
    I said, ‘Here am I, here am I.’

twi: Da mu nyinaa, matrɛw me nsa mu amannipa a wɔyɛ asoɔden ne nyiyiano,a wɔnenam akwammɔne so,na wodi wɔn ankasa nsusuwii akyi.
english:
All day long I have held out my hands
    to an obstinate people,
who walk in ways not good,
    pursuing their own imaginations—

twi: Nnipa a daa no woyi me ahiwɔ mʼanim pɛɛ,wɔbɔ afɔre wɔ nturo muna wɔhyew nnuhuam wɔ ntayaa afɔremuka so;
english:
a people who continually provoke me
    to my very face,
offering sacrifices in gardens
    and burning incense on altars of brick;

twi: wɔn a wɔtenatena nna sona anadwo wosii pɛ kokoa mu;wɔwe mprakonamna wɔn nkutu mu wɔ nkwan a wɔde nam a ɛho ntew ayɛ;
wɔka se, ‘Mumfi ha; mommmɛn me,efisɛ me ho tew dodo ma mo!’Saa nnipa yi yɛ wusiw wɔ me hwenem,ogya a ɛkɔ so hyew da mu nyinaa.
english:
who say, ‘Keep away; don’t come near me,
    for I am too sacred for you!’
Such people are smoke in my nostrils,
    a fire that keeps burning all day.

twi: “Hwɛ; wɔakyerɛw ato hɔ wɔ mʼanim se,merenyɛ komm, metua so ka pɛpɛɛpɛ;metua so ka agu wɔn asrɛ so,
mo ne mo agyanom bɔne nti,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.“Esiane sɛ wɔhyew afɔrebɔde wɔ mmepɔw sona wotwirii me wɔ nkoko so ntimesusuw bɔne a wɔyɛɛ kan no so akatua pɛpɛɛpɛagu wɔn asrɛ so.”
english:
both your sins and the sins of your ancestors,”
    says the Lord.
“Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains
    and defied me on the hills,
I will measure into their laps
    the full payment for their former deeds.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Sɛnea wonya nsu fi bobe kasiaw mu,na nnipa ka se, ‘Monnsɛe no,efisɛ ade pa bi da so wɔ mu’ nosaa ara na mʼasomfo no nti mɛyɛ.Merensɛe wɔn nyinaa.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes
    and people say, ‘Don’t destroy it,
    there is still a blessing in it,’
so will I do in behalf of my servants;
    I will not destroy them all.

twi: Mede Yakob asefo bɛba,na me mmepɔw no sodifo afi Yuda aba;me nkurɔfo a mapaw wɔn no bedi wɔn ade,na hɔ na mʼasomfo bɛtena.
english:
I will bring forth descendants from Jacob,
    and from Judah those who will possess my mountains;
my chosen people will inherit them,
    and there will my servants live.

twi: Saron bɛyɛ nguankuw adidibea,na Akor bon no ayɛ anantwikuw homebeaama me nkurɔfo a wɔhwehwɛ me.
english:
Sharon will become a pasture for flocks,
    and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds,
    for my people who seek me.

twi: “Na mo a mo de mugyaw Awuradena mo werɛ fi ne bepɔw kronkron no,mo a moto pon ma Ahonyana mohyɛ afrasa wɔ nkuruwa mu ma Nkrabea no,
english:
“But as for you who forsake the Lord
    and forget my holy mountain,
who spread a table for Fortune
    and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,

twi: mede mo bɛto afoa ano,na mo nyinaa akotow ama wɔakum mo;efisɛ mefrɛe nanso moannye so,mekasae nanso moantie.Moyɛɛ nea ɛyɛ mʼani so bɔnena moyɛɛ nea mempɛ.”
Enti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“Mʼasomfo bedidi,nanso ɔkɔm bɛde mo,mʼasomfo bɛnom,nanso osukɔm bɛde mo;mʼasomfo ani begye,nanso mo anim begu ase.
english:
Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says:
“My servants will eat,
    but you will go hungry;
my servants will drink,
    but you will go thirsty;
my servants will rejoice,
    but you will be put to shame.

twi: Mʼasomfo bɛto nnwomafi koma mu anigye muna mobɛteɛ mu asuafi mo koma ahoyeraw mu,na mubetwa adwo afi honhom a ayɛ mmrɛw mu.
english:
My servants will sing
    out of the joy of their hearts,
but you will cry out
    from anguish of heart
