twi: Mede awɛmfo sisii mo so na mekae se,‘Muntie torobɛnto nnyigyei no!’Nanso mokae se, ‘Yɛrentie.’
english:
I appointed watchmen over you and said,
    ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’
    But you said, ‘We will not listen.’

twi: Ɛno nti monyɛ aso, mo amanaman;mo a moyɛ nnansefo, monhwɛ,monhwɛ nea ɛbɛto wɔn.
Tie, wo asase:Mede amanehunu reba saa nnipa yi so,wɔn nneyɛe so aba,efisɛ wɔantie me nsɛmna wɔapo me mmara.
english:
Hear, you earth:
    I am bringing disaster on this people,
    the fruit of their schemes,
because they have not listened to my words
    and have rejected my law.

twi: Nnuhuam a efi Sebaanaa ahwerew pa a efi akyirikyiri asase so fa me ho bɛn?Minnye wo hyew afɔre no nto mu,wʼafɔrebɔ ahorow no nsɔ mʼani.”
english:
What do I care about incense from Sheba
    or sweet calamus from a distant land?
Your burnt offerings are not acceptable;
    your sacrifices do not please me.”

twi: Ɛno nti, nea Awurade se ni:“Mede akwanside begu saa nkurɔfo yi anim.Agyanom ne mmabarima nyinaa behintiw wɔ so;yɔnkonom ne nnamfonom bɛyera.”
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord says:
“I will put obstacles before this people.
    Parents and children alike will stumble over them;
    neighbors and friends will perish.”

twi: Sɛnea Awurade se ni:“Monhwɛ, nsraadɔm bi reba,wofi atifi fam asase so;wɔrehwanyan wɔnafi nsase ano.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Look, an army is coming
    from the land of the north;
a great nation is being stirred up
    from the ends of the earth.

twi: Wokurakura bɛmma ne mpeaw;wɔn tirim yɛ den, na wonni ahummɔbɔ.Wɔn nnyigyei te sɛ po asorɔkye.Sɛ wɔtete wɔn apɔnkɔ so a,wɔba te sɛ mmarima a wɔrekɔ ɔko.Wɔrebɛtow ahyɛ wo so, Ɔbabea Sion.”
Yɛate wɔn ho nsɛm,na yɛn nsa sesa yɛn ho sɛ nea awuwu.Awerɛhow akyekyere yɛnyɛte yaw sɛ ɔbea a ɔreko awo.
english:
We have heard reports about them,
    and our hands hang limp.
Anguish has gripped us,
    pain like that of a woman in labor.

twi: Mfi adi nkɔ wuramna nnantew akwan no so,efisɛ ɔtamfo no wɔ afoa,na baabiara ayɛ hu.
english:
Do not go out to the fields
    or walk on the roads,
for the enemy has a sword,
    and there is terror on every side.

twi: Me nkurɔfo, mumfura atweaatamna mommunummunum wɔ nsõ mu,momfa adwadwotwa yaayaw nni awerɛhowsɛnea wosu ma ɔbabarima koro,efisɛ ɔsɛefo nobɛba yɛn so mpofirim.
english:
Put on sackcloth, my people,
    and roll in ashes;
mourn with bitter wailing
    as for an only son,
for suddenly the destroyer
    will come upon us.

twi: “Mayɛ wo obi a ɔsɔ agude hwɛna me nkurɔfo dadeben,a wobɛhwɛna woasɔ wɔn akwan ahwɛ.
english:
“I have made you a tester of metals
    and my people the ore,
that you may observe
    and test their ways.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ atuatewfo a wɔyɛ den,wɔnenam di nseku.Wɔyɛ kɔbere ne dade;wɔn nyinaa yɛ wɔn ade wɔ porɔwee kwan so.
english:
They are all hardened rebels,
    going about to slander.
They are bronze and iron;
    they all act corruptly.

twi: Afa no bɔ mframa dennende ogya nan sumpii no,nanso ɔnan no yɛ ɔkwa.Entumi nyiyii bɔne no mfii wɔn mu ɛ.
english:
The bellows blow fiercely
    to burn away the lead with fire,
but the refining goes on in vain;
    the wicked are not purged out.

twi: Wɔfrɛ wɔn dwetɛ a wɔapo,efisɛ Awurade apo wɔn.”
english:
They are called rejected silver,
    because the Lord has rejected them.”

twi: Atoro Nyamesom So Nni MfasoEyi ne asɛm a efi Awurade hɔ baa Yeremia nkyɛn:
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord:

twi: “Gyina Awurade asɔredan no pon ano, na ka saa asɛm yi:“ ‘Muntie Awurade asɛm, mo nnipa a mowɔ Yuda nyinaa a mofa apon yi ano kɔsom Awurade.
english:
“Stand at the gate of the Lord’s house and there proclaim this message:
“‘Hear the word of the Lord, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the Lord.

twi: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn no se: Monsakra mo akwan ne mo nneyɛe, na mɛma mo atena ha.
english: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.

twi: Mommfa mo ho nto nnaadaasɛm so na monnka se, “Eyi ne Awurade asɔredan, Awurade asɔredan, Awurade asɔredan!”
english: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, “This is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord!”

twi: Sɛ mosakra mo akwan ne mo nneyɛe nokware mu, na mo ne mo ho mo ho di no trenee mu,
english: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,

twi: sɛ moanhyɛ ɔhɔho, ayisaa anaa okunafo so, na moanhwie mogya a edi bem angu wɔ ha, na moanni anyame foforo akyi ankɔ mo ara ɔsɛe mu a,
english: if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,

twi: ɛno de, mɛma mo atena ha, asase a mede maa mo agyanom afebɔɔ no so.
english: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors for ever and ever.

twi: Nanso monhwɛ, mode mo ho ato nnaadaa nsɛm a so nni mfaso so.
english: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

twi: “ ‘Mobɛbɔ korɔn na moadi awu, mobɛbɔ aguaman na moadi adansekurum, mobɛhyew nnuhuam ama Baal na moadi anyame afoforo a munnim wɔn akyi,
english: “‘Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,

twi: na afei, moaba abegyina mʼanim wɔ ofi a me din da so na moaka se, “Yenni ɔhaw,” sɛ moyɛ akyiwade yi nyinaa a na munni ɔhaw ana?
english: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, “We are safe”—safe to do all these detestable things?

twi: Na ofi a me din da so yi, abɛyɛ adwowtwafo tu ama mo ana? Nanso migu so rehwɛ! Awurade na ose.
english: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Na afei monkɔ Silo, faako a midii kan bɔɔ atenae de me Din too so, na monhwɛ nea meyɛɛ no esiane me nkurɔfo Israelfo amumɔyɛ nti.
english: “‘Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

twi: Bere a moreyɛ eyinom nyinaa, Awurade na ose, mekasa kyerɛɛ mo mpɛn bebree, nanso moantie; mefrɛɛ mo, nanso moannye so.
english: While you were doing all these things, declares the Lord, I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.

twi: Ɛno nti, sɛnea meyɛɛ Silo no, mede bɛyɛ ofi a me Din da so no, asɔredan a mode mo ho to so, baabi a mede maa mo ne mo agyanom no.
english: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.

twi: Mɛpam mo afi mʼanim sɛnea meyɛɛ mo nuanom Efraimfo no.’
english: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your fellow Israelites, the people of Ephraim.’

twi: “Enti mommmɔ mpae mma saa nnipa yi, monnsrɛ na munni mma wɔn nso; monnsrɛ me, efisɛ merentie mo.
english: “So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

twi: Munnhu nea wɔreyɛ wɔ Yuda nkurow no mu ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no ana?
english: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

twi: Mmofra boaboa nnyina ano, na agyanom sɔ ogya no ano, mmea fɔtɔw asikresiam de to brodo ma Ɔsoro Hemmea. Na wogu nsa ma anyame afoforo de hyɛ me abufuw.
english: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse my anger.

twi: Na ɛyɛ me na wɔrehyɛ me abufuw ana? Awurade na ose. Na ɛnyɛ wɔn mmom na wɔrehaw wɔn ho, hyɛ wɔn ho aniwu ana?
english: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the Lord. Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?

twi: “ ‘Ɛno nti, nea Otumfo Awurade se ni: Wobehwie mʼabufuw ne mʼabufuwhyew agu beae yi so, agu nnipa ne mmoa, mfuw so nnua ne asase no so aba so, na ɛbɛdɛw a ɛrennum.’
english: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place—on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the crops of your land—and it will burn and not be quenched.

twi: “ ‘Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se: Monkɔ so, momfa mo ɔhyew afɔrebɔ nka mo afɔrebɔ a aka no ho, na mo ankasa monwe nam no!
english: “‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

twi: Na bere a miyii mo agyanom fii Misraim na mekasa kyerɛɛ wɔn no, manhyɛ wɔn mmara a ɛfa ɔhyew afɔrebɔ ne afɔrebɔ ho nko ara,
english: For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

twi: mmom mede saa mmara yi kaa ho: Monyɛ osetie mma me, na mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn, na moayɛ me nkurɔfo. Monnantew akwan nyinaa a mɛhyɛ mo no so, na asi mo yiye.
english: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in obedience to all I command you, that it may go well with you.

twi: Nanso wɔantie na wɔanyɛ aso; mmom, wofi wɔn koma bɔne mu yɛɛ asoɔden. Wɔsan wɔn akyi na wɔankɔ wɔn anim.
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

twi: Efi bere a mo agyanom fii Misraim de besi nnɛ yi, da biara ne bere biara mesomaa me nkoa adiyifo baa mo nkyɛn.
english: From the time your ancestors left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.

twi: Nanso wɔantie me na wɔanyɛ aso. Wɔde asoɔden yɛɛ bɔne boroo wɔn agyanom de so.’
english: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.’

twi: “Sɛ moka eyinom nyinaa kyerɛ wɔn a, wɔrentie mo; sɛ mofrɛ wɔn a wɔrennye so.
english: “When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.

twi: Ɛno nti monka nkyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Eyi ne ɔman a ɔnyɛɛ osetie mmaa Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔmfaa nteɛso no. Nokware asa, na afi wɔn ano.
english: Therefore say to them, ‘This is the nation that has not obeyed the Lord its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.

twi: Munyi mo tinwi na montow ngu, muntwa agyaadwo wɔ nkoko no so, efisɛ Awurade apo, na wagyaa saa awo ntoatoaso yi a wɔwɔ nʼabufuwhyew no ase akyidi.’ ”
english: “‘Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the Lord has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.

twi: Okum Bon No“ ‘Yudafo ayɛ bɔne wɔ mʼani so, sɛnea Awurade se ni. Wɔde ahoni a, ɛyɛ akyiwade asisi ofi a me Din da so mu de agu ho fi.
english: “‘The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the Lord. They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.

twi: Wɔasisi Tofet sorɔnsorɔmmea wɔ Ben Hinom bon mu; ɛhɔ na wɔhyew wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea. Ade a manhyɛ wɔn na amma mʼadwene mu nso.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.

twi: Ɛno nti, monhwɛ yiye na nna no reba, Awurade na ose, a wɔremfrɛ hɔ Tofet anaa Hinom Bon bio, na mmom, wɔbɛfrɛ no Okum Bon, efisɛ wobesie awufo wɔ Tofet kosi sɛ hɔ bɛyɛ ma.
english: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

twi: Na afei saa nnipa yi afunu bɛyɛ aduan ama wim nnomaa ne asase so mmoa, na ɛrenka obiara wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛpam wɔn.
english: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

twi: Mede ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nnyigyei, ayeforo ne ayeforokunu nne a ɛwɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no bɛba awiei, efisɛ asase no bɛda mpan.’ ”
english: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.

twi: “ ‘Saa bere no, sɛnea Awurade se ni, wobeyiyi Yuda ahemfo ne adwumayɛfo nnompe, asɔfo ne adiyifo nnompe ne Yerusalemfo nnompe afi wɔn nna mu.
english: “‘At that time, declares the Lord, the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

twi: Wɔbɛsɛw no kɛtɛ wɔ owia ne ɔsram ne ɔsorosoro nsoromma nyinaa a wɔdɔe, na wɔsomee, na wodii akyi kɔɔ so abisa na wɔsɔree no ase. Wɔremmoa wɔn ano na wɔrensie wɔn; mmom, wɔbɛyɛ sɛ sumina a egugu fam.
english: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.

twi: Baabiara a metwa saa ɔman bɔne yi nkae no asu akɔ no, wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wobewu sen sɛ wɔbɛtena nkwa mu, sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.’
english: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the Lord Almighty.’

twi: Bɔne Ne Asotwe“Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nea Awurade se ni:“ ‘Sɛ nnipa hwe ase a, wɔnsɔre ana?Sɛ onipa dan ne ho a, ɔnsan nʼakyi ana?
english:
“Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says:
“‘When people fall down, do they not get up?
    When someone turns away, do they not return?

twi: Afei adɛn nti na saa nnipa yi adan wɔn ho?Adɛn nti na Yerusalem dan ne ho daa yi?Wokura nnaadaa mu pintinn;na wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔsan wɔn akyi.
english:
Why then have these people turned away?
    Why does Jerusalem always turn away?
They cling to deceit;
    they refuse to return.

twi: Mawɛn mʼaso atie,nanso wɔnnka nea ɛteɛ.Wɔn mu biara nnu ne ho wɔ nʼamumɔyɛ ho,na ɔka se, “Dɛn na mayɛ?”Obiara fa ne kwante sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ a ɔrepem akɔ akono.
english:
I have listened attentively,
    but they do not say what is right.
None of them repent of their wickedness,
    saying, “What have I done?”
Each pursues their own course
    like a horse charging into battle.

twi: Mpo aturukuku a ɔwɔ wimnim ne mmere a wɔahyehyɛ ama no,na asukɔnkɔn, asomfena ne agyenkukuhu bere a wotu kɔtena baabi,nanso me nkurɔfo nnimnea Awurade hwehwɛ.
english:
Even the stork in the sky
    knows her appointed seasons,
and the dove, the swift and the thrush
    observe the time of their migration.
But my people do not know
    the requirements of the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Adɛn na mutumi ka se, “Yenim nyansa,efisɛ yɛwɔ Awurade mmara,”wɔ bere a akyerɛwfo kyerɛwdua torofode atoro adannan mu?
english:
“‘How can you say, “We are wise,
    for we have the law of the Lord,”
when actually the lying pen of the scribes
    has handled it falsely?

twi: Anyansafo no anim begu ase;wɔn ho bedwiriw wɔn na afide ayi wɔn.Sɛ wɔapo Awurade asɛm no a,na nyansa bɛn na wɔwɔ?
english:
The wise will be put to shame;
    they will be dismayed and trapped.
Since they have rejected the word of the Lord,
    what kind of wisdom do they have?

twi: Mede wɔn yerenom bɛma mmarima afoforone wɔn mfuw nso ama afoforo.Efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so,wɔn nyinaa yɛ adifudepɛfo de pɛ ahonya;adiyifo ne asɔfo te saa,wɔn nyinaa yɛ asisifo.
english:
Therefore I will give their wives to other men
    and their fields to new owners.
From the least to the greatest,
    all are greedy for gain;
prophets and priests alike,
    all practice deceit.

twi: Wɔtoto me nkurɔfo apirakurute sɛnea ɛnyɛ hu.Wɔka se, “Asomdwoe, asomdwoe”wɔ mmere a asomdwoe nni hɔ.
english:
They dress the wound of my people
    as though it were not serious.
“Peace, peace,” they say,
    when there is no peace.

twi: Wɔn ani wu wɔ wɔn animguase nneyɛe no ho ana?Dabi da, wɔn ani nnwu koraa;wonnim fɛre mpo.Enti wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ atɔfo mu;wɔbɛhwehwe ase, sɛ metwe wɔn aso a,sɛnea Awurade se ni.
“ ‘Mɛfa wɔn twabere nnɔbae akɔ,nea Awurade se ni.Aba biara remma bobe nnua no so.Aba biara remma borɔdɔma nnua no so,ɛso nhaban begunguan.Nea mede ama wɔn no,wobegye afi wɔn nsam.’ ”
english:
“‘I will take away their harvest,
declares the Lord.
    There will be no grapes on the vine.
There will be no figs on the tree,
    and their leaves will wither.
What I have given them
    will be taken from them.’”

twi: Adɛn nti na yɛtete ha?Mommoaboa mo ho ano!Momma yenguan nkɔ nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ muna yenkowuwu wɔ hɔ!efisɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn abu yɛn kumfɔna wama yɛn nsu a awuduru wɔ mu sɛ yɛnnom,efisɛ yɛayɛ bɔne atia no.
english:
Why are we sitting here?
    Gather together!
Let us flee to the fortified cities
    and perish there!
For the Lord our God has doomed us to perish
    and given us poisoned water to drink,
    because we have sinned against him.

twi: Yɛhwɛɛ kwan sɛ yebenya asomdwoenanso biribi pa biara amfi mu amma,yɛhwɛɛ ayaresabere kwannanso ehu nko ara na ɛkaa yɛn.
english:
We hoped for peace
    but no good has come,
for a time of healing
    but there is only terror.

twi: Wɔte atamfo no apɔnkɔ homefii Dan;na wɔn apɔnkɔnini suma asase no nyinaa wosow.Wɔaba sɛ wɔrebɛsɛeasase no ne so nneɛma nyinaa,kuropɔn no ne wɔn a wɔtete mu nyinaa.
english:
The snorting of the enemy’s horses
    is heard from Dan;
at the neighing of their stallions
    the whole land trembles.
They have come to devour
    the land and everything in it,
    the city and all who live there.

twi: “Hwɛ, mɛsoma awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ bɔre aba mo mu,nhurutoa a wontumi nnwudwo wɔn,na wɔbɛkeka mo,”nea Awurade se ni.
english:
“See, I will send venomous snakes among you,
    vipers that cannot be charmed,
    and they will bite you,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Wone mʼawerɛhow mu Werɛkyekyefo,me koma abotow wɔ me mu.
english:
You who are my Comforter in sorrow,
    my heart is faint within me.

twi: Tie me nkurɔfo sufrɛ;a efi akyirikyiri asase so:“Awurade nni Sion ana?Ne Hene no nni hɔ bio ana?”“Adɛn nti na wɔde wɔn nsɛsode ahyɛ me abufuw,wɔn ananafo ahoni huhuw no?”
english:
Listen to the cry of my people
    from a land far away:
“Is the Lord not in Zion?
    Is her King no longer there?”
“Why have they aroused my anger with their images,
    with their worthless foreign idols?”

twi: “Otwabere no atwa mu,ahuhuru bere no aba awiei,na wonnnyee yɛn nkwa.”
english:
“The harvest is past,
    the summer has ended,
    and we are not saved.”

twi: Sɛ wɔadwerɛw me nkurɔfo no nti, wɔadwerɛw me;midi awerɛhow, na ahodwiriw akyekyere me.
english:
Since my people are crushed, I am crushed;
    I mourn, and horror grips me.

twi: Aduru bi nni Gilead ana?Ɔyaresafo bi nni hɔ ana?Na afei adɛn nti na ayaresa nni hɔmma me nkurɔfo apirakuru?
english:
Is there no balm in Gilead?
    Is there no physician there?
Why then is there no healing
    for the wound of my people?

twi: Ao, sɛ me ti yɛ asuti,na mʼaniwa yɛ nusu abura a!Mɛtew nusu awia ne anadwoama me nkurɔfo a wɔakunkum wɔn no.
english:
Oh, that my head were a spring of water
    and my eyes a fountain of tears!
I would weep day and night
    for the slain of my people.

twi: Ao, sɛ mewɔ akwantufo asoɛewɔ nweatam no so aanka megyaw me nkurɔfo hɔna mafi wɔn nkyɛn;efisɛ wɔn nyinaa yɛ nguaman,nnipakuw a wonni nokware.
“Wosiesie wɔn tɛkrɛmate sɛ agyan de di atoro;Ɛnyɛ nokware so na wɔnamdi yiye wɔ asase yi so.Wɔyɛ bɔne toatoa so;na wonnye me nto mu,”Awurade na ose.
english:
“They make ready their tongue
    like a bow, to shoot lies;
it is not by truth
    that they triumph in the land.
They go from one sin to another;
    they do not acknowledge me,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Monhwɛ yiye wɔ mo nnamfonom ho;munnye obiara nni wɔ mo abusua mu.Efisɛ wɔn mu biara yɛ ɔdaadaafo,na adamfo biara yɛ ɔsɛefo.
english:
“Beware of your friends;
    do not trust anyone in your clan.
For every one of them is a deceiver,
    and every friend a slanderer.

twi: Adamfo daadaa adamfo,na wɔn mu biara nka nokware.Wɔn tɛkrɛma akokwaw atorodi mu,wɔde bɔneyɛ haw wɔn ho.
english:
Friend deceives friend,
    and no one speaks the truth.
They have taught their tongues to lie;
    they weary themselves with sinning.

twi: Wote nnaadaa mfimfini;na wɔn nnaadaa mu wɔmpɛ sɛ wogye me to mu,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
Ɛno nti, sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se,“Hwɛ, mɛnan wɔn asɔ wɔn ahwɛ,na dɛn bio na metumi ayɛesiane me nkurɔfo yi bɔne nti?
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says:
“See, I will refine and test them,
    for what else can I do
    because of the sin of my people?

twi: Wɔn tɛkrɛma yɛ agyan a ano wɔ bɔre;ɛka nnaadaasɛm.Obiara kasa asomdwoe mu kyerɛ ne yɔnko,nanso ne koma mu de, osum no afiri.
english:
Their tongue is a deadly arrow;
    it speaks deceitfully.
With their mouths they all speak cordially to their neighbors,
    but in their hearts they set traps for them.

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ metwe wɔn aso wɔ eyi ho?”Sɛɛ na Awurade se.“Ɛnsɛ sɛ mʼankasa metɔɔman a ɛte sɛɛ so were ana?
english:
Should I not punish them for this?”
    declares the Lord.
“Should I not avenge myself
    on such a nation as this?”

twi: Mesu na metwa adwo ama mmepɔw no,mɛbɔ abubuw a ɛfa nweatam adidibea ho.Ayɛ fo na obi mfa hɔ bio,na wɔnte anantwi su wɔ hɔ.Wim nnomaa no atutu kɔna mmoa no nso aguan kɔ.
english:
I will weep and wail for the mountains
    and take up a lament concerning the wilderness grasslands.
They are desolate and untraveled,
    and the lowing of cattle is not heard.
The birds have all fled
    and the animals are gone.

twi: “Mɛyɛ Yerusalem mmubui siw,sakraman atu;na mɛma Yuda nkurow ada mpansɛnea obiara ntumi ntena hɔ.”
english:
“I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins,
    a haunt of jackals;
and I will lay waste the towns of Judah
    so no one can live there.”

twi: Onipa bɛn na onim nyansa ara sɛ ɔbɛte eyi ase? Hena na Awurade akyerɛkyerɛ no a obetumi akyerɛ ase? Adɛn nti na wɔasɛe asase no ama ada mpan sɛ nweatam a obiara ntumi mfa so?
english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the Lord and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?

twi: Awurade kae se, “Esiane sɛ wɔapo me mmara a mehyɛ maa wɔn no nti, wɔanyɛ osetie amma me na wɔanni me mmara so.
english: The Lord said, “It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

twi: Mmom, wɔadi wɔn koma asoɔden akyi, wɔadi Baalnom akyi sɛnea wɔn agyanom kyerɛɛ wɔn no.”
english: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their ancestors taught them.”

twi: Ɛno nti, nea Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn no se ni: “Hwɛ, mɛma saa nnipa yi adi aduan a ɛyɛ nwen na wɔanom nsu a wɔde awuduru afra.
english: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

twi: Mɛbɔ wɔn ahwete amanaman a wɔn anaa wɔn agyanom nnim so no so, na mede afoa bɛtaa wɔn kosi sɛ mɛsɛe wɔn.”
english: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.”

twi: Sɛnea Awurade tumfo se ni:“Dwene ho! Frɛ mmea agyaadwotwafo no,frɛ wɔn a wɔakwadaw mu pa ara.
Ma wɔmmra ntɛmmmesu ngu yɛn sokosi sɛ yɛn ani so bɛtaa nusuna nusu aguare yɛn.
english:
Let them come quickly
    and wail over us
till our eyes overflow with tears
    and water streams from our eyelids.

twi: Wɔte agyaadwotwa nnyigyei fi Sion se,‘Wɔasɛe yɛn!Yɛn anim agu ase yiye!Ɛsɛ sɛ yetu fi yɛn asase soefisɛ yɛn afi abubu.’ ”
english:
The sound of wailing is heard from Zion:
    ‘How ruined we are!
    How great is our shame!
We must leave our land
    because our houses are in ruins.’”

twi: Afei, mo mmea, muntie Awurade asɛm;monyɛ aso mma nsɛm a efi nʼanom.Monkyerɛ mo mmabea sɛnea wotwa dwo;monkyerɛ mo ho mo ho abubuwbɔ.
Owu aforo afa yɛn mfɛnsere muahyɛn yɛn aban mu;apam mmofra afi mmɔnten sone mmerante afi ɔman aguabɔbea.
english:
Death has climbed in through our windows
    and has entered our fortresses;
it has removed the children from the streets
    and the young men from the public squares.

twi: Ka se, “Sɛɛ Na Awurade se,“ ‘Nnipa afunu bɛdeda hɔte sɛ sumina a egugu petee mu,te sɛ aburow a nnɔbaetwafo atwa agu nʼakyia obiara mmoaboaa ano.’ ”
english:
Say, “This is what the Lord declares:
“‘Dead bodies will lie
    like dung on the open field,
like cut grain behind the reaper,
    with no one to gather them.’”

twi: Eyi ne nea Awurade se:“Mma onyansafo mfa ne nyansa nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔhoɔdenfo mfa nʼahoɔden nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔdefo mfa nʼahonya nhyehyɛ ne ho.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Let not the wise boast of their wisdom
    or the strong boast of their strength
    or the rich boast of their riches,

twi: Mmom ma nea ɔhyehyɛ ne ho nhyehyɛ ne ho sɛɔwɔ nhumu, na onim sɛ,me ne Awurade a ɔyɛ adɔe,na obu atɛntrenee na ɔyɛ adetrenee wɔ asase so,efisɛ eyinom na ɛsɔ mʼani,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
english:
but let the one who boasts boast about this:
    that they have the understanding to know me,
that I am the Lord, who exercises kindness,
    justice and righteousness on earth,
    for in these I delight,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Nna no reba,” Awurade na ose, “A mɛtwe wɔn a wɔatwa twetia wɔ honam fam nko ara no nyinaa aso:
english: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord, “when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—

twi: Misraimfo, Yudafo, Edomfo, Amonfo, Moabfo ne wɔn a wɔtete nweatam a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri nsase so nyinaa. Na nokware, saa aman yi nyinaa yɛ momonotofo na mpo Israelfi nyinaa yɛ koma mu momonotofo.”
english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”

twi: Onyankopɔn Ne AhoniMuntie nea Awurade ka kyerɛ mo, Israelfi.
english: Hear what the Lord says to you, people of Israel.

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Munnsua amanaman no akwananaa momma wim nsɛnkyerɛnne mmɔ mo hu,ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔbɔ amanaman no hu.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Do not learn the ways of the nations
    or be terrified by signs in the heavens,
    though the nations are terrified by them.

twi: Na nkurɔfo no amanne nka hwee;wotwa dua fi kwae mu,na odwumfo de ne fitii asen.
Wɔde dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ hyehyɛ no;wɔde nnadewa ne asae bobɔ si hɔsɛnea ɛrenhwe fam.
Ɛte sɛ kaakaabotoni a esi ɛfere mfikyifuw mu,wɔn ahoni no ntumi nkasa;ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsoa wɔnefisɛ wontumi nnantew.Munnsuro wɔn;wɔrentumi nhaw mona wɔrentumi nyɛ ade pa biara nso.”
english:
Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field,
    their idols cannot speak;
they must be carried
    because they cannot walk.
Do not fear them;
    they can do no harm
    nor can they do any good.”

twi: Obiara nte sɛ wo, Awurade;woyɛ ɔkɛsena wo din so wɔ tumi mu.
Hena na ɛnsɛ sɛ odi wo ni,Amansanhene?Eyi na ɛfata wo.Amanaman no so anyansafo nyinaa mune wɔn ahenni nyinaa mu,obiara ne wo nsɛ.
english:
Who should not fear you,
    King of the nations?
    This is your due.
Among all the wise leaders of the nations
    and in all their kingdoms,
    there is no one like you.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ adwenharefo ne nkwaseafo;dua ahoni a so nni mfaso na ɛma wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ.
english:
They are all senseless and foolish;
    they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

twi: Wɔde dwetɛ a wɔaboro fi Tarsis ba,ne sikakɔkɔɔ nso fi Ufas ba.Ɛyɛ nea odwumfo ne sika dwumfo ayɛa wɔde ntama bibiri ne beredum afura no,ne nyinaa yɛ adwumfo anyansafo nsa ano nnwuma.
english:
Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish
    and gold from Uphaz.
What the craftsman and goldsmith have made
    is then dressed in blue and purple—
    all made by skilled workers.

twi: Nanso Awurade ne nokware Onyankopɔn no;ɔno ne Onyankopɔn teasefo, daapem Hene no.Sɛ ne bo fuw a asase wosow;na amanaman no ntumi nnyina nʼabufuwhyew ano.
“Ka eyi kyerɛ wɔn: ‘Saa anyame a ɛnyɛ wɔn na wɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase no bɛyera afi asase so ne ɔsorosoro ase.’ ”
english: “Tell them this: ‘These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.’”

twi: Nanso Onyankopɔn de ne tumi bɔɔ asase;ɔtoo wiase fapem wɔ ne nyansa mu,na ɔde ne nhumu trɛw ɔsorosoro mu.
Sɛ ɔpaapae aprannaa a ɔsorosoro nsu bobɔ mu;ɔma omununkum ma ne ho so fi nsase ano.Ɔde anyinam ka osu ho ba,na ogyaa mframa mu fi nʼadekoradan mu.
english:
When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar;
    he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth.
He sends lightning with the rain
    and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

twi: Onipa biara nnim nyansa, na onni nimdeɛ;sikadwumfo biara anim gu ase, esiane nʼahoni nti.Ne nsɛsode yɛ atoro;wonni ɔhome biara wɔ wɔn mu.
Wɔn so nni mfaso, wɔn ho yɛ serew;sɛ wɔn atemmu du so a, wɔbɛyera.
english:
They are worthless, the objects of mockery;
    when their judgment comes, they will perish.

twi: Nea ɔyɛ Yakob Kyɛfa no nte sɛ eyinom,efisɛ ɔno ne ade nyinaa Yɛfoa Israel, abusua a ɛyɛ nʼagyapade nso ka ho,Asafo Awurade ne ne din.
english:
He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these,
    for he is the Maker of all things,
including Israel, the people of his inheritance—
    the Lord Almighty is his name.

twi: Ɔsɛe A ƐrebaMommoaboa mo ahode ano mfi asase no so,mo a motete nkurow a wɔatua wɔn ano mu.
english:
Gather up your belongings to leave the land,
    you who live under siege.

twi: Na sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Saa bere yi mɛtow wɔn awɔtete asase yi so agu;mede amanehunu bɛba wɔn sosɛnea wɔbɛfa wɔn nnommum.”
english:
For this is what the Lord says:
    “At this time I will hurl out
    those who live in this land;
I will bring distress on them
    so that they may be captured.”

twi: Me pira yi nti minnue,mʼapirakuru yɛ akisikuru!Nanso mehyɛɛ me ho den sɛ,“Eyi ne me yare, na ɛsɛ sɛ mimia mʼani.”
english:
Woe to me because of my injury!
    My wound is incurable!
Yet I said to myself,
    “This is my sickness, and I must endure it.”

twi: Wɔasɛe me ntamadan;wɔatwitwa nʼahama nyinaa mu.Wɔafa me mma nyinaa kɔ a merenhu wɔn bio;anka obiara a obesi me ntamadananaa obesiesie me suhyɛ.
Nguanhwɛfo no yɛ adwenharefowommisa Awurade akyi kwan;ɛno nti wɔnkɔ sona wɔn nguankuw no abɔ ahwete.
english:
The shepherds are senseless
    and do not inquire of the Lord;
so they do not prosper
    and all their flock is scattered.

twi: Muntie! Amanneɛ no reba,basabasayɛ kɛse a efi atifi fam asase bi so!Ɛbɛma Yuda nkurow ada mpan,na ayɛ sakraman atu.
english:
Listen! The report is coming—
    a great commotion from the land of the north!
It will make the towns of Judah desolate,
    a haunt of jackals.

twi: Yeremia MpaebɔAwurade, minim sɛ, onipa nkwa nyɛ ne de;na ɛnyɛ onipa na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nʼanammɔntu.
english:
Lord, I know that people’s lives are not their own;
    it is not for them to direct their steps.

twi: Teɛ me so, Awurade, wɔ trenee mu,mfi wʼabufuw mu nyɛ;anyɛ saa a wobɛdwerɛw me.
english:
Discipline me, Lord, but only in due measure—
    not in your anger,
    or you will reduce me to nothing.

twi: Hwie wʼabufuwhyew no gu amanamana wonnye wo nto mu no so,nnipa a wɔmmɔ wo din no so.Efisɛ, wɔasɛe Yakobwɔasɛe no koraana wɔasɛe nʼasase a wɔwoo no too so no.
english:
Pour out your wrath on the nations
    that do not acknowledge you,
    on the peoples who do not call on your name.
For they have devoured Jacob;
    they have devoured him completely
    and destroyed his homeland.

twi: Wɔabu Apam No SoAsɛm a efi Awurade hɔ baa Yeremia nkyɛn ni:
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord:

twi: “Tie apam yi mu nhyehyɛe na ka kyerɛ Yudafo ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem.
english: “Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.

twi: Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se: ‘Nnome nka onipa a onni apam yi mu nhyehyɛe so,
english: Tell them that this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says: ‘Cursed is the one who does not obey the terms of this covenant—

twi: nea mehyɛ maa mo agyanom bere a miyii wɔn fii Misraim, fononoo a wɔnan dade wɔ mu no.’ Mekae se, ‘Monyɛ osetie mma me na monyɛ biribiara a mehyɛ mo, na mobɛyɛ me nkurɔfo na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
english: the terms I commanded your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.’ I said, ‘Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

twi: Na afei mɛma ntam a mekaa mo agyanom se, mɛma wɔn asase a nufusu ne ɛwo sen wɔ so no aba mu,’ asase a mote so nnɛ yi.”Mibuae se, “Amen, Awurade.”
english:
Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey’—the land you possess today.”
I answered, “Amen, Lord.”

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Bɔ saa asɛm yi ho dawuru wɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so se: ‘Muntie apam yi ho nhyehyɛe na munni so.
english: The Lord said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.

twi: Efi bere a miyii mo agyanom fii Misraim besi nnɛ yi, mebɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ bere biara se, “Monyɛ osetie mma me.”
english: From the time I brought your ancestors up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, “Obey me.”

twi: Nanso wɔantie na wɔamfa no asɛm; na mmom, wodii asoɔden a efi wɔn koma bɔne mu no akyi. Ɛno nti memaa nnome a efi apam a mahyɛ wɔn sɛ wonni so na wɔanni so no mu no baa wɔn so.’ ”
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.’”

twi: Na afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Atuatew apam bi wɔ Yudafo ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem no ntam.
english: Then the Lord said to me, “There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.

twi: Wɔasan kɔ wɔn agyanom a wɔampɛ sɛ wotie mʼasɛm no bɔne ho. Wɔadi anyame foforo akyi akɔsom wɔn. Yerusalem fifo ne Yuda fifo abu apam a me ne wɔn agyanom yɛe no so.
english: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.

twi: Ɛno nti nea Awurade se ni: ‘Mede amanehunu a wɔrentumi nguan mfi mu bɛba wɔn so. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ, wosu frɛ me de, nanso merennye wɔn so.
english: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.

twi: Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalemfo bɛkɔ akosu afrɛ anyame a wɔhyew nnuhuam ma wɔn no, nanso sɛ amanehunu ba a wɔrentumi mmoa wɔn koraa.
english: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.

twi: Wo Yuda, wowɔ anyame a wɔn dodow bɛyɛ sɛ wo nkurow; na afɔremuka a moasisi sɛ mobɛhyew nnuhuam wɔ so ama animguase nyame Baal no dɔɔso sɛ Yerusalem mmɔnten.’
english: You, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’

twi: “Mmɔ mpae mma saa nnipa yi, nni mma wɔn na nsrɛ mma wɔn, efisɛ, sɛ wosu frɛ me wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu a merennye wɔn so.
english: “Do not pray for this people or offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.

twi: “Dɛn na me dɔfo reyɛ wɔ mʼasɔredan mubere a ɔne bebree hyehyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi ho?Ahodwira nam betumi abɔ wo asotwe agu ana?Sɛ woyɛ wʼamumɔyɛsɛm ana wʼani agye.”
english:
“What is my beloved doing in my temple
    as she, with many others, works out her evil schemes?
    Can consecrated meat avert your punishment?
When you engage in your wickedness,
    then you rejoice.”

twi: Awurade, frɛ wo ngodua a enyin frɔmfrɔma ɛsow aba a ɛyɛ fɛ.Nanso ɔde ahum kɛse bi nteɛmubɛto mu gya,na ne mman bebubu.
english:
The Lord called you a thriving olive tree
    with fruit beautiful in form.
But with the roar of a mighty storm
    he will set it on fire,
    and its branches will be broken.

twi: Asafo Awurade a oduaa wo no ahyɛ amanehunu ho nkɔm wɔ wo ho, efisɛ Israel fifo ne Yuda fifo ayɛ bɔne ahyɛ me abufuw sɛ wɔhyew nnuhuam ma Baal.
english: The Lord Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the people of both Israel and Judah have done evil and aroused my anger by burning incense to Baal.

twi: Yeremia TirisopamEsiane sɛ Awurade yii pɔw a wabɔ kyerɛɛ me no nti, mihui, efisɛ saa bere no ɔde nea wɔreyɛ no kyerɛɛ me.
english: Because the Lord revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.

twi: Meyɛɛ sɛ oguamma a odwo a wɔde no rekɔ akokum no; amma mʼadwene mu sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn tirim pɔw atia me sɛ,“Momma yɛnsɛe dua no ne nʼaba no;momma yentwa no mfi ateasefo asase so,sɛnea wɔnnkae ne din bio.”
Nanso wo, Asafo Awurade, wo a wubu atɛntreneena wosɔ koma ne adwene hwɛ,ma minhu wʼaweretɔ wɔ wɔn so,na wo nsam na mede me nsɛm nyinaa hyɛ.
english:
But you, Lord Almighty, who judge righteously
    and test the heart and mind,
let me see your vengeance on them,
    for to you I have committed my cause.

twi: Ɛno nti nea Awurade ka fa Anatot mmarima a wɔrehwehwɛ wo akum wo na wɔka se, “Nhyɛ nkɔm wɔ Awurade din mu anyɛ saa a, wubewu wɔ yɛn nsa ano,”
english: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the people of Anathoth who are threatening to kill you, saying, “Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord or you will die by our hands”—

twi: Ɛno nti, nea Asafo Awurade se ni: “Mɛtwe wɔn aso. Wɔn mmerante bewuwu afoa ano, na ɔkɔm bekunkum wɔn mmabarima ne mmabea.
english: therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

twi: Wɔrennya wɔn nkae biara mpo, efisɛ mede amanehunu bɛba Anatotfo so wɔ wɔn asotwe afe mu.”
english: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”

twi: Yeremia AnwiinwiiWoyɛ ɔtreneeni bere biara, Awurade,sɛ mede asɛm to wʼanim a.Nso me ne wo bɛkasa afa wʼatɛntrenee ho:Adɛn nti na amumɔyɛfo kwan si wɔn yiye?Adɛn nti na wɔn a wonni gyidi ho dwo wɔn?
english:
You are always righteous, Lord,
    when I bring a case before you.
Yet I would speak with you about your justice:
    Why does the way of the wicked prosper?
    Why do all the faithless live at ease?

twi: Woadua wɔn, na wɔagye ntin;wonyinyin na wɔsow aba.Wɔbɔ wo din bere biarananso wɔn koma mmɛn wo.
english:
You have planted them, and they have taken root;
    they grow and bear fruit.
You are always on their lips
    but far from their hearts.

twi: Nanso wunim me, Awurade;wuhu me, na wosɔ mʼadwene a mewɔ wɔ wo ho no hwɛ.Twe wɔn kɔ sɛ nguan a wɔrekotwitwa wɔn mu!Yi wɔn si nkyɛn ma okumda!
english:
Yet you know me, Lord;
    you see me and test my thoughts about you.
Drag them off like sheep to be butchered!
    Set them apart for the day of slaughter!

twi: Asase no nkyen nkosi da bɛnna prama so sare nguan nkosi da bɛn?Esiane sɛ wɔn a wɔte so no yɛ amumɔyɛfo ntimmoa ne nnomaa a wɔwɔ so awuwu.Na nnipa no da so ka se,“Ɔrenhu nea ɛba yɛn so.”
english:
How long will the land lie parched
    and the grass in every field be withered?
Because those who live in it are wicked,
    the animals and birds have perished.
Moreover, the people are saying,
    “He will not see what happens to us.”

twi: Onyankopɔn Mmuae“Sɛ wo ne mmarima atu mmirikaama woabrɛ a,ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wo ne apɔnkɔ besi mmirikakan?Sɛ wuhintiw wɔ asase petee so a,ɛno de, dɛn na wobɛyɛ wɔ Yordan ho nkyɛkyerɛ mu?
english:
“If you have raced with men on foot
    and they have worn you out,
    how can you compete with horses?
If you stumble in safe country,
    how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

twi: Wo nuabarimanom, wʼankasa abusuafo,wɔn mpo ayi wo ama;wɔteɛ mu dennen tia wo.Mfa wo ho nto wɔn so,sɛ mpo wɔka wo ho asɛm pa a.
english:
Your relatives, members of your own family—
    even they have betrayed you;
    they have raised a loud cry against you.
Do not trust them,
    though they speak well of you.

twi: “Megyaw me fi,ato mʼagyapade asaworam;mede nea medɔ no nobɛhyɛ nʼatamfo nsa.
english:
“I will forsake my house,
    abandon my inheritance;
I will give the one I love
    into the hands of her enemies.

twi: Mʼagyapade ayɛ me sɛgyata a ɔwɔ kwae mu.Ɔbobɔ mu gu me so;ɛno nti metan no.
english:
My inheritance has become to me
    like a lion in the forest.
She roars at me;
    therefore I hate her.

twi: So mʼagyapade nyɛɛ me sɛ anomaaa nkekae sisi ne ho a ɔkyere mmoana nnomaa foforo a wɔkyere mmoa atwa ne ho ahyia resosɔw no ana?Monkɔboaboa nkekaboa nyinaa ano.Momfa wɔn mmra na wonkum wɔn.
english:
Has not my inheritance become to me
    like a speckled bird of prey
    that other birds of prey surround and attack?
Go and gather all the wild beasts;
    bring them to devour.

twi: Nguanhwɛfo bebree bɛsɛe me bobeturo,na wɔatiatia me mfuw so;wɔbɛdan me mfuw fɛɛfɛ noayɛ no asase hunu a ɛda mpan.
english:
Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard
    and trample down my field;
they will turn my pleasant field
    into a desolate wasteland.

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ asase a ada mpan a,awo wosee na ɛda hɔ kwa wɔ mʼanim;asase no nyinaa bɛda mpanefisɛ obiara nni hɔ a ɔhwɛ so.
english:
It will be made a wasteland,
    parched and desolate before me;
the whole land will be laid waste
    because there is no one who cares.

twi: Nkoko wosee a ɛwɔ nweatam no nyinaa so nona asɛefo bɛba abegu bebree,Awurade afoa bekunkum wɔnafi asase ano de akosi ano nohɔ;obiara remfa ne ho nni.
english:
Over all the barren heights in the desert
    destroyers will swarm,
for the sword of the Lord will devour
    from one end of the land to the other;
    no one will be safe.

twi: Wobedua atoko, nso wobetwa nsɔe;wɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ho nanso wɔrennya hwee.Wɔn ani bewu wɔ wɔn nnɔbaetwa ho.Awurade abufuwhyew nti.”
english:
They will sow wheat but reap thorns;
    they will wear themselves out but gain nothing.
They will bear the shame of their harvest
    because of the Lord’s fierce anger.”

twi: Nea Awurade se ni: “Na me yɔnkonom amumɔyɛfo a wɔfa agyapade a, mede maa me nkurɔfo Israelfo no de, metu wɔn afi wɔn nsase so na metu Yudafi afi wɔn mu.
english: This is what the Lord says: “As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the people of Judah from among them.

twi: Na sɛ mitu wɔn wie a, mehu wɔn mmɔbɔ bio, na mede wɔn mu biara bɛba nʼagyapade, ne nʼasase so.
english: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own country.

twi: Na sɛ wosua me nkurɔfo akwan yiye na wɔbɔ me din ka ntam se, ‘Nokware sɛ Awurade te ase yi’ a, ɛwɔ mu sɛ mmere bi wɔkyerɛɛ me nkurɔfo ma wɔde Baal kaa ntam de, nanso wɔn ase betim wɔ me nkurɔfo mu.
english: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives’—even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among my people.

twi: Nanso sɛ ɔman bi antie a, metu nʼase, na masɛe no korakora,” Awurade na ose.
english: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it,” declares the Lord.

twi: Nwera AbɔsoSɛɛ na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me: “Kɔ na kɔtɔ nwera abɔso bɔ wʼasen, nanso mma no nka nsu.”
english: This is what the Lord said to me: “Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”

twi: Enti metɔɔ abɔso sɛnea Awurade kyerɛe no, na mede bɔɔ mʼasen.
english: So I bought a belt, as the Lord directed, and put it around my waist.

twi: Afei, Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn ne mprenu so se,
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me a second time:

twi: “Fa abɔso a wotɔe a ɛbɔ wʼasen no kɔ Eufrate ho mprempren ara na fa kosie ɔbotan tokuru bi mu.”
english: “Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks.”

twi: Enti mede kosiee Eufrate ho, sɛnea Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me no.
english: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the Lord told me.

twi: Nna bebree akyi no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Afei kɔ Eufrate ho na kɔfa abɔso a meka kyerɛɛ wo se fa kosie hɔ no.”
english: Many days later the Lord said to me, “Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there.”

twi: Enti mekɔɔ Eufrate ho kotuu abɔso no wɔ beae a mede siei no, nanso na asuw atetew a so nni mfaso biara.
english: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.

twi: Afei Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

twi: “Sɛɛ na Awurade se, ‘Saa ara na mɛsɛe Yuda ahantan ne Yerusalem ahantankyɛnee no.
english: “This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

twi: Saa amumɔyɛfo yi a wɔmpɛ sɛ wotie mʼasɛm na wodi wɔn komaden akyi na wodi anyame afoforo akyi som wɔn, sɔre wɔn no, bɛyɛ sɛ saa abɔso yi, na wɔn so remma mfaso biara!
english: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt—completely useless!

twi: Sɛnea abɔso kyekyere onipa asen no, saa ara na mede Israelfi ne Yudafi nyinaa bataa me ho sɛ wɔnyɛ me nkurɔfo a wɔbɛma me din so, aka mʼayeyi na wɔahyɛ me anuonyam, nanso wɔantie me,’ nea Awurade se ni.
english: For as a belt is bound around the waist, so I bound all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah to me,’ declares the Lord, ‘to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.’

twi: Nsa Kotoku“Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nea Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se ni, Wɔmfa nsa nhyɛ nsa kotoku biara ma.’ Na sɛ wɔka kyerɛ wo se, ‘Yenim sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nsa hyɛ nsa kotoku biara ma a,’
english: “Say to them: ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And if they say to you, ‘Don’t we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’

twi: afei ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nea Awurade se ni: Mede nsabow bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔtete asase yi so nyinaa ma, a ahemfo a wɔte Dawid ahengua so, asɔfo, adiyifo ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem nyinaa ka ho bi.
english: then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.

twi: Mɛtotow wɔn abobɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho, agyanom ne mmabarima nyinaa, Awurade na ose. Meremma ahummɔbɔ anaa ayamye anaa ayamhyehye nsiw ɔsɛe a merebɛsɛe wɔn no ho kwan.’ ”
english: I will smash them one against the other, parents and children alike, declares the Lord. I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.’”

twi: Nnommumfa Ho AhunahunaMuntie na monyɛ aso,na monnyɛ ahantan,efisɛ Awurade akasa.
english:
Hear and pay attention,
    do not be arrogant,
    for the Lord has spoken.

twi: Monhyɛ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn, anuonyamansa na wama sum aduru,ansa na mo anan ahintihintiwwɔ nkoko a ɛso reduru sum no so.Mo ani da hann so,nanso ɔbɛdan no sum kusuuna wɔasesa ayɛ no sum kabii.
english:
Give glory to the Lord your God
    before he brings the darkness,
before your feet stumble
    on the darkening hills.
You hope for light,
    but he will turn it to utter darkness
    and change it to deep gloom.

twi: Nanso sɛ moantie a,mesu wɔ kokoa muesiane mo ahantan nti;mʼani bɛtaataa nsu,na nusu aguare me,efisɛ wɔbɛfa Awurade nguankuw no akɔ nnommum mu.
english:
If you do not listen,
    I will weep in secret
    because of your pride;
my eyes will weep bitterly,
    overflowing with tears,
    because the Lord’s flock will be taken captive.

twi: Monka nkyerɛ ɔhene ne ɔhemmea se,“Mumfi mo ahengua so nsi fam,na mo anuonyam ahenkyɛwbefi mo ti so.”
english:
Say to the king and to the queen mother,
    “Come down from your thrones,
for your glorious crowns
    will fall from your heads.”

twi: Wɔbɛtoto Negeb nkuropɔn apon mu,na obiara nni hɔ a obebuebue.Wɔbɛsoa Yudafo akɔ nnommum muwobetwa wɔn asu koraa.
english:
The cities in the Negev will be shut up,
    and there will be no one to open them.
All Judah will be carried into exile,
    carried completely away.

twi: Mo mpagyaw mo ani nhwɛwɔn a wofi atifi fam reba no.Nguankuw a wɔde hyɛɛ mo nsa no,nguan a mode wɔn hoahoaa mo ho no wɔ he?
english:
Look up and see
    those who are coming from the north.
Where is the flock that was entrusted to you,
    the sheep of which you boasted?

twi: Sɛ Awurade de wɔn a wɔyɛ mo nnamfonom yɛ mo so atitiriw a,dɛn na mobɛka?Na ɛrenyɛ mo yawte sɛnea ɔbea ɔreko awo ana?
english:
What will you say when the Lord sets over you
    those you cultivated as your special allies?
Will not pain grip you
    like that of a woman in labor?

twi: Na sɛ wubebisa wo ho se,“Adɛn nti na eyi aba me so a?”Na efi wʼamumɔyɛ bebrebe nonti na wɔatetew wo fam atade muayɛ wo nipadua basaa no.
english:
And if you ask yourself,
    “Why has this happened to me?”—
it is because of your many sins
    that your skirts have been torn off
    and your body mistreated.

twi: Etiopiani betumi asesa nʼahosu ana?Na ɔsebɔ nso betumi asesa ne ho nsisimu no?Saa ara na worentumi nyɛ papa,wo a bɔneyɛ akokwaw wo no.
english:
Can an Ethiopian change his skin
    or a leopard its spots?
Neither can you do good
    who are accustomed to doing evil.

twi: “Mɛbɔ mo ahwete sɛ ntɛtɛ a,nweatam so mframa rebɔ no.
english:
“I will scatter you like chaff
    driven by the desert wind.

twi: Eyi ne nea mubenya,mo kyɛfa a mahyɛ ama mo,”Awurade na ose,“efisɛ mo werɛ afi mena mode mo ho ato anyame huhuw so.
english:
This is your lot,
    the portion I have decreed for you,”
declares the Lord,
“because you have forgotten me
    and trusted in false gods.

twi: Mɛtwe mo fam ntade abua mo animna wɔahu mo ahohora.
english:
I will pull up your skirts over your face
    that your shame may be seen—

twi: Mo aguamammɔ ne mo akɔnnɔ bɔne,mo aguamammɔ a momfɛre ho!Mahu mo nneyɛe bɔne nowɔ nkoko ne sare so.Due, Yerusalem!Wobɛyɛ fi akosi da bɛn?”
english:
your adulteries and lustful neighings,
    your shameless prostitution!
I have seen your detestable acts
    on the hills and in the fields.
Woe to you, Jerusalem!
    How long will you be unclean?”

twi: Nsuyow, Ɔkɔm, AfoaEyi ne Awurade asɛm a ɔde maa Yeremia a ɛfa nsuyow ho:
english: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

twi: “Yuda resu,ne nkuropɔn hu amane;wɔbɔ asase no ho abubuw,na osu foro fi Yerusalem kɔ.
english:
“Judah mourns,
    her cities languish;
they wail for the land,
    and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

twi: Mmapɔmma soma wɔn asomfo ma wɔkɔhwehwɛ nsu;wɔkɔhwɛ ahina munanso wonnya nsu.Wɔde wɔn asuhina san ba a hwee nni mu;wɔde awerɛhow ne abawpakatakata wɔn ti so.
Asase no apaapae,efisɛ osu ntɔ wɔ asase no so;akuafo no koma atutuna wɔkata wɔn ti so.
english:
The ground is cracked
    because there is no rain in the land;
the farmers are dismayed
    and cover their heads.

twi: Mpo ɔforotebere a ɔwɔ sare sogyaw ne ba a wawo no foforo,efisɛ sare biara nni hɔ.
english:
Even the doe in the field
    deserts her newborn fawn
    because there is no grass.

twi: Sare so mfurum gyinagyina nkoko wosee no sohome sɛ sakraman;wɔkrankran wɔn ani hwehwɛ didibeananso wonhu bi.”
english:
Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights
    and pant like jackals;
their eyes fail
    for lack of food.”

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ yɛn amumɔyɛ di adanse tia yɛn de,nanso Awurade, wo din nti yɛ ho biribi.Yɛn atuatew dɔɔso;na yɛayɛ bɔne atia wo.
english:
Although our sins testify against us,
    do something, Lord, for the sake of your name.
For we have often rebelled;
    we have sinned against you.

twi: Wo a woyɛ Israel Anidaso,nʼAgyenkwa wɔ amanehunu mmere mu,adɛn nti na woayɛ sɛ ɔhɔho wɔ asase no so,sɛ ɔkwantuni a ɔsoɛ anadwo?
english:
You who are the hope of Israel,
    its Savior in times of distress,
why are you like a stranger in the land,
    like a traveler who stays only a night?

twi: Adɛn nti na woayɛ sɛ obi a ade afu ne mu yi,sɛ ɔkofo a onni ahoɔden a ɔde boa?Wowɔ yɛn ntam, Awuradena wo din da yɛn so;nnyaw yɛn mu!
english:
Why are you like a man taken by surprise,
    like a warrior powerless to save?
You are among us, Lord,
    and we bear your name;
    do not forsake us!

twi: Eyi ne nea Awurade ka fa saa nnipa yi ho:“Wɔn ani gye akyinkyinakyinkyin ho yiye;wɔmma wɔn anan nhome.Ɛno nti Awurade nnye wɔn nto mu;afei ɔbɛkae wɔn amumɔyɛsɛm nona watwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho.”
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Mmɔ yiyeyɛ ho mpae mma saa nnipa yi.
english: Then the Lord said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

twi: Mmom ɛwɔ mu sɛ wodi mmuada de, nso merentie wɔn sufrɛ; ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre ne aduan afɔre de, nso merennye. Mmom, mede afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm bɛsɛe wɔn.”
english: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague.”

twi: Nanso mekae se, “Ao, Otumfo Awurade, adiyifo no ka kyerɛ wɔn daa se, ‘Morenhu afoa, na ɔkɔm remma. Nokware mɛma mo asomdwoe a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa wɔ ha.’ ”
english: But I said, “Alas, Sovereign Lord! The prophets keep telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’”

twi: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Adiyifo no hyɛ akɔntoro wɔ me din mu. Mensomaa wɔn, minnyii wɔn na menkasa nkyerɛɛ wɔn ɛ. Wɔrehyɛ nkɔm fa atoro anisoadehu, asumansɛm, abosonsom ne wɔn ankasa nnaadaa adwene ho.
english: Then the Lord said to me, “The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.

twi: Ɛno nti, nea Awurade ka fa adiyifo a wɔde me din hyɛ nkɔm no ho ni: mensomaa wɔn nanso wɔka se, ‘Afoa biara anaa ɔkɔm biara remma asase yi so.’ Saa adiyifo no ara bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano ne ɔkɔm mu.
english: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.

twi: Na nnipa a wɔhyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ wɔn no, wɔbɛtotow wɔn agu Yerusalem mmɔnten so esiane ɔkɔm ne afoa nti. Wɔrenya obiara nsie wɔn: wɔn yerenom, wɔn mmabarima anaa wɔn mmabea. Mɛma amanehunu a ɛfata wɔn aba wɔn so.
english: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.

twi: “Ka saa asɛm yi kyerɛ wɔn:“ ‘ma nisu nguare meanadwo ne awia, a to ntwa,efisɛ Ɔbabea Babun no, me nkurɔfo,anya apirakuru a ɛyɛ huna ɛyɛ ahodwiriw mmoroso.
Sɛ mekɔ ɔman no mu a,mihu nnipa a wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano;sɛ mekɔ kuropɔn no mu amihu ɔkɔm nsunsuanso.Odiyifo ne ɔsɔfo nyinaakɔ asase a wonnim so so.’ ”
Woapo Yuda koraa ana?Wubu Sion animtiaa ana?Adɛn nti na wode ɔhaw aba yɛn sona yennya ayaresa?Yɛn ani daa asomdwoe so,nanso ade papa biara mmaa ɛ;yɛn ani daa ayaresa bere sonanso ehu na ɛbae.
english:
Have you rejected Judah completely?
    Do you despise Zion?
Why have you afflicted us
    so that we cannot be healed?
We hoped for peace
    but no good has come,
for a time of healing
    but there is only terror.

twi: Awurade, yegye yɛn amumɔyɛne yɛn agyanom afɔdi to mu;nokware, yɛayɛ bɔne atia wo.
Na wo din nti mmu yɛn animtiaa;nhura wʼanuonyam ahengua no ho.Kae wo ne yɛn apam nona mmu so.
english:
For the sake of your name do not despise us;
    do not dishonor your glorious throne.
Remember your covenant with us
    and do not break it.

twi: Na amanaman ahoni ahuhuw no mu bi ma osu tɔ ana?Wim ankasa na ɛtɔ obosu ana?Dabi da, ɛyɛ wo, Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn.Enti wo so na yɛn ani da,na wo na woyɛ eyinom nyinaa.
english:
Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain?
    Do the skies themselves send down showers?
No, it is you, Lord our God.
    Therefore our hope is in you,
    for you are the one who does all this.

twi: Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Sɛ mpo, Mose ne Samuel begyinaa mʼanim a anka me koma rentɔ nkɔ saa nnipa yi so. Ma womfi mʼani so! Ma wɔnkɔ!
english: Then the Lord said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!

twi: Na sɛ wobisa wo se, ‘Ɛhe na yɛnkɔ’ a, ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“ ‘Wɔn a wɔahyɛ owu ama wɔn no, bɛkɔ owu mu;wɔn a wɔahyɛ afoa ama wɔn no bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano;wɔn a wɔahyɛ ɔkɔm ama wɔn no, ɔkɔm bɛde wɔn;wɔn a wɔahyɛ nnommumfa ama wɔn no bɛkɔ nnommum mu.’
“Mede adesɛefo ahorow anan bɛba wɔn so,” Awurade na ose, “afoa a ebekunkum wɔn, akraman a wɔbɛtwe wɔn ase akɔ, wim nnomaa ne asase so mmoa a wɔbɛtetew wɔn nam asɛe wɔn.
english: “I will send four kinds of destroyers against them,” declares the Lord, “the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds and the wild animals to devour and destroy.

twi: Mɛma wɔayɛ akyiwade ama asase so ahenni nyinaa, esiane nea Yudahene Hesekia babarima Manase yɛɛ wɔ Yerusalem nti.
english: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

twi: “Hena na obehu wo mmɔbɔ, Yerusalem?Hena na obegyam wo?Hena na obegyina abisa sɛnea wo ho te?
english:
“Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem?
    Who will mourn for you?
    Who will stop to ask how you are?

twi: Woapo me,” Awurade na ose.“Wugu akyirisan so ara.Ɛno nti mɛteɛ me nsa wɔ wo so na masɛe wo.Me yam renhyehye me mma wo bio.
english:
You have rejected me,” declares the Lord.
    “You keep on backsliding.
So I will reach out and destroy you;
    I am tired of holding back.

twi: Mede nhuhuwso apampaa behuhuw wɔn sowɔ asase no kuropɔn apon ano.Mede owu ne ɔsɛe bɛba me nkurɔfo so,efisɛ wɔnsakraa wɔn akwan ɛ.
english:
I will winnow them with a winnowing fork
    at the city gates of the land.
I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people,
    for they have not changed their ways.

twi: Mɛma wɔn akunafo adɔɔsoasen mpoano nwea.Mede ɔsɛefo bɛba owigyinae,abɛhaw wɔn mmerante nanom;mpofirim medeɔyaw ne ehu bɛba wɔn so.
english:
I will make their widows more numerous
    than the sand of the sea.
At midday I will bring a destroyer
    against the mothers of their young men;
suddenly I will bring down on them
    anguish and terror.

twi: Ɔbeatan a wawo ason bɛtɔ beraw,na wagyaa mu.Ne wia bɛtɔ wɔ bere a ade nsaa ɛ;wobegu nʼanim ase abrɛ no ase.Mede nkae no bɛma afoawɔ wɔn atamfo anim,”Awurade na ose.
english:
The mother of seven will grow faint
    and breathe her last.
Her sun will set while it is still day;
    she will be disgraced and humiliated.
I will put the survivors to the sword
    before their enemies,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Ao, me na a wowoo me,onipa a asase no sofo nyinaa ne me ham, di aperepere!Memfɛm obi biribi na memmɔɔ bosea mfii obi hɔ ɛ,nanso obiara dome me.
english:
Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth,
    a man with whom the whole land strives and contends!
I have neither lent nor borrowed,
    yet everyone curses me.

twi: Awurade kae se,“Nokware megye wo ama botae pa bi;ampa ara mɛma wʼatamfo apa wo kyɛwwɔ amanehunu ne ahohia mmere mu.
english:
The Lord said,
“Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose;
    surely I will make your enemies plead with you
    in times of disaster and times of distress.

twi: “Onipa betumi abu dade mudade a efi atifi fam, anaa kɔbere?
english:
“Can a man break iron—
    iron from the north—or bronze?

twi: “Mo ahode ne mo nnwetɛbonamede bɛma sɛ wɔmfom a wɔrentua ka,esiane mo nnebɔne nyinaawɔ mo man no mu nti.
english:
“Your wealth and your treasures
    I will give as plunder, without charge,
because of all your sins
    throughout your country.

twi: Mede mo bɛyɛ nkoa ama mo atamfowɔ ɔman a munnim so so,mʼabufuw bɛma ogya adɛwna ɛbɛhyew mo.”
english:
I will enslave you to your enemies
    in a land you do not know,
for my anger will kindle a fire
    that will burn against you.”

twi: Wote ase, Awurade;kae me na hwɛ me so.Tɔ wɔn a wɔtaa me no so were.Wowɔ abodwokyɛre, mma me nwu;hwɛ sɛnea wo nti wɔbɔ me ahohora.
Wo nsɛm bae no, midii;ɛyɛɛ mʼahosɛpɛw ne me koma apɛde,na wo din da me so,Ao, Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn.
Mantena wɔn a wogye wɔn ani fekuw mu,ne wɔn annye wɔn ani;metew me ho tenae, efisɛ wo nsa daa me sona wʼabufuw hyɛɛ me ma.
english:
I never sat in the company of revelers,
    never made merry with them;
I sat alone because your hand was on me
    and you had filled me with indignation.

twi: Adɛn nti na me yaw to ntwa dana mʼapirakuru ayɛ akisikuru a ano yɛ den?Wopɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ nnaadaa asuwa ma me,sɛ asuti a ɛyow ana?
english:
Why is my pain unending
    and my wound grievous and incurable?
You are to me like a deceptive brook,
    like a spring that fails.

twi: Enti sɛɛ na Awurade se,“Sɛ wosakra wʼadwene a megye wo ato mu biona woasom me;sɛ nsɛm a edi mu fi wʼanom, na ɛnyɛ nsɛm huhuw a,wobɛyɛ me kasamafo.Ma saa nnipa yi nnan mmra wo nkyɛn,na wo de, ɛnsɛ sɛ wodan kɔ wɔn nkyɛn.
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord says:
“If you repent, I will restore you
    that you may serve me;
if you utter worthy, not worthless, words,
    you will be my spokesman.
Let this people turn to you,
    but you must not turn to them.

twi: Mede wo bɛyɛ ɔfasu ama saa nnipa yi,bammɔ fasu a wɔde kɔbere ato;wɔne wo bedi asinanso wɔrenni wo so nkonim,efisɛ me ne wo wɔ hɔsɛ meyi wo na magye wo nkwa,”Awurade, na ose.
english:
I will make you a wall to this people,
    a fortified wall of bronze;
they will fight against you
    but will not overcome you,
for I am with you
    to rescue and save you,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Megye wo nkwa afi amumɔyɛfo nsamna mayi wo afi atirimɔdenfo nsam.”
english:
“I will save you from the hands of the wicked
    and deliver you from the grasp of the cruel.”

twi: Amanehunu DaAfei Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

twi: “Ɛnsɛ sɛ woware na wowo mmabarima anaa mmabea wɔ ha.”
english: “You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade ka fa mmabarima ne mmabea a wɔwo wɔn asase yi so; mmea a wɔyɛ wɔn nanom ne mmarima a wɔyɛ wɔn agyanom no ho:
english: For this is what the Lord says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:

twi: “Owuyare bekunkum wɔn. Wɔrensu wɔn na wɔrensie wɔn, mmom wɔbɛyɛ sɛ sumina a egugu fam. Wɔbɛtotɔ afoa ano na ɔkɔm bekunkum wɔn na wɔn afunu bɛyɛ aduan ama wim nnomaa ne asase so mmoa.”
english: “They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like dung lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.”

twi: “Nhyɛn ofi a ayiyɛ aponto wo mu; nkosu wɔn abia, na mma wɔn hyɛden, efisɛ mayi me nhyira, me dɔ ne mʼahummɔbɔ afi saa nnipa yi so,” Awurade na ose.
english: For this is what the Lord says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people,” declares the Lord.

twi: Atitiriw ne mpapahwekwa bewuwu wɔ asase yi so. Wɔrensie wɔn na wɔrensu wɔn na obiara remmɔ ne ho kam, na ɔrenyi ne ti wɔ wɔn nti.
english: “Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut themselves or shave their head for the dead.

twi: Obiara remma wɔn a wodi awufo no ho awerɛhow no aduan mfa nkyekye wɔn werɛ, owufo no agya anaa ne na mpo, obiara remma wɔn nsa mfa nkyekye wɔn werɛ.
english: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even for a father or a mother—nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.

twi: “Na nhyɛn ofi a aponto kɔ so wɔ mu nkɔtena ase, nnidi na nnom.
english: “And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

twi: Na sɛɛ na Awurade Tumfo, Israel Nyankopɔn no se: Wo nkwanna mu a wʼani tua no, mede ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nnyigyei, ayeforokunu ne ayeforo ahosɛpɛw nne a ɛwɔ ha no bɛba awiei.
english: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.

twi: “Sɛ woka eyinom nyinaa kyerɛ saa nnipa yi na wobisa wo se, ‘Adɛn nti na Awurade abɔ atoyerɛnkyɛm a ɛyɛ hu sɛɛ atia yɛn? Dɛn mfomso na yɛayɛ? Bɔne bɛn na yɛayɛ atia Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn’ a,
english: “When you tell these people all this and they ask you, ‘Why has the Lord decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the Lord our God?’

twi: ɛno de ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Efisɛ mo agyanom gyaw me hɔ kodii anyame foforo akyi, kɔsom wɔn sɔree wɔn, Awurade asɛm ni. Wogyaw me na wɔanni me mmara so.
english: then say to them, ‘It is because your ancestors forsook me,’ declares the Lord, ‘and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.

twi: Na mo de, moayɛ amumɔyɛsɛm asen mo agyanom. Monhwɛ sɛnea mo mu biara di ne koma bɔne asoɔden akyi wɔ bere a anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ osetie ma me.
english: But you have behaved more wickedly than your ancestors. See how all of you are following the stubbornness of your evil hearts instead of obeying me.

twi: Ɛno nti, metu mo afi saa asase yi so de mo akɔ asase a, mo anaasɛ mo agyanom nnim so, na mobɛsom anyame foforo wɔ hɔ awia ne anadwo, na merenhu mo mmɔbɔ.’
english: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

twi: “Nanso nna no reba,” Awurade na ose, “a nnipa renka bio se, ‘Sɛ Awurade te ase yi, nea oyii Israelfo fii Misraim,’
english: “However, the days are coming,” declares the Lord, “when it will no longer be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’

twi: mmom, wɔbɛka se, ‘Sɛ Awurade te ase yi nea oyii Israelfo fii atifi fam asase ne aman a otuu wɔn kɔɔ so nyinaa.’ Efisɛ mɛsan de wɔn aba asase a mede maa wɔn tete agyanom no no so.
english: but it will be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.

twi: “Na mprempren, mɛsoma apopofo bebree a wɔbɛkyere wɔn.” Awurade na ose. “Ɛno akyi, mɛsoma akɔfa abɔmmɔfo bebree a wɔbɛtaataa wɔn wɔ mmepɔw ne nkoko nyinaa so ne abotan atokuru mu.
english: “But now I will send for many fishermen,” declares the Lord, “and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.

twi: Mʼani tua wɔn akwan nyinaa; enhintaw me, na wɔn bɔne nso nhintaw wɔ mʼani so.
english: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.

twi: Metua wɔn amumɔyɛ ne wɔn bɔne so ka mprenu, efisɛ wɔde aniwude nsɛsode a enni nkwa ne wɔn ahoni a ɛyɛ akyiwade abɛhyɛ mʼagyapade so ma de agu mʼasase ho fi.”
english: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols.”

twi: Awurade, mʼahoɔden ne mʼabandennen,mʼahohia mu guankɔbea,wo nkyɛn na amanaman no bɛba;wobefi nsase ano aka se,“Yɛn agyanom annya biribiara sɛ anyame huhuw,ahoni a wɔn so nni mfaso na wɔammoa wɔn.
english:
Lord, my strength and my fortress,
    my refuge in time of distress,
to you the nations will come
    from the ends of the earth and say,
“Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods,
    worthless idols that did them no good.

twi: Nnipa yɛ wɔn ankasa anyame ana?Yiw, nanso wɔnyɛ nokware anyame!”
english:
Do people make their own gods?
    Yes, but they are not gods!”

twi: “Ɛno nti mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn,saa bere yi nea mɛkyerɛ wɔn,me tumi ne mʼahoɔden.Afei wobehu sɛme din ne Awurade.
english:
“Therefore I will teach them—
    this time I will teach them
    my power and might.
Then they will know
    that my name is the Lord.

twi: “Wɔde dade kyerɛwdua akrukyerɛw Yuda bɔne,dade kyerɛwdua a ano te sɛ kyerɛwbo,wɔ wɔn koma apon sone wɔn afɔremuka mmɛn so.
english:
“Judah’s sin is engraved with an iron tool,
    inscribed with a flint point,
on the tablets of their hearts
    and on the horns of their altars.

twi: Mpo, wɔn mma kaewɔn afɔremuka ne Asera nnuaa ɛwɔ nnua a adennan no nkyɛnne nkoko atenten no so.
english:
Even their children remember
    their altars and Asherah poles
beside the spreading trees
    and on the high hills.

twi: Me mmepɔw a ɛwɔ asase no so,mo ahonyade ne mo nnwetɛbona nyinaamede bɛma sɛ asade,ɛne mo sorɔnsorɔmmea nso,esiane mo man no so bɔne nti.
english:
My mountain in the land
    and your wealth and all your treasures
I will give away as plunder,
    together with your high places,
    because of sin throughout your country.

twi: Mo ankasa mfomso nti mobɛhwereagyapade a mede maa mo no.Mede mo bɛyɛ nkoa ama mo atamfowɔ asase a munnim so so,efisɛ moahwanyan mʼabufuw,na ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.”
english:
Through your own fault you will lose
    the inheritance I gave you.
I will enslave you to your enemies
    in a land you do not know,
for you have kindled my anger,
    and it will burn forever.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se,“Nnome nka nea ɔde ne ho to onipa so,nea ɔde ne ho to ɔhonam so pɛ nʼahoɔdenna ne koma dan fi Awurade ho.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Cursed is the one who trusts in man,
    who draws strength from mere flesh
    and whose heart turns away from the Lord.

twi: Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ wura a ɛwɔ nsase tamaa so;sɛ yiyedi ba a ɔrenhu,ɔbɛtena nweatam a awo so,ne nkyene asase a obi nte so so.
english:
That person will be like a bush in the wastelands;
    they will not see prosperity when it comes.
They will dwell in the parched places of the desert,
    in a salt land where no one lives.

twi: “Nhyira nka onipa a ɔde ne ho to Awurade so,na nʼanidaso wɔ ne mu.
english:
“But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord,
    whose confidence is in him.

twi: Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ dua a wɔadua no asu hona ne ntin teɛ kɔ asu no mu.Sɛ ahuhuru ba a onsuro;ne nhaban yɛ frɔmfrɔm mmere nyinaa.Onni ɔhaw biara wɔ afe a osu ntɔ muna ɛkɔ so sow aba daa.”
english:
They will be like a tree planted by the water
    that sends out its roots by the stream.
It does not fear when heat comes;
    its leaves are always green.
It has no worries in a year of drought
    and never fails to bear fruit.”

twi: Koma yɛ nnaadaa sen ade nyinaana ano nni aduru.Hena na ɔbɛte nʼase?
english:
The heart is deceitful above all things
    and beyond cure.
    Who can understand it?

twi: “Me Awurade, mepɛɛpɛɛ koma muna mehwehwɛ adwene mu,gyina so de tua onipa ka sɛnea nʼabrabɔ te,ne sɛnea ɛfata ne nneyɛe.”
english:
“I the Lord search the heart
    and examine the mind,
to reward each person according to their conduct,
    according to what their deeds deserve.”

twi: Sɛnea asɛmɛntɛ a osow nkesua a ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔtowee no,saa ara na onipa a onya sika a ɔmfa ɔkwan pa so no te.Sɛ obu ne nkwa nna mu abien a wobegyaw no mu,na awiei no, ne kwasea bɛda adi.
english:
Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay
    are those who gain riches by unjust means.
When their lives are half gone, their riches will desert them,
    and in the end they will prove to be fools.

twi: Anuonyam ahengua a wɔama so fi mfiase no,ne yɛn kronkronbea.
english:
A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning,
    is the place of our sanctuary.

twi: Awurade, woyɛ Israel anidaso,wɔn a wɔpa wʼakyi nyinaa ani bewu.Wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi wo ho no, wobesie wɔnefisɛ wɔagyaw Awuradea ɔyɛ nkwa asuti no.
english:
Lord, you are the hope of Israel;
    all who forsake you will be put to shame.
Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust
    because they have forsaken the Lord,
    the spring of living water.

twi: Sa me yare Awurade, na me ho bɛtɔ me;gye me na menya nkwa,na wo ne ɔbaako a mekamfo wo.
Wobisa me daa sɛ,“Ɛhe na Awurade asɛm no wɔ?Ma ɛmmra mu mprempren!”
english:
They keep saying to me,
    “Where is the word of the Lord?
    Let it now be fulfilled!”

twi: Minnguan mfii mʼadwuma sɛ wo guanhwɛfo ho;wunim sɛ menhwehwɛɛ abasamtu da.Nea efi mʼanom yɛ pefee wɔ wʼanim.
Nhunahuna me;wo ne me guankɔbea wɔ amanehunu da.
english:
Do not be a terror to me;
    you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔtaa me anim ngu ase,na yi me fi ahohora mu.Ma wɔmmɔ hu,nanso mma me koma ntu.Ma amanehunu da no mmra wɔn so;fa ɔhawprenu sɛe wɔn.
Monyɛ Homeda No KronkronSɛɛ na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me, “Kɔ na kogyina nnipa no pon a Yuda ahemfo di hɔ ahyɛmfiri no; kogyina Yerusalem apon a aka no nso ano.
english: This is what the Lord said to me: “Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

twi: Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Muntie Awurade asɛm, mo Yuda ahemfo ne Yudafo nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem a wɔfa saa apon yi mu.
english: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, you kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se: Monhwɛ yiye na moansoa nnesoa Homeda anaa moamfa amfa Yerusalem apon mu.
english: This is what the Lord says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

twi: Monnsoa adesoa mfi mo afi mu na monnyɛ adwuma biara Homeda, na mmom monyɛ Homeda no kronkron, sɛnea mehyɛɛ mo agyanom no.
english: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.

twi: Nanso wɔantie na wɔammu; wɔyɛɛ asoɔden, wɔantie na wɔampɛ nteɛso.
english: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.

twi: Nanso sɛ mohwɛ yiye na moyɛ osetie ma me a, sɛɛ na Awurade se, na moamfa nnesoa amfa saa kuropɔn yi apon mu Homeda, na sɛ moyɛ Homeda no kronkron a monnyɛ adwuma biara a,
english: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the Lord, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,

twi: ɛno de ahemfo a wɔte Dawid ahengua so ne wɔn adwumayɛfo bɛfa saa apon yi mu. Wɔn nyinaa bɛba a wɔtete nteaseɛnam mu ne apɔnkɔ so, a Yuda mmarima ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem ka ho, na nnipa bɛtena kuropɔn yi mu daa nyinaa.
english: then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

twi: Nnipa befi Yuda nkurow ne nkuraa a atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no aba, wobefi Benyamin asase ne atɔe fam nkoko so, wobefi mmepɔw, mantam ne Negeb aba a wɔde ɔhyew afɔrebɔde ne afɔrebɔ, aduan afɔrebɔde, nnuhuam ne aseda afɔrebɔde reba Awurade fi.
english: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord.

twi: Nanso sɛ moanyɛ osetie amma me, anyɛ Homeda no kronkron, na sɛ mosoa adesoa biara fa Yerusalem apon mu Homeda a, ɛno de mɛsɔ ogya a ɛrennum da wɔ Yerusalem apon mu na abɛhyew nʼaban ahorow no.’ ”
english: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.’”

twi: Ɔnwemfo No FiEyi ne Awurade asɛm a ɛbaa Yeremia nkyɛn.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord:

twi: “Kɔ ɔnwemfo no fi, na hɔ na mede mʼasɛm no bɛma wo.”
english: “Go down to the potter’s house, and there I will give you my message.”

twi: Ɛno nti, mekɔɔ ɔnwemfo no fi na mihuu no sɛ, ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ne ntwahode so.
english: So I went down to the potter’s house, and I saw him working at the wheel.

twi: Nanso kuku a na ɔde dɔte no reyɛ ho adwuma no sɛe wɔ ne nsam; ɛno nti ɔnwemfo no yɛɛ kuku foforo, sɛnea eye pa ara ma no.
english: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.

twi: Afei Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me.

twi: “Israelfi, merentumi nyɛ mo sɛnea ɔnwemfo yi yɛ ana?” Awurade na ose. “Sɛnea dɔte te wɔ ɔnwemfo nsam no, saa ara na mote wɔ me nsam, Israelfi.
english: He said, “Can I not do with you, Israel, as this potter does?” declares the Lord. “Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, Israel.

twi: Sɛ bere biara meka se ɛsɛ sɛ wotutu ɔman bi anaa ahenni bi ase, dwerɛw wɔn, sɛe wɔn a,
english: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,

twi: na sɛ ɔman a mebɔɔ no kɔkɔ no sakra fi ne bɔne ho a, mɛsakra mʼadwene na meremfa amanehunu a misusuwii sɛ mede bɛba wɔn so mma bio.
english: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.

twi: Na sɛ mmere foforo bi meka se, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyekye ɔman anaa ahenni bi gye no si hɔ,
english: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

twi: na sɛ ɔyɛ bɔne wɔ mʼani so na wanyɛ osetie amma me a, ɛno de mesan adwene papa a mepɛɛ sɛ meyɛ no no ho.
english: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

twi: “Na afei ka kyerɛ Yudafo ne wɔn a wɔtete Yerusalem no se, ‘Sɛɛ na Awurade se: Hwɛ! mede amanehunu reba mo so, na mereyɛ nhyehyɛe a etia mo. Ɛno nti mo mu biara nnan mfi nʼakwammɔne so na munsiesie mo akwan ne mo nneyɛe.’
english: “Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘This is what the Lord says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.’

twi: Nanso wobebua se, ‘So nni mfaso. Yɛbɛkɔ so adi yɛn ara yɛn nhyehyɛe so; yɛn mu biara bɛyɛ asoɔden a efi ne koma bɔne mu.’ ”
english: But they will reply, ‘It’s no use. We will continue with our own plans; we will all follow the stubbornness of our evil hearts.’”

twi: Ɛno nti nea Awurade se ni,“Mummisa wɔ amanaman no mu se,hena na wate biribi sɛɛ pɛn?Ɔbabun Israel ayɛade bi a ɛyɛ hu yiye.
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord says:
“Inquire among the nations:
    Who has ever heard anything like this?
A most horrible thing has been done
    by Virgin Israel.

twi: So sukyerɛmma a ɛwɔ Lebanon noyera fi nʼabotan a esian no so ana?So nʼatifi nsu wiridudu a efi akyirikyirino gyae sen ana?
english:
Does the snow of Lebanon
    ever vanish from its rocky slopes?
Do its cool waters from distant sources
    ever stop flowing?
