twi: Ribla hɔ na Babiloniahene kunkum Sedekia mmabarima wɔ nʼanim na okum Yudafo mmapɔmma nyinaa nso.
english: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and also killed all the nobles of Judah.

twi: Afei otutuu Sedekia ani, de kɔbere mfrafrae mpokyerɛ guu no sɛ ɔde no rekɔ Babilonia.
english: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

twi: Babiloniafo no de ogya too ahemfi no ne nnipa no afi mu, na wodwiriw Yerusalem afasu no.
english: The Babylonians set fire to the royal palace and the houses of the people and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

twi: Ɔsahene Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no de kuropɔn no mu nkae, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho kɔmaa no ne nnipa a wɔaka no kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilonia.
english: Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard carried into exile to Babylon the people who remained in the city, along with those who had gone over to him, and the rest of the people.

twi: Nanso ɔsahene Nebusaradan a otua awɛmfo no ano no gyaa ahiafo a wonni hwee no mu bi wɔ Yuda asase so, na saa bere no ɔmaa wɔn bobe nturo ne nsase.
english: But Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people, who owned nothing; and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.

twi: Na Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar afa ɔsahene Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no so ama saa ɔhyɛ nsɛm yi a ɛfa Yeremia ho se,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given these orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard:

twi: “Fa no na hwɛ no so; nhaw no na nea obisa biara no, yɛ ma no.”
english: “Take him and look after him; don’t harm him but do for him whatever he asks.”

twi: Enti ɔsahene Nebusaradan a otua awɛmfo no ano, Nebusaradan, adwumayɛfo panyin, Nergal-Sareser a ɔyɛ otitiriw ne Babiloniahene adwumayɛfo a wɔaka no nyinaa
english: So Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard, Nebushazban a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officers of the king of Babylon

twi: soma ma wɔkɔfaa Yeremia fii awɛmfo adiwo hɔ bae. Wɔde no hyɛɛ Safan babarima Gedalia babarima Ahikam nsa sɛ ɔmfa no nkɔ ne fi. Enti Yeremia tenaa nʼankasa nkurɔfo mu.
english: sent and had Jeremiah taken out of the courtyard of the guard. They turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him back to his home. So he remained among his own people.

twi: Bere a Yeremia da so da afiase wɔ awɛmfo adiwo hɔ no, Awurade asɛm baa ne nkyɛn se,
english: While Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the Lord came to him:

twi: “Kɔka kyerɛ Kusni Ebed-Melek se, ‘Sɛnea Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se ni: Me nsɛm a etia kuropɔn yi, mede refa amanehunu so na ɛnyɛ yiyedi so ama aba mu. Saa bere no ɛbɛba mu wɔ wʼanim.
english: “Go and tell Ebed-Melek the Cushite, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am about to fulfill my words against this city—words concerning disaster, not prosperity. At that time they will be fulfilled before your eyes.

twi: Nanso megye wo saa da no, Awurade na ose; wɔremfa wo nhyɛ wɔn a wusuro wɔn no nsa.
english: But I will rescue you on that day, declares the Lord; you will not be given into the hands of those you fear.

twi: Megye wo nkwa, na worentɔ wɔ afoa ano na mmom wubenya wo ti adidi mu, efisɛ wugye me di, Awurade, na ose.’ ”
english: I will save you; you will not fall by the sword but will escape with your life, because you trust in me, declares the Lord.’”

twi: Wogyaa YeremiaƆsahene Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no gyaa Yeremia wɔ Rama akyi no, asɛm no fi Awurade nkyɛn baa Yeremia hɔ. Ohuu sɛ wɔagu Yeremia nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn wɔ nnommum a wofi Yerusalem ne Yuda a na wɔde wɔn rekɔ Babilonia no mu.
english: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord after Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had released him at Ramah. He had found Jeremiah bound in chains among all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being carried into exile to Babylon.

twi: Bere a ɔsahene a otua awɛmfo no ano no huu Yeremia no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔhyɛɛ saa amanehunu yi maa beae yi.
english: When the commander of the guard found Jeremiah, he said to him, “The Lord your God decreed this disaster for this place.

twi: Na afei, Awurade ama aba mu, wayɛ sɛnea ɔkaa se ɔbɛyɛ no. Eyinom nyinaa baa mu, efisɛ mo saa nnipa yi yɛɛ bɔne tiaa Awurade na moanyɛ osetie amma no.
english: And now the Lord has brought it about; he has done just as he said he would. All this happened because you people sinned against the Lord and did not obey him.

twi: Nanso nnɛ mereyi wo afi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a egu wo nsa no mu. Sɛ wopɛ a, ma yɛnkɔ Babilonia na mɛhwɛ wo so, nanso sɛ wompɛ de a, mma. Hwɛ ɔman no nyinaa na ɛda wʼanim no, kɔ baabiara a wopɛ.”
english: But today I am freeing you from the chains on your wrists. Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don’t come. Look, the whole country lies before you; go wherever you please.”

twi: Na ansa na Yeremia bɛdan ne ho akɔ no, Nebusaradan ka kaa ho se, “San kɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia a, ɔyɛ Safan nena, a Babiloniahene apa no sɛ ɔnhwɛ Yuda nkurow so no nkyɛn na wo ne no nkɔtena wɔ nnipa no mu, anaasɛ kɔ baabi foforo biara a wopɛ.”Na ɔsahene no maa Yeremia aduan ne akyɛde, na ɔmaa no kɔe.
english:
However, before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the towns of Judah, and live with him among the people, or go anywhere else you please.”
Then the commander gave him provisions and a present and let him go.

twi: Enti Yeremia kɔɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa, na ɔne no tenaa nnipa a wɔkaa wɔ asase no so no mu.
english: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left behind in the land.

twi: Wokum GedaliaBere a asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa ne wɔn mmarima a wɔda so wɔ wuram no tee sɛ, Babiloniahene ayɛ Ahikam babarima Gedalia amrado wɔ asase no so, na ɔde mmarima, mmea ne mmofra a wɔyɛ ahiafo wɔ asase no so, na wɔamfa wɔn ankɔ nnommum mu wɔ Babilonia ahyɛ ne nsa no,
english: When all the army officers and their men who were still in the open country heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam as governor over the land and had put him in charge of the men, women and children who were the poorest in the land and who had not been carried into exile to Babylon,

twi: wɔbaa Gedalia hɔ wɔ Mispa: Netania babarima Ismael, Karea mmabarima Yohanan ne Yonatan, Tanhumet babarima Seraia, Efai a ofi Netofa mmabarima, Yesania a ɔyɛ Maakatni babarima ne wɔn mmarima.
english: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.

twi: Na Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena no kaa ntam de hyɛɛ wɔn ne wɔn mmarima den se, “Munnsuro sɛ mobɛsom Babiloniafo. Montena asase no so na monsom Babiloniahene, na ebesi mo yiye.
english: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, took an oath to reassure them and their men. “Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians,” he said. “Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.

twi: Me de, mɛtena Mispa, na masi mo anan mu wɔ Babiloniafo a, wɔba yɛn nkyɛn no mu, na mo de, monkɔboaboa nsa, ahohuru bere mu nnuaba ne ngo ano ngu adekora nkuruwa mu wɔ twabere mu, na montenatena nkurow a moafa no so.”
english: I myself will stay at Mizpah to represent you before the Babylonians who come to us, but you are to harvest the wine, summer fruit and olive oil, and put them in your storage jars, and live in the towns you have taken over.”

twi: Bere a Yudafo a wɔwɔ Moab, Amon, Edom ne aman ahorow a aka no, tee sɛ Babiloniahene agyaw nkae bi wɔ Yuda na wayi Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena sɛ amrado wɔ wɔn so no,
english: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom and all the other countries heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as governor over them,

twi: wɔn nyinaa san baa Yuda asase so fi aman a wɔbɔɔ wɔn petee no so, kɔɔ Gedalia hɔ wɔ Mispa. Na wɔboaboaa nsa ne ahohuru bere mu nnuaba bebree ano wɔ twabere mu.
english: they all came back to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, from all the countries where they had been scattered. And they harvested an abundance of wine and summer fruit.

twi: Na Karea babarima Yohanan ne ntuano asraafo a wɔda so wɔ wuram no baa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa
english: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers still in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah

twi: na wɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Wunnim sɛ, Amonhene Baalis asoma Netania babarima Ismael se, ommekum wo ana?” Nanso Ahikam babarima Gedalia annye wɔn anni.
english: and said to him, “Don’t you know that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.

twi: Na Karea babarima Yohanan ka kyerɛɛ Gedalia wɔ kokoa mu wɔ Mispa se, “Ma minkokum Netania babarima Ismael, na obiara rente. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ okum wo na ɔma Yudafo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no bɔ ahwete, na Yudafo nkae no yera?”
english: Then Johanan son of Kareah said privately to Gedaliah in Mizpah, “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one will know it. Why should he take your life and cause all the Jews who are gathered around you to be scattered and the remnant of Judah to perish?”

twi: Nanso Ahikam babarima Gedalia ka kyerɛɛ Karea babarima Yohanan se, “Nyɛ saa ade yi! Nea woka fa Ismael ho no nyɛ nokware.”
english: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Don’t do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true.”

twi: Ɔsram a ɛto so ason mu no, Elisama babarima Netania babarima Ismael a ɔyɛ ɔdehye a na anka ɔyɛ ɔhene adwumayɛfo no mu baako no ne mmarima du baa Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa. Bere a wɔn nyinaa gu so redidi no,
english: In the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood and had been one of the king’s officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. While they were eating together there,

twi: Netania babarima Ismael ne ne mmarima du no a wɔka ne ho no sɔree na wɔde afoa wɔɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia, a ɔyɛ Safan nena ne nea Babiloniahene ayi no sɛ amrado wɔ asase no so no kum no.
english: Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

twi: Ismael kum Yudafo a na wɔka Gedalia ho wɔ Mispa ne Babilonia asraafo a na wɔwɔ hɔ no nso.
english: Ishmael also killed all the men of Judah who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Babylonian soldiers who were there.

twi: Ade kyee no, ansa na obiara bɛte Gedalia wu no,
english: The day after Gedaliah’s assassination, before anyone knew about it,

twi: mmarima aduɔwɔtwe a wɔayiyi wɔn abogyesɛ, asunsuane wɔn ntade mu na wɔasesa wɔn honam ani fi Sekem, Silo ne Samaria bae a wɔde aduan afɔrebɔde ne nnuhuam reba Awurade fi.
english: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, bringing grain offerings and incense with them to the house of the Lord.

twi: Netania babarima Ismael de agyaadwo fi Mispa kohyiaa wɔn. Bere a ohyiaa wɔn no ɔkae se, “Mommra Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn.”
english: Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he met them, he said, “Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.”

twi: Woduu kuropɔn no mu no, Netania babarima Ismael ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no kum wɔn na wɔtow wɔn afunu guu abura bi mu.
english: When they went into the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men who were with him slaughtered them and threw them into a cistern.

twi: Nanso nnipa no mu du ka kyerɛɛ Ismael se, “Nkum yɛn! Yɛwɔ awi ne atoko, ngo ne ɛwo a yɛde asie wɔ afuw bi mu.” Enti ogyaa wɔn na wankum wɔn nso.
english: But ten of them said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us! We have wheat and barley, olive oil and honey, hidden in a field.” So he let them alone and did not kill them with the others.

twi: Abura a Ismael tow nnipa a okunkum wɔn no afunu ne Gedalia guu mu no, na ɛyɛ nea ɔhene Asa tuu sɛ ne ho bammɔ fa bi de tiaa Israelhene Baasa. Netania babarima Ismael de afunu hyɛɛ no ma.
english: Now the cistern where he threw all the bodies of the men he had killed along with Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made as part of his defense against Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the dead.

twi: Ismael faa nnipa a na wɔaka wɔ Mispa no nyinaa nnommum; ɔhene mmabea ne wɔn a wɔkaa hɔ no nyinaa, wɔn a Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no ayi Ahikam babarima Gedalia sɛ ɔnhwɛ wɔn so no. Netania babarima Ismael faa wɔn nnommum na osii mu kɔɔ Amonfo nkyɛn.
english: Ishmael made captives of all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah—the king’s daughters along with all the others who were left there, over whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.

twi: Bere a Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa tee awudisɛm a Netania babarima Ismael adi no,
english: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,

twi: wɔfaa wɔn asraafo nyinaa sɛ wɔne Netania babarima Ismael rekɔko. Wɔkɔtoo no wɔ ɔtare kɛse bi a ɛwɔ Gibeon ho.
english: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.

twi: Bere a nnipa a wɔka Ismael ho no nyinaa huu Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no, wɔn ani gyei.
english: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.

twi: Nnipa a na Ismael afa wɔn nnommum wɔ Mispa no nyinaa dan kɔɔ Karea babarima Yohanan afa.
english: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.

twi: Nanso Netania babarima Ismael ne ne mmarima baawɔtwe, guan fii Yohanan anim kɔɔ Amonfo nkyɛn.
english: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.

twi: Woguan Kɔ MisraimAfei Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no dii Mispa nkae a ogyee wɔn fii Netania babarima Ismael nsam bere a okum Ahikam babarima Gedalia no akyi no anim: Ɔde asraafo, mmea, mmofra ne asennii adwumayɛfo, fii Gibeon bae.
english: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the people of Mizpah who had survived, whom Johanan had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam—the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had recovered from Gibeon.

twi: Wosii mu sɛ wɔrekɔ Misraim no, wɔsoɛɛ wɔ Gerut Kimham a ɛbɛn Betlehem;
english: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt

twi: na wɔreguan Babiloniafo no. Na wosuro wɔn, efisɛ na Netania babarima Ismael akum Ahikam babarima Gedalia a Babiloniahene yii no sɛ amrado a ɔhwɛ asase no so no.
english: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

twi: Afei asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa a Karea babarima Yohanan ne Hosaia babarima Yesania ka ho, ne nnipa no nyinaa, efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so kɔɔ
english: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached

twi: odiyifo Yeremia nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Yɛsrɛ wo, tie yɛn adesrɛ yi na bɔ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn mpae ma wɔn a wɔaka yi nyinaa. Sɛnea wuhu no, kan no na yɛdɔɔso nanso afei yɛaka kakraa bi.
english: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, “Please hear our petition and pray to the Lord your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.

twi: Bɔ mpae sɛnea Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ yɛn faako a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkɔ ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ.”
english: Pray that the Lord your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do.”

twi: Yeremia buaa wɔn se, “Mate mo asɛm no, na ɔkwan biara so mɛbɔ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn mpae sɛnea moasrɛ no; mɛka nea Awurade bɛka biara akyerɛ mo na meremfa hwee nsie mo.”
english: “I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will certainly pray to the Lord your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the Lord says and will keep nothing back from you.”

twi: Na afei, wɔka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se, “Sɛ yɛanyɛ nea Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn soma wo se ka kyerɛ yɛn no a, ma ɔnyɛ ɔdanseni nokwafo ntia yɛn.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the Lord your God sends you to tell us.

twi: Sɛ yɛpɛ o, sɛ yɛmpɛ o, yɛbɛyɛ osetie ama Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛresoma wo wɔ ne nkyɛn no, sɛnea ebesi yɛn yiye, na yebedi Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn asɛm so.”
english: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the Lord our God.”

twi: Nna du akyi no, Awurade asɛm baa Yeremia hɔ.
english: Ten days later the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.

twi: Enti ɔfrɛɛ Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho ne nnipa no nyinaa; efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so.
english: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.

twi: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a mosomaa me sɛ memfa mo adesrɛ nkɔto nʼanim no se:
english: He said to them, “This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:

twi: ‘Sɛ motena asase yi so a, mesiesie mo na merensɛe mo, medua mo na merentu mo ase, efisɛ me werɛ ahow wɔ amanehunu a mama aba mo so no ho.
english: ‘If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I have relented concerning the disaster I have inflicted on you.

twi: Munnsuro Babiloniahene a mprempren musuro no no. Munnsuro no, Awurade na ose, efisɛ mene mo wɔ hɔ, megye mo, na mayi mo afi ne tumi ase.
english: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the Lord, for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.

twi: Mehu mo mmɔbɔ na ɔno nso ahu mo mmɔbɔ na ɔde mo asan aba mo asase so.’
english: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.’

twi: “Nanso sɛ moka se, ‘Yɛrentena saa asase yi so,’ na ne saa nti moanyɛ osetie amma Awurade mo Nyankopɔn,
english: “However, if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and so disobey the Lord your God,

twi: na sɛ moka se, ‘Dabi, yɛbɛkɔ akɔtena Misraim, faako a yɛrenhu ɔko, na yɛrente akobɛn nnyigyei na aduankɔm renne yɛn a,’
english: and if you say, ‘No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,’

twi: ɛno de tie Awurade asɛm, mo Yuda nkae. Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se, ‘Sɛ moawe ahinam sɛ mobɛkɔ akɔtena Misraim, na sɛ munya kɔtena hɔ a,
english: then hear the word of the Lord, you remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,

twi: ɛno de afoa a musuro no bɛto mo wɔ hɔ na ɔkɔm a, mo koma tu wɔ ho no bedi mo akyi akɔ Misraim na hɔ na mubewuwu.
english: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.

twi: Nokware wɔn a wɔasi wɔn adwene pi sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Misraim akɔtena hɔ no bewuwu wɔ afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm ano, na wɔn mu baako po renka anaa ɔrenguan mfi amanehunu a mede bɛba wɔn so no mu.’
english: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.’

twi: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se, ‘Sɛnea mʼabufuw ne mʼabufuwhyew hwie guu nnipa a wɔwɔ Yerusalem so no, saa ara na sɛ, mokɔ Misraim a, mʼabufuwhyew behwie agu mo so. Mobɛyɛ nnome, ahodwiriwde, afɔbu ne ahohora; morenhu saa beae yi bio.’
english: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach; you will never see this place again.’

twi: “Yuda nkae, Awurade aka akyerɛ mo se, ‘Monnkɔ Misraim.’ Mommma mo werɛ mmfi, nnɛ merebɔ mo kɔkɔ
english: “Remnant of Judah, the Lord has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Be sure of this: I warn you today

twi: sɛ moyɛɛ mfomso a ɛyɛ hu yiye, bere a mosomaa me kɔɔ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn hɔ, na mokae se, ‘Bɔ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn mpae ma yɛn, na ka nea ɔka biara kyerɛ yɛn na yɛbɛyɛ,’ no.
english: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the Lord your God and said, ‘Pray to the Lord our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.’

twi: Nnɛ, maka akyerɛ mo, nanso monyɛɛ osetie mmaa Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ara wɔ biribiara a ɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menka nkyerɛ mo no ho.
english: I have told you today, but you still have not obeyed the Lord your God in all he sent me to tell you.

twi: Enti afei mommma mo werɛ mfi sɛ, mubewuwu wɔ afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm ano wɔ faako a mopɛ sɛ mokɔtena hɔ no.”
english: So now, be sure of this: You will die by the sword, famine and plague in the place where you want to go to settle.”

twi: Bere a Yeremia wiee nsɛm a efi Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no ka no, biribiara a Awurade asoma no sɛ ɔmmɛka nkyerɛ wɔn no,
english: When Jeremiah had finished telling the people all the words of the Lord their God—everything the Lord had sent him to tell them—

twi: Hosaia babarima Asaria, Karea babarima Yohanan ne mmarima ahomasofo no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se, “Woredi atoro! Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, nsomaa wo se bɛka se, ‘Ɛnsɛ sɛ mokɔ Misraim kɔtena hɔ.’
english: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are lying! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to settle there.’

twi: Na mmom Neria babarima Baruk na ɔregyigye wo so tia yɛn ama wɔde yɛn ahyɛ Babiloniafo nsa, sɛnea wobekum yɛn anaa wɔbɛsoa yɛn de yɛn akɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilonia.”
english: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon.”

twi: Enti Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa ne nnipa no anni Awurade hyɛ a ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ, wɔntena Yuda asase so no so.
english: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers and all the people disobeyed the Lord’s command to stay in the land of Judah.

twi: Mmom Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa de Yuda nkae a wofi amanaman a wɔbɔɔ wɔn ahwete kɔɔ so no so na wɔaba sɛ wɔrebɛtena Yuda asase so no nyinaa kɔe.
english: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.

twi: Wɔde mmarima, mmea, mmofra ne ɔhene mmabea a ɔsahene Nebusaradan, a ɔyɛ ɔhene awɛmfo panyin no, de wɔn gyaw Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena, odiyifo Yeremia ne Neria babarima Baruk nso kɔe.
english: They also led away all those whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan—the men, the women, the children and the king’s daughters. And they took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah along with them.

twi: Enti wɔhyɛn Misraim a wɔanni Awurade asɛm so, na wokoduu Tapanhes.
english: So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the Lord and went as far as Tahpanhes.

twi: Awurade asɛm baa Yeremia nkyɛn wɔ Tapanhes se,
english: In Tahpanhes the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

twi: “Bere a Yudafo no rehwɛ no, fa abo akɛse, afei tutu fam wɔ birikisi nsɛwee a ɛwɔ Farao ahemfi a ɛwɔ Tapanhes abobow ano hɔ, na fa gu mu kata so.
english: “While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes.

twi: Afei ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se: Mɛsoma me somfo Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar, na mede nʼahengua besi saa abo a masi wɔ ha no so; na ɔbɛtrɛw nʼadehye kyinii mu wɔ so.
english: Then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.

twi: Ɔbɛba abɛtow ahyɛ Misraim so, na obekum wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wonkum wɔn no, ɔbɛfa wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔnkɔ nnommum mu no nnommum, na wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn mma afoa no, wɔde wɔn bɛma afoa.
english: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.

twi: Ɔbɛto Misraim anyame asɔredan mu gya, ahyew na wɔafa wɔn anyame no nnommum. Sɛnea oguanhwɛfo de nʼatade kyekyere ne ho no, saa ara na ɔde Misraim bɛkyekyere ne ho na wafi hɔ akɔ a ne ho baabiara renti.
english: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd picks his garment clean of lice, so he will pick Egypt clean and depart.

twi: Owia asɔredan a ɛwɔ Misraim no, obebubu nʼafadum kronkron no, na wahyew Misraim anyame asɔredan no dwerɛbee.’ ”
english: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’”

twi: Abosonsom Mu AmanehunuSaa asɛm yi baa Yeremia nkyɛn; ɛfa Yudafo a wɔtete Misraim anafo fam wɔ Migdol, Tapanhes, Memfis ne Misraim atifi fam no ho.
english: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt—in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis—and in Upper Egypt:

twi: “Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se: Muhuu amanehunu kɛse a mede baa Yerusalem ne Yuda nkurow nyinaa so no. Nnɛ wɔayeyɛ amamfo na wɔasɛesɛe
english: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins

twi: esiane bɔne a wɔayɛ no nti. Wɔhyew nnuhuam, som anyame foforo a, wɔn anaa mo anaa mo agyanom nnim wɔn de hyɛɛ me abufuw.
english: because of the evil they have done. They aroused my anger by burning incense to and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever knew.

twi: Mesomaa mʼasomfo adiyifo mpɛn pii a wɔkae se, ‘Monnyɛ saa atantanne a mikyi no!’
english: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!’

twi: Nanso wɔantie, wɔamfa anyɛ asɛm, na wɔannan amfi wɔn amumɔyɛsɛm no ho na wɔannyae hyew a wɔhyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo no.
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

twi: Enti mihwiee mʼabufuw gui, na ɛdɛw kɔɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so ma ɛsɛesɛe na ɛdedaa mpan sɛnea ɛtete nnɛ yi.
english: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.

twi: “Na mprempren, nea Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn se ni: Adɛn nti na mode amanehunu kɛse aba mo ho so, sɛ muyii mmarima ne mmea, mmofra ne mmotafowa fii Yuda a moannyaw nkae biara amma mo ho.
english: “Now this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?

twi: Adɛn nti na mode nea mo nsa ayɛ hyɛ me abufuw, na mohyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo wɔ Misraim, baabi a moabɛtena hɔ no? Mobɛsɛe mo ho, na moayɛ nnome ne nsopa wɔ asase so amanaman nyinaa mu.
english: Why arouse my anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves a curse and an object of reproach among all the nations on earth.

twi: Mo werɛ afi amumɔyɛsɛm a mo agyanom, Yuda ahemfo ne ahemmea yɛe, na mo ne mo yerenom nso yɛɛ wɔ Yuda asase ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no ana?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your ancestors and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

twi: Ebesi nnɛ yi, wɔmmrɛɛ wɔn ho ase, wɔnnaa nidi adi na wonnii me mmara ne ahyɛde a mede maa mo ne mo agyanom no so.
english: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your ancestors.

twi: “Enti nea Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se ni: Masi mʼadwene pi sɛ mede amanehunu bɛba mo so na masɛe Yuda nyinaa.
english: “Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

twi: Mɛfa Yuda nkae a wosii wɔn adwene pi sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Misraim akɔtena hɔ no. Wɔn nyinaa bewuwu wɔ Misraim; wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano anaa ɔkɔm bekum wɔn. Efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so, afoa ne ɔkɔm bekunkum wɔn. Wɔbɛyɛ nnome, ahodwiriwde, afɔbude ne ahohora.
english: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach.

twi: Mede afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm bɛtwe wɔn a wɔtete Misraim no aso, sɛnea metwee Yerusalem aso no.
english: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.

twi: Yuda nkae a wɔakɔtena Misraim no mu biara renguan, na wɔremfa wɔn ho nni na wɔasan aba Yuda, asase a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsan bɛtena so no so; wɔn mu biara remma, gye aguanfo kakraa bi.”
english: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives.”

twi: Afei mmarima a na wonim sɛ wɔn yerenom hyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo, wɔne mmea a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa, nnipadɔm no, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Misraim Atifi fam ne Anafo fam ka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se,
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present—a large assembly—and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,

twi: “Yɛrentie asɛm a waka akyerɛ yɛn wɔ Awurade din mu no!
english: “We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord!

twi: Ampa ara yɛbɛyɛ biribiara a yɛkae se yɛbɛyɛ: Yɛbɛhyew nnuhuam ama Ɔsoro Hemmea na yɛahwie ahwiesa ama no, sɛnea yɛne yɛn agyanom, ahemfo ne adwumayɛfo yɛɛ wɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Saa bere no na yɛwɔ aduan, na yedi yiye a yenni ɔhaw biara nso.
english: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our ancestors, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.

twi: Nanso efi bere a yegyaee nnuhuam a yɛhyew ma Ɔsoro Hemmea, na yegyaee ahwiesa a yɛde ma no no, biribiara abɔ yɛn na yɛrewuwu wɔ afoa ne ɔkɔm ano.”
english: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine.”

twi: Na mmea no ka kaa ho se, “Bere a yɛhyew nnuhuam maa Ɔsoro Hemmea, na yehwiee ahwiesa maa no no, na yɛn kununom nnim sɛ yɛto ɔfam a ɛyɛ ne sɛso, hwie ahwiesa ma no ana?”
english: The women added, “When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes impressed with her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?”

twi: Na Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa; mmarima ne mmea a wɔrebua no no se,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,

twi: “Mususuw sɛ, Awurade nnim sɛ, na mo ne mo agyanom, mo ahemfo, adwumayɛfo ne ɔmanfo no hyew nnuhuam ma ahoni wɔ Yuda nkurow so ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so ana?
english: “Did not the Lord remember and call to mind the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your ancestors, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?

twi: Bere a mo amumɔyɛ ne akyiwade a moyɛɛ no fonoo Awurade no, mo asase dannan nnomede ne amamfo a obiara nte so, sɛnea ɛte nnɛ yi.
english: When the Lord could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became a curse and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.

twi: Esiane sɛ moahyew nnuhuam, ayɛ bɔne atia Awurade, na moanyɛ osetie amma no, na moanni ne mmara, nʼahyɛde ne nʼadansesɛm so nti, amanehunu aba mo so sɛnea muhu yi.”
english: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the Lord and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see.”

twi: Afei Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa a mmea no ka ho se, “Mo Yudafo a mowɔ Misraim nyinaa muntie Awurade asɛm.
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, “Hear the word of the Lord, all you people of Judah in Egypt.

twi: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se: Mo ne mo yerenom de mo nneyɛe akyerɛ mo bɔ a mohyɛe se, ‘Ampa ara yebedi bɔ a yɛhyɛe sɛ, yɛbɛhyew nnuhuam ahwie ahwiesa ama Ɔsoro Hemmea no,’ no so.”Monkɔ so, munni mo bɔhyɛ ne mo ntam so!
english:
This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have done what you said you would do when you promised, ‘We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.’
“Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!

twi: Nanso muntie Awurade asɛm, mo Yudafo a mowɔ Misraim nyinaa. Mede me din kɛse no ka ntam se, nea Awurade se ni, obiara a ofi Yuda a ɔte Misraim asase so baabiara remmɔ me din nka ntam bio da se, “Sɛ Otumfo Awurade te ase yi.”
english: But hear the word of the Lord, all you Jews living in Egypt: ‘I swear by my great name,’ says the Lord, ‘that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, “As surely as the Sovereign Lord lives.”

twi: Na mɛhwɛ ama wɔahu amane na ɛnyɛ yiyedi; Yudafo a wɔwɔ Misraim bewuwu wɔ afoa ne ɔkɔm ano kosi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.
english: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.

twi: Wɔn a wobeguan afi afoa ano na wɔasan afi Misraim akɔ Yuda asase so no bɛyɛ kakraa bi. Afei Yuda nkae a wɔbɛtenaa Misraim no nyinaa behu nea nʼasɛm yɛ nokware; me de anaa wɔn de.
english: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand—mine or theirs.

twi: “ ‘Eyi na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ama mo sɛ mɛtwe mo aso wɔ ha, na moahu sɛ ampa ara mʼahunahuna a ɛfa ɔhaw ho no bɛba mu,’ Awurade na ose.
english: “‘This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,’ declares the Lord, ‘so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.’

twi: ‘Mede Misraimhene Farao Hofra rebɛhyɛ nʼatamfo a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum no no nsa, sɛnea mede Yudahene Sedekia hyɛɛ Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar, ne tamfo a na ɔrehwehwɛ no akum no no nsa. Sɛɛ na Awurade se.’ ”
english: This is what the Lord says: ‘I am going to deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who want to kill him, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who wanted to kill him.’”

twi: Asɛm A Wɔde Ma BarukEyi ne nsɛm a odiyifo Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ Neria babarima Baruk wɔ Yudahene Yosia babarima Yehoiakim adedi afe a ɛto so anan no mu, bere a na Baruk akyerɛw nsɛm a efi Yeremia anom no agu nhoma mmobɔwee bi mu.
english: When Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Jeremiah said this to Baruch:

twi: “Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, ka kyerɛ wo, Baruk:
english: “This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

twi: Wokae se, ‘Nnome nka me! Awurade de awerɛhow aka me yawdi ho; apinisi ne ɔbrɛ ama mʼahoɔden asa.’
english: You said, ‘Woe to me! The Lord has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.’

twi: Awurade kae se, ‘Ka eyi kyerɛ no: Nea Awurade se ni: Mɛsɛe nea makyekyere na matu nea madua no ase wɔ asase no so nyinaa.
english: But the Lord has told me to say to you, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will overthrow what I have built and uproot what I have planted, throughout the earth.

twi: Enti ɛsɛ sɛ wopɛ nneɛma akɛse ma wo ho ana? Nyɛ saa. Efisɛ mede amanehunu bɛba nnipa nyinaa so, Awurade na ose, nanso baabiara a wobɛkɔ no, mɛbɔ wo ho ban.’ ”
english: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the Lord, but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.’”

twi: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Misraim HoEyi ne asɛm a efi Awurade nkyɛn baa odiyifo Yeremia hɔ a ɛfa aman no ho.
english: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

twi: Nea ɛfa Misraim ho:Eyi ne nsɛm a etia Misraimhene Farao Neko asraafo a Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar dii wɔn so nkonim wɔ Karkemis, Asubɔnten Eufrate ho wɔ Yudahene Yosia babarima Yehoiakim adedi afe a ɛto so anan no:
english:
Concerning Egypt:
This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

twi: “Siesie wo nkatabo akɛse ne nketewa nyinaa,na muntu santen nkɔ ɔsa!
english:
“Prepare your shields, both large and small,
    and march out for battle!

twi: Munsiesie apɔnkɔ no,na momforo ntenatena wɔn so.Munnyinagyina mo afaa mohyehyɛ mo nnade kyɛw!Monsew mo mpeaw ano,na monhyɛ mo nkatabo.
english:
Harness the horses,
    mount the steeds!
Take your positions
    with helmets on!
Polish your spears,
    put on your armor!

twi: Dɛn na mihu?Wɔabɔ hu,wɔresan wɔn akyi,wɔn dɔmmarima adi nkogu.Woguan ntɛm soa wɔnhwɛ wɔn akyi,na ehu wɔ baabiara,”Awurade na ose.
english:
What do I see?
    They are terrified,
they are retreating,
    their warriors are defeated.
They flee in haste
    without looking back,
    and there is terror on every side,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Ɔhoɔharefo ntumi nguan,na ɔhoɔdenfo nso saa ara.Atifi fam wɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate howohintihintiw na wɔhwehwe ase.
english:
“The swift cannot flee
    nor the strong escape.
In the north by the River Euphrates
    they stumble and fall.

twi: “Hena, na ɔma ne homene so sɛ Asubɔnten Nil,sɛ nsubɔnten a mu nsu woro yi?
english:
“Who is this that rises like the Nile,
    like rivers of surging waters?

twi: Misraim ma ne homene so sɛ Nil,sɛ nsubɔnten a mu nsu woro.Ɔka se, ‘Mɛsɔre akata asase no so;mɛsɛe nkuropɔn ne mu nnipa.’
english:
Egypt rises like the Nile,
    like rivers of surging waters.
She says, ‘I will rise and cover the earth;
    I will destroy cities and their people.’

twi: Monkɔ mo anim, apɔnkɔ!Monka wɔn anibere so, mo nteaseɛnamkafo!Muntu nteɛ, dɔmmarima,Kus ne Put mmarima a mukura nkatabo,Lidia mmarima a motow agyan.
english:
Charge, you horses!
    Drive furiously, you charioteers!
March on, you warriors—men of Cush and Put who carry shields,
    men of Lydia who draw the bow.

twi: Nanso da no yɛ Awurade, Asafo Awurade dea,aweretɔda, nʼatamfo so aweretɔ.Afoa bekunkum akosi sɛ ɔbɛmee,akosi bere a ɔde mogya bedwudwo ne osukɔm ano.Efisɛ, Awurade, Asafo Awurade bɛbɔ afɔrewɔ atifi fam asase a ɛwɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate ho no so.
english:
But that day belongs to the Lord, the Lord Almighty—
    a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes.
The sword will devour till it is satisfied,
    till it has quenched its thirst with blood.
For the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will offer sacrifice
    in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.

twi: “Foro kɔ Gilead kogye aduruMisraim Babea Ɔbabun.Nanso nnuru bebrebe a wofa no yɛ ɔkwa,ayaresa biara nni hɔ ma wo.
english:
“Go up to Gilead and get balm,
    Virgin Daughter Egypt.
But you try many medicines in vain;
    there is no healing for you.

twi: Amanaman no bɛte wʼanimguase;wʼagyaadwo bɛhyɛ asase so ma.Ɔkofo baako behintiw afa ɔfoforo so;na wɔn baanu bɛbɔ mu ahwe ase.”
Eyi ne asɛm a Awurade ka kyerɛɛ odiyifo Yeremia a ɛfa Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar ba a ɔbɛba abɛtow ahyɛ Misraim so:
english: This is the message the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:

twi: “Mommɔ eyi ho dawuru wɔ Misraim, na mompae mu nka wɔ Migdol;monka wɔ Memfis ne Tapanhes nso se,‘Munnyinagyina na monyɛ krado,efisɛ, afoa rekunkum wɔn a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia.’
english:
“Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol;
    proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes:
‘Take your positions and get ready,
    for the sword devours those around you.’

twi: Adɛn nti na mo dɔmmarima bɛbotow sɛɛ?Wɔrentumi nnyina, efisɛ, Awurade bɛbɔ wɔn ahwe fam.
english:
Why will your warriors be laid low?
    They cannot stand, for the Lord will push them down.

twi: Wobehintihintiw atoatoa so;wɔbɛhwehwe ase adeda wɔn ho wɔn ho so.Wɔbɛka se, ‘Monsɔre, momma yɛnkɔ yɛn nkyinkɔ yɛn nkurɔfo nkyɛn ne faako a wɔwoo yɛn,na yemfi nhyɛsofo no afoa ano.’
english:
They will stumble repeatedly;
    they will fall over each other.
They will say, ‘Get up, let us go back
    to our own people and our native lands,
    away from the sword of the oppressor.’

twi: Ɛhɔ na wɔbɛteɛ mu se,‘Misraimhene Farao tu ne ho kwa;nʼakwannya a ɔwɔ no atwa mu.’
“Ampa ara sɛ mete ase yi” Ɔhene ane din ne Asafo Awurade na ose,“Ɔbaako bɛba a ɔte sɛ Tabor wɔ mmepɔw no mu,sɛ Karmel wɔ mpoano.
english:
“As surely as I live,” declares the King,
    whose name is the Lord Almighty,
“one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains,
    like Carmel by the sea.

twi: Mommoaboa mo nneɛma ano ntwɛn nnommumfa,mo a motete Misraim,efisɛ wɔbɛsɛe Memfis kurowna ɛbɛda mpan a obiara rentena mu.
english:
Pack your belongings for exile,
    you who live in Egypt,
for Memphis will be laid waste
    and lie in ruins without inhabitant.

twi: “Misraim yɛ nantwi ba bere a ne ho yɛ fɛ,nanso ɔtɛn bi fiatifi fam reba ne so.
english:
“Egypt is a beautiful heifer,
    but a gadfly is coming
    against her from the north.

twi: Asraafo apaafo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu note sɛ nantwimma a wɔadodɔ srade.Wɔn nso bɛdan wɔn ho abɔ mu aguan,wɔrentumi nnyina wɔn anan so,efisɛ amanehunu da no reba wɔn so,bere a wɔde bɛtwe wɔn aso no.
english:
The mercenaries in her ranks
    are like fattened calves.
They too will turn and flee together,
    they will not stand their ground,
for the day of disaster is coming upon them,
    the time for them to be punished.

twi: Misraim bɛteɛ mu sɛ ɔwɔ a ɔreguanbere a ɔtamfo de ahoɔden reba ne so no;wɔde mmonnua bɛba ne sote sɛ, mmarima a wobu nnua.
english:
Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent
    as the enemy advances in force;
they will come against her with axes,
    like men who cut down trees.

twi: Wɔbɛsɛe ne kwae,”Awurade na ose,“sɛnea ayɛ kusuu yi mpo.Wɔdɔɔso bebree sen mmoadabi,na wɔrentumi nkan wɔn.
english:
They will chop down her forest,”
declares the Lord,
    “dense though it be.
They are more numerous than locusts,
    they cannot be counted.

twi: Wobegu Misraim Babea anim ase,wɔde no bɛhyɛ atifi fam nnipa no nsa.”
english:
Daughter Egypt will be put to shame,
    given into the hands of the people of the north.”

twi: Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, ka se, “Mede asotwe reba Tebes nyame Amon, Farao, Misraim ne nʼanyame ne nʼahemfo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Farao so no so.
english: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.

twi: Mede wɔn bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum wɔn no, Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar ne nʼadwumayɛfo no nsa. Nanso akyiri no, nnipa bɛtena Misraim asase so te sɛ kan no,” Awurade na ose.
english: I will give them into the hands of those who want to kill them—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past,” declares the Lord.

twi: “Nsuro, Yakob me somfo;nni yaw, Israel.Ampa ara megye wo afi beae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri,ne wʼasefo afi wɔn nnommumfa asase soYakob bɛsan anya asomdwoe ne bammɔ,na obiara renhunahuna no.
english:
“Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant;
    do not be dismayed, Israel.
I will surely save you out of a distant place,
    your descendants from the land of their exile.
Jacob will again have peace and security,
    and no one will make him afraid.

twi: Nsuro, Yakob me somfo;na me ne wo wɔ hɔ,” Awurade na ose.“Ɛwɔ mu, mesɛe aman no nyinaa koraaaman a mehwetee mo kɔɔ so no de,nanso merensɛe mo korakora.Mede trenee nko ara na ɛbɛteɛteɛ mo so;meremma mommfa mo ho nni a merentwe mo aso.”
english:
Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant,
    for I am with you,” declares the Lord.
“Though I completely destroy all the nations
    among which I scatter you,
    I will not completely destroy you.
I will discipline you but only in due measure;
    I will not let you go entirely unpunished.”

twi: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Filistifo HoAnsa na Farao bɛtow ahyɛ Gasa so no, eyi ne Awurade asɛm a ɛfa Filistifo ho a ɛbaa odiyifo Yeremia nkyɛn:
english: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monhwɛ sɛnea nsu rebobɔ ba wɔ atifi fam;ɛbɛyɛ ɔhweam a abu afa so.Ebebu afa asase no ne biribiara ɛwɔ so no so,nkurow no ne nnipa a wɔtete mu.Nnipa no bɛteɛteɛ mu;wɔn a wɔte asase no so nyinaa betwa adwo
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“See how the waters are rising in the north;
    they will become an overflowing torrent.
They will overflow the land and everything in it,
    the towns and those who live in them.
The people will cry out;
    all who dwell in the land will wail

twi: bere a wɔate apɔnkɔ a wotu mmirika no anan ase nnyigyei,na wɔate atamfo no nteaseɛnam gyegyeegyene wɔn ntwahonan nnyigyei no.Agyanom rentwa wɔn ani nhwɛ wɔn mma;wɔn nsa bɛsensɛn wɔn ho kwa.
english:
at the sound of the hooves of galloping steeds,
    at the noise of enemy chariots
    and the rumble of their wheels.
Parents will not turn to help their children;
    their hands will hang limp.

twi: Na da no abasɛ wɔsɛe Filistifo no nyinaana wotwa wɔn a wɔaka no nyinaa gu,wɔn a anka wotumi boa Tiro ne Sidon no.Awurade rebɛsɛe Filistifo no,nkae a wofi Kreta mpoano no.
english:
For the day has come
    to destroy all the Philistines
and to remove all survivors
    who could help Tyre and Sidon.
The Lord is about to destroy the Philistines,
    the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.

twi: Gasa bɛbɔ tikwaw bere a ɔretwa adwo;wɔbɛma Askelon atɔ mum.Mo nkae a mowɔ tataw so,mobɛbobɔ mo ho akam akosi da bɛn?
english:
Gaza will shave her head in mourning;
    Ashkelon will be silenced.
You remnant on the plain,
    how long will you cut yourselves?

twi: “ ‘Aa, Awurade afoa,’‘da bɛn na wobɛhome?San kɔhyɛ wo boha mu;gyae na da komm.’
english:
“‘Alas, sword of the Lord,
    how long till you rest?
Return to your sheath;
    cease and be still.’

twi: Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ada kommbere a Awurade ahyɛ nobere a wahyɛ no seɔnkɔtow nhyɛ Askelon ne mpoano asase no so?”
english:
But how can it rest
    when the Lord has commanded it,
when he has ordered it
    to attack Ashkelon and the coast?”

twi: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Moab HoNea ɛfa Moab ho:Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se:“Nebo nnue, na wɔbɛsɛe no.Wobegu Kiriataim anim ase, na wɔafa;wobegu aban dennen no anim ase, na wɔadwiriw agu fam.
english:
Concerning Moab:
This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says:
“Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined.
    Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured;
    the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.

twi: Wɔrenkamfo Moab bio;Hesbon mmarima bɛbɔ nʼasehwe ho pɔw;‘Mommra, momma yɛnkɔbɔ saa ɔman yi.’Mo nso, Madmen mmarima mobɛka mo ano ato mu;afoa no bɛtaa mo.
Muntie osu a efi Horonaim,adesɛe ne ɔsɛe ho su.
english:
Cries of anguish arise from Horonaim,
    cries of great havoc and destruction.

twi: Wɔbɛbɔ Moab:na ne mma nketewa bɛteɛteɛ mu.
english:
Moab will be broken;
    her little ones will cry out.

twi: Wɔforo kɔ Luhit,wɔde agyaadwotwa a mu yɛ den na ɛrekɔ;ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Horonaim so nowɔte ahoyeraw nteɛteɛmu wɔ adesɛe no ho.
english:
They go up the hill to Luhith,
    weeping bitterly as they go;
on the road down to Horonaim
    anguished cries over the destruction are heard.

twi: Munguan! muntu mmirika mpere mo nkwa.Monyɛ sɛ wura wɔ nweatam so.
english:
Flee! Run for your lives;
    become like a bush in the desert.

twi: Esiane sɛ mode mo ho to mo nneyɛe ne mo ahonya so nti,mo nso wɔbɛfa mo nnommum,na Kemos bɛkɔ nnommum mu,ɔne nʼasɔfo ne adwumayɛfo.
english:
Since you trust in your deeds and riches,
    you too will be taken captive,
and Chemosh will go into exile,
    together with his priests and officials.

twi: Ɔsɛefo no betu kurow biara so sa,na mu biara rennya ne ho ntetew.Wɔbɛsɛe obon nona wasɛe mmepɔw mpampam a ɛyɛ tamaa no,efisɛ Awurade akasa.
english:
The destroyer will come against every town,
    and not a town will escape.
The valley will be ruined
    and the plateau destroyed,
    because the Lord has spoken.

twi: Momfa nkyene nhyɛ Moab,efisɛ wɔrebɛsɛe no;ne nkurow bɛda mpan aobiara rentena mu.
english:
Put salt on Moab,
    for she will be laid waste;
her towns will become desolate,
    with no one to live in them.

twi: “Nnome nka nea ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase wɔ Awurade adwumayɛ ho!Nnome nka nea ɔmmfa nʼafoa nhwie mogya ngu!
english:
“A curse on anyone who is lax in doing the Lord’s work!
    A curse on anyone who keeps their sword from bloodshed!

twi: “Moab atena ase asomdwoe mu fi ne mmerantebere mu,te sɛ nsa ase puw a ataa dinn,wonnhwie mfi ahina mu nkogu ahina foforo mu,ɔnkɔɔ nnommum mu da.Enti ɔte sɛ nea ɔte ara,na ne ho hua nsakrae ɛ.
english:
“Moab has been at rest from youth,
    like wine left on its dregs,
not poured from one jar to another—
    she has not gone into exile.
So she tastes as she did,
    and her aroma is unchanged.

twi: Nanso nna bi reba,”Awurade na ose,“a mɛsoma mmarima a wohwie fi ahina mu,na wobehwie no agu;wɔbɛma nʼahina mu ayɛ hweena wɔabobɔ ne nkuruwa.
english:
But days are coming,”
    declares the Lord,
“when I will send men who pour from pitchers,
    and they will pour her out;
they will empty her pitchers
    and smash her jars.

twi: Afei Kemos ho bɛyɛ Moab aniwu,sɛnea Israelfi anim guu asebere a wɔde wɔn ho too Bet-El so no.
english:
Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh,
    as Israel was ashamed
    when they trusted in Bethel.

twi: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wutumi ka se, ‘Yɛyɛ dɔmmarima,mmarima akokodurufo wɔ ɔsa mu’?
english:
“How can you say, ‘We are warriors,
    men valiant in battle’?

twi: Wɔbɛsɛe Moab na wɔatu ne nkurow so sa;wobekunkum ne mmerante a wɔte apɔw no,”nea Ɔhene a wɔfrɛ no Asafo Awurade no se ni.
“Moab asehwe abɛn;nʼamanehunu bɛba ntɛm.
english:
“The fall of Moab is at hand;
    her calamity will come quickly.

twi: Munsu no, mo a motete ne ho nyinaa,ne mo a munim ne din nyinaa;monka se, ‘Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wɔabubu ahempema a ɛyɛ den yiɛyɛɛ dɛn wɔabu anuonyam pema fɛfɛ yi mu!’
english:
Mourn for her, all who live around her,
    all who know her fame;
say, ‘How broken is the mighty scepter,
    how broken the glorious staff!’

twi: “Fi wʼanuonyam mu,na bɛtena asase wosee no so,wo a wote Dibon Babea,efisɛ nea ɔsɛe Moab nobetu aba wo soabɛsɛe wo nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ no.
english:
“Come down from your glory
    and sit on the parched ground,
    you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon,
for the one who destroys Moab
    will come up against you
    and ruin your fortified cities.

twi: Gyina kwankyɛn na hwɛ,wo a wote Aroer.Bisa ɔbarima a ɔreguan no ne ɔbea a ɔrefi mu afi,bisa wɔn se, ‘Asɛm bɛn na asi?’
english:
Stand by the road and watch,
    you who live in Aroer.
Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping,
    ask them, ‘What has happened?’

twi: Moab anim agu ase, efisɛ wɔabubu no pasaa;muntwa adwo na monteɛteɛ mu!Mommɔ dawuru wɔ Arnon ho sewɔasɛe Moab.
english:
Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered.
    Wail and cry out!
Announce by the Arnon
    that Moab is destroyed.

twi: Atemmu aba bepɔw tamaa sowɔ Holon, Yahas ne Mefaat,
english:
Judgment has come to the plateau—
    to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,

twi: Dibon ne Nebo ne Bet-Diblataim
english: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,

twi: ne Kiriataim ne Bet Gamul ne Bet Meon
english: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,

twi: ne Keriot ne Bosrawɔ Moab nkurow nyinaa, nea ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ne nea ɛbɛn.
english:
to Kerioth and Bozrah—
    to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

twi: Wɔatwa Moab mmɛn;na ne basa abu,”Awurade na ose.
“Momma no mmow nsa,efisɛ wabu Awurade animtiaa.Momma Moab nyantam wɔ ne fe mu;momma no nyɛ nea wodi ne ho fɛw.
english:
“Make her drunk,
    for she has defied the Lord.
Let Moab wallow in her vomit;
    let her be an object of ridicule.

twi: Ɛnyɛ Israel na na wudi ne ho fɛw?Wɔkyeree no akorɔmfo mu ana,a enti mowosow mo ti animtiaabu sobere biara a mobɛka ne ho asɛm?
english:
Was not Israel the object of your ridicule?
    Was she caught among thieves,
that you shake your head in scorn
    whenever you speak of her?

twi: Mumfifi mo nkurow so nkɔtena abotan mu,mo a motete Moab.Monyɛ sɛ aborɔnoma a ɔyɛ ne berebuwwɔ ɔbodan ano.
english:
Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks,
    you who live in Moab.
Be like a dove that makes its nest
    at the mouth of a cave.

twi: “Yɛate Moab ahantan nonʼahomaso ne gye a ogye ne ho di mmoroso;nʼahantan ne nʼahomaso,ne ne koma mu ahohoahoa.
english:
“We have heard of Moab’s pride—
    how great is her arrogance!—
of her insolence, her pride, her conceit
    and the haughtiness of her heart.

twi: Minim nʼasoɔden nanso ɛyɛ ɔkwa,”Awurade na ose,“na nʼahohoahoa mfa hwee mma.
english:
I know her insolence but it is futile,”
declares the Lord,
    “and her boasts accomplish nothing.

twi: Enti mitwa adwo ma Moab,misu teɛ mu ma Moabfo nyinaa,midi awerɛhow ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Kir Hereset.
Misu ma mo sɛnea Yaser su,mo Sibma bobe.Mo mman dennan kɔɔ po ho pɛɛ;koduu Yaser po ho.Ɔsɛefo no abegumo nnuaba a abere ne mo bobe no so.
english:
I weep for you, as Jazer weeps,
    you vines of Sibmah.
Your branches spread as far as the sea;
    they reached as far as Jazer.
The destroyer has fallen
    on your ripened fruit and grapes.

twi: Ahosɛpɛw ne anigye atu afiMoab nnuaba nturo ne mfuw so.Matwa nsa a ɛteɛ fi nsakyiamoa no so;obiara mmfa ahosɛpɛw ntiatia bobe no so.Ɛwɔ mu nteɛteɛmu wɔ hɔ de,nanso ɛnyɛ ahosɛpɛw nteɛteɛmu.
english:
Joy and gladness are gone
    from the orchards and fields of Moab.
I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses;
    no one treads them with shouts of joy.
Although there are shouts,
    they are not shouts of joy.

twi: “Wɔn su ano den gyigye fiHesbon kɔ Eleale ne Yahas,fi Soar de kosi Horonaim ne Eglat Selisiya,mpo, nsu a ɛwɔ Nimrim no ayow.
Moab mu,mede sorɔnsorɔmmea afɔrebɔ ne nnuhuama wɔhyew ma wɔn anyame no, bɛba awiei,”Awurade, na ose.
english:
In Moab I will put an end
    to those who make offerings on the high places
    and burn incense to their gods,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Enti me koma su sɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma Moab;esu sɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Kir Hereset.Ahonyade a wɔpɛe no kɔ.
Wɔabɔ eti biara tikwawna wɔayi abogyesɛ biara;nsa nyinaa ho ayɛ akamakamna atweaatam sisi obiara asen.
english:
Every head is shaved
    and every beard cut off;
every hand is slashed
    and every waist is covered with sackcloth.

twi: Adan a ɛwɔ Moab nyinaa atifine ɔmanfo aguabɔbea nyinaa;biribiara nni hɔ sɛ awerɛhow,efisɛ mabubu Moabayɛ no sɛ ahina a obiara mpɛ,”Awurade na ose.
english:
On all the roofs in Moab
    and in the public squares
there is nothing but mourning,
    for I have broken Moab
    like a jar that no one wants,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Hwɛ sɛnea wabubu afa! Hwɛ sɛnea wɔretwa adwo!Na hwɛ sɛnea Moab de aniwu dan nʼakyi!Moab ayɛ nea wodi ne ho fɛw,ne ahodwiriwde ama wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia nyinaa.”
english:
“How shattered she is! How they wail!
    How Moab turns her back in shame!
Moab has become an object of ridicule,
    an object of horror to all those around her.”

twi: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monhwɛ! ɔkɔre rebɔ hoo aba fam.Watrɛw ne ntaban mu wɔ Moab so.
english:
This is what the Lord says:
“Look! An eagle is swooping down,
    spreading its wings over Moab.

twi: Wɔbɛfa Keriot nnommumna wɔafa nʼabandennen no.Saa da no Moab dɔmmarima komabetu sɛ ɔbea a ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
english:
Kerioth will be captured
    and the strongholds taken.
In that day the hearts of Moab’s warriors
    will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

twi: Wɔbɛsɛe Moab na ɛrenyɛ ɔman bio,efisɛ obuu Awurade animtiaa.
english:
Moab will be destroyed as a nation
    because she defied the Lord.

twi: Ehu, nkonomoa ne afiri retwɛn mo,Moabfo,”Awurade na ose.
english:
Terror and pit and snare await you,
    you people of Moab,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Nea oguan nea ɛyɛ hu nobɛtɔ nkonomoa mu,nea ɔbɛforo afi nkonomoa no mu noafide beyi no;na mede Moab asotwe afe no bɛba ne so,”Awurade na ose.
english:
“Whoever flees from the terror
    will fall into a pit,
whoever climbs out of the pit
    will be caught in a snare;
for I will bring on Moab
    the year of her punishment,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Hesbon nwini asena aguanfo no gyinagyina a wonni mmoa biara,efisɛ ogya bi atu afi Hesbon;ogyaframa bi fi Sihon mfimfini;ɛhyew Moab moma,ne ahohoahoafo a wɔn ano yɛ den no ti koraa.
Nnome nka wo, wo Moab!Wɔasɛe Kemos nkurɔfo no;wɔde wo mmabarima kɔ nnommum muna wo mmabea nso kɔ nkoasom mu.
english:
Woe to you, Moab!
    The people of Chemosh are destroyed;
your sons are taken into exile
    and your daughters into captivity.

twi: “Nanso mede Moab adenya bɛsan ama nowɔ nna a ɛbɛba no mu,”Awurade na ose.Moab atemmu no awiei ni.
english:
“Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab
    in days to come,”
declares the Lord.
Here ends the judgment on Moab.

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Amon HoNea ɛfa Amonfo ho:Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Israel nni mmabarima ana?Onni wɔn a wobedi nʼade?Ɛno de adɛn nti na Molek afa Gad ayɛ ne de yi?Adɛn nti na ne nkurɔfo tete ne nkurow mu?
english:
Concerning the Ammonites:
This is what the Lord says:
“Has Israel no sons?
    Has Israel no heir?
Why then has Molek taken possession of Gad?
    Why do his people live in its towns?

twi: Nanso nna no reba,”Awurade na ose.“Bere a mɛbobɔ mu de afrɛ ɔkoatia Raba a ɛyɛ Amonfo de;ɛbɛyɛ afabo siw,wɔbɛto nkuraa a atwa ne ho ahyia no mu gya.Na Israel bɛpam wɔn awɔpam no no,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.
english:
But the days are coming,”
    declares the Lord,
“when I will sound the battle cry
    against Rabbah of the Ammonites;
it will become a mound of ruins,
    and its surrounding villages will be set on fire.
Then Israel will drive out
    those who drove her out,”
says the Lord.

twi: “Twa adwo. Hesbon, efisɛ wɔasɛe Ai!Monteɛ mu, mo a mowɔ Raba!Mumfura ayitam na munni awerɛhow;mommɔ nnyenyen wɔ afasu no mu,efisɛ Molek bɛkɔ nnommum mu,ɔne nʼasɔfo ne nʼadwumayɛfo.
Adɛn nti na wode wʼabon ahorow no hoahoa wo ho,wʼabon a wunya mu aba bebree no nti?Amon Babea a Onni nokware,wode wo ho to wʼahonya so na woka se,‘Hena na ɔbɛtow ahyɛ me so?’
english:
Why do you boast of your valleys,
    boast of your valleys so fruitful?
Unfaithful Daughter Ammon,
    you trust in your riches and say,
    ‘Who will attack me?’

twi: Mede ehu bɛba wo so,ebefi wɔn a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no nyinaa,”Awurade na ose, Asafo Awurade no.“Wɔbɛpam mo nyinaa,na obiara remmoaboa akobɔfo ano.
english:
I will bring terror on you
    from all those around you,”
declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.
“Every one of you will be driven away,
    and no one will gather the fugitives.

twi: “Nanso akyiri no, mɛsan de Amonfo adenya ama wɔn,”sɛe na Awurade se.
english:
“Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Edom HoNea ɛfa Edom ho:Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Nyansa nni Teman bio ana?Afotu ayera wɔ anyansafo mu ana?Wɔn nyansa no aporɔw ana?
english:
Concerning Edom:
This is what the Lord Almighty says:
“Is there no longer wisdom in Teman?
    Has counsel perished from the prudent?
    Has their wisdom decayed?

twi: Monnan mo ho na munguan,monkɔtetɛw abodan a mu dɔ mu,mo a motete Dedan,efisɛ mede amanehunu bɛba Esau sowɔ bere a mɛtwe nʼaso no.
english:
Turn and flee, hide in deep caves,
    you who live in Dedan,
for I will bring disaster on Esau
    at the time when I punish him.

twi: Sɛ bobetetewfo no baa mo nkyɛn aanka wɔrennya bobe no kakra ana?Sɛ akorɔmfo baa ɔdasu mu a,anka wɔrenwia ade dodow a wɔpɛ ana?
english:
If grape pickers came to you,
    would they not leave a few grapes?
If thieves came during the night,
    would they not steal only as much as they wanted?

twi: Na mɛma Esau ada adagyaw.Mɛda ne hintabea ahorow adi,sɛnea ɔrentumi mfa ne ho nhintaw.Ne mma, nʼabusuafo ne ne mfɛfo bewuwu,na wɔrenhu no bio.
english:
But I will strip Esau bare;
    I will uncover his hiding places,
    so that he cannot conceal himself.
His armed men are destroyed,
    also his allies and neighbors,
    so there is no one to say,

twi: Munnyaw mo ayisaa, mɛbɔ wɔn nkwa ho ban.Mo akunafo nso betumi de wɔn ho ato me so.”
english:
‘Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive.
    Your widows too can depend on me.’”

twi: Nea Awurade se ni: “Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔmfata sɛ wɔnom kuruwa no nom a, ɛno de adɛn nti na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtwe mo aso? Wɔbɛtwe mo aso na mobɛnom nso.
english: This is what the Lord says: “If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.

twi: Meka me ho ntam sɛ wɔbɛsɛe Bosra na ayɛ ahodwiriwde, ahohorade ne nnome; na ne nkurow nyinaa bɛsɛe afebɔɔ,” Awurade na ose.
english: I swear by myself,” declares the Lord, “that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and reproach; and all its towns will be in ruins forever.”

twi: Mate asɛm a efi Awurade nkyɛn:wɔsomaa ananmusini bi sɛ ɔnkɔka nkyerɛ amanaman no se,“Mommoaboa mo ho ano nkɔtow nhyɛ no so!Monsɔre nkɔ ɔko!”
english:
I have heard a message from the Lord;
    an envoy was sent to the nations to say,
“Assemble yourselves to attack it!
    Rise up for battle!”

twi: “Na mɛyɛ wo ketewa wɔ aman no mu,na wɔabu wo animtiaa.
english:
“Now I will make you small among the nations,
    despised by mankind.

twi: Ehu a wobɔne koma mu ahomaso adaadaa wo,wo a wote abotan ntokuru mu,na wote koko no sorɔnsorɔmmea.Ɛwɔ mu, woyɛ wo berebuw wɔ sorosoro sɛ ɔkɔre de,nanso hɔ na mefi de wo aba fam,”Awurade na ose.
english:
The terror you inspire
    and the pride of your heart have deceived you,
you who live in the clefts of the rocks,
    who occupy the heights of the hill.
Though you build your nest as high as the eagle’s,
    from there I will bring you down,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Edom bɛyɛ ahodwiriwde;wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no nyinaa ho bedwiriw wɔn na wɔadi ne ho fɛwesiane nʼapirakuru nyinaa nti.
Sɛnea wɔdan Sodom ne Gomorane wɔn nkurow gui no,”Awurade na ose,“saa ara na obiara rentena hɔ;onipa biara rentena mu.
english:
As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown,
    along with their neighboring towns,”
says the Lord,
“so no one will live there;
    no people will dwell in it.

twi: “Sɛnea gyata a ofi Yordan nkyɛkyerɛ murekɔ adidibea frɔmfrɔm no,saa ara na mɛtaa Edom afi nʼasase so wɔ bere tiaa bi mu.Hena ne nea mayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ eyi?Hena na ɔte sɛ me, na hena na obetumi ne me adi asi?Na oguanhwɛfo bɛn na obetumi asɔre atia me?”
english:
“Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets
    to a rich pastureland,
I will chase Edom from its land in an instant.
    Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this?
Who is like me and who can challenge me?
    And what shepherd can stand against me?”

twi: Enti tie nea Awurade ahyehyɛ atia Edom,nea wabɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛyɛ de atia wɔn a wɔte Teman ni:Nguankuw no mu nkumaa no wɔbɛtwe wɔn akɔ;wɔn nti ɔbɛsɛe adidibea no koraa.
english:
Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Edom,
    what he has purposed against those who live in Teman:
The young of the flock will be dragged away;
    their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

twi: Wɔn asehwe nnyigyei bɛma asase awosow;wɔn nteɛteɛmu gyegyeegye akodu Po Kɔkɔɔ ho.
english:
At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble;
    their cry will resound to the Red Sea.

twi: Monhwɛ! Ɔkɔre bi betu akɔ soro na wabɔ hoo aba fam awatrɛtrɛw ne ntaban mu wɔ Bosra so.Saa da no Edom dɔmmarima komabetu sɛ ɔbea a ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
english:
Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down,
    spreading its wings over Bozrah.
In that day the hearts of Edom’s warriors
    will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Damasko HoNea ɛfa Damasko ho:“Hamat ne Arpad di yaw,efisɛ wɔate asɛmmɔne.Wɔn koma abotowte sɛ po a ayɛ hagyahagya.
english:
Concerning Damascus:
“Hamath and Arpad are dismayed,
    for they have heard bad news.
They are disheartened,
    troubled like the restless sea.

twi: Damasko ayɛ mmerɛw,wayɛ sɛ ɔrebeguanwabɔ huboa;ahoyeraw ne ɔyaw akyekyere no,ɔyaw a ɛte sɛ ɔbea a, ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
english:
Damascus has become feeble,
    she has turned to flee
    and panic has gripped her;
anguish and pain have seized her,
    pain like that of a woman in labor.

twi: Adɛn nti na wonnyaw kuropɔn a agye din yi ntoo hɔ,kurow a mʼani gye mu?
english:
Why has the city of renown not been abandoned,
    the town in which I delight?

twi: Ampa ara ne mmerante bɛtotɔ wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔbɛma nʼasraafo nyinaa aka wɔn ano ato mu saa da no,”sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se.
“Mede ogya bɛto Damasko afasu mu;na ɛbɛhyew Ben-Hadad aban.”
english:
“I will set fire to the walls of Damascus;
    it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.”

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Kedar Ne Hasor HoNea ɛfa Kedar ne Hasor ahenni, a Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar tow hyɛɛ so no.Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Sɔre na kɔtow hyɛ Kedar sona sɛe nnipa a wɔwɔ apuei fam no.
english:
Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked:
This is what the Lord says:
“Arise, and attack Kedar
    and destroy the people of the East.

twi: Wɔbɛfa wɔn ntamadan ne wɔn nguankuw;wɔbɛfa wɔn nkataso,ne wɔn ho nneɛma ne yoma akɔ.Nnipa bɛteɛteɛ mu se,‘Ehu wɔ baabiara!’
english:
Their tents and their flocks will be taken;
    their shelters will be carried off
    with all their goods and camels.
People will shout to them,
    ‘Terror on every side!’

twi: “Munguan nkɔ ntɛmntɛm!Monhyehyɛ abodan a mu dɔ mu, mo a motete Hasor,”Awurade na ose.“Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar apam mo ti so;wayɛ nhyehyɛe a etia mo.
english:
“Flee quickly away!
    Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor,”
declares the Lord.
“Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you;
    he has devised a plan against you.

twi: “Sɔre kɔtow hyɛ ɔman bi so a woremmrɛ,ɔman a wɔte ahotoso mu,”Awurade na ose,“ɔman a wonni apon anaa akwanside;na emu nnipa nko ara na wɔte.
english:
“Arise and attack a nation at ease,
    which lives in confidence,”
declares the Lord,
“a nation that has neither gates nor bars;
    its people live far from danger.

twi: Wɔn mfurum bɛyɛ asade,na wɔn anantwikuw akɛse no bɛyɛ asade.Mɛbɔ saa nnipa a wɔtete akyirikyiri no ahwete ama mframa no,na mede amanehunu befi afa nyinaa aba wɔn so,”Awurade na ose.
english:
Their camels will become plunder,
    and their large herds will be spoils of war.
I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places
    and will bring disaster on them from every side,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Hasor bɛyɛ ahade ama adompo,ɛbɛda mpan afebɔɔ.Obiara rentena hɔ;onipa biara rentena mu.”
english:
“Hazor will become a haunt of jackals,
    a desolate place forever.
No one will live there;
    no people will dwell in it.”

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Elam HoEyi ne asɛm a, efi Awurade nkyɛn baa odiyifo Yeremia hɔ a ɛfa Elam ho, wɔ Yudahene Sedekia adedi mfiase:
english: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:

twi: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Hwɛ mebubu Elam agyan mu,nea wɔn ahoɔden gyina so no.
english:
This is what the Lord Almighty says:
“See, I will break the bow of Elam,
    the mainstay of their might.

twi: Mede mframa anan no bɛba Elam soafi ɔsorosoro afanan;mɛbɔ wɔn ahwete mframa anan no mu,na ɔman biara nni hɔ aElam atubrafo renkɔ so.
english:
I will bring against Elam the four winds
    from the four quarters of heaven;
I will scatter them to the four winds,
    and there will not be a nation
    where Elam’s exiles do not go.

twi: Mɛbɔ Elam ahwete wɔ wɔn atamfo anim,wɔ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn akum wɔn no anim;mede amanehunu bɛba wɔn sompo mʼabufuwhyew no,”Awurade na ose.“Mede afoa bɛtaa wɔnkosi sɛ, mewie wɔn korakora.
english:
I will shatter Elam before their foes,
    before those who want to kill them;
I will bring disaster on them,
    even my fierce anger,”
declares the Lord.
“I will pursue them with the sword
    until I have made an end of them.

twi: Mesi mʼahengua wɔ Elamna masɛe ne hene ne nʼadwumayɛfo,”Awurade na ose.
english:
I will set my throne in Elam
    and destroy her king and officials,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Nanso mɛsan de Elam adenya ama nonna a ɛreba no mu,”Awurade na ose.
english:
“Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam
    in days to come,”
declares the Lord.

twi: Asɛm A Ɛfa Babilonia HoAsɛm a Awurade nam odiyifo Yeremia so ka faa Babilonia ne Babiloniafo asase ho ni:
english: This is the word the Lord spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians:

twi: “Mommɔ no dawuru na mompae mu nka wɔ amanaman mu.Momma frankaa so na mompae mu nka;na momma wɔnte sɛ,‘Wɔbɛfa Babilonia;wobegu Bel anim ase,na ehu bɛhyɛ Merodak ma.Wobegu ne nsɛsode anim asena ehu bɛhyɛ nʼahoni ma.’
english:
“Announce and proclaim among the nations,
    lift up a banner and proclaim it;
    keep nothing back, but say,
‘Babylon will be captured;
    Bel will be put to shame,
    Marduk filled with terror.
Her images will be put to shame
    and her idols filled with terror.’

twi: Ɔman bi fi atifi fam bɛtow ahyɛ ne sona wɔbɛyɛ nʼasase amamfo.Obiara rentena so;nnipa ne mmoa beguan afi so.
english:
A nation from the north will attack her
    and lay waste her land.
No one will live in it;
    both people and animals will flee away.

twi: “Nna no mu ne saa bere no,”Awurade na ose,“Israelfo ne Yudafo bɛka abɔ mude nusu akɔhwehwɛ wɔn Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn.
english:
“In those days, at that time,”
    declares the Lord,
“the people of Israel and the people of Judah together
    will go in tears to seek the Lord their God.

twi: Wobebisa ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Sionna wɔde wɔn ani akyerɛ hɔ.Wɔbɛba de wɔn ho abɛbɔ Awuradewɔ daa apam awerɛ remfi mu.
english:
They will ask the way to Zion
    and turn their faces toward it.
They will come and bind themselves to the Lord
    in an everlasting covenant
    that will not be forgotten.

twi: “Me nkurɔfo ayɛ nguan a wɔayera;wɔn nguanhwɛfo ama wɔafom ɔkwanma wokyinkyin mmepɔw so.Wokyinkyin bepɔw ne koko sona wɔn werɛ fii wɔn ankasa homebea.
english:
“My people have been lost sheep;
    their shepherds have led them astray
    and caused them to roam on the mountains.
They wandered over mountain and hill
    and forgot their own resting place.

twi: Obiara a ohuu wɔn no tetew wɔn mu:wɔn atamfo kae se, ‘Yenni fɔ,efisɛ wɔyɛɛ bɔne tiaa Awurade, wɔn nokware didibea no,Awurade wɔn agyanom anidaso no.’
“Munguan mfi Babilonia;mumfi Babiloniafo asase so,na monyɛ sɛ mpapo a wodi nguankuw anim.

Mɛkanyan amanaman akɛse nkabomafi atifi fam asase so de wɔn abɛko atia Babilonia.Wobegyinagyina wɔn afa atia no,wobefi atifi fam ako afa no.Wɔn agyan bɛyɛ sɛ dɔmmarima a wɔakwadaw akodi mu,wɔn a wɔmmfa nsapan nsan wɔn akyi.
english:
For I will stir up and bring against Babylon
    an alliance of great nations from the land of the north.
They will take up their positions against her,
    and from the north she will be captured.
Their arrows will be like skilled warriors
    who do not return empty-handed.

twi: Enti wɔbɛfow Babilonia;wɔn a wɔfow no nyinaa benya asade bebree,”Awurade na ose.
“Esiane sɛ mo ani gye na mudi ahurusi,mo a mofow mʼagyapade,sɛ muhuruhuruw anigye so te sɛ nantwiforo a ɔwɔ sare frɔmfrɔm muna musu te sɛ apɔnkɔnini nti,
english:
“Because you rejoice and are glad,
    you who pillage my inheritance,
because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain
    and neigh like stallions,

twi: wo na ani bewu pa ara;nea ɔwoo wo anim begu ase.Ɔbɛyɛ akumaa wɔ amanaman no mu,sare, asase wosee ne nweatam.
english:
your mother will be greatly ashamed;
    she who gave you birth will be disgraced.
She will be the least of the nations—
    a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.

twi: Awurade abufuw nti, obiara rentena hɔna ɛbɛda mpan korakora.Wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ Babilonia nyinaa ho bedwiriw wɔn na wɔadi ne ho fɛwesiane nʼapirakuru nyinaa nti.
english:
Because of the Lord’s anger she will not be inhabited
    but will be completely desolate.
All who pass Babylon will be appalled;
    they will scoff because of all her wounds.

twi: “Munnyinagyina mo afa ntwa Babilonia ho nhyia,mo a motow agyan nyinaa.Montow no! Munnyaw bɛmma biara,efisɛ wayɛ bɔne atia Awurade.
english:
“Take up your positions around Babylon,
    all you who draw the bow.
Shoot at her! Spare no arrows,
    for she has sinned against the Lord.

twi: Monteɛ mu ntia no wɔ afanan nyinaa!Ɔma ne nsa so, nʼabandennen bubu,wodwiriw nʼafasu gu fam.Esiane sɛ eyi yɛ Awurade aweretɔ no nti,montɔ ne so were;monyɛ no sɛnea wayɛ afoforo no.
english:
Shout against her on every side!
    She surrenders, her towers fall,
    her walls are torn down.
Since this is the vengeance of the Lord,
    take vengeance on her;
    do to her as she has done to others.

twi: Munyi ogufo mfi Babilonia,ɔne otwafo a okura ne kantankrankyi wɔ otwabere mu no.Esiane nhyɛsofo no afoa ntiobiara nsan nkɔ ne nkurɔfo mu,obiara nguan nkɔ nʼankasa asase so.
english:
Cut off from Babylon the sower,
    and the reaper with his sickle at harvest.
Because of the sword of the oppressor
    let everyone return to their own people,
    let everyone flee to their own land.

twi: “Israel yɛ nguankuw a wɔahwetea gyata apam wɔn.Nea odii kan tetew ne muyɛ Asiriahene;na nea ɔdwerɛwee ne nnompe akyiri noyɛ Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar.”
english:
“Israel is a scattered flock
    that lions have chased away.
The first to devour them
    was the king of Assyria;
the last to crush their bones
    was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.”

twi: Ɛno nti, sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se:“Mɛtwe Babiloniahene ne nʼasase asosɛnea metwee Asiriahene aso no.
english:
Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says:
“I will punish the king of Babylon and his land
    as I punished the king of Assyria.

twi: Na mede Israel bɛsan aba nʼankasa didibea,na obedidi wɔ Karmel ne Basan;ɔbɛmee wɔ Efraim ne Gilead nkoko so.
english:
But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture,
    and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan;
their appetite will be satisfied
    on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

twi: Saa nna no ne saa bere no,”Awurade na ose,“Wɔbɛhwehwɛ Israel afɔbu mu,nanso wɔrennya bi,wɔbɛhwehwɛ Yuda nnebɔne mu,nanso wɔrenhu bi,efisɛ, mede nkae a migyaa wɔn no bɔne bɛkyɛ wɔn.
english:
In those days, at that time,”
    declares the Lord,
“search will be made for Israel’s guilt,
    but there will be none,
and for the sins of Judah,
    but none will be found,
    for I will forgive the remnant I spare.

twi: “Montow nhyɛ Merataim asase sone nnipa a wɔte Pekod.Montaa wɔn, munkunkum wɔnna monsɛe wɔn korakora,”Awurade na ose.“Monyɛ biribiara a mahyɛ mo no.
english:
“Attack the land of Merathaim
    and those who live in Pekod.
Pursue, kill and completely destroy them,”
declares the Lord.
    “Do everything I have commanded you.

twi: Ɔko mu gyegyeegye wɔ asase no so,ɔsɛe kɛse nnyigyei!
english:
The noise of battle is in the land,
    the noise of great destruction!

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔabubu na wɔabobɔasase nyinaa so asae!Hwɛ sɛnea Babilonia ada mpanwɔ amanaman no mu!
english:
How broken and shattered
    is the hammer of the whole earth!
How desolate is Babylon
    among the nations!

twi: Misum wo afiri, Babilonia,na eyii wo ansa na worehu;wohuu wo kyeree woefisɛ woko tiaa Awurade.
english:
I set a trap for you, Babylon,
    and you were caught before you knew it;
you were found and captured
    because you opposed the Lord.

twi: Otumfo Awurade abue nʼakode adekoradanna wayi nʼabufuwhyew akode de apue,efisɛ Asafo Awurade wɔ adwuma yɛwɔ Babiloniafo asase so.
english:
The Lord has opened his arsenal
    and brought out the weapons of his wrath,
for the Sovereign Lord Almighty has work to do
    in the land of the Babylonians.

twi: Mumfi akyirikyiri mmra ne so.Mummubu nʼasan no ani;monhɔre no siw sɛ awi akuwakuw.Monsɛe no korakorana munnyaw nkae biara mma no.
english:
Come against her from afar.
    Break open her granaries;
    pile her up like heaps of grain.
Completely destroy her
    and leave her no remnant.

twi: Munkunkum nʼanatwinini nyinaa;momfa wɔn nkɔ mma wonkokum wɔn!Mmusu nka wɔn! Efisɛ wɔn da no adu,bere a wɔde bɛtwe wɔn aso no.
english:
Kill all her young bulls;
    let them go down to the slaughter!
Woe to them! For their day has come,
    the time for them to be punished.

twi: Muntie akobɔfo ne aguanfo a wofi Babilonia nosɛ wɔreka wɔ Sionsɛnea Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn atɔ were,nʼasɔrefi ho aweretɔ.
english:
Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon
    declaring in Zion
how the Lord our God has taken vengeance,
    vengeance for his temple.

twi: “Momfrɛ agyantowfo nkɔtoa Babilonia,wɔn a wɔtow agyan nyinaa.Muntwa ne ho nhyia;mommma obiara nguan.Muntua ne nneyɛe so ka;monyɛ no sɛnea wayɛ.Efisɛ wabu Awurade animtiaa,Israel kronkronni no.
english:
“Summon archers against Babylon,
    all those who draw the bow.
Encamp all around her;
    let no one escape.
Repay her for her deeds;
    do to her as she has done.
For she has defied the Lord,
    the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Enti ne mmerante bɛtotɔ wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔbɛtɔre nʼasraafo nyinaa ase saa da no,”Awurade na ose.
“Hwɛ, mikyi wo; ɔhantanni.”Awurade, Asafo Awurade na ose,“efisɛ wo da no adubere a wɔde bɛtwe wʼaso no.
english:
“See, I am against you, you arrogant one,”
    declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty,
