The Lord has brought her grief
    because of her many sins.
Her children have gone into exile,
    captive before the foe.

twi: Anuonyam nyinaa atuafi Ɔbabea Sion so kɔ.Ne mmapɔmma ayɛ sɛ aforotea wonnya adidibea;na wɔde mmerɛwyɛ aguanwɔ wɔn ataafo anim.
english:
All the splendor has departed
    from Daughter Zion.
Her princes are like deer
    that find no pasture;
in weakness they have fled
    before the pursuer.

twi: Nʼamanehunu ne akyinkyinakyinkyin nna mu no,Yerusalem kae ademude nyinaaa na ɛwɔ no wɔ nna a atwa mu no mu.Ne nkurɔfo kɔtɔɔ ɔtamfo no nsa mu no,na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛboa no.Nʼatamfo de wɔn ani hwɛɛ nona wɔserew ne sɛe.
english:
In the days of her affliction and wandering
    Jerusalem remembers all the treasures
    that were hers in days of old.
When her people fell into enemy hands,
    there was no one to help her.
Her enemies looked at her
    and laughed at her destruction.

twi: Yerusalem ayɛ bɔne kɛseenti ne ho agu fi.Wɔn a wodi no ni no sopa no,efisɛ wɔahu nʼadagyaw;ɔno ankasa gu ahomena ɔdan nʼani.
english:
Jerusalem has sinned greatly
    and so has become unclean.
All who honored her despise her,
    for they have all seen her naked;
she herself groans
    and turns away.

twi: Nʼafideyɛ atu aka ne ntade mu;wannwene ne daakye ho.Nʼasehwe yɛ nwonwa;obiara ankyekye ne werɛ.“Awurade, hwɛ mʼamanehunu,efisɛ ɔtamfo adi nkonim.”
Ɔtamfo no de ne nsa toonʼademude nyinaa so;ohuu sɛ amanamanrehyɛn ne kronkronbea hɔ,nnipa a woabra sɛwɔnnhyɛn wʼasafo mu no.
english:
The enemy laid hands
    on all her treasures;
she saw pagan nations
    enter her sanctuary—
those you had forbidden
    to enter your assembly.

twi: Ne nkurɔfo nyinaa si apinibere a wɔrehwehwɛ aduan;wɔde wɔn ademude sesa aduande nya ahoɔden.“Awurade, hwɛ na dwene me ho,efisɛ wobu me animtiaa.”
english:
All her people groan
    as they search for bread;
they barter their treasures for food
    to keep themselves alive.
“Look, Lord, and consider,
    for I am despised.”

twi: “Ɛmfa mo ho ana, mo a mutwa mu wɔ hɔ nyinaa?Monhwɛ na munhu.Ɔyaw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛte sɛ me dea wɔma ɛbaa me so yi,nea Awurade de baa me sowɔ nʼabufuwhyew da no ana?
english:
“Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by?
    Look around and see.
Is any suffering like my suffering
    that was inflicted on me,
that the Lord brought on me
    in the day of his fierce anger?

twi: “Ɔsomaa ogya fii ɔsoro,ma ɛbaa me nnompe mu.Osum afiri maa mʼananna ɔsan me kɔɔ mʼakyi.Ɔyɛɛ me pasaa,metɔɔ beraw da mu nyinaa.
english:
“From on high he sent fire,
    sent it down into my bones.
He spread a net for my feet
    and turned me back.
He made me desolate,
    faint all the day long.

twi: “Woakyekyere me bɔne ahyɛ konnua mu;ɔde ne nsa nwen bɔɔ mu.Wɔde asɛn me kɔn muna Awurade atwe mʼahoɔden.Ɔde me ahyɛ wɔn amerentumi nnyina wɔn anim no nsa.
english:
“My sins have been bound into a yoke;
    by his hands they were woven together.
They have been hung on my neck,
    and the Lord has sapped my strength.
He has given me into the hands
    of those I cannot withstand.

twi: “Awurade apoakofo a wɔwɔ me ntam nyinaa;wafrɛ asraafo atia mesɛ wɔmmɛdwerɛw me mmerante.Awurade atiatia Ɔbabea Ɔbabun Yuda sowɔ ne nsakyiamoa mu.
english:
“The Lord has rejected
    all the warriors in my midst;
he has summoned an army against me
    to crush my young men.
In his winepress the Lord has trampled
    Virgin Daughter Judah.

twi: “Eyinom nti na misuna nusu aguare me.Obiara mmɛn a ɔbɛkyekye me werɛ,nea ɔbɛhyɛ me honhom den nni hɔ.Me mma agyigyaefisɛ ɔtamfo no adi nkonim.”
english:
“This is why I weep
    and my eyes overflow with tears.
No one is near to comfort me,
    no one to restore my spirit.
My children are destitute
    because the enemy has prevailed.”

twi: Sion trɛw ne nsa munanso obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛkyekye ne werɛ.Awurade ahyɛ ama Yakob sene mfɛfo bɛyɛ nʼatamfo;Yerusalem abɛyɛafide wɔ wɔn mu.
english:
Zion stretches out her hands,
    but there is no one to comfort her.
The Lord has decreed for Jacob
    that his neighbors become his foes;
Jerusalem has become
    an unclean thing among them.

twi: “Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni,nanso manni nʼahyɛde so.Muntie, mo amanaman nyinaamonhwɛ me yaw.Me mmerante ne mmabaakɔ nnommum mu.
english:
“The Lord is righteous,
    yet I rebelled against his command.
Listen, all you peoples;
    look on my suffering.
My young men and young women
    have gone into exile.

twi: “Mefrɛɛ mʼadɔfonanso woyii me mae.Mʼasɔfo ne me mpanyimfoase tɔree wɔ kuropɔn no mu,bere a wɔrehwehwɛ aduan adina wɔanwuwu.
english:
“I called to my allies
    but they betrayed me.
My priests and my elders
    perished in the city
while they searched for food
    to keep themselves alive.

twi: “Awurade, hwɛ me mmɔbɔ!Meredi yaw wɔ me mu,na me koma mu nso minni ahotɔ,efisɛ mayɛ otuatewfo kɛse.Afoa hyɛ me awerɛhow wɔ abɔnten so;ofie nso yɛ owu nko ara.
english:
“See, Lord, how distressed I am!
    I am in torment within,
and in my heart I am disturbed,
    for I have been most rebellious.
Outside, the sword bereaves;
    inside, there is only death.

twi: “Nnipa ate mʼapinisi,nanso obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛkyekye me werɛ.Mʼatamfo nyinaa ate mʼamanehunuwɔn ani gye nea woayɛ no ho.Ma nna a woahyɛ no mmrasɛnea wɔbɛyɛ sɛ me.
english:
“People have heard my groaning,
    but there is no one to comfort me.
All my enemies have heard of my distress;
    they rejoice at what you have done.
May you bring the day you have announced
    so they may become like me.

twi: “Fa wɔn atirimɔdensɛm nyinaa si wʼanim;na wo ne wɔn nnisɛnea wo ne me adi;esiane mʼamumɔyɛ no nti.Mʼapinisi dɔɔsona me koma abotow.”
english:
“Let all their wickedness come before you;
    deal with them
as you have dealt with me
    because of all my sins.
My groans are many
    and my heart is faint.”

twi: Sɛnea Awurade de nʼabufuwhyew mununkumakata Ɔbabea Sion so ni?Watow Israel anuonyamafi ɔsoro abɛhwe fam;wankae ne nan ntiasowɔ nʼabufuw da no.
english:
How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion
    with the cloud of his anger!
He has hurled down the splendor of Israel
    from heaven to earth;
he has not remembered his footstool
    in the day of his anger.

twi: Awurade annya ahummɔbɔna wamene Yakob atenae nyinaa;nʼabufuwhyew mu, wadwiriwYuda Babea abandennen no agu fam.Wagu nʼahenni ne ne mmapɔmmaho fi.
english:
Without pity the Lord has swallowed up
    all the dwellings of Jacob;
in his wrath he has torn down
    the strongholds of Daughter Judah.
He has brought her kingdom and its princes
    down to the ground in dishonor.

twi: Ɔde abufuwhyew atwitwaIsrael mmɛn nyinaa.Wayi ne bammɔwɔ bere a atamfo no reba.Wasɔ wɔ Yakob mu sɛ ogyatannaaa ɛhyew biribiara a atwa ho ahyia.
english:
In fierce anger he has cut off
    every horn of Israel.
He has withdrawn his right hand
    at the approach of the enemy.
He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire
    that consumes everything around it.

twi: Wapema ne bɛmma sɛ ɔtamfo;ne nsa nifa ayɛ krado.Te sɛ ɔtamfo no, wakunkumwɔn a wɔyɛ fɛ wɔ ani so nyinaa;wahwie nʼabufuwhyew sɛ ogyaagu Ɔbabea Sion ntamadan so.
Awurade ayɛ sɛ ɔtamfo;wamene Israel.Wamene nʼahemfi nyinaaasɛe nʼabandennen.Wama awerɛhowdi ne agyaadwotwa adɔɔsoama Yuda Babea.
english:
The Lord is like an enemy;
    he has swallowed up Israel.
He has swallowed up all her palaces
    and destroyed her strongholds.
He has multiplied mourning and lamentation
    for Daughter Judah.

twi: Wama nʼatenae ada mpan sɛ turo;wasɛe nʼaguabɔbea.Awurade ama Sion werɛ afinʼafahyɛ ne homenna;nʼabufuwhyew mu nowabu ɔhene ne ɔsɔfo animtiaa.
Awurade apo nʼafɔremukana wagyaa ne kronkronbea mu.Ɔde nʼahemfi afasuahyɛ nʼatamfo nsa.Wɔteɛ mu wɔ Awurade fite sɛ afahyɛ da.
english:
The Lord has rejected his altar
    and abandoned his sanctuary.
He has given the walls of her palaces
    into the hands of the enemy;
they have raised a shout in the house of the Lord
    as on the day of an appointed festival.

twi: Awurade sii nʼadwene pi sɛ ɔbɛsɛeƆbabea Sion fasu a atwa ne ho ahyia no.Ɔde susuhama too hona wannyae ɔsɛe no.Ɔmaa pie ne afasu dii abooboo;wɔn nyinaa sɛee.
english:
The Lord determined to tear down
    the wall around Daughter Zion.
He stretched out a measuring line
    and did not withhold his hand from destroying.
He made ramparts and walls lament;
    together they wasted away.

twi: Nʼapon amem fam;wɔn adaban nso, wabubu mu asɛe no.Ne hene ne ne mmapɔmma, watwa wɔn asu kɔ amanaman no mu,mmara nni hɔ bio,na nʼadiyifo nnya anisoadehu aefi Awurade hɔ bio.
english:
Her gates have sunk into the ground;
    their bars he has broken and destroyed.
Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations,
    the law is no more,
and her prophets no longer find
    visions from the Lord.

twi: Ɔbabea Sion mpanyimfotete fam ayɛ komm;wɔde mfutuma agu wɔn tirimafurafura atweaatam.Yerusalem mmabaaasisi wɔn ti ase.
english:
The elders of Daughter Zion
    sit on the ground in silence;
they have sprinkled dust on their heads
    and put on sackcloth.
The young women of Jerusalem
    have bowed their heads to the ground.

twi: Mʼani rentumi nnyae nisutew,me yafunu mu retwa me,me koma retew atɔ fam,efisɛ wɔasɛe me nkurɔfo,efisɛ mmofra ne mmotafowa totɔ pitiwɔ kuropɔn no mmɔnten so.
english:
My eyes fail from weeping,
    I am in torment within;
my heart is poured out on the ground
    because my people are destroyed,
because children and infants faint
    in the streets of the city.

twi: Wobisa wɔn nanom se,“Ɛhe na brodo ne nsa wɔ?”Bere a wɔtotɔ beraw sɛ apirafowɔ kuropɔn no mmɔnten so,bere a wɔn nkwa resawɔ wɔn nanom abasa so.
english:
They say to their mothers,
    “Where is bread and wine?”
as they faint like the wounded
    in the streets of the city,
as their lives ebb away
    in their mothers’ arms.

twi: Asɛm bɛn na metumi aka ama wo?Dɛn ho na metumi de wo atoto,Ɔbabea Yerusalem?Dɛn na metumi de asusuw wo,de akyekye wo werɛ,Sion Babea Ɔbabun?Wʼapirakuru so sɛ po.Hena na obetumi asa wo yare?
english:
What can I say for you?
    With what can I compare you,
    Daughter Jerusalem?
To what can I liken you,
    that I may comfort you,
    Virgin Daughter Zion?
Your wound is as deep as the sea.
    Who can heal you?

twi: Wʼadiyifo anisoadehuyɛ atoro a so nni mfaso;wɔanna mo amumɔyɛ adiansiw mo nnommumfa ano.Nkɔmhyɛ a wɔde maa mo noyɛ atoro ne nnaadaa.
english:
The visions of your prophets
    were false and worthless;
they did not expose your sin
    to ward off your captivity.
The prophecies they gave you
    were false and misleading.

twi: Wɔn a wotwa mu wo kwan so nyinaabobɔ wɔn nsam gu wo so;wodi wo ho fɛw na wɔwosow wɔn tigu Yerusalem Babea so ka se,“Eyi ne kuropɔn a na wɔfrɛ noahoɔfɛ a edi mu no?Asase nyinaa anigyede no ni?”
english:
All who pass your way
    clap their hands at you;
they scoff and shake their heads
    at Daughter Jerusalem:
“Is this the city that was called
    the perfection of beauty,
    the joy of the whole earth?”

twi: Wʼatamfo nyinaa baa wɔn anomtɛtrɛɛ tia wo;wɔserew na wɔtwɛre wɔn sena wɔka se, “Yɛamene no.Da a na yɛretwɛn no ni;Yɛatena ase ahu.”
Awurade ayɛ nea ɔhyehyɛe;wama nʼasɛm aɔhyɛɛ dedaada no aba mu.Watu wo agu a wanhu wo mmɔbɔ,wama ɔtamfo no ani agyewama wʼatamfo no mmɛn so.
english:
The Lord has done what he planned;
    he has fulfilled his word,
    which he decreed long ago.
He has overthrown you without pity,
    he has let the enemy gloat over you,
    he has exalted the horn of your foes.

twi: Nnipa no komasu frɛ Awurade.Ɔbabea Sion afasu,momma mo nusu nsen sɛ asubɔntenawia ne anadwo;munnye mo ahomemomma mo ani nso nnya ɔhome.
english:
The hearts of the people
    cry out to the Lord.
You walls of Daughter Zion,
    let your tears flow like a river
    day and night;
give yourself no relief,
    your eyes no rest.

twi: Sɔre, su dennen anadwo,ɔdasu mu mfiase;hwie wo koma mu nsɛm sɛ nsugu Awurade anim.Ma wo nsa so kyerɛ nowo mma nkwa nti,wɔn a ɔkɔm ama wɔatotɔ berawwɔ mmɔnten so.
english:
Arise, cry out in the night,
    as the watches of the night begin;
pour out your heart like water
    in the presence of the Lord.
Lift up your hands to him
    for the lives of your children,
who faint from hunger
    at every street corner.

twi: “Hwɛ na dwene ho, Awurade:Hena na wode no afa saa ɔkwan yi so pɛn?Ɛsɛ sɛ mmea we wɔn yafunumma nam ana,mma a wɔahwɛ wɔn?Ɛsɛ sɛ wokunkum ɔsɔfo ne odiyifowɔ Awurade kronkronbea ana?
english:
“Look, Lord, and consider:
    Whom have you ever treated like this?
Should women eat their offspring,
    the children they have cared for?
Should priest and prophet be killed
    in the sanctuary of the Lord?

twi: “Mmofra ne mpanyin da adabumwɔ mmɔnten so mfutuma mu so,me mmerante ne mmabaaatotɔ wɔ afoa ano.Woakum wɔn wɔ wʼabufuwda;woayam wɔn na woannya ahummɔbɔ.

“Sɛnea wotoo wo nsa frɛ wɔ aponto da no,saa ara na wofrɛfrɛɛamanehunu fii afanan nyinaa tiaa me.Awurade abufuw da no,obiara anguan na anka obiara:wɔn a mehwɛɛ wɔn na metetew wɔn no,me tamfo adwerɛw wɔn.”
english:
“As you summon to a feast day,
    so you summoned against me terrors on every side.
In the day of the Lord’s anger
    no one escaped or survived;
those I cared for and reared
    my enemy has destroyed.”

twi: Mene ɔbarima a mahu amanewɔ nʼabufuw abaa ano.
english:
I am the man who has seen affliction
    by the rod of the Lord’s wrath.

twi: Wapam me afi ne ho ama manantewsum mu na ɛnyɛ hann mu;
english:
He has driven me away and made me walk
    in darkness rather than light;

twi: Ampa ara wama nsa so atia mempɛn bebree, da mu nyinaa.
english:
indeed, he has turned his hand against me
    again and again, all day long.

twi: Wama me were ne me nam anyinNa wabubu me nnompe.
english:
He has made my skin and my flesh grow old
    and has broken my bones.

twi: Waka me ahyɛ mu, na watua me anoɔde nweenwen ne ahokyere atwa me ho ahyia.
english:
He has besieged me and surrounded me
    with bitterness and hardship.

twi: Wama matena sum musɛ wɔn a wɔawuwu dedaw no.
english:
He has made me dwell in darkness
    like those long dead.

twi: Wato ɔfasu atwa me ho ahyia enti mintumi nguan;wagu me nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ama matɔ beraw.
english:
He has walled me in so I cannot escape;
    he has weighed me down with chains.

twi: Mpo sɛ mefrɛ anaasɛ mebɔ mpae srɛ mmoa aosiw me mpaebɔ ano.
english:
Even when I call out or cry for help,
    he shuts out my prayer.

twi: Ɔde abotan asiw me kwan;wama mʼakwan ayɛ kɔntɔnkye.
english:
He has barred my way with blocks of stone;
    he has made my paths crooked.

twi: Te sɛ sisi a ɔda hɔ retwɛn,te sɛ gyata a watɛw,
english:
Like a bear lying in wait,
    like a lion in hiding,

twi: ɔtwee me fii ɔkwan no mu bebaree mena ogyaw me a minni mmoa biara.
english:
he dragged me from the path and mangled me
    and left me without help.

twi: Okuntun ne ta muna ɔde ne bɛmma kyerɛɛ me so.
english:
He drew his bow
    and made me the target for his arrows.

twi: Ɔde bɛmma a efi ne kotoku muhwirew me koma mu.
english:
He pierced my heart
    with arrows from his quiver.

twi: Meyɛɛ akyiwade maa me nkurɔfo nyinaa;wɔto akutia nnwomde di me ho fɛw da mu nyinaa.
english:
I became the laughingstock of all my people;
    they mock me in song all day long.

twi: Ɔde nhaban nweenwen ahyɛ me ma.Wama me bɔnwoma anom.
english:
He has filled me with bitter herbs
    and given me gall to drink.

twi: Ɔde mmosea abubu me se;na watiatia me so wɔ mfutuma mu.
english:
He has broken my teeth with gravel;
    he has trampled me in the dust.

twi: Wɔama asomdwoe abɔ me;na me werɛ afi yiyedi.
english:
I have been deprived of peace;
    I have forgotten what prosperity is.

twi: Enti mise, “Mʼanuonyam asa,nea mede mʼani too so Awurade mu no nyinaa.”
english:
So I say, “My splendor is gone
    and all that I had hoped from the Lord.”

twi: Mekae mʼamanehunu wɔ mʼakyinkyinakyinkyin mu,nweenwen ne bɔnwoma mu.
english:
I remember my affliction and my wandering,
    the bitterness and the gall.

twi: Mekae yiye,na me kra abotow wɔ me mu.
english:
I well remember them,
    and my soul is downcast within me.

twi: Nanso midwen eyi ho;saa nti mewɔ anidaso.
english:
Yet this I call to mind
    and therefore I have hope:

twi: Awurade dɔ kɛse nti yɛnsɛee ɛ.Nʼayamhyehye nni huammɔ.
english:
Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed,
    for his compassions never fail.

twi: Ɛyɛ foforo anɔpa biara;wo nokwaredi yɛ kɛse.
english:
They are new every morning;
    great is your faithfulness.

twi: Meka kyerɛ me ho se,“Awurade yɛ me kyɛfa, enti mɛtwɛn no.”
english:
I say to myself, “The Lord is my portion;
    therefore I will wait for him.”

twi: Awurade ye ma wɔn a wɔn anidaso wɔ ne mu,onipa a ɔhwehwɛ no no;
english:
The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him,
    to the one who seeks him;

twi: Eye sɛ wɔyɛ kommde twɛn Awurade nkwagye.
english:
it is good to wait quietly
    for the salvation of the Lord.

twi: Eye ma ɔbarima sɛ ɔsoa konnua nowɔ ne mmerantebere mu.
english:
It is good for a man to bear the yoke
    while he is young.

twi: Ma ɔntena ase komm,efisɛ Awurade de ato ne so.
english:
Let him sit alone in silence,
    for the Lord has laid it on him.

twi: Ma ɔmfa nʼanim nsie wɔ mfutuma mu,ebia anidaso wɔ hɔ.
english:
Let him bury his face in the dust—
    there may yet be hope.

twi: Ma ɔmfa nʼafono mma nea ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔbɔ no nona ɔnhyɛ no aniwu.
english:
Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him,
    and let him be filled with disgrace.

twi: Na Awurade ntow onipa biara nkyene koraa.
english:
For no one is cast off
    by the Lord forever.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu, ɔde awerɛhow ba de, nanso obenya ayamhyehye.Ne dɔ kɛse no to rentwa da.
english:
Though he brings grief, he will show compassion,
    so great is his unfailing love.

twi: Ofi amemenemfe mu de amanehunuanaa awerɛhow brɛ nnipa mma.
english:
For he does not willingly bring affliction
    or grief to anyone.

twi: Sɛ wɔde wɔn nan dwerɛwnneduafo a wɔwɔ asase no so a,
english:
To crush underfoot
    all prisoners in the land,

twi: sɛ wotiatia obi ahofadi sowɔ Ɔsorosoroni no anim a,
english:
to deny people their rights
    before the Most High,

twi: anaa sɛ wobu obi ntɛnkyew a,Awurade renhu saa nneɛma yi ana?
english:
to deprive them of justice—
    would not the Lord see such things?

twi: Hena na obetumi aka na wama aba muwɔ bere a ɛnyɛ Awurade na ɔhyɛe?
english:
Who can speak and have it happen
    if the Lord has not decreed it?

twi: Ɛnyɛ Ɔsorosoroni no anomna mmusu ne nnepa fi ana?
english:
Is it not from the mouth of the Most High
    that both calamities and good things come?

twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔteasefo nwiinwiibere a wɔatwe nʼaso wɔ ne bɔne ho?
english:
Why should the living complain
    when punished for their sins?

twi: Momma yɛnhwehwɛ yɛn akwan mu na yɛnsɔ nhwɛ,na yɛnsan nkɔ Awurade nkyɛn.
english:
Let us examine our ways and test them,
    and let us return to the Lord.

twi: Momma yɛmma yɛn koma ne yɛn nsa so,nkyerɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro, na yɛnka se:
english:
Let us lift up our hearts and our hands
    to God in heaven, and say:

twi: “Yɛayɛ bɔne, na yɛatew atuana wamfa ankyɛ.
english:
“We have sinned and rebelled
    and you have not forgiven.

twi: “Wode abufuw akata wo ho ataa yɛn;na woakunkum a woannya ahummɔbɔ.
english:
“You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us;
    you have slain without pity.

twi: Wode wo ho asie omununkum munti mpaebɔ biara nnu wo nkyɛn.
english:
You have covered yourself with a cloud
    so that no prayer can get through.

twi: Woayɛ yɛn atantanne ne nwurawɔ amanaman no mu.
english:
You have made us scum and refuse
    among the nations.

twi: “Yɛn atamfo nyinaa abaa wɔn anom tɛtrɛɛde tia yɛn.
english:
“All our enemies have opened their mouths
    wide against us.

twi: Yɛabrɛ ne ahunahuna ne akukuruhwease,mmubui ne ɔsɛe.”
english:
We have suffered terror and pitfalls,
    ruin and destruction.”

twi: Me nusu sen sɛ asutenefisɛ wɔasɛe me nkurɔfo.
english:
Streams of tears flow from my eyes
    because my people are destroyed.

twi: Me nusu bɛsen ara,na ɛrennyae,
english:
My eyes will flow unceasingly,
    without relief,

twi: kosi sɛ Awurade bɛhwɛafi ɔsoro, na wahu.
english:
until the Lord looks down
    from heaven and sees.

twi: Nea mihu no ma me kra werɛ how,me kuropɔn no mu mmea nyinaa nti.
english:
What I see brings grief to my soul
    because of all the women of my city.

twi: Mʼatamfo a menyɛɛ wɔn hweepampam me sɛ anomaa.
english:
Those who were my enemies without cause
    hunted me like a bird.

twi: Wɔpɛɛ sɛ wotwa me nkwa sona wosiw me abo wɔ amoa mu;
english:
They tried to end my life in a pit
    and threw stones at me;

twi: nsu bu faa me ti so,na ɛyɛɛ me sɛnea wɔrewie me.
english:
the waters closed over my head,
    and I thought I was about to perish.

twi: Mebɔɔ wo din, Awuradefii amoa no ase tɔnn.
english:
I called on your name, Lord,
    from the depths of the pit.

twi: Wotee me sufrɛ: “Nsiw wʼasowɔ me gye sufrɛ ho.”
english:
You heard my plea: “Do not close your ears
    to my cry for relief.”

twi: Wutwiw bɛn me bere a mefrɛɛ wo no,na wokae se, “Nsuro.”
english:
You came near when I called you,
    and you said, “Do not fear.”

twi: Wo Awurade, wudii mʼasɛm maa me;na wugyee me nkwa.
english:
You, Lord, took up my case;
    you redeemed my life.

twi: Woahu bɔne a wɔayɛ me, Awurade.Di mʼasɛm ma me!
english:
Lord, you have seen the wrong done to me.
    Uphold my cause!

twi: Woahu wɔn aweretɔ no mu den,wɔn pɔw a wɔbɔ tia me no nyinaa.
english:
You have seen the depth of their vengeance,
    all their plots against me.

twi: Awurade, woate wɔn ntwirii,wɔn pɔw a wɔbɔ tia me no nyinaa,
english:
Lord, you have heard their insults,
    all their plots against me—

twi: nea mʼatamfo ka no asomsɛm na wɔka no brɛoode tia me da mu nyinaa.
english:
what my enemies whisper and mutter
    against me all day long.

twi: Hwɛ wɔn! Sɛ wogyinagyina hɔ anaasɛ wɔtete hɔ,wɔto akutia nnwom de di me ho fɛw.
english:
Look at them! Sitting or standing,
    they mock me in their songs.

twi: Fa nea ɛfata tua wɔn so ka, Awurade,nea wɔn nsa ayɛ nti.
english:
Pay them back what they deserve, Lord,
    for what their hands have done.

twi: Pirim wɔn koma,na ma wo nnome mmra wɔn so.
english:
Put a veil over their hearts,
    and may your curse be on them!

twi: Fa abufuw taa wɔn, na sɛe wɔnfi Awurade ɔsorosoro ase.
english:
Pursue them in anger and destroy them
    from under the heavens of the Lord.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea sikakɔkɔɔ ayera ne hyerɛn no niSikakɔkɔɔ ankasa na ho abiri saa!Wɔatoto aboɔdemmo kronkron apetewɔ abɔnten biara so.
english:
How the gold has lost its luster,
    the fine gold become dull!
The sacred gems are scattered
    at every street corner.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea Sion mmabarima a wodi muna anka wɔsom bo sɛ sikakɔkɔɔ no ayɛ,mprempren wɔfa wɔn sɛ dɔte nkuku,ɔnwemfo nsa ano adwuma!
english:
How the precious children of Zion,
    once worth their weight in gold,
are now considered as pots of clay,
    the work of a potter’s hands!

twi: Mpo adompo yi wɔn nufuma wɔn mma num,nanso me nkurɔfo ayɛ atirimɔdenfosɛ sohori a ɔwɔ sare so.
english:
Even jackals offer their breasts
    to nurse their young,
but my people have become heartless
    like ostriches in the desert.

twi: Osukɔm nti, akokoaa tɛkrɛmafam ne dodo mu;mmofra no srɛ aduan,nanso obiara mfa mma wɔn.
english:
Because of thirst the infant’s tongue
    sticks to the roof of its mouth;
the children beg for bread,
    but no one gives it to them.

twi: Wɔn a na anka wodi nnuan pa noohia buruburoo aka wɔn wɔ mmɔnten so.Wɔn a wɔde sirikyi tetew wɔn nomprempren wɔdeda nso a wɔaboa ano so.
english:
Those who once ate delicacies
    are destitute in the streets.
Those brought up in royal purple
    now lie on ash heaps.

twi: Me nkurɔfo asotweso sen Sodom awotuu wɔn mpofirim no,a wɔannya ɔboafo biara de.
english:
The punishment of my people
    is greater than that of Sodom,
which was overthrown in a moment
    without a hand turned to help her.

twi: Na wɔn ahenemma ho twa sen sukyerɛmma,na wɔnan sen nufusu,na wɔn nipadua no bere, na ɛwɔ ahoɔden te sɛ abohemaa,na wɔte sɛ hoabo.
english:
Their princes were brighter than snow
    and whiter than milk,
their bodies more ruddy than rubies,
    their appearance like lapis lazuli.

twi: Nanso mprempren de, wobiri sen wusiw bɔtɔ;na wonhu wɔn yiye wɔ mmɔnten so.Wɔn were atwintwam wɔ wɔn nnompe so;ho awo wosee sɛ abaa.
Wɔn a wɔtotɔɔ wɔ afoa ano no ye koraasen wɔn a ɔkɔm kunkum wɔn;ɔkɔm tware wɔn ma wowuwu,esiane aduan a enni mfuw so nti.
english:
Those killed by the sword are better off
    than those who die of famine;
racked with hunger, they waste away
    for lack of food from the field.

twi: Mmea a wɔwɔ ayamhyehyede wɔn nsa anoa wɔn ankasa mma,ayɛ wɔn aduan,bere a wɔsɛee me nkurɔfo no.
english:
With their own hands compassionate women
    have cooked their own children,
who became their food
    when my people were destroyed.

twi: Awurade ada nʼabufuwhyew nyinaa adi;wahwie nʼabufuw a ano yɛ den no.Ɔsɔɔ ogya ano wɔ Sionma ɛhyew ne fapem.
english:
The Lord has given full vent to his wrath;
    he has poured out his fierce anger.
He kindled a fire in Zion
    that consumed her foundations.

twi: Asase so ahemfo annye anni,wiase mu nnipa nso annye annisɛ atamfo betumi ahyɛnYerusalem apon mu.
english:
The kings of the earth did not believe,
    nor did any of the peoples of the world,
that enemies and foes could enter
    the gates of Jerusalem.

twi: Nanso esii, nʼadiyifo no bɔnene nʼasɔfo amumɔyɛ nti,wɔn na wohwiee atreneefo mogyaguu wɔ kuropɔn no mu.
english:
But it happened because of the sins of her prophets
    and the iniquities of her priests,
who shed within her
    the blood of the righteous.

twi: Afei wɔkeka wɔ mmɔnten sote sɛ nnipa a wɔn ani afura.Mogya a ama wɔn ho agu fi no ntiobiara suro sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛka wɔn ntade.
english:
Now they grope through the streets
    as if they were blind.
They are so defiled with blood
    that no one dares to touch their garments.

twi: Nnipa teɛteɛɛ mu gu wɔn so se, “Mumfi ha nkɔ! Mo ho ntew!”“Monkɔ, monkɔ! Mommfa mo ho nka yɛn.”Sɛ woguan kɔnenam aamanaman no mu nnipa ka se,“Wɔrentumi ntena ha bio.”
english:
“Go away! You are unclean!” people cry to them.
    “Away! Away! Don’t touch us!”
When they flee and wander about,
    people among the nations say,
    “They can stay here no longer.”

twi: Awurade ankasa abɔ wɔn ahwete;nʼani nni wɔn so bio.Wɔmmfa nidi mma asɔfo,na wɔn ani nsɔ mpanyimfo.
english:
The Lord himself has scattered them;
    he no longer watches over them.
The priests are shown no honor,
    the elders no favor.

twi: Nea ɛka ho bio, yɛn ani anni ammoa yɛn,yɛpɛɛ sɛ yebenya mmoa, nanso ɛyɛɛ ɔkwa;yefi yɛn abantenten so de yɛn ani tooɔman a wɔrentumi nnye yɛn so.
english:
Moreover, our eyes failed,
    looking in vain for help;
from our towers we watched
    for a nation that could not save us.

twi: Nnipa dii yɛn ntɛntɛnso wɔ yɛn anammɔntu mu,enti yɛantumi annantew yɛn mmɔnten so.Yɛn awiei bɛnee, na wɔkan yɛn nna,efisɛ na yɛn awiei adu so.
english:
People stalked us at every step,
    so we could not walk in our streets.
Our end was near, our days were numbered,
    for our end had come.

twi: Yɛn ataafo ho yɛ haresen akɔre a wɔwɔ wim;wɔtaa yɛn faa mmepɔw sona wɔtɛw yɛn wɔ sare so.
english:
Our pursuers were swifter
    than eagles in the sky;
they chased us over the mountains
    and lay in wait for us in the desert.

twi: Nea Awurade asra no ngo, yɛn nkwa home ankasa no,kɔtɔɔ wɔn mfiri mu.Yegye dii sɛ ne nwini ase,yebenya nkwa wɔ amanaman no mu.
english:
The Lord’s anointed, our very life breath,
    was caught in their traps.
We thought that under his shadow
    we would live among the nations.

twi: Di ahurusi na ma wʼani nnye, Edom Babea,wo a wote Us asase so.Wɔde kuruwa no bɛma wo nso bi;wobɛbow na wɔabɔ wo adagyaw.
english:
Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom,
    you who live in the land of Uz.
But to you also the cup will be passed;
    you will be drunk and stripped naked.

twi: Ɔbabea Sion, wʼasotwe bɛba awiei;ɔremma wo nkɔ so ntena nnommum mu.Nanso Ɔbabea Edom, obetua wo bɔne so kana wada wʼamumɔyɛ adi.
english:
Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion;
    he will not prolong your exile.
But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom,
    and expose your wickedness.

twi: Awurade, kae nea aba yɛn so;hwɛ, na hu yɛn animguase.
english:
Remember, Lord, what has happened to us;
    look, and see our disgrace.

twi: Wɔadan yɛn agyapade ama ahɔho,wɔde yɛn afi ama ananafo.
english:
Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,
    our homes to foreigners.

twi: Yɛayɛ nyisaa na yenni agyanom,yɛn nanom yɛ akunafo.
english:
We have become fatherless,
    our mothers are widows.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛtɔ nsu a yɛnom;yebenya nnyina a, gye sɛ yɛtɔ.
english:
We must buy the water we drink;
    our wood can be had only at a price.

twi: Wɔn a wɔtaa yɛn no abɛn yɛn pɛɛ;Yɛabrɛ na yennya ahomegye.
english:
Those who pursue us are at our heels;
    we are weary and find no rest.

twi: Yɛde yɛn ho maa Misraim ne Asiriasɛnea yebenya aduan a ɛbɛso yɛn.
english:
We submitted to Egypt and Assyria
    to get enough bread.

twi: Yɛn agyanom yɛɛ bɔne, na wonni hɔ bio,na yɛn na wɔn asotwe abɛda yɛn so.
english:
Our ancestors sinned and are no more,
    and we bear their punishment.

twi: Nkoa di yɛn so,na obiara nni hɔ a obegye yɛn afi wɔn nsam.
english:
Slaves rule over us,
    and there is no one to free us from their hands.

twi: Yɛde yɛn nkwa bɔ afɔre de pɛ yɛn anoduan,afoa a ɛwɔ sare so no nti.
english:
We get our bread at the risk of our lives
    because of the sword in the desert.

twi: Yɛn honam adɔ sɛ fononoo.Ɔkɔm ama atiridii abɔ yɛn.
english:
Our skin is hot as an oven,
    feverish from hunger.

twi: Wɔato mmea mmonnaa wɔ Sion,ne mmabun a wɔwɔ Yuda nkurow so.
english:
Women have been violated in Zion,
    and virgins in the towns of Judah.

twi: Wɔkyekyere mmapɔmma nsa na wɔasɛn wɔn;wɔmmfa nidi mma mpanyimfo.
english:
Princes have been hung up by their hands;
    elders are shown no respect.

twi: Mmerante yɛ adwumaden wɔ awiyammo so;na mmerantewa nan toto wɔ nnyina duruduru ase.
english:
Young men toil at the millstones;
    boys stagger under loads of wood.

twi: Mpanyimfo ntena kuropɔn apon ano bio;mmerante agyae wɔn nnwonto.
english:
The elders are gone from the city gate;
    the young men have stopped their music.

twi: Ahosɛpɛw afi yɛn koma mu;yɛn asaw adan agyaadwotwa.
english:
Joy is gone from our hearts;
    our dancing has turned to mourning.

twi: Ahenkyɛw afi yɛn ti so.Yɛn ara, yennue sɛ yɛayɛ bɔne!
english:
The crown has fallen from our head.
    Woe to us, for we have sinned!

twi: Eyi nti yɛn koma atɔ beraw,eyinom nti yɛn ani so ayɛ kusuu
english:
Because of this our hearts are faint,
    because of these things our eyes grow dim

twi: wɔ Sion bepɔw a ada mpanna sakraman nenam so no nti.
english:
for Mount Zion, which lies desolate,
    with jackals prowling over it.

twi: Wo, Awurade, di hene afebɔɔ;wʼahengua fi awo ntoatoaso kosi awo ntoatoaso.
english:
You, Lord, reign forever;
    your throne endures from generation to generation.

twi: Adɛn nti na wo werɛ fi yɛn daa yi?Adɛn nti na wagyaw yɛn, mmere tenten mu yi?
english:
Why do you always forget us?
    Why do you forsake us so long?

twi: Ka yɛn bata wo ho bio, Awurade, na yɛatumi asan aba wo nkyɛn;yɛ yɛn nna foforo sɛ tete no
english:
Restore us to yourself, Lord, that we may return;
    renew our days as of old

twi: gye sɛ woapo yɛn koraaanaasɛ wo bo afuw yɛn mmoroso.
english:
unless you have utterly rejected us
    and are angry with us beyond measure.

twi: Ɔhyew AfɔrebɔAfei, Awurade kasa fii Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. He said,

twi: “Kyerɛ Israelfo no se, ‘sɛ morebɔ Awurade afɔre a, momfa mo anantwi ne mo nguan no bi na mommɔ saa afɔre no.
english: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When anyone among you brings an offering to the Lord, bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ mo ɔhyew afɔrebɔde no yɛ nantwi a ofi mo nantwibuw mu a, momfa nantwi a onnii dɛm na ɛmmɔ saa afɔre no sɛnea ɛbɛsɔ Awurade ani. Fa aboa no kɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no pon ano na ɛhɔ na asɔfo no begye wʼayɛyɛde a wode rebrɛ Awurade no.
english: “‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ onipa a ɔde aboa no reba no de ne nsa gu aboa no ti so sɛ mpata ma afɔrebɔni no. Onyankopɔn bɛpɛ aboa no wu sen sɛ afɔrebɔni a ɔde saa aboa no bɛba no bewu sɛ ne bɔne so akatua.
english: You are to lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on your behalf to make atonement for you.

twi: Afɔrebɔni no bekum aboa no wɔ hɔ wɔ Awurade anim. Na Aaron mmabarima asɔfo no asɔw aboa no mogya de akyerɛ Awurade. Na wɔde mogya no apete afɔremuka a esi Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan no ano no ne ho nyinaa.
english: You are to slaughter the young bull before the Lord, and then Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

twi: Afei, asɔfo no bɛpa aboa no ho nwoma na wɔabobɔw.
english: You are to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron mmabarima no bɛsɔ gya wɔ afɔremuka no so.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

twi: Na wɔde aboa no akwaa bi ne ne ti ne ne srade ka ho agu nnyansin no so.
english: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

twi: Momfa nsu nhohoro nʼayamde ne ne nan ho na asɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so. Ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, aduan afɔrebɔ, ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ afɔrebɔ no yɛ ɔhyew afɔre na aboa no yɛ oguan anaa abirekyi a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onini a ne ho nni dɛm biara.
english: “‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, you are to offer a male without defect.

twi: Onipa a ɔde no bae no bekum no Awurade anim wɔ afɔremuka no atifi na Aaron mmabarima asɔfo no apete mogya no agu afɔremuka no so ne ɛho nyinaa.
english: You are to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

twi: Ɔbɛhyehyɛ nam no na asɔfo no de nʼasinasin no ne ti no ne ne srade no agu nnyansin a egu afɔremuka no so no so.
english: You are to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

twi: Wɔde nsu bɛhohoro nʼayamde ne ne nan no ho ansa na asɔfo no ahyew wɔ afɔremuka no so de ama Awurade; efisɛ ɔhyew afɔre sɔ Awurade ani.
english: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of them and burn them on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔde anomaa bɔ ɔhyew afɔre a, ɔmfa nturukuku anaa mmorɔnomamma.
english: “‘If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you are to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no bɛfa anomaa no de no akɔ afɔremuka no so na watew ne ti ahyew no, na wasɔn ne mogya no agu afɔremuka no nkyɛn.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

twi: Afei, ɔsɔfo no beyi ne mene ase, atutu ne ntakra no na watow agu nsõ no mu wɔ afɔremuka no apuei fam.
english: He is to remove the crop and the feathers and throw them down east of the altar where the ashes are.

twi: Afei, ɔbɛtwe ne ntaban mu ama emu ntin no atetew asensɛn hɔ, na ɔsɔfo no ahyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so. Ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, aduan afɔrebɔ, ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: He shall tear it open by the wings, not dividing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is burning on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Atoko Afɔrebɔ“ ‘Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɔ aduan afɔre de ma Awurade no, ɛsɛ sɛ afɔrebɔde no yɛ asikresiam muhumuhu koraa. Wonhwie ngo ngu so mfa aduhuam mfra
english: “‘When anyone brings a grain offering to the Lord, their offering is to be of the finest flour. They are to pour olive oil on it, put incense on it

twi: nkɔma Aaron mma asɔfo no. Ɔsɔfo no bɛsaw siam ne ngo no nsa mma de aka aduhuam no nyinaa ho na wahyew eyi sɛ afɔremuka no nkae ade, aduan afɔrebɔ, ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: and take it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikresiam nkae no ma Aaron ne ne mmabarima sɛ wɔn aduan; nanso wɔfa ne nyinaa sɛ afɔre kronkron a wɔabɔ ama Awurade.
english: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ wɔde brodo a wɔato no fononoo mu brɛ Awurade sɛ afɔrebɔde a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu a wɔde ngo afra ato a mmɔkaw nni mu na ɛbɔ saa afɔre no. Mutumi de brodo ntrantraa dɛdɛ a mmɔkaw nni mu na mode ngo afa so nso bɔ afɔre ma ɛyɛ yiye.
english: “‘If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of the finest flour: either thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in or thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with olive oil.

twi: Sɛ afɔrebɔde no yɛ aduan a wɔato wɔ dade so a, asikresiam muhumuhu a mmɔkaw mfra mu, na mode ngo afra na momfa mmɔ saa afɔre no.
english: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of the finest flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.

twi: Mummubu mu asinasin na munhwie ngo ngu so na ɛnyɛ sɛ atoko afɔre ara pɛ.
english: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

twi: Sɛ monoa mo afɔre no wɔ kuruwa mu a, ɛno nso, momfa asikresiam muhumuhu a mode ngo afra na ɛmmɔ saa afɔre no.
english: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of the finest flour and some olive oil.

twi: Sɛ moyɛ aduan bi, sɛ motoe, sɛ mokyewee anaasɛ mohowee no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode saa afɔrebɔde no kɔma ɔsɔfo na ɔno nso de kɔ afɔremuka no anim de kɔma Awurade.
english: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

twi: Afɔrebɔde no mu kakraa bi na ɛsɛ sɛ asɔfo no hyew, nanso Awurade ani bɛsɔ ade mu no nyinaa.
english: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Nea ɛbɛka no yɛ asɔfo no dea, nanso wɔfa no sɛ ne nyinaa yɛ ɔhyew afɔre kronkron a wɔabɔ de ama Awurade.
english: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Afɔre a mode asikresiam na ɛbɔ no, mommfa mmɔkaw mmfra mu, efisɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔhyew afɔre biara a mobɛbɔ ama Awurade no, mode mmɔkaw anaa ɛwo fra mu.
english: “‘Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in a food offering presented to the Lord.

twi: Mode bɛbrɛ Awurade sɛ aduankan afɔrebɔde, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so sɛ afɔre a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

twi: Momfa nkyene mfra afɔrebɔde biara. Munnyi mo Nyankopɔn apam mu nkyene mmfi mo atoko afɔrebɔ mu; momfa nkyene nka mo afɔrebɔ nyinaa ho.
english: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ mode mo nnɔbae a edi kan mu aba kan rebɛbɔ afɔre a, emu aburow no munhuan ho na montoto na momfa mma Awurade.
english: “‘If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord, offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

twi: Momfa ngo ne aduhuam nyɛ ho; ɛyɛ atoko afɔre.
english: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew aburow a wɔayam ne ngo no nkae de aduhuam afra sɛ aduan afɔrebɔde a wɔde aba Awurade anim.
english: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as a food offering presented to the Lord.

twi: Asomdwoe Afɔrebɔ“ ‘Sɛ obiara pɛ sɛ ɔbɔ asomdwoe afɔre ma Awurade a, otumi de nantwinini anaa nantwibere bɔ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ aboa no yɛ nea ne ho nni dɛm biara.
english: “‘If your offering is a fellowship offering, and you offer an animal from the herd, whether male or female, you are to present before the Lord an animal without defect.

twi: Onipa a ɔde aboa no aba no de ne nsa begu aboa no apampam na wakum no wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano. Na Aaron mmabarima asɔfo no apete aboa no mogya agu afɔremuka no ho.
english: You are to lay your hand on the head of your offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash the blood against the sides of the altar.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mufi asomdwoe afɔre mu de nʼayamde ne srade a ɛwɔ ho nyinaa bɛbɔ aduan afɔre ma Awurade,
english: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord: the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

twi: a nʼasaabo abien no ne ne sisi ne nea ne mmerɛbo sa so a mubeyi aka asaabo no ho no.
english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

twi: Na ɛsɛ sɛ Aaron mma hyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, wɔ ɔhyew afɔre a ɛda dua a ɛrehyew no so; ɛyɛ aduan afɔre, ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is lying on the burning wood; it is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ abirekyi anaa oguan na mode bɛbɔ asomdwoe afɔre ama Awurade a, ɛnsɛ sɛ dɛm biara ba ne ho na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onini anaa ɔbere.
english: “‘If you offer an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the Lord, you are to offer a male or female without defect.

twi: Sɛ mode oguan ba sɛ mo akyɛde a,
english: If you offer a lamb, you are to present it before the Lord,

twi: momfa mo nsa ngu nʼapampam na munkum no wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano. Afei, Aaron mmabarima no bɛpete mogya no agu afɔremuka no ho nyinaa.
english: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

twi: Saa asomdwoe afɔrebɔde yi fa bi na wɔmfa mma Awurade sɛ ɔhyew afɔrebɔde a ne dua ne mu nneɛma ne ɛho srade, srade a ɛwɔ nʼayamde ho no nyinaa,
english: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord: its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

twi: ne asaabo abien ne ɛho srade a ɛbɛn ne sisia ne ne merɛbo a wobeyi a nʼasaabo ka ho no.
english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so sɛ aduan a ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre ama Awurade.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ wode abirekyi brɛ Awurade sɛ wʼafɔrebɔde a,
english: “‘If your offering is a goat, you are to present it before the Lord,

twi: fa wo nsa gu aboa no apampam na kum no wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano. Aaron mmabarima de aboa no mogya bɛpete afɔremuka no ho nyinaa.
english: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhyew saa afɔrebɔde yi fa bi ma Awurade. Saa afɔrebɔde fa no yɛ aboa no yam srade,
english: From what you offer you are to present this food offering to the Lord: the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

twi: nʼasaabo abien ne ɛho srade a ɛbɛn nʼasen mu ne ne mmerɛbo a wobeyi aka ne asaabo no ho no.
english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so sɛ ɔhyew afɔre. Awurade ani bɛsɔ saa ɔhyew afɔre no. Kae sɛ srade no nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the Lord’s.

twi: “ ‘Eyi ne mmara a munni so daa nyinaa wɔ asase yi so baabiara. Munnni srade anaa mogya.’ ”
english: “‘This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.’”

twi: Bɔne Ho AfɔrebɔAfei Awurade hyɛɛ mmara foforo maa Mose sɛ:
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo se saa mmara yi na ɛwɔ hɔ ma obiara a wanhyɛ da na obebu me mmara no bi so.
english: “Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands—

twi: “ ‘Sɛ ɔsɔfo bi anhyɛ da na ɔfom mmara bi na ɛnam so de afɔbu ba nnipa no so a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde nantwinini ba a onnii dɛm bɔ bɔne ho afɔre de ma Awurade.
english: “‘If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the Lord a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde aboa no ba Ahyiae Ntamadan no pon ano na ɔde ne nsa gu nʼapampam na okum no wɔ hɔ wɔ Awurade anim.
english: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the tent of meeting before the Lord. He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it there before the Lord.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no de aboa no mogya bɛkɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu.
english: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and carry it into the tent of meeting.

twi: Ɔde ne nsateaa baako bɛbɔ mogya no mu apete mpɛn ason wɔ Awurade anim wɔ ntama a ɛsɛn kronkron mu kronkron no anim.
english: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

twi: Afei, ɔsɔfo no de mogya no bi begu aduhuam no tumpan a esi afɔremuka no so no wɔ Awurade anim wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu; mogya no a ɛbɛka no, wobehwie agu afɔremuka no ase de abɔ ɔhyew afɔre wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano.
english: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

twi: Afei ɔbɛtetew srade a ɛwɔ ne nsono no ho nyinaa,
english: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—all the fat that is connected to the internal organs,

twi: ne asaabo abien no ne sisia srade ne ne bɔnwoma kotoku,
english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—

twi: na wahyew no wɔ ɔhyew afɔremuka no so te sɛ nantwinini anaa nantwibere a wɔde no bɔ asomdwoe afɔre no pɛ.
english: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

twi: Nanso nantwi ba no ho nneɛma a ɛbɛka a ɛyɛ ne nwoma, ne nam, ne ti, ne nan, nʼayamde, ne ne nsono no de,
english: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the internal organs and the intestines—

twi: wɔmfa nkɔ afahyɛbea bi a ɛhɔ tew wɔ akyiri baabi a wɔde nsõ fi afɔremuka no so kɔ hɔ kɔhyew no nnyansin so no.
english: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it there in a wood fire on the ash heap.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ Israelfo nyinaa yɛ bɔne a etia Awurade, na sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔboayɛ a, nnipa no nyinaa bedi ho fɔ.
english: “‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, when they realize their guilt

twi: Na sɛ wohu wɔn bɔne a, wɔde nantwi ba bɛba abɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu.
english: and the sin they committed becomes known, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the tent of meeting.

twi: Sɛ wɔrebɔ saa afɔre no a, ɔman no mu mpanyimfo de wɔn nsa begu aboa no apampam na wɔakum no wɔ Awurade anim.
english: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the Lord, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no de ne mogya aba Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu,
english: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull’s blood into the tent of meeting.

twi: na ɔde ne nsateaa baako abɔ mogya no mu apete mpɛn ason wɔ Awurade ne ntama a etwa ɔdan no mu no anim.
english: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times in front of the curtain.

twi: Ɔde mogya begu mmɛn a etuatua afɔremuka no ho no so wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu wɔ Awurade anim. Afei obehwie mogya a aka wɔ ɔhyew afɔre no afɔremuka no ase no agu wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano.
english: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ woyi na wɔhyew srade a ɛwɔ aboa no mu no nyinaa wɔ afɔremuka no so.
english: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,

twi: Ɔbɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so bɔ bɔne ho afɔre no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Eyi bɛma ɔsɔfo no abɛyɛ mpata ama ɔman no, na wɔde obiara bɔne bɛkyɛ no.
english: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the community, and they will be forgiven.

twi: Afei asɔfo no bɛtwe nantwinini ba no de no akɔ beae foforo bi akɔhyew no wɔ hɔ te sɛnea ɔrebɔ ɔbaakofo bɔne ho afɔre no. Nanso eyi de, ɛyɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa afɔrebɔde.
english: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ mpanyimfo no bi yɛ bɔne a onnim sɛ wafom Onyankopɔn mmara no baako
english: “‘When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the Lord his God, when he realizes his guilt

twi: na wɔma no te ne ho ase a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde ɔpapo a ne ho nni dɛm ba sɛ nʼafɔrebɔde.
english: and the sin he has committed becomes known, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.

twi: Ɔde ne nsa begu aboa no apampam na wakum no wɔ beae a wokum ɔhyew afɔre mmoa no de ama Awurade no. Eyi yɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔde.
english: He is to lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord. It is a sin offering.

twi: Afei, ɔsɔfo no de ne nsateaa baako bɛbɔ afɔrebɔde mogya no mu na ɔde asra afɔremuka a wɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre wɔ so no mmɛn no ho; na afei wɔahwie mogya no nkae agu afɔremuka no ase.
english: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

twi: Wɔbɛhyew srade no nyinaa wɔ afɔremuka no so te sɛ nea wɔhyew asomdwoe afɔre srade no ara pɛ; ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama ɔpanyin ko no wɔ ne bɔne no ho; na wɔde ne bɔne no bɛkyɛ no.
english: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he will be forgiven.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ apapahwekwa bi yɛ bɔne a onnim sɛ wafom a, odi ho fɔ.
english: “‘If any member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands, when they realize their guilt

twi: Nanso onya te ne ho ase ara pɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde abirekyibere a ne ho nni dɛm ba ma wɔde pata ne bɔne no.
english: and the sin they have committed becomes known, they must bring as their offering for the sin they committed a female goat without defect.

twi: Ɔde no bɛba beae a wɔde mmoa a wɔde wɔn ba ma wokum wɔn de wɔn bɔ ɔhyew afɔre hɔ no, na ɔde ne nsa ato bɔne ho afɔrebɔde no apampam na wɔakum no.
english: They are to lay their hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no de mogya no bi asra ne nsateaa baako ho na ɔde asra ɔhyew afɔremuka mmɛn no ho. Afei, ɔsɔfo no behwie mogya no nkae no agu afɔremuka no ase.
english: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

twi: Wobeyi srade no nyinaa afi mu te sɛ nea wɔfa bɔ asomdwoe afɔre no ara. Na ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so. Na Awurade ani bɛsɔ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama saa onipa no na wɔde ne bɔne bɛkyɛ no.
english: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord. In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

twi: “ ‘Na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde oguamma bɛbɔ ne bɔne ho afɔre nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbere a dɛm biara nni ne ho.
english: “‘If someone brings a lamb as their sin offering, they are to bring a female without defect.

twi: Ɔde no bɛba beae a wɔde mmoa a wɔde wɔn ba ma wokum wɔn de wɔn bɔ ɔhyew afɔre hɔ no, na ɔde ne nsa ato bɔne ho afɔrebɔde no apampam na wakum no sɛ bɔne ho afɔrebɔde.
english: They are to lay their hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no de mogya no bi asra ne nsateaa baako ho na ɔde asra ɔhyew afɔremuka mmɛn no ho. Na wahwie mogya no nkae no agu afɔremuka no ase.
english: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

twi: Wɔbɛyɛ srade no sɛnea wɔyɛ asomdwoe oguamma srade no. Ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew srade no wɔ afɔremuka no so te sɛ afɔre ahorow a wɔde ogya bɔ ma Awurade no ara pɛ. Ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama onipa ko no, na wɔde ne bɔne bɛkyɛ no.
english: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

twi: Bɔne Ahorow A Ɛsɛ Sɛ Wɔbɔ Ho Afɔre“ ‘Obiara a ɔnka bɔne bi a onim ho biribi ho hwee no di ho fɔ.
english: “‘If anyone sins because they do not speak up when they hear a public charge to testify regarding something they have seen or learned about, they will be held responsible.

twi: “ ‘Obiara a ɔde ne nsa ka ade bi a amanne kwan so no ɛho ntew, te sɛ aboa bi a ne ho ntew funu, sɛ ɔyɛ wuram aboa, sɛ ɔyɛ afieboa anaa aboa a ɔwea wɔ fam no, mpo sɛ onnim sɛ ne ho agu fi na akyiri no ogye nʼafɔdi to mu,
english: “‘If anyone becomes aware that they are guilty—if they unwittingly touch anything ceremonially unclean (whether the carcass of an unclean animal, wild or domestic, or of any unclean creature that moves along the ground) and they are unaware that they have become unclean, but then they come to realize their guilt;

twi: anaa sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔde ne nsa ka biribi a efi onipa mu a ɛho ntew na ɔte ne ho ase sɛ odi ho fɔ,
english: or if they touch human uncleanness (anything that would make them unclean) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt;

twi: anaa sɛ obi annwene ho na ɔka ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ biribi a eye anaa ennye na akyiri no ohu nʼafɔdi;
english: or if anyone thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil (in any matter one might carelessly swear about) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt—

twi: sɛ obi ani ba ne ho so wɔ eyinom biara mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔpae mu ka ne bɔne a wayɛ.
english: when anyone becomes aware that they are guilty in any of these matters, they must confess in what way they have sinned.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde oguammere anaa abirekyibere bɔ afɔre ma Awurade wɔ ne bɔne ho asotwe ho. Ɔsɔfo na ɔbɛbɔ onipa ko no bɔne no ho afɔre ama no. Ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama no.
english: As a penalty for the sin they have committed, they must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for them for their sin.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ ɔyɛ ohiani a ɔrennya oguamma mfa mma Awurade a, ɔmfa nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnomamma abien mmra sɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔde. Nnomaa no mu baako bɛyɛ ne bɔne no afɔrebɔde na ɔbaako ayɛ ne hyew afɔrebɔde.
english: “‘Anyone who cannot afford a lamb is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for their sin—one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

twi: Ɔde bɛma ɔsɔfo no na ɔde anomaa a odi kan no abɔ bɔne afɔre no. Obekyim aboa no kɔn nanso ɔrentew ne ti mfi so,
english: They are to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not dividing it completely,

twi: na wapete ne mogya no bi agu afɔremuka no ho. Mogya no nkae no, obehwie agu afɔremuka no ase. Eyi ne afɔrebɔ kwan a ɛpepa bɔne.
english: and is to splash some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no de anomaa a ɔto so abien no bɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre sɛnea ɔbɔɔ afɔre a edi kan no ara pɛ. Ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama nea wayɛ bɔne no, na ɛnam so ama wɔde ne bɔne akyɛ no.
english: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ ɔyɛ ohiani buruburoo a ɔrentumi mfa nturukuku anaa mmorɔnomamma mmɛbɔ ne bɔne ho afɔre a, ɔde asikresiam muhumuhu lita abien ne fa bɛba sɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔde. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde ɔsra ngo fra. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde aduhuam nso gu so, efisɛ ɛyɛ bɔne afɔre.
english: “‘If, however, they cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, they are to bring as an offering for their sin a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour for a sin offering. They must not put olive oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

twi: Ɔde bɛma ɔsɔfo no. Na ɔsɔfo no asaw ne nsa ma de asi ne nyinaa anan na wahyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so ama Awurade sɛ afɔrebɔde biara. Eyi bɛyɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔ.
english: They are to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord. It is a sin offering.

twi: Sɛ ɛba saa a, ɔsɔfo no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama onipa no na wɔde ne bɔne no bɛkyɛ no. Asikresiam a aka no, wɔde bɛma ɔsɔfo no te sɛ nnɔbae afɔrebɔde no ara pɛ.’ ”
english: In this way the priest will make atonement for them for any of these sins they have committed, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.’”

twi: Awurade hyɛɛ mmara maa Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses:

twi: “Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ogu ade kronkron ho fi a, ɔde odwennini a ne ho nni dɛm a ɔfata sɛ mpata wɔ nʼafɔdi no ho bɛba abɛbɔ Awurade afɔre.
english: “When anyone is unfaithful to the Lord by sinning unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord’s holy things, they are to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

twi: Ade kronkron a nipa no guu ho fi no nso, ɔde foforo besi anan na watua dekode no bo ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonu aka ho sɛ asotwe. Ɔde ne nyinaa bɛma ɔsɔfo na ɔde Odwennini no abɔ bɔne afɔre no na wɔde ne bɔne akyɛ no.
english: They must make restitution for what they have failed to do in regard to the holy things, pay an additional penalty of a fifth of its value and give it all to the priest. The priest will make atonement for them with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven.

twi: “Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na obu Awurade mmara no bi so a, odi fɔ nti ɛsɛ sɛ otua afɔbude a Mose bɛhyɛ no.
english: “If anyone sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord’s commands, even though they do not know it, they are guilty and will be held responsible.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde odwennini anaa ɔpapo a onni dɛm brɛ ɔsɔfo sɛ ne bɔne no ho afɔrebɔde. Na ɔsɔfo no de ayɛ mpata ama no wɔ bɔne biara a ɔyɛe a wanhyɛ da no ho, na wɔde ne bɔne bɛkyɛ no.
english: They are to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the wrong they have committed unintentionally, and they will be forgiven.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ saa afɔre no sɛ afɔdi afɔre, efisɛ odi fɔ pefee wɔ Awurade anim.”
english: It is a guilt offering; they have been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord.”

twi: Bɔne A Ɛsɛ Sɛ Wɔbɔ Ho Afɔdi AfɔreNa Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses:

twi: “Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne tia me, sɛ ebia, ɔbɛdaadaa ne yɔnko wɔ biribi a wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa anaa ade a wɔawia na wɔde abegyaw no no ho, anaasɛ osisi ne yɔnko,
english: “If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving a neighbor about something entrusted to them or left in their care or about something stolen, or if they cheat their neighbor,

twi: anaa otu ahu na ɔka ntam san wɔ ho se dekode no nni ne nkyɛn a,
english: or if they find lost property and lie about it, or if they swear falsely about any such sin that people may commit—

twi: sɛ obi yɛ bɔne na odi ho fɔ a, ɔbɛsan de ne akorɔnne no anaa ne tintimgye ade anaa nea wɔde maa no siei anaa agyapade a wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa, anaa ade a ayera no aba,
english: when they sin in any of these ways and realize their guilt, they must return what they have stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to them, or the lost property they found,

twi: biribiara a waka ho ntamhunu no nso, ɔbɛsan de ne nyinaa aba na ɔde ho mfɛntom ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonu aka ho abrɛ onipa ko a ɛyɛ ne de no wɔ da a ɔrebɔ afɔdi ho afɔre no.
english: or whatever it was they swore falsely about. They must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day they present their guilt offering.

twi: Nʼafɔdi ho afɔrebɔde no sɛ ɔde odwennini a onni dɛm na ɔsom bo kɔma ɔsɔfo.
english: And as a penalty they must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord, their guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

twi: Na ɔsɔfo no de no bɛyɛ mpata ama no wɔ Awurade anim na wɔde ne bɔne akyɛ no.”
english: In this way the priest will make atonement for them before the Lord, and they will be forgiven for any of the things they did that made them guilty.”

twi: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses:

twi: “Fa saa mmara a ɛfa ɔhyew afɔre ho yi ma Aaron ne ne mmabarima. ‘Wobegyaw ɔhyew afɔrebɔde no wɔ ogya no so anadwo mu no nyinaa, na ɛsɛ sɛ afɔremuka gya no kɔ so dɛw.
english: “Give Aaron and his sons this command: ‘These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

twi: Ade kye a, ɔsɔfo no bɛhyɛ nʼasɔfotade hyerɛnhyerɛn wɔ ase na wahyɛ atadetam koro no ara bi nguguso na wakɔpra ɔhyew afɔre nsõ no de agu afɔremuka no nkyɛn.
english: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

twi: Afei, ɔbɛsesa ne ntade no na wasoa nsõ no afi beae hɔ de akogu beae foforo a wɔatew hɔ no.
english: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

twi: Saa bere yi nyinaa ɛsɛ sɛ ogya a ɛwɔ afɔremuka no so no dɛw. Ɛnsɛ sɛ edum. Anɔpa biara ɔsɔfo no de ogya foforo bɛhyɛ mu na ɔde da biara ɔhyew afɔre agu so, na wahyew srade a wɔde bɔ da biara asomdwoe afɔre no.
english: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ bere biara ogya no kɔ so dɛw wɔ afɔremuka no so; ɛnsɛ sɛ edum.
english: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

twi: “ ‘Atoko afɔre ho mmara nso ni: Aaron mmabarima begyina afɔremuka no anim na wɔde atoko afɔrebɔ no ama Awurade.
english: “‘These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons are to bring it before the Lord, in front of the altar.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no bɛsaw asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu no ne nsa ma na ɔde ngo ne aduhuam afra ahyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: The priest is to take a handful of the finest flour and some olive oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Ɔsaw ne nsa ma wie a, nea ɛbɛka no yɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima de a wobedi. Wobedi wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no adiwo hɔ a wɔremfa mmɔkaw mfra.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in the sanctuary area; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

twi: Si so dua sɛ, sɛ wɔto a, wɔmmfa mmɔkaw mmfra mu. Mede saa ɔhyew afɔre a wɔbɔ maa me no bi ama asɔfo no. Esiane sɛ ne nyinaa yɛ bɔne ne afɔdi ho afɔrebɔ, nti ɛyɛ kronkron.
english: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the food offerings presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

twi: Aaron asefo mmarima ne asɔfo na wonni mfi awo ntoatoaso so nkosi awo ntoatoaso so. Nanso asɔfo no nko ara na wonni afɔrebɔde a wɔabɔ no ogya so ama Awurade no. Biribiara a ɛbɛka wɔn no bɛyɛ kronkron.’ ”
english: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. For all generations to come it is his perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord. Whatever touches them will become holy.’”

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord also said to Moses,

twi: “Da a wɔbɛsra Aaron ne ne mmabarima ngo no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikresiam lita abien ne fa brɛ Awurade. Wɔde fa bɛba anɔpa na wɔde fa aba anwummere.
english: “This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

twi: Wɔde ngo bɛfra ato wɔ dade apampaa so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔto no yiye na wɔde ba sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade nʼani.
english: It must be prepared with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Ɔsɔfo a ofi Aaron mmabarima mu a wɔrehyɛ no sɔfo ma wasi nʼagya anan no de bɛma Awurade sɛnea wɔahyɛ ho mmara afebɔɔ sɛ wɔnhyew ne nyinaa no.
english: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord’s perpetual share and is to be burned completely.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhyew ɔsɔfo biara atoko afɔre a ɔbɛbɔ no nyinaa; ɛnsɛ sɛ wodi.”
english: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten.”

twi: Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima sɛ bɔne afɔrebɔ ho mmara ni: ‘Saa afɔrebɔde yi ho yɛ kronkron yiye enti ɛsɛ sɛ wokum no Awurade anim wɔ beae a wokum ɔhyew afɔrebɔde no.
english: “Say to Aaron and his sons: ‘These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfo a ɔyɛ afɔrebɔ no ho adwuma no we afɔrebɔde no wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no adiwo hɔ.
english: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in the sanctuary area, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

twi: Wɔn a wɔatew wɔn ho a wɔyɛ asɔfo nko ara na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa ka nam no bi; na sɛ ɛba sɛ aboa no mogya bi pete wɔn ntade mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhoro ntade no wɔ beae a wɔatew ho hɔ.
english: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in the sanctuary area.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ kuku a wɔnoaa nam no wɔ mu no; na sɛ ɛyɛ kɔbere nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ wotwiw mu, na wɔde nsu hohoro mu nyinaa yiye.
english: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.

twi: Ɔbarima biara a ɔfra asɔfo no mu no bedi afɔrebɔde no bi—wɔn nko ara—efisɛ ɛyɛ kronkron yiye.
english: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it; it is most holy.

twi: Sɛ wɔde bɔne ho afɔrebɔde no mogya no bi kɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan mu hɔ de kɔyɛ mpata wɔ kronkronbea hɔ a, ɔsɔfo biara renwe bi. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ogya hyew aboa no nyinaa wɔ Awurade anim.
english: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned up.

twi: “ ‘Amanne a ɛfa afɔdi afɔrebɔ a ɛyɛ kronkron ho no ni:
english: “‘These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:

twi: Wobekum aboa a wɔde no rebɔ afɔdi afɔre no wɔ beae a wokum aboa a wɔde no bɔ ɔhyew afɔre no na wɔde ne mogya no apete afɔremuka no ho ahyia.
english: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be splashed against the sides of the altar.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no de aboa no mu srade nyinaa, ne dua,
english: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,

twi: nʼasaabo abien ne ne sisia srade ne ne bɔnwoma kotoku no nyinaa begu nkyɛn de abɔ saa afɔre no.
english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

twi: Ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew no afɔremuka no so sɛ aduan afɔrebɔ a wɔde rema Awurade. Ɛyɛ afɔdi afɔre.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord. It is a guilt offering.

twi: Ɔbarima a ɔfra asɔfo abusua mu no mu tumi we nam no bi. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwe wɔ beae a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, efisɛ ɛyɛ afɔrebɔde a ɛho tew yiye.
english: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it, but it must be eaten in the sanctuary area; it is most holy.

twi: “ ‘Amanne koro no ara na wɔbɛfa so abɔ bɔne afɔre ne afɔdi afɔre no. Ɛyɛ ɔsɔfo a ɔyɛɛ mpata maa wɔn no de.
english: “‘The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

twi: Ɔsɔfo a odii ɔhyew afɔrebɔ no ho dwuma no betumi afa aboa no ho nwoma no.
english: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

twi: Sɛ asɔfo a wɔbɔ atoko ho afɔre ma Awurade no wie saa afɔrebɔ no a, wɔde atoko no nkae bɛma wɔn. Sɛ afɔrebɔde no, wɔto o, wɔkyew o, wɔnoa o, amanne koro no ara ase na ɛhyɛ.
english: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,

twi: Atoko afɔrebɔ biara a aka no, sɛ wɔde ngo fra anaa wɔamfa ngo amfra a, ɛyɛ Aaron mmabarima nyinaa dea.
english: and every grain offering, whether mixed with olive oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

twi: “ ‘Amanne a ɛfa asomdwoe afɔre sononko a wɔbɔ ma Awurade no ho no ni:
english: “‘These are the regulations for the fellowship offering anyone may present to the Lord:

twi: “ ‘Sɛ ɛyɛ asomdwoe afɔre a, wɔmfa brodo a mmɔkaw nni mu a wɔde ngo afra nka ho. Saa ara na wɔmfa brodo ntrantraa bi a wɔde ngo agu so ne asikresiam mfrafrae a wɔde afra ngo nka saa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: “‘If they offer it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering they are to offer thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with oil, and thick loaves of the finest flour well-kneaded and with oil mixed in.

twi: Wɔmfa brodo a emu piw a wɔde mmɔkaw afra nka saa aseda asomdwoe afɔre yi ho.
english: Along with their fellowship offering of thanksgiving they are to present an offering with thick loaves of bread made with yeast.

twi: Wɔde saa afɔrebɔde yi bi begyina afɔremuka no anim na wɔahim wɔ afɔremuka no anim akɔ fa aba fa de akyerɛ sɛ wɔde ama Awurade. Afei, wɔbɛdan afɔrebɔde no ama ɔsɔfo a ɔpete aboa a wɔde no bɛbɔ afɔre no mogya a ɔboa dwumadi no.
english: They are to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord; it belongs to the priest who splashes the blood of the fellowship offering against the altar.

twi: Sɛ wɔde aboa no bɔ Awurade afɔre de ma no sɛ asomdwoe afɔrebɔ de kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ anisɔ ne asedade a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwe ne nam da no ara. Ɛnsɛ sɛ bi ka ma ade kye so.
english: The meat of their fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; they must leave none of it till morning.

twi: “ ‘Na sɛ obi de afɔrebɔde bi ba a ɛnyɛ asomdwoe afɔre na mmom, sɛ ɛyɛ bɔhyɛ anaa efi ne koma mu na ɔde rebrɛ Awurade de a, nea ɛbɛka biara wɔ afɔrebɔ no akyi no, sɛ ade kye so a, wotumi we.
english: “‘If, however, their offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day they offer it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

twi: Afɔrebɔ nam biara a ebedi nnansa no de, wɔnhyew.
english: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

twi: Sɛ obi we nea adi nnansa no bi a, Awurade rennye afɔrebɔde no; na ɛrenni mu sɛ afɔrebɔde, na onipa a ɔde bae sɛ wɔmfa mmɔ saa afɔre no rennya so mfaso biara. Ɔsɔfo a ɔbɛwe no nso bedi ho fɔ, efisɛ ɛyɛ akyiwade ma Awurade; na onipa a ɔbɛwe saa nam no, ɛsɛ sɛ oyi ne ho ano wɔ saa bɔne no ho.
english: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, the one who offered it will not be accepted. It will not be reckoned to their credit, for it has become impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

twi: “ ‘Nam biara a ɛka biribi a wɔntew ho no, wɔnnwe; wɔnhyew. Nam biara a aka de, obiara a ne ho tew wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔwe.
english: “‘Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

twi: Ɔsɔfo biara a ne ho ntew na obedi asomdwoe afɔre no bi no, wobetwa no asu, efisɛ wagu ade kronkron ho fi.
english: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord, they must be cut off from their people.

twi: Obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka biribi a ɛho ntew no, sɛ ɛyɛ onipa anaa aboa na oguu ho fi na obedii asomdwoe afɔrebɔde no bi no, wobetwa no asu, efisɛ wagu ade kronkron ho fi.’ ”
english: Anyone who touches something unclean—whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature that moves along the ground—and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord must be cut off from their people.’”

twi: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se wonnni srade, sɛ efi anantwi, nguan anaa mmirekyi mu.
english: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.

twi: Sɛ ɔyare bi bɔ aboa bi na owu anaasɛ mmoa bɔne bi taataa aboa foforo bi kum no a, wonnni ne srade na mmom, wɔmfa nyɛ ade foforo.
english: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

twi: Obiara a obedi srade a efi afɔrebɔde a wɔbɔ no ogya so de ma Awurade no, ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa no asu.
english: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the Lord must be cut off from their people.

twi: Munnni mogya—sɛ ɛyɛ nnomaa anaa ntɔteboa.
english: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

twi: Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ saa no, ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa no asu.”
english: Anyone who eats blood must be cut off from their people.’”

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo se obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɔ Awurade asomdwoe afɔre no, ɔno ara nkita mmra.
english: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as their sacrifice to the Lord.

twi: Ɔmfa afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ srade ne ne yan a wobehim wɔ afɔremuka no anim de ama Awurade no mmra.
english: With their own hands they are to present the food offering to the Lord; they are to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.

twi: Afei, ɔsɔfo no bɛhyew srade no wɔ afɔremuka no so na ne yan no de, Aaron ne ne mmabarima bɛfa.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode mo asomdwoe afɔrebɔde no srɛ nifa no ma ɔsɔfo no sɛ mo fam de.
english: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

twi: Na Aaron mmabarima no mu nea ɔde mogya ne srade a efi afɔrebɔde no mu no bɛba afɔremuka no so no na ɔbɛfa srɛ nifa no.
english: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.

twi: Mahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa ne yan no ne ne srɛ no mma sɛ akyɛde a efi Israelfo nkyɛn a wɔde rebrɛ Aaron mmabarima. Bere biara, wɔmfa saa afɔrebɔde no kyɛfa yi no mma Aaron ne ne mmabarima.”
english: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their perpetual share from the Israelites.’”

twi: Wɔn akatua ne no: Ɔhyew afɔrebɔ no, wɔde bɛto nkyɛn na wɔde ama wɔn a wɔayi wɔn sɛ Awurade asɔfo a ɛyɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima no.
english: This is the portion of the food offerings presented to the Lord that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.

twi: Efisɛ da a Awurade sraa wɔn ngo no, ɔhyɛɛ sɛ Israelfo mfa saa kyɛfa no mma wɔn; ɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa daa daa wɔ awo ntoatoaso ɛbɛba nyinaa mu.
english: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their perpetual share for the generations to come.

twi: Eyinom ne amanne a ɛfa ɔhyew afɔrebɔ, atoko afɔrebɔ, bɔne afɔrebɔ, afɔdi afɔrebɔ, ahotew afɔrebɔ ne asomdwoe afɔrebɔ ho.
english: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

twi: Awurade de saa mmara yi maa Mose wɔ Sinai Bepɔw so sɛ ɔno nso mfa mma Israelfo no, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobehu ɔkwan a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔfa so bɔ wɔn afɔre ahorow no de ma Onyankopɔn wɔ Sinai sare so hɔ.
english: which the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord.

twi: AsɔfohyɛAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Afei fa Aaron ne ne mmabarima bra Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan no ano. Wɔmfa wɔn ntade, ɔsra ngo, nantwi ba a wɔde no bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre, adwennini abien ne brodo a mmɔkaw nni mu nkɛntɛn abien
english: “Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,

twi: na frɛ Israelfo no nyinaa na wɔmmra hɔ bi.”
english: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting.”
