twi: Wopaee po mu maa wo nkurɔfo, sɛnea wobetumi afa asase wosee so. Na wusum wɔn atamfo guu po bun mu. Wɔmemem sɛ abo wɔ bun a emu dɔ no ase.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.

twi: Wonam omununkum fadum so dii yɛn agyanom anim awia ne ogya fadum so, dii wɔn anim anadwo sɛnea wobehu kwan.
english: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.

twi: “Wusian bepɔw Sinai, kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn fi ɔsoro. Wode mmara a ɛyɛ turodoo ne ahyɛde a ɛyɛ nokware brɛɛ wɔn.
english: “You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.

twi: Wokyerɛɛ wɔn mmara a ɛfa wo homeda kronkron ho. Na wonam wo somfo Mose so hyɛɛ wɔn sɛnea wonsi nni wʼahyɛde ne wo mmara no nyinaa so.
english: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.

twi: Bere a ɔkɔm dee wɔn no, womaa wɔn brodo a efi ɔsoro ne nsu a efi ɔbotan mu, bere a osukɔm dee wɔn no. Wohyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔfa asase a woaka ho ntam sɛ wode bɛma wɔn no.
english: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.

twi: “Nanso yɛn agyanom yɛɛ ahantan ne asoɔden, na wɔanni wʼahyɛde so.
english: “But they, our ancestors, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and they did not obey your commands.

twi: Wɔantie, na wɔankae wʼanwonwade a woyɛ maa wɔn no. Mmom, wɔtew atua yii ntuanoni sɛ ɔnsan mfa wɔn nkɔ wɔn nkoasom mu wɔ Misraim. Nanso woyɛ ɔdebɔnekyɛ, ahummɔbɔ ne ɔdomfo Nyankopɔn a wo bo kyɛ fuw na wʼadɔe dɔɔso. Enti woampo wɔn,
english: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,

twi: bere a wɔyɛɛ nantwi ba na wɔka se, ‘Oyi ne mo nyame a, oyii mo fii Misraim no.’ Wɔyɛɛ bɔne, kekaa abususɛm a ɛyɛ hu.
english: even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your god, who brought you up out of Egypt,’ or when they committed awful blasphemies.

twi: “Nanso wo mmɔborɔhunu mu no, woannyaa wɔn amma wɔanwuwu wɔ sare no so. Omununkum fadum no kɔɔ so dii wɔn anim awia, na ogya fadum no kyerɛɛ wɔn kwan anadwo.
english: “Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud did not fail to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.

twi: Wosomaa wo honhom pa no kyerɛɛ wɔn nea wɔnyɛ, na woannyae sɛ wobɛma wɔn brodo afi ɔsoro anaa nsu bere a osukɔm de wɔn.
english: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.

twi: Wohwɛɛ wɔn so mfe aduanan wɔ sare so. Saa bere no, biribiara anhia wɔn. Wɔn ntade antetew, na wɔn anan ase antaatae.
english: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.

twi: “Woboaa yɛn agyanom ma wodii ahemman akɛse ne aman bebree so, na wode wo nkurɔfo duaa aman no afanan nyinaa so. Wɔfaa ɔhene Sihon a ofi Hesbon ne Basanhene Og asase no nyinaa.
english: “You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.

twi: Womaa wɔn asefo dɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, na wode wɔn baa asase a woahyɛ wɔn agyanom ho bɔ no so.
english: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their parents to enter and possess.

twi: Wɔkɔfaa asase no. Wobrɛɛ aman no nyinaa ase wɔ wɔn anim. Na mpo, ahemfo ne Kanaanfo a wɔtenaa asase no so no tumi sae. Wo nkurɔfo ne wɔn dii no sɛnea wɔpɛ.
english: Their children went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you gave the Canaanites into their hands, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.

twi: Yɛn agyanom faa nkurow a wɔabɔ ho ban ne nsasebere no. Wɔfaa afi a nnepa wɔ mu ne asuten a wɔatutu dedaw no ne bobeturo ne ngofuw ne nnuabafuw no bebree. Enti wodidii ara kosii sɛ wɔdodɔ yɛɛ akɛse, na wɔn ani gyee wɔn ho wɔ wo nhyira mu.
english: They captured fortified cities and fertile land; they took possession of houses filled with all kinds of good things, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. They ate to the full and were well-nourished; they reveled in your great goodness.

twi: “Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no, wɔyɛɛ asoɔden, tew wʼanim atua. Wɔtow wo mmara no guu nkyɛn. Wokunkum adiyifo a wɔhyɛɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnsan mmra wo nkyɛn no, na wɔkaa abususɛm a ɛyɛ hu.
english: “But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they turned their backs on your law. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.

twi: Enti wode wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn atamfo nsa. Nanso wɔn amanehunu mu no, wosu frɛɛ wo, na wutiee wɔn fi ɔsoro. Na ahummɔbɔ a ɛso mu na wosomaa agyefo a wogyee wɔn fii wɔn atamfo nsam.
english: So you delivered them into the hands of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.

twi: “Nanso na nneɛma nyinaa rekɔ so yiye no, wo manfo san kɔɔ bɔne mu bio, na wosan maa wɔn atamfo dii wɔn so. Nanso bere biara a wo nkurɔfo besu afrɛ wo bio, apɛ mmoa no, wufi ɔsoro tiee wɔn bio. Wʼahummɔbɔ nwonwaso nti, wugyee wɔn ntoatoaso.
english: “But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.

twi: “Wobɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ sɛ wɔnsan mmedi wo mmara no so, nanso wɔyɛɛ ahomaso ne asobrakye a wɔanni wʼahyɛde no so. Wɔanni wo mmara a sɛ nnipa di so a wɔnam so benya nkwa no so. Wɔnam ahomaso so, dan wɔn akyi kyerɛɛ wo a wɔampɛ sɛ wobetie wo.
english: “You warned them in order to turn them back to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, of which you said, ‘The person who obeys them will live by them.’ Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.

twi: Wo dɔ nti, wunyaa wɔn ho ntoboase mfe bebree. Wosomaa wo honhom ma ɔnam adiyifo so bɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ faa wɔn bɔne ho. Nanso wɔantie. Enti womaa abosonsomfo a wɔwɔ asase yi so no ho kwan ma wodii wɔn so bio.
english: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you warned them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.

twi: Nanso wo mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti, woantɔre wɔn ase anaa woannyaa wɔn afebɔɔ. Woyɛ ɔdomfo ne ahummɔbɔ Nyankopɔn.
english: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.

twi: “Afei, yɛn Nyankopɔn, ɔkɛse, otumfo ne ɔnwonwani Nyankopɔn a ne dɔ apam a ɔyɛe no ommu so, mma yɛn amanehunu a yɛkɔɔ mu no nyinaa nnyɛ ɔkwa wɔ wʼanim. Ɔhaw kɛse aba yɛn ne yɛn ahemfo, yɛn ahenemma ne asɔfo ne adiyifo ne yɛn agyanom so fi bere a Asiria ahemfo didii yɛn so nkonim, de besi saa bere yi.
english: “Now therefore, our God, the great God, mighty and awesome, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes—the hardship that has come on us, on our kings and leaders, on our priests and prophets, on our ancestors and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.

twi: Bere biara a wobɛtwe yɛn aso no, na ɛfata. Yɛayɛ bɔne kɛse a wotwe yɛn aso sɛnea ɛsɛ wɔ so.
english: In all that has happened to us, you have remained righteous; you have acted faithfully, while we acted wickedly.

twi: Yɛn ahemfo, ahenemma, asɔfo, ne yɛn agyanom no anni wo mmara so anaa wʼahyɛde ne wo kɔkɔbɔ dennen no so.
english: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our ancestors did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the statutes you warned them to keep.

twi: Mpo, bere a wɔn ankasa nyaa wɔn ahemman no, wɔansom wo wɔ bere a woahwie wʼayamye adom agu wɔn so no. Womaa wɔn nsase pa akɛse, nanso wɔannu wɔn ho amfi wɔn amumɔyɛsɛm ho.
english: Even while they were in their kingdom, enjoying your great goodness to them in the spacious and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you or turn from their evil ways.

twi: “Enti mprempren, yɛyɛ nkoa wɔ asase a nnepa abu so wɔ so a wode maa yɛn agyanom no so. Dodow yi nyinaa mu, yɛyɛ nkoa.
english: “But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.

twi: Nnɔbae a ebu so boro so no nyinaa akodi ahemfo a esiane yɛn bɔne nti, woatu wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ yɛn so no nsam. Wɔwɔ yɛn ne yɛn anantwi so tumi. Yɛsom wɔn sɛnea wɔpɛ, na yɛwɔ ahokyere kɛse mu.
english: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.

twi: Woti Apam No Mu“Eyinom nyinaa nti, yɛnam kurukyerɛw so rehyɛ bɔ a emu yɛ den. Saa nsɔwano krataa yi mu na yɛn ahenemma ne Lewifo ne asɔfo din wɔ.”
english: “In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it.”

twi: Nnipa a wogyee nhoma no too mu na wɔsɔw ano no ni:Hakalia babarima Nehemia a na ɔyɛ amrado.Asɔfo a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ase no ne Sedekia,
english:
Those who sealed it were:
Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hakaliah.
Zedekiah,

twi: Seraia, Asaria, Yeremia,
english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

twi: Pashur, Amaria, Malkia,
english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah,

twi: Hatus, Sebania, Maluk,
english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk,

twi: Harim, Meremot, Obadia,
english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

twi: Daniel, Gineton, Baruk,
english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

twi: Mesulam, Abia, Miyamin,
english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

twi: Maasia, Bilgai ne Semaia.Eyinom ne asɔfo no.
english:
Maaziah, Bilgai and Shemaiah.
These were the priests.

twi: Lewifo a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ase no ne:Asania babarima Yesua, Binui a ofi Henadad abusua mu, Kadmiel,
english:
The Levites:
Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,

twi: ne wɔn mfɛfo Lewifo a, wɔne:Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanan,
english:
and their associates: Shebaniah,
Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

twi: Mika, Rehob, Hasabia,
english: Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah,

twi: Sakur, Serebia, Sebania,
english: Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

twi: Hodia, Bani ne Beninu.
english: Hodiah, Bani and Beninu.

twi: Ntuanofo a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ase no ne:Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Satu, Bani,
english:
The leaders of the people:
Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

twi: Buni, Asgad, Bebai,
english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

twi: Adoniya, Bigwai, Adin,
english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

twi: Ater, Hesekia, Asur,
english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

twi: Hodia, Hasum, Besai,
english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

twi: Harif, Anatot, Nebai,
english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

twi: Magpias, Mesulam, Hesir,
english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

twi: Mesesabel, Sadok, Yadua,
english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

twi: Pelatia, Hanan, Anaia,
english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

twi: Hosea, Hanania, Hasub,
english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

twi: Halohes, Pilha, Sobek,
english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

twi: Rehum, Hasabna, Maaseia,
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

twi: Ahiya, Hanan, Anan,
english: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,

twi: Maluk, Harim, Baana.
english: Malluk, Harim and Baanah.

twi: “Nnipa no nkae a wɔyɛ asɔfo, Lewifo, aponanohwɛfo, nnwontofo, Asɔredan mu asomfo ne wɔn a wɔatwe wɔn ho afi abosonsomfo a wɔwɔ asase no so nyinaa, sɛnea wɔbɛsom Nyankopɔn, na wɔanyinyin a wɔte asɛm ase no,
english: “The rest of the people—priests, Levites, gatekeepers, musicians, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand—

twi: wɔn nyinaa fi koma pa mu kaa ntam de kyekyeree wɔn ho. Wɔkaa ntam dii nsew sɛ, sɛ wobu Onyankopɔn mmara a ɔnam ne somfo Mose so de abrɛ wɔn no so a, nnome biara a Onyankopɔn de bɛba wɔn so no, wɔpene so. Wofi koma mu hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ, wɔbɛtɔ wɔn bo adi Awurade, wɔn Wura, ahyɛde ne ne mmara nyinaa so.
english: all these now join their fellow Israelites the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the Lord our Lord.

twi: Nnipa No Bɔhyɛ“Yɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ, yɛremma yɛn mmabea nware abosonsomfo a wɔwɔ asase no so, na saa ara nso na yɛremma yɛn mmabarima nso nware wɔn mmabea.
english: “We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.

twi: “Yɛsan hyɛ bɔ sɛ, sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ asase no so de aguade anaa atoko ba bɛtɔn no homeda anaa da kronkron bi a, yɛrentɔ bi. Na yɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ, yɛrenyɛ adwuma biara mfe ason a ɛbɛba biara mu, na ka biara a Yudafo afoforo bi de yɛn no, yebetwa mu.
english: “When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.

twi: “Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ, yɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ, yebetua Asɔredan afirihyiatow a wɔahyɛ yɛn sɛ yentua a ɛyɛ dwetɛ gram anan, sɛnea ɛbɛma wɔanya sika bebree de abɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan no ho bra.
english: “We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:

twi: Eyi bɛboa ama yɛanya Daa Daa Brodo, na yɛatumi abɔ atoko ne ɔhyew afɔre bere ano bere ano, abɔ homeda afɔre ahorow, adi ɔsram foforo afahyɛ ahorow ne dapɔnna ahorow no. Saa ara na ɛbɛma yɛatumi abɔ kronkronyɛ afɔre ne bɔne ho afɔre sɛ mpata ama Israel. Afei, ɛbɛboa ama yɛanya nneɛma bi a ɛho behia ama yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan no ho adwumayɛ.
english: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.

twi: “Yɛabɔ ntonto ahorow, ahu afe biara mu mmere a ɛfata sɛ asɔfo, Lewifo ne ɔmanfo no abusuafo de nnyansin ba Onyankopɔn asɔredan ho na wɔhyew wɔ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔremuka so, sɛnea mmara no kyerɛ no.
english: “We—the priests, the Levites and the people—have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law.

twi: “Yɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ, daa yɛde otwakan biara mu kyɛfa bi, sɛ ɛyɛ asaseduan anaa aduaba a efi nnua so no, bɛba Awurade Asɔredan mu.
english: “We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the Lord each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.

twi: “Yɛpene so sɛ, yɛde yɛn mmabarima a wɔyɛ abakan ne yɛn anantwi ne yɛn nguan mmakan bɛma Onyankopɔn, sɛnea mmara no kyerɛ no. Yɛde wɔn bɛma asɔfo a wɔsom wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan mu no.
english: “As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.

twi: “Yɛbɛkora nnɔbae no nyinaa wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan adekoradan mu. Yɛde yɛn asikresiam a eye pa ara ne atoko nkae afɔrebɔde, yɛn nnuaba papa ne yɛn nsa foforo papa ne ngo bɛba. Na yɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ, yɛde yɛn nnɔbae biara a efi yɛn asase so nkyɛmu du mu baako bɛbrɛ Lewifo, efisɛ wɔn na wogyigye ntotoso du du no wɔ yɛn nkuraa.
english: “Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and olive oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.

twi: Ɔsɔfo a ɔyɛ Aaron aseni bɛka Lewifo no ho bere a wɔregyigye ntotoso du du no. Na biribiara a wobegye sɛ ntotoso du du no, Lewifo de mu nkyɛmu du mu baako bɛkɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan no mu, na wɔde akosisi adekoradan no mu.
english: A priest descended from Aaron is to accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of the tithes up to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔmanfo no ne Lewifo no de afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ atoko, nsa foforo ne ngo no begu adekorade kronkron a ɛbɛn asɔfo a wɔresom no, aponanohwɛfo ne nnwontofo no wɔ Asɔredan no mu.“Enti yɛbɔ mu hyɛ bɔ sɛ yɛrentoto yɛn Nyankopɔn Asɔredan no ase.”
english:
The people of Israel, including the Levites, are to bring their contributions of grain, new wine and olive oil to the storerooms, where the articles for the sanctuary and for the ministering priests, the gatekeepers and the musicians are also kept.
“We will not neglect the house of our God.”

twi: Nnipa No Kɔtena YerusalemAfei, ɔmanfo no ntuanofo kɔtenaa Yerusalem, kuropɔn kronkron no mu. Wɔbɔɔ ntonto kronkron wɔ nnipa no a na wɔtete Yuda ne Benyamin nkurow bi no so, yii mu nkyɛmu du mu baako ma wɔn nso kɔtenaa hɔ. Na nkae no de, wɔtenaa nea wɔte hɔ ara.
english: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten of them to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the remaining nine were to stay in their own towns.

twi: Na ɔmanfo no kamfoo obiara a ofi ne pɛ mu san kɔtenaa Yerusalem no.
english: The people commended all who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

twi: Amantam mu mpanyimfo a wɔbaa Yerusalem no din na wɔakyerɛw wɔ ha yi. Ɔmanfo no mu fa kɛse a wɔyɛ asɔfo, Lewifo, Asɔredan mu asomfo ne Salomo asomfo asefo no kɔɔ so tenaa wɔn ankasa afi mu wɔ Yuda nkurow ahorow so,
english: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon’s servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on their own property in the various towns,

twi: nanso nnipa no bi a wofi Yuda ne Benyamin mu no san kɔtenaa Yerusalem.Yuda abusuakuw mu nnipa no ni:Usia babarima Ataia, Sakaria babarima, Amaria babarima, Sefatia babarima, Mahalalel babarima a ofi Peres abusua mu;
Baruk babarima Maaseia, Kol-Hose babarima, Hasaia babarima, Adaia babarima, Yoiarib babarima, Sakaria babarima a ofi Sela abusua mu.
english: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Kol-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.

twi: Afei, na Peres asefo ahannan ne aduosia awotwe () a wodi mu no na na wɔte Yerusalem.
english: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of standing.

twi: Benyamin abusuakuw no mu nnipa ni:Mesulam babarima Salu, Yoed babarima, Pedaia babarima, Kolaia babarima, Maaseia babarima, Itiel babarima ne Yesaia babarima;
english:
From the descendants of Benjamin:
Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,

twi: na nʼakyi no na Gabai ne Salai, ne abusuafo ahankron aduonu awotwe () ba.
english: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.

twi: Wɔn panyin pa ara no ne Sikri babarima Yoel na Hasenua, a ɔyɛ kuropɔn no sohwɛfo abediakyiri babarima Yuda boaa no.
english: Joel son of Zikri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the New Quarter of the city.

twi: Asɔfo no mu nnipa ni:Yoiarib babarima Yedaia; Yakin;
english:
From the priests:
Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;

twi: ne Hilkia babarima Seraia, Mesulam babarima, Sadok babarima, Meraiot babarima ne Ahitub a na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no sohwɛfo babarima,
english: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God,

twi: ne wɔn mfɛfo ahanwɔtwe aduonu abien () a, na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Asɔredan no mu, ne Yeroham babarima Adaia, Pelalia babarima, Amsi babarima, Sakaria babarima, Pashur babarima, Malkia babarima
english: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,

twi: ne ne mfɛfo ahannu aduanan abien () a wɔyɛ wɔn mmusua ntuanofo. Wɔn a na wɔka ho nso ne Asarel babarima Amasai, Ahsai babarima, Mesilemot babarima, Imer babarima
english: and his associates, who were heads of families—242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

twi: ne ne mfɛfo atitiriw ɔha aduonu awotwe (). Wɔn panyin pa ara a otua wɔn ano no ne Hagedolim babarima Sabdiel.
english: and his associates, who were men of standing—128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.

twi: Lewifo no nso ni:Hasub babarima Semaia, Asrikam babarima, Hasabia babarima, Buni babarima;
english:
From the Levites:
Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

twi: ne Sabetai ne Yosabad a na wɔhwɛ Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no mfikyiri dwumadi so;
english: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;

twi: Mika babarima Matania, Sabdi babarima a ɔyɛ Asaf aseni a ɔde mpaebɔ buee aseda afɔre som ano;Bakbukia a na ɔyɛ Matania abediakyiri ne Samua babarima Abda, Galal babarima, Yedutun babarima.
english: Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the director who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

twi: Na Lewifo a wɔwɔ kuropɔn kronkron no mu no nyinaa dodow si ahannu aduɔwɔtwe anan ().
english: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.

twi: Aponanohwɛfo no ni:Akub, Talmon ne wɔn mfɛfo ɔha aduɔson abien a () na wɔwɛn wɔ apon no ano.
english:
The gatekeepers:
Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.

twi: Asɔfo a wɔaka no, Lewifo ne Israelfo nkae no tenatenaa Yudaman mu baabiara a wɔn agyapade wɔ.
english: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on their ancestral property.

twi: Nanso Asɔredan mu asomfo no a na Siha ne Gispa da wɔn ano no de, wɔn nyinaa kɔtenaa Ofel koko so.
english: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.

twi: Na ɔpanyin pa ara a otua Lewifo a wɔwɔ Yerusalem ano no ne Bani babarima Usi, Hasabia babarima, Matania babarima, Mika babarima a ɔyɛ Asaf aseni, na nʼabusuafo som sɛ nnwontofo wɔ Onyankopɔn asɔredan mu no.
english: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mika. Uzzi was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the musicians responsible for the service of the house of God.

twi: Na wɔhyɛ ɔhene mmara a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ da biara no ase.
english: The musicians were under the king’s orders, which regulated their daily activity.

twi: Mesesabel babarima Petahia a ɔyɛ Yuda babarima Serah aseni no yɛ ɔhene ananmusini wɔ ɔman no amammui mu.
english: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in all affairs relating to the people.

twi: Yudafo no bi tenaa Kiriat-Arba ne ne nkuraa, Dibon ne ne nkuraa ne Yekabseel ne ne nkuraa.
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

twi: Wɔtenatenaa Yesua, Molada, Bet-Pelet,
english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet,

twi: Hasar-Sual, Beer-Seba ne ɛho nkuraa,
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its settlements,

twi: Siklag ne Mekona ne ɛho nkuraa.
english: in Ziklag, in Mekonah and its settlements,

twi: Na wɔtete En-Rimon, Sora, Yarmut,
english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

twi: Sanoa ne Adulam ne wɔn nkuraa nso. Na wɔtete Lakis ne ne mfuw a ɛbɛn hɔ no so ne Aseka ne ne nkuraa nso. Enti Yudafo no tenatena nsase a efi Beer-Seba kosi Hinom bon no mu.
english: Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its settlements. So they were living all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

twi: Benyamin nkurɔfo no bi tenaa Geba, Mikmas, Aya ne Bet-El ne ɛho nkuraa.
english: The descendants of the Benjamites from Geba lived in Mikmash, Aija, Bethel and its settlements,

twi: Ebinom nso tenatenaa Anatot, Nob, Anania,
english: in Anathoth, Nob and Ananiah,

twi: Hasor, Rama, Gitaim,
english: in Hazor, Ramah and Gittaim,

twi: Hadid, Seboim, Nebalat,
english: in Hadid, Zeboim and Neballat,

twi: Lod, Ono ne Adwumfo Bon mu nso.
english: in Lod and Ono, and in Ge Harashim.

twi: Wɔmaa Lewifo a na wɔte Yuda no bi kɔkaa Benyamin abusuakuw no ho, ne wɔn tenae.
english: Some of the divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.

twi: Asɔfo Ne Lewifo Ho AbakɔsɛmSaa nnipa yi ne asɔfo ne Lewifo a wɔne Sealtiel babarima Serubabel ne ɔsɔfopanyin Yesua san wɔn akyi no:Seraia, Yeremia, Ɛsra,
english:
These were the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Joshua:
Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

twi: Amaria, Maluk, Hatus,
english: Amariah, Malluk, Hattush,

twi: Sekania, Rehum, Meremot,
english: Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

twi: Ido, Ginetoi, Abia,
english: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,

twi: Miamin, Maadia, Bilga,
english: Mijamin, Moadiah, Bilgah,

twi: Semaia, Yoiarib, Yedaia,
english: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

twi: Salu, Amok, Hilkia ne Yedaia.Yesua bere so no, na eyinom ne asɔfo ntuanofo ne wɔn mfɛfo.
english:
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah and Jedaiah.
These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Joshua.

twi: Lewifo a wɔne wɔn san wɔn akyi no ni: Yesua, Binui Kadmiel, Serebia, Yuda, Matania a na ɔne ne mfɛfo na na wɔhwɛ aseda nnwom so no.
english: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

twi: Na sɛ wɔresom a, wɔn mfɛfo Bakbukia ne Uni sɔre gyina ne wɔn di nhwɛanim.
english: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.

twi: Ɔsɔfopanyin Yesua woo Yoiakim,Yoiakim woo Eliasib,Eliasib woo Yoiada,
english: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim the father of Eliashib, Eliashib the father of Joiada,

twi: na Yoiada woo Yonatan,na Yonatan woo Yadua.
english: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.

twi: Bere a Yoiakim yɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no, na asɔfo mmusua mu ntuanofo no ne:Meraia a otua Seraia abusua ano.Hanania a otua Yeremia abusua ano.
Mesulam a otua Ɛsra abusua ano.Yehohanan a otua Amaria abusua ano.
english:
of Ezra’s, Meshullam;
of Amariah’s, Jehohanan;

twi: Yonatan a otua Maluki abusua ano.Yosef a otua Sebania abusua ano.
english:
of Malluk’s, Jonathan;
of Shekaniah’s, Joseph;

twi: Adna a otua Harim abusua ano.Helkai a otua Meraiot abusua ano.
english:
of Harim’s, Adna;
of Meremoth’s, Helkai;

twi: Sakaria a otua Ido abusua ano.Mesulam a otua Gineton abusua ano.
english:
of Iddo’s, Zechariah;
of Ginnethon’s, Meshullam;

twi: Sikri a otua Abia abusua ano.Miniamin abusua nso na obi tua ano.Piltai tua Moadia abusua ano.
english:
of Abijah’s, Zikri;
of Miniamin’s and of Moadiah’s, Piltai;

twi: Samua a otua Bilga abusua ano.Yehonatan a otua Semaia abusua ano.
english:
of Bilgah’s, Shammua;
of Shemaiah’s, Jehonathan;

twi: Matenai a otua Yoiarib abusua ano.Usi a otua Yedaia abusua ano.
english:
of Joiarib’s, Mattenai;
of Jedaiah’s, Uzzi;

twi: Kalai a otua Salai abusua ano.Eber a otua Amok abusua ano.
english:
of Sallu’s, Kallai;
of Amok’s, Eber;

twi: Hasabia a otua Hilkia abusua ano.Netanel a otua Yedaia abusua ano.
english:
of Hilkiah’s, Hashabiah;
of Jedaiah’s, Nethanel.

twi: Persiahene Dario a ɔto so abien bere so no, wɔkyerɛw Lewifo ne asɔfo mmusua mu ntuanofo no nyinaa din wɔ saa asɔfo mpanyimfo yi bere so: Eliasib, Yoiada, Yohanan, ne Yadua.
english: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.

twi: Wɔkyerɛw Lewifo mmusua ntuanofo no din guu Abakɔsɛm Nhoma mu kosii Eliasib nena Yohanan bere so.
english: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.

twi: Eyinom ne Lewifo mmusua ntuanofo: Hasabia, Serebia, Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel ne wɔn mfɛfo bi a sɛ edu ayeyi ne aseda afahyɛ so a, wogyina hɔ ne wɔn di nhwɛanim, na ɔfa gye ɔfa so wɔ nnwonto mu, sɛnea Dawid, Onyankopɔn nipa, kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no.
english: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.

twi: Na Matania, Bakbukia ne Obadia nso ka ho. Mesulam, Talmon ne Akub na wɔyɛ aponanohwɛfo a wɔhwɛ adekoradan a ɛwɔ apon no ano no so.
english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.

twi: Na eyinom nyinaa som wɔ Yesua babarima Yoiakim a ɔyɛ Yosadak nena ne Nehemia a ɔyɛ amrado ne Ɛsra a na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo ne mmara no kyerɛkyerɛfo bere so.
english: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Joshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law.

twi: Wodwira Yerusalem Fasu NoBere a wɔredwira Yerusalem fasu foforo no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Lewifo a wɔwɔ asase no so nyinaa se, wɔmmra Yerusalem mmɛboa dwumadi no. Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde kyɛnkyɛn, mmɛnta ne asankuten to wɔn aseda nnwom de hyɛ anigye fa no.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.

twi: Wɔde nnwontofo no fi Yerusalem ne ne nkuraa ne Netofafo nkuraa nyinaa bɔɔ mu bae.
english: The musicians also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem—from the villages of the Netophathites,

twi: Ebi nso fi Bet-Gilgal ne Geba pɔw mu hɔ ne Asmawet, efisɛ na nnwontofo no ara akyekyere wɔn ankasa nkuraa afa Yerusalem ho ahyia.
english: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the musicians had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

twi: Asɔfo no ne Lewifo no dwiraa wɔn ho, afei wodwiraa ɔmanfo no, dwiraa apon no ne fasu no nso.
english: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.

twi: Midii Yuda ntuanofo no anim kɔɔ ɔfasu no atifi, na meboaboaa nnwontofo akuw akɛse abien ano ma wɔbɛdaa ase. Nnwontofo kuw no mu baako kɔɔ anafo wɔ ɔfasu no atifi kosii Sumina Pon no.
english: I had the leaders of Judah go up on top of the wall. I also assigned two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed on top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.

twi: Hosaia ne Yuda ntuanofo no mu fa dii wɔn akyi,
english: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,

twi: na Asaria, Ɛsra, Mesulam,
english: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

twi: Yuda, Benyamin, Semaia, Yeremia
english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

twi: ne asɔfo no bi a wɔhyɛn torobɛnto no dii wɔn akyi. Ɛno akyi na Yonatan babarima Sakaria, Semaia babarima, Matania babarima, Mikaia babarima, Sakur babarima a ɔyɛ Asaf aseni no di.
english: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zakkur, the son of Asaph,

twi: Ne korakora no, Sakaria mfɛfo a wɔne Semaia, Asarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel, Yuda ne Hanani dii wɔn so. Wɔfaa nnwontode a Dawid a ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn nipa akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa no. Na Ɛsra a ɔyɛ mmara no kyerɛkyerɛfo no na odii santen no anim.
english: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani—with musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the teacher of the Law led the procession.

twi: Wɔfaa Asu Aniwa Pon no ho, kɔɔ tee kɔforoo kuropɔn no fasu antweri a ɛkyerɛ Dawid kuropɔn no. Wɔfaa Dawid fi ho, kosii Nsu Pon a ɛwɔ apuei fam no ho.
english: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the site of David’s palace to the Water Gate on the east.

twi: Nnwontofo a wɔto so abien no faa atifi kwan kohyiaa wɔn. Me ne ɔmanfo no mu fa dii wɔn akyi. Yɛfaa ɔfasu no so nam Fononoo Abantenten no ho kosii Ɔfasu Tɛtrɛɛ no,
english: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people—past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,

twi: afei yetwaa Efraim Pon no ho, kosii Kuropɔn Dedaw Pon no, yɛfaa Mpataa Pon no ho, kosii Hananel Abantenten ho kɔɔ Ɔha Abantenten no ho. Yɛtoaa so kɔɔ Nguan Pon no ho, na yekogyinaa Ɔwɛn Pon no ano.
english: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.

twi: Nnwontokuw abien a na wɔreda ase no kɔɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu kɔtenatenaa ase. Me nso me ne akuw ntuanofo a na wɔka me ho no yɛɛ saa ara.
english: The two choirs that gave thanks then took their places in the house of God; so did I, together with half the officials,

twi: Yɛne asɔfo a na wɔhyɛn torobɛnto a wɔne Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamin, Mikaia, Elioenai, Sakaria, Hanania
english: as well as the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets—

twi: ne nnwontofo Maaseia, Semaia, Eleasar, Usi, Yehohanan, Malkia, Elam ne Eser na yɛbɔɔ mu kɔe. Wɔtoo nnwom a na dwonkyerɛfo Yisrahia rema wɔn akwankyerɛ.
english: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.

twi: Saa anigye da no, wɔbɔɔ afɔre bebree, efisɛ na Onyankopɔn ayɛ biribi ama wɔn a enti ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn ani gye. Mmea ne mmofra nyinaa de wɔn ho hyɛɛ afahyɛ no mu, na ɔmanfo a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no osebɔ no duu akyirikyiri.
english: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.

twi: Nneɛma A Ehia Ma Asɔredan Mu SomDa no, woyii mmarima sɛ wɔnhwɛ adekoradan a wɔde akyɛde, otwakan ne ntotoso du du gu mu no so. Na ɛyɛ wɔn asɛde sɛ wokogyigye fi mfuw mu, sɛnea asɔfo ne Lewifo mmara kyerɛ no, efisɛ na asɔfo ne Lewifo ne wɔn dwumadi no ho hia Yudafo nyinaa yiye.
english: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn som no ne ahodwira som no pɛpɛɛpɛ, sɛnea Dawid ne ne babarima Salomo mmara kyerɛ no, na saa ara nso na nnwontofo no ne aponanohwɛfo no yɛe.
english: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the musicians and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.

twi: Amanne a wɔma nnwontofo akwankyerɛfo di nnwontofo no anim wɔ nkamfo ne aseda nnwom a wɔto de ma Onyankopɔn no fii ase fi Dawid ne Asaf bere so.
english: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the musicians and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

twi: Enti efi Serubabel ne Nehemia bere so no, na daa ɔmanfo brɛ nnwontofo no ne aponanohwɛfo ne Lewifo no nnuan. Na Lewifo no nso de nea wonya no mu bi ma asɔfo a wɔyɛ Aaron asefo no.
english: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the musicians and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.

twi: Nehemia Nsesɛw Foforo A Etwa ToDa no ara, bere a wogu so rekenkan Mose Nhoma no, ɔmanfo no huu asɛm bi a ɛka se, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔma Amonni anaa Moabni kwan ma ɔkɔ Onyankopɔn aguabɔ ase.
english: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,

twi: Ase ne sɛ, bere a Israelfo fii Misraim no, wɔne wɔn anni no yiye. Mmom, wɔbɔɔ Balaam paa sɛ ɔnnome wɔn, nanso yɛn Nyankopɔn dan nnome no ma ɛyɛɛ nhyira.
english: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)

twi: Wɔkenkan saa mmara no wiee no, wɔpam ananafo no nyinaa fii aguabɔ no ase.
english: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.

twi: Ansa na saa asɛm yi rebesi no, na ɔsɔfo Eliasib a woyii no sɛ ɔnyɛ Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no adekoradan sohwɛfo no a na ɔsan yɛ Tobia busuani no,
english: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,

twi: adan adekoradan kɛse no bi mu de ahyɛ Tobia nsa. Na anka saa dan no mu na wɔkora atoko afɔrebɔde, aduhuam, Asɔredan no nkuku ne nkaka ne atoko ntotoso du du, nsa foforo, ngo ne kyɛfa sononko a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma asɔfo. Na Mose ahyɛ sɛ saa afɔrebɔde no yɛ Lewifo, nnwontofo ne aponanohwɛfo no de.
english: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil prescribed for the Levites, musicians and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.

twi: Saa bere no, na minni Yerusalem. Na masan kɔ Babiloniahene Artasasta nkyɛn wɔ nʼahenni afe a ɛto so aduasa abien so. Akyiri no na ɔmaa me kwan sɛ mensan mmra.
english: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission

twi: Mibeduu Yerusalem, na metee bɔne a Eliasib ayɛ, sɛ ɔde Onyankopɔn Asɔredan adiwo dan bi ama Tobia no,
english: and came back to Jerusalem. Here I learned about the evil thing Eliashib had done in providing Tobiah a room in the courts of the house of God.

twi: ɛtɔɔ me so, na miyii Tobia nneɛma a ɛwɔ dan no mu no nyinaa gui.
english: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.

twi: Afei mehyɛe sɛ, wonnwira adan no nyinaa ho, na mede Awurade Asɔredan no nkuku ne nkaka no, atoko afɔrebɔde ne aduhuam no san beguu mu.
english: I gave orders to purify the rooms, and then I put back into them the equipment of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the incense.

twi: Mesan huu sɛ wɔmfaa nea ɛsɛ sɛ Lewifo no nya no mmaa wɔn ɛ, enti na wɔne nnwontofo no a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ ɔsom no so no asan akɔyɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn mfuw mu.
english: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and musicians responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.

twi: Ɛhɔ ara na mekɔɔ ntuanofo no nkyɛn, kobisaa wɔn se, “Adɛn nti na moayi mo ani afi Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no so?” Na mefrɛɛ Lewifo no nyinaa ma wɔsan bae, de wɔn tuatuaa nnwuma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ano.
english: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, “Why is the house of God neglected?” Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.

twi: Na bio, Yudafo nyinaa fii ase de wɔn atoko ntotoso du du, nsa foforo ne ngo baa Asɔredan no adekoradan no mu.
english: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil into the storerooms.

twi: Na mede adekoradan no hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Selemia, mmara no kyerɛkyerɛfo Sadok ne Lewifo no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Pedaia nsa sɛ wɔnhwɛ so. Na miyii Sakur babarima Hanan a ɔyɛ Matania nena sɛ wɔn boafo. Na saa mmarima yi wɔ din pa, na wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔde nokware bɛkyɛ nneɛma ama wɔn mfɛfo Lewifo no.
english: I put Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and a Levite named Pedaiah in charge of the storerooms and made Hanan son of Zakkur, the son of Mattaniah, their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy. They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites.

twi: Kae saa ade pa yi yɛ, me Nyankopɔn, na mma wo werɛ mfi nea mifi nokwaredi mu ayɛ nyinaa de ama me Nyankopɔn Asɔredan no.
english: Remember me for this, my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.

twi: Da koro Homeda bi, mihuu Yuda mmarima bi sɛ wɔretiatia wɔn nsakyiamoa so. Na wɔrehyehyɛ atoko afiafi wɔ wɔn mfurum so de aba. Na saa da no, na wɔde wɔn nsa, bobe aba, borɔdɔma ne nnɔbae bebree reba Yerusalem abɛtɔn. Na mekaa wɔn anim sɛ, wɔretɔn wɔn nnɔbae homeda.
english: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.

twi: Na mmarima bi nso fi Tiro a wɔde nsumnam ne aguade ahorow bebree aba. Na wɔretɔn no Homeda ama Yudafo wɔ Yerusalem fie ankasa!
english: People from Tyre who lived in Jerusalem were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them in Jerusalem on the Sabbath to the people of Judah.

twi: Ɛno nti, mekɔɔ Yuda ntuanofo no so kobisaa wɔn se, “Adɛn nti na mode saa bɔne yi gu homeda ho fi?
english: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, “What is this wicked thing you are doing—desecrating the Sabbath day?

twi: Munnim sɛ mo agyanom yɛɛ saa bi no nti na yɛn Nyankopɔn de saa ɔhaw a ɛwɔ yɛn so mprempren yi brɛɛ yɛn ne yɛn kurow yi? Gu a moregu Homeda no ho fi ntraso mprempren no bɛma abufuwhyew aba Israelfo so.”
english: Didn’t your ancestors do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity on us and on this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath.”

twi: Na afei, mehyɛɛ sɛ, efi saa bere no rekɔ, Fida biara anwummere, wɔntoto kurow no apon mu a wommmue ara kosi sɛ Homeda no betwa mu. Bio, memaa mʼankasa mʼasomfo kɔwɛn apon no, sɛnea wɔrentumi mfa aguade mma homeda no.
english: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.

twi: Aguadifo ne nsaanodwumayɛfo a wɔde aguade ahorow ba no soɛɛ wɔ Yerusalem mfikyiri pɛnkoro anaa mprenu.
english: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.

twi: Nanso mekasa kyerɛɛ wɔn anibere so se, “Dɛn na motete ɔfasu yi akyi reyɛ? Sɛ moyɛ saa bio a, mɛkyere mo!” Efi hɔ no, wɔamma Yerusalem wɔ Homeda bio.
english: But I warned them and said, “Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you.” From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.

twi: Na mehyɛɛ Lewifo no sɛ, wonnwira wɔn ho, na wɔnnwɛn apon no sɛnea Homeda no kronkronyɛ no bɛka hɔ.Kae saa ade pa yi yɛ nso, me Nyankopɔn, na wʼadɔe kɛse a ɛnsa da no nti, hu me mmɔbɔ.
english:
Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy.
Remember me for this also, my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.

twi: Saa bere koro no ara mu, mihuu sɛ Yuda mmarima no bi awareware mmaa a wofi Asdod, Amon ne Moab.
english: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.

twi: Na nea na enye koraa ne sɛ, na wɔn mma no mu fa ka Asdod ne nnipa foforo bi kasa a na wontumi nka Yudafo kasa no koraa.
english: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.

twi: Enti mekɔɔ wɔn so kɔdomee wɔn. Mehwee wɔn mu bi, tutuu wɔn tinwi. Mema wɔkaa ntam wɔ Awurade anim sɛ, wɔremma wɔn mma ne abosonsomfo a wɔwɔ asase no so nni aware.
english: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God’s name and said: “You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.

twi: Mibisae se, “Ɛnyɛ eyi bi pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛde Israelhene Salomo kɔɔ bɔne mu no?” Na wode ɔman biara so hene toto ne ho a, ɛnyɛ yiye. Onyankopɔn dɔɔ no, na osii no hene wɔ Israel nyinaa so. Nanso ɔno mpo ananafo aware de no kɔɔ bɔne mu.
english: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.

twi: Dɛn na ɛhaw mo ma modwene sɛ mobɛware ananafo mmea, na monam so ayɛ bɔne a ɛte saa, na munni Onyankopɔn nokware?
english: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?”

twi: Esiane sɛ ɔsɔfopanyin Eliasib babarima Yoiada aware Horonni Sanbalat babea nti, mepam no fii mʼanim.
english: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.

twi: Kae wɔn, me Nyankopɔn, efisɛ wɔagu asɔfodwuma, asɔfo ne Lewifo bɔhyɛ ne ntam no ho fi.
english: Remember them, my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

twi: Enti miguu biribiara a ɛyɛ ananasɛm, na mede nnwuma hyehyɛɛ asɔfo ne Lewifo nsa, hwɛɛ sɛ obiara nim nʼadwuma.
english: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.

twi: Mehwɛɛ nso sɛ, nnyina a ɛba afɔremuka so no nso bɛba mmere a ɛsɛ mu, na afei wobegye otwa a edi kan no mu nnɔbae de abrɛ asɔfo no.Kae eyi na dom me, me Nyankopɔn.
english:
I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits.
Remember me with favor, my God.

twi: NnipakanAwurade kasa kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan a ɛwɔ Sinai nweatam so. Eyi sii wɔ mfe abien a Israelfo fii Misraim no akyi, ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a edi kan. Ɔkae se:
english: The Lord spoke to Moses in the tent of meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:

twi: “Gyina Israelfo no mmusuakuw ne wɔn mmusua so kan wɔn nyinaa. Kyerɛw ɔbarima biara din.
english: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

twi: Wo ne Aaron na mobɛkan mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu no ne nea ɛboro saa a wotumi kɔ ɔsa.
english: You and Aaron are to count according to their divisions all the men in Israel who are twenty years old or more and able to serve in the army.

twi: Ɔbarima a ofi abusuakuw biara mu a ɔyɛ ntuanoni na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa mo.
english: One man from each tribe, each of them the head of his family, is to help you.

twi: “Mmarima a wɔbɛboa mo no din ni:“Ruben abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Sedeur babarima Elisur;
english:
These are the names of the men who are to assist you:
from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

twi: Simeon abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Surisadai babarima Selumiel;
english: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

twi: Yuda abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Aminadab babarima Nahson;
english: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

twi: Isakar abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Suar babarima Netanel;
english: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

twi: Sebulon abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Helon babarima Eliab;
english: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

twi: Yosef mmabarima no:Efraim abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Amihud babarima Elisama;Manase abusuakuw no ntuanoni ne Pedahsur babarima Gamaliel;
Benyamin abusuakuw ntuanoni ne Gideoni babarima Abidan;
english: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

twi: Dan abusuakuw ntuanoni ne Amisadai babarima Ahieser;
english: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

twi: Aser abusuakuw ntuanoni ne Okran babarima Pagiel;
english: from Asher, Pagiel son of Okran;

twi: Gad abusuakuw ntuanoni ne Deguel babarima Eliasaf;
english: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

twi: Naftali abusuakuw ntuanoni ne Enan babarima Ahira.”
english: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”

twi: Eyinom ne mmarima a woyii wɔn fii nnipa no mu, a wɔyɛ wɔn agyanom mmusua no ntuanofo.
english: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.

twi: Mose ne Aaron faa saa nnipa a wɔabobɔ wɔn din yi,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men whose names had been specified,

twi: na da a edi kan wɔ ɔsram a ɛto so abien no mu no, wɔfrɛɛ ɔmanfo no nyinaa. Nnipa no nam wɔn mmusuakuw ne wɔn mmusua so kyerɛɛ wɔn anato na wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa no din mmaako mmaako,
english: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people registered their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,

twi: sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no. Enti ɔkan wɔn wɔ Sinai sare so.
english: as the Lord commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:

twi: Ruben a ɔyɛ Israel abakan asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wotumi kɔ ɔsa no, wɔkyerɛw wɔn din mmaako mmaako sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Ruben abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduanan asia ne ahannum (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Reuben was 46,500.

twi: Simeon asefo:Mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no, wɔkyerɛw wɔn din mmaako mmaako sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Simeon:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were counted and listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Simeon abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduonum akron ne ahaasa (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Simeon was 59,300.

twi: Gad asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Gad:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Gad abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduanan anum ahansia ne aduonum (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Gad was 45,650.

twi: Yuda asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Judah:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Yuda abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduɔson anan ne ahansia (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Judah was 74,600.

twi: Isakar asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Issachar:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Isakar abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduonum anan ne ahannan (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Issachar was 54,400.

twi: Sebulon asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Zebulun:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Sebulon abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduonum ason ne ahannan (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Zebulun was 57,400.

twi: Yosef mmabarima no:Efraim asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the sons of Joseph:
From the descendants of Ephraim:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Efraim abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduanan ne ahannum (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Ephraim was 40,500.

twi: Manase asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Manasseh:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Manase abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduasa abien ne ahannu (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Manasseh was 32,200.

twi: Benyamin asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Benjamin:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Benyamin abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduasa anum ne ahannan (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.

twi: Dan asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Dan:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Dan abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduosia abien ne ahanson (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.

twi: Aser asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Asher:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Aser abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduanan baako ne ahannum (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Asher was 41,500.

twi: Naftali asefo:Wɔkyerɛw mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa no din sɛnea wɔn mmusua te.
english:
From the descendants of Naphtali:
All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

twi: Nnipa dodow a wofi Naftali abusuakuw no mu no yɛ mpem aduonum abiɛsa ne ahannan (,).
english: The number from the tribe of Naphtali was 53,400.

twi: Eyinom ne mmarima a Mose ne Aaron ne Israel mmusuakuw dumien no ntuanofo kan wɔn.
english: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.

twi: Israelfo a na wɔadi mfe aduonu anaa nea ɛboro saa no a wobetumi adɔm Israel asraafodɔm no nso, wogyinaa wɔn mmusua so kan wɔn.
english: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.

twi: Na wɔn nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem ahansia ne abiɛsa ne ahannum aduonum (,).
english: The total number was 603,550.

twi: Mmusua a wɔwɔ Lewi abusuakuw no de, wɔankan wɔn anka wɔn a aka no ho.
english: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.

twi: Na Awurade aka akyerɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord had said to Moses:

twi: “Nkan Lewifo abusuakuw no, na mfa wɔn nka Israelfo a wɔaka no ho.
english: “You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

twi: Fa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho dwumadi hyɛ Lewifo no nsa. Wɔnhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde asiesie mu ne nea ɛkeka ho nyinaa so. Wɔn na wɔbɛsoa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ne mu nneɛma, wɔbɛhwɛ so na wɔatenatena ho.
english: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

twi: Bere biara a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu Ahyiae Ntamadan no, Lewifo no na ɛsɛ sɛ wotutu, na baabiara a wɔde besi no, wɔn na wɔbɛyɛ. Onipa foforo biara a ɔbɛbɛn ho no, wobekum no.
english: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.

twi: Israel abusuakuw biara benya ne tenabea ne ne frankaa.
english: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.

twi: Lewifo no besisi wɔn ntamadan atwa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho ahyia, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Onyankopɔn abufuwhyew remma Israelfo no so. Lewifo no na wɔbɛhwɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no so.”
english: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law.”

twi: Israelfo no yɛɛ eyinom nyinaa sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.
english: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.

twi: Israel Mmusuakuw Atenae Ho NhyehyɛeAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron se:
english: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

twi: “Abusua biara benya nʼafa wɔ atenae hɔ, na kuw biara bɛtena nʼabusua frankaa ase. Na mmusua no atenae ahorow no mfimfini na wɔde Ahyiae Ntamadan no besi.”
english: “The Israelites are to camp around the tent of meeting some distance from it, each of them under their standard and holding the banners of their family.”

twi: Apuei fam,baabi a owia pue fi hɔ no na ɛsɛ sɛ Yuda nnipa nkyekyɛmu ahorow no nyinaa bɔ wɔn atenae wɔ wɔn frankaa ase. Yudafo ntuanoni ne Aminadab ba Nahson.
english: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

twi: Na ne dɔm no ano si mpem aduɔson anan ne ahansia (,).
english: His division numbers 74,600.

twi: Isakar abusuakuw na wobedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Suar babarima Netanel.
english: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.

twi: Na ne dɔm no ano si mpem aduonum anan ne ahannan (,).
english: His division numbers 54,400.

twi: Sebulon abusuakuw na wobedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Helon babarima Eliab.
english: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.

twi: Na ne dɔm no ano si mpem aduonum ason ne ahannan (,).
english: His division numbers 57,400.

twi: Enti na nnipa dodow a wɔwɔ Yuda atenae no nyinaa sɛnea wɔn nkyekyɛmu te no ano si mpem ɔha aduɔwɔtwe asia ne ahannan (,). Sɛ Israelfo no tu a, saa mmusuakuw abiɛsa yi na edi kan.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.

twi: Anafo fam na Ruben nnipa nkyekyɛmu ahorow no nyinaa bɛbɔ wɔn atenae de wɔn frankaa asi. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Sedeur babarima Elisur.
english: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduanan asia ne ahannum (,).
english: His division numbers 46,500.

twi: Simeon abusuakuw na wobedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Surisadai babarima Selumiel.
english: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduonum akron ne ahaasa (,).
english: His division numbers 59,300.

twi: Gad abusuakuw na wobedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Reuel babarima Eliasaf.
english: The tribe of Gad will be next. The leader of the people of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.

twi: Na ne dɔm ano si mpem aduanan anum ahansia ne aduonum (,).
english: His division numbers 45,650.

twi: Na mmarima a wɔwɔ Ruben atenae ne sɛnea wɔn nkyekyɛmu te no ano si mpem ɔha aduonum baako ahannan ne aduonum (,). Na sɛ Israelfo tu a, wɔn na wɔto so abien.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.

twi: Afei Lewifo no de Ahyiae Ntamadan befi wɔn atenae mfimfini hɔ akɔ. Mmusuakuw no nyinaa bɛkɔ no nnidiso sɛnea wɔn atenae nhyehyɛe te wɔ wɔn mmusuakuw mfrankaa akyi.
english: Then the tent of meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in their own place under their standard.

twi: Efraim abusuakuw bɛfa atenae hɔ atɔe fam adi wɔn abusua frankaa akyi. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Amihud babarima Elisama.
english: On the west will be the divisions of the camp of Ephraim under their standard. The leader of the people of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduanan ne ahannum (,).
english: His division numbers 40,500.

twi: Manase abusuakuw na wobedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Pedahsur babarima Gamaliel.
english: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to them. The leader of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduasa abien ne ahannu (,).
english: His division numbers 32,200.

twi: Benyamin abusuakuw na wodi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Gideoni babarima Abidan.
english: The tribe of Benjamin will be next. The leader of the people of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduasa anum ne ahannan (,).
english: His division numbers 35,400.

twi: Na mmarima a wɔwɔ Efraim atenae ne sɛnea wɔn nkyekyɛmu te no ano si mpem ɔha ne awotwe ne ɔha baako (,). Na sɛ Israelfo tu a, wɔn na wɔto so abiɛsa.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.

twi: Dan abusuakuw bɛfa atifi fam adi wɔn abusua frankaa akyi. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Amisadai babarima Ahieser.
english: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduosia abien ne ahanson (,).
english: His division numbers 62,700.

twi: Aser abusuakuw no bedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Okran babarima Pagiel.
english: The tribe of Asher will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Asher is Pagiel son of Okran.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduanan baako ne ahannum (,).
english: His division numbers 41,500.

twi: Naftali abusuakuw no bedi so. Wɔn ntuanoni ne Enan ba Ahira.
english: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

twi: Ne dɔm ano si mpem aduonum abiɛsa ne ahannan (,).
english: His division numbers 53,400.

twi: Mmarima a wɔwɔ Dan atenae no ano si mpem ɔha aduonum ason ne ahansia (,).
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Dan number 157,600. They will set out last, under their standards.

twi: Sɛɛ na Israelfo a wɔkan wɔn mmusuakuw mmusuakuw no te. Wɔn a wɔwɔ atenae hɔ nyinaa, sɛnea wɔn nkyekyɛmu te no ano si mpem ahansia ne abiɛsa ahannum ne aduonum (,).
english: These are the Israelites, counted according to their families. All the men in the camps, by their divisions, number 603,550.

twi: Sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no, wɔankan Lewifo no anka Israelfo no ho.
english: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.

twi: Enti Israelfo yɛɛ biribiara sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no. Wɔbobɔɔ wɔn atenae, tenatenaa wɔn frankaa ahorow ase, na wɔnantew nnidiso nnidiso sɛnea wɔn mmusua ne wɔn afi te.
english: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.

twi: LewifoEyi ne nea ɛfa Aaron ne Mose mmusua ho bere a Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ Sinai Bepɔw so no.
english: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.

twi: Aaron mmabarima din na edidi so yi: Nadab, nʼabakan, Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.
english: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

twi: Eyinom ne Aaron mma a wɔasra wɔn ngo na wɔayi wɔn asi hɔ sɛ asɔfo.
english: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

twi: Nadab ne Abihu de, wowuwuu wɔ Awurade anim bere a wɔhyew afɔrebɔde wɔ ogya a ɛmfata so wɔ Sinai sare so no. Na wonni mma nti, Eleasar ne Itamar nko ara na wɔsom sɛ asɔfo, bere a wɔn agya Aaron te ase no.
english: Nadab and Abihu, however, died before the Lord when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se:
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Frɛ Lewifo no, na fa wɔn ma ɔsɔfo Aaron sɛ nʼaboafo.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

twi: Wɔbɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu ama ɔsɔfo Aaron ne nnipa no nyinaa.
english: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

twi: Afei, wɔbɛhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde siesie Ahyiae Ntamadan mu no so de asi Israelfo no anan mu ayɛ asodi a wɔyɛ wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu.
english: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

twi: Fa Lewifo no ma Aaron ne ne mmabarima; wɔn ne Israelfo a wɔde wɔn bɛma no korakora.
english: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

twi: Ma Aaron ne ne mmabarima no nsom sɛ asɔfo; onipa foforo biara a ɔbɛbɛn kronkronbea hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ wokum no.”
english: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death.”

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord also said to Moses,

twi: “Mayi Lewifo no afi Israelfo no mu de wɔn asi Israel babea biara abakan a ɔyɛ ɔbarima anan mu. Lewifo no yɛ me de,
english: “I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,

twi: efisɛ abakan biara wɔ me. Bere a mikunkum mmakan wɔ Misraim no, migyaw Israel mmakan, sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa anaa mmoa. Wɔyɛ me dea. Mene Awurade.”
english: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether human or animal. They are to be mine. I am the Lord.”

twi: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ Sinai sare so se,
english: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

twi: “Kan Lewifo no wɔ wɔn mmusua ne afi mu. Kan ɔbarima biara fi nea wadi ɔsram baako so.”
english: “Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more.”

twi: Enti Mose kan wɔn sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no.
english: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord.

twi: Eyinom ne Lewi mmabarima:Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
english:
These were the names of the sons of Levi:
Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

twi: Gerson asefo ni:Libni ne Simei.
english:
These were the names of the Gershonite clans:
Libni and Shimei.

twi: Kohat asefo:Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel.
english:
The Kohathite clans:
Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

twi: Merari asefo:Mahli ne Musi.Eyinom ne Lewifo, sɛnea wɔn mmusua ne wɔn afi te.
english:
The Merarite clans:
Mahli and Mushi.
These were the Levite clans, according to their families.

twi: Gerson asefo no na wɔyɛ mmusua a wofi Libni ne Simei ase.
english: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

twi: Na Gersonfo mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa a wofi Gerson mmusua mu no dodow yɛ mpem ahanson ne ahannum (,).
english: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

twi: Wɔn atenae wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no akyi wɔ atɔe fam.
english: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

twi: Na Gersonfo no ntuanoni ne Lael babarima Eliasaf.
english: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

twi: Saa mmusua abien yi na na wɔhwɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ne ne nkataho no ne ɔkwan nkataano no so.
english: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,

twi: Afei, na wɔhwɛ adiwo nkataano a etwa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho ne afɔremuka ne adiwo nkataano nhoma ne ɛhɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ahorow no nyinaa so.
english: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.

twi: Kohat asefo yɛ mmusua a wofi Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel ase.
english: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.

twi: Na Kehat mmusua no mu mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa no dodow yɛ mpem awotwe ne ahansia (,).Wɔn na na wɔhwɛ kronkronbea no so.
english: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

twi: Wɔmaa wɔn atenae wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no anafo fam.
english: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

twi: Na Kohatfo ntuanoni no ne Usiel babarima Elisafan.
english: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

twi: Saa mmusua anan yi na na wɔhwɛ apam adaka, ɔpon, kaneadua, afɔremuka ahorow, ne nea ɛkeka ho a na wɔde di dwuma wɔ kronkronbea hɔ, mfimfini ntwamtam ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ahorow wɔ hɔ nyinaa no so.
english: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.

twi: Aaron babarima ɔsɔfo Eleasar no na na ɔyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Lewifo no nyinaa so. Ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ asɔfo a wɔhwɛ kronkronbea no so.
english: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

twi: Na Merari asefo no yɛ mmusua a wofi Mahli ne Musi ase.
english: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

twi: Merarifo mmusua no mu na mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa no dodow yɛ mpem asia ne ahannu (,).
english: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.

twi: Merari abusua no ntuanoni ne Abihail babarima Suriel,na wɔtenaa Ahyiae Ntamadan no atifi fam.
english: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

twi: Dwumadi a wɔde hyɛɛ saa mmusuakuw abien yi nsa ne sɛ, wɔbɛhwɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no nnyinaso so. Afei, wɔbɛhwɛ mmeamu nnua, mpuran, nsisiso ne ɛho nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no nyinaa,
english: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,

twi: ne mpuran a ɛwɔ adiwo hɔ nyinaa ne ne nsisiso, nnyinaso, ne ntampehama nyinaa, wɔbɛhwɛ so.
english: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

twi: Ahyiae Ntamadan no apuei fam, nea owia pue fi no, wogyaw maa Mose ne Aaron ne ne mmabarima sɛ wonsisi wɔn ntamadan wɔ hɔ.Saa nnipa yi na na wosi Israelfo no anan mu di Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho dwuma nyinaa.Obi foforo biara a ɔbɛbɛn kronkronbea hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ wokum no.
english: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the tent of meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

twi: Lewifo a Awurade hyɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ wɔnkan wɔn sɛnea wɔn mmusua te a ɔbarima biara a wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa ka ho no dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien (,).
english: The total number of Levites counted at the Lord’s command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Kan Israelfo mmakan a wɔyɛ mmarima na wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa no, na kyerɛw wɔn din.
english: The Lord said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.

twi: Lewifo no bɛyɛ me de. Ma wonsi Israelfo mmakan nyinaa anan mu, na Lewifo nyɛmmoa mmakan nsi Israelfo nyɛmmoa mmakan anan mu. Mene Awurade.”
english: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord.”

twi: Enti Mose kan Israelfo mmakan nyinaa sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no.
english: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.

twi: Mmakan mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne nea ɛboro saa no a ɔkyerɛw wɔn din no ano si mpem aduonu abien ahannu ne aduɔson abiɛsa (,).
english: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

twi: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord also said to Moses,

twi: “Ma Lewifo nsi Israelfo mmakan anan mu. Na Lewifo nyɛmmoa mmakan nso nsi Israelfo nyɛmmoa mmakan anan mu. Lewifo yɛ me dea. Mene Awurade.
english: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the Lord.

twi: Ansa na mubegye Israelfo mmakan ahannu aduɔson abiɛsa no a wɔboro Lewifo no dodow so no,
english: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

twi: momma wontua ti ade, sɛnea hyiadan mu nnwetɛbona te, a emu duru yɛ gram aduonum nson.
english: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

twi: Fa ti ade sika no ma Aaron ne ne mma.”
english: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons.”

twi: Enti Mose gyigyee Israelfo ahannu aduɔson abiɛsa a na wɔboro Lewifo no dodow so no ti ade.
english: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.

twi: Sika a wogyigyee no nyinaa ano sii dwetɛ kilogram dunum ne fa.
english: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

twi: Na Mose de maa Aaron ne ne mmabarima sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no.
english: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord.

twi: Kohar MmabarimaAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron se:
english: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

twi: “Kan Kohatfo no dodow a wɔwɔ Lewifo no abusua mu.
english: “Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.

twi: Saa nnipakan yi bɛyɛ mmarima nko ara a wɔadi fi mfe aduasa kosi aduonum a wobetumi ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan mu.
english: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

twi: “Kohat mma no dwumadi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ akronkronne no so wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu.
english: “This is the work of the Kohathites at the tent of meeting: the care of the most holy things.

twi: Sɛ wɔretu afi atenae hɔ a, Aaron ne ne mma mmarima na wobedi kan akɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu akɔfa nkataanim no de akata adaka no ho.
english: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and put it over the ark of the covenant law.

twi: Afei, wɔde abirekyi nhoma bɛkata nkataanim no ho na wɔde ntama tuntum akata abirekyi nhoma no ho na wɔde nnua a wɔde soa adaka no ahyehyɛ ne nkaa no mu.
english: Then they are to cover the curtain with a durable leather, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.

twi: “Afei, wɔmfa ntama tuntum nsɛw ɔpon a Daa Daa Brodo no da so no so; na wɔmfa mprɛte, nsanka, ne adidi nkankyee ne ɔnom afɔre nkuruwa no; brodo no ngu ntama no so ara.
english: “Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.

twi: Wɔde ntama kɔkɔɔ bɛkata so na wɔasan de abirekyi nhoma akata ntama kɔkɔɔ no so. Na afei, wɔde nnua a wɔde bɛsoa no ahyehyɛ ɔpon no mu.
english: They are to spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ntama tuntum kata kaneadua no, akanea no, adabaw no, nkuku apampaa no ne ngo tumpan no ho.
english: “They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the olive oil used to supply it.

twi: Saa nneɛma yi nyinaa nso wɔde abirekyi nhoma a ɛyɛ den bɛkata ho na wɔde nea wɔakyekyere no nyinaa abegu ɔpon no so.
english: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of the durable leather and put it on a carrying frame.

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ntama tuntum kata sikakɔkɔɔ afɔremuka no so na wɔsan de abirekyi nhoma kata so bio na wɔde nnua a wɔde soa no hyehyɛ afɔremuka no mu.
english: “Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

twi: “Hyiadan no mu som no ho nneɛma a aka no nyinaa, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ntama bibiri kyekyere ho a wɔde abirekyi nhoma asan akyekyere ho na wɔde ato mpata a wɔde soa no so.
english: “They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with the durable leather and put them on a carrying frame.

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ wotu nsõ no nyinaa fi afɔremuka no mu gu, na wɔde ntama kɔkɔɔ kyekyere ho.
english: “They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde afɔremuka no ho ɔsom nneɛma nyinaa gu ntama no so. Saa nneɛma no ne nkankyee a wɔnoa mu, adinam, sofi, ne nkankyee a wɔde nsu a wɔde pete gu mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde abirekyi nhoma kata ne nyinaa so na wɔde nnua a wɔde soa no gu faako a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde gu.
