english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

twi: Ade kyee anɔpa no, Balak faa Balaam de no kɔɔ Bamot-Baal atifi. Ofi hɔ too nʼani huu sɛ Israelfo no sam wɔn atenae hɔ.
english: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp.

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Edi KanBalaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no se, “Si afɔremuka ason wɔ ha, na siesie anantwinini ason ne adwennini ason ma me.”
english: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

twi: Balak yɛɛ sɛnea Balaam kae no, na wɔn baanu no de nantwinini ne odwennini bɔɔ afɔremuka no biara so afɔre.
english: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

twi: Afei Balaam ka kyerɛɛ Balak se, “Tena wʼafɔre no ho na merekɔ nkyɛn. Ebia na Awurade bɛba abehyia me, na nea ɔbɛda no adi akyerɛ me biara no mɛka akyerɛ wo.” Enti, ɔforo kɔɔ sorosoro baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ petee.
english: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the Lord will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you.” Then he went off to a barren height.

twi: Ɛhɔ na Onyankopɔn hyiaa no ma ɔkae se, “Masiesie afɔremuka ason, na mede nantwinini ne odwennini abɔ afɔre wɔ biara so.”
english: God met with him, and Balaam said, “I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”

twi: Awurade de asɛm hyɛɛ Balaam anom se, “San kɔ Balak nkyɛn na kɔka asɛm yi kyerɛ no.”
english: The Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”

twi: Ɔsan bae no ɔbɛtoo no sɛ ɔne Moab mpanyimfo no nyinaa gyinagyina afɔre no ho.
english: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the Moabite officials.

twi: Na Balaam hyɛɛ ne nkɔm:“Balak soma bɛfrɛɛ me fii Aram,Moabhene frɛɛ me fii apuei fam nkoko so.Ɔkae se, ‘Bra bɛdome Yakob ma me;bra bɛka mmususɛm gu Israel so.’
english:
Then Balaam spoke his message:
“Balak brought me from Aram,
    the king of Moab from the eastern mountains.
‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me;
    come, denounce Israel.’

twi: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi adomewɔn a Onyankopɔn nnome ɛ?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi aka mmususɛm aguwɔn a Awurade mmuu wɔn fɔ so?
english:
How can I curse
    those whom God has not cursed?
How can I denounce
    those whom the Lord has not denounced?

twi: Mihu wɔn fi ɔbotan atifi;mehwɛ wɔn fi nkoko so.Mihu nnipa a wɔatew wɔn hoa wommu wɔn ho sɛ wɔyɛ aman no bi mu nnipa.
english:
From the rocky peaks I see them,
    from the heights I view them.
I see a people who live apart
    and do not consider themselves one of the nations.

twi: Hena na obetumi akan Yakob mfutuma,anaa ɔbɛkan Israelfo nkyemu anan mu baako?Ma minwu atreneefo wu,na mʼawiei nyɛ sɛ wɔn de.”
english:
Who can count the dust of Jacob
    or number even a fourth of Israel?
Let me die the death of the righteous,
    and may my final end be like theirs!”

twi: Balak bisaa Balaam se, “Dɛn na woayɛ me yi? Mede wo baa sɛ bɛdome mʼatamfo, nanso woahyira wɔn mmom!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!”

twi: Obuae se, “So ɛnsɛ sɛ meka nea Awurade de ahyɛ mʼano no ana?”
english: He answered, “Must I not speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AbienAfei, Balak ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Bra na yɛnkɔ baabi foforo a yebehu wɔn; worenhu wɔn nyinaa, gye wɔn atenae no nkyɛn nkyɛn. Gyina hɔ na dome wɔn ma me.”
english: Then Balak said to him, “Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will not see them all but only the outskirts of their camp. And from there, curse them for me.”

twi: Enti ɔde no kɔɔ Sofim bepɔw Pisga atifi. Osii afɔremuka ason wɔ hɔ na ɔde nantwinini ne odwennini bɔɔ afɔre afɔre wɔ afɔremuka biara so.
english: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

twi: Balaam ka kyerɛɛ Balak se, “Tena wʼafɔre no ho wɔ ha na me nso merekohyia Awuradewɔ hɔ.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there.”

twi: Awurade hyiaa Balaam na ɔde asɛm hyɛɛ nʼanom se, “San kɔ Balak hɔ na kɔka asɛm yi kyerɛ no.”
english: The Lord met with Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”

twi: Enti ɔsan ba bɛtoo no no sɛ ogyina nʼafɔre no ho a Moab mpanyimfo no ka ne ho. Balak bisae se, “Awurade aka dɛn?”
english: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the Moabite officials. Balak asked him, “What did the Lord say?”

twi: Na ɔhyɛɛ ne nkɔm:“Balak, sɔre na tie;Sipor babarima tie me.
Onyankopɔn nyɛ onipa na wadi atoro;Ɔnyɛ onipa na wasesa nʼadwene.Ɔka asɛm a ɔnyɛ ana?Wahyɛ bɔ bi pɛn a wanni so ana?
english:
God is not human, that he should lie,
    not a human being, that he should change his mind.
Does he speak and then not act?
    Does he promise and not fulfill?

twi: Wɔahyɛ me sɛ minhyira;wahyira, na merentumi nnan ani!
english:
I have received a command to bless;
    he has blessed, and I cannot change it.

twi: “Wonhu ɔyawdi bi wɔ Yakob mu,wonhuu awerɛhowdi biara wɔ Israel mu.Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn ka wɔn ho;Ɔhene ka wɔn ho!
english:
“No misfortune is seen in Jacob,
    no misery observed in Israel.
The Lord their God is with them;
    the shout of the King is among them.

twi: Onyankopɔn yii wɔn fii Misraim;ɔte sɛ nantwi hoɔdenfo ma wɔn.
english:
God brought them out of Egypt;
    they have the strength of a wild ox.

twi: Nnome biara mmaa Yakob so ɛ,mmusu biara nni Israel so.Afei, wɔbɛka afa Yakobne Israel ho se, ‘Hwɛ nea Onyankopɔn ayɛ!’
english:
There is no divination against Jacob,
    no evil omens against Israel.
It will now be said of Jacob
    and of Israel, ‘See what God has done!’

twi: Nnipa no sɔre sɛ gyatabere.Wɔwosow wɔn ho sɛ gyataa onnye nʼahome de kosi sɛ ɔbɛtetew nea wakyere no no nam pasaana ɔnom nea wakyere no no mogya.”
english:
The people rise like a lioness;
    they rouse themselves like a lion
that does not rest till it devours its prey
    and drinks the blood of its victims.”

twi: Na Balak ka kyerɛɛ Balaam se, “Sɛ worennome wɔn a, ɛno de nhyira wɔn koraa.”
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”

twi: Balaam buaa no se, “Manka ankyerɛ wo se nea Awurade bɛka biara na mɛyɛ ana?”
english: Balaam answered, “Did I not tell you I must do whatever the Lord says?”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AbiɛsaAfei, Balak ka kyerɛɛ Balaam se, “Bra mma memfa wo nkɔ baabi foforo. Ebia, ɛhɔ bɛyɛ anisɔ ama Onyankopɔn sɛ wubegyina hɔ adome wɔn.”
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there.”

twi: Na Balak faa Balaam de no kɔɔ bepɔw Peor a ani kyerɛ nweatam no atifi pɛɛ no so.
english: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.

twi: Bio, Balaam kae se, “Si afɔremuka ason na siesie anantwinini ason ne adwennini ason ma me.”
english: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

twi: Balak yɛɛ nea Balaam kae no, enti ɔde nantwinini ne odwennini bɔɔ afɔre wɔ afɔremuka no biara so.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

twi: Afei, Balaam huu sɛ ɛsɔ Awurade ani sɛ ohyira Israel no, wankɔ abisa sɛnea ɔtaa yɛ no; mmom, ɔtoo nʼani hwɛɛ sare no so.
english: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not resort to divination as at other times, but turned his face toward the wilderness.

twi: Bere a Balaam huu sɛ Israelfo no abobɔ wɔn atenae sɛnea wɔn mmusuakuw te no, Onyankopɔn honhom baa ne so,
english: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came on him

twi: na eyi ne nkɔmhyɛ a ɔmae:“Beor ba Balaam nkɔmhyɛ,nkɔmhyɛ a efi obi a nʼani hu ade yiye,
english:
and he spoke his message:
“The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor,
    the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,

twi: nea ɔte Onyankopɔn nsɛm nkɔmhyɛ;nea onya anisoadehu a efi Otumfo no hɔ;na ɔda fam, a nʼani hu ade:
english:
the prophecy of one who hears the words of God,
    who sees a vision from the Almighty,
    who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

twi: “Yakob, mo ntamadan yɛ fɛ,Israel, mo atenae yɛ ahomeka!
english:
“How beautiful are your tents, Jacob,
    your dwelling places, Israel!

twi: “Ɛtrɛtrɛw sɛ abon,sɛ nturo a ɛwɔ asubɔnten ho.Wɔte sɛ pɛprɛ a Awurade adua,te sɛ sida a esisi nsu ho.
english:
“Like valleys they spread out,
    like gardens beside a river,
like aloes planted by the Lord,
    like cedars beside the waters.

twi: Nsu bɛsen afi wɔn ahina mu.Wɔn aba benya nsu ama aboro so.“Wɔn hene bɛyɛ kɛse asen Agag;wɔn ahenni bɛkorɔn.
“Onyankopɔn de wɔn fii Misraim na ɛbae;wɔwɔ ahoɔden sɛ wuram nantwi.Wɔsɛe atirimɔdenfo amanna wobubu wɔn nnompe mu asinasin,wɔde wɔn bɛmma wowɔ wɔn.
Wobutuw da sɛ gyata;te sɛ gyatabere, hena na obetumi agyigye wɔn?“Wobehyira wɔn a wohyira wo,na wɔbɛdome wɔn a wɔdome wo.”
english:
Like a lion they crouch and lie down,
    like a lioness—who dares to rouse them?
“May those who bless you be blessed
    and those who curse you be cursed!”

twi: Balak bo fuw Balaam. Ɔbɔɔ ne nsam guu ne so kae se, “Mefrɛɛ wo se bɛdome mʼatamfo, nanso woahyira wɔn mprɛnsa yi nyinaa.
english: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.

twi: Fi ha kɔ wo nkyi ntɛm! Mekae se mɛkyɛ wo ade a ɛsom bo nanso, Awurade amma woannya akyɛde no.”
english: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the Lord has kept you from being rewarded.”

twi: Balaam buaa no se, “So manka ankyerɛ abɔfo a wosomaa wɔn baa me nkyɛn no se,
english: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not tell the messengers you sent me,

twi: ‘Sɛ Balak ma me dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛwɔ nʼahemfi hɔ nyinaa koraa a, minni tumi sɛ mɛyɛ biribi atia Awurade ahyɛde, sɛ ɛyɛ papa anaa bɔne.’ Mmom nea Awurade aka no nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ meka.
english: ‘Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the Lord—and I must say only what the Lord says’?

twi: Afei, meresan akɔ me nkurɔfo nkyɛn. Nanso ma menka nea Israelfo no bɛyɛ wo nkurɔfo no daakye no nkyerɛ wo.”
english: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you of what this people will do to your people in days to come.”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AnanEyi ne nkɔmhyɛ a Balaam de mae:“Beor ba Balaam nkɔmhyɛ,nkɔmhyɛ a efi ɔbarima a nʼani hu ade yiye,
english:
Then he spoke his message:
“The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor,
    the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,

twi: nea ɔte Onyankopɔn nsɛm no nkɔmhyɛ,nea ɔwɔ nimdeɛ a efi Ɔsorosoroni no hɔ,nea onya anisoadehu a efi Otumfo no hɔ,na ɔda fam, a nʼani hu ade no:
english:
the prophecy of one who hears the words of God,
    who has knowledge from the Most High,
who sees a vision from the Almighty,
    who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

twi: “Mihu no, nanso ɛnyɛ mprempren;mehwɛ no, nanso ɔmmɛn.Nsoromma bepue afi Yakob mu;ahempema bepue afi Israel mu.Ɔbɛdwerɛw Moabfo ti,Moabfo nyinaa tikora.
Wɔbɛfa Edom,na Seir a ɔyɛ ne tamfo no, wobedi ne so nkonim,na Israel bɛkɔ so ayɛ den.
Ɔhene bi bɛsɔre wɔ Yakob muɔno na ɔbɛsɛe kurow no mu nkaefo.”
english:
A ruler will come out of Jacob
    and destroy the survivors of the city.”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AnumAfei, Balaam hwɛɛ Amalekfo na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm:“Amalek na na ɔyɛ aman nyinaa abakan,nanso nʼawiei bɛyɛ ɔsɛe pasaa.”
english:
Then Balaam saw Amalek and spoke his message:
“Amalek was first among the nations,
    but their end will be utter destruction.”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AsiaAfei, ohuu Kenifo, na ɔhyɛɛ ne nkɔm:“Mo atenae wɔ bammɔ,wɔanwen mo berebuw wɔ abotan mu;
Nanso wɔbɛsɛe mo Kenifobere a Asur fa mo nnommum no.”
english:
yet you Kenites will be destroyed
    when Ashur takes you captive.”

twi: Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛto So AsonAfei ɔhyɛɛ ne nkɔm:“Aa! Sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ sɛɛ a, hena na ɔbɛtena nkwa mu?
english:
Then he spoke his message:
“Alas! Who can live when God does this?

twi: Ahyɛn befi Kipro mpoano aba;wobedi Eber ne Asur so.Nanso wɔn nso, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.”
Afei, Balaam sɔree na ɔsan kɔɔ ne kurom, na Balak nso kɔɔ ne kwan.
english: Then Balaam got up and returned home, and Balak went his own way.

twi: Moabfo Daadaa IsraelfoBere a Israelfo no tenaa Sitim no, wɔn mu mmarima no bi fii ase ne Moab mmea no bɔɔ aguaman de guu wɔn ho fi.
english: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with Moabite women,

twi: Saa mmea yi too nsa frɛɛ wɔn ma wɔkɔbɔɔ afɔre maa wɔn anyame. Wodii Moabfo anyame so afɔrebɔ nnuan na wɔkotow wɔn nso.
english: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate the sacrificial meal and bowed down before these gods.

twi: Enti Baal a ɛwɔ Peor no som bɛyɛɛ ɔhyɛ maa Israelfo. Eyi maa Awurade bo fuw ne nkurɔfo no yiye.
english: So Israel yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. And the Lord’s anger burned against them.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Fa saa nnipa yi ntuanofo no nyinaa, kunkum wɔn na fa wɔn gu owia so wɔ Awurade anim sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, nʼabufuwhyew no befi Israel so.”
english: The Lord said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the Lord, so that the Lord’s fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”

twi: Enti Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israel atemmufo no no se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ mo mu biara kunkum mo nkurɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho akɔhyɛ Baal a ɛwɔ Peor no ase no nyinaa.”
english: So Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you must put to death those of your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor.”

twi: Na Israelni bi de Midiani bea bi baa wɔn atenae hɔ maa Mose ne nnipa no nyinaa huu wɔn bere a na wogyinagyina Ahyiae Ntamadan pon no ano retwa adwo no.
english: Then an Israelite man brought into the camp a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

twi: Bere a Pinehas a ɔyɛ Eleasar babarima a na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron nena huu eyi no, ofii wɔn mu, kɔfaa peaw kitae;
english: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand

twi: na odii Israelni no akyi kɔɔ ntamadan no mu. Ɔde peaw no wɔɔ ɔbarima no san de wɔɔ ɔbea no yafunu mu. Enti ɔyaredɔm a na aba Israelfo no so no to twae;
english: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear into both of them, right through the Israelite man and into the woman’s stomach. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;

twi: nanso saa bere no, na nnipa mpem aduonu anan (,) awuwu dedaw.
english: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Eleasar babarima Pinehas a ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron nena ayi mʼabufuw afi Israelfo no so. Esiane sɛ wako apere mʼanuonyam wɔ wɔn mu sɛnea mepɛ ayɛ no nti, sɛnea meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ mɛsɛe Israelfo no, magyae.
english: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites. Since he was as zealous for my honor among them as I am, I did not put an end to them in my zeal.

twi: Enti ka kyerɛ no se, me ne no rebɛyɛ asomdwoe apam.
english: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.

twi: Saa apam yi mu, ɔno ne nʼasefo bɛyɛ asɔfo afebɔɔ, efisɛ watwe me ho ninkunu wɔ Israelfo mu de ayɛ mpata ama wɔn.”
english: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”

twi: Ɔbarima a wokum no ne Midiani bea no, na ne din de Simri a na ɔyɛ Salu a otua Simeon abusuakuw ano no babarima.
english: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

twi: Ɔbea no nso, na ne din de Kosbi a na ɔyɛ Midianhene babarima Sur babea.
english: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Kozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.

twi: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Tow hyɛ Midianfo no so sɛ atamfo na kunkum wɔn.
english: “Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them.

twi: Efisɛ wɔfaa mo sɛ atamfo, na wɔdaadaa mo ma mo som Baal a ɛwɔ Peor, ne Kosbi a ɔyɛ Midian ntuanoni babea, a wokum no wɔ Peor ɔyaredɔm da no.”
english: They treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the Peor incident involving their sister Kozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of that incident.”

twi: Israel Nnipakan A Ɛto So AbienƆyaredɔm no akyi no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Aaron babarima Eleasar se,
english: After the plague the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

twi: “Monkan Israelfo mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa nyinaa na monhwɛ dodow a wobetumi akɔ ɔsa ama Israel wɔ abusua biara mu.”
english: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families—all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel.”

twi: Enti Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn wɔ Moab tataw so, wɔ Asubɔnten Yordan ho a na wɔatra Yeriko no se,
english: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,

twi: “Monkan mmarima a wɔadi mfe aduonu ne nea ɛboro saa sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.”Eyinom ne Israelfo a wofi Misraim bae no:
english:
“Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the Lord commanded Moses.”
These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:

twi: Ruben AbusuakuwEyinom ne Yakob babarima panyin Ruben asefo:Hanokfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hanok;Palufo abusua, wɔde too a wɔn tete agya Palu;
Hesronfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hesron;Karmifo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Karmi.
english:
through Hezron, the Hezronite clan;
through Karmi, the Karmite clan.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Ruben mmusua nyinaa mu no dodow yɛ mpem aduanan abiɛsa ahanson aduasa (,).
english: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.

twi: Na Palu yɛ Eliab babarima,
english: The son of Pallu was Eliab,

twi: na Eliab mmabarima ne Nemuel, Datan ne Abiram. Saa Datan ne Abiram yi ara na wɔyɛ nnipa no ntuanofo a wɔka Kora akyidifo a wɔyɛɛ adwene tiaa Mose ne Aaron, de buu Awurade animtiaa no ho.
english: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the Lord.

twi: Na asase mu bue menee wɔne Kora. Ogya fi Awurade nkyɛn bɛsɛee wɔn akyidifo ahannu aduonum. Na wɔyɛɛ kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.

twi: Nanso Kora ase antɔre.
english: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.

twi: Simeon AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Simeon ase:Nemuelfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Nemuel.Yaminfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yamin.Yakinfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yakin.
Serafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Serah;Saulfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Saulo.
english:
through Zerah, the Zerahite clan;
through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Simeon mmusua mu nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien ne ahannu (,).
english: These were the clans of Simeon; those numbered were 22,200.

twi: Gad AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wɔyɛ Gad asefo:Sefonfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sefon;Hagifo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hagi;Sunifo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Suni;
Osnifo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Osni;Erifo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Eri;
english:
through Ozni, the Oznite clan;
through Eri, the Erite clan;

twi: Arodfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn agya Arod;Arelifo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Areli.
english:
through Arodi, the Arodite clan;
through Areli, the Arelite clan.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Gad mmusua mu no dodow yɛ mpem aduanan ne ahannum (,).
english: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.

twi: Yuda AbusuakuwNa Yuda wɔ mmabarima baanu a wɔn din de Er ne Onan a wowuwuu wɔ Kanaan asase so.
english: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.

twi: Yuda asefo mmusua a edidi so yi:Selafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sela;Peresfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Peres;Serafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Serah.
Eyinom ne mmusua a wofi Peres ase.Hesronfo abusua, a wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hesron;Hamulfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hamul.
Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Yuda mmusua mu no nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduɔson asia ne ahannum (,).
english: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.

twi: Isakar AsefoEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Isakar ase:Tolafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Tola;Puwafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Puwa;
Yasubfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yasub;Simronfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Simron.
english:
through Jashub, the Jashubite clan;
through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Isakar mmusua no mu no nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduosia anan ne ahaasa (,).
english: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.

twi: Sebulon AsefoEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Sebulon ase:Seredfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sered;Elonfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Elon.Yakleefo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yakleel.
Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Sebulon mmusua no mu no nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduosia ne ahannum (,).
english: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.

twi: Manase AbusuakuwƐnam Manase ne Efraim so na mmusua abien fii Yosef mu bae.
english: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:

twi: Manase asefo:Makirfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Makir;Gileadfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya, Makir babarima, Gilead.
Eyinom ne mmusua a wofi Gileadfo ase:Yeserfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yeser;Helekfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn agya Helek.
Asrielfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Asriel;Sekemfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sekem;
english:
through Asriel, the Asrielite clan;
through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;

twi: Semidafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Semida;Heferfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hefer.
english:
through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan;
through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

twi: Hefer babarima Selofehad annya mmabarima nanso na ɔwɔ mmabea a wɔn din de Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka ne Tirsa.
english: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Manase mmusua no nyinaa mu dodow yɛ mpem aduonum abien ne ahanson (,).
english: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.

twi: Efraim AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Efraim ase:Sutelafo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sutela;Bekerfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Beker;Tahanfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Tahan.
Eyinom ne Sutela asefo:Eranfo abusua, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Eran.
english:
These were the descendants of Shuthelah:
through Eran, the Eranite clan.

twi: Eyinom Efraim mmusua; wɔn dodow yɛ mpem aduasa abien ne ahannum (,).Eyinom ne mmusua a wɔyɛ Yosef asefo.
english:
These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500.
These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.

twi: Benyamin AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Benyamin ase.Belafo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Bela;Asbelfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Asbel;Ahiramfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Ahiram;
Sufamfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Sufam;Hufamfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Hufam.
english:
through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan;
through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

twi: Eyinom ne mmusua a wofi Belafo mu;Ardfo a wɔde wɔn too wɔn tete agya Ard;Naamanfo a wɔde wɔn too wɔn tete agya Naaman.
Na mmarima a na wɔwɔ Benyamin mmusua no mu nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduanan anum ne ahansia (,).
english: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.

twi: Dan AbusuakuwEyi ne abusua a efi Dan ase.Suhamfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Suham.Na Dan asefo no nyinaa yɛ Suhamfo.
english:
These were the descendants of Dan by their clans:
through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan.
These were the clans of Dan:

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ saa mu no nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduosia anan ne ahannan (,).
english: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.

twi: Aser AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Aser ase:Yimnafo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yimna;Isuifo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Isui;Beriafo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Beria.
Eyinom ne mmusua a wofi Beria ase:Heberfo de wɔn ho too wɔn tete agya Heber;Malkielfo de wɔn ho too wɔn tete agya Malkiel.
Na Aser wɔ ɔbabea bi a ne din de Sera.
english: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)

twi: Mmarima a na wɔyɛ Aser asefo no nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduonum abiɛsa ne ahannan (,).
english: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.

twi: Naftali AbusuakuwEyinom ne mmusua a wofi Naftali ase:Yakseelfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yakseel;Gunifo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn agya Guni;
Yeserfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Yeser;Silemfo abusua no, wɔde too wɔn tete agya Silem.
english:
through Jezer, the Jezerite clan;
through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

twi: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ Naftali mmusua nyinaa mu no dodow yɛ mpem aduanan anum ne ahannan (,).
english: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

twi: Nnipa Dodow A Wɔkan WɔnNnipa dodow a wɔkan wɔn no ano si mpem ahansia ne baako ahanson aduasa (,).
english: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.

twi: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Kyekyɛ asase no ma mmusua no sɛ wɔn agyapade, sɛnea wɔn dodow te.
english: “The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.

twi: Ma abusua a ɛso no agyapade kɛse na abusua a esua no agyapade ketewa.
english: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.

twi: Hwɛ sɛ wɔnam ntontobɔ so bɛkyekyɛ asase no. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ kuw biara nya no begyina nʼagyanom abusuakuw din dodow so.
english: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ntonto wɔ agyapade no kyekyɛ so wɔ akuw akɛse ne nketewa no mu.”
english: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups.”

twi: Eyinom ne Lewifo a wɔnam wɔn mmusua so kan wɔn:Wɔde Gersonfo too wɔn tete agya Gerson.Wɔde Kohatfo too wɔn tete agya Kohat.Wɔde Merarifo too wɔn tete agya Merari.
Eyinom nso yɛ Lewifo mmusua:Libnifo,Hebronfo,Mahlifo,Musifo neKorafo.Kohat yɛ Amram tete agya.
english:
These also were Levite clans:
the Libnite clan,
the Hebronite clan,
the Mahlite clan,
the Mushite clan,
the Korahite clan.
(Kohath was the forefather of Amram;

twi: Bere a Lewi wɔ Misraim no, wɔwoo ɔbabea a ne din de Yokebed. Kehat babarima Amram waree no. Wɔn na wɔwoo Aaron, Mose ne Miriam.
english: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.

twi: Aaron woo Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.
english: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

twi: Nanso, bere a Nadab ne Abihu de ogya a ɛnyɛ kronkron brɛɛ Awurade no, wowuwui.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the Lord with unauthorized fire.)

twi: Nnipakan no mu no, na Lewifo nyinaa dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abiɛsa (,). Wɔkan mmarima a wɔadi fi ɔsram kosi mpanyimfo so. Nanso, wɔammu Lewifo no ano anka Israel nnipakan no ho, efisɛ wɔrekyɛ nsase no ama mmusuakuw no, wɔamma Lewifo no bi.
english: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

twi: Enti sɛnea Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar fa kyerɛɛ nnipa no ano wɔ Moab bepɔw a ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Yordan a na wɔatwa Yeriko ne no.
english: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

twi: Na saa nnipa yi mu biara nni hɔ a ɔfra wɔn a Mose ne Aaron kan wɔn wɔ Sinai sare so no mu.
english: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

twi: Efisɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ saa Israelfo no se wobewuwu wɔ sare no so. Anka wɔn mu biara, gye Yefune ba Kaleb ne Nun babarima Yosua.
english: For the Lord had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

twi: Selofehad MmabeaHefer a ɔyɛ Manase ba, Mika ba, Gilead ba no babarima Selofehad a wofi Manase mmusua a efi Yosef ase no mmabea a wɔn din ne Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka ne Tirsa sɔree.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward

twi: Wɔbaa Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasar, mpanyimfo ne wɔn a wɔahyia wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano no nyinaa anim bɛkaa se,
english: and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said,

twi: “Yɛn agya wuu wɔ sare so nanso na ɔnka wɔn a wɔne Kora yɛɛ dɔm tiaa Awurade a enti ɛma wowuwuu no ho. Ɔno ankasa bɔne nti na owui a wannyaw mmabarima.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord, but he died for his own sin and left no sons.

twi: Adɛn nti na esiane sɛ yɛn agya anwo ɔbabarima nti ne din ayera fi nʼabusua mu? Momma yɛn yɛn agya abusua mu agyapade no bi.”
english: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives.”

twi: Enti Mose de wɔn asɛm too Awurade anim.
english: So Moses brought their case before the Lord,

twi: Awurade buaa no se,
english: and the Lord said to him,

twi: “Asɛm a Selofehad mmabea no ka no yɛ nokware. Ma wɔn ne wɔn agya nuanom no asase. Fa agyapade a sɛ wɔn agya no te ase a anka obenya no ma wɔn.
english: “What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se sɛ obi wu na onni mmabarima a ɛsɛ sɛ nʼagyapade kɔ ne mmabea hɔ.
english: “Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.

twi: Na sɛ onni ɔbabea nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ agyapade no kɔ ne nuabarimanom nkyɛn.
english: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

twi: Na sɛ onni nuabarimanom a, ɛkɔ ne wɔfanom nkyɛn.
english: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

twi: Na sɛ onni wɔn mu biara bi a, ɛkɔ ne busuani bi a ɔbɛn no nkyɛn. Ɛsɛ sɛ Israelfo di saa mmara a Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no so.”
english: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’”

twi: Woyi Yosua Sɛ Mose AbediakyiriAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Kɔ bepɔw a ɛwɔ Abarim mmepɔw no so na hwɛ asase a mede maa Israelfo no.
english: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

twi: Sɛ wohwɛ wie a, wubewu sɛnea wo nua Aaron wui no,
english: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,

twi: efisɛ wɔsɔre tiaa me mmara wɔ Sin sare so hɔ, mo baanu no buu mʼahyɛde so na moanhyɛ me anuonyam sɛ ɔkronkronni wɔ wɔn ani so.” Na ɔretwe nʼadwene aba Meriba nsu “Akoe” a ɛwɔ Kades a ɛwɔ Sin sare so no so.
english: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes.” (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)

twi: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Awurade se,
english: Moses said to the Lord,

twi: “Awurade, Onyankopɔn a woyɛ nnipa nyinaa honhom ti, yi obi ma onni dɔm yi anim
english: “May the Lord, the God who gives breath to all living things, appoint someone over this community

twi: a ɔde wɔn befi adi na ɔde wɔn aba mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Awurade nnipa renyɛ sɛ nguan a wonni ɔhwɛfo.”
english: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the Lord’s people will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”

twi: Enti Awurade buaa Mose se, “Kɔ na kɔfrɛ Nun babarima Yosua a ɔwɔ akanni honhom wɔ ne mu no, na fa wo nsa to no so.
english: So the Lord said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit of leadership, and lay your hand on him.

twi: Fa no kɔ ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne nnipa no nyinaa anim na fa ne dwumadi hyɛ ne nsa.
english: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

twi: Fa wo tumi no bi ma no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Israelfo nyinaa betie no.
english: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.

twi: Sɛ wohia akwankyerɛ a efi Awurade hɔ a, Yosua begyina ɔsɔfo Eleasar anim, na ɔsɔfo Eleasar abɔ ntonto kronkron de abisa Awurade apɛde. Ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ ama Israelfo no nyinaa afi adi na wahyɛ ama wɔaba mu.”
english: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the Lord. At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in.”

twi: Mose yɛɛ sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no. Ɔde Yosua kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne nnipa no nyinaa.
english: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.

twi: Na ɔde ne nsa guu no so, de nʼadwuma hyɛɛ ne nsa sɛnea Awurade nam ne so hyɛe no.
english: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the Lord instructed through Moses.

twi: Afɔrebɔ AhorowAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo se, ‘Monhwɛ na momfa mʼaduan afɔre mmrɛ me wɔ ne bere ano sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ mʼani.’
english: “Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’

twi: Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Eyi ne aduan afɔre a ɛsɛ sɛ mode brɛ Awurade: nguamma abien a wɔadi afe a dɛm nni wɔn ho; momfa mmra sɛ daa ɔhyew afɔre.
english: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the Lord: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.

twi: Momfa oguamma no baako mmɔ afɔre anɔpa na momfa ɔbaako mmɔ anwummere,
english: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

twi: na momfa aburow lita abien ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu na wɔde ngo lita baako afra nka ho.
english: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.

twi: Eyi ne ɔhyew afɔre a wofii ase wɔ Sinai Bepɔw so a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ no bere ano bere ano ma eyi hua. Ɛyɛ aduan afɔre a wɔbɔ ma Awurade.
english: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ɔnom afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ nsa a apae lita baako a oguamma ka ho ka afɔrebɔde no ho a wobehwie agu beae bi a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron wɔ Awurade anim.
english: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.

twi: Momfa oguamma a ɔto so abien no mmɔ afɔre anwummere a atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔ ka ho. Ɛno nso yɛ Awurade huam. Ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre.’
english: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: “ ‘Sɛ edu homeda a, momfa nguantenmma a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm biara ne afɔrebɔde ahorow a ɛsɛ sɛ mode ka ho no mmɔ afɔre. Ɛsɛ sɛ atoko afɔrebɔde lita anan ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu de ngo afra a nsa ka ho saa ara na wɔde bɔ saa afɔre no.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.

twi: Eyi ne ɔhyew afɔre a wɔbɔ no homeda biara de ka bere ano ɔhyew afɔre ne nsa afɔre ho no.
english: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Saa ara nso na da a edi kan wɔ ɔsram biara mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ mobɔ ɔhyew afɔre foforo bi ka ho de ma Awurade. Afɔrebɔde no bɛyɛ nantwinini abien, Odwennini baako ne nguantenmma ason a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm biara.
english: “‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Nantwinini biara no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode ka ho ne asikresiam lita asia ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu de ngo afra. Afei, mode asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu lita anan ne fa a wɔde ngo afra bɛbɔ aburow afɔre a Odwennini no ka ho;
english: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;

twi: na oguamma biara nso, mode asikresiam lita abiɛsa. Eyi bɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre a ɛsɔ ani, aduan afɔre a wɔbɔ ma Awurade.
english: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord.

twi: Nantwi biara, nsa afɔrebɔde lita abien ka ho. Odwennini biara, nsa afɔrebɔde lita baako ne fa ka ho. Oguamma biara nso, nsa afɔrebɔde lita baako ka ho. Afe mu no, eyi na ɛbɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre wɔ ɔsram biara mu.
english: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.

twi: Mo bere ano bere ano ɔhyew ne nsa afɔrebɔ akyi no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre ma Awurade.
english: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.

twi: “ ‘Ɛsɛ sɛ mudi Awurade Twam Afahyɛ no afe biara sram a edi kan no da a ɛto so dunan no so.
english: “‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord’s Passover is to be held.

twi: Da a edi so no, mubefi ase adi afahyɛ; munnni brodo a mmɔkaw wɔ mu nnanson.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.

twi: Afahyɛ no da a edi kan no, nnipa no nyinaa bɛbɔ ahotew gua na obiara renyɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ den biara.
english: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

twi: Momfa nantwimma anini abien, Odwennini baako ne nguantenmma ason a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm mmɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre ama Awurade.
english: Present to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Mode esiam muhumuhu lita ason a wɔde ngo afra bɛka nantwi baako biara ho. Afei, mode esiam lita anum bɛka odwennini no ho,
english: With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

twi: na nguanten ason no biara nso, mode esiam lita abiɛsa aka ho.
english: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo bɔ bɔne ho afɔre sɛ mpata ma mo ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

twi: Momfa saa afɔrebɔde yi nka nea daadaa mobɔ no ho.
english: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

twi: Momfa saa kwan yi so mmɔ aduan afɔre da biara saa ara nnanson sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani; ɛsɛ sɛ mobɔ ka ɔhyew afɔre ne nsa afɔre a mobɔ daa no ho.
english: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

twi: Da a ɛto so ason no, monyɛ nhyiamu kronkron na monnyɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ den biara.
english: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

twi: “ ‘Aduankan da no a wɔfrɛ no Nnaawɔtwe mu Afahyɛ anaasɛ Pentekoste no, ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa no nyinaa de kronkronyɛ sononko hyia, de di Otwabere Afahyɛ no. Da no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode mo mfuw mu nnɔbae foforo bɛbɔ Awurade aduan afɔre. Ɛnsɛ sɛ moyɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ den biara.
english: “‘On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the Lord an offering of new grain during the Festival of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

twi: Momfa nantwimma anini abien, odwennini baako ne nguantenmma anini ason mmɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

twi: Mode mo aburow lita asia ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu a mode ngo afra bɛka nantwi baako biara ho. Mode lita anan bɛka Odwennini no ho;
english: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

twi: na mode lita abiɛsa bɛka nguantenmma ason no biara ho.
english: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako na wɔmfa nyɛ mpata mma mo.
english: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.

twi: Saa afɔre ahorow yi ka daa ɔhyew afɔre, aburow afɔre ne nsa afɔre no ho. Monhwɛ sɛ mmoa a mode wɔn bɛbɔ saa afɔre no nnii dɛm biara ɛ.
english: Offer these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.

twi: Ntorobɛnto Afahyɛ“ ‘Ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a edi kan wɔ afe biara mu no, munni torobɛnto afahyɛ no. Monyɛ nhyiamu kronkron no na obiara nyɛ adwumaden biara.
english: “‘On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.

twi: Momfa nantwi ba onini baako, Odwennini baako ne adwennini ason a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm mmɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre a eyi hua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
english: As an aroma pleasing to the Lord, offer a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa esiam lita asia ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu a wɔde ngo afra mmɔ atoko afɔre no a nantwi no ka ho. Odwennini no, momfa lita anan ne fa nka ho
english: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

twi: na lita abien ne fa nso nka nguantenmma no biara ho.
english: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako nka ho mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre mfa nyɛ mpata mma mo.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

twi: Eyinom ka ɔhyew afɔre ne nsa afɔre a mobɔ no ɔsram biara ne daa de a wɔakyerɛ no ho. Ɛyɛ aduan afɔre a wɔde brɛ Awurade sɛ ehua a ɛsɔ ani.
english: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the Lord, a pleasing aroma.

twi: Mpata Da Afɔrebɔ“ ‘Ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a ɛto so du so no monyɛ nhyiamu kronkron. Ɛyɛ da a ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa no nyinaa yɛ komm ahobrɛase mu wɔ Awurade anim na ɛnsɛ sɛ biara yɛ adwuma biara.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.

twi: Mommɔ ɔhyew afɔre a eyi hua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani. Afɔrebɔde no yɛ nantwi ba baako, odwennini baako, nguamma a wɔadi afe ason a wonnii dɛm biara.
english: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa nantwi ba no nsiesie atoko afɔre a mode asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu ne ngo lita asia ne fa afra,
english: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

twi: na momfa lita anan ne fa nka odwennini no ho na momfa lita abien ne fa aka nguamma ason no mu biara ho.
english: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo baako bɔ bɔne ho afɔre. Eyi ka bɔne afɔrebɔde a wɔbɔ de pata ne ɔhyew afɔre a wɔbɔ no daadaa a aduan afɔrebɔde ne nsa afɔre ka ho no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

twi: Ntamadan Afahyɛ“ ‘Monyɛ nhyiamu kronkron wɔ ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a ɛto so dunum no so, na monnyɛ adwumaden biara. Munni afahyɛ no nnanson mma Awurade.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the Lord for seven days.

twi: Nneɛma a mode bɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre na ama ayi hua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani no yɛ nantwimma anini dumiɛnsa, adwennini abien ne adwennini dunan a wɔadi afe na wonnii dɛm biara.
english: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu lita asia ne fa a wɔde ngo afra ka nantwimma dumiɛnsa no biara ho. Lita anan ne fa nka adwennini no baako biara ho,
english: With each of the thirteen bulls offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;

twi: na lita abien ne fa nka nguantenmma dunan no biara ho.
english: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre nka daa ɔhyew afɔre, atoko ne nsa afɔre a mobɔ no daa no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Da a ɛto so abien no, momfa anantwi anini mma dumien, adwennini abien ne adwennini a wɔadi afe dunan a wonnii dɛm biara mmɛbɔ afɔre.
english: “‘On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Saa afɔrebɔde yi mu biara no, mode anantwinini, adwennini ne nguantenmma no ho aduan ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔahyɛ no bɛka ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Ɔhyew afɔre a mobɔ no daa akyi no, mode ɔpapo bɛka atoko afɔrebɔde ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho abɔ bɔne ho afɔre.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

twi: “ ‘Afahyɛ no da a ɛto so abiɛsa no, mode anantwinini dubaako, adwennini abien, nguantenmma a wɔadi afe no dunan a wonnii dɛm biara;
english: “‘On the third day offer eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: na sɛnea moyɛ no daa no, mode anantwi, adwennini ne nguantenmma no ne aduan ne nsa afɔrebɔde bɛka afɔrebɔde biara ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo bɔ bɔne ho afɔre de ka daa ɔhyew afɔrebɔ no ho a atoko afɔrebɔde ne nsa afɔrebɔde ka ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Afahyɛ no da a ɛto so anan no, momfa anantwinini du, adwennini abien, ne nguantenmma a wɔadi afe no dunan a wonnii dɛm biara mmɔ afɔre.
english: “‘On the fourth day offer ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa atoko afɔrebɔde ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔakyerɛ no nka biara ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔrebɔ nka daa ɔhyew, atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Afahyɛ no da a ɛto so anum no, momfa anantwinini akron, adwennini abien ne nguantenmma a wɔadi afe no dunan a wonnii dɛm biara mmɔ afɔre.
english: “‘On the fifth day offer nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔakyerɛ no nka anantwinini, adwennini ne nguamma afɔrebɔ no ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔrebɔ nka daa ɔhyew, atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Afahyɛ no da a ɛto so asia no, momfa de anantwinini awotwe, adwennini abien ne nguantenmma a wɔadi afe dunan a wonnii dɛm biara mmɔ afɔre.
english: “‘On the sixth day offer eight bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔakyerɛ no nka anantwinini, adwennini ne nguantenmma afɔrebɔ no ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔrebɔ nka daa ɔhyew, atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Afahyɛ no da a ɛto so ason no, momfa anantwinini ason, adwennini abien ne nguamma a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm biara dunan mmɔ afɔre.
english: “‘On the seventh day offer seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔakyerɛ no nka anantwinini, adwennini ne nguantenmma afɔrebɔ no ho.
english: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre nka daa ɔhyew, atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Da a ɛto so awotwe no, monyɛ ɔpɔn nhyiamu sononko. Ɛnsɛ sɛ moyɛ adwumaden biara saa da no.
english: “‘On the eighth day hold a closing special assembly and do no regular work.

twi: Mommɔ aduan afɔre a ɔhyew afɔre a ɛwɔ hua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani wɔ mu. Momfa nantwinini baako, Odwennini baako, nguantenmma ason a wɔadi afe a wonnii dɛm mmɔ.
english: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

twi: Momfa atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde dodow a wɔakyerɛ no nka nantwinini, odwennini ne nguantenmma no ho.
english: With the bull, the ram and the lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

twi: Momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre nka daa ɔhyew, atoko ne nsa afɔrebɔde no ho.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

twi: “ ‘Mommɔ afɔre yinom mma mo Awurade wɔ mo afahyɛ ahorow no nu: mo hyew, atoko, nsa ne asomdwoe afɔre no; na momfa nka afɔre a mufi mo pɛ mu hyɛ ho bɔ no no ho. Muhyia, didi afirihyia no mu a, twa ara na etwa sɛ mobɔ saa afɔre yi. Na ɛka mo afɔre a mobɔ fa bɔ a moahyɛ anaa nea efi mo pɛ mu a ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, atoko afɔre, nsa afɔre anaa asomdwoe afɔre no ho.’ ”
english: “‘In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, offer these to the Lord at your appointed festivals: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.’”

twi: Mose kaa saa mmara yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no.
english: Moses told the Israelites all that the Lord commanded him.

twi: Bɔhyɛ Ho MmaraMose hyiaa Israel mmusua no mu mpanyimfo no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Awurade ahyɛ se:
english: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: “This is what the Lord commands:

twi: Sɛ obi hyɛ Awurade bɔ anaa ɔka ntam hyɛ bɔ a, ɛnsɛ sɛ obu so. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ nea ɔkaa se ɔbɛyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english: When a man makes a vow to the Lord or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.

twi: “Sɛ ababaa bi hyɛ Awurade bɔ anaa ɔka ntam hyɛ bɔ bere a ɔda so te nʼagya fi,
english: “When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the Lord or obligates herself by a pledge

twi: na nʼagya no te sɛ ne ba no ahyɛ bɔ, na wanka hwee a, ne bɔhyɛ ne ne ntam a ɔkaa no nyinaa no di mu.
english: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

twi: Nanso sɛ ɛba sɛ nʼagya no siw no bɔhyɛ no ho kwan a, etwa ne bɔhyɛ ne ntam a ɔkae no mu. Awurade de bɛkyɛ ababaa no, efisɛ nʼagya ampene sɛ obedi so.
english: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the Lord will release her because her father has forbidden her.

twi: “Sɛ ɔhyɛ bɔ anaa ɔka ntam ansa na ɔware na ɛbɛyɛ asodi ma no
english: “If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself

twi: na ne kunu no te saa bɔhyɛ no ho asɛm nanso wanka ho hwee a, na ne bɔhyɛ no gyina hɔ.
english: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

twi: Na sɛ ne kunu no te na osiw no ho kwan a na ɛkyerɛ sɛ watwa mu a bɔhyɛ no anaa ntam no ho asodi nna ne so bio, enti Awurade de ne ho bɛkyɛ no.
english: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the Lord will release her.

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbea kunafo anaa nea wɔagyaa no aware no di ne ntam a ɔbɛka anaa bɔ a ɔbɛhyɛ no biara so.
english: “Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.

twi: “Sɛ waware na ɔte ne kunu fi na ɔhyɛ bɔ anaa ɔka ntam,
english: “If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath

twi: na ne kunu no te na wansiw no ho kwan a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ne bɔhyɛ no gyina hɔ.
english: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

twi: Na sɛ ne kunu no te na, sɛ wampene so na, otwa mu a, na ne bɔhyɛ no nni mu na Awurade de ne ho bɛkyɛ no.
english: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the Lord will release her.

twi: Enti ne kunu no betumi asi ne bɔ a ɔhyɛ anaa ntam a ɔka no so dua anaasɛ obetwa mu.
english: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.

twi: Sɛ da mu no nyinaa wanka ho hwee ankyerɛ no de a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔpene so wɔ hwee a wanka amfa ho no nti.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

twi: Sɛ ɔtwɛn ma mmere bi fa so ansa na ɔka se bɔhyɛ no nni mu a, ɛno de, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsoa ɔbea no mfomso no ho asodi.”
english: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing.”

twi: Eyinom ne mmara a Awurade nam Mose so de maa ɔbarima ne ne yere, ne agya ne ne babea a ɔda so te ne fi no.
english: These are the regulations the Lord gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living at home.

twi: Midianfo So AweretɔAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Esiane sɛ Midianfo daadaa mo de mo kɔɔ abosonsom mu no nti, tɔ so were ma Israelfo no. Eyi akyi no wubewu na woakɔ wʼagyanom nkyɛn.”
english: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”

twi: Mose ka kyerɛɛ nkurɔfo so se, “Munyi mo mmarima no mu bi na wɔnkɔ Awurade aweretɔ sa a ɔde tia Midianfo no.
english: So Moses said to the people, “Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites so that they may carry out the Lord’s vengeance on them.

twi: Momfa Israel abusua biara mu nnipa apem nkɔ ɔsa no.”
english: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel.”

twi: Wɔyɛɛ saa nyaa mmarima mpem dumien siesie wɔn maa ɔko no; Israel abusuakuw biara maa mmarima apem.
english: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.

twi: Afei Mose ma wɔkɔe, nnipa apem baako a wofi abusuakuw biara mu. Ɔsɔfo Eleasar babarima Pinehas na odii wɔn anim kɔɔ ɔko no. Wɔrekɔ no, wɔde akronkronne a ɛwɔ kronkronbea hɔ ne ntorobɛnto a wɔbɛhyɛn de ama asraafo no nsɛnkyerɛnne kɔe.
english: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

twi: Wɔne Midiafo no koe, na sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no wokum Midian mmarima no nyinaa.
english: They fought against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every man.

twi: Wɔn a wokum wɔn no bi ne Midian ahemfo baanum a wɔn din de Ewi, Rekem, Sur, Hur ne Reba. Beor babarima Balaam nso, wɔde afoa kum no.
english: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

twi: Afei, Israel asraafo no kyekyeree Midian mmea ne mmofra nyinaa ne wɔn anantwi ne wɔn nguan fom nneɛma pii kaa ho sɛ asade.
english: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.

twi: Wɔtoo Midian no atenae, nkurow ne nkuraa nyinaa mu gya, hyew no pasaa.
english: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.

twi: Wɔfaa asade ne afowde a nnipa no ne mmoa ka ho.
english: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

twi: Wɔde nnommum no ne ɔko no mu nneɛma a wonyae no nyinaa brɛɛ Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne Israelfo a na wɔabɔ wɔn atenase wɔ Moab tataw so baabi a na ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Yordan a wotwa fi Yeriko baa hɔ no.
english: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

twi: Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne mpanyimfo a wotuatua nnipa no ano no fii atenae hɔ kohyiaa nkonimdifo no kwan.
english: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

twi: Nanso Mose bo fuw mpanyimfo a wotuatua nsraadɔm apem ne ɔha no ano a wofi ɔsa no bae no.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who returned from the battle.

twi: Obisaa wɔn se, “So moankunkum mmea no?
english: “Have you allowed all the women to live?” he asked them.

twi: Wɔn ne nnipa no a wotie Balaam nti wɔtwetwee Israelfo na amma wɔanni Awurade nokware kɔsom abosom wɔ bepɔw Peor so a enti ɛmaa ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ bebree baa Awurade nkurɔfo so no.
english: “They were the ones who followed Balaam’s advice and enticed the Israelites to be unfaithful to the Lord in the Peor incident, so that a plague struck the Lord’s people.

twi: Munkunkum mmarimaa no nyinaa. Na munkunkum mmea a wɔne mmarima adeda no nyinaa.
english: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,

twi: Mmeawa nketewa a wɔne mmarima nnae no na munnyaa wɔn na mo ne wɔn ntena.
english: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara a wakum obi, anaa ɔde ne nsa kaa nea wɔakum no no, fi atenae ha nkɔtena baabi nnanson. Munnwira mo ho ne mo nnommum no nnansa ne ne nnanson so.
english: “Anyone who has killed someone or touched someone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.

twi: Munnwira mo ntade ne biribiara a wɔde aboa nhoma, abirekyi nwi anaa dua ayɛ.”
english: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood.”

twi: Afei, ɔsɔfo Eleasar ka kyerɛɛ mmarima a wɔkɔɔ ɔko no se, “Eyi ne mmara a Awurade ahyɛ a waka akyerɛ Mose:
english: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is what is required by the law that the Lord gave Moses:

twi: Sikakɔkɔɔ, dwetɛ, kɔbere, dade, sanyaa, sumpii
english: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead

twi: ne biribiara a etumi etumi gyina ogya ano no ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde fa ogya mu sɛnea ɛho bɛtew. Eyi akyi, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ahodwira nsu dwira ho ma ɛtew ho. Nanso, biribiara a ɛrentumi nnyina ogya ano no de, wɔmfa nsu nnwira ho.
english: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.

twi: Nnanson so no, ɛsɛ sɛ mohoro mo ntade na mo ho afi. Afei mubetumi asan aba atenae hɔ.”
english: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp.”

twi: Wɔkyɛ AsadeAwurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,
english: The Lord said to Moses,

twi: “Ɛsɛ sɛ wo ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne mmusua no mpanyimfo nyinaa kan asade a nnipa ne mmoa a mofaa wɔ ɔko no mu no.
english: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.

twi: Monkyɛ asade no mu abien pɛpɛɛpɛ mfa fa mma asraafo a wɔkɔɔ ɔko no na momfa fa a aka no mma nnipa a wɔaka no.
english: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.

twi: Asraafo a wɔkoo no kyɛfa mu no, munyi ahannum biara so baako; sɛ ɛyɛ nnipa, anantwi, mfurum anaa nguan na momfa nsom Awurade.
english: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the Lord one out of every five hundred, whether people, cattle, donkeys or sheep.

twi: Fa saa kyɛfa yi ma ɔsɔfo Eleasar na onhim no afɔremuka no anim mfa mma Awurade.
english: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the Lord’s part.

twi: Afei Israelfo a wɔaka no kyɛfa no, munyi aduonum biara mu baako; sɛ ɛyɛ nnipa, anantwi, mfurum, nguanten anaa mmoa foforo biara no, momfa mma Lewifo a wɔhwɛ Awurade Ahyiae Ntamadan no so no.”
english: From the Israelites’ half, select one out of every fifty, whether people, cattle, donkeys, sheep or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the Lord’s tabernacle.”

twi: Enti Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar yɛɛ nea Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no.
english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

twi: Asade a ɛkae a akofo no fae no dodow yɛ nguan mpem ahansia ne aduɔson anum (,);
english: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,

twi: anantwi mpem aduɔson abien (,);
english: 72,000 cattle,

twi: mfurum mpem aduosia baako (,);
english: 61,000 donkeys

twi: ne mmeawa mpem aduasa abien (,).
english: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.

twi: Nneɛma no fa a wɔde maa asraafo no dodow ni:Nguan mpem ahaasa aduasa ason ne ahannum (,)
english:
The half share of those who fought in the battle was:
337,500 sheep,

twi: a wɔde mu ahansia aduɔson anum () som Awurade;
english: of which the tribute for the Lord was 675;

twi: Anantwi mpem aduasa asia (,) a wɔde mu aduɔson abien () som Awurade;
english: 36,000 cattle, of which the tribute for the Lord was 72;

twi: mfurum mpem aduasa ne ahannum (,) a wɔde emu aduosia baako () som Awurade;
english: 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the Lord was 61;

twi: mmeawa mpem dunsia (,); wɔde wɔn mu aduasa abien () som Awurade.
english: 16,000 people, of whom the tribute for the Lord was 32.

twi: Kyɛfa a wɔde Awurade no nyinaa no wɔde maa ɔsɔfo Eleasar sɛnea Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔnyɛ no ara pɛ.
english: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the Lord’s part, as the Lord commanded Moses.

twi: Asade no a Israelfo no nyaa no na edidi so yi:
english: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men—

twi: nguan mpem ahaasa aduasa ason ne ahannum (,),
english: the community’s half—was 337,500 sheep,

twi: anantwi mpem aduasa asia (,),
english: 36,000 cattle,

twi: mfurum Mpem aduasa ne ahannum (,) ne
english: 30,500 donkeys

twi: mmeawa mpem dunsia (,).
english: and 16,000 people.

twi: Nnipa no kyɛfa a wonyae no, Mose yiyii nnommum ne mmoa aduonum biara mu baako de maa Lewifo a wɔhwɛ Awurade Ahyiae Ntamadan so no. Wɔyɛɛ eyi nyinaa sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.
english: From the Israelites’ half, Moses selected one out of every fifty people and animals, as the Lord commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the Lord’s tabernacle.

twi: Afei, asraafo no so mpanyimfo baa Mose nkyɛn
english: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—went to Moses

twi: bɛka kyerɛɛ no se, “Yɛabu nnipa a yɛde wɔn kɔɔ ɔko no nyinaa ano akyerɛ wo na ɔbaako koraa anyera.
english: and said to him, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one is missing.

twi: Ɛno nti, yefi nea yenyaa no ɔko no mu no bi mu rebɛda Awurade ase. Yɛn asedade no yɛ sika nnwinne, nkapo, nkaa, asokaa ne kɔnmuade. Eyinom bɛyɛ mpata ama yɛn kra wɔ Awurade anim.”
english: So we have brought as an offering to the Lord the gold articles each of us acquired—armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the Lord.”

twi: Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar gyee saa akyɛde yi a ɛyɛ sikakɔkɔɔ ne nnwinne no fii asraafo mpanyimfo no nkyɛn.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold—all the crafted articles.

twi: Ne nyinaa mu sikakɔkɔɔ a asahene no de bae sɛ akyɛde a wɔde rebrɛ Awurade no ano si nkaribo kilogram ɔha ne aduɔkron.
english: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the Lord weighed 16,750 shekels.

twi: Na asraafo no afa ɔko no mu nneɛma a wonyae no bi.
english: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.

twi: Enti Mose ne Eleasar gyee akyɛde no fii asraafo mpanyimfo no hɔ, na wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ no baa Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu sɛ ɛnyɛ nkae ade mma Awurade sɛ Israelfo yɛ ne dea.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord.

twi: Mmusuakuw A Wɔwɔ Yordan AgyaNa Ruben ne Gad mmusuakuw no wɔ nyɛmmoa pii, enti wuhuu sɛ Yaser ne Gilead nsase no beye ama wɔn nguan ne anantwi no.
english: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for livestock.

twi: Enti wɔkɔɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne nnipa no ntuanofo no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se,
english: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,

twi: “Atarot, Dibon, Yaser, Nimra, Hesbon, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo ne Beon yɛ
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo and Beon—

twi: nsase a Awurade ako, agye ama Israelfo na eye ma yɛn nguan ne yɛn anantwi.
english: the land the Lord subdued before the people of Israel—are suitable for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

twi: Sɛ yɛanya adom wɔ mo anim a, yɛsrɛ mo momfa saa asase yi mma yɛn sɛ yɛn kyɛfa na munnyae Asubɔnten Yordan agya nohɔ a mopɛ sɛ mode ma yɛn no.”
english: If we have found favor in your eyes,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as our possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”

twi: Mose nso bisaa Rubenfo ne Gadfo no se, “Mokyerɛ sɛ, mopɛ sɛ motena ha bere a mo nuanom atwa mu rekɔko?
english: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, “Should your fellow Israelites go to war while you sit here?

twi: Adɛn nti na mopɛ sɛ mubu Israelfo no aba mu ma wɔsan sɛ wɔrenkɔ asase a Awurade de ama wɔn no so no?
english: Why do you discourage the Israelites from crossing over into the land the Lord has given them?

twi: Ade koro yi ara na mo agyanom yɛe. Mesomaa wɔn fii Kades-Barnea sɛ wɔnkɔsra asase no.
english: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.

twi: Wowiee nsra no na wofi Eskol subon mu bae no, wobuu nnipa no aba mu sɛ wɔnnkɔ asase a Awurade de ama wɔn no so.
english: After they went up to the Valley of Eshkol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the Lord had given them.

twi: Da no Awurade abufuw sɔree na ɔkaa saa ntam yi:
english: The Lord’s anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath:

twi: ‘Esiane sɛ wɔamfi wɔn koma nyinaa mu anni mʼakyi nti wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a bere a wɔrefi Misraim no a na wadi mfe aduonu anaa nea ɛboro saa a no behu asase a mehyɛɛ Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ho bɔ no,
english: ‘Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of those who were twenty years old or more when they came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—

twi: ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ, gye Kenesini Yefune babarima Kaleb ne Nun babarima Yosua, efisɛ wɔde wɔn koma nyinaa dii Awurade akyi, hyɛɛ nnipa nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔ Bɔhyɛ Asase no so.’
english: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the Lord wholeheartedly.’

twi: Awurade maa yekyinkyin sare no so hɔ mfirihyia aduanan kosii sɛ saa awo ntoatoaso amumɔyɛfo no nyinaa wuwui.
english: The Lord’s anger burned against Israel and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation of those who had done evil in his sight was gone.

twi: “Nanso monhwɛ, abɔnefo, moregyina mo agyanom anan mu ama Awurade bo afuw Israel nea ɛkyɛn so.
english: “And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the Lord even more angry with Israel.

twi: Sɛ mosan fi nʼakyi a, ɔbɛsan agyaw ne nnipa no nyinaa wɔ sare so hɔ na wɔn sɛe no befi mo.”
english: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”

twi: Wɔteɛɛ mu se, “Ɛnte saa koraa! Yɛbɛyɛ yɛn nguannan na yɛakyekyere nkurow akɛse ama yɛn mmea ne mmofra.
english: Then they came up to him and said, “We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.

twi: Na yɛn ankasa de akode bɛhyehyɛ yɛn ho adi Israelfo a wɔaka no anim akosi sɛ yɛde wɔn bɛba asomdwoe mu ama wɔabɛfa wɔn agyapade. Na nea edi kan no, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkyekye nkurow a yebegye afasu afa ho ama yɛn nkurɔfo atena mu na ɛhɔfo no ankɔtow anhyɛ wɔn so.
english: But we will arm ourselves for battle and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

twi: Sɛ Israelfo no nyinaa nsa nkaa wɔn agyapade no a, yɛrensan mma yɛn afi mu.
english: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.

twi: Yɛne wɔn renkyɛ Yordan agya hɔ asase biara, efisɛ yɛanya yɛn agyapade no wɔ Yordan apuei fam hɔ.”
english: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”

twi: Mose kae se, “Sɛ mobɛyɛ sɛnea moaka no, sɛ mobɛhyehyɛ mo ho wɔ Awurade anim ama ɔko,
english: Then Moses said to them, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the Lord for battle

twi: na mode mo asraafo no atwa Yordan kosi sɛ Awurade bɛpam nʼatamfo no,
english: and if all of you who are armed cross over the Jordan before the Lord until he has driven his enemies out before him—

twi: na sɛ asase no ho asɛm dwo brɛoo wɔ Awurade anim a, ɛno de mutumi san ba. Ɛba saa a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ, moayɛ mo asɛde ama Awurade ne Israelfo nyinaa. Na asase a ɛda apuei no nso, Awurade de bɛma mo.
english: then when the land is subdued before the Lord, you may return and be free from your obligation to the Lord and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the Lord.

twi: “Sɛ moanni asɛm a moaka no so a, na moayɛ bɔne atia Awurade, munhu sɛ, ɛho asotwe bɛba mo so.
english: “But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the Lord; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

twi: Monkɔ so nkyekyere nkurow mma mo fifo na monyɛ nguannan mma mo nguan na munni asɛm a mokae no nyinaa so.”
english: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”

twi: Ruben ne Gad nkurɔfo no kae se, “Yebedi wʼahyɛde no so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “We your servants will do as our lord commands.

twi: Yɛn mma, yɛn yerenom, yɛn nguan ne yɛn anantwi bɛtena Gilead nkuropɔn mu.
english: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

twi: Nanso yɛn a wɔakyere yɛn sɛ asraafo no bɛko ama Awurade sɛnea woaka no.”
english: But your servants, every man who is armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the Lord, just as our lord says.”

twi: Enti Mose penee so ka kyerɛɛ Eleasar, Yosua ne mpanyimfo a wotuatua Israel mmusuakuw ano no se,
english: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.

twi: “Sɛ Gad ne Ruben abusuakuw mu mmarima nyinaa a wɔakyere wɔn ayɛ wɔn asraafo sɛ wɔnkɔko mma Awurade no ne me kɔ Yordan na sɛ wɔkɔko di nkonim wɔ hɔ a, momfa Gilead asase no mma wɔn;
english: He said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the Lord, then when the land is subdued before you, you must give them the land of Gilead as their possession.

twi: na sɛ wɔankɔ a, ɛno de, wɔmpene so mfa nsase a mowɔ wɔ Kanaan asase so no bi.”
english: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan.”

twi: Gad ne Ruben abusuafo kaa bio se, “Wo nkoa bedi Awurade asɛm so;
english: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, “Your servants will do what the Lord has said.

twi: yɛde akode bɛhyehyɛ yɛn ho adi Awurade akyi akɔ Kanaan, nanso yɛn ara yɛn asase bɛda Yordan fa ha.”
english: We will cross over before the Lord into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan.”

twi: Enti Mose ma wɔde Amorihene Sihon ne Basanhene Og nsasetam ne wɔn nkurow akɛse maa Gad, Ruben ne Yosef babarima Manase mmusuakuw.
english: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.

twi: Gad nkurɔfo na wɔkyekyeree saa nkurow yi: Dibon, Atarot, Aroer.
english: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

twi: Atrot-Sofan, Yaser Yogbeha,
english: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

twi: Bet-Nimra ne Betharan. Na ɛyɛ nkurow a nguan wɔ mu yiye.
english: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.

twi: Ruben mmabarima na wɔkyekyeree saa nkurow a edidi so yi: Hesbon, Eleale ne Kiriataim,
english: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,

twi: Nebo, Baal-Meon a akyiri no wɔsesaa wɔn din, ne Sibma. Wɔtotoo nkurow a wɔsan kyekyee no din.
english: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.

twi: Makir asefo a wofi Manase abusuakuw mu kɔɔ Gilead kɔko dii hɔ so pam Amorifo a saa bere no na wɔte hɔ no nyinaa.
english: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.

twi: Enti Mose de Gilead maa Makirfo a wɔyɛ Manase asefo no, ma wɔtenaa hɔ.
english: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.

twi: Manase abusuakuw mu nnipa foforo bi a wofi Yair nso tenatenaa Gilead nkurow bebree so, sesaa beae a wɔwɔ hɔ no din frɛɛ hɔ Hafrotyair.
english: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.

twi: Ɔbarima bi a ne din de Noba dii asraafo bi anim de wɔn kɔɔ Kenat ne ne nkuraase kɔbɔɔ wɔn atenae wɔ hɔ enti ɔde ne din Noba too saa beae hɔ.
english: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.

twi: Israelfo AkwantuEyi ne akwantu nhyehyɛe a Israelfo dii so bere a Mose ne Aaron de wɔn fi Misraim no.
english: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

twi: Mose kyerɛw faako a wɔfaa nyinaa sɛnea Awurade kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no. Eyinom ne mmeae ahorow a wɔsoɛɛ wɔ wɔn akwantu no mu.
english: At the Lord’s command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:

twi: Wosii mu fii Rameses kuropɔn no mu wɔ Twam Afahyɛ a edi kan no akyi ɔsram edi kan da ɛto so dunum. Wɔde akokoduru fii hɔ a Misraimfo no rehwɛ wɔn.
english: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,

twi: Saa bere no na Misraimfo no resie wɔn mmakan a Awurade kunkum wɔn anadwo a ade rebɛkye ama wɔatu kwan no, efisɛ na Awurade de atemmu aba wɔn anyame no nyinaa so.
english: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them; for the Lord had brought judgment on their gods.

twi: Wofii Rameses no, wɔbɛbɔɔ atenae wɔ Sukot.
english: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.

twi: Wofii Sukot bɛbɔɔ atenae wɔ Etam, sare no ano.
english: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.

twi: Wofii Etam san wɔn akyi baa Pihahirot a ɛwɔ Baal-Sefon apuei fam, na wɔbɔɔ atenae bɛnee bepɔw Migdol.
english: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

twi: Wofi Pihahirot, na wotwaa Po Kɔkɔɔ no kɔɔ sare so. Wɔde nnansa nantew faa Etam sare so kɔbɔɔ atenae wɔ Mara.
english: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.

twi: Wofii Mara no, wɔbaa Elim; baabi a na mmura dumien ne mmedua aduɔson wɔ hɔ.
english: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

twi: Wofii Elim no, wɔbɔɔ atenae wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho.
english: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
