twi: Ma ɔfoforo nkamfo wo; na ɛnyɛ wo ankasa;ma emfi ɔfoforo anom na ɛnyɛ wo.
english:
Let someone else praise you, and not your own mouth;
    an outsider, and not your own lips.

twi: Ɔbo mu yɛ duru, na nwea yɛ adesoa,nanso ɔkwasea abufuwhyew yɛ duru sen emu biara.
english:
Stone is heavy and sand a burden,
    but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

twi: Abufuw tirim yɛ den, na abufuwhyew sɛe ade,na hena na obetumi agyina ninkutwe ano?
english:
Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming,
    but who can stand before jealousy?

twi: Animka a ɛda guaye sen ɔdɔ a asuma.
english:
Better is open rebuke
    than hidden love.

twi: Apirakuru a efi adamfo nkyɛn no yesen ɔtamfo mfewano bebrebe.
english:
Wounds from a friend can be trusted,
    but an enemy multiplies kisses.

twi: Ɛwo nyɛ nea wamee akɔnnɔ,nanso nea ɛyɛ nwen mpo yɛ nea ɔkɔm de no no nʼanom dɛ.
english:
One who is full loathes honey from the comb,
    but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.

twi: Onipa a wayera ne fi kwan,te sɛ anomaa a wafi ne berebuw mu rekyinkyin.
english:
Like a bird that flees its nest
    is anyone who flees from home.

twi: Ngo ne aduhuam ma koma ani gye,adamfo ho anigye fi nʼafotu pa a ɔma.
english:
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart,
    and the pleasantness of a friend
    springs from their heartfelt advice.

twi: Nnyaa wʼadamfo ne wʼagya adamfo mu,nkɔ wo nuabarima fi bere a ɔhaw ato wo,na ɔyɔnko a ɔbɛn wo no ye sen onuabarima a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri.
english:
Do not forsake your friend or a friend of your family,
    and do not go to your relative’s house when disaster strikes you—
    better a neighbor nearby than a relative far away.

twi: Me ba, hu nyansa na ma me koma ani nnye;ɛno na ɛbɛma manya mmuae ama obiara a obu me animtiaa.
english:
Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart;
    then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.

twi: Mmadwemma hu asiane na wohintaw,nanso ntetekwaafo kɔ wɔn anim kɔtɔ mu.
english:
The prudent see danger and take refuge,
    but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

twi: Fa atade a ɛhyɛ obi a odi ɔhɔho akagyinamu;sɛ ɔregyina ɔbea huhufo akyi a, fa si awowa.
english:
Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger;
    hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

twi: Sɛ obi teɛ mu hyira ne yɔnko anɔpahema a,wɔbɛfa no sɛ ɛyɛ nnome.
english:
If anyone loudly blesses their neighbor early in the morning,
    it will be taken as a curse.

twi: Ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo te sɛahumtuda nsusosɔ wɔ ɔdan a enwin so;
english:
A quarrelsome wife is like the dripping
    of a leaky roof in a rainstorm;

twi: sɛ wopata no a, ɛte sɛ nea wopata mframaanaa wode wo nsa beso ngo mu.
english:
restraining her is like restraining the wind
    or grasping oil with the hand.

twi: Dade sew dade,saa ara na onipa sew ɔfoforo.
english:
As iron sharpens iron,
    so one person sharpens another.

twi: Nea ɔhwɛ borɔdɔma dua so no bedi so aba,na nea ɔsom ne wura no, wɔbɛhyɛ no anuonyam.
english:
The one who guards a fig tree will eat its fruit,
    and whoever protects their master will be honored.

twi: Sɛnea nsu yi animdua kyerɛ no,saa ara na onipa koma da onipa no adi.
english:
As water reflects the face,
    so one’s life reflects the heart.

twi: Sɛnea Owu ne Ɔsɛe bo ntɔ da no,saa ara, na onipa ani nso bo ntɔ da.
english:
Death and Destruction are never satisfied,
    and neither are human eyes.

twi: Kyɛmfɛre wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sikakɔkɔɔ,nanso wɔnam nkamfo a onipa nya so na ɛsɔ no hwɛ.
english:
The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold,
    but people are tested by their praise.

twi: Sɛ wowɔw ɔkwasea wɔ ɔwaduru mu,sɛ wode ɔwɔma wɔw no te sɛnea wusiw aburow a,worentumi nyi agyimisɛm mfi ne ho.
english:
Though you grind a fool in a mortar,
    grinding them like grain with a pestle,
    you will not remove their folly from them.

twi: Ma ɛnyɛ wo asɛnhia sɛ wubehu wo nguankuw tebea,na ma wʼani nkɔ wo anantwikuw so;
english:
Be sure you know the condition of your flocks,
    give careful attention to your herds;

twi: efisɛ, ahonya ntena hɔ daa,na ahenkyɛw ntena hɔ mma awo ntoantoaso nyinaa.
english:
for riches do not endure forever,
    and a crown is not secure for all generations.

twi: Sɛ wotwa sare no na foforo fifi,na wɔboaboa nkoko so sare no ano a,
english:
When the hay is removed and new growth appears
    and the grass from the hills is gathered in,

twi: ɛno de, nguantenmma no bɛma wo ntama,na mmirekyi ama sika a ɛtɔ mfuw.
english:
the lambs will provide you with clothing,
    and the goats with the price of a field.

twi: Wubenya mmirekyi nufusu bebreeama wo ne wʼabusuafo adine aduan ama wo mmaawa.
english:
You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed your family
    and to nourish your female servants.

twi: Omumɔyɛfo guan bere a obiara ntaa no,nanso atreneefo koko yɛ duru sɛ gyata.
english:
The wicked flee though no one pursues,
    but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

twi: Atuatewman nya sodifo pii,nanso onipa a ɔwɔ nhumu ne nimdeɛ ma mmara yɛ adwuma.
english:
When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers,
    but a ruler with discernment and knowledge maintains order.

twi: Sodifo a ɔhyɛ ahiafo so note sɛ osu mu ahum a ennyaw nnɔbae bi wɔ akyi.
english:
A ruler who oppresses the poor
    is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.

twi: Wɔn a wɔpo mmara no kamfo amumɔyɛfo,na wɔn a wodi mmara so no siw wɔn kwan.
english:
Those who forsake instruction praise the wicked,
    but those who heed it resist them.

twi: Abɔnefo nte atɛntrenee ase,nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, te ase yiye.
english:
Evildoers do not understand what is right,
    but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.

twi: Ohiani a ne nantew ho nni asɛmye sen ɔdefo a nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye.
english:
Better the poor whose walk is blameless
    than the rich whose ways are perverse.

twi: Nea odi mmara so yɛ ɔba a ɔwɔ nhumu,nanso nea ɔne adidibradafo bɔ no gu nʼagya anim ase.
english:
A discerning son heeds instruction,
    but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.

twi: Nea ogye mfɛntom mmoroso de nya ne ho no,ɔboaboa ano ma nea ɔbɛyɛ ahiafo adɔe.
english:
Whoever increases wealth by taking interest or profit from the poor
    amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.

twi: Sɛ obi nni mmara so a,ne mpaebɔ mpo yɛ akyiwade.
english:
If anyone turns a deaf ear to my instruction,
    even their prayers are detestable.

twi: Nea odi atreneefo anim de wɔn fa ɔkwan bɔne so nobɛhwe ɔno ankasa afiri mu,nanso wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no benya agyapade a eye.
english:
Whoever leads the upright along an evil path
    will fall into their own trap,
    but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.

twi: Ɔdefo tumi yɛ onyansafo wɔ nʼankasa ani so,nanso ohiani a ɔwɔ nhumu no hu sɛnea ɔte.
english:
The rich are wise in their own eyes;
    one who is poor and discerning sees how deluded they are.

twi: Sɛ atreneefo di nkonim a, nnipa di ahurusi pii;nanso sɛ amumɔyɛfo nya tumi a nnipa kohintaw.
english:
When the righteous triumph, there is great elation;
    but when the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding.

twi: Onipa a ɔkata ne bɔne so no nnya nkɔso,na nea ɔka ne bɔne na ogyae yɛ no nya ahummɔbɔ.
english:
Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper,
    but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

twi: Nhyira nka nea osuro Awurade bere nyinaa,nanso nea opirim ne koma no tɔ amane mu.
english:
Blessed is the one who always trembles before God,
    but whoever hardens their heart falls into trouble.

twi: Omumɔyɛfo a odi nnipa a wonni mmoa so note sɛ gyata a ɔbobɔ mu anaa sisi a nʼani abere.
english:
Like a roaring lion or a charging bear
    is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

twi: Ɔsodifo tirimɔdenfo nni adwene,na nea okyi mfaso a wɔnam ɔkwan bɔne so nya no benya nkwa tenten.
english:
A tyrannical ruler practices extortion,
    but one who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long reign.

twi: Nea awudi ma ne tiboa bu no fɔ nobɛyɛ ɔkobɔfo akosi ne wu da;wɔmma obiara nsiw no kwan.
Nea ne nantew ho nni asɛm no, wogye no fi ɔhaw mu,nanso nea nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye no bɛhwe ase mpofirim.
english:
The one whose walk is blameless is kept safe,
    but the one whose ways are perverse will fall into the pit.

twi: Nea ɔyɛ nʼasase so adwuma no benya aduan pii,nanso wɔn a wodi nnaadaasɛm akyi no benya wɔn so ne wɔn hia.
english:
Those who work their land will have abundant food,
    but those who chase fantasies will have their fill of poverty.

twi: Wobehyira onipa nokwafo pii,na nea ɔpere pɛ ahonyade no remfa ne ho nni.
english:
A faithful person will be richly blessed,
    but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.

twi: Nhwɛanim nye,nanso aduan kakraa bi nti nnipa bɛyɛ bɔne.
english:
To show partiality is not good—
    yet a person will do wrong for a piece of bread.

twi: Nea ɔyɛ pɛpɛe pere sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔdefona onnim sɛ ohia retwɛn no.
english:
The stingy are eager to get rich
    and are unaware that poverty awaits them.

twi: Nea ɔka obi anim no bɛsɔ nnipa ani akyiri noasen nea ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmadɛ.
english:
Whoever rebukes a person will in the end gain favor
    rather than one who has a flattering tongue.

twi: Nea ɔbɔ nʼagya anaa ne na korɔnna ɔka se, “Ɛnyɛ bɔne no,”ɔne ɔsɛefo na ɛbɔ.
english:
Whoever robs their father or mother
    and says, “It’s not wrong,”
    is partner to one who destroys.

twi: Odifudepɛfo de mpaapaemu bana nea ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no benya nkɔso.
english:
The greedy stir up conflict,
    but those who trust in the Lord will prosper.

twi: Nea ogye ne ho di no yɛ ɔkwasea,na nea ɔnantew nyansa mu no wobegye no.
english:
Those who trust in themselves are fools,
    but those who walk in wisdom are kept safe.

twi: Nea ɔma ahiafo no, hwee renhia no,nanso nea obu nʼani gu wɔn so no nya nnome pii.
english:
Those who give to the poor will lack nothing,
    but those who close their eyes to them receive many curses.

twi: Sɛ amumɔyɛfo nya tumi a, nnipa kohintaw;na sɛ amumɔyɛfo ase tɔre a, atreneefo ase dɔ.
english:
When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding;
    but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.

twi: Obi a ɔkɔ so yɛ tufoante wɔ animka pii akyi nowɔbɛsɛe no mpofirim a wɔrennya ano aduru.
english:
Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes
    will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.

twi: Sɛ atreneefo di yiye a, nnipa no di ahurusi;sɛ amumɔyɛfo di nnipa so a, wusi apini.
english:
When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice;
    when the wicked rule, the people groan.

twi: Onipa a ɔdɔ nyansa no ma nʼagya anigye,nanso nguamanfo yɔnko sɛe nʼahonya.
english:
A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father,
    but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

twi: Ɔhene nam atɛntrenee so ma ɔman no asomdwoe,nanso nea ɔde adifudepɛ gye adanmude no bɔ ɔman no.
english:
By justice a king gives a country stability,
    but those who are greedy for bribes tear it down.

twi: Obiara a ɔdaadaa ne yɔnko nosum ne nan afiri.
english:
Those who flatter their neighbors
    are spreading nets for their feet.

twi: Ɔdebɔneyɛni bɔne sum no afiri,nanso ɔtreneeni betumi ato dwom ama nʼani agye.
english:
Evildoers are snared by their own sin,
    but the righteous shout for joy and are glad.

twi: Ahiafo atɛntreneebu ho hia atreneefo,nanso amumɔyɛfo nni saa ɔtema no.
english:
The righteous care about justice for the poor,
    but the wicked have no such concern.

twi: Fɛwdifo de basabasayɛ ba kuropɔn mu,nanso anyansafo sianka abufuw.
english:
Mockers stir up a city,
    but the wise turn away anger.

twi: Sɛ onyansafo de ɔkwasea kɔ asennii a,ɔkwasea no bobɔ mu kasa di fɛw, na asomdwoe mma.
english:
If a wise person goes to court with a fool,
    the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.

twi: Mogyapɛfo kyi ɔnokwafo,na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wobekum nea ɔteɛ.
english:
The bloodthirsty hate a person of integrity
    and seek to kill the upright.

twi: Ɔkwasea da abufuw nyinaa adi,nanso onyansafo hyɛ ne ho so.
english:
Fools give full vent to their rage,
    but the wise bring calm in the end.

twi: Sɛ ɔsodifo tie nkontomposɛm a,nʼadwumayɛfo nyinaa bɛyɛ amumɔyɛfo.
english:
If a ruler listens to lies,
    all his officials become wicked.

twi: Ohiani ne ɔsohyɛfo nyinaa wɔ saa ade baako yi:Awurade ma wɔn baanu nyinaa ani a wɔde hu ade.
english:
The poor and the oppressor have this in common:
    The Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.

twi: Sɛ ɔhene di ahiafo asɛm yiye a,nʼahengua betim hɔ daa.
english:
If a king judges the poor with fairness,
    his throne will be established forever.

twi: Nteɛso abaa ma nyansa,na abofra a wɔde ne pɛ ma no no, gu ne na anim ase.
english:
A rod and a reprimand impart wisdom,
    but a child left undisciplined disgraces its mother.

twi: Sɛ amumɔyɛfo di yiye a, bɔne nso kɔ so,na atreneefo behu wɔn asehwe.
english:
When the wicked thrive, so does sin,
    but the righteous will see their downfall.

twi: Teɛ wo ba, na ɔbɛma wo asomdwoe;ɔbɛma wo kra ani agye.
english:
Discipline your children, and they will give you peace;
    they will bring you the delights you desire.

twi: Sɛ anisoadehu nni hɔ a nnipa no yɛ basaa;na nhyira nka nea odi mmara so.
english:
Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint;
    but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom’s instruction.

twi: Wɔmfa anom nsɛm kɛkɛ nteɛ ɔsomfo;ɔte ase de, nanso ɔremfa.
english:
Servants cannot be corrected by mere words;
    though they understand, they will not respond.

twi: Wuhu obi a ɔpɛ ntɛm kasa ana?Ɔkwasea wɔ anidaso sen no.
english:
Do you see someone who speaks in haste?
    There is more hope for a fool than for them.

twi: Sɛ obi kokɔ ne somfo fi ne mmofraase a,awiei no ɔde awerɛhow na ɛbɛba.
english:
A servant pampered from youth
    will turn out to be insolent.

twi: Onipa a ne bo afuw de mpaapaemu ba,na nea ne bo nkyɛ fuw no yɛ bɔne pii.
english:
An angry person stirs up conflict,
    and a hot-tempered person commits many sins.

twi: Onipa ahomaso brɛ no ase,nanso nea ɔwɔ ahobrɛase no nya anuonyam.
english:
Pride brings a person low,
    but the lowly in spirit gain honor.

twi: Nea ɔboa ɔkorɔmfo no haw ɔno ankasa ho.Wɔama waka ntam nti osuro sɛ obedi adanse.
english:
The accomplices of thieves are their own enemies;
    they are put under oath and dare not testify.

twi: Onipa ho suro betumi ayɛ afiri,na nea ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no, wobegye no.
english:
Fear of man will prove to be a snare,
    but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

twi: Bebree hwehwɛ sɛ wobenya ɔhene ne no akasa,nanso onipa nya atɛntrenee fi Awurade nkyɛn.
english:
Many seek an audience with a ruler,
    but it is from the Lord that one gets justice.

twi: Atreneefo kyi atorofo;na amumɔyɛfo kyi wɔn a wɔn akwan teɛ.
english:
The righteous detest the dishonest;
    the wicked detest the upright.

twi: Agur Nsɛm A ƆkaeYake babarima Agur nsɛm a ɔkae a ɛyɛ nkuranhyɛ:Saa ɔbarima yi ka kyerɛɛ Itiel ne Ukal se:
english:
The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh—an inspired utterance.
This man’s utterance to Ithiel:
“I am weary, God,
    but I can prevail.

twi: “Me na minnim hwee koraa wɔ nnipa mu,minni onipa ntease.
english:
Surely I am only a brute, not a man;
    I do not have human understanding.

twi: Minsuaa nyansa,na minni Ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ nso.
english:
I have not learned wisdom,
    nor have I attained to the knowledge of the Holy One.

twi: Hena na waforo akɔ ɔsoro na wasian aba fam?Hena na wabɔ mframa boa wɔ ne nsam?Hena na ɔde nʼatade abɔ nsu boa?Hena na ɔbɔɔ asase tamaa yi?Ne din de dɛn, na ne babarima nso din de dɛn?Sɛ wunim a ka kyerɛ me!
english:
Who has gone up to heaven and come down?
    Whose hands have gathered up the wind?
Who has wrapped up the waters in a cloak?
    Who has established all the ends of the earth?
What is his name, and what is the name of his son?
    Surely you know!

twi: “Onyankopɔn asɛm biara yɛ nokware;ɔyɛ nkatabo ma wɔn a woguan toa no.
english:
“Every word of God is flawless;
    he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

twi: Mfa biribi nka nʼasɛm ho,anyɛ saa a ɔbɛka wʼanim ama woayɛ ɔtorofo.
english:
Do not add to his words,
    or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.

twi: “Awurade, nneɛma abien na mehwehwɛ afi wo nkyɛn;mfa nkame me ansa na mawu:
english:
“Two things I ask of you, Lord;
    do not refuse me before I die:

twi: ma me ne atoro ne nnaadaasɛm ntam nware koraa;mma mennyɛ ohiani anaa ɔdefo;nanso ma me me daa aduan nkutoo.
Anyɛ saa a, ebia minya me ho pii a ɛbɛma mapa wona maka se, ‘Hena ne Awurade?’Anaa mɛyɛ ohiani na mabɔ korɔn,na ama magu me Nyankopɔn din ho fi.
english:
Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you
    and say, ‘Who is the Lord?’
Or I may become poor and steal,
    and so dishonor the name of my God.

twi: “Nsɛe ɔsomfo din nkyerɛ ne wura;sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɔbɛdome wo na wubetua so ka.
english:
“Do not slander a servant to their master,
    or they will curse you, and you will pay for it.

twi: “Nnipa bi dome wɔn agyanom,na wonhyira wɔn nanom nso;
english:
“There are those who curse their fathers
    and do not bless their mothers;

twi: Wɔn a wɔteɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa ani sonanso wɔnhohoroo wɔn ho fi no;
english:
those who are pure in their own eyes
    and yet are not cleansed of their filth;

twi: wɔn a wɔn ani tra ntɔn,na wobu animtiaa;
english:
those whose eyes are ever so haughty,
    whose glances are so disdainful;

twi: wɔn a wɔn se yɛ afoana asekan hyehyɛ wɔn abogye muwɔn na wɔbɛtɔre ahiafo ase afi asase so,na wɔayi ahiafo afi adesamma mu.
english:
those whose teeth are swords
    and whose jaws are set with knives
to devour the poor from the earth
    and the needy from among mankind.

twi: “Amemem wɔ mmabea baanua wɔteɛ mu se, ‘Fa ma! Fa ma!’ “Nneɛma abiɛsa na ɛmmee daanan na ɛnka da se, ‘Eye!’
english:
“The leech has two daughters.
    ‘Give! Give!’ they cry.
“There are three things that are never satisfied,
    four that never say, ‘Enough!’:

twi: Ɔda,obonin awotwaa,asase a ɛyɛ wosee daa,ne ogya a ɛnka da se, ‘Eye!’
english:
the grave, the barren womb,
    land, which is never satisfied with water,
    and fire, which never says, ‘Enough!’

twi: “Ani a eyi agya ahi,na ebu ɛna animtiaa no,obon mu kwaakwaadabi betutu,na apete abedi.
english:
“The eye that mocks a father,
    that scorns an aged mother,
will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley,
    will be eaten by the vultures.

twi: “Nneɛma abiɛsa na ɛyɛ me nwonwa,anan na mente ase:
english:
“There are three things that are too amazing for me,
    four that I do not understand:

twi: Ɔkwan a ɔkɔre nam so wɔ wim,sɛnea ɔwɔ nantew ɔbotan so,ɔkwan a hyɛn nam so wɔ po tamaa so,ne sɛnea ɔbarima dɔ ababaa.
english:
the way of an eagle in the sky,
    the way of a snake on a rock,
the way of a ship on the high seas,
    and the way of a man with a young woman.

twi: “Ɔbea ɔwaresɛefo kwan ni:Odidi, ɔpepa nʼanona ɔka se, ‘Menyɛɛ mfomso biara.’
english:
“This is the way of an adulterous woman:
    She eats and wipes her mouth
    and says, ‘I’ve done nothing wrong.’

twi: “Nneɛma abiɛsa na ɛma asase wosow,anan na asase ntumi nnyina ano:
english:
“Under three things the earth trembles,
    under four it cannot bear up:

twi: akoa a wabɛyɛ ɔhene,ɔkwasea a wadidi amee,
english:
a servant who becomes king,
    a godless fool who gets plenty to eat,

twi: ɔbea a wɔmpɛ no na waware,afenaa a otu nʼawuraa tena nʼanan mu.
english:
a contemptible woman who gets married,
    and a servant who displaces her mistress.

twi: “Nneɛma nketenkete anan na ɛwɔ asase so,nanso wɔyɛ anyansafo ankasa:
english:
“Four things on earth are small,
    yet they are extremely wise:

twi: Ntɛtea yɛ abɔde nketewa a wonni ahoɔden,nanso wɔboaboa wɔn aduan ano ahuhuru bere mu;
english:
Ants are creatures of little strength,
    yet they store up their food in the summer;

twi: Nkukuban yɛ abɔde a wonni ahoɔden,nanso wɔyɛ wɔn afi wɔ abotan mu,
english:
hyraxes are creatures of little power,
    yet they make their home in the crags;

twi: mmoadabi nni ɔhene,nanso wɔsa so akuwakuw, kɔ wɔn anim;
english:
locusts have no king,
    yet they advance together in ranks;

twi: wotumi de nsa kyere ɔketew,nanso wohu no abirɛmpɔn ahemfi.
english:
a lizard can be caught with the hand,
    yet it is found in kings’ palaces.

twi: “Nneɛma abiɛsa na wɔwɔ abirɛmpɔnnantew,anan na wɔkeka wɔn ho te sɛ abirɛmpɔn:
english:
“There are three things that are stately in their stride,
    four that move with stately bearing:

twi: gyata, mmoadoma hene a, biribiara mmɔ no hu;
english:
a lion, mighty among beasts,
    who retreats before nothing;

twi: akokɔnini a ɔretutu taataa,ɔpapo,ne ɔhene a nʼasraafo atwa no ho ahyia.
english:
a strutting rooster, a he-goat,
    and a king secure against revolt.

twi: “Sɛ woayɛ ɔkwasea ama wo ho so,anaa woadwene bɔne a,ma wʼani nwu na mua wʼano!
english:
“If you play the fool and exalt yourself,
    or if you plan evil,
    clap your hand over your mouth!

twi: Sɛnea wɔka nufusu nu mu a srade fi mu ba,na wokyinkyim hwene a etu mogya no,saa ara na abufuw de akasakasa ba.”
english:
For as churning cream produces butter,
    and as twisting the nose produces blood,
    so stirring up anger produces strife.”

twi: Ɔhene Lemuel NsɛmƆhene Lemuel nsɛm a ɛyɛ nkuranhyɛ a ne na kyerɛɛ no:
english: The sayings of King Lemuel—an inspired utterance his mother taught him.

twi: Tie, me babarima! Tie, me yafunu ba,Tie, me bɔhyɛ ba, me mpaebɔ ho mmuae!
english:
Listen, my son! Listen, son of my womb!
    Listen, my son, the answer to my prayers!

twi: Nsɛe wʼahoɔden wɔ mmea ho,wɔn a wogu ahemfo asu no.
english:
Do not spend your strength on women,
    your vigor on those who ruin kings.

twi: Enye mma ahemfo, Lemuel,asanom nye mma ahemfo,ɛnsɛ sɛ sodifo pere bobesa ho;
english:
It is not for kings, Lemuel—
    it is not for kings to drink wine,
    not for rulers to crave beer,

twi: sɛ wɔnom nsa a wɔn werɛ befi nea mmara no ka,na wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no rennya nea ɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa.
english:
lest they drink and forget what has been decreed,
    and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.

twi: Fa bobesa ma wɔn a wɔresɛe,na fa nsa ma wɔn a wɔwɔ amanehunu mu;
english:
Let beer be for those who are perishing,
    wine for those who are in anguish!

twi: Momma wɔnnom, na wɔn werɛ mfi wɔn hia,na wɔnnkae wɔn awerɛhow bio.
english:
Let them drink and forget their poverty
    and remember their misery no more.

twi: Kasa ma wɔn a wontumi nkasa mma wɔn ho,kasa ma mmɔborɔfo yiyedi.
english:
Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,
    for the rights of all who are destitute.

twi: Kasa na bu atɛntrenee;kasa ma ahiafo ne onnibi yiyedi.
english:
Speak up and judge fairly;
    defend the rights of the poor and needy.

twi: Awiei: Ɔyere A Ɔsom BoƆyere pa, hena na obenya?Ɔsom bo pa ara sen nhene pa.
english:
A wife of noble character who can find?
    She is worth far more than rubies.

twi: Ne kunu wɔ ne mu ahotoso pa ara,na biribiara a ɛwɔ bo nhia no.
english:
Her husband has full confidence in her
    and lacks nothing of value.

twi: Ɔde nea eye brɛ no, na ɛnyɛ ɔhaw,ne nkwanna nyinaa mu.
english:
She brings him good, not harm,
    all the days of her life.

twi: Ɔhwehwɛ oguannwi ne asaawana ɔde ne nsa nwen wɔ fɛw so.
english:
She selects wool and flax
    and works with eager hands.

twi: Ɔte sɛ aguadifo ahyɛn,ɔde ne nnuan fi akyirikyiri ba.
english:
She is like the merchant ships,
    bringing her food from afar.

twi: Ade nnya nkyee no na wasɔre;osiesie aduan ma nʼabusuafona ɔkyekyɛ nnwuma ma ne mmaawa.
Osusuw afuw ho na ɔtɔ;ofi nea onya mu yɛ bobeturo.
english:
She considers a field and buys it;
    out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

twi: Ɔde nsi yɛ nʼadwuma;nʼabasa mu wɔ ahoɔden ma nʼadwuma.
english:
She sets about her work vigorously;
    her arms are strong for her tasks.

twi: Ɔhwɛ sɛ nʼaguadi so wɔ mfaso,na ne kanea anum anadwo.
english:
She sees that her trading is profitable,
    and her lamp does not go out at night.

twi: Daa, na ne nsa kura tadua mua ne nsateaa nso retoatoa asaawa.
english:
In her hand she holds the distaff
    and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

twi: Ogow ne nsam ma ahiafona ne nsa so ohiani so.
english:
She opens her arms to the poor
    and extends her hands to the needy.

twi: Sɛ sukyerɛmma tɔ a ne yam nhyehye no wɔ ne fifo ho;efisɛ wɔn nyinaa wɔ adurade a wɔde ko awɔw.
english:
When it snows, she has no fear for her household;
    for all of them are clothed in scarlet.

twi: Ɔyɛ ne mpasotam;na ofura nwera ne sirikyi ntama.
english:
She makes coverings for her bed;
    she is clothed in fine linen and purple.

twi: Ne kunu wɔ anuonyam wɔ kuropɔn pon ano,faako a ɔne asase no so mpanyimfo tena.
english:
Her husband is respected at the city gate,
    where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.

twi: Ɔpempam nwera ntade tontɔn,na otu nkyekyeremu ma aguadifo.
english:
She makes linen garments and sells them,
    and supplies the merchants with sashes.

twi: Ɔwɔ ahoɔden ne anuonyam;na onsuro nna a ɛwɔ nʼanim.
english:
She is clothed with strength and dignity;
    she can laugh at the days to come.

twi: Ɔkasa nyansa mu,na nokware nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ne tɛkrɛma so.
english:
She speaks with wisdom,
    and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

twi: Ɔhwɛ ne fi mu nnwuma sona onnyigye anihaw so.
english:
She watches over the affairs of her household
    and does not eat the bread of idleness.

twi: Ne mma sɔre a wɔfrɛ no nhyira;ne kunu nso saa ara, na ɔkamfo no se,
english:
Her children arise and call her blessed;
    her husband also, and he praises her:

twi: “Mmea pii yɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ dinna wo de, wosen wɔn nyinaa.”
english:
“Many women do noble things,
    but you surpass them all.”

twi: Ɔbea kɔnnɔfo yɛ nnaadaa, na ahoɔfɛ twa mu ntɛm so;nanso ɔbea a osuro Awurade no fata nkamfo.
english:
Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting;
    but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.

twi: Fa abasobɔde a wanya no ma no,na wɔnkamfo ne nnwuma wɔ kuropɔn pon ano.
english:
Honor her for all that her hands have done,
    and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.

twi: ƆFA A EDI KANNnwom –Dwom Nhyira ne onipa aontie amumɔyɛfo afotuna onni nnebɔneyɛfo nhwɛso akyina ɔntena fɛwdifo tenabea.
english:
Blessed is the one
    who does not walk in step with the wicked
or stand in the way that sinners take
    or sit in the company of mockers,

twi: Na mmom, Awurade mmara sɔ nʼani,na osusuw ho awia ne anadwo.
english:
but whose delight is in the law of the Lord,
    and who meditates on his law day and night.

twi: Ɔte sɛ dua a wɔatɛw wɔ asuten ho,na ɛsow nʼaba ne bere mu anʼahaban no nguan da.Nea ɔyɛ biara yɛ yiye.
english:
That person is like a tree planted by streams of water,
    which yields its fruit in season
and whose leaf does not wither—
    whatever they do prospers.

twi: Nanso nnebɔneyɛfo nte saa;wɔte sɛ ntɛtɛ amframa bɔ gu.
english:
Not so the wicked!
    They are like chaff
    that the wind blows away.

twi: Enti amumɔyɛfo rentumi nnyina atemmu no ano,na nnebɔneyɛfo nso rentena atreneefo asafo mu.
english:
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
    nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

twi: Efisɛ Awurade kyerɛ ɔtreneeni kwannanso amumɔyɛfo kwan de, ɛbɛyera.
english:
For the Lord watches over the way of the righteous,
    but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.

twi: Dwom Adɛn nti na amanaman no hyehyɛ bɔne hona nnipa no bɔ pɔw hunu yi?
english:
Why do the nations conspire
    and the peoples plot in vain?

twi: Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyinana sodifo ka wɔn ho bɔ mutia Awurade ne Nea Wɔasra no no.
english:
The kings of the earth rise up
    and the rulers band together
    against the Lord and against his anointed, saying,

twi: Wɔka se,“Momma yemmubu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔnna yɛntow wɔn mpokyerɛ ngu.”
english:
“Let us break their chains
    and throw off their shackles.”

twi: Nea ɔte agua so wɔ ɔsoro no serew;Awurade di wɔn ho fɛw.
english:
The One enthroned in heaven laughs;
    the Lord scoffs at them.

twi: Afei ɔka wɔn anim wɔ nʼabufuw mu,hunahuna wɔn wɔ nʼabufuwhyew mu, ka se,
english:
He rebukes them in his anger
    and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

twi: “Masi me Henewɔ Sion, me bepɔw kronkron no so.”
english:
“I have installed my king
    on Zion, my holy mountain.”

twi: Mɛpae mu aka Awurade ahyɛde:Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woyɛ me Ba;nnɛ mayɛ wʼAgya.
Bisa me,na mede amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ wʼagyapade,asase ano nyinaa bɛyɛ wo de.
english:
Ask me,
    and I will make the nations your inheritance,
    the ends of the earth your possession.

twi: Wode dade ahempema bedi wɔn so;na woabobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwemfo ahina.”
english:
You will break them with a rod of iron;
    you will dash them to pieces like pottery.”

twi: Enti mo ahemfo, munsua nyansa;monkae kɔkɔbɔ yi, mo asase sodifo.
english:
Therefore, you kings, be wise;
    be warned, you rulers of the earth.

twi: Momfa osuro nsom Awuradena monsɛpɛw mo ho ahopopo mu.
english:
Serve the Lord with fear
    and celebrate his rule with trembling.

twi: Mumfew Ɔba no ano, na ne bo amfuwna mo akwan de mo bɛkɔ ɔsɛe mu,efisɛ nʼabufuwhyew tumi sɔre mpofirim.Nhyira ne wɔn a woguan toa no nyinaa.
english:
Kiss his son, or he will be angry
    and your way will lead to your destruction,
for his wrath can flare up in a moment.
    Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoe bere a ɔreguan afi ne babarima Absalom anim.Awurade, hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo dɔɔso fa!dodow no ara na wɔsɔre tia me!
english:
Lord, how many are my foes!
    How many rise up against me!

twi: Bebree no ara ka fa me ho se,“Onyankopɔn rennye no.”
english:
Many are saying of me,
    “God will not deliver him.”

twi: Nanso wo, Awurade, woyɛ nkatabo a atwa me ho ahyiamʼanuonyam, nea Ɔpagyaw me ti.
english:
But you, Lord, are a shield around me,
    my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

twi: Meteɛ mu su frɛ Awurade,na ogye me so fi ne bepɔw kronkron no so.
english:
I call out to the Lord,
    and he answers me from his holy mountain.

twi: Metɔ hɔ na meda a,minyan bio, efisɛ Awurade ma migyina.
english:
I lie down and sleep;
    I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

twi: Merensuro atamfo mpem mpem awɔatwa me ho ahyia no.
english:
I will not fear though tens of thousands
    assail me on every side.

twi: Sɔre, Awurade!Gye me, me Nyankopɔn!Bobɔ mʼatamfo nyinaa abogye;na tutu amumɔyɛfo se.
english:
Arise, Lord!
    Deliver me, my God!
Strike all my enemies on the jaw;
    break the teeth of the wicked.

twi: Awurade hɔ na ogye fi ba.Ma wo nhyira mmra wo nkurɔfo so.
english:
From the Lord comes deliverance.
    May your blessing be on your people.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so,me trenee Nyankopɔn.Ma me ɔhome wɔ mʼahohia mu;hu me mmɔbɔ na tie me mpaebɔ.
english:
Answer me when I call to you,
    my righteous God.
Give me relief from my distress;
    have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

twi: Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdan mʼanuonyam ahohora?Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdɔ nneɛma hunu na moadi ahoni ahuhuw akyi?
english:
How long will you people turn my glory into shame?
    How long will you love delusions and seek false gods?

twi: Hu sɛ Awurade ayi nea ɔwɔ nyamesu ama ne ho;Awurade betie, sɛ misu mefrɛ no a.
english:
Know that the Lord has set apart his faithful servant for himself;
    the Lord hears when I call to him.

twi: Sɛ mo bo fuw a, monnyɛ bɔne;sɛ modeda mo mpa so a,monyɛ komm na monhwehwɛ mo koma mu.
Mommɔ afɔre a ɛfatana momfa mo werɛ nhyɛ Awurade mu.
english:
Offer the sacrifices of the righteous
    and trust in the Lord.

twi: Nnipa bebree bisa se:“Hena na ɔde yiyeyɛ bɛbrɛ yɛn?”Awurade, ma wʼanim hann no nhyerɛn yɛn so.
english:
Many, Lord, are asking, “Who will bring us prosperity?”
    Let the light of your face shine on us.

twi: Fa anigye mmoroso hyɛ me koma mabere a wɔn aburow ne nsa foforo abu so no.
english:
Fill my heart with joy
    when their grain and new wine abound.

twi: Mɛtɔ hɔ, na mada asomdwoe mu,efisɛ wo nko ara, Awurade,na woma metena dwoodwoo.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nsɛmna dwen mʼapinisi ho.
english:
Listen to my words, Lord,
    consider my lament.

twi: Tie me mmoa ho sufrɛ,me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn,efisɛ wo na mebɔ wo mpae.
english:
Hear my cry for help,
    my King and my God,
    for to you I pray.

twi: Awurade, wote me nne anɔpa;anɔpa, mede mʼadesrɛ ba wʼanimna mede anidaso twɛn.
Wonyɛ Onyankopɔn a wʼani gye bɔne ho;na amumɔyɛfo rentumi ne wo ntena.
english:
For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness;
    with you, evil people are not welcome.

twi: Ahantanfo rentumi nnyina wʼanim;wukyi wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa.
Wosɛe wɔn a wɔka atosɛm;Awurade kyimogyapɛfo ne asisifo.
english:
you destroy those who tell lies.
The bloodthirsty and deceitful
    you, Lord, detest.

twi: Nanso me, wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe nti,mɛba wo fi;na nidi mu na mɛkotowakyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no.
english:
But I, by your great love,
    can come into your house;
in reverence I bow down
    toward your holy temple.

twi: Awurade kyerɛ me kwanwɔ wo trenee mumʼatamfo nti,bɔ wo kwan tee wɔ mʼanim.
english:
Lead me, Lord, in your righteousness
    because of my enemies—
    make your way straight before me.

twi: Wɔn anom asɛm baako mpo nyɛ nokware;ɔsɛe ahyɛ wɔn koma ma.Wɔn menewa yɛ ɔda a so abuewɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma ka nnaadaasɛm.
Onyankopɔn, bu wɔn fɔ!Ma wɔn pɔw bɔne nyɛ wɔn asehwe.Pam wɔn; esiane wɔn bɔne dodow no nti,efisɛ wɔasɔre atia wo.
english:
Declare them guilty, O God!
    Let their intrigues be their downfall.
Banish them for their many sins,
    for they have rebelled against you.

twi: Nanso ma wɔn a woguan ba wo nkyɛn no ani nnye;ma wɔmfa anigye nto dwom daa.Trɛw wo bammɔ mu wɔ wɔn so,na wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din noma wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu.
english:
But let all who take refuge in you be glad;
    let them ever sing for joy.
Spread your protection over them,
    that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

twi: Awurade, ampa ara, wuhyira atreneefo;na wode wʼayamye twa wɔn ho hyia sɛ nkatabo.
english:
Surely, Lord, you bless the righteous;
    you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw mu,na ntwe mʼaso nso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.
english:
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger
    or discipline me in your wrath.

twi: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ meyɛ mmrɛw;Awurade sa me yarena me nnompe wɔ ahoyeraw mu.
english:
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am faint;
    heal me, Lord, for my bones are in agony.

twi: Me kra wɔ ahohia mu.Enkosi da bɛn, Ao Awurade, enkosi da bɛn?
english:
My soul is in deep anguish.
    How long, Lord, how long?

twi: San bra, Awurade, na begye me nkwa;gye me, wo dɔ a enni nhuammɔ no nti.
english:
Turn, Lord, and deliver me;
    save me because of your unfailing love.

twi: Obi a wawu no renkae wo da,hena na ofi ɔda mu kamfo wo?
english:
Among the dead no one proclaims your name.
    Who praises you from the grave?

twi: Apinisi ama mayɛ mmerɛw.Anadwo mu nyinaa mede agyaadwotwa fɔw me mpa,na me nusu fɔw me sumii.
english:
I am worn out from my groaning.
All night long I flood my bed with weeping
    and drench my couch with tears.

twi: Awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ me kusuu.Ɛredum; mʼatamfo nyinaa nti.
english:
My eyes grow weak with sorrow;
    they fail because of all my foes.

twi: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo, montwe mo ho mfi me ho!efisɛ Awurade ate me sufrɛ.
english:
Away from me, all you who do evil,
    for the Lord has heard my weeping.

twi: Awurade ate me mmɔborɔsu;Awurade tie me sufrɛ.
english:
The Lord has heard my cry for mercy;
    the Lord accepts my prayer.

twi: Mʼatamfo nyinaa anim begu asena wɔn ho adwiriw wɔn;na wɔapatuw de fɛre asan wɔn akyi.
english:
All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish;
    they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

twi: Dwom Dawid adesrɛ dwom a Benyaminni Kus nsɛm nti ɔto maa Awurade.Awurade me Nyankopɔn,miguan toa wo;Gye me fi wɔn a wɔtaa me nyinaa nsam,
english:
Lord my God, I take refuge in you;
    save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

twi: anyɛ saa a wɔbɛtetew me mu sɛ gyatana wɔatetew me mu asinasin aobiara rentumi nnye me.
english:
or they will tear me apart like a lion
    and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

twi: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mayɛ eyina sɛ afɔdi aba me so a,
english:
Lord my God, if I have done this
    and there is guilt on my hands—

twi: sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia nea ɔne me te yiye,anaasɛ mabɔ me tamfo korɔn kwa a,
english:
if I have repaid my ally with evil
    or without cause have robbed my foe—

twi: ɛno de ma mʼatamfo ntaa me na wɔmmɛto me;ma wontiatia me so wɔ fam,na wɔmma me funu nna mfutuma mu.
Sɔre wɔ wʼabufuw mu, Awurade!Sɔre tia mʼatamfo abufuw.Nyan, me Nyankopɔn; hyɛ atɛntrenee mmara.
Ma nnipadɔm mmetwa wo ho nhyia.Fi ɔsoro hɔ di wɔn so;
english:
Let the assembled peoples gather around you,
    while you sit enthroned over them on high.

twi: ma Awurade mmu nnipa no atɛn.Bu me atɛn, Awurade sɛnea me trenee te,sɛnea me nokwaredi te, Ao, Ɔsorosoroni.
english:
Let the Lord judge the peoples.
Vindicate me, Lord, according to my righteousness,
    according to my integrity, O Most High.

twi: Onyankopɔn treneeni,wo a wohwehwɛ adwene ne koma mu,fa amumɔyɛfo basabasayɛ bra awieina ma atreneefo nnya bammɔ.
english:
Bring to an end the violence of the wicked
    and make the righteous secure—
you, the righteous God
    who probes minds and hearts.

twi: Me nkatabo ne Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔnnea ogye koma mu treneeni no.
english:
My shield is God Most High,
    who saves the upright in heart.

twi: Onyankopɔn yɛ otemmufo treneeni,Onyame a ɔda nʼabufuwhyew adi da biara.
english:
God is a righteous judge,
    a God who displays his wrath every day.

twi: Sɛ wansesa nʼadwene a,ɔbɛsew nʼafoa ano;obekuntun ne tadua na ɔde bɛmma ahyɛ mu.
Wasiesie nʼakode a ɛyɛ hu;ayɛ ne bɛmma a ɛredɛw no krado.
english:
He has prepared his deadly weapons;
    he makes ready his flaming arrows.

twi: Nea onyinsɛn amumɔyɛna basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma no, ɔwo nnaadaa.
english:
Whoever is pregnant with evil
    conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.

twi: Nea otu tokuru, na oyi mu dɔte nohwe tokuru a watu no mu.
english:
Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out
    falls into the pit they have made.

twi: Ɔhaw a ɔde ba no dan bɔ nʼankasa so;ne basabasayɛ bɔ nʼankasa ti so.
english:
The trouble they cause recoils on them;
    their violence comes down on their own heads.

twi: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade,ne trenee nti,na mato ayeyi dwom ayi Awurade, Ɔsorosoroni no din ayɛ.
english:
I will give thanks to the Lord because of his righteousness;
    I will sing the praises of the name of the Lord Most High.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, yɛn Awurade,wo din kɛseyɛ ada adi wiase mmaa nyinaa.Wode wʼanuonyamatimtim ɔsoro nohɔ,
english:
Lord, our Lord,
    how majestic is your name in all the earth!
You have set your glory
    in the heavens.

twi: mmofra ne nkokoaa mpo de wɔn anokamfo wo, wʼatamfo nti;na wode bɔ atamfo ne aweretɔfo ano.
english:
Through the praise of children and infants
    you have established a stronghold against your enemies,
    to silence the foe and the avenger.

twi: Sɛ mehwɛ wo ɔsorosoro,wo nsateaa ano adwuma;ɔsram ne nsoromma awode obiara asi nʼafa a,
english:
When I consider your heavens,
    the work of your fingers,
the moon and the stars,
    which you have set in place,

twi: onipa ne hena a wokae no,na onipa ba nso ne hena a wʼani ku ne ho?
english:
what is mankind that you are mindful of them,
    human beings that you care for them?

twi: Wobɔɔ no ma ɔyɛɛ akumaa kakra sen abɔfona wode wʼanuonyam ne nidi abɔ no abotiri.
english:
You have made them a little lower than the angels
    and crowned them with glory and honor.

twi: Woyɛɛ no ɔsodifo maa wo nsa ano nnwumawode nneɛma nyinaa ahyɛ nʼanan ase:
english:
You made them rulers over the works of your hands;
    you put everything under their feet:

twi: nguankuw ne anantwikuw nyinaane wuram mmoa nso,
english:
all flocks and herds,
    and the animals of the wild,

twi: wim nnomaane po mu mpataa,nea ɛnenam po mu akwan so nyinaa.
english:
the birds in the sky,
    and the fish in the sea,
    all that swim the paths of the seas.

twi: Awurade, yɛn Awurade,wo din yɛ kɛse wɔ asase nyinaa so!
english:
Lord, our Lord,
    how majestic is your name in all the earth!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, mefi me koma nyinaa mu ada wo ase.Mɛka wʼanwonwade no nyinaa.
english:
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart;
    I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

twi: Mɛma mʼani agye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo mu.Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din, Ɔsorosoroni.
english:
I will be glad and rejoice in you;
    I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.

twi: Mʼatamfo san wɔn akyi;wɔtetew hwe, na wowuwu wɔ wʼanim.
english:
My enemies turn back;
    they stumble and perish before you.

twi: Woadi mʼasɛm ama me, na menya mʼahofadi;woatena wʼahengua so, abu atɛntrenee.
english:
For you have upheld my right and my cause,
    sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.

twi: Woatwe amanaman no aso, na woasɛe amumɔyɛfo.Woapepa wɔn din a wɔrenkae wɔn bio.
english:
You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked;
    you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

twi: Ɔsɛe a enni awiei ato ɔtamfo no,woatutu wɔn nkuropɔn;na wɔnkae wɔn bio mpo.
Awurade di hene daa daa;wasi nʼatemmu ahengua.
english:
The Lord reigns forever;
    he has established his throne for judgment.

twi: Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛn;ɔde atɛntrenee bedi nnipa no so.
english:
He rules the world in righteousness
    and judges the peoples with equity.

twi: Awurade yɛ guankɔbea ma wɔn a wodi wɔn nya no,ɔyɛ abandennen wɔ ahohia mmere mu.
english:
The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed,
    a stronghold in times of trouble.

twi: Wɔn a wonim wo din no de wɔn ho bɛto wo so,efisɛ, wo Awurade, wunnyaw obiara a ɔhwehwɛ wo no mu da.
english:
Those who know your name trust in you,
    for you, Lord, have never forsaken those who seek you.

twi: Monto ayeyi dwom mma Awurade a ɔte ahengua so wɔ Sion;mompae mu nka nea wayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.
english:
Sing the praises of the Lord, enthroned in Zion;
    proclaim among the nations what he has done.

twi: Na ɔkae nea ɔtɔ mogya so were no;ommu nʼani ngu ɔbrɛfo sufrɛ so.
english:
For he who avenges blood remembers;
    he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.

twi: Awurade, hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo teetee me!Hu me mmɔbɔ na yi me fi owu apon ano,
english:
Lord, see how my enemies persecute me!
    Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

twi: na matumi apae mu aka wʼayeyiwɔ Ɔbabea Sion apon ano,na madi ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye no mu hɔ.
english:
that I may declare your praises
    in the gates of Daughter Zion,
    and there rejoice in your salvation.

twi: Amanaman mufo atɔ amoa a wɔatu no mu;afiri a wosum hintaw no ayi wɔn anan.
english:
The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug;
    their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

twi: Awurade atɛntrenee da no adi;amumɔyɛfo nsa ano adwuma ayi wɔn.
english:
The Lord is known by his acts of justice;
    the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo san kɔ ɔda mu,amanaman a wɔn werɛ fi Onyankopɔn nyinaa.
english:
The wicked go down to the realm of the dead,
    all the nations that forget God.

twi: Nanso ɛnyɛ daa na ne werɛ befi ohiani,anaasɛ mmɔborɔni anidaso bɛyera korakora.
english:
But God will never forget the needy;
    the hope of the afflicted will never perish.

twi: Sɔre! Awurade, mma ɔdesani nni nkonim,bu amanaman no atɛn wɔ wʼanim.
english:
Arise, Lord, do not let mortals triumph;
    let the nations be judged in your presence.

twi: Bɔ wɔn hu, Awurade;na ma wonhu sɛ, wɔyɛ adesa bi kɛkɛ.
english:
Strike them with terror, Lord;
    let the nations know they are only mortal.

twi: Dwom Adɛn, Awurade, na wugyina akyirikyiri saa?Adɛn na wode wo ho ahintaw wɔ amanehunu mmere mu yi?
english:
Why, Lord, do you stand far off?
    Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

twi: Omumɔyɛfo de ahantan taataa mmɔborɔfo,wɔn a ne nneyɛe mfiri yiyi wɔn no.
english:
In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak,
    who are caught in the schemes he devises.

twi: Ɔde nea ne koma hwehwɛ hoahoa ne ho;ohyira odifudepɛfo na oyi Awurade ahi.
english:
He boasts about the cravings of his heart;
    he blesses the greedy and reviles the Lord.

twi: Ahantan nti omumɔyɛfo nhwehwɛ Awurade;ne nsusuwii mu no Onyankopɔn nsi hwee.
english:
In his pride the wicked man does not seek him;
    in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

twi: Nʼakwan nyinaa mu odi yiye;ɔma ne ho so, na wo mmara mfa no ho;na odi nʼatamfo nyinaa ho fɛw.
Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se: “Hwee remma minhinhim;mʼani begye daa, na merenkɔ amanehunu mu da.”
english:
He says to himself, “Nothing will ever shake me.”
    He swears, “No one will ever do me harm.”

twi: Nnome, atoro ne ahunahuna ahyɛ nʼanom ma;Ɔhaw ne mmusu hyɛ ne tɛkrɛma ase.
english:
His mouth is full of lies and threats;
    trouble and evil are under his tongue.

twi: Ɔtɛw bɛn nkuraa no;ofi ahintawee kum nea onnim hwee,ohintaw hwɛ wɔn a ɔrehwehwɛ wɔn ayɛ wɔn bɔne no.
Ɔte sɛ gyata a wahintaw;ɔtɛw sɛ ɔbɛkyere mmɔborɔni;ɔkyere wɔn twe wɔn ase de wɔn kɔ ne bon mu.
Ɔdwerɛw wɔn a ɔkyere wɔn no ma wɔtɔ beraw;na ɔde nʼahoɔden ka wɔn hyɛ.
english:
His victims are crushed, they collapse;
    they fall under his strength.

twi: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se, “Onyankopɔn werɛ afi;wayi nʼani afi so na onhu.”
english:
He says to himself, “God will never notice;
    he covers his face and never sees.”

twi: Sɔre, Awurade! Ma wo nsa so, Onyankopɔn.Mma wo werɛ mfi wɔn a wonni aboafo.
english:
Arise, Lord! Lift up your hand, O God.
    Do not forget the helpless.

twi: Adɛn nti na omumɔyɛfo yi Onyankopɔn ahi?Adɛn nti na ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se,“Ɔremfrɛ me akontaabu so?”
english:
Why does the wicked man revile God?
    Why does he say to himself,
    “He won’t call me to account”?

twi: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wuhu amanehunufo haw;na wayɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛhwɛ.Mmɔborɔni de ne ho ma wo;wo na woyɛ ayisaa boafo.
Bubu omumɔyɛfo ne ɔbɔnefo aprɛw;frɛ no na ommebu nʼamumɔyɛ ho nkontaa,nʼamumɔyɛ a anka wɔrenhu no.
Awurade yɛ ɔhene daa nyinaa;amanaman no bɛyera nʼasase so.
english:
The Lord is King for ever and ever;
    the nations will perish from his land.

twi: Awurade, wutie mmɔborɔfo adesrɛ;wohyɛ wɔn nkuran, na wutie wɔn sufrɛ,
english:
You, Lord, hear the desire of the afflicted;
    you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

twi: na wudi ma ayisaa ne nea wɔhyɛ no so,sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdesani a ofi asase murenhunahuna bio.
english:
defending the fatherless and the oppressed,
    so that mere earthly mortals
    will never again strike terror.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade mu na mede me werɛ ahyɛ.Adɛn na wutumi ka kyerɛ me se,“Tu te sɛ anomaa kɔ wo bepɔw so.
english:
In the Lord I take refuge.
    How then can you say to me:
    “Flee like a bird to your mountain.

twi: Na hwɛ, amumɔyɛfo akuntun wɔn ta mu,na wɔde wɔn mmɛmma asisi ahama sosɛ wɔbɛtow wɔ sum mude awɔ koma mu ahotefo.
english:
For look, the wicked bend their bows;
    they set their arrows against the strings
to shoot from the shadows
    at the upright in heart.

twi: Sɛ wɔresɛe fapem no a,dɛn na ɔtreneeni betumi ayɛ?”
english:
When the foundations are being destroyed,
    what can the righteous do?”

twi: Awurade wɔ nʼasɔredan kronkron no mu;Awurade te ne soro ahengua so.Ɔhwɛ nnipa mma,nʼani hwehwɛ wɔn mu.
Awurade hwehwɛ ɔtreneeni mu,na amumɔyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔpɛ basabasayɛ de,ne kra kyi wɔn.
english:
The Lord examines the righteous,
    but the wicked, those who love violence,
    he hates with a passion.

twi: Ɔbɛtɔ ogyatannaa ne sufre a ɛredɛwagu amumɔyɛfo so;na mframa a mu yɛ hyew bɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa.
Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni,na ɔpɛ atɛntrenee;wɔn a wɔteɛ no behu nʼanim.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Boa yɛn, Awurade, na nyamesurofo asa;nokwafo ayera wɔ nnipa mu.
english:
Help, Lord, for no one is faithful anymore;
    those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.

twi: Obiara di atoro kyerɛ ne yɔnko;wɔn ano a ɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ no ka nnaadaasɛm.
Ma Awurade ntwa nnaadaa anone tɛkrɛma biara a ɛhoahoa ne ho nkyene;
english:
May the Lord silence all flattering lips
    and every boastful tongue—

twi: nea ɛka se, “Yɛde yɛn tɛkrɛma bedi nkonim;yɛn ano bedi ama yɛn, na hena na odi yɛn so tumi?”
“Esiane ɔhyɛ a wɔde hyɛ mmɔborɔnine ohiani apinisi no nti,mɛsɔre afei,” Awurade na ose.“Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi wɔn a wɔhaw wɔn no ho.”
english:
“Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan,
    I will now arise,” says the Lord.
    “I will protect them from those who malign them.”

twi: Awurade asɛm yɛ nokwarete sɛ dwetɛ a wɔasɔn so wɔ fononoo mu,na wɔahoa ho mpɛn ason.
english:
And the words of the Lord are flawless,
    like silver purified in a crucible,
    like gold refined seven times.

twi: Awurade, wobɛkora mmɔborɔnina woabɔ yɛn ho ban afi saa nnipa yi ho afebɔɔ.
english:
You, Lord, will keep the needy safe
    and will protect us forever from the wicked,

twi: Amumɔyɛfo nenam sɛnea wɔpɛ,bere a adesamma de nidi ma afide.
english:
who freely strut about
    when what is vile is honored by the human race.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade enkosi da bɛn? Wo werɛ befi me afebɔɔ ana?Enkosi da bɛn na wode wʼanim behintaw me?
english:
How long, Lord? Will you forget me forever?
    How long will you hide your face from me?

twi: Enkosi da bɛn na mene mʼadwennwene bedi apereperena awerɛhow ahyɛ me koma mu daa?Mʼatamfo nni me so nkonim nkosi da bɛn?
english:
How long must I wrestle with my thoughts
    and day after day have sorrow in my heart?
    How long will my enemy triumph over me?

twi: Twa wʼani hwɛ me na bua me, Awurade, me Nyankopɔn.Ma mʼani so nyɛ hann, na manna owu nna.
english:
Look on me and answer, Lord my God.
    Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,

twi: Me tamfo bɛka se, “Madi ne so nkonim.”Na mʼahohiahiafo bedi ahurusi bere a mahwe ase.
english:
and my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,”
    and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

twi: Nanso mede me ho to wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no so;me koma di ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye mu.
english:
But I trust in your unfailing love;
    my heart rejoices in your salvation.

twi: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade,efisɛ ɔne me adi no yiye.
english:
I will sing the Lord’s praise,
    for he has been good to me.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ɔkwasea ka wɔ ne koma mu se,“Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.”Wɔaporɔw, na wɔn nneyɛe yɛ fina wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.
english:
The fool says in his heart,
    “There is no God.”
They are corrupt, their deeds are vile;
    there is no one who does good.

twi: Awurade fi ɔsoro hwɛadesamma wɔ famsɛ obehu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ ntease,anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.
english:
The Lord looks down from heaven
    on all mankind
to see if there are any who understand,
    any who seek God.

twi: Nanso nnipa nyinaa atwe wɔn ho afi Onyankopɔn ho;wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne.Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.Ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
Enti abɔnefo rensua nyansa ana?Wɔwe me nkurɔfo te sɛnea nnipa di aduan.Wonnsu mfrɛ Awurade?
Nanso wonni, ehu akyekyere wɔn,efisɛ Onyankopɔn te wɔn a wɔteɛ mu.
english:
But there they are, overwhelmed with dread,
    for God is present in the company of the righteous.

twi: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo sɛe ahiafo nhyehyɛe,nanso, Awurade ne wɔn guankɔbea.
english:
You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor,
    but the Lord is their refuge.

twi: Ao, Israel nkwagye mfi Sion mmra!Awurade bɛsan de ne nkurɔfo agyapade ama wɔn.Na Yakob adi ahurusi, na Israel ani agye!
english:
Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion!
    When the Lord restores his people,
    let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, hena na ɔbɛtena wo kronkronbea ntamadan no mu?Hena na ɔbɛtena wo bepɔw kronkron no so?
english:
Lord, who may dwell in your sacred tent?
    Who may live on your holy mountain?

twi: Nea ne ho nni asɛmna ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ,nea ɔka nokware a efi ne koma mu
na ɔmfa ne tɛkrɛma nsɛe nnipanea ɔnyɛ ne yɔnko bɔnena ommu ne yɔnko nipa abomfiaa,
nea obu afideyɛni animtiaana ɔde nidi ma wɔn a wosuro Awurade,nea odi ne ntam so,bere a etia no mpo,
nea ɔde ne sika bɔ bosea a onnye nsihona onnye adanmude ntia nea odi bem.Nea ɔyɛ eyinom norenhinhim da.
english:
who lends money to the poor without interest;
    who does not accept a bribe against the innocent.
Whoever does these things
    will never be shaken.

twi: Dwom Dawid mpaebɔ.Bɔ me ho ban, me Nyankopɔn,na wo mu na minya guankɔbea.
english:
Keep me safe, my God,
    for in you I take refuge.

twi: Meka kyerɛɛ Awurade se,“MʼAwurade ne wo;minni ade pa biara ka wo ho.”
english:
I say to the Lord, “You are my Lord;
    apart from you I have no good thing.”

twi: Ahotefo a wɔwɔ asase no so de,wɔne anuonyamfo amʼanigye wɔ wɔn mu.
english:
I say of the holy people who are in the land,
    “They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.”

twi: Wɔn a wodi anyame afoforo akyi no,wɔn awerɛhow bɛdɔɔso.Merengu mogya nsa mma saa anyame nona meremfa mʼano mmɔ wɔn din.
english:
Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more.
    I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods
    or take up their names on my lips.

twi: Awurade, wode me kyɛfa ne me kuruwa ama me;woama me kyɛfa anya bammɔ.
english:
Lord, you alone are my portion and my cup;
    you make my lot secure.

twi: Mʼahye akɔdeda mmeae a eye ama me;ampa ara mewɔ agyapade a ho yɛ anigye.
english:
The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places;
    surely I have a delightful inheritance.

twi: Mɛkamfo Awurade a otu me fo;na anadwo mpo, me koma kyerɛkyerɛ me.
english:
I will praise the Lord, who counsels me;
    even at night my heart instructs me.

twi: Mihu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa.Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa nti, merenhinhim da.
english:
I keep my eyes always on the Lord.
    With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

twi: Ɛno nti, me kra ani gye, na mede me tɛkrɛma di ahurusi;me nipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoe mu,
english:
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices;
    my body also will rest secure,

twi: efisɛ, worennyaw me awufo mu.Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔw.
english:
because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead,
    nor will you let your faithful one see decay.

twi: Woakyerɛ me nkwagye kwan,na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim,na anigye a ɛrensa da wɔ wo nifa so.
Dwom Dawid Mpaebɔ.Awurade, tie me trenee abisade;tie me sufrɛ.Yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ;nea emfi nnaadaa anofafa mu.
english:
Hear me, Lord, my plea is just;
    listen to my cry.
Hear my prayer—
    it does not rise from deceitful lips.

twi: Ma me bembu mfi wo;ma wʼani nhu nea ɛyɛ pɛ.
english:
Let my vindication come from you;
    may your eyes see what is right.

twi: Wopɛɛpɛɛ me koma mu,wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo,na wosɔ me hwɛ de, nanso wubehu sɛ minsusuw bɔne bi ɛ;mʼano nkaa bɔne bi ɛ.
english:
Though you probe my heart,
    though you examine me at night and test me,
you will find that I have planned no evil;
    my mouth has not transgressed.

twi: Nnipa nneyɛe fam no,anom asɛm ntimatwe me ho afibasabasayɛfo akwan ho.
english:
Though people tried to bribe me,
    I have kept myself from the ways of the violent
    through what your lips have commanded.

twi: Menam wʼakwan so daa;me nan nhintiw ɛ.
english:
My steps have held to your paths;
    my feet have not stumbled.

twi: Misu mefrɛ wo, Onyankopɔnna wubegye me so;yɛ aso ma me na tie me mpaebɔ.
english:
I call on you, my God, for you will answer me;
    turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.

twi: Da wo dɔ nwonwaso no adi;wo a wode wo nsa nifagye wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no nkwafi wɔn atamfo nsam no.
english:
Show me the wonders of your great love,
    you who save by your right hand
    those who take refuge in you from their foes.

twi: Hwɛ me so sɛ obi a wodɔ no;fa me sie wo ntaban nwini no ase,
english:
Keep me as the apple of your eye;
    hide me in the shadow of your wings

twi: fi amumɔyɛfo a wɔretaataa me no nsam,mʼatamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.
english:
from the wicked who are out to destroy me,
    from my mortal enemies who surround me.

twi: Wopirim wɔn koma,na wɔkasa ahantan so.
english:
They close up their callous hearts,
    and their mouths speak with arrogance.

twi: Wɔadi me ntɛntɛ, afei wɔatwa me ho ahyia;wɔn ani abere sɛ wɔbɛbɔ me ahwe fam.
english:
They have tracked me down, they now surround me,
    with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

twi: Wɔte sɛ gyata a hanam ho kɔm de no,te sɛ gyata kɛse bi a wabutuw wɔ ahintawee.
english:
They are like a lion hungry for prey,
    like a fierce lion crouching in cover.

twi: Sɔre, Awurade!Wone wɔn mfa mmɔ ani na ka wɔn hyɛ;fa wʼafoa no gye me fi amumɔyɛfo no nsam.
english:
Rise up, Lord, confront them, bring them down;
    with your sword rescue me from the wicked.

twi: Awurade, fa wo nsagye me fi nnipa a wɔte sɛɛ nsam;asase so nnipa a wɔn akatua wɔ nkwa yi mu no.Womma ɔkɔm nne wɔn a wʼani ku wɔn ho;wɔn mmabarima wɔ bebree,na wɔkora agyapade ma wɔn mma.
english:
By your hand save me from such people, Lord,
    from those of this world whose reward is in this life.
May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies;
    may their children gorge themselves on it,
    and may there be leftovers for their little ones.

twi: Na me trenee mu, mehu wʼanim;sɛ minyan na mihu wo a me koma bɛtɔ me yam.
english:
As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face;
    when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

twi: Dwom Awurade akoa Dawid dwom. Ɔtoo saa dwom yi maa Awurade, bere a ogyee no fii nʼatamfo nyinaa ne Saulo nsam no.Medɔ wo, Awurade, mʼahoɔden.
english: I love you, Lord, my strength.

twi: Awurade ne me botantim;mʼaban ne me gyefo;me Nyankopɔn yɛ me botan.Ne mu na minya me hintabea.Ɔyɛ me nkatabo, me nkwagye abɛn ne mʼabandennen.
Misu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayeyi sɛ no,efisɛ ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam.
english:
I called to the Lord, who is worthy of praise,
    and I have been saved from my enemies.

twi: Owu nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kyekyeree me;na ɔsɛe asorɔkye bu faa me so.
english:
The cords of death entangled me;
    the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

twi: Ɔda mu hama kyekyeree me;mihyiaa owu mfiri.
english:
The cords of the grave coiled around me;
    the snares of death confronted me.

twi: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade.Misu frɛɛ me Nyankopɔn hwehwɛɛ mmoa.Ofi nʼasɔrefi hɔ tee me nne;me sufrɛ baa nʼanim, na ɛkɔɔ nʼasom.
Asase wosowee na ehinhimii,na mmepɔw fapem wosoweewosuroe, efisɛ na ne bo afuw.
Wusiw fii ne hwene mu;ogyaframa fii nʼanom,na nnyansramma dɛw fii mu.
Ofii ɔsoro baa fam;na omununkum kabii duruu nʼanan ase.
english:
He parted the heavens and came down;
    dark clouds were under his feet.

twi: Ɔte kerubim so tu kɔɔ soro;gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.
english:
He mounted the cherubim and flew;
    he soared on the wings of the wind.

twi: Ɔde sum kataa ne ho,osu a amuna tumm atwa ne ho ahyia.
english:
He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him—
    the dark rain clouds of the sky.

twi: Hann kɛse hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim,na omununkum a mparuwbo ne anyinam wɔ mu fii ne ho hyerɛn mu bae.
english:
Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced,
    with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

twi: Awurade bobɔɔ mu fii ɔsoro;Ɔsorosoroni no nne gyigyee bio.
english:
The Lord thundered from heaven;
    the voice of the Most High resounded.

twi: Ɔtow ne bɛmma no de bɔɔ atamfo no ahwete,ɔde anyinam a ano yɛn den pam wɔn.
english:
He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy,
    with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

twi: Po mu abon ho yiyiina asase nnyinaso ho daa hɔ,esiane wʼanimka ne ahomegu a efi wo hwene mu no nti,Awurade.
english:
The valleys of the sea were exposed
    and the foundations of the earth laid bare
at your rebuke, Lord,
    at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

twi: Ofi soro baa fam besoo me mu;ɔtwee me fii nsu a mu dɔ mu.
english:
He reached down from on high and took hold of me;
    he drew me out of deep waters.

twi: Ogyee me fii me tamfo hoɔdenfo nsam,wɔn a wɔn ani sa me, na wɔn ho yɛ den dodo ma me no.
english:
He rescued me from my powerful enemy,
    from my foes, who were too strong for me.

twi: Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu,nanso Awurade maa me so,
english:
They confronted me in the day of my disaster,
    but the Lord was my support.

twi: wode me baa baabi a hɔ trɛw;ogyee me, efisɛ nʼani sɔɔ me.
english:
He brought me out into a spacious place;
    he rescued me because he delighted in me.

twi: Awurade ne me adi no sɛnea me trenee te;wahwɛ me nsa a ho tew so atua me ka.
english:
The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness;
    according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

twi: Manantew Awurade akwan so.Mentwee me ho mfii me Nyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne ɛ.
english:
For I have kept the ways of the Lord;
    I am not guilty of turning from my God.

twi: Madi ne mmara nyinaa so:mimmuu nʼahyɛde so.
english:
All his laws are before me;
    I have not turned away from his decrees.

twi: Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim,na matwe me ho afi bɔne ho.
english:
I have been blameless before him
    and have kept myself from sin.

twi: Awurade agyina me treneeyɛne me nsa a ho tew wɔ nʼanim no so atua me ka.
english:
The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
    according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

twi: Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafo kyerɛ wɔn a wodi nokware,wɔn a wodi mu nso wokyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.
english:
To the faithful you show yourself faithful,
    to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

twi: Woyɛ kronkron ma wɔn a wɔyɛ kronkron,na amumɔyɛfo de, wukyi wɔn.
english:
to the pure you show yourself pure,
    but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

twi: Wugye ahobrɛasefo nkwa,na wobrɛ ahantanfo ase.
english:
You save the humble
    but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

twi: Awurade, woma me kanea hyerɛn.Yiw, woma me sum dan hann.
english:
You, Lord, keep my lamp burning;
    my God turns my darkness into light.

twi: Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me nti, mitumi ka asraafo gu;me Nyankopɔn nti, mitumi foro ɔfasu.
english:
With your help I can advance against a troop;
    with my God I can scale a wall.

twi: Onyankopɔn de, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ;Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu.Ɔyɛ nkataboma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ bammɔ wɔ ne mu.
Na hena na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ka Awurade ho?Hena na ɔyɛ Ɔbotan no? Gye sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn no.
english:
For who is God besides the Lord?
    And who is the Rock except our God?

twi: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma me ahoɔden,na ɔma me kwan yɛ pɛ.
english:
It is God who arms me with strength
    and keeps my way secure.

twi: Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforote de.Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.
english:
He makes my feet like the feet of a deer;
    he causes me to stand on the heights.

twi: Osiesie me ma ɔko,na me basa tumi kuntun kɔbere mfrafrae tadua.
english:
He trains my hands for battle;
    my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

twi: Wode wo ogye boa me nkatabo,na wo nsa nifa ma me gyina.Wobrɛ wo ho ase ma meyɛ ɔkɛse.
Woabɔ kwan tɛtrɛɛ ama mʼanansɛnea me nkotodwe rengurow.
english:
You provide a broad path for my feet,
    so that my ankles do not give way.

twi: Metaa mʼatamfo kɔtoo wɔn;mansan mʼakyi kosii sɛ mesɛee wɔn.
english:
I pursued my enemies and overtook them;
    I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

twi: Mɛdwerɛw wɔn, na wɔantumi ansɔre,wɔhwehwee ase wɔ mʼanan ase.
english:
I crushed them so that they could not rise;
    they fell beneath my feet.

twi: Wode akodi ahoɔden maa me;womaa mʼatamfo bɔɔ wɔn mu ase wɔ me nan ase.
english:
You armed me with strength for battle;
    you humbled my adversaries before me.

twi: Womaa mʼatamfo dan wɔn ho guanee,na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me.
english:
You made my enemies turn their backs in flight,
    and I destroyed my foes.

twi: Wosu hwehwɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammegye wɔn,wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, nanso wammua.
english:
They cried for help, but there was no one to save them—
    to the Lord, but he did not answer.

twi: Meyam wɔn sɛ mfutuma a mframa bɔ gu;mihwiee wɔn guu sɛ mmɔnten so dontori.
english:
I beat them as fine as windblown dust;
    I trampled them like mud in the streets.

twi: Woagye me afi nnipa no ɔfow mu,woayɛ me amanaman no ti;nnipa a minnim wɔn abɛyɛ mʼasomfo.
Wɔte me nka pɛ a, wɔyɛ osetie ma me;ananafo kotow mʼanim.
english:
foreigners cower before me;
    as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa botobotow;wofi wɔn abandennen mu ba ahopopo so.
english:
They all lose heart;
    they come trembling from their strongholds.

twi: Awurade te ase! Ayeyi nka me Botan!Wɔmma Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo no din so!
english:
The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock!
    Exalted be God my Savior!

twi: Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ were ma me,ɔno na ɔka amanaman hyɛ mʼase,
english:
He is the God who avenges me,
    who subdues nations under me,

twi: ɔno na ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam.Wopagyaw me sii mʼatamfo so,wugyee me fii basabasayɛfo nsam.
Ɛno nti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu, Ao Awurade.Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din.
english:
Therefore I will praise you, Lord, among the nations;
    I will sing the praises of your name.

twi: Wode nkonimdi akɛse ama wo hene;woda ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da adi kyerɛ nea woasra no ngo,wode kyerɛ Dawid, ne nʼasefo afebɔɔ.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Ɔsoro ka Onyankopɔn anuonyam!Wim pae mu ka ne nsa ano adwuma,
english:
The heavens declare the glory of God;
    the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

twi: Da biara, wɔkasa;anadwo biara, wɔda nimdeɛ adi.
english:
Day after day they pour forth speech;
    night after night they reveal knowledge.

twi: Wonni ɔkasa, wɔnnka nsɛm;wɔnnte wɔn nne.
english:
They have no speech, they use no words;
    no sound is heard from them.

twi: Wɔn nne akodu asase so mmaa nyinaa,na wɔn nsɛm nso akodu asase ano.Onyankopɔn asi ntamadan ama owia wɔ ɔsoro hɔ.
english:
Yet their voice goes out into all the earth,
    their words to the ends of the world.
In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.

twi: Ɛte sɛ ayeforokunu a ofi ne pia mu,te sɛ ɔbran a ne ho pere no sɛ obetu ne mmirika.
english:
It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,
    like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

twi: Epue wɔ ɔsoro fa baabina atwa ne ho akosi ano;biribiara nsiw ne hyew ho kwan.
Awurade mmara yɛ pɛ,ɛkanyan ɔkra no.Ahotoso wɔ Awurade nhyehyɛe mu,ɛma nea onnim nyansa hu nyansa.
english:
The law of the Lord is perfect,
    refreshing the soul.
The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy,
    making wise the simple.

twi: Awurade ahyɛde teɛ;ɛma koma mu anigye.Awurade ɔhyɛ nsɛm mu da hɔ;na ebue ani.
english:
The precepts of the Lord are right,
    giving joy to the heart.
The commands of the Lord are radiant,
    giving light to the eyes.

twi: Awurade suro yɛ kronkron,ɛte hɔ daa.Awurade mmara nsɛm yɛ nokwarena ne nyinaa teɛ.
english:
The fear of the Lord is pure,
    enduring forever.
The decrees of the Lord are firm,
    and all of them are righteous.

twi: Ɛsom bo sen sikakɔkɔɔɛsen sikakɔkɔɔ kann;ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo,ɛsen ɛwo a efi ɛwokyɛm mu.
english:
They are more precious than gold,
    than much pure gold;
they are sweeter than honey,
    than honey from the honeycomb.

twi: Wɔnam so bɔ wo somfo kɔkɔ se,sodi so akatua yɛ bebree.
english:
By them your servant is warned;
    in keeping them there is great reward.

twi: Hena na ohu nʼankasa mfomso?Fa me mfomso a ahintaw kyɛ me.
english:
But who can discern their own errors?
    Forgive my hidden faults.

twi: Bɔ wʼakoa ho ban fi ɔboayɛ bɔne ho,na anhyɛ me so.Ɛno na ɛbɛma madi bem,a merenni fɔ wɔ bɔne akɛse ho.
english:
Keep your servant also from willful sins;
    may they not rule over me.
Then I will be blameless,
    innocent of great transgression.

twi: Ma mʼanom nsɛm ne me koma mu adwenenyɛ nea ɛsɔ wʼani, Awurademe Botan ne me Gyefo.
english:
May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart
    be pleasing in your sight,
    Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade ntie wo wɔ wʼahohia mu;Yakob Nyankopɔn din mmɔ wo ho ban.
english:
May the Lord answer you when you are in distress;
    may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

twi: Ɔmfa mmoa mfi kronkronbea hɔ mmrɛ wo,na omfi Sion mmɛhyɛ wo den.
english:
May he send you help from the sanctuary
    and grant you support from Zion.

twi: Ɔnkae wʼafɔrebɔ nyinaa,na ɔmma wo hyew afɔre nsɔ nʼani.
english:
May he remember all your sacrifices
    and accept your burnt offerings.

twi: Ɔmma wo nea wo koma pɛ,na wo nhyehyɛe nyinaa nyɛ yiye.
english:
May he give you the desire of your heart
    and make all your plans succeed.

twi: Yɛbɛbɔ ose bere a woadi nkonim,na yɛama yɛn frankaa so wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn din mu.Awurade nyɛ wʼabisade nyinaa mma wo.
english:
May we shout for joy over your victory
    and lift up our banners in the name of our God.
May the Lord grant all your requests.

twi: Afei mahu sɛ Awurade ma nea wasra no no nkonimdi,ofi ne kronkronbea wɔ ɔsoro gye no so,ɔde ne nkonimdi tumi a ɛwɔ ne nsa nifa mu no.
english:
Now this I know:
    The Lord gives victory to his anointed.
He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary
    with the victorious power of his right hand.

twi: Ebinom de wɔn ho to wɔn nteaseɛnam sona afoforo nso, wɔn apɔnkɔ so,nanso yɛn de, yɛde yɛn ho to Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn din so.
english:
Some trust in chariots and some in horses,
    but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.

twi: Wɔbrɛ wɔn ase ma wɔhwehwe ase,na yɛn de, yɛsɔre gyina kirebenn.
english:
They are brought to their knees and fall,
    but we rise up and stand firm.

twi: Awurade, ma ɔhene nkonimdi!Yɛfrɛ a, gye yɛn so!
english:
Lord, give victory to the king!
    Answer us when we call!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, ɔhene di anigye wɔ wʼahoɔden mu.Nʼani gye mmoroso wɔ nkonimdi a woma no nti!
english:
The king rejoices in your strength, Lord.
    How great is his joy in the victories you give!

twi: Woama no nea ne koma pɛ;woamfa nʼabisade ankame no.
english:
You have granted him his heart’s desire
    and have not withheld the request of his lips.

twi: Wode nhyira a edi mu hyiaa nona wode sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa ahenkyɛw hyɛɛ no.
english:
You came to greet him with rich blessings
    and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

twi: Obisaa wo hɔ nkwa, na wode maa no,nna tenten a enni awiei.
english:
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him—
    length of days, for ever and ever.

twi: Nkonimdi a woma no nti, nʼanuonyam so;wode kɛseyɛ ne nidi adom no.
english:
Through the victories you gave, his glory is great;
    you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

twi: Ampa ara, woama no nhyira a ɛnsa dana woama no ahosɛpɛw wɔ wʼanim anigye mu.
english:
Surely you have granted him unending blessings
    and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

twi: Ɔhene no de ne ho to Awurade so;Ɔsorosoroni no nokware dɔ no nti,ɔrenhinhim.
Wo nsa bɛka wʼatamfo nyinaa;wo nsa nifa beso wɔn a wokyi wo no mu.
english:
Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies;
    your right hand will seize your foes.

twi: Bere a wubeyi wo ho adi nowobɛyɛ wɔn sɛ fononoo a mu adɔ.Awurade fi nʼabufuwhyew mu bɛmene wɔn,na ne gya no ahyew wɔn.
english:
When you appear for battle,
    you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace.
The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath,
    and his fire will consume them.

twi: Wobɛtɔre wɔn ase wɔ asase so,na wɔn asefo afi adesamma mu.
english:
You will destroy their descendants from the earth,
    their posterity from mankind.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔbɔ pɔw tia wona wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe bɔne, nanso wɔrenni nkonim;
english:
Though they plot evil against you
    and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.

twi: efisɛ wobɛma wɔasan wɔn akyibere a woatwe bɛmma akyerɛ wɔn so no.
english:
You will make them turn their backs
    when you aim at them with drawn bow.

twi: Yɛma wo so, Awurade, wɔ wʼahoɔden mu;yɛbɛto nnwom na yɛakamfo wo kɛseyɛ.
english:
Be exalted in your strength, Lord;
    we will sing and praise your might.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, adɛn nti na woagyaw me?Adɛn nti na me nkwagye ne wo ntam aware,adɛn na mʼapinisi nsɛm ne wo ntam aware?
english:
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
    Why are you so far from saving me,
    so far from my cries of anguish?

twi: Me Nyankopɔn, misu frɛ wo awia, nanso wunnye me so,mefrɛ wo anadwo, nanso minnya ɔhome.
english:
My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer,
    by night, but I find no rest.

twi: Nanso wɔasi wo hene sɛ Ɔkronkronni;wo na Israel kamfo wo.
english:
Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One;
    you are the one Israel praises.

twi: Wo mu na yɛn agyanom de wɔn werɛ hyɛe;wogyee wo dii, na wugyee wɔn.
english:
In you our ancestors put their trust;
    they trusted and you delivered them.

twi: Wosu frɛɛ wo na wugyee wɔn,wɔde wɔn ho too wo so na woanni wɔn nhuammɔ.
english:
To you they cried out and were saved;
    in you they trusted and were not put to shame.

twi: Nanso meyɛ osunson, na menyɛ onipannipa bɔ me ahohora na wobu me animtiaa.
english:
But I am a worm and not a man,
    scorned by everyone, despised by the people.

twi: Obiara a ohu me di me ho fɛw;wotwa me adapaa, wosow wɔn ti ka se:
english:
All who see me mock me;
    they hurl insults, shaking their heads.

twi: “Ɔde ne ho to Awurade so;ma Awurade mmegye no.Ma ɔmmɛboa no,efisɛ ɔwɔ no mu anigye.”
english:
“He trusts in the Lord,” they say,
    “let the Lord rescue him.
Let him deliver him,
    since he delights in him.”

twi: Wo na wuyii me fii awotwaa mu baena womaa me de me ho too wo sobere a mitua me na nufu ano mpo.
english:
Yet you brought me out of the womb;
    you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.

twi: Efi mʼawo mu na wɔde me too wo so;efi me na yafunu mu, woayɛ me Nyankopɔn.
english:
From birth I was cast on you;
    from my mother’s womb you have been my God.

twi: Ntwe wo ho mfi me ho!Efisɛ amane abɛnna ɔboafo nni baabi.
english:
Do not be far from me,
    for trouble is near
    and there is no one to help.

twi: Anantwinini bebree atwa me ho ahyia;Basan anantwinini a wɔn ho yɛ den atwa me ho ahyia.
english:
Many bulls surround me;
    strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

twi: Gyata a wɔbobɔ mu na wɔtetew wɔn hanam muabuebue wɔn anom tɛtrɛɛ de kyerɛ me.
english:
Roaring lions that tear their prey
    open their mouths wide against me.

twi: Wɔahwie me agu sɛ nsu,na me nnompe nyinaa ahodwow.Me koma adan amane;anan wɔ me mu.
english:
I am poured out like water,
    and all my bones are out of joint.
My heart has turned to wax;
    it has melted within me.

twi: Mʼanom ayow te sɛ kyɛmfɛre mu.Na me tɛkrɛma atare mʼanom.Wode me to owu mfutuma mu.
Akraman atwa me ho ahyia,nnebɔneyɛfo kuw atwa me ahyia,wɔahwirew me nsa ne mʼanan mu.
Me nnompe nyinaa gu petee mu;Mʼatamfo hwɛ me haa na wɔserew me.
english:
All my bones are on display;
    people stare and gloat over me.

twi: Wɔkyɛ me atade mu fa,na wɔbɔ me ntama so ntonto.
english:
They divide my clothes among them
    and cast lots for my garment.

twi: Na wo, Awurade, ntwe wo ho;wone mʼahoɔden, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.
english:
But you, Lord, do not be far from me.
    You are my strength; come quickly to help me.

twi: Gye me kra fi afoa ano;gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no fi akraman tumi ase.
english:
Deliver me from the sword,
    my precious life from the power of the dogs.

twi: Gye me nkwa fi gyata anom;gye me fi ɛko mmɛn so.
english:
Rescue me from the mouth of the lions;
    save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

twi: Mɛbɔ wo din akyerɛ me nuanom;mɛkamfo wo wɔ wɔn a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.
english:
I will declare your name to my people;
    in the assembly I will praise you.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a musuro no no!Mo a moyɛ Yakob asefo, monhyɛ no anuonyam!Mo Israel asefo nyinaa, munni no ni!
english:
You who fear the Lord, praise him!
    All you descendants of Jacob, honor him!
    Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

twi: Ommuu nʼani nguuɔmanehunufo ateetee so ɛ,ɔmfaa nʼanim nhintaw no;na mmom watie ne sufrɛ a ɔde rehwehwɛ mmoa no.
english:
For he has not despised or scorned
    the suffering of the afflicted one;
he has not hidden his face from him
    but has listened to his cry for help.

twi: Me botae a mede yi wo ayɛ wɔ bagua mu no fi wo;medi me bɔhyɛ so wɔ wɔn a wosuro wo no anim.
english:
From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly;
    before those who fear you I will fulfill my vows.

twi: Ahiafo bedidi na wɔamee;wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade beyi no ayɛ,mo koma nnya nkwa daa.
Asase ano nyinaabɛkae akɔ Awurade nkyɛn,na amanaman no mmusua nyinaabɛkotow nʼanim,
english:
All the ends of the earth
    will remember and turn to the Lord,
and all the families of the nations
    will bow down before him,

twi: efisɛ tumi wɔ Awuradena odi amanaman so hene.
english:
for dominion belongs to the Lord
    and he rules over the nations.

twi: Asase so adefo nyinaa bedidi na wɔasɔre no;wɔn a wɔkɔ dɔte mu nyinaa bebu nkotodwe nʼanim,wɔn a wɔrentumi mma nkwa mu.
Nkyirimma nyinaa bɛsom no;wɔbɛka Awurade ho asɛm akyerɛ awo ntoatoaso a edidi so.
english:
Posterity will serve him;
    future generations will be told about the Lord.

twi: Wɔbɛka ne trenee akyerɛnnipa a wonnya nwoo wɔnefisɛ ɔno na wayɛ.
english:
They will proclaim his righteousness,
    declaring to a people yet unborn:
    He has done it!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade ne me hwɛfo, hwee renhia me.
english: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

twi: Ɔma meda wura frɔmfrɔm adidibea;ogya me kɔ nsu a ɛho dwo ho,
english:
He makes me lie down in green pastures,
he leads me beside quiet waters,

twi: odwudwo me kra.Ɔde me fa akwantrenee so,ne din nti.
english:
he refreshes my soul.
He guides me along the right paths
    for his name’s sake.

twi: Sɛ menamowu sum kabii mu mpo a,minsuro bɔne bi,efisɛ wo ne me na ɛwɔ hɔ;wʼabaa ne wo pemana ɛkyekye me werɛ.
english:
Even though I walk
    through the darkest valley,
I will fear no evil,
    for you are with me;
your rod and your staff,
    they comfort me.

twi: Woto me pon wɔmʼatamfo anim.Wode ngo fɔw me tirim;me kuruwa yɛ ma bu so.
english:
You prepare a table before me
    in the presence of my enemies.
You anoint my head with oil;
    my cup overflows.

twi: Yiye ne adɔe nko na ebedi mʼakyime nkwanna nyinaa;na mɛtena Awurade fidaa.
english:
Surely your goodness and love will follow me
    all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in the house of the Lord
    forever.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade de;wiase ne wɔn a wɔte mu nyinaa wɔ no;
english:
The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it,
    the world, and all who live in it;

twi: efisɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem wɔ po sona ɔde sii nsu ani.
english:
for he founded it on the seas
    and established it on the waters.

twi: Hena na obetumi aforo Awurade bepɔw no?Hena na obetumi agyina ne tenabea kronkron hɔ?
english:
Who may ascend the mountain of the Lord?
    Who may stand in his holy place?

twi: Nea ɔyɛ ade trenee na ne koma mu tew,nea ne kra nni ahoni akyina ɔnka ntamhunu.
english:
The one who has clean hands and a pure heart,
    who does not trust in an idol
    or swear by a false god.

twi: Obenya Awurade nsam nhyirane bembu a efi ne Nkwagye Nyankopɔn.
english:
They will receive blessing from the Lord
    and vindication from God their Savior.

twi: Saa na awo ntoatoaso a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no tewɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wʼanim no, Yakob Nyankopɔn.
english:
Such is the generation of those who seek him,
    who seek your face, God of Jacob.

twi: Mo aponkɛse, momma mo ti so;wɔmma mo so, mo tete apon,na Anuonyam Hene nhyɛn mu.
Hena ne saa Anuonyam Hene yi?Ɔno ne Awurade hoɔdenfo ne otumfo noAwurade a ɔyɛ ɔko mu nkonimdifo.
english:
Who is this King of glory?
    The Lord strong and mighty,
    the Lord mighty in battle.

twi: Momma mo ti so, mo aponkɛsemomma wɔn so, mo tete apon,na anuonyam Hene no nkɔ mu.
Hena ne saa anuonyam Hene yi?Asafo Awurade no,ɔno ne anuonyam Hene no.
english:
Who is he, this King of glory?
    The Lord Almighty—
    he is the King of glory.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, me Nyankopɔn, wo mu na mede me werɛ hyɛ.
english:
In you, Lord my God,
    I put my trust.

twi: Wo so, me Nyankopɔn, na mede me ho to,mma mʼanim ngu ase,na mma mʼatamfo nso nni me so nkonim.
