Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no mu biaraanim rengu ase da,mmom, wɔn a wɔyɛ kɔntɔnkye kwa noanim begu ase.
english:
No one who hopes in you
    will ever be put to shame,
but shame will come on those
    who are treacherous without cause.

twi: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade,na minhu wʼatempɔn.
english:
Show me your ways, Lord,
    teach me your paths.

twi: Fa wo nokware no so kyerɛkyerɛ me,efisɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo,na mʼani da wo so daa nyinaa.
Kae, Awurade, wo mmɔborɔhunu ne wo dɔ kɛsea ɛwɔ hɔ fi tete no.
english:
Remember, Lord, your great mercy and love,
    for they are from of old.

twi: Nkae me mmabun bere mu bɔnene mʼatuatew akwan;kae me sɛnea wʼadɔe te,Awurade, efisɛ wuye.
english:
Do not remember the sins of my youth
    and my rebellious ways;
according to your love remember me,
    for you, Lord, are good.

twi: Awurade ye na ɔteɛ;enti ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfo nʼakwan.
english:
Good and upright is the Lord;
    therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

twi: Ɔde ahobrɛasefo fa ɔkwan pa sona ɔkyerɛ wɔn nʼapɛde.
english:
He guides the humble in what is right
    and teaches them his way.

twi: Awurade akwan nyinaa yɛ ɔdɔ ne nokwaredima wɔn a wodi nʼapam mu ahyɛde so.
english:
All the ways of the Lord are loving and faithful
    toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.

twi: Awurade, me bɔne so de,nanso wo din nti, fa kyɛ me.
english:
For the sake of your name, Lord,
    forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

twi: Enti hena ne onipa a osuro Awurade?Ɔbɛkyerɛ no ɔkwan a wabɔ ama no.
english:
Who, then, are those who fear the Lord?
    He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.

twi: Obedi yiye wɔ ne nkwanna mu,na nʼasefo afa asase no sɛ wɔn agyapade.
english:
They will spend their days in prosperity,
    and their descendants will inherit the land.

twi: Awurade da nʼatirimsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wosuro no;na ɔma wohu nʼapam.
english:
The Lord confides in those who fear him;
    he makes his covenant known to them.

twi: Mʼani da Awurade so daa,efisɛ ɔno nko ara na obeyi mʼanan afi afiri mu.
english:
My eyes are ever on the Lord,
    for only he will release my feet from the snare.

twi: Dan wʼani hwɛ me, na dom me,efisɛ meyɛ ankonam na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.
english:
Turn to me and be gracious to me,
    for I am lonely and afflicted.

twi: Me koma mu dadwen adɔɔso;yi me dadwen fi me so.
english:
Relieve the troubles of my heart
    and free me from my anguish.

twi: Hwɛ me haw ne mʼahohiahiana yi me bɔne nyinaa fi me so.
english:
Look on my affliction and my distress
    and take away all my sins.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo adɔɔsone ɔtan kɛse a wɔde tan me!
english:
See how numerous are my enemies
    and how fiercely they hate me!

twi: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban na gye me;mma mʼanim ngu ase,efisɛ me guankɔbea ne wo.
Ma trenee ne nokware mmɔ me ho ban,efisɛ mʼani da wo so.
english:
May integrity and uprightness protect me,
    because my hope, Lord, is in you.

twi: Gye Israel, Onyankopɔn,fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.
english:
Deliver Israel, O God,
    from all their troubles!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Bu me bem, Awurade,efisɛ, mabɔ bra a asɛm nni ho:mede me ho too Awurade sona manhinhim.
english:
Vindicate me, Lord,
    for I have led a blameless life;
I have trusted in the Lord
    and have not faltered.

twi: Sɔ me hwɛ, Awurade,hwehwɛ me koma ne mʼadwene mu.
english:
Test me, Lord, and try me,
    examine my heart and my mind;

twi: Wʼadɔe wɔ mʼanim daana mɛnantew wo nokware mu.
english:
for I have always been mindful of your unfailing love
    and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.

twi: Me ne nnaadaafo ntenana me ne nyaatwomfo nso nni hwee yɛ.
english:
I do not sit with the deceitful,
    nor do I associate with hypocrites.

twi: Mikyi nnebɔneyɛfo guabɔna mempɛ sɛ me ne amumɔyɛfo tena.
english:
I abhor the assembly of evildoers
    and refuse to sit with the wicked.

twi: Mehohoro me nsa wɔ bembu mu,na mekɔ wʼafɔremuka ho ahyia, Awurade,
english:
I wash my hands in innocence,
    and go about your altar, Lord,

twi: na mepae mu ka wʼayeyina meka wʼanwonwade nyinaa.
english:
proclaiming aloud your praise
    and telling of all your wonderful deeds.

twi: Mʼani gye ofi a wote mu ho, Awurade,faako a wʼanuonyam wɔ no.
english:
Lord, I love the house where you live,
    the place where your glory dwells.

twi: Mfa me kra nka nnebɔneyɛfo de ho nkɔ,ne me nkwa nka mogyapɛfo de ho,
english:
Do not take away my soul along with sinners,
    my life with those who are bloodthirsty,

twi: wɔn a amumɔyɛ nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn nsamna adanmude ayɛ wɔn nsa nifa ma.
english:
in whose hands are wicked schemes,
    whose right hands are full of bribes.

twi: Nanso mebɔ ɔbra a ho tew;hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me nkwa.
english:
I lead a blameless life;
    deliver me and be merciful to me.

twi: Mʼanan sisi asase tamaa so;na guabɔ kɛse ase na mɛkamfo Awurade.
english:
My feet stand on level ground;
    in the great congregation I will praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade ne me hann ne me nkwagye;hena na minsuro no?Awurade ne me nkwa ahoɔden,na hena anim na me ho mpopo?
english:
The Lord is my light and my salvation—
    whom shall I fear?
The Lord is the stronghold of my life—
    of whom shall I be afraid?

twi: Sɛ nnipa bɔne bɔ toa mepɛ sɛ wokum me,sɛ mʼatamfo tow hyɛ me so a,wobehintihintiw ahwehwe ase.
english:
When the wicked advance against me
    to devour me,
it is my enemies and my foes
    who will stumble and fall.

twi: Sɛ dɔm mpo twa me ho hyia a,me koma rentu;mpo sɛ wotu me so sa a,ɛno mu koraa na minya awerehyɛmu.
english:
Though an army besiege me,
    my heart will not fear;
though war break out against me,
    even then I will be confident.

twi: Ade baako na mibisa Awurade;na ɛno na mehwehwɛ;sɛ mɛtena Awurade fime nkwanna nyinaa,na mahwɛ Awurade ahoɔfɛna mahwehwɛ no wɔ nʼasɔrefi.
english:
One thing I ask from the Lord,
    this only do I seek:
that I may dwell in the house of the Lord
    all the days of my life,
to gaze on the beauty of the Lord
    and to seek him in his temple.

twi: Hiada mu no,ɔde me besie nʼatenae dwoodwoo;ɔbɛkora me wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan kronkron muɔde me si ɔbotan so wɔ sorosoro.
english:
For in the day of trouble
    he will keep me safe in his dwelling;
he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent
    and set me high upon a rock.

twi: Afei ɔbɛma me ti sowɔ atamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so;mede anigye bɛbɔ afɔre wɔ nʼAhyiae Ntamadan mu;na mɛto dwom, ahyehyɛ nnwom ama Awurade.
Awurade, sɛ misu frɛ wo a, tie me!Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me so!
english:
Hear my voice when I call, Lord;
    be merciful to me and answer me.

twi: Me koma ka wɔ wo ho se, “Hwehwɛ nʼanim!”Wʼanim, Awurade na mɛhwehwɛ.
english:
My heart says of you, “Seek his face!”
    Your face, Lord, I will seek.

twi: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw me,mfa abufuw mpam wo somfome boafo ne wo.Mpo me, na nnyaw me,mʼAgyenkwa Nyankopɔn.
english:
Do not hide your face from me,
    do not turn your servant away in anger;
    you have been my helper.
Do not reject me or forsake me,
    God my Savior.

twi: Mʼagya ne me na begyaw me hɔ de,nanso Awurade begye me.
english:
Though my father and mother forsake me,
    the Lord will receive me.

twi: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade;fa me fa ɔkwan tee so,me nhyɛsofo nti.
Nnyaa me mma sɛnea mʼatamfo pɛ,nnansekurumfo sɔre tia mena wopuw awurukasɛm.
Meda so wɔ saa anidaso yi sɛ:mehu Awurade ayamyewɔ ateasefo asase so.
english:
I remain confident of this:
    I will see the goodness of the Lord
    in the land of the living.

twi: Twɛn Awurade.Hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duruna twɛn Awurade.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Wo na misu frɛ wo,Awurade me Botan;nsiw wʼaso wɔ me ho.Sɛ woyɛ komm a,mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔasian kɔ amoa mu no.
english:
To you, Lord, I call;
    you are my Rock,
    do not turn a deaf ear to me.
For if you remain silent,
    I will be like those who go down to the pit.

twi: Tie me mmɔborɔsubere a mefrɛ wo apɛ mmoa,bere a mema me nsa sokyerɛ wo Tenabea Kronkron hɔ.
english:
Hear my cry for mercy
    as I call to you for help,
as I lift up my hands
    toward your Most Holy Place.

twi: Mfa me mfra amumɔyɛfo mu ntwe me nkɔ,mfa me nka wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho.Wɔne wɔn yɔnkonom kasa fɛfɛ,nanso wɔde ɔtan sie wɔn koma mu.
english:
Do not drag me away with the wicked,
    with those who do evil,
who speak cordially with their neighbors
    but harbor malice in their hearts.

twi: Twe wɔn aso wɔ nea wɔayɛ no so;wɔn adwuma bɔne no so;tua nea wɔde wɔn nsa ayɛ so kana fa nea ɛfata wɔn san bra wɔn so.
english:
Repay them for their deeds
    and for their evil work;
repay them for what their hands have done
    and bring back on them what they deserve.

twi: Sɛ wommu nea Awurade ayɛne nea ɔde ne nsa ayɛ no ntiɔbɛbrɛ wɔn asena ɔremma wɔnnsɔre bio.
english:
Because they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord
    and what his hands have done,
he will tear them down
    and never build them up again.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade,efisɛ watie me mmɔborɔsu.
english:
Praise be to the Lord,
    for he has heard my cry for mercy.

twi: Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne me nkatabome koma wɔ ne mu ahotoso, na ɔboa me.Me koma di ahurusina mede dwonto bɛda no ase.
english:
The Lord is my strength and my shield;
    my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.
My heart leaps for joy,
    and with my song I praise him.

twi: Awurade yɛ ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo;ne nkwagye nsraban ma nea wɔasra no ngo.
english:
The Lord is the strength of his people,
    a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

twi: Gye wo nkurɔfo na hyira wʼagyapade;yɛ wɔn hwɛfo, na wo ne wɔn nnantew afebɔɔ.
english:
Save your people and bless your inheritance;
    be their shepherd and carry them forever.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Momfa mma Awurade no, mo ɔsoro abɔde,momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.
english:
Ascribe to the Lord, you heavenly beings,
    ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

twi: Momfa anuonyam a ɛfata Awurade din mma no;monsɔre Awurade wɔ nʼanuonyam kronkron mu.
english:
Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name;
    worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

twi: Awurade nne wɔ nsu no so;anuonyam Nyankopɔn bobɔ mu,Awurade bobɔ mu wɔ nsu akɛse so.
Awurade nne mu wɔ tumi;Awurade nne mu wɔ anuonyam.
english:
The voice of the Lord is powerful;
    the voice of the Lord is majestic.

twi: Awurade nne bubu sida;Awurade nne bubu Lebanon sida mu nketenkete
english:
The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars;
    the Lord breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

twi: Ɔma Lebanon huruhuruw te sɛ nantwi ba,na Sirion nso sɛ ɛko ba.
english:
He makes Lebanon leap like a calf,
    Sirion like a young wild ox.

twi: Awurade nne pa ma anyinam gya dɛw.
english:
The voice of the Lord strikes
    with flashes of lightning.

twi: Awurade nne wosow sare so;Awurade wosow Kades sare.
english:
The voice of the Lord shakes the desert;
    the Lord shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

twi: Awurade nne kyinkyim adumna ɛma kwae yɛ kwaterekwa.Nʼasɔredan mufo nyinaa teɛ mu ka se,“Anuonyam nka Onyankopɔn!”
english:
The voice of the Lord twists the oaks
    and strips the forests bare.
And in his temple all cry, “Glory!”

twi: Awurade di hene wɔ nsuyiri so;wɔasi Awurade hene afebɔɔ.
english:
The Lord sits enthroned over the flood;
    the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

twi: Awurade ma ne nkurɔfo ahoɔden,na ɔde asomdwoe hyira wɔn.
english:
The Lord gives strength to his people;
    the Lord blesses his people with peace.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mɛma wo so, Awurade,efisɛ, woayi me afi bun muna woamma mʼatamfo anserew me.
english:
I will exalt you, Lord,
    for you lifted me out of the depths
    and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

twi: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, misu frɛɛ wo sɛ boa mena wosaa me yare.
english:
Lord my God, I called to you for help,
    and you healed me.

twi: Awurade, wuyii me fii ɔda mu;wode me ho kyɛɛ me na woamma mankɔ amoa mu.
english:
You, Lord, brought me up from the realm of the dead;
    you spared me from going down to the pit.

twi: Monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade;mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo!Monkamfo ne din kronkron no.
english:
Sing the praises of the Lord, you his faithful people;
    praise his holy name.

twi: Nʼabufuw nkyɛ,na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;agyaadwotwa bɛwɔ hɔ anadwo,nanso ahosɛpɛw bɛba anɔpa.
english:
For his anger lasts only a moment,
    but his favor lasts a lifetime;
weeping may stay for the night,
    but rejoicing comes in the morning.

twi: Metee nka sɛ mewɔ bammɔ no, mekae se,“Merenhinhim da.”
english:
When I felt secure, I said,
    “I will never be shaken.”

twi: Awurade, woyɛɛ me adom nowomaa me bepɔw gyinaa pintinnna wode wʼanim hintaw me no,me koma tui.
english:
Lord, when you favored me,
    you made my royal mountain stand firm;
but when you hid your face,
    I was dismayed.

twi: Wo, Awurade na mefrɛɛ wo;wo hɔ na misu mesrɛɛ mmɔborɔhunu se:
english:
To you, Lord, I called;
    to the Lord I cried for mercy:

twi: “Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ me sɛe so,sɛ mɛkɔ amoa mu?Mfutuma beyi wo ayɛ ana?Ɛbɛpae mu aka wo nokwaredi ana?
english:
“What is gained if I am silenced,
    if I go down to the pit?
Will the dust praise you?
    Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

twi: Tie me, Awurade, na hu me mmɔbɔ!Awurade, yɛ me boafo.”
english:
Hear, Lord, and be merciful to me;
    Lord, be my help.”

twi: Wodan mʼagyaadwotwa yɛɛ no asaw;wuyii mʼatweaatam fii me hona wode anigye furaa me,
english:
You turned my wailing into dancing;
    you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

twi: sɛ me koma bɛto nnwom ama wo na ɛrenyɛ komm.Awurade me Nyankopɔn, meyi wo ayɛ daa.
english:
that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent.
    Lord my God, I will praise you forever.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Wo mu, Awurade na manya guankɔbea;mma mʼanim ngu ase;fi wo trenee mu gye me.
Yɛ aso ma me,bra ntɛm begye me;yɛ me bammɔ botan,aban a mʼatamfo nsa renka me.
english:
Turn your ear to me,
    come quickly to my rescue;
be my rock of refuge,
    a strong fortress to save me.

twi: Sɛ woyɛ me botan ne mʼaban nti,wo din nti di mʼanim na kyerɛ me kwan.
english:
Since you are my rock and my fortress,
    for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

twi: Gye me fi afiri a wɔasum me no mu,efisɛ wo ne me guankɔbea.
english:
Keep me free from the trap that is set for me,
    for you are my refuge.

twi: Wo nsam na mede me kra hyɛ;gye me bio, Awurade, Onyankopɔn nokwafo.
english:
Into your hands I commit my spirit;
    deliver me, Lord, my faithful God.

twi: Mikyi wɔn a wɔsom abosom huhuw;mede me ho to Awurade so.
english:
I hate those who cling to worthless idols;
    as for me, I trust in the Lord.

twi: Mʼani begye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo dɔ mu,efisɛ wuhu mʼamanehunu,na wunim me kra mu haw.
english:
I will be glad and rejoice in your love,
    for you saw my affliction
    and knew the anguish of my soul.

twi: Womfaa me nhyɛɛ ɔtamfo no nsammom wode me nan asisi petee mu.
english:
You have not given me into the hands of the enemy
    but have set my feet in a spacious place.

twi: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ me ho yeraw me;awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuuɔyaw ama me kra ne me honam ayɛ mmerɛw.
Ɔyawdi retew me nkwa so,na abooboo tew me mfe so;ɔhaw nti mʼahoɔden kɔ fam,na me nnompe nso ahodwow.
english:
My life is consumed by anguish
    and my years by groaning;
my strength fails because of my affliction,
    and my bones grow weak.

twi: Mʼatamfo nyinaa nti,mayɛ ahohora wɔ me nnamfonom mu;nnipa a wonim me suro me,na wɔn a wohu me mmɔnten so guan.
english:
Because of all my enemies,
    I am the utter contempt of my neighbors
and an object of dread to my closest friends—
    those who see me on the street flee from me.

twi: Obiara werɛ afi me te sɛ nea mawu;mayɛ sɛ kuku a abɔ.
english:
I am forgotten as though I were dead;
    I have become like broken pottery.

twi: Mete asomsɛm dodow a wɔkaahunahuna atwa me ho ahyia.Wɔrepam me ti so,na wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wobekum me.
english:
For I hear many whispering,
    “Terror on every side!”
They conspire against me
    and plot to take my life.

twi: Nanso mede me ho ato wo so, Awurade;meka se, “Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn.”
english:
But I trust in you, Lord;
    I say, “You are my God.”

twi: Me mmere wɔ wo nsamgye me fi mʼatamfone wɔn a wɔtaa me no nsam.
Tew wʼanim kyerɛ wo somfo;gye me wɔ wo dɔ a enni huammɔ no mu.
english:
Let your face shine on your servant;
    save me in your unfailing love.

twi: Mma mʼanim ngu ase, Awurade,efisɛ masu afrɛ wo;mmom, ma amumɔyɛfo anim ngu asena wɔnna wɔn nna mu komm.
english:
Let me not be put to shame, Lord,
    for I have cried out to you;
but let the wicked be put to shame
    and be silent in the realm of the dead.

twi: Mua atorofo ano,efisɛ wɔde ahantan ne animtiaabukasa tia atreneefo.
english:
Let their lying lips be silenced,
    for with pride and contempt
    they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

twi: Wo papayɛ dɔɔso,ɛno na woakora ama wɔn a wosuro wo noɛno na wode ma wɔn a woguan toa wo nowɔ nnipa anim.
english:
How abundant are the good things
    that you have stored up for those who fear you,
that you bestow in the sight of all,
    on those who take refuge in you.

twi: Wode wɔn sie wʼanim bammɔ mufi nnipa nsusuwii bɔne ho;wo tenabea hɔ na wode wɔn sie dwoodwoofi tɛkrɛma a ɛbɔ sobo ho.
english:
In the shelter of your presence you hide them
    from all human intrigues;
you keep them safe in your dwelling
    from accusing tongues.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade!Sɛ wayi ne dɔ nwonwaso akyerɛ mebere a na mewɔ kuropɔn a atamfo atwa ho ahyia no mu no.
english:
Praise be to the Lord,
    for he showed me the wonders of his love
    when I was in a city under siege.

twi: Mebɔɔ huboa no mekae se:“Woayi wʼani afi me so!”Nanso wotee me mmɔborɔsubere a mekotow srɛɛ wo no.
english:
In my alarm I said,
    “I am cut off from your sight!”
Yet you heard my cry for mercy
    when I called to you for help.

twi: Monnɔ Awurade mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo nyinaa!Awurade kora wɔn a wodi nokware so,na ahomasofo de, otua wɔn ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english:
Love the Lord, all his faithful people!
    The Lord preserves those who are true to him,
    but the proud he pays back in full.

twi: Monyɛ den na momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam,mo a mowɔ anidaso wɔ Awurade mu nyinaa.
english:
Be strong and take heart,
    all you who hope in the Lord.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhyira ne wɔn awɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ akyɛ wɔn,na wɔakata wɔn bɔne so.
english:
Blessed is the one
    whose transgressions are forgiven,
    whose sins are covered.

twi: Nhyira nka onipa aAwurade mmu ne bɔne ngu no sona nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.
english:
Blessed is the one
    whose sin the Lord does not count against them
    and in whose spirit is no deceit.

twi: Bere a meyɛɛ komm no,me nnompe yɛɛ mmrɛw,apini a misii no da mu nyinaa nti.
english:
When I kept silent,
    my bones wasted away
    through my groaning all day long.

twi: Awia ne anadwowo nsa yɛɛ den wɔ me so;mʼahoɔden saete sɛ awia bere mu ɔhyew.
english:
For day and night
    your hand was heavy on me;
my strength was sapped
    as in the heat of summer.

twi: Afei, migyee me bɔne too mu.Mankata mʼamumɔyɛ so.Mekae se, “Mɛkame bɔne akyerɛ Awurade,”na wode me bɔne ho afɔdi kyɛɛ me.
english:
Then I acknowledged my sin to you
    and did not cover up my iniquity.
I said, “I will confess
    my transgressions to the Lord.”
And you forgave
    the guilt of my sin.

twi: Enti, ma agyidifo nyinaa mmɔ wo mpaebere a wohu wo;ampa ara sɛ asu akɛse yiri a,ɛrenka no.
english:
Therefore let all the faithful pray to you
    while you may be found;
surely the rising of the mighty waters
    will not reach them.

twi: Wone me hintabea;wobɛbɔ me ho ban wɔ amanehunu muna wode nkwagye nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.
Mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ɔkwan a wobɛfa sometu wo fo na mahwɛ wo so.
english:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go;
    I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

twi: Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ anaa afurumpɔnkɔ aonni ntease ntiwɔde nnareka ne hama na ɛdannan no,sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn.
english:
Do not be like the horse or the mule,
    which have no understanding
but must be controlled by bit and bridle
    or they will not come to you.

twi: Omumɔyɛfo amanehunu dɔɔso,nanso Awurade adɔe a ɛnsa da notwa onipa a ɔde ne ho to no so no ho hyia.
english:
Many are the woes of the wicked,
    but the Lord’s unfailing love
    surrounds the one who trusts in him.

twi: Munni ahurusi na mo ani nnye wɔ Awurade mu, mo atreneefo;monto dwom, mo a mo koma mu tew.
english:
Rejoice in the Lord and be glad, you righteous;
    sing, all you who are upright in heart!

twi: Dwom Momfa ahurusi nto dwom mma Awurade, mo atreneefo,ɛfata sɛ wɔn a wɔteɛ no yi no ayɛ.
english:
Sing joyfully to the Lord, you righteous;
    it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

twi: Momfa sanku nkamfo Awurade;monto dwom mma no wɔ sankuten so.
english:
Praise the Lord with the harp;
    make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

twi: Monto dwom foforo mma no.Momfa nimdeɛ mmɔ sanku no na monteɛ mu ahurusi so!
english:
Sing to him a new song;
    play skillfully, and shout for joy.

twi: Awurade asɛm teɛ na ɛyɛ nokwareodi nokware wɔ nea ɔyɛ nyinaa mu.
english:
For the word of the Lord is right and true;
    he is faithful in all he does.

twi: Awurade dɔ treneeyɛ ne atɛntrenee.Nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ahyɛ asase so ma.
english:
The Lord loves righteousness and justice;
    the earth is full of his unfailing love.

twi: Awurade asɛm so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsorosoro,nʼanom home so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsoro asafo.
english:
By the word of the Lord the heavens were made,
    their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

twi: Ɔka po nsu boa ano kuw;na ɔde bun sie nea hɔ dɔ.
english:
He gathers the waters of the sea into jars;
    he puts the deep into storehouses.

twi: Momma asase sofo nyinaa nsuro Awurade;na wiasefo nyinaa mfa nidi mma no.
english:
Let all the earth fear the Lord;
    let all the people of the world revere him.

twi: Ɔno na ɔkasa ma ɛbaa muna ɔhyɛ ma egyinaa pintinn.
english:
For he spoke, and it came to be;
    he commanded, and it stood firm.

twi: Awurade sɛe amanaman no nhyehyɛe;ɔma adesamma nsusuwii yɛ ɔkwa.
english:
The Lord foils the plans of the nations;
    he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

twi: Nanso Awurade nhyehyɛe tim hɔ daa,ne koma mu botae wɔ hɔ ma awo ntoatoaso.
english:
But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever,
    the purposes of his heart through all generations.

twi: Nhyira ne ɔman a ne Nyankopɔn ne Awurade,nnipa a oyii wɔn sɛ nʼagyapade no.
english:
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord,
    the people he chose for his inheritance.

twi: Awurade hwɛ adesamma nyinaa fi ɔsoro.
english:
From heaven the Lord looks down
    and sees all mankind;

twi: Ofi nʼatenae hwɛ wɔn a wɔte asase so nyinaa.
english:
from his dwelling place he watches
    all who live on earth—

twi: Ɔno ne nea ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa koma,na osusuw nea wɔyɛ nyinaa ho.
english:
he who forms the hearts of all,
    who considers everything they do.

twi: Ɛnyɛ ɔhene asraafo dɔm kɛse na ebegye no;ɔkofo biara nni hɔ a ofi nʼahoɔden mu guan.
english:
No king is saved by the size of his army;
    no warrior escapes by his great strength.

twi: Ɔpɔnkɔ mu ahotoso yɛ ɔkwa wɔ nkwagye mu;nʼahoɔden nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentumi nnye nkwa.
english:
A horse is a vain hope for deliverance;
    despite all its great strength it cannot save.

twi: Nanso Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wosuro no no so,wɔn a wɔwɔ anidaso wɔ ne dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu,
english:
But the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him,
    on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

twi: sɛ obegye wɔn afi owu muna wama wɔatena nkwa mu wɔ ɔkɔm bere mu.
english:
to deliver them from death
    and keep them alive in famine.

twi: Yɛde anidaso twɛn Awurade;ɔyɛ yɛn boafo ne yɛn nkatabo.
english:
We wait in hope for the Lord;
    he is our help and our shield.

twi: Ne mu na yɛn koma di ahurusi,efisɛ yɛde yɛn ho to ne din kronkron no so.
english:
In him our hearts rejoice,
    for we trust in his holy name.

twi: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ntena yɛn so, Awurade,sɛnea anidaso a yɛwɔ wɔ mu no te.
english:
May your unfailing love be with us, Lord,
    even as we put our hope in you.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a ɔboapa dan ɔbɔdamfo wɔ Abimelek anim no na ɔpanyin no gyaa no ma ɔkɔe no akyi.Mede aseda bɛma Awurade bere nyinaa;nʼayeyi wɔ mʼanom daa.
english:
I will extol the Lord at all times;
    his praise will always be on my lips.

twi: Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu;ma amanehunufo nte na wonni ahurusi.
english:
I will glory in the Lord;
    let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

twi: Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade;momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!
english:
Glorify the Lord with me;
    let us exalt his name together.

twi: Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ogyee me so;na ogyee me wɔ nea misuro nyinaa mu.
english:
I sought the Lord, and he answered me;
    he delivered me from all my fears.

twi: Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nʼanim no hyerɛnna wɔn anim rengu ase da.
english:
Those who look to him are radiant;
    their faces are never covered with shame.

twi: Ohiani yi frɛe, na Awurade tiee no;na ogyee no fii nʼahohia nyinaa mu.
english:
This poor man called, and the Lord heard him;
    he saved him out of all his troubles.

twi: Awurade bɔfo wɛn wɔn a wosuro no,na ogye wɔn.
english:
The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him,
    and he delivers them.

twi: Monka nhwɛ na munhu sɛ Awurade ye.Nhyira ne onipa a oguan toa no.
english:
Taste and see that the Lord is good;
    blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

twi: Munsuro Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefo,na wɔn a wosuro no no nhia hwee.
english:
Fear the Lord, you his holy people,
    for those who fear him lack nothing.

twi: Gyata yɛ mmerɛw na ɔkɔm de wɔn,nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, ade pa biara remmɔ wɔn.
english:
The lions may grow weak and hungry,
    but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

twi: Mommra, me mma, monyɛ aso mma me;mɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo Awurade ho suro.
english:
Come, my children, listen to me;
    I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

twi: Mo mu hena na ɔpɛ nkwana ɔpɛ sɛ ohu nna pa bebree?
english:
Whoever of you loves life
    and desires to see many good days,

twi: Ɛne ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka kasa bɔne, na ɛsɛ sɛ ogyae atorotwa.
english:
keep your tongue from evil
    and your lips from telling lies.

twi: Twe wo ho fi bɔne ho, na yɛ papa;hwehwɛ asomdwoe na tiw no.
english:
Turn from evil and do good;
    seek peace and pursue it.

twi: Awurade ani wɔ atreneefo sona otie wɔn mpaebɔ;
english:
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
    and his ears are attentive to their cry;

twi: Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne,sɛ obeyi wɔn nkae afi asase yi so.
english:
but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil,
    to blot out their name from the earth.

twi: Atreneefo teɛ mu su, na Awurade tie wɔn;oyi wɔn fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.
english:
The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them;
    he delivers them from all their troubles.

twi: Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔn koma abotowna ogye wɔn a wɔadwerɛw wɔn wɔ honhom mu no nkwa.
english:
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted
    and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

twi: Onipa trenee behu amane bebreenanso Awurade gye no fi ne nyinaa mu;
english:
The righteous person may have many troubles,
    but the Lord delivers him from them all;

twi: ɔbɔ ne nnompe nyinaa ho ban,sɛnea mu baako mpo mu remmu.
english:
he protects all his bones,
    not one of them will be broken.

twi: Bɔne bekum ɔdebɔneyɛni;ɔtreneeni atamfo benya afɔbu.
english:
Evil will slay the wicked;
    the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

twi: Awurade gye nʼasomfo nkwa;wɔn a woguan toa no no mu biara renkɔ afɔbu mu.
english:
The Lord will rescue his servants;
    no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade wo ne wɔn a wɔne me di asi no nni asi;ko tia wɔn a wɔko tia me.
english:
Contend, Lord, with those who contend with me;
    fight against those who fight against me.

twi: Fa wo nkatabo ne wʼakode;na sɔre bra bɛboa me.
english:
Take up shield and armor;
    arise and come to my aid.

twi: Twe peaw ne abonnuawɔ wɔn a wɔtaa me no so.Ka kyerɛ me kra se,“Mene wʼagyenkwa.”
english:
Brandish spear and javelin
    against those who pursue me.
Say to me,
    “I am your salvation.”

twi: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no,ma wɔn anim ngu ase;wɔn a wɔbɔ me sɛe ho pɔw no,ma wɔmfa aniwu nsan wɔn akyi.
english:
May those who seek my life
    be disgraced and put to shame;
may those who plot my ruin
    be turned back in dismay.

twi: Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ guwɔn a Awurade bɔfo repam wɔn no.
english:
May they be like chaff before the wind,
    with the angel of the Lord driving them away;

twi: Ma wɔn akwan so nnuru sum na ɛso ɛnyɛ toro,na Awurade bɔfo ntaa wɔn.
english:
may their path be dark and slippery,
    with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.

twi: Esiane sɛ wɔde ɔtan sum me afiri kwa,na wotuu amoa maa me a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee no nti
english:
Since they hid their net for me without cause
    and without cause dug a pit for me,

twi: ma ɔsɛe mmefu wɔn muna ɔtan no a wɔde hintaw no nyi wɔn,na ma wɔnhwe amoa no mu nsɛe.
english:
may ruin overtake them by surprise—
    may the net they hid entangle them,
    may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

twi: Afei me kra ani begye wɔ Awurade muna wasɛpɛw ne ho wɔ ne nkwagye mu.
english:
Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord
    and delight in his salvation.

twi: Me nipadua nyinaa bɛteɛ mu aka se,“Hena na ɔte sɛ wo, Awurade?Wugye ohiani fi ahoɔdenfo nsam,ne nea onni bi fi apoobɔfo nsam.”
english:
My whole being will exclaim,
    “Who is like you, Lord?
You rescue the poor from those too strong for them,
    the poor and needy from those who rob them.”

twi: Adansekurumfo sɔre;wobisa me nneɛma a minnim ho hwee ho asɛm.
english:
Ruthless witnesses come forward;
    they question me on things I know nothing about.

twi: Wɔde bɔne tua papa a meyɛ so kana wɔma me kra yɛ basaa.
english:
They repay me evil for good
    and leave me like one bereaved.

twi: Nanso bere a wɔyaree no, mifuraa atweaatamna mede akɔnkyen brɛɛ me ho ase.Bere a me mpaebɔ ho mmuae nnya mmae no,
english:
Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth
    and humbled myself with fasting.
When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

twi: mekɔɔ so twaa adwo,sɛnea meyɛ ma mʼadamfo anaa onuabarima.Mede awerɛhow sii me ti asete sɛ nea meregyam me na.
english:
I went about mourning
    as though for my friend or brother.
I bowed my head in grief
    as though weeping for my mother.

twi: Nanso bere a mihintiw no wɔde anigye boaa wɔn ho ano;afowfo twaa me ho hyiae a minnim,na wodii me ho nseku a wɔantwa so da.
Wɔde adwemmɔne dii me ho fɛw te sɛ nnipa a wonni nyamesu,wɔtwɛree wɔn se guu me so.
english:
Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked;
    they gnashed their teeth at me.

twi: Awurade, wobɛhwɛ wɔn akosi da bɛn?Gye me nkwa fi wɔn sɛe mu,gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no fi saa gyata yi nsam.
english:
How long, Lord, will you look on?
    Rescue me from their ravages,
    my precious life from these lions.

twi: Na mɛda wo ase wɔ guabɔ kɛse ase;wɔ nnipa dodow mu na mɛkamfo wo.
english:
I will give you thanks in the great assembly;
    among the throngs I will praise you.

twi: Mma mʼatamfo a wɔtan me kwa nonhwɛ me haw nserew.Mma wɔn a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee nanso wɔtan me nommfa adwene bɔne mmu me anikyiw.
english:
Do not let those gloat over me
    who are my enemies without cause;
do not let those who hate me without reason
    maliciously wink the eye.

twi: Wɔnnkasa asomdwoe so,na mmom, wɔde ntwatosotia nnipa a wɔmpɛ wɔn ho asɛm wɔ asase yi so.
english:
They do not speak peaceably,
    but devise false accusations
    against those who live quietly in the land.

twi: Wɔhwɛ me haw ka se, “Yiw! Yiw,yɛde yɛn ankasa ani ahu.”
english:
They sneer at me and say, “Aha! Aha!
    With our own eyes we have seen it.”

twi: Awurade, woahu na mmua wʼano.Ntwe wo ho nkɔ akyiri, Awurade.
english:
Lord, you have seen this; do not be silent.
    Do not be far from me, Lord.

twi: Nyan, sɔre na bɛbɔ me ho ban!Ka bi ma me, me Nyankopɔn ne mʼAwurade.
english:
Awake, and rise to my defense!
    Contend for me, my God and Lord.

twi: Di mʼasɛm ma me wɔ wo trenee no mu, Awurade me Nyankopɔn;mma wɔnnhwɛ me haw nserew.
english:
Vindicate me in your righteousness, Lord my God;
    do not let them gloat over me.

twi: Mma wɔnnwene nka se, “Yiw, nea yɛpɛ ni!”anaa wɔnnka se, “Yɛanya no.”
english:
Do not let them think, “Aha, just what we wanted!”
    or say, “We have swallowed him up.”

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ me haw serew me wɔ mʼahohiahia mu nonyinaa anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;ma wɔn a wodi me so akokurokosɛm nonhyɛ aniwu ne animguase atade.
english:
May all who gloat over my distress
    be put to shame and confusion;
may all who exalt themselves over me
    be clothed with shame and disgrace.

twi: Ma wɔn a wodi ahurusi wɔ me bembu ho nomfa anigye ne ahosɛpɛw nteɛ mubere nyinaa mu; ma wɔnka se, “Momma Awurade so,ɔno na nʼani gye ne somfo yiyedi ho.”
english:
May those who delight in my vindication
    shout for joy and gladness;
may they always say, “The Lord be exalted,
    who delights in the well-being of his servant.”

twi: Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo trenee,ne wʼayeyi, da mu nyinaa.
english:
My tongue will proclaim your righteousness,
    your praises all day long.

twi: Dwom Awurade somfo Dawid dwom.Nkɔmhyɛ bi wɔ me koma mu a efi Onyankopɔn hɔa ɛfa omumɔyɛfo mmarato ho.Onyankopɔn suro nni wɔn ani so.
english:
I have a message from God in my heart
    concerning the sinfulness of the wicked:
There is no fear of God
    before their eyes.

twi: Na ɔno ankasa ani so no ɔdaadaa no ho dodo,nti ɛmma onhu ne bɔne nnyae yɛ.
english:
In their own eyes they flatter themselves
    too much to detect or hate their sin.

twi: Nʼanom nsɛm yɛ atirimɔden ne nnaadaa;onnim nyansa bio na wayɛ papa.
english:
The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful;
    they fail to act wisely or do good.

twi: Ɔda ne mpa so mpo a ɔbɔ pɔw bɔne;na ogyaa ne ho ma bɔne kwanna ɔmpo nea enye.
Awurade, wʼadɔe du ɔsorosorowo nokwaredi du wim tɔnn.
english:
Your love, Lord, reaches to the heavens,
    your faithfulness to the skies.

twi: Wo trenee te sɛ mmepɔw akɛse.Wʼatɛntrenee mu dɔ sɛ po bun.Ao Awurade, wokora nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa so.
english:
Your righteousness is like the highest mountains,
    your justice like the great deep.
    You, Lord, preserve both people and animals.

twi: Wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no som bo!Nnipa mu akɛse ne nketewanya guankɔbea wɔ wo ntaban nwini ase.
english:
How priceless is your unfailing love, O God!
    People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

twi: Wodi nea abu so wɔ wo fi,woma wɔnom fi wʼanika asuten no mu.
english:
They feast on the abundance of your house;
    you give them drink from your river of delights.

twi: Wo nkyɛn na nkwa asuti wɔ;wo hann mu na yehu hann.
english:
For with you is the fountain of life;
    in your light we see light.

twi: Kɔ so dɔ wɔn a wonim wo,ma wo trenee ntena wɔn a wɔteɛ, koma mu.
english:
Continue your love to those who know you,
    your righteousness to the upright in heart.

twi: Mma ɔhantanni nan ntia meanaa omumɔyɛfo nsa nnsunsum me.
english:
May the foot of the proud not come against me,
    nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea nnebɔneyɛfo ahwehwe ase,wɔdeda hɔ a wɔrentumi nsɔre bio.
english:
See how the evildoers lie fallen—
    thrown down, not able to rise!

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhaw wo ho, nnebɔneyɛfo nti;mma wʼani mmmere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne;
english:
Do not fret because of those who are evil
    or be envious of those who do wrong;

twi: Wɔte sɛ sare, ɛrenkyɛ na ahyew,wɔte sɛ dua amono, ɛrenkyɛ na awu.
english:
for like the grass they will soon wither,
    like green plants they will soon die away.

twi: Fa wo ho to Awurade so na yɛ papa.Tena asase no so na ma wʼani nka asomdwoe adidibea hɔ.
english:
Trust in the Lord and do good;
    dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

twi: Ma wʼani nnye wɔ Awurade muna wama wo nea wo koma pɛ.
english:
Take delight in the Lord,
    and he will give you the desires of your heart.

twi: Fa wʼakwan hyɛ Awurade nsam;na fa wo ho to no so, na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ:
english:
Commit your way to the Lord;
    trust in him and he will do this:

twi: ɔbɛma wo treneeyɛ ahyerɛn sɛ adekyee,na wʼatɛntrenee ayɛ sɛ owigyinae.
english:
He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn,
    your vindication like the noonday sun.

twi: Yɛ komm wɔ Awurade anim na tɔ wo bo ase twɛn no,nhaw wo ho wɔ wɔn a asi wɔn yiye hoefisɛ wɔnam bɔne akwan so.
english:
Be still before the Lord
    and wait patiently for him;
do not fret when people succeed in their ways,
    when they carry out their wicked schemes.

twi: Mma wo bo mmfuw na gyae abufuwhyew;nhaw wo ho, ekowie bɔne nko ara.
english:
Refrain from anger and turn from wrath;
    do not fret—it leads only to evil.

twi: Wobetwa nnebɔneyɛfo agu,nanso wɔn a wɔn ani da Awurade so nowobenya asase no adi so.
english:
For those who are evil will be destroyed,
    but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

twi: Ɛrenkyɛ, nnebɔneyɛfo bɛyera.Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso wɔrenhu wɔn.
english:
A little while, and the wicked will be no more;
    though you look for them, they will not be found.

twi: Nanso ahobrɛasefo benya asase no adi sona wɔanya asomdwoe mmoroso.
english:
But the meek will inherit the land
    and enjoy peace and prosperity.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo bɔ pɔw bɔne tia atreneefona wɔtwɛre wɔn se gu wɔn so;
english:
The wicked plot against the righteous
    and gnash their teeth at them;

twi: nanso Awurade serew amumɔyɛfo,na onim sɛ wɔn nna abɛn.
english:
but the Lord laughs at the wicked,
    for he knows their day is coming.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo twe afoana wokuntun wɔn ta musɛ wobekum ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo,sɛ wobekum wɔn a wɔn akwan teɛ.
english:
The wicked draw the sword
    and bend the bow
to bring down the poor and needy,
    to slay those whose ways are upright.

twi: Nanso wɔn afoa bɛwowɔ wɔn ankasa koma mu,na wɔn ta mu abubu.
english:
But their swords will pierce their own hearts,
    and their bows will be broken.

twi: Kakra a atreneefo wɔ no som bosen amumɔyɛfo bebree ahonya;
english:
Better the little that the righteous have
    than the wealth of many wicked;

twi: efisɛ amumɔyɛfo ahoɔden bɛsananso Awurade bɛwowaw atreneefo.
english:
for the power of the wicked will be broken,
    but the Lord upholds the righteous.

twi: Awurade nim wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no nna,na wɔn agyapade bɛtena hɔ daa.
english:
The blameless spend their days under the Lord’s care,
    and their inheritance will endure forever.

twi: Ahohiahia bere mu wɔremmrɛ.Ɔkɔm bere mu wobenya ama abu so.
english:
In times of disaster they will not wither;
    in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

twi: Nanso amumɔyɛfo bɛyera.Awurade atamfo bɛyɛ sɛ nwura mu nhwiren;wobetu ayera sɛ wusiw.
english:
But the wicked will perish:
    Though the Lord’s enemies are like the flowers of the field,
    they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo pɛ bosea, na wontua,nanso ɔtreneeni de ahummɔbɔ ma;
english:
The wicked borrow and do not repay,
    but the righteous give generously;

twi: Wɔn a Awurade ahyira wɔn no benya asase no adi so,na wobetwa wɔn a ɔdome wɔn no agu.
english:
those the Lord blesses will inherit the land,
    but those he curses will be destroyed.

twi: Sɛ Awurade ani sɔ onipa akwan a,ɔma nʼanammɔntu si pi.
english:
The Lord makes firm the steps
    of the one who delights in him;

twi: Sɛ ohintiw a ɔrenhwe ase,efisɛ Awurade kura no wɔ ne nsam.
english:
though he may stumble, he will not fall,
    for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

twi: Na meyɛ aberante, na mprempren mabɔ akwakoraa,na minhuu ɔtreneeni a Awurade apa nʼakyianaasɛ ne mma resrɛ aduan.
english:
I was young and now I am old,
    yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken
    or their children begging bread.

twi: Bere biara ɔyɛ adɔe, na ɔde fɛm kwa;na ne mma benya nhyira.
english:
They are always generous and lend freely;
    their children will be a blessing.

twi: Twe wo ho fi bɔne ho na yɛ papana wobɛtena asase no so afebɔɔ.
english:
Turn from evil and do good;
    then you will dwell in the land forever.

twi: Efisɛ, Awurade pɛ nea ɛteɛ,na ɔrennyaw ne nkurɔfo anokwafo no.Wobenya bammɔ daa nyinaa.Nanso amumɔyɛfo asefo de, wobetwa wɔn agu.
english:
For the Lord loves the just
    and will not forsake his faithful ones.
Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed;
    the offspring of the wicked will perish.

twi: Atreneefo benya asase no adi sona wɔatena so afebɔɔ.
english:
The righteous will inherit the land
    and dwell in it forever.

twi: Ɔtreneeni ano ka nyansasɛm,na ne tɛkrɛma ka nea ɛteɛ.
english:
The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom,
    and their tongues speak what is just.

twi: Ne Nyankopɔn mmara wɔ ne koma mu;wɔn anan nwatiri.
english:
The law of their God is in their hearts;
    their feet do not slip.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo tetɛw atreneefohwehwɛ sɛ wobekum wɔn,
english:
The wicked lie in wait for the righteous,
    intent on putting them to death;

twi: nanso Awurade nnyaa wɔn mma wɔn,na ɔremma wommu wɔn kumfɔ wɔ asennii.
english:
but the Lord will not leave them in the power of the wicked
    or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

twi: Montwɛn Awuradena monhwɛ nʼakwan.Ɔbɛma mo so na moanya asase no adi so;sɛ wotwitwa amumɔyɛfo no gu a, mubehu.
english:
Hope in the Lord
    and keep his way.
He will exalt you to inherit the land;
    when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.

twi: Mahu omumɔyɛfo a ɔyɛ basabasasɛ ɔredi yiye sɛ dua amono a esi asase pa so,
english:
I have seen a wicked and ruthless man
    flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,

twi: nanso ankyɛ na nʼawiei bae a wonhu no bio;mehwehwɛɛ no, nanso manhu no.
english:
but he soon passed away and was no more;
    though I looked for him, he could not be found.

twi: Susuw nea ɔyɛ pɛ ho, na hwɛ nea ɔteɛ;na asomdwoe nipa benya asetena pa daakye.
english:
Consider the blameless, observe the upright;
    a future awaits those who seek peace.

twi: Nanso wɔbɛsɛe nnebɔneyɛfo nyinaa;na wɔbɛtɔre wɔn asefo ase.
english:
But all sinners will be destroyed;
    there will be no future for the wicked.

twi: Atreneefo nkwagye fi Awuradeɔne wɔn aban wɔ amanehunu bere mu.
english:
The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord;
    he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

twi: Awurade boa wɔn na ogye wɔn;oyi wɔn fi amumɔyɛfo nsam, na ogye wɔn nkwa,efisɛ wohintaw wɔ ne mu.
Dwom Dawid dwom. Adesrɛ.Awurade, nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw muna ntwe mʼaso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.
english:
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger
    or discipline me in your wrath.

twi: Wo bɛmma hwirew me mu,na wo nsa adwerɛw me.
english:
Your arrows have pierced me,
    and your hand has come down on me.

twi: Wʼabufuwhyew no nti ahoɔden biara nni me mu;me bɔne nti, me nnompe ahodwow.
english:
Because of your wrath there is no health in my body;
    there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.

twi: Mʼafɔdi amene mete sɛ adesoa a mu yɛ duru dodo.
english:
My guilt has overwhelmed me
    like a burden too heavy to bear.

twi: Mʼakuru bɔn na aporɔwesiane me bɔne mu agyimisɛm nti.
english:
My wounds fester and are loathsome
    because of my sinful folly.

twi: Makotow na wɔabrɛ me ase;da mu nyinaa menantenantew twa agyaadwo.
english:
I am bowed down and brought very low;
    all day long I go about mourning.

twi: Mʼakyi dompe mu yaw boro so:ahoɔden biara nni me nipadua mu.
english:
My back is filled with searing pain;
    there is no health in my body.

twi: Mabrɛ na mapɛtɛw koraa.Me koma mu yaw ma misi apini.
english:
I am feeble and utterly crushed;
    I groan in anguish of heart.

twi: Awurade, nea merehwɛ anim nyinaa da wʼanim;mʼapinisi nhintaw wo.
english:
All my longings lie open before you, Lord;
    my sighing is not hidden from you.

twi: Me koma bɔ kitirikitiri, na mʼahoɔden asampo mʼaniwa aduru sum.
english:
My heart pounds, my strength fails me;
    even the light has gone from my eyes.

twi: Mʼapirakuru nti me nnamfonom ne me yɔnkonom mmɛn me;mʼafipamfo twe wɔn ho fi me ho.
english:
My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds;
    my neighbors stay far away.

twi: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no sum me mfiri,wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw me no di me sɛe ho nkɔmmɔda mu nyinaa wodwen nnaadaasɛm ho.
Mete sɛ ɔsotifo a ɔnte asɛm,mete sɛ mum a ontumi nkasa.
english:
I am like the deaf, who cannot hear,
    like the mute, who cannot speak;

twi: Mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnte asɛm,nea nʼano ntumi mma mmuae.
english:
I have become like one who does not hear,
    whose mouth can offer no reply.

twi: Awurade, meretwɛn wo;Awurade me Nyankopɔn, wubegye me so.
english:
Lord, I wait for you;
    you will answer, Lord my God.

twi: Mekae se, “Mma wɔn ani nnye;anaa wɔmma wɔn ho so bere a mʼanan awatiri no.”
english:
For I said, “Do not let them gloat
    or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip.”

twi: Mereyɛ mahwe ase,na me yaw da so wɔ me mu.
english:
For I am about to fall,
    and my pain is ever with me.

twi: Meka me mfomso kyerɛ;me bɔne hyɛ me so.
english:
I confess my iniquity;
    I am troubled by my sin.

twi: Bebree na wɔyɛ mʼatamfo;wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso.
english:
Many have become my enemies without cause;
    those who hate me without reason are numerous.

twi: Wɔn a wɔde bɔne tua me papa so ka no,bɔ me ahohora bere a mereyɛ papa.
english:
Those who repay my good with evil
    lodge accusations against me,
    though I seek only to do what is good.

twi: Awurade nnyaw me.Me Nyankopɔn, nkɔ akyiri!
english:
Lord, do not forsake me;
    do not be far from me, my God.

twi: Bra ntɛm bɛboa me,Awurade, mʼAgyenkwa.
english:
Come quickly to help me,
    my Lord and my Savior.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mekae se, “Mɛhwɛ mʼakwan yiyena mamfa me tɛkrɛma anyɛ bɔne;mɛto mʼano nnarekabere a amumɔyɛfo bɛn me yi.
english:
I said, “I will watch my ways
    and keep my tongue from sin;
I will put a muzzle on my mouth
    while in the presence of the wicked.”

twi: Enti meyɛɛ komma manka asɛm papa biara mponanso mʼapinisi mu yɛɛ den.
Me koma ho guan no wɔ me mu.Midwinnwen no, ogya dɛwee;afei mede me tɛkrɛma kasae se:
“Awurade, ma minhu me nkwa awieine me nna dodow;ma minhu sɛnea me nkwa si twa mu ntɛm so.
Woayɛ me nna sɛ nsateaa baako pɛ;na me mfe dodow nyɛ hwee wɔ wʼani so.Onipa nkwa yɛ ɔhome bi kɛkɛ.
english:
You have made my days a mere handbreadth;
    the span of my years is as nothing before you.
Everyone is but a breath,
    even those who seem secure.

twi: Onipa redi akɔneaba nyinaa no, ɔte sɛ sunsuma bi kwa;ɔhaw ne ho nanso ɔyɛ kwa;ɔboa ahonya ano na onnim nea ɛbɛyɛ ne de.
“Afei Awurade, dɛn na merehwehwɛ?Mʼanidaso wɔ wo mu.
english:
“But now, Lord, what do I look for?
    My hope is in you.

twi: Gye me fi me bɔne nyinaa mu;mma mennyɛ nkwaseafo aserewde.
english:
Save me from all my transgressions;
    do not make me the scorn of fools.

twi: Meyɛɛ komm, na mammue mʼano,efisɛ wo na woayɛ eyi.
english:
I was silent; I would not open my mouth,
    for you are the one who has done this.

twi: Yi wʼasotwe fi me so;wo nsa ano amanehunu amene me.
english:
Remove your scourge from me;
    I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

twi: Woka nnipa anim, na wotwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho;wosɛe wɔn ahonya te sɛ nwewee;onipa biara yɛ ɔhome kɛkɛ.
english:
When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin,
    you consume their wealth like a moth—
    surely everyone is but a breath.

twi: “Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ,tie me sufrɛ;nsiw wʼaso wɔ me su ho.Me ne wo te hɔ sɛ ɔnanani,sɛnea na mʼagyanom nyinaa te no.
english:
“Hear my prayer, Lord,
    listen to my cry for help;
    do not be deaf to my weeping.
I dwell with you as a foreigner,
    a stranger, as all my ancestors were.

twi: Yi wʼani fi me so na manya nkwa bio,ansa na mafi ha a mente ase bio.”
english:
Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again
    before I depart and am no more.”

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mede boasetɔ twɛn Awurade;na ɔhwɛɛ me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.
english:
I waited patiently for the Lord;
    he turned to me and heard my cry.

twi: Oyii me fii amoa a mu yɛ toro mu,fii dɔte ne dontori mu;ɔde mʼanan sii ɔbotan sona ɔmaa me baabi pa gyinae.
english:
He lifted me out of the slimy pit,
    out of the mud and mire;
he set my feet on a rock
    and gave me a firm place to stand.

twi: Ɔde dwom foforo hyɛɛ mʼanom,ayeyi dwom a yɛde ma yɛn Nyankopɔn.Bebree behu na wɔasuro,na wɔde wɔn werɛ ahyɛ Awurade mu.
english:
He put a new song in my mouth,
    a hymn of praise to our God.
Many will see and fear the Lord
    and put their trust in him.

twi: Nhyira ne onipa aɔde Awurade yɛ nʼahotoso,nea ɔmfa nʼani nto ahomaso so,ne wɔn a wɔman di anyame huhuw akyi.
english:
Blessed is the one
    who trusts in the Lord,
who does not look to the proud,
    to those who turn aside to false gods.

twi: Awurade me Nyankopɔnwoayɛ anwonwade bebree.Nneɛma a wohyehyɛ maa yɛn noobiara ntumi nka ne nyinaa nkyerɛ wo;sɛ meka se mereka ne nyinaa ho asɛm aɛbɛdɔɔso dodo.
english:
Many, Lord my God,
    are the wonders you have done,
    the things you planned for us.
None can compare with you;
    were I to speak and tell of your deeds,
    they would be too many to declare.

twi: Wompɛ afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛde,nanso woabue mʼaso;woampɛ ɔhyew afɔre ne bɔne afɔre.
english:
Sacrifice and offering you did not desire—
    but my ears you have opened—
    burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

twi: Na mekae se, “Mini, maba,sɛnea wɔakyerɛw afa me ho wɔ nhoma mmobɔwee no mu no.
english:
Then I said, “Here I am, I have come—
    it is written about me in the scroll.

twi: Me Nyankopɔn, mepɛ sɛ meyɛ wʼapɛde;wo mmara wɔ me koma mu.”
english:
I desire to do your will, my God;
    your law is within my heart.”

twi: Meka wo trenee ho asɛm wɔ guabɔ kɛse ase;mimmua mʼano,Awurade, sɛnea wunim no.
Memmfa wo trenee ho asɛm nsie me koma mu;meka wo nokware ne wo nkwagye ho asɛm.Mankata wʼadɔe ne wo nokware sowɔ guabɔ kɛse no ase.
english:
I do not hide your righteousness in my heart;
    I speak of your faithfulness and your saving help.
I do not conceal your love and your faithfulness
    from the great assembly.

twi: Awurade, nyi wʼahummɔbɔ mfi me so;ma wʼadɔe ne wo nokware mmɔ me ho ban daa.
english:
Do not withhold your mercy from me, Lord;
    may your love and faithfulness always protect me.

twi: Ɔhaw bebree atwa me ho ahyia;mʼamumɔyɛ abu afa me so enti minhu ade bio.Ɛdɔɔso sen me ti so nwi,na me koma abotow wɔ me mu.
english:
For troubles without number surround me;
    my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see.
They are more than the hairs of my head,
    and my heart fails within me.

twi: Awurade, ma ɛnsɔ wʼani sɛ wubegye me;Awurade, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.
english:
Be pleased to save me, Lord;
    come quickly, Lord, to help me.

twi: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no nyinaa,ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;ma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ mesɛe nomfa aniwu nsan wɔn akyi.
english:
May all who want to take my life
    be put to shame and confusion;
may all who desire my ruin
    be turned back in disgrace.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me nonsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.
english:
May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!”
    be appalled at their own shame.

twi: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaansɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu;ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se,“Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse!”
english:
But may all who seek you
    rejoice and be glad in you;
may those who long for your saving help always say,
    “The Lord is great!”

twi: Nanso meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni;ma Awurade nnwen me ho.Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo;wo ne me Nyankopɔn, bra ntɛm.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhyira ne onipa a mmɔborɔni asɛm ho hia no;Awurade gye no wɔ amanehunu bere mu.
english:
Blessed are those who have regard for the weak;
    the Lord delivers them in times of trouble.

twi: Awurade bɛbɔ ne ho ban na wakora ne kra;obehyira no wɔ asase no so;ɔrennyaa no mma nʼatamfo apɛde.
english:
The Lord protects and preserves them—
    they are counted among the blessed in the land—
    he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.

twi: Awurade bɛhwɛ no wɔ ne yare mpa sona wagye no asi hɔ.
english:
The Lord sustains them on their sickbed
    and restores them from their bed of illness.

twi: Mekae se, “Ao Awurade hu me mmɔbɔ;sa me yare, efisɛ mayɛ bɔne atia wo.”
english:
I said, “Have mercy on me, Lord;
    heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

twi: Mʼatamfo de adwene bɔne ka fa me ho se:“Da bɛn na obewu ama ne din ayera?”
english:
My enemies say of me in malice,
    “When will he die and his name perish?”

twi: Bere biara a obi ba me nkyɛn no,ɔka atosɛm, na ne koma hɔre dinsɛe;ofi adi kɔ a, ɔde kodi nseku.
Mʼatamfo nyinaa keka asomsɛm fa me ho;wosusuw bɔne ma me na wɔka se:
english:
All my enemies whisper together against me;
    they imagine the worst for me, saying,

twi: “Ɔyare bɔne bi abɔ no;ɔrensɔre mfi nea ɔda hɔ bio.”
english:
“A vile disease has afflicted him;
    he will never get up from the place where he lies.”

twi: Mpo me yɔnko pa ara a mede me ho too no so,nea me ne no too nsa didii no,asɔre atia me.
english:
Even my close friend,
    someone I trusted,
one who shared my bread,
    has turned against me.

twi: Nanso wo, Awurade, hu me mmɔbɔ;ma me so, na mintua wɔn so ka.
english:
But may you have mercy on me, Lord;
    raise me up, that I may repay them.

twi: Minim sɛ wʼani sɔ me,na me tamfo renni me so nkonim.
english:
I know that you are pleased with me,
    for my enemy does not triumph over me.

twi: Me nokwaredi mu, wukura me muna wode me gyina wʼanim afebɔɔ.
english:
Because of my integrity you uphold me
    and set me in your presence forever.

twi: Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn,nnɛ ne daa nyinaa.Amen! ne Amen!
english:
Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel,
    from everlasting to everlasting.
Amen and Amen.

twi: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ABIENNnwom –Dwom Koramma “maskil” dwom.Sɛnea ɔforote pere hwehwɛ nsuwansuwa no,saa ara na me kra pere hwehwɛ wo, me Nyankopɔn.
english:
As the deer pants for streams of water,
    so my soul pants for you, my God.

twi: Onyankopɔn ho sukɔm de me kra, Onyankopɔn teasefo no.Da bɛn na metumi akohyia Onyankopɔn?
english:
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.
    When can I go and meet with God?

twi: Me nisu ayɛ mʼaduanawia ne anadwo,na da mu nyinaa nnipa bisa me se:“Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
english:
My tears have been my food
    day and night,
while people say to me all day long,
    “Where is your God?”

twi: Saa nneɛma yi na mekaebere a mereka me koma mu nsɛm;sɛnea na midi asafokuw anim,na yɛde anigye nteɛteɛmu ne aseda nnwomnantew yuu bɔ mu kɔ Onyankopɔn fiwɔ afahyɛ da no.
english:
These things I remember
    as I pour out my soul:
how I used to go to the house of God
    under the protection of the Mighty One
with shouts of joy and praise
    among the festive throng.

twi: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.
english:
Why, my soul, are you downcast?
    Why so disturbed within me?
Put your hope in God,
    for I will yet praise him,
    my Savior and my God.

twi: Me kra abotow wɔ me mu,enti mɛkae wofi Yordan asase so,Hermon mmepɔw so, fi Bepɔw Misar so.
Ebun kɔ bun muwɔ wo nsu a ɛworo gu no nnyigyei mu;wʼasorɔkye nyinaaabu afa me so.
english:
Deep calls to deep
    in the roar of your waterfalls;
all your waves and breakers
    have swept over me.

twi: Adekyee mu, Awurade kyerɛ nʼadɔe,adesae mu, ne dwom ba me nkyɛn,mpae a mebɔ srɛ me nkwa Nyankopɔn.
english:
By day the Lord directs his love,
    at night his song is with me—
    a prayer to the God of my life.

twi: Mibisa Onyankopɔn, me Botan no se,“Adɛn nti na wo werɛ afi me?Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwo,mʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?”
english:
I say to God my Rock,
    “Why have you forgotten me?
Why must I go about mourning,
    oppressed by the enemy?”

twi: Me nnompe te ɔdesani yawdi,mʼahohiahiafo ateetee nti,daa nyinaa wobisa me se,“Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
english:
My bones suffer mortal agony
    as my foes taunt me,
saying to me all day long,
    “Where is your God?”

twi: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.
english:
Why, my soul, are you downcast?
    Why so disturbed within me?
Put your hope in God,
    for I will yet praise him,
    my Savior and my God.

twi: Dwom Me Nyankopɔn, bu me bem,na ka mʼasɛm a etia ɔman a wonsuro wo no ma me;gye me fi nnaadaafo ne amumɔyɛfo nsam.
english:
Vindicate me, my God,
    and plead my cause
    against an unfaithful nation.
Rescue me from those who are
    deceitful and wicked.

twi: Woyɛ Onyankopɔn, mʼabandennen.Adɛn nti na woapo me?Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwomʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?
english:
You are God my stronghold.
    Why have you rejected me?
Why must I go about mourning,
    oppressed by the enemy?

twi: Soma wo hann ne wo nokwarema wɔnkyerɛ me kwan;ma wɔmfa me mmra wo Bepɔw Kronkron no so,faako a wote no.
Afei, mɛkɔ Onyankopɔn afɔremuka anim,mʼanigye ne mʼahosɛpɛw Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Mede sanku beyi wo ayɛ,Onyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn.
english:
Then I will go to the altar of God,
    to God, my joy and my delight.
I will praise you with the lyre,
    O God, my God.

twi: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.
english:
Why, my soul, are you downcast?
    Why so disturbed within me?
Put your hope in God,
    for I will yet praise him,
    my Savior and my God.

twi: Dwom Koramma “maskil” dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛde yɛn aso ate;yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn;nea woyɛɛ wɔ wɔn bere so,wɔ tete mmere no mu.
english:
We have heard it with our ears, O God;
    our ancestors have told us
what you did in their days,
    in days long ago.

twi: Wode wo nsa pam amanaman nona wobɔɔ yɛn agyanom atenase;wodwerɛw nnipa nona womaa yɛn agyanom dii yiye.
english:
With your hand you drove out the nations
    and planted our ancestors;
you crushed the peoples
    and made our ancestors flourish.

twi: Ɛnyɛ wɔn afoa na wɔde nyaa asase no,na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsa na ɛmaa wɔn nkonimdi;ɛyɛ wo nsa nifa, wo basa,ne wʼanim hann, efisɛ na wodɔ wɔn.
english:
It was not by their sword that they won the land,
    nor did their arm bring them victory;
it was your right hand, your arm,
    and the light of your face, for you loved them.

twi: Woyɛ me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn,nea ɔhyɛ nkonimdi ma Yakob.
english:
You are my King and my God,
    who decrees victories for Jacob.

twi: Ɛnam wo so na yɛpam yɛn Atamfo;wo din mu na yetiatia wɔn a wokyi yɛn no so.
english:
Through you we push back our enemies;
    through your name we trample our foes.

twi: Memmfa me ho nto mʼagyan so,mʼafoa remfa nkonimdi mmrɛ me;
english:
I put no trust in my bow,
    my sword does not bring me victory;

twi: na wo na woma yedi yɛn atamfo sowugu wɔn a wɔtan yɛn no anim ase.
english:
but you give us victory over our enemies,
    you put our adversaries to shame.

twi: Onyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa,na yɛbɛkamfo wo din no daa daa.
english:
In God we make our boast all day long,
    and we will praise your name forever.

twi: Nanso mprempren woapo yɛn abrɛ yɛn ase;wone yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio.
english:
But now you have rejected and humbled us;
    you no longer go out with our armies.

twi: Woma yeguan fii dɔm anim,ma yɛn atamfo fom yɛn agyapade.
english:
You made us retreat before the enemy,
    and our adversaries have plundered us.

twi: Wuyii yɛn maa sɛ wonkum yɛn sɛ nguanna woahwete yɛn wɔ amanaman no mu.
english:
You gave us up to be devoured like sheep
    and have scattered us among the nations.

twi: Wotɔn wo nkurɔfo fofoofow,na woannya mfaso biara amfi mu.
english:
You sold your people for a pittance,
    gaining nothing from their sale.

twi: Woayɛ yɛn ahohorade ama yɛn afipamfo,animtiaabude ne aserewde ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.
english:
You have made us a reproach to our neighbors,
    the scorn and derision of those around us.

twi: Woayɛ yɛn kasabebui wɔ aman no muna nnipa no wosow wɔn ti de gu yɛn so.
english:
You have made us a byword among the nations;
    the peoples shake their heads at us.

twi: Mʼanimguase di mʼanim daa,na aniwu akata mʼanim,
english:
I live in disgrace all day long,
    and my face is covered with shame

twi: esiane wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora na wɔkasa tia me de yi me ahi,esiane ɔtamfo a nʼani abere sɛ ɔbɛtɔ were no nti.
english:
at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me,
    because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

twi: Eyinom nyinaa too yɛn de,nanso yɛn werɛ mfii wo,na yemmuu wʼapam no nso so ɛ.
Yɛn koma ntwe mfii wo ho;na yɛn anan nso mman mfii wo kwan so ɛ.
english:
Our hearts had not turned back;
    our feet had not strayed from your path.

twi: Nanso wodwerɛw yɛn yɛɛ yɛn sakraman tuna wode sum kabii kataa yɛn so.
english:
But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals;
    you covered us over with deep darkness.

twi: Sɛ na yɛn werɛ afi yɛn Nyankopɔn dinanaa sɛ yɛatrɛw yɛn nsam akyerɛ ananafo nyame a,
english:
If we had forgotten the name of our God
    or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

twi: anka Onyankopɔn behu,efisɛ onim koma mu ahintasɛm.
english:
would not God have discovered it,
    since he knows the secrets of the heart?

twi: Nanso wo nti wokum yɛn daa nyinaa;wobu yɛn sɛ nguan a wɔrekokum wɔn.
english:
Yet for your sake we face death all day long;
    we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

twi: Nyan, Awurade! Adɛn nti na woada?Keka wo ho! Nnyaw yɛn hɔ afebɔɔ.
english:
Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep?
    Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

twi: Adɛn nti na wode wʼanim ahintawna wo werɛ fi yɛn ahohia ne nhyɛso?
english:
Why do you hide your face
    and forget our misery and oppression?

twi: Wɔabrɛ yɛn ase kɔ dɔte muna yɛn nipadua aka afam dɔte.
english:
We are brought down to the dust;
    our bodies cling to the ground.

twi: Sɔre bɛboa yɛn;wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nti, gye yɛn.
english:
Rise up and help us;
    rescue us because of your unfailing love.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom. Ayeforohyia dwom.Botae bi a edi mu akanyan me komabere a merebɔ ɔhene mmran no;me tɛkrɛma yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo kunini bi kyerɛwdua.
Wudi mu koraa wɔ mmarima muna wɔde adom bi asra wʼano,esiane sɛ Onyankopɔn ahyira wo afebɔɔ no nti.
english:
You are the most excellent of men
    and your lips have been anointed with grace,
    since God has blessed you forever.

twi: Fa wʼafoa bɔ wo nkyɛn mu, okokuroko;fa anuonyam ne kɛseyɛ fura.
english:
Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one;
    clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

twi: Fa wo kɛseyɛ mu kɔ wʼanim nkonimdi sowɔ nokware, ahobrɛase ne trenee mu;ma wo nsa nifa nna wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa no adi.
Ma wo bɛmma nnamnam no nhwirew ɔhene atamfo koma mu;na ma amanaman nhwe wʼanan ase.
english:
Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies;
    let the nations fall beneath your feet.

twi: Ao Onyankopɔn, wʼahengua no bɛtena hɔ daa daa;trenee ahempema bɛyɛ wʼahenni no ahempema.
english:
Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever;
    a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

twi: Wodɔ trenee na wukyi bɔne.Ɛno nti Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn de wo asi wo mfɛfo so,na ɔde anigye ngo asra wo.
Kurobow, pɛprɛ ne bɛwewonua hua agye wo batakari mu nyinaa;sanku so nnwom a efi ahemfi a wɔde asonse asiesie ho muma wʼani gye.
Ahemfo mmabea ka wo mmea atitiriw ho;wo nsa nifa so na ayeforo dehye a ɔhyɛ Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ gyina.
english:
Daughters of kings are among your honored women;
    at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

twi: Ɔbabea tie, dwene ho, na yɛ osetie;ma wo werɛ mfi wo nkurɔfo ne wo papa fi.
english:
Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention:
    Forget your people and your father’s house.

twi: Wʼahoɔfɛ asɔ ɔhene no ani;di no ni, efisɛ ɔno ne wo wura.
english:
Let the king be enthralled by your beauty;
    honor him, for he is your lord.

twi: Tiro Babea de ayɛyɛde bɛba;mmarima adefo bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ wo.
english:
The city of Tyre will come with a gift,
    people of wealth will seek your favor.

twi: Ɔhene babea a ɔwɔ ne pia mu no yɛ onuonyamfowɔde sikakɔkɔɔ abobɔ nʼatade yuu mu.
english:
All glorious is the princess within her chamber;
    her gown is interwoven with gold.

twi: Ɔhyɛ ntade a wɔadi mu adwinni na wɔde no kɔma ɔhene;ne mfɛfo mmabun di nʼakyina wɔde wɔn nyinaa brɛ wo.
Wɔde ahosɛpɛw ne anigye kɔ mu;wɔhyɛn ɔhempɔn no ahemfi.
english:
Led in with joy and gladness,
    they enter the palace of the king.

twi: Wo mmabarima besi wʼagyanom anan muwobɛyɛ wɔn mmapɔmma wɔ asase no so nyinaa.
english:
Your sons will take the place of your fathers;
    you will make them princes throughout the land.

twi: Mɛma wɔakae wo wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu;ɛno nti amanaman bɛkamfo wo daa nyinaa.
english:
I will perpetuate your memory through all generations;
    therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom. Wɔto no “alamot” sanku nne so.Onyankopɔn ne yɛn guankɔbea ne yɛn ahoɔden,amanehunu mu boafo a ɔwɔ hɔ bere biara.
english:
God is our refuge and strength,
    an ever-present help in trouble.

twi: Enti sɛ asase ani dan butuw,na mmepɔw tutu kogu po ase a, yɛrensuro,
english:
Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way
    and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

twi: sɛ po bɔ asorɔkye na ehuruna ɛma nkoko wosow mpo a, yɛrensuro.
english:
though its waters roar and foam
    and the mountains quake with their surging.

twi: Asuten bi wɔ hɔ ane nsuwansuwa de anigye ba Onyankopɔn kuropɔn mu,beae kronkron a Ɔsorosoroni no te.
english:
There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God,
    the holy place where the Most High dwells.

twi: Onyankopɔn te kuropɔn no mu, na ɔrenhwe ase;Onyankopɔn bɛboa no anɔpahema.
english:
God is within her, she will not fall;
    God will help her at break of day.

twi: Amanaman yɛ hoo, na ahenni hwehwe ase;ɔma ne nne so ma asase nan.
english:
Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall;
    he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

twi: Asafo Awurade ka yɛn ho.Yakob Nyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban.
english:
The Lord Almighty is with us;
    the God of Jacob is our fortress.

twi: Bra bɛhwɛ Awurade nnwuma,ɔsɛe a ɔde aba asase no so.
english:
Come and see what the Lord has done,
    the desolations he has brought on the earth.

twi: Ɔma akodi gyae kosi asase ano.Obubu agyan mu na ɔsɛe peaw;ɔde ogya hyew nkatabo.
english:
He makes wars cease
    to the ends of the earth.
He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;
    he burns the shields with fire.

twi: Monyɛ komm na munhu sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn;wɔbɛma me so wɔ amanaman no mu,wɔbɛma me so wɔ asase so.
Asafo Awurade ka yɛn ho;Yakob Nyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban.
english:
The Lord Almighty is with us;
    the God of Jacob is our fortress.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Amanaman nyinaa, mommɔ mo nsam;momfa anigye nteɛ mu mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.
english:
Clap your hands, all you nations;
    shout to God with cries of joy.

twi: Awurade Ɔsorosoroni no ho yɛ nwonwa,Ɔyɛ Ɔhene kɛse wɔ asase nyinaa so!
english:
For the Lord Most High is awesome,
    the great King over all the earth.

twi: Ɔde amanaman hyɛɛ yɛn ase,na ɔde nnipa hyɛɛ yɛn anan ase.
english:
He subdued nations under us,
    peoples under our feet.

twi: Oyii yɛn agyapade maa yɛn,nea ɛyɛ Yakob a ɔdɔ no no ahohoahoade.
english:
He chose our inheritance for us,
    the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.

twi: Onyankopɔn aforo kɔ soro wɔ anigye nteɛteɛmu mu,Awurade wɔ torobɛnto nnyigyei mu.
english:
God has ascended amid shouts of joy,
    the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.

twi: To ayeyi nnwom ma Onyankopɔn, to ayeyi nnwom;to ayeyi nnwom ma yɛn Hene, to ayeyi nnwom.
english:
Sing praises to God, sing praises;
    sing praises to our King, sing praises.

twi: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ asase nyinaa so Hene.Monto ahurusi nnwom mma no.
english:
For God is the King of all the earth;
    sing to him a psalm of praise.

twi: Onyankopɔn di hene wɔ amanaman no so;Onyankopɔn te nʼahengua kronkron so.
english:
God reigns over the nations;
    God is seated on his holy throne.

twi: Amanaman no mu akunini boaboa wɔn ho anosɛ Abraham Nyankopɔn nkurɔfo,efisɛ asase so ahemfo yɛ Onyankopɔn de;na wɔma no so kɛse.
english:
The nobles of the nations assemble
    as the people of the God of Abraham,
for the kings of the earth belong to God;
    he is greatly exalted.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse na ɔsɛ nkamfo,wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn kuropɔn mu, ne bepɔw kronkron so.
english:
Great is the Lord, and most worthy of praise,
    in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

twi: Ne sorokɔ ma ɛyɛ fɛ,ɛyɛ wiase nyinaa anigyede.Bepɔw Sion te sɛ Safon sorɔnsorɔmmea,Ɔhenkɛse no kuropɔn.
english:
Beautiful in its loftiness,
    the joy of the whole earth,
like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion,
    the city of the Great King.

twi: Onyankopɔn te nʼabankɛse muwada ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ nʼabandennen.
english:
God is in her citadels;
    he has shown himself to be her fortress.

twi: Bere a ahemfo yi boaa wɔn ho ano,na wotuu ɔsa bɔɔ mu no,
english:
When the kings joined forces,
    when they advanced together,

twi: wohuu no ma ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwiriw,na wɔde ehu guanee.
english:
they saw her and were astounded;
    they fled in terror.

twi: Wɔbɔɔ huboa wɔ hɔ,ɔyaw a ɛte sɛ ɔbea a awo aka no.
english:
Trembling seized them there,
    pain like that of a woman in labor.

twi: Wosɛe wɔn sɛ Tarsis ahyɛn aapuei mframa abɔ adwira wɔn.
english:
You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish
    shattered by an east wind.

twi: Sɛnea yɛate no,saa ara na yɛahuwɔ Asafo Awurade kuropɔn no mu,yɛn Nyankopɔn kuropɔn mu;Onyankopɔn ma etim hɔ afebɔɔ.
english:
As we have heard,
    so we have seen
in the city of the Lord Almighty,
    in the city of our God:
God makes her secure
    forever.

twi: Wʼasɔredan no mu; Ao, Onyankopɔn,na yɛdwene wo dɔ a enni huammɔ da no ho,
english:
Within your temple, O God,
    we meditate on your unfailing love.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, wʼayeyi du asase anote sɛ wo din te;trenee ayɛ wo nsa nifa mu ma.
Sion bepɔw di ahurusi,Yuda nkuraase no ani gyeesiane wʼatemmu no nti.
english:
Mount Zion rejoices,
    the villages of Judah are glad
    because of your judgments.

twi: Nantew Sion na twa ho hyia,kan nʼabantenten dodow,
english:
Walk about Zion, go around her,
    count her towers,

twi: dwene nʼafasu ho yiye,hwɛ nʼabankɛse no,na woaka ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma.
english:
consider well her ramparts,
    view her citadels,
that you may tell of them
    to the next generation.

twi: Saa Onyankopɔn yi yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn daa daa;ɔbɛyɛ yɛn kwankyerɛfo akosi awiei mpo.
english:
For this God is our God for ever and ever;
    he will be our guide even to the end.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Muntie, mo saa nnipa yi nyinaa;monyɛ aso, mo a mowɔ wiase yi mu nyinaa,
english:
Hear this, all you peoples;
    listen, all who live in this world,

twi: nea ɔyɛ abomfiaa ne nea odi mu,adefo ne ahiafo nyinaa.
english:
both low and high,
    rich and poor alike:

twi: Mʼano bɛka anyansasɛm;nsɛm a efi me koma mu bɛma nhumu.
english:
My mouth will speak words of wisdom;
    the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.

twi: Mɛbrɛ mʼaso ase atie mmebusɛm;na sanku na mede bɛkyerɛ mʼabisae ase.
english:
I will turn my ear to a proverb;
    with the harp I will expound my riddle:

twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ misuro, bere a nna bɔne aba,bere a amumɔyɛfo nnaadaafo atwa me ho ahyia,
english:
Why should I fear when evil days come,
    when wicked deceivers surround me—

twi: wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ahonya sona wɔde wɔn ade dodow hoahoa wɔn ho?
english:
those who trust in their wealth
    and boast of their great riches?

twi: Onipa biara rentumi nnye ne yɔnko nkwana ɔrentumi mfa mpata biara mma Onyankopɔn,
english:
No one can redeem the life of another
    or give to God a ransom for them—

twi: nkwa ho mpata bo yɛ den,akatua biara renso,
english:
the ransom for a life is costly,
    no payment is ever enough—

twi: sɛ ɛbɛma no atena ase afebɔɔa ɔrenhu porɔwee.
english:
so that they should live on forever
    and not see decay.

twi: Obiara nim pefee sɛ anyansafo wu;saa ara na nkwaseafo ne agyimifo nso wu,na wogyaw wɔn ahonya hɔ ma afoforo.
english:
For all can see that the wise die,
    that the foolish and the senseless also perish,
    leaving their wealth to others.

twi: Wɔn nna bɛyɛ wɔn afi afebɔɔ,wɔn atenae wɔ awo ntoatoaso bere a enni awiei mu,ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔde wɔn din atoto nsase so.
english:
Their tombs will remain their houses forever,
    their dwellings for endless generations,
    though they had named lands after themselves.

twi: Na onipa ahonya nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentena hɔ daa;ɔte sɛ mmoa a wowu no ara.
english:
People, despite their wealth, do not endure;
    they are like the beasts that perish.

twi: Eyi ne nea ɛda hɔ ma wɔn a wogye wɔn ho di,ne wɔn akyidifo a wɔfoa wɔn nsɛm so.
english:
This is the fate of those who trust in themselves,
    and of their followers, who approve their sayings.

twi: Wɔte sɛ nguan, na wɔbɛkɔ ɔda mu,na owu de wɔn bɛyɛ nʼaduan.Atreneefo bedi wɔn so anɔpa;wɔn nipadua bɛporɔw wɔ ɔda mu,na wɔne wɔn adan akɛse no ntam akwan bɛware.
english:
They are like sheep and are destined to die;
    death will be their shepherd
    (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning).
Their forms will decay in the grave,
    far from their princely mansions.

twi: Nanso Onyankopɔn begye me afi ɔda mu;ampa ara, ɔde me bɛkɔ ne nkyɛn.
english:
But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead;
    he will surely take me to himself.

twi: Sɛ onipa nya ne ho a, mma ɛnnhaw wo;na sɛ ne fi anigye yɛ bebree a, mma ɛnnhaw wo;
english:
Do not be overawed when others grow rich,
    when the splendor of their houses increases;

twi: efisɛ, sɛ owu a ɔremmfa hwee nkɔ,nʼanuonyam ne no renkɔ amoa mu.
english:
for they will take nothing with them when they die,
    their splendor will not descend with them.

twi: Mpo ɔte ase no, ɔfaa no sɛ wɔahyira no,efisɛ wɔkamfo nnipa bere a wodi yiye,
english:
Though while they live they count themselves blessed—
    and people praise you when you prosper—

twi: nanso ɔbɛkɔ akɔka nʼagyanom ho,wɔn a wɔrenhu nkwa hann ara da no.
english:
they will join those who have gone before them,
    who will never again see the light of life.

twi: Onipa a ɔwɔ ahonya na onni nhumu note sɛ mmoa a wowu.
english:
People who have wealth but lack understanding
    are like the beasts that perish.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Tweduampɔn, Onyankopɔn, Awurade no kasa,na ɔfrɛ asase nyinaaefi apuei kosi atɔe.
english:
The Mighty One, God, the Lord,
    speaks and summons the earth
    from the rising of the sun to where it sets.

twi: Onyankopɔn hyerɛn fi Sionkurow a ne fɛ wie pɛyɛ.
english:
From Zion, perfect in beauty,
    God shines forth.

twi: Yɛn Nyankopɔn reba nanso ɔrenyɛ komm;ogya a ɛhyew nneɛma di nʼanim,ahum a ɛretu atwa ne ho ahyia.
english:
Our God comes
    and will not be silent;
a fire devours before him,
    and around him a tempest rages.

twi: Ɔfrɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase,sɛ ɔrebu ne nkurɔfo atɛn;
english:
He summons the heavens above,
    and the earth, that he may judge his people:

twi: Ɔka se, “Boaboa nnipa a wɔatew wɔn ho no ano ma me;wɔn a wɔnam afɔrebɔ so ne me yɛɛ apam no.”
english:
“Gather to me this consecrated people,
    who made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

twi: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee,na Onyankopɔn ankasa ne otemmufo.
english:
And the heavens proclaim his righteousness,
    for he is a God of justice.

twi: “Muntie, me nkurɔfo, na mɛkasa,medi adanse atia wo, Israel;Mene Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn no.
Merenka mo anim wɔ mo afɔrebɔdeanaa mo hyew afɔre a ɛwɔ mʼanim daa no ho.
english:
I bring no charges against you concerning your sacrifices
    or concerning your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

twi: Anantwinini a wofi mo mfuw soanaa mpapo a wofi mo buw mu ho nhia me,
english:
I have no need of a bull from your stall
    or of goats from your pens,

twi: efisɛ kwae mu aboa biara yɛ me de,anantwi a wɔwɔ nkoko mpempem so nso saa ara.
english:
for every animal of the forest is mine,
    and the cattle on a thousand hills.

twi: Minim anomaa biara a ɔwɔ mmepɔw no so,na wuram abɔde nyinaa yɛ me de.
english:
I know every bird in the mountains,
    and the insects in the fields are mine.

twi: Sɛ ɔkɔm dee me a, anka merenka nkyerɛ mo;efisɛ, wiase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ me de.
english:
If I were hungry I would not tell you,
    for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

twi: Mewe anantwinini nam,na menom mpapo mogya ana?
english:
Do I eat the flesh of bulls
    or drink the blood of goats?

twi: Momfa aseda afɔre mma Onyankopɔn,na munni bɔ a mohyɛɛ Ɔsorosoroni no so,
english:
“Sacrifice thank offerings to God,
    fulfill your vows to the Most High,

twi: na momfrɛ me hiada;na megye mo na moahyɛ me anuonyam.”
english:
and call on me in the day of trouble;
    I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

twi: Nanso amumɔyɛfo de, Onyankopɔn bisa wɔn se,“Adɛn nti na moka me mmarana mʼapam da mo ano?
english:
But to the wicked person, God says:
“What right have you to recite my laws
    or take my covenant on your lips?

twi: Mukyi me nkyerɛkyerɛ,na motow me nsɛm gu mo akyi.
english:
You hate my instruction
    and cast my words behind you.

twi: Sɛ muhu ɔkorɔmfo a mode mo ho bɔ no;na mo ne nguaman nso bɔ.
english:
When you see a thief, you join with him;
    you throw in your lot with adulterers.

twi: Mode mo ano yɛ bɔne,na mode mo tɛkrɛma boaboa nnaadaa ano.
english:
You use your mouth for evil
    and harness your tongue to deceit.

twi: Mokasa tia mo nuabarima bere biarana mosopa mo ankasa na ba.
english:
You sit and testify against your brother
    and slander your own mother’s son.

twi: Moayɛ eyinom nyinaa; nanso manka hwee,enti mususuw sɛ mete sɛ mo.Nanso mɛka mo anim,na mede mo sobo asi mo anim.
english:
When you did these things and I kept silent,
    you thought I was exactly like you.
But I now arraign you
    and set my accusations before you.

twi: “Munnwen eyi ho, mo a mo werɛ fi Onyankopɔn,anyɛ saa a, mɛtetew mo mu nketenkete a obiara remmegye mo;
english:
“Consider this, you who forget God,
    or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

twi: Nea ɔbɔ aseda afɔre no hyɛ me anuonyam,na osiesie kwansɛnea mɛda Onyankopɔn nkwagye adi akyerɛ no.”
english:
Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me,
    and to the blameless I will show my salvation.”

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo no bere a ɔde ne ho kaa Batseba na odiyifo Natan kɔɔ ne nkyɛn no.Ao, Onyankopɔn hu me mmɔbɔ,sɛnea wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no te;wʼahummɔbɔ kɛse no nti,pepa me mmarato.
english:
Have mercy on me, O God,
    according to your unfailing love;
according to your great compassion
    blot out my transgressions.

twi: Hohoro mʼamumɔyɛ nyinaana tew me ho fi me bɔne mu!
english:
Wash away all my iniquity
    and cleanse me from my sin.

twi: Na mahu me mmarato,na mekae me bɔne daa.
english:
For I know my transgressions,
    and my sin is always before me.

twi: Mayɛ mfomso atia wo; atia wo nko arana mayɛ nea ɛyɛ bɔne wɔ wʼani so,enti wudi bem wɔ wʼatemmu muna woteɛ wɔ wʼatemmu mu.
english:
Against you, you only, have I sinned
    and done what is evil in your sight;
so you are right in your verdict
    and justified when you judge.

twi: Ampa ara wɔwoo me wɔ bɔne mu,na bɔne mu na me na nyinsɛn me.
english:
Surely I was sinful at birth,
    sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

twi: Ampa ara nokware na wohwehwɛ wɔ me mu.Wokyerɛ me nyansa a mu dɔ.
english:
Yet you desired faithfulness even in the womb;
    you taught me wisdom in that secret place.

twi: Fa adwerɛ hohoro me ho, na me ho afi;guare me, na mɛhoa asen sukyerɛmma.
english:
Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean;
    wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

twi: Ma mente ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nka;na ma nnompe a woabubu no nni ahurusi.
english:
Let me hear joy and gladness;
    let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

twi: Kata wʼani wɔ me bɔne hona pepa mʼamumɔyɛ nyinaa.
english:
Hide your face from my sins
    and blot out all my iniquity.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, bɔ koma a mu tew wɔ me mu,na yɛ honhom a atim no foforo wɔ me mu.
english:
Create in me a pure heart, O God,
