    and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

twi: Mpam me mfi wʼanim,na nyi wo Honhom Kronkron mfi me mu.
english:
Do not cast me from your presence
    or take your Holy Spirit from me.

twi: Fa wo nkwagye mu anigye no ma me bio,na ma me ɔpɛ honhom a ɛbɛma magyina.
english:
Restore to me the joy of your salvation
    and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

twi: Afei mɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfo wʼakwan,na amumɔyɛfo bɛsan aba wo nkyɛn.
english:
Then I will teach transgressors your ways,
    so that sinners will turn back to you.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me fi mogya ho afɔdi mu.Onyame a wugye me nkwa,na me tɛkrɛma bɛto wo trenee ho dwom.
english:
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God,
    you who are God my Savior,
    and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

twi: Awurade, bue mʼano fafa,na mede mʼano bɛpae mu aka wʼayeyi.
english:
Open my lips, Lord,
    and my mouth will declare your praise.

twi: Wompɛ afɔrebɔ, anka mɛbɔ;wʼani nnye ɔhyew afɔre ho.
english:
You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it;
    you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

twi: Onyankopɔn afɔre yɛ honhom a abotow,Onyankopɔn,worempo ahonu ne ahobrɛase koma.
Ma ɛnyɛ wo fɛ sɛ wobɛma Sion anya nkɔso wɔ wʼanigye mu;na woasi Yerusalem afasu.
english:
May it please you to prosper Zion,
    to build up the walls of Jerusalem.

twi: Afei wʼani begye ɔtreneeni afɔrebɔ ho,ɔhyew afɔre a edi mu;na wɔde anantwinini bɛbɔ afɔre wʼafɔremuka so.

Dwom Dawid “maskil” dwom. Ɔtoo bere a Edomni Doeg bɛka kyerɛɛ Saulo se, “Dawid akɔ Ahimelek fi” no.Ɔkɛse, adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho wɔ wo bɔne ho?Adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho da mu nyinaa,wo a woyɛ animguasede wɔ Onyankopɔn ani so?
english:
Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero?
    Why do you boast all day long,
    you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

twi: Wo tɛkrɛma bɔ ɔsɛe ho pɔw;ɛte sɛ oyiwan a ano yɛ nam yiye.Wo a wutwa nkontompo nko ara.
Wʼani gye bɔne ho sen papa,wopɛ atoro sen sɛ wobɛka nokware.
english:
You love evil rather than good,
    falsehood rather than speaking the truth.

twi: Wodɔ asɛm biara a ɛde ɔhaw ba,wo tɛkrɛma daadaafo!
english:
You love every harmful word,
    you deceitful tongue!

twi: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn de ɔsɛe a enni awiei bɛbrɛ wo;ɔbɛtwe wo afi wo ntamadan mu na watetew wo mu;Ɔbɛtɔre wʼase wɔ ateasefo asase so.
Atreneefo behu eyi na wɔasuro;wɔbɛserew no na wɔaka se,
english:
The righteous will see and fear;
    they will laugh at you, saying,

twi: “Hwɛ, onipa no ni,nea wamfa Onyankopɔn anyɛ nʼabandennenna mmom ɔde ne ho too nʼahonya dodow so,na onyaa ahoɔden de sɛee afoforo no!”
english:
“Here now is the man
    who did not make God his stronghold
but trusted in his great wealth
    and grew strong by destroying others!”

twi: Nanso mete sɛ ngodua aɛrenyin wɔ Onyankopɔn fi:mede me ho to Onyankopɔn dɔ a ɛnsa da no sodaa nyinaa.
english:
But I am like an olive tree
    flourishing in the house of God;
I trust in God’s unfailing love
    for ever and ever.

twi: Meyi wo ayɛ daa wɔ nea woayɛ nti;wo din so na mʼani bɛda, efisɛ eye.Meyi wo ayɛ wɔ wʼahotefo anim.
english:
For what you have done I will always praise you
    in the presence of your faithful people.
And I will hope in your name,
    for your name is good.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ɔkwasea ka wɔ ne koma mu se,“Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.”Porɔwee adi wɔn, na wɔn akwan yɛ animguase.Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.
english:
The fool says in his heart,
    “There is no God.”
They are corrupt, and their ways are vile;
    there is no one who does good.

twi: Onyankopɔn fi ɔsoro hwɛ adesamma wɔ famsɛ obehu wɔn mu bi awɔwɔ ntease,anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.
english:
God looks down from heaven
    on all mankind
to see if there are any who understand,
    any who seek God.

twi: Nanso nnipa nyinaa atwe wɔn ho afi Onyankopɔn ho;wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne.Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.Ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
Enti abɔnefo rensua nyansa ana?Wɔwe me nkurɔfo sɛnea nnipa di aduan.Wonnsu mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.
Wɔn na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ huboawɔ faako a ehu nni.Onyankopɔn hwetee wɔn a wɔtow hyɛɛ wo so no nnompe mu;wuguu wɔn anim ase, efisɛ Onyankopɔn buu wɔn animtiaa.
english:
But there they are, overwhelmed with dread,
    where there was nothing to dread.
God scattered the bones of those who attacked you;
    you put them to shame, for God despised them.

twi: Ao, Israel nkwagye mfi Sion mmra!Awurade bɛsan de ne nkurɔfo agyapade ama wɔn.Na Yakob adi ahurusi, na Israel ani agye!
english:
Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion!
    When God restores his people,
    let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

twi: Dwom Dawid “maskil” dwom. Ɔtoo no bere a Sififo kɔka kyerɛɛ Saulo se, “Dawid abehintaw wɔ yɛn mu.”Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me wɔ wo din mu;fa wo tumi bu me bem.
english:
Save me, O God, by your name;
    vindicate me by your might.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ;tie mʼanom nsɛm.
english:
Hear my prayer, O God;
    listen to the words of my mouth.

twi: Ahɔho retow ahyɛ me so.Atirimɔdenfo rehwehwɛ me akum me;nnipa a wɔmmfa Onyankopɔn nyɛ hwee.
Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ne me boafo;Awurade ne me hwɛfo.
english:
Surely God is my help;
    the Lord is the one who sustains me.

twi: Ma mmusu nkyim mmra wɔn a wodi me ho nseku no so;wo nokwaredi mu, sɛe wɔn.
english:
Let evil recoil on those who slander me;
    in your faithfulness destroy them.

twi: Mefi me pɛ mu abɔ afɔre ama wo;Awurade, meyi wo din ayɛ,efisɛ eye.
english:
I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you;
    I will praise your name, Lord, for it is good.

twi: Woagye me afi me haw nyinaa mu,na mʼani ahu nkonimdi wɔ mʼatamfo so.
english:
You have delivered me from all my troubles,
    and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

twi: Dwom Dawid “maskil” dwom.Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ,mmu wʼani ngu me nkotosrɛ so,
english:
Listen to my prayer, O God,
    do not ignore my plea;

twi: tie me na gye me so.Me dadwen haw me na ama mayɛ basaa,
english:
hear me and answer me.
My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

twi: esiane nea me tamfo reka,esiane omumɔyɛfo ahunahuna nti;efisɛ wɔde amanehunu ba me so;na wofi wɔn abufuw mu kum me.
english:
because of what my enemy is saying,
    because of the threats of the wicked;
for they bring down suffering on me
    and assail me in their anger.

twi: Me koma wɔ ahoyeraw mu;na owu huboa aba me so.
english:
My heart is in anguish within me;
    the terrors of death have fallen on me.

twi: Ehu ne ahopopo akyekyere me.Ahodwiriw abu afa me so.
english:
Fear and trembling have beset me;
    horror has overwhelmed me.

twi: Mekae se, “Ao, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburu a,anka metu akɔ ama me ho atɔ me,
english:
I said, “Oh, that I had the wings of a dove!
    I would fly away and be at rest.

twi: anka metu akɔ akyirikyiriakɔtena sare so;
english:
I would flee far away
    and stay in the desert;

twi: anka mɛyɛ ntɛm akɔ me hintabea,faako a mframahweam ne ahum mmɛn koraa.”
english:
I would hurry to my place of shelter,
    far from the tempest and storm.”

twi: Awurade, ma amumɔyɛfo nyɛ basaa, na ma wɔn kasa ntoto,efisɛ mihu basabasayɛ ne aperepere wɔ kuropɔn no mu.
english:
Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words,
    for I see violence and strife in the city.

twi: Awia ne anadwo wɔtetɛw nʼafasu ho;adwemmɔne ne asisi wɔ mu.
english:
Day and night they prowl about on its walls;
    malice and abuse are within it.

twi: Adesɛefo dɔm reyɛ adwuma wɔ kuropɔn no mu.Ahunahuna ne nnaadaa wɔ ne mmɔnten so daa.
english:
Destructive forces are at work in the city;
    threats and lies never leave its streets.

twi: Sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔresopa me a,anka metumi agyina ano;sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔrema ne ho so atia me a,anka metumi de me ho ahintaw no.
Nanso ɛyɛ wo, ɔdesani te sɛ me,me yɔnko, mʼadamfo kann,
english:
But it is you, a man like myself,
    my companion, my close friend,

twi: a kan no na me ne no wɔ ayɔnkofa a mu yɛ denbere a yɛn nyinaa bɔɔ mu yuu kɔɔ Onyankopɔn fi na yɛka asomfo no ho no.
english:
with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship
    at the house of God,
as we walked about
    among the worshipers.

twi: Ma owu mmɛfa mʼatamfo mpofirim;ma wɔnkɔ ɔda mu anikann,efisɛ bɔne te wɔn mu.
Nanso misu frɛ Onyankopɔn,na Awurade gye me nkwa.
english:
As for me, I call to God,
    and the Lord saves me.

twi: Anwummere, anɔpa ne awia,mede mmɔborɔnne su frɛ no,na ɔte me nne.
english:
Evening, morning and noon
    I cry out in distress,
    and he hears my voice.

twi: Ɔde ne ho bɔ afɔre ma minya me ti didi muwɔ ako a wodi tia me no mu,mpo dodow na wɔsɔre tia me.
Onyankopɔn a wɔasi no hene afebɔɔ no,ɔbɛte wɔn nka na wahaw wɔn,ɔbɛhaw nnipa a wɔnsakra wɔn akwan dana wonsuro Onyankopɔn nso.
english:
God, who is enthroned from of old,
    who does not change—
he will hear them and humble them,
    because they have no fear of God.

twi: Me yɔnko tow hyɛ ne nnamfonom so;na obu nʼapam so.
english:
My companion attacks his friends;
    he violates his covenant.

twi: Ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmawo,nanso ɔtan wɔ ne koma mu.Nʼano asɛm dwudwo sen ngo,nanso ɛyɛ afoa a wɔatwe.
english:
His talk is smooth as butter,
    yet war is in his heart;
his words are more soothing than oil,
    yet they are drawn swords.

twi: Fa wo haw to Awurade sona ɔno na obegye wo;ɔremma ɔtreneeni nhwe ase.
english:
Cast your cares on the Lord
    and he will sustain you;
he will never let
    the righteous be shaken.

twi: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wobɛbrɛ amumɔyɛfo aseama wɔakɔ ɔporɔw amoa mu;mogyapɛfo ne nnaadaaforenni wɔn nkwanna mu fa.Nanso me de, mede me ho to wo so.
english:
But you, God, will bring down the wicked
    into the pit of decay;
the bloodthirsty and deceitful
    will not live out half their days.
But as for me, I trust in you.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a Filistifo kyeree no wɔ Gat no.Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ na nnipa taa me anibere so;da mu nyinaa womia wɔn taa no mu.
Wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora taa me da mu nyinaa;wɔn a wɔma wɔn ho so tia me no dɔɔso.
english:
My adversaries pursue me all day long;
    in their pride many are attacking me.

twi: Sɛ mebɔ hu a,mede me ho bɛto wo so.
english: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

twi: Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so, na merensuro.Dɛn na onipa desani betumi ayɛ me?
english:
In God, whose word I praise—
in God I trust and am not afraid.
    What can mere mortals do to me?

twi: Da mu nyinaa wogye mʼano si bɔne;bere biara wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me.
english:
All day long they twist my words;
    all their schemes are for my ruin.

twi: Wɔbɔ pɔw, wɔtetɛw,wɔhwɛ mʼanammɔntu,susuw sɛ wobekum me.
english:
They conspire, they lurk,
    they watch my steps,
    hoping to take my life.

twi: Wɔn amumɔyɛ nti mma wɔmmfa wɔn ho nni;Onyankopɔn, brɛ amanaman no ase wɔ wʼabufuw mu.
english:
Because of their wickedness do not let them escape;
    in your anger, God, bring the nations down.

twi: Kyerɛw me kwadwom to hɔ;sese me nusu wɔ wo nhoma mmobɔwee no mu.Enni nea woakyerɛw ato hɔ no mu ana?
Sɛ mepɛ mmoa fi wo hɔ a,mʼatamfo bɛsan wɔn akyi.Eyi bɛma mahu sɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ mʼafa.
english:
Then my enemies will turn back
    when I call for help.
    By this I will know that God is for me.

twi: Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,Awurade a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,
english:
In God, whose word I praise,
    in the Lord, whose word I praise—

twi: mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so; na merensuro.Dɛn na ɔdesani betumi ayɛ me?
english:
in God I trust and am not afraid.
    What can man do to me?

twi: Me Onyankopɔn, mehyɛ bɔ a mahyɛ wo no ase,mede mʼaseda afɔre bɛbrɛ wo.
english:
I am under vows to you, my God;
    I will present my thank offerings to you.

twi: Efisɛ, woagye me afi owu mu,na mʼanan anhintiw,na matumi anantew Onyankopɔn animwɔ nkwa hann no mu.
english:
For you have delivered me from death
    and my feet from stumbling,
that I may walk before God
    in the light of life.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a oguan fii Saulo nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔbodan no mu.Hu me mmɔbɔ, me Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ,na wo mu na me kra nya guankɔbea.Wo ntaban nwini ase na mɛpɛ guankɔbeakosi sɛ amanehunu no betwa mu.
english:
Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me,
    for in you I take refuge.
I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings
    until the disaster has passed.

twi: Misu frɛ Onyankopɔn, Ɔsorosoroni no;Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne pɛ ba mu wɔ me ho.
english:
I cry out to God Most High,
    to God, who vindicates me.

twi: Ɔsoma fi ɔsoro hɔ begye me nkwa,ɔka wɔn a wɔtaa me anibere so no anim;Onyankopɔn soma ne dɔ ne ne nokware.
english:
He sends from heaven and saves me,
    rebuking those who hotly pursue me—
    God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.

twi: Gyata atwa me ho ahyia;meda mmoa a wɔwe nam amono mu,nnipa a wɔn se te sɛ mpeaw ne mmɛmmana wɔn tɛkrɛma te sɛ afoa a ɛyɛ nnam.
english:
I am in the midst of lions;
    I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts—
men whose teeth are spears and arrows,
    whose tongues are sharp swords.

twi: Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro,na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.
english:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
    let your glory be over all the earth.

twi: Wɔtrɛw asau mu de sum mʼanan afiri,ahohiahia brɛɛ me ase.Wotuu amoa wɔ me kwan mu,nanso wɔn ankasa akɔtotɔ mu.
english:
They spread a net for my feet—
    I was bowed down in distress.
They dug a pit in my path—
    but they have fallen into it themselves.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, me koma agyina pintinn,me koma yɛ pintinn;mɛto dwom na mayi wo ayɛ.
Me kra nyan!Sanku ne bɛnta, munnyan!Me nso menyan anɔpahema.
english:
Awake, my soul!
    Awake, harp and lyre!
    I will awaken the dawn.

twi: Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu;mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa mu.
english:
I will praise you, Lord, among the nations;
    I will sing of you among the peoples.

twi: Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro;wo nokwaredi du wim.
english:
For great is your love, reaching to the heavens;
    your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, wɔmma wo so mmoro ɔsoro;ma wʼanuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so.
english:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
    let your glory be over all the earth.

twi: Dwom Dawid “miktam” dwom.So mo asodifo, ampa ara sɛ, moka asɛm a ɛteɛ ana?Mubu atɛntrenee wɔ nnipa mu ana?
english:
Do you rulers indeed speak justly?
    Do you judge people with equity?

twi: Dabi da! Modwene ntɛnkyew wɔ mo koma muna mo nsa de akakabensɛm ba asase so.
english:
No, in your heart you devise injustice,
    and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo fom kwan fi awo mu;wɔyɛ mmaratofo fi awotwaa mu na wodi atoro.
english:
Even from birth the wicked go astray;
    from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.

twi: Wɔn ano bɔre te sɛ ɔwɔ de,ɛte sɛ ɔprammiri a wawɛn nʼaso,
english:
Their venom is like the venom of a snake,
    like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

twi: a ɔnte ntafowayifo dwom,na ne dwom dɛdɛ no mpo mfa ne ho.
english:
that will not heed the tune of the charmer,
    however skillful the enchanter may be.

twi: Ao Onyankopɔn, bubu ɛse a egu wɔn anom,Awurade, tutu gyata no sebɔmmɔfo no gu!
english:
Break the teeth in their mouths, O God;
    Lord, tear out the fangs of those lions!

twi: Ma wontwa mu nkɔ sɛ sunsuan;sɛ wɔtwe wɔn agyan a, ma wɔn bɛmma no ano nwu.
english:
Let them vanish like water that flows away;
    when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.

twi: Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ nwaw horɔdɔhorɔdɔ bi a ɔrenan agu wɔ bere a ɔretene no.Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɔba a owu wɔ awoe a onhu owia koraa.
english:
May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along,
    like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.

twi: Ansa na mo nkuku bɛte nsɔe ano yaw,sɛ ɛyɛ amono anaa awo no, wɔbɛpra amumɔyɛfo akɔ.
english:
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns—
    whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.

twi: Sɛ wɔtɔ were ma atreneefo a wɔn ani begye,na wɔbɛhohoro wɔn anan ho wɔ amumɔyɛfo mogya mu.
english:
The righteous will be glad when they are avenged,
    when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.

twi: Afei nnipa bɛka se, “Ampa ara atreneefo kɔ so nya wɔn akatua;na ampa ara Onyankopɔn bi wɔ hɔ a obu wiase atɛn.”

Dwom Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Nsɛe No” sanku nne so. Dawid “miktam” dwom. Ɔtoo no bere a Saulo soma kɔwɛn Dawid fi sɛ wonkokum no no.Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me fi mʼatamfo nsam;bɔ me ho ban fi wɔn a wɔtaa me no ho.
english:
Deliver me from my enemies, O God;
    be my fortress against those who are attacking me.

twi: Gye me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam.Gye me nkwa fi mogyapɛfo nsam.
english:
Deliver me from evildoers
    and save me from those who are after my blood.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔatɛw rehwehwɛ me akum me!Nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ hu bɔ pɔw bɔne tia mea emfi me mfomso anaa bɔne bi, Awurade.
english:
See how they lie in wait for me!
    Fierce men conspire against me
    for no offense or sin of mine, Lord.

twi: Menyɛɛ mfomso bi, nanso wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ me so.Sɔre begye me; hwɛ mʼamanehunu!
english:
I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me.
    Arise to help me; look on my plight!

twi: Wo, Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn,ma wo ho so na twe amanaman no nyinaa aso;nhu amumɔyɛfo nkontompofo no mmɔbɔ.
english:
You, Lord God Almighty,
    you who are the God of Israel,
rouse yourself to punish all the nations;
    show no mercy to wicked traitors.

twi: Wɔsan ba anwummere,wɔbobɔ mu sɛ akraman,na wokyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.
english:
They return at evening,
    snarling like dogs,
    and prowl about the city.

twi: Hwɛ nea wɔfe fi wɔn anom,wɔn anofafa mu nsɛm ano yɛ nnam sɛ mfoa,na wosusuw se: “Hena na ɔbɛte yɛn nka?”
english:
See what they spew from their mouths—
    the words from their lips are sharp as swords,
    and they think, “Who can hear us?”

twi: Nanso wo Awurade, woserew wɔn;wudi saa aman no nyinaa ho fɛw.
english:
But you laugh at them, Lord;
    you scoff at all those nations.

twi: Wone mʼAhoɔden, mehwɛ wo kwan;wo, Onyankopɔn, ne mʼabandennen,
english:
You are my strength, I watch for you;
    you, God, are my fortress,

twi: me Nyankopɔn a metumi atweri no.Onyankopɔn bedi mʼanimna ɔbɛma mahwɛ wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora no haw.
english:
my God on whom I can rely.
God will go before me
    and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

twi: Nanso nkum wɔn, Awurade, yɛn nkatabo,na me nkurɔfo werɛ amfi wɔn.Wo tumi mu no tutu wɔn ase,na brɛ wɔn ase.
english:
But do not kill them, Lord our shield,
    or my people will forget.
In your might uproot them
    and bring them down.

twi: Bɔne a efi wɔn anom,ne wɔn ano nsɛm ntima wɔn ahomaso nkyekyere wɔn.Abususɛm a wɔka ne atoro a wotwa nti,
english:
For the sins of their mouths,
    for the words of their lips,
    let them be caught in their pride.
For the curses and lies they utter,

twi: sɛe wɔn wɔ abufuwhyew mu,kosi sɛ wɔn ase bɛtɔre.Afei ɛbɛma asase so mmaa nyinaa ahusɛ Onyankopɔn di Yakob so.
english:
consume them in your wrath,
    consume them till they are no more.
Then it will be known to the ends of the earth
    that God rules over Jacob.

twi: Wɔsan ba anwummere,wɔbobɔ mu sɛ akraman,na wokyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.
english:
They return at evening,
    snarling like dogs,
    and prowl about the city.

twi: Wokyinkyin pɛ aduanna sɛ wɔammee a, wosu bobɔ mu.
english:
They wander about for food
    and howl if not satisfied.

twi: Nanso mɛto wʼahoɔden ho dwom,mɛto wʼadɔe ho dwom anɔpa;efisɛ woyɛ mʼabandennen,me guankɔbea wɔ ahohia mmere mu.
Ao mʼAhoɔden, mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo;wo, Onyankopɔn, ne mʼabandennen, me Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔdɔ.

Dwom Dawid “Miktam” dwom. Wɔde yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ. Ɔtoo no bere a ɔne Aram Naharanfo ne Aram Zobafo koe na Yoab san kokum Edomfo mpem dumien wɔ Nkyene Bon mu no.Onyankopɔn, woapo yɛn, woabɔ yɛn agu;wo bo afuw yɛn, nanso gye yɛn bio!
english:
You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us;
    you have been angry—now restore us!

twi: Woawosow asase no na woapae mu;toatoa nea abubu no, efisɛ ɛrehinhim.
english:
You have shaken the land and torn it open;
    mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

twi: Woama wo nkurɔfo ahu mmere bɔne;woama yɛn nsa a ɛma yɛtɔ ntintan.
english:
You have shown your people desperate times;
    you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

twi: Nanso wɔn a wosuro wo de, woama wɔn frankaa sosɛ wontu ntia agyan no.
english:
But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner
    to be unfurled against the bow.

twi: Gye yɛn nkwa na fa wo nsa nifa boa yɛn,na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.
english:
Save us and help us with your right hand,
    that those you love may be delivered.

twi: Onyankopɔn akasa afi ne kronkronbea se,“Nkonim mu, mɛkyɛ Sekem mu,na masusuw Sukot bon no.
english:
God has spoken from his sanctuary:
    “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem
    and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

twi: Gilead yɛ me de; Manase nso saa ara;Efraim yɛ me dade kyɛw,Yuda yɛ mʼahempema.
Moab yɛ me guasɛn,Edom so na metow me mpaboa gu;na meteɛ mu nkonimdi so gu Filistifo so.”
Hena na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?Hena na obedi mʼanim akɔ Edom?
english:
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
    Who will lead me to Edom?

twi: Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛnna wo ne yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio ana?
english:
Is it not you, God, you who have now rejected us
    and no longer go out with our armies?

twi: Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfo no,na ɔdesani mmoa nka hwee.
english:
Give us aid against the enemy,
    for human help is worthless.

twi: Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yebedi nkonim,na obetiatia yɛn atamfo so.
english:
With God we will gain the victory,
    and he will trample down our enemies.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, tie me sufrɛ;tie me mpaebɔ.
english:
Hear my cry, O God;
    listen to my prayer.

twi: Mifi asase ano frɛ wo,mefrɛ wo, efisɛ me koma atɔ beraw;fa me kɔ ɔbotan a ɛware sen me no so.
Woayɛ me guankɔbea,aban a ɛyɛ den ma ɔtamfo no.
english:
For you have been my refuge,
    a strong tower against the foe.

twi: Me kɔn dɔ sɛ metena wo ntamadan no mu afebɔɔna manya guankɔbea wɔ wo ntaban nwini ase.
english:
I long to dwell in your tent forever
    and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.

twi: Woate me bɔ a mehyɛe no, Onyankopɔn;na wode wɔn a wosuro wo din no agyapade ama me.
english:
For you, God, have heard my vows;
    you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

twi: To ɔhene nkwanna mu bebree;na ne mfe mfi awo ntoatoaso nkodu awo ntoatoaso.
english:
Increase the days of the king’s life,
    his years for many generations.

twi: Ma onni hene wɔ Onyankopɔn anim daafa wʼadɔe ne wo nokware bɔ ne ho ban.
english:
May he be enthroned in God’s presence forever;
    appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.

twi: Afei mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din daana madi me bɔhyɛ so daa nyinaa.
english:
Then I will ever sing in praise of your name
    and fulfill my vows day after day.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Me kra wɔ ahomegye wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu;me nkwagye fi ne nkyɛn.
english:
Truly my soul finds rest in God;
    my salvation comes from him.

twi: Ampa, ɔyɛ me botan ne me nkwagye;ɔyɛ mʼabandennen, hwee renhinhim me da.
english:
Truly he is my rock and my salvation;
    he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

twi: Mobɛkɔ so ahyɛ onipa so akosi da bɛn,mo nyinaa besum me ahwe fam ana?Ɔfasu a akyea yi, ban a ɛrebu yi?
english:
How long will you assault me?
    Would all of you throw me down—
    this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

twi: Ampa, wɔayɛ adwene se wobetu noafi ne dibea a ɛkorɔn no so;wɔn ani gye atorodi ho.Wɔde wɔn ano hyirana wɔn koma mu de, wɔdome.
english:
Surely they intend to topple me
    from my lofty place;
    they take delight in lies.
With their mouths they bless,
    but in their hearts they curse.

twi: Yiw me kra, gye wʼahome wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu;na ne mu na mʼanidaso wɔ.
english:
Yes, my soul, find rest in God;
    my hope comes from him.

twi: Ampa, ɔyɛ me botan ne me nkwagye;ɔyɛ mʼabandennen, hwee renhinhim me.
english:
Truly he is my rock and my salvation;
    he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

twi: Me nkwagye ne mʼanuonyam gyina Onyankopɔn so;ɔyɛ me botan a ɛkorɔn, ne me guankɔbea.
english:
My salvation and my honor depend on God;
    he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

twi: Mo nnipa, momfa mo ho nto ne so daa;monka mo koma mu nsɛm nyinaa nkyerɛ no,efisɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn guankɔbea.
Nnipa nyinaa te sɛ home;akɛse ne nkumaa nyinaa nka hwee;sɛ wɔkari wɔn wɔ nsania so a, wɔnka hwee;wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu a wɔyɛ home nko.
english:
Surely the lowborn are but a breath,
    the highborn are but a lie.
If weighed on a balance, they are nothing;
    together they are only a breath.

twi: Mommfa mo ho nto asisi sona monnhoahoa mo ho akorɔnne ho;ɛwɔ mu sɛ mo ahonya dɔɔso de,nanso mommfa mo koma nto so.
english:
Do not trust in extortion
    or put vain hope in stolen goods;
though your riches increase,
    do not set your heart on them.

twi: Asɛm baako na Onyankopɔn aka,nsɛm abien na mate sɛ,wo, Onyankopɔn, na wowɔ ahoɔden,
english:
One thing God has spoken,
    two things I have heard:
“Power belongs to you, God,

twi: na wo, Awurade, na woyɛ adɔe,ampa ara wubetua obiara kasɛnea nʼadwuma te.

Dwom Dawid dwom. Bere a ɔwɔ Yuda Sare so no na ɔtoe.Wo, Onyankopɔn, ne me NyankopɔnMehwehwɛ wo anibere so;wo ho sukɔm de me kra,me nipadua ani agyina wo,wɔ asase a awo na asade nni mu so,faako a nsu nni.
english:
You, God, are my God,
    earnestly I seek you;
I thirst for you,
    my whole being longs for you,
in a dry and parched land
    where there is no water.

twi: Mahu wo wɔ Kronkronbea hɔmahu wo tumi ne wʼanuonyam.
english:
I have seen you in the sanctuary
    and beheld your power and your glory.

twi: Esiane sɛ wʼadɔe di mu sen nkwa ntimʼanofafa bɛhyɛ wo anuonyam.
english:
Because your love is better than life,
    my lips will glorify you.

twi: Sɛ mete ase yi, mɛkamfo wo,na wo din mu na mɛma me nsa so.
english:
I will praise you as long as I live,
    and in your name I will lift up my hands.

twi: Me kra bɛmee sɛnea wadi aduan papa bi;mede anofafa a ɛto dwom beyi wo ayɛ.
english:
I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods;
    with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

twi: Meda me mpa so a, mekae wo.Anadwo dasu mu nyinaa, midwen wo ho.
english:
On my bed I remember you;
    I think of you through the watches of the night.

twi: Efisɛ wone me boafo,wo ntaban ase nwini mu na mɛto dwom.
english:
Because you are my help,
    I sing in the shadow of your wings.

twi: Me kra bata wo ho;na wo nsa nifa kura me mu.
english:
I cling to you;
    your right hand upholds me.

twi: Wɔn a wɔpɛ me akum me no bɛsɛe;wɔbɛkɔ asase ase tɔnn.
english:
Those who want to kill me will be destroyed;
    they will go down to the depths of the earth.

twi: Wɔbɛdan wɔn ama afoana wɔbɛyɛ aduan ama sakraman.
english:
They will be given over to the sword
    and become food for jackals.

twi: Nanso ɔhene bedi ahurusi wɔ Onyankopɔn mu;wɔn a wɔka ntam wɔ Onyankopɔn din mu nyinaa bɛkamfo no,na wobemua atorofo ano.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Me Nyankopɔn, tie me, bere a mereka me haw;bɔ me kra ho ban fi ɔtamfo ahunahuna ho.
english:
Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint;
    protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

twi: Fa me sie fi amumɔyɛfo agyinatu ho,ne nnebɔneyɛfo pɔwbɔ ho.
english:
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked,
    from the plots of evildoers.

twi: Wɔsew wɔn tɛkrɛma sɛ afoana wɔde atirimɔden nsɛm sɔn sɛ mmɛmma werɛmfo.
english:
They sharpen their tongues like swords
    and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.

twi: Wofi ahintawee mu, tow bɔ onipa a ne ho nni asɛm;wɔtow bɔ no mpofirim a wonsuro.
english:
They shoot from ambush at the innocent;
    they shoot suddenly, without fear.

twi: Wɔhyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho nkuran wɔ wɔn amumɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ho,wɔka sɛnea wobesum wɔn mfiri asie;wɔka se, “Hena na obehu yɛn?”
Wɔbɔ ntɛnkyew ho pɔw na wɔka se,“Yɛayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛso nni koraa!”Ampa ara onipa koma ne nʼadwene yɛ anifere.
english:
They plot injustice and say,
    “We have devised a perfect plan!”
    Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.

twi: Nanso Onyankopɔn bɛto bɛmma abɔ wɔn;na wɔbɛhwe fam prɛko pɛ.
english:
But God will shoot them with his arrows;
    they will suddenly be struck down.

twi: Ɔbɛdan wɔn ankasa tɛkrɛma atia wɔnna ɔde wɔn aba ɔsɛe mu;na wɔn a wobehu wɔn nyinaa de animka bɛbɔ wɔn ti nko.
Adesamma nyinaa besuro;wɔbɛpae mu aka Onyankopɔn nnwumana wɔasusuw nea wayɛ ho.
Ma atreneefo nni ahurusi wɔ Awurade muna wɔmpɛ guankɔbea wɔ no mu;ma wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew nyinaa nyi no ayɛ!
Dwom Dawid dwom.Yɛn Nyankopɔn, ayeyi retwɛn wo wɔ Sion,na yebedi yɛn bɔ a yɛahyɛ wo no so.
english:
Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion;
    to you our vows will be fulfilled.

twi: Wo a woyɛ mpaebɔ tiefo,wo nkyɛn na nnipa nyinaa bɛba.
english:
You who answer prayer,
    to you all people will come.

twi: Bere a yɛn bɔne menee yɛn no,wo na wode yɛn mmarato kyɛɛ yɛn.
english:
When we were overwhelmed by sins,
    you forgave our transgressions.

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wuyi wɔnma wɔbɛn wo sɛ wɔntena wʼadiwo hɔ!Nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ wo fi ahyɛ yɛn ma,nea ɛwɔ wʼasɔredan kronkron mu no.
english:
Blessed are those you choose
    and bring near to live in your courts!
We are filled with the good things of your house,
    of your holy temple.

twi: Wode trenee nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma yɛn mmuae,Onyankopɔn, yɛn agyenkwa,asase so mmaa nyinaa anidasone po so akyirikyiri nso.
english:
You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds,
    God our Savior,
the hope of all the ends of the earth
    and of the farthest seas,

twi: Wonam wo tumi so yɛɛ mmepɔwde daa wʼahoɔden adi.
english:
who formed the mountains by your power,
    having armed yourself with strength,

twi: Wudwudwoo po asorɔkye ano,asorɔkye no mmobɔwee,ne amanaman no hooyɛ.
english:
who stilled the roaring of the seas,
    the roaring of their waves,
    and the turmoil of the nations.

twi: Wɔn a wɔte akyirikyiri no suro wʼanwonwade;faako a ade kye, nea anwummere yera,wofrɛ ahurusi nnwom wɔ hɔ.
Wohwɛ asase no gugu so nsu;woma no yɛ asase pa ma ɛboro so.Wode nsu hyɛ Onyankopɔn nsuwansuwa masɛnea ɛbɛma nnipa no aduan,efisɛ saa ne nea woahyɛ.
english:
You care for the land and water it;
    you enrich it abundantly.
The streams of God are filled with water
    to provide the people with grain,
    for so you have ordained it.

twi: Wofɔw nea woafuntum hɔ no fɔkyeena wokaa nkɔmoa no kataa so;wode nsu petee so ma no yɛɛ bɛtɛɛna wuhyiraa so afifide.
english:
You drench its furrows and level its ridges;
    you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

twi: Wode nnɔbae bebree wiee afe no,na wo nteaseɛnam yɛɛ ma buu so.
english:
You crown the year with your bounty,
    and your carts overflow with abundance.

twi: Sare so nwura dɔɔsona anigye baa nkoko so.
english:
The grasslands of the wilderness overflow;
    the hills are clothed with gladness.

twi: Nguankuw ahyɛ adidibea hɔ mana awi akata aku no so;wɔbɔ ose, to ahosɛpɛw dwom.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Asase nyinaa momfa ahosɛpɛw nteɛ mu mma Onyankopɔn!
english: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!

twi: Monto ne din anuonyamhyɛ ho dwom;momma nʼayeyi nyɛ anuonyamhyɛ!
english:
Sing the glory of his name;
    make his praise glorious.

twi: Munse Onyankopɔn sɛ, “Wo nneyɛe yɛ nwonwa dodo!Wo tumi so mmorosoa wʼatamfo nyinaa de osuro kotow wʼanim.
english:
Say to God, “How awesome are your deeds!
    So great is your power
    that your enemies cringe before you.

twi: Asase nyinaa kotow wo;wɔto ayeyi dwom ma wo,wɔto dwom kamfo wo din.”
Mommra mmɛhwɛ nea Onyankopɔn ayɛ;anwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.
english:
Come and see what God has done,
    his awesome deeds for mankind!

twi: Ɔmaa po yɛɛ asase kesee;wɔnantew twaa nsu nomommra mma yenni ahurusi wɔ no mu.
english:
He turned the sea into dry land,
    they passed through the waters on foot—
    come, let us rejoice in him.

twi: Ɔde ne tumi di hene daa daa,na ɔde nʼani nso hwɛ aman so.Mma atuatewfo nsɔre ntia no.
english:
He rules forever by his power,
    his eyes watch the nations—
    let not the rebellious rise up against him.

twi: Aman nyinaa, munhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn,momma wɔnte mo nkamfo no nnyigyei;
english:
Praise our God, all peoples,
    let the sound of his praise be heard;

twi: wahwɛ yɛn nkwa sona wamma yɛn anan anwatiri.
english:
he has preserved our lives
    and kept our feet from slipping.

twi: Na wo, Onyankopɔn, wosɔɔ yɛn hwɛe;na wonan yɛn sɛ dwetɛ.
english:
For you, God, tested us;
    you refined us like silver.

twi: Wode yɛn koguu afiasena wode nneɛma a ɛyɛ duru too yɛn akyi.
english:
You brought us into prison
    and laid burdens on our backs.

twi: Womaa yɛn atamfo twiw faa yɛn so;yɛfaa ogya ne nsu mu,nanso wode yɛn baa faako a nnepa abu so.
Mede ɔhyew afɔre bɛba wʼasɔredan muna madi bɔ a mahyɛ wo no so,
english:
I will come to your temple with burnt offerings
    and fulfill my vows to you—

twi: bɔ a mʼanofafa hyɛe, na mʼano kaabere a na mewɔ ɔhaw mu no.
english:
vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke
    when I was in trouble.

twi: Mede mmoa a wɔadɔ srade bɛbɔ afɔre ama wo;adwennini ayɛyɛde;mede anantwinini ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔre.
Mommra mmetie, mo a musuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa;momma menka nea wayɛ ama me nkyerɛ mo.
english:
Come and hear, all you who fear God;
    let me tell you what he has done for me.

twi: Mede mʼano su frɛɛ no;na me tɛkrɛma yii no ayɛ.
english:
I cried out to him with my mouth;
    his praise was on my tongue.

twi: Sɛ mede bɔne hyɛɛ me koma mu a,anka Awurade antie me.
english:
If I had cherished sin in my heart,
    the Lord would not have listened;

twi: Nanso nokware, Onyankopɔn atie me,wate me mpaebɔ.
english:
but God has surely listened
    and has heard my prayer.

twi: Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn,a wampo me mpaebɔna wanyi nʼadɔe amfi me so.
english:
Praise be to God,
    who has not rejected my prayer
    or withheld his love from me!

twi: Dwom Dwom.Onyankopɔn nnom yɛn na onhyira yɛnɔmma nʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,
english:
May God be gracious to us and bless us
    and make his face shine on us—

twi: na ɔmma wonhu nʼakwan wɔ asase so,ne ne nkwagye wɔ amanaman no nyinaa mu.
english:
so that your ways may be known on earth,
    your salvation among all nations.

twi: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn;ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo.
english:
May the peoples praise you, God;
    may all the peoples praise you.

twi: Ma amanaman ani nnye na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom,efisɛ wudi nnipa no so trenee muna woma asase so amanaman no akwankyerɛ.
english:
May the nations be glad and sing for joy,
    for you rule the peoples with equity
    and guide the nations of the earth.

twi: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn;ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo!
english:
May the peoples praise you, God;
    may all the peoples praise you.

twi: Afei asase no bɛbɔ ne nnɔbae,na Onyankopɔn, yɛn Nyankopɔn ahyira yɛn.
english:
The land yields its harvest;
    God, our God, blesses us.

twi: Onyankopɔn behyira yɛn,na asase mmaa nyinaa besuro no.
english:
May God bless us still,
    so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ma Onyankopɔn nsɔre, ma nʼatamfo nhwete;wɔn a wɔtan no no nguan mfi nʼanim.
english:
May God arise, may his enemies be scattered;
    may his foes flee before him.

twi: Sɛnea mframa bɔ wusiw gu no,saa ara na bɔ wɔn gu;sɛnea srade nan wɔ ogya so no,saa ara na amumɔyɛfo nyera mfi Onyankopɔn anim.
english:
May you blow them away like smoke—
    as wax melts before the fire,
    may the wicked perish before God.

twi: Nanso ma atreneefo ani nnyena wɔnsɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ Onyankopɔn anim;ma wɔn ho ntɔ wɔn na wonni ahurusi.
To dwom ma Onyankopɔn, to dwom yi ne din ayɛ.Ma nea ɔnantew omununkum so no din so.Ne din ne Awurade;ma wʼani nnye wɔ nʼanim.
Ayisaa agya ne nea odi akunafo asɛm ma wɔnne Onyankopɔn a ɔte nʼatenae kronkron hɔ.
english:
A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows,
    is God in his holy dwelling.

twi: Ɔma ohiani tena mmusua mu,na ɔde nnwonto yi nneduafo ma wɔde wɔn ho;na atuatewfo de, wɔtena asase a awo so.
Onyankopɔn, bere a wudii wo nkurɔfo anim,bere a wode wɔn faa sare so no,
english:
When you, God, went out before your people,
    when you marched through the wilderness,

twi: asase wosowee,na ɔsoro tuee osu guu fam,wɔ Onyankopɔn, Sinai Nyankopɔn,Onyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no anim.
english:
the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain,
    before God, the One of Sinai,
    before God, the God of Israel.

twi: Womaa osu tɔɔ bebree, Ao, Onyankopɔn,guu wʼagyapade a abotow no so ma ɛyɛɛ frɔmfrɔm.
english:
You gave abundant showers, O God;
    you refreshed your weary inheritance.

twi: Wo nkurɔfo bɔɔ atenase wɔ so,Onyankopɔn, wonam wʼadɔe bebree no so hwɛɛ ahiafo.
english:
Your people settled in it,
    and from your bounty, God, you provided for the poor.

twi: Awurade kaa asɛm no,na dodow no ara ne wɔn a wɔpaee mu kae;
english:
The Lord announces the word,
    and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:

twi: “Ahemfo ne wɔn asraafo guan ntɛm so;mmea a wɔwɔ fie no kyɛ asade.
english:
“Kings and armies flee in haste;
    the women at home divide the plunder.

twi: Mpo bere a woda nguanban mu no,wɔde dwetɛ duraa mʼaborɔnoma ntaban ho,de sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛhyerɛn guu wɔn ntakra so.”
english:
Even while you sleep among the sheep pens,
    the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver,
    its feathers with shining gold.”

twi: Bere a Otumfo bɔɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase no so hwetee no,na ɛte sɛ sukyerɛmma a agu Bepɔw Salmon so.
english:
When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land,
    it was like snow fallen on Mount Zalmon.

twi: Basan mmepɔw gyinagyina hɔ,Basan mmepɔw so yɛ abonkyiabonkyi.
english:
Mount Bashan, majestic mountain,
    Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,

twi: Wo bepɔw abonkyiabonkyi, adɛn nti na wode ani bɔne hwɛbepɔw a Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ obedi so hene,faako a Awurade ankasa bɛtena afebɔɔ?
english:
why gaze in envy, you rugged mountain,
    at the mountain where God chooses to reign,
    where the Lord himself will dwell forever?

twi: Onyankopɔn nteaseɛnam yɛ mpem mpemne mpem mpem mu mpem;Awurade fi Sinai aba ne kronkronbea.
Bere a woforo kɔɔ soro no,wode nnommum kaa wo ho;wunyaa ayɛyɛde fii nnipa hɔ,fii atuatewfo hɔ mpo,sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtena hɔ, Awurade Nyankopɔn.
english:
When you ascended on high,
    you took many captives;
    you received gifts from people,
even from the rebellious—
    that you, Lord God, might dwell there.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade, nka Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa,nea ɔsoa yɛn nnesoa da biara no.
english:
Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior,
    who daily bears our burdens.

twi: Yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn a ogye nkwa;na Awurade mu na owu tow fom yɛn.
english:
Our God is a God who saves;
    from the Sovereign Lord comes escape from death.

twi: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn bɛdwerɛw nʼatamfo ti,wɔn a wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne ti kusuu no.
english:
Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies,
    the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

twi: Awurade ka se, “Mede wɔn befi Basan aba;mede wɔn befi po bun mu aba,
english:
The Lord says, “I will bring them from Bashan;
    I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

twi: na moanantew wɔn a wokyi mo no mogya muna mo akraman tɛkrɛma anya wɔn kyɛfa.”
english:
that your feet may wade in the blood of your foes,
    while the tongues of your dogs have their share.”

twi: Onyankopɔn, yɛahu wo santen yuu no,me Nyankopɔn ne me Hene santen yuu no a ɔde reba ne kronkronbea hɔ.
english:
Your procession, God, has come into view,
    the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

twi: Nnwontofo no wɔ anim, na asankubɔfo no nso di so,na mmabaa a wɔrewosow akasae nso ka wɔn ho.
english:
In front are the singers, after them the musicians;
    with them are the young women playing the timbrels.

twi: Monkamfo Onyankopɔn wɔ asafo kɛse no mu;monkamfo Awurade wɔ Israel nnipakuw no mu.
english:
Praise God in the great congregation;
    praise the Lord in the assembly of Israel.

twi: Abusuakuw ketewa, Benyamin na odi wɔn kan,Yuda mmapɔmma kuw kɛse no di so,na Sebulon ne Naftali mmapɔmma aba.
english:
There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them,
    there the great throng of Judah’s princes,
    and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

twi: Kyerɛ wo tumi, Onyankopɔn;da wʼahoɔden adi kyerɛ yɛn, sɛnea woayɛ pɛn no.
english:
Summon your power, God;
    show us your strength, our God, as you have done before.

twi: Wʼasɔredan a ɛwɔ Yerusalem ntiahemfo de ayɛyɛde bɛbrɛ wo.
english:
Because of your temple at Jerusalem
    kings will bring you gifts.

twi: Ka aboa a ɔhyɛ mfea mu no anim,ne anantwinini kuw a wɔhyɛ amanaman no nantwimma mu no.Brɛ wɔn ase kosi sɛ wɔde dwetɛ mpɔw bɛba.Bɔ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ɔko ho no pansam.
english:
Rebuke the beast among the reeds,
    the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations.
Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver.
    Scatter the nations who delight in war.

twi: Ananmusifo befi Misraim aba,na Kus de ne ho bɛma Onyankopɔn.
english:
Envoys will come from Egypt;
    Cush will submit herself to God.

twi: Wiase ahemman, monto dwom mma Onyankopɔn,monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade,
english:
Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth,
    sing praise to the Lord,

twi: monto mma nea ɔte tete ɔsorosoro so no,na ɔde nne kɛse bobɔ mu no.
english:
to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens,
    who thunders with mighty voice.

twi: Mompae mu nka Onyankopɔn tumi,nea ne kɛseyɛ kata Israel so no,na ne tumi wɔ soro ɔsoro no.
english:
Proclaim the power of God,
    whose majesty is over Israel,
    whose power is in the heavens.

twi: Wo ho yɛ hu, Onyankopɔn, wɔ wo kronkronbea hɔ;Israel Nyankopɔn de tumi ne ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo.Ayeyi nka Onyankopɔn!
Dwom Dawid dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me nkwana nsu no abɛdeda me kɔn mu.
english:
Save me, O God,
    for the waters have come up to my neck.

twi: Meremem wɔ dontori a mu dɔ mu,wɔ baabi a mʼanan nnya sibea.Madu bun muna nsu abu afa me so.
english:
I sink in the miry depths,
    where there is no foothold.
I have come into the deep waters;
    the floods engulf me.

twi: Mafrɛ abrɛ rehwehwɛ mmoa.Me mene mu ayow.Mʼani so ayɛ kusuu,na merehwehwɛ me Nyankopɔn.
english:
I am worn out calling for help;
    my throat is parched.
My eyes fail,
    looking for my God.

twi: Wɔn a wɔtan me kwa nodɔɔso sen me ti so nwi;wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso,wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me no.Wɔhyɛ me sɛ mennannea minnwiae no mma.
english:
Those who hate me without reason
    outnumber the hairs of my head;
many are my enemies without cause,
    those who seek to destroy me.
I am forced to restore
    what I did not steal.

twi: Wo, Onyankopɔn, nim me nkwaseasɛm;mʼafɔdi nhintaw wo.
english:
You, God, know my folly;
    my guilt is not hidden from you.

twi: Awurade, Awurade Tweduampɔn,mma wɔn a wɔn ani da wo so no,anim ngu ase esiane me nti, Awurade, Asafo Awurade;Israel Nyankopɔn,mma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo noanim ngu ase esiane me nti.
english:
Lord, the Lord Almighty,
    may those who hope in you
    not be disgraced because of me;
God of Israel,
    may those who seek you
    not be put to shame because of me.

twi: Wo nti migyina animka ano,na aniwu kata mʼanim.
english:
For I endure scorn for your sake,
    and shame covers my face.

twi: Mete sɛ ɔhɔho wɔ me nuanom mu,mete sɛ ɔmamfrani wɔ me na mmabarima mu,
english:
I am a foreigner to my own family,
    a stranger to my own mother’s children;

twi: na wo fi ho mmɔdemmɔ hyɛ me so,wɔn a wɔbɔ wo ahohora no animtiaabu bɛda me so.
english:
for zeal for your house consumes me,
    and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

twi: Sɛ mitwa adwo na midi mmuada awɔbɔ me ahohora;
english:
When I weep and fast,
    I must endure scorn;

twi: sɛ mifura atweaatam annipa de me yɛ aserewde.
english:
when I put on sackcloth,
    people make sport of me.

twi: Wɔn a wɔtete ɔpon no ano no serew me,na akɔwensafo de me din to dwom.
english:
Those who sit at the gate mock me,
    and I am the song of the drunkards.

twi: Nanso mɛbɔ wo mpae, Awurade,wɔ wʼadom bere mu;wɔ wʼadɔe kɛse no nti, Ao, Onyankopɔn,fa wo nokware nkwagye no gye me so.
english:
But I pray to you, Lord,
    in the time of your favor;
in your great love, O God,
    answer me with your sure salvation.

twi: Yi me fi dontori no mu,mma memmem wɔ mu;gye me fi wɔn a wɔtan me no nsam,ne nsu bun mu.
english:
Rescue me from the mire,
    do not let me sink;
deliver me from those who hate me,
    from the deep waters.

twi: Mma nsu nnyiri mmfa meanaa bun mmene meanaa amoa nkata me so.
english:
Do not let the floodwaters engulf me
    or the depths swallow me up
    or the pit close its mouth over me.

twi: Awurade, gye me so fi wʼadɔe a eye no mu;wʼadom nti, dan bɛhwɛ me.
english:
Answer me, Lord, out of the goodness of your love;
    in your great mercy turn to me.

twi: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw wo somfo;gye me so ntɛm, na mewɔ ɔhaw mu.
english:
Do not hide your face from your servant;
    answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

twi: Twiw bɛn me na gye me;gye me nkwa, mʼatamfo nti.
english:
Come near and rescue me;
    deliver me because of my foes.

twi: Wunim sɛnea wɔkasa tia me, gu mʼanim ase na wotiatia mʼanim;wʼani tua mʼatamfo nyinaa.
english:
You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed;
    all my enemies are before you.

twi: Kasatia ahyɛ me koma soama mayɛ sɛ obi a onni ɔboafo;mepɛɛ awerɛkyekye, nanso mannya bi,mepɛɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo, nanso manhu bi.
english:
Scorn has broken my heart
    and has left me helpless;
I looked for sympathy, but there was none,
    for comforters, but I found none.

twi: Wɔde bɔnwoma guu mʼaduan mu,osukɔm dee me no, wɔmaa me nsa nwenweenwen.
english:
They put gall in my food
    and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

twi: Ma wɔn didipon a esi wɔn anim nyi wɔn sɛ afiri;ma ɛnyɛ akatua ne afide mma wɔn.
english:
May the table set before them become a snare;
    may it become retribution and a trap.

twi: Ma wɔn ani so nyɛ wɔn kusuu na wɔanhu ade,na ma wɔn akyi nkuntun afebɔɔ.
english:
May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see,
    and their backs be bent forever.

twi: Hwie wʼabufuwhyew gu wɔn so;na ma wʼabufuw huhuhuhu no mmra wɔn so.
english:
Pour out your wrath on them;
    let your fierce anger overtake them.

twi: Ma wɔn fi nyɛ amamfo;mma obiara ntena wɔn ntamadan mu.
english:
May their place be deserted;
    let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

twi: Wɔtaa wɔn a wupira wɔn no,wɔka wɔn a wupira wɔn no yawdi ho asɛm.
english:
For they persecute those you wound
    and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

twi: Fa amumɔyɛ mu amumɔyɛ ho sobo bɔ wɔn;mma wonnya wo nkwagye mu kyɛfa.
english:
Charge them with crime upon crime;
    do not let them share in your salvation.

twi: Pepa wɔn din fi nkwa nhoma no mu,mfa wɔn din nka atreneefo de ho.
english:
May they be blotted out of the book of life
    and not be listed with the righteous.

twi: Mewɔ ɔyaw ne ahohiahia mu;Onyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagye no mmɔ me ho ban.
english:
But as for me, afflicted and in pain—
    may your salvation, God, protect me.

twi: Mede dwonto beyi Onyankopɔn din ayɛna mede aseda ahyɛ no anuonyam.
english:
I will praise God’s name in song
    and glorify him with thanksgiving.

twi: Eyi bɛsɔ Awurade ani yiye asen nantwi,asen nantwinini a otua mmɛn na ɔwɔ tɔte.
english:
This will please the Lord more than an ox,
    more than a bull with its horns and hooves.

twi: Mmɔborɔni behu na nʼani agye,mo a mohwehwɛ Onyankopɔn no koma benya nkwa.
english:
The poor will see and be glad—
    you who seek God, may your hearts live!

twi: Awurade tie wɔn a ade ahia wɔn,na ommu ne nkurɔfo nneduafo animtiaa.
english:
The Lord hears the needy
    and does not despise his captive people.

twi: Ma ɔsoro ne asase nkamfo no,po ne nea ɛkeka ne ho wɔ mu nyinaa,
english:
Let heaven and earth praise him,
    the seas and all that move in them,

twi: efisɛ Onyankopɔn begye Sion nkwana wakyekye Yuda nkuropɔn no bio.Afei nnipa bɛtena mu na ayɛ wɔn de;
Nʼasomfo asefo na wɔbɛfa hɔ,na wɔn a wɔdɔ ne din no bɛtena hɔ.
english:
the children of his servants will inherit it,
    and those who love his name will dwell there.

twi: Dwom Dawid adesrɛ dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm gye me nkwa;Awurade bra ntɛm bɛboa me.
english:
Hasten, O God, to save me;
    come quickly, Lord, to help me.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra noanim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me sɛe no nyinaamfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.
english:
May those who want to take my life
    be put to shame and confusion;
may all who desire my ruin
    be turned back in disgrace.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me nonsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.
english:
May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!”
    turn back because of their shame.

twi: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaansɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu;ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se,“Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔkɛse!”
english:
But may all who seek you
    rejoice and be glad in you;
may those who long for your saving help always say,
    “The Lord is great!”

twi: Me de meyɛ ohiani a minni ɔboafo;Ao, Onyankopɔn, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm.Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo;Awurade, ntwentwɛn wʼanan ase.
Dwom Awurade, wo mu na maguan ahintaw;mma mʼanim ngu ase da.
english:
In you, Lord, I have taken refuge;
    let me never be put to shame.

twi: Wo trenee no nti, yi me na gye me;tie me na gye me nkwa.
english:
In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me;
    turn your ear to me and save me.

twi: Yɛ me nkwagye botan,faako a metumi akɔ daa;hyɛ ma wommegye me nkwa,na wone me botan ne mʼabandennen.
english:
Be my rock of refuge,
    to which I can always go;
give the command to save me,
    for you are my rock and my fortress.

twi: Me Nyankopɔn, gye me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam,gye me fi nnebɔneyɛfo ne atirimɔdenfo nsam.
english:
Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked,
    from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.

twi: Na woayɛ mʼanidaso, Asafo Awurade,mʼahotoso fi me mmabun bere mu.
english:
For you have been my hope, Sovereign Lord,
    my confidence since my youth.

twi: Mede me ho ato wo so fi awo mu;wo na wuyii me fii me na yafunu mu.Mɛkamfo wo daa.
Mayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ama bebree,nanso wo ne me guankɔbea dennen.
english:
I have become a sign to many;
    you are my strong refuge.

twi: Wo nkamfo ahyɛ mʼanom ma,mekamfo wʼanuonyam da mu nyinaa.
english:
My mouth is filled with your praise,
    declaring your splendor all day long.

twi: Ntow me nkyene bere a mabɔ akwakoraa;mʼahoɔden sa wɔ me mu a, nnyaw me.
english:
Do not cast me away when I am old;
    do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

twi: Efisɛ mʼatamfo kasa tia mewɔn a wɔtwɛn sɛ wobekum me no bɔ mu pam me ti so.
english:
For my enemies speak against me;
    those who wait to kill me conspire together.

twi: Wɔka se, “Onyankopɔn agyaw no mu;momma yentiw no na yɛnkyere no,na obiara nni hɔ a obegye no.”
Me Nyankopɔn, mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ akyiri;Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.
english:
Do not be far from me, my God;
    come quickly, God, to help me.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔbɔ me sobo no nsɛe wɔ animguase mu;wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wopira me noma ahohora ne animguase nkata wɔn so.
Nanso me de, menya anidaso daa;mɛkɔ so akamfo wo.
english:
As for me, I will always have hope;
    I will praise you more and more.

twi: Mɛka wo trenee ho asɛm,ne wo nkwagye da mu nyinaa,nanso minnim ano.
english:
My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds,
    of your saving acts all day long—
    though I know not how to relate them all.

twi: Otumfo Awurade, mɛba abɛpae mu aka wo nnwuma akɛse no;mɛpae mu aka wo trenee, wo nko ara de no, akyerɛ.
english:
I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord;
    I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.

twi: Onyankopɔn, efi me mmabun bere na wokyerɛkyerɛɛ me,na ebesi nnɛ yi meka wʼanwonwade a woayɛ kyerɛ.
english:
Since my youth, God, you have taught me,
    and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

twi: Mpo sɛ mebɔ akwakoraa na mifuw dwen a,Onyankopɔn, nnyaw me,kosi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma,ne wo kɛseyɛ akyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.
english:
Even when I am old and gray,
    do not forsake me, my God,
till I declare your power to the next generation,
    your mighty acts to all who are to come.

twi: Onyankopɔn, wo trenee du ɔsorosoro,wo a woayɛ nneɛma akɛse.Onyankopɔn, hena na ɔte sɛ wo?
english:
Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens,
    you who have done great things.
    Who is like you, God?

twi: Mmom woama mahu ɔhaw bebree a ɛyɛ yaw;nanso wobɛma me nkwa bio;na wubeyi me bio,afi asase yam.
english:
Though you have made me see troubles,
    many and bitter,
    you will restore my life again;
from the depths of the earth
    you will again bring me up.

twi: Wobɛhyɛ me anuonyam bebreena woakyekye me werɛ bio.
english:
You will increase my honor
    and comfort me once more.

twi: Mede sanku bɛkamfo wome Nyankopɔn, wo trenee ntimɛto wʼayeyi dwom wɔ sankuten so,Israel Kronkronni.
english:
I will praise you with the harp
    for your faithfulness, my God;
I will sing praise to you with the lyre,
    Holy One of Israel.

twi: Mʼanofafa de anigye bɛteɛ mubere a meto dwom kamfo wo,me a woagye me no.
english:
My lips will shout for joy
    when I sing praise to you—
    I whom you have delivered.

twi: Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo trenee nnwumada mu nyinaa,efisɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw me nokɔ animguase ne basaayɛ mu.
english:
My tongue will tell of your righteous acts
    all day long,
for those who wanted to harm me
    have been put to shame and confusion.

twi: Dwom Salomo dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, fa wʼatɛntrenee dom ɔhene no,na fa wo trenee ma ɔhene babarima.
english:
Endow the king with your justice, O God,
    the royal son with your righteousness.

twi: Ɔde trenee bebu wo nkurɔfo atɛn,obebu wo nkurɔfo a wɔrehu amane no atɛntrenee.
english:
May he judge your people in righteousness,
    your afflicted ones with justice.

twi: Mmepɔw no de yiyedi bɛbrɛ nnipa no,nkoko no de trenee bɛba.
english:
May the mountains bring prosperity to the people,
    the hills the fruit of righteousness.

twi: Ɔbɛko ama nnipa no mu amanehunufona wagye wɔn a wonni bi mma nkwa;ɔbɛdwerɛw nhyɛsofo.
Owia ne ɔsram da so wɔ hɔ yiwobesuro wo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
english:
May he endure as long as the sun,
    as long as the moon, through all generations.

twi: Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ osu a ɛtɔ gu asase a wɔadɔw so so,te sɛ obosu a egugu asase so.
english:
May he be like rain falling on a mown field,
    like showers watering the earth.

twi: Atreneefo benyin frɔmfrɔm wɔ ne bere so;yiyedi bebu so akosi da a ɔsram nni hɔ bio.
english:
In his days may the righteous flourish
    and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.

twi: Obedi hene afi po akosi po,afi Asubɔnten Efrata akosi asase ano.
english:
May he rule from sea to sea
    and from the River to the ends of the earth.

twi: Sare so mmusua bɛkotow nʼanimna nʼatamfo adi mfutuma.
english:
May the desert tribes bow before him
    and his enemies lick the dust.

twi: Tarsis ne mpoano ahemfo a wɔwɔ akyirikyiride sonkahiri bɛbrɛ no;Saba ne Seba ahemfode ayɛyɛde bɛbrɛ no.
english:
May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores
    bring tribute to him.
May the kings of Sheba and Seba
    present him gifts.

twi: Ahemfo nyinaa bɛkotow no,amanaman nyinaa bɛsom no.
english:
May all kings bow down to him
    and all nations serve him.

twi: Na obegye mmɔborɔfo a wosu frɛ no,ne amanehunufo a wonni ɔboafo.
english:
For he will deliver the needy who cry out,
    the afflicted who have no one to help.

twi: Obehu wɔn a wɔayɛ mmrɛw ne ahiafo mmɔbɔna wagye ahiafo nkwa.
english:
He will take pity on the weak and the needy
    and save the needy from death.

twi: Obegye wɔn afi nhyɛso ne akakabensɛm ase,efisɛ wɔn mogya som bo wɔ nʼanim.
english:
He will rescue them from oppression and violence,
    for precious is their blood in his sight.

twi: Ɔhene nkwa so!ma wɔmfa sikakɔkɔɔ mfi Seba mmrɛ no.Ma nnipa mmɔ mpae mma nona wonhyira no da mu nyinaa.
english:
Long may he live!
    May gold from Sheba be given him.
May people ever pray for him
    and bless him all day long.

twi: Aburow mmu so wɔ asase no so nyinaa;nnuan mmu so wɔ nkoko so,ma nʼaba mmɔ sɛ Lebanon;na enyin sɛ mfuw so sare.
english:
May grain abound throughout the land;
    on the tops of the hills may it sway.
May the crops flourish like Lebanon
    and thrive like the grass of the field.

twi: Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa;ɛntena hɔ nkyɛ sɛ owia.Wɔbɛfa no so ahyira amanaman no,na wɔbɛfrɛ no nhyira.
english:
May his name endure forever;
    may it continue as long as the sun.
Then all nations will be blessed through him,
    and they will call him blessed.

twi: Nhyira nka Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn!Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwonwade.
english:
Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel,
    who alone does marvelous deeds.

twi: Nhyira nka ne din a anuonyam ahyɛ no ma no daa daa.Ma nʼanuonyam nhyɛ wiase nyinaa ma.Amen! Amen!
Yisai ba Dawid mpaebɔ no awiei ni.
english: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

twi: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ABIƐSANnwom –Dwom Asaf dwom.Ampa ara Onyankopɔn ye ma Israel,oye ma wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew.
english:
Surely God is good to Israel,
    to those who are pure in heart.

twi: Nanso me de, anka me nan reyɛ awatiri;anka merehwere me nnyinaso,
english:
But as for me, my feet had almost slipped;
    I had nearly lost my foothold.

twi: efisɛ mʼani beree ahantanfobere a mihuu amumɔyɛfo yiyedi no.
english:
For I envied the arrogant
    when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

twi: Wonni aperepere;na wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne apɔwmuden.
english:
They have no struggles;
    their bodies are healthy and strong.

twi: Dadwen a ɛtaa ba nnipa so biara nna wɔn so;ɔdesani haw biara nna wɔn so.
english:
They are free from common human burdens;
    they are not plagued by human ills.

twi: Enti ahantan yɛ wɔn kɔnmuade,na wofura akakabensɛm.
english:
Therefore pride is their necklace;
    they clothe themselves with violence.

twi: Wɔn koma a apirim no mu na nnebɔne fi;na wɔn amumɔyɛ adwene nni awiei.
english:
From their callous hearts comes iniquity;
    their evil imaginations have no limits.

twi: Wɔserew afoforo na wɔka wɔn ho nsɛm a enye;wɔde nhyɛso hunahuna afoforo wɔ ahomaso mu.
english:
They scoff, and speak with malice;
    with arrogance they threaten oppression.

twi: Wɔn ano ka ɔsoro nsɛm,na wɔn tɛkrɛma agye asase afa.
english:
Their mouths lay claim to heaven,
    and their tongues take possession of the earth.

twi: Ɛno nti wɔn nkurɔfo kɔ wɔn nkyɛnna wonya nsu nom ma ebu so.
english:
Therefore their people turn to them
    and drink up waters in abundance.

twi: Wobisa se, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn ahu?Na Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ nhumu ana?”
english:
They say, “How would God know?
    Does the Most High know anything?”

twi: Sɛɛ na amumɔyɛfo no te,hwee mfa wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ so pɛ ahonyade.
english:
This is what the wicked are like—
    always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.

twi: Ampa ara, mannya hwee amfi me komamtew mu;me nsa a enni fɔ no ayɛ ɔkwa.
english:
Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure
    and have washed my hands in innocence.

twi: Da mu nyinaa mihu amane;anɔpa biara wɔtwe mʼaso.
english:
All day long I have been afflicted,
    and every morning brings new punishments.

twi: Sɛ mekae se, “Mɛkasa saa” a,anka midii wo mma no huammɔ.
english:
If I had spoken out like that,
    I would have betrayed your children.

twi: Mebɔɔ mmɔden sɛ mɛte eyinom nyinaa ase,nanso na ɛhyɛ me so
english:
When I tried to understand all this,
    it troubled me deeply

twi: kosii sɛ mekɔɔ Onyankopɔn kronkronbea hɔ;ɛhɔ na metee nea awiei no ɛbɛba wɔn so no ase.
english:
till I entered the sanctuary of God;
    then I understood their final destiny.

twi: Ampa ara wode wɔn gu faako a hɔ yɛ torowode wɔn hwe fam sɛe wɔn pasaa.
english:
Surely you place them on slippery ground;
    you cast them down to ruin.

twi: Sɛnea wɔsɛe prɛko pɛ,na ehu hwim wɔn kɔ no.
english:
How suddenly are they destroyed,
    completely swept away by terrors!

twi: Ɛte sɛ adaeso, bere a onipa anyan,Awurade, sɛ wokanyan wo ho a,wubebu wʼani agu wɔn so sɛ biribi a enni hɔ.
Bere a awerɛhow hyɛɛ me koma muna me honhom dii yaw no,
english:
When my heart was grieved
    and my spirit embittered,

twi: meyɛɛ sɛ obi a onnim hwee na onni adwene;meyɛɛ sɛ aboa gyimfo wɔ wʼanim.
english:
I was senseless and ignorant;
    I was a brute beast before you.

twi: Nanso na me ne wo wɔ hɔ bere biara;na wode wo nsa nifa aso me mu.
english:
Yet I am always with you;
    you hold me by my right hand.

twi: Wode wʼafotu kyerɛ me kwan;na akyiri no, wode me bɛkɔ anuonyam mu.
english:
You guide me with your counsel,
    and afterward you will take me into glory.

twi: Hena na mewɔ wɔ ɔsoro ka wo ho?Na biribiara nni asase so a mepɛ ka wo ho.
english:
Whom have I in heaven but you?
    And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

twi: Me honam, ne me koma bedi me huammɔ,nanso Onyankopɔn ne me koma ahoɔdenne me kyɛfa daa nyinaa.
english:
My flesh and my heart may fail,
    but God is the strength of my heart
    and my portion forever.

twi: Wɔn a wɔmmɛn wo no bɛyera.Wosɛe wɔn a wonni wo nokware nyinaa.
english:
Those who are far from you will perish;
    you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

twi: Nanso me de, minim sɛ eye sɛ wobɛbɛn Onyankopɔn.Mede Otumfo Awurade ayɛ me guankɔbea;mɛka wo nneyɛe nyinaa akyerɛ.
Dwom Asaf dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, adɛn nti na woapo yɛn koraa yi?Adɛn nti na wʼabufuw hyew wʼadidibea nguan?
english:
O God, why have you rejected us forever?
    Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

twi: Kae nkurɔfo a wotɔɔ wɔn teteete no,abusua a ɛyɛ wʼagyapade a wugyee wɔn no,Bepɔw Sion, faako a wote hɔ.
english:
Remember the nation you purchased long ago,
    the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed—
    Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

twi: Dan wʼanammɔntu kyerɛ saa nnwiriwii a ɛto ntwa da yi,ɔtamfo no de saa ɔsɛe yi nyinaa aba wo kronkronbea no so.
english:
Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins,
    all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

twi: Wʼatamfo bobɔɔ mu wɔ faako a wuhyiaa yɛn no;wɔasisi wɔn mfrankaa sɛ agyiraehyɛde wɔ hɔ.
english:
Your foes roared in the place where you met with us;
    they set up their standards as signs.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ wɔn sɛ nnipa a wɔrehwim mmonnuade abubu nnua a ayɛ nkyɛkyerɛ.
english:
They behaved like men wielding axes
    to cut through a thicket of trees.

twi: Wɔde wɔn mmonnua ne nnamebubuu nnua a wɔasen adi ho adwinni no.
english:
They smashed all the carved paneling
    with their axes and hatchets.

twi: Wɔhyew wo kronkronbea no dwerɛbee;woguu faako a wo Din te no ho fi.
english:
They burned your sanctuary to the ground;
    they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

twi: Wɔkaa wɔ wɔn koma mu se, “Yebetiatia wɔn so ayɛ wɔn pasaa!”Wɔhyew baabiara a wɔsom Onyankopɔn wɔ asase no so.
english:
They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely!”
    They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

twi: Wɔmmaa yɛn nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛyɛ nwonwa biara;adiyifo no asa,na yɛn mu biara nnim nna dodow a ebedi.
Onyankopɔn, wʼatamfo bɛserew wo akosi da bɛn?Wɔn a wokyi wo no begu wo din ho fi daa ana?
english:
How long will the enemy mock you, God?
    Will the foe revile your name forever?

twi: Adɛn nti na woatwe wo nsa, wo nsa nifa no?Yi fi wʼatade mmobɔwee no mu na sɛe wɔn.
english:
Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand?
    Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

twi: Nanso Onyankopɔn yɛ me hene fi tete;wode nkwagye ba asase so.
english:
But God is my King from long ago;
    he brings salvation on the earth.

twi: Ɛyɛ wo na wode wo tumi paee po mu no;wopɛtɛw nsu mu ɔwɔ no ti.
english:
It was you who split open the sea by your power;
    you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

twi: Wopɛtɛw Lewiatan no tina wode no maa sare so abɔde sɛ wɔn aduan.
english:
It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan
    and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.

twi: Wo na womaa nsuwa ne nsuti tuei;na womaa nsubɔnten a ɛsen yoyowee.
english:
It was you who opened up springs and streams;
    you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

twi: Adekyee wɔ wo na adesae nso yɛ wo dea;wode owia ne ɔsram sisii hɔ.
english:
The day is yours, and yours also the night;
    you established the sun and moon.

twi: Ɛyɛ wo na wototoo asase so ahye nyinaa;wobɔɔ ahohuru ne awɔw mmere.
english:
It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth;
    you made both summer and winter.

twi: Awurade, kae sɛnea ɔtamfo no aserew wo,sɛnea nkwaseafo agu wo din ho fi.
english:
Remember how the enemy has mocked you, Lord,
    how foolish people have reviled your name.

twi: Mmfa wʼaborɔnoma nkwa mma nkekaboa;mma wo werɛ mfi wo nkurɔfo a wɔrehu amane no nkwa afebɔɔ.
english:
Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts;
    do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

twi: Ma wʼapam no ho nhia wo,efisɛ akakabensɛm ahyɛ asase no so sum mu ma.
english:
Have regard for your covenant,
    because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

twi: Mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no mmfa animguase nsan;ma ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo nkamfo wo din.
english:
Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace;
    may the poor and needy praise your name.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, ma wo ho so na ka wo ara wʼasɛm;kae sɛnea nkwaseafo serew wo da mu nyinaa.
english:
Rise up, O God, and defend your cause;
    remember how fools mock you all day long.

twi: Mmu wʼani ngu wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo no nteɛteɛmu so,wʼatamfo gyegyeegyeyɛ a ɛkɔ soro daa no.
english:
Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries,
    the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Onyankopɔn, yɛda wo ase,yɛda wo ase, efisɛ wo Din abɛn;nnipa ka wʼanwonwade kyerɛ.
Woka se, “Me na mehyɛɛ bere a ɛsɛ no;ɛyɛ me na mibu atɛntrenee.
english:
You say, “I choose the appointed time;
    it is I who judge with equity.

twi: Sɛ asase ne so nnipa nyinaa wosow a,me na mema nʼafadum gyina hɔ pintinn.
english:
When the earth and all its people quake,
    it is I who hold its pillars firm.

twi: Meka kyerɛ ahantanfo se, ‘Monnhoahoa mo ho bio,’na meka kyerɛ amumɔyɛfo nso se, ‘Mommma mo mmɛn so.
english:
To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’
    and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.

twi: Mommma mo mmɛn so ntia ɔsoro;mommfa animtiaabu nkasa.’ ”
english:
Do not lift your horns against heaven;
    do not speak so defiantly.’”

twi: Obiara mmfi apuei anaa atɔeanaa sare no so a obetumi ama obi so.
english:
No one from the east or the west
    or from the desert can exalt themselves.

twi: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na obu atɛn:Ɔbrɛ ɔbaako ase, na ɔma ɔfoforo so.
english:
It is God who judges:
    He brings one down, he exalts another.

twi: Kuruwa bi hyɛ Awurade nsamnsa bi a etwa ahuru a wɔde nnuhuam afra ahyɛ no ma;ohwie, na asase so amumɔyɛfo nyinaanom ma ɛka ase puw.
english:
In the hand of the Lord is a cup
    full of foaming wine mixed with spices;
he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth
    drink it down to its very dregs.

twi: Me de, mɛpae mu aka eyi daa daa;mɛto ayeyi dwom ama Yakob Nyankopɔn.
english:
As for me, I will declare this forever;
    I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,

twi: Mebubu amumɔyɛfo nyinaa mmɛn,na atreneefo mmɛn de, wɔbɛma so.
english:
who says, “I will cut off the horns of all the wicked,
    but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.”

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Onyankopɔn din ahyeta wɔ Yuda;ne din so wɔ Israel.
english:
God is renowned in Judah;
    in Israel his name is great.

twi: Ne ntamadan si Salem,ne tenabea wɔ Sion.
english:
His tent is in Salem,
    his dwelling place in Zion.

twi: Ɛhɔ na obubuu mmemma a ɛpa gya,nkatabo ne afoa, akode nyinaa mu.
english:
There he broke the flashing arrows,
    the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.

twi: Wo ho hann no hyerɛn,na woso sen mmepɔw a mmoadoma ahyɛ mu ma no.
english:
You are radiant with light,
    more majestic than mountains rich with game.

twi: Mmarima akokodurufo deda hɔ a wɔagye wɔn ho nneɛma,wɔadeda awufo nna;na akofo no mu baako mpontumi mma ne nsa so.
english:
The valiant lie plundered,
    they sleep their last sleep;
not one of the warriors
    can lift his hands.

twi: Yakob Nyankopɔn, wokaa wɔn anim noapɔnkɔ no ne nteaseɛnam no adeda dinn.
english:
At your rebuke, God of Jacob,
    both horse and chariot lie still.

twi: Wo nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro wo.Sɛ wo bo fuw a hena na obetumi agyina wʼanim?
english:
It is you alone who are to be feared.
    Who can stand before you when you are angry?

twi: Wubuu atɛn fii ɔsoro,asase suroe, na ɛyɛɛ komm,
english:
From heaven you pronounced judgment,
    and the land feared and was quiet—

twi: bere a wo, Onyankopɔn, sɔre buu atɛn,de gyee amanehunufo wɔ asase no so no.
english:
when you, God, rose up to judge,
    to save all the afflicted of the land.

twi: Ampa ara wʼabufuwhyew a etia nnipa no de ayeyi brɛ wo,na wɔn a wotumi gyina ano no nya kɔkɔbɔ.
english:
Surely your wrath against mankind brings you praise,
    and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

twi: Monhyɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn no bɔ na munni so;momma nsase a atwa ne ho ahyiamfa ayɛyɛde mmrɛ Ɔbaako a ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no no.
Ɔbrɛ sodifonom honhom ase;na asase so ahemfo suro no.
english:
He breaks the spirit of rulers;
    he is feared by the kings of the earth.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Misu mefrɛɛ Onyankopɔn srɛɛ mmoa;misu mefrɛɛ no sɛ ontie me.
english:
I cried out to God for help;
    I cried out to God to hear me.

twi: Bere a mewɔ ahohiahia mu no, mehwehwɛɛ Awurade;metrɛw me nsa a ɛmpa abaw mu anadwona me kra ampene sɛ wɔbɛkyekye ne werɛ.
Onyankopɔn mekaee wo, na misii apini;medwenee, na me honhom tɔɔ beraw.
english:
I remembered you, God, and I groaned;
    I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.

twi: Woamma mʼani ankum;amanehunu dodow nti, mantumi ankasa.
english:
You kept my eyes from closing;
    I was too troubled to speak.

twi: Medwenee nna a atwam no ho,teteete mfe no ho;
english:
I thought about the former days,
    the years of long ago;

twi: mekaee me nnwom a na meto no anadwo.Me koma dwenee ho na me honhom bisae se:
english:
I remembered my songs in the night.
    My heart meditated and my spirit asked:

twi: “Enti, Awurade bɛpo yɛn daa?Ɔrenhu yɛn mmɔbɔ bio ana?
english:
“Will the Lord reject forever?
    Will he never show his favor again?

twi: Nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da atu ayera koraa ana?Na ne bɔhyɛ no, amma mu koraa ana?
english:
Has his unfailing love vanished forever?
    Has his promise failed for all time?

twi: Onyankopɔn werɛ afi sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmɔborɔhunufo ana?Ɔde abufuw atwe nʼayamhyehye no asan ana?”
english:
Has God forgotten to be merciful?
    Has he in anger withheld his compassion?”

twi: Afei misusuwii se, “Eyi de, mɛsrɛ:mfe a Ɔsorosoroni no teɛɛ ne nsa nifa mu no.”
english:
Then I thought, “To this I will appeal:
    the years when the Most High stretched out his right hand.

twi: Mɛkae nneɛma a Awurade ayɛ;yiw, mɛkae wo tete anwonwade no.
english:
I will remember the deeds of the Lord;
    yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

twi: Mɛdwene wo nnwuma nyinaa hona masusuw wo nneyɛe akɛse nyinaa ho.
english:
I will consider all your works
    and meditate on all your mighty deeds.”

twi: Onyankopɔn, wʼakwan yɛ kronkron.Onyame bɛn na ɔso sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn?
english:
Your ways, God, are holy.
    What god is as great as our God?

twi: Wone Onyankopɔn a woyɛ anwonwade;wokyerɛ wo tumi wɔ aman mu.
english:
You are the God who performs miracles;
    you display your power among the peoples.

twi: Wode wo tumi nsa no gyee wo nkurɔfo,Yakob ne Yosef asefo no.
english:
With your mighty arm you redeemed your people,
    the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

twi: Onyankopɔn, nsu no huu wo,nsu no huu wo na wɔpopoe;bun no mpo ho wosowee.
Omununkum tɔɔ nsu,aprannaa gyigyee wɔ ɔsoro;na wo bɛmma paa gya dii akɔneaba.
Wʼaprannaa bobɔɔ mu wɔ mfɛtɛ no mu,wʼanyinam hyerɛn wiase;asase popoe, na ɛwosowee.
Wode wo kwan faa po mu,wode faa nsu kɛse mu,nanso wɔanhu wʼanammɔn.
english:
Your path led through the sea,
    your way through the mighty waters,
    though your footprints were not seen.

twi: Wonam Mose ne Aaron abasa so,dii wo nkurɔfo anim sɛ nguankuw.
english:
You led your people like a flock
    by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Me nkurɔfo, muntie me nkyerɛkyerɛ;monyɛ aso mma mʼanom nsɛm.
english:
My people, hear my teaching;
    listen to the words of my mouth.

twi: Mɛkasa wɔ abebu mu,mɛka ahintasɛm, teteete nneɛma no,
english:
I will open my mouth with a parable;
    I will utter hidden things, things from of old—

twi: nneɛma a yɛate na yɛahu;nneɛma a yɛn agyanom aka ho asɛm akyerɛ yɛn.
english:
things we have heard and known,
    things our ancestors have told us.

twi: Yɛremfa nkame wɔn mma;yɛbɛka akyerɛ nkyirimmaAwurade nneyɛe a ɛfata nkamfo no,ne tumi ne anwonwade a wayɛ no.
english:
We will not hide them from their descendants;
    we will tell the next generation
the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord,
    his power, and the wonders he has done.

twi: Ɔyɛɛ ahyɛde maa Yakobna ɔyɛɛ mmara wɔ Israel,nea ɔhyɛɛ yɛn nenanomsɛ wɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma,
english:
He decreed statutes for Jacob
    and established the law in Israel,
which he commanded our ancestors
    to teach their children,

twi: sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nkyirimma besua,mpo mmofra a wonnya nwoo wɔn,na wɔn nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma.
english:
so the next generation would know them,
    even the children yet to be born,
    and they in turn would tell their children.

twi: Afei wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Onyankopɔn so,na wɔn werɛ remfi ne nneyɛe,na wobedi nʼahyɛde so.
english:
Then they would put their trust in God
    and would not forget his deeds
    but would keep his commands.

twi: Wɔrenyɛ sɛ wɔn nenanom,a na wɔyɛ asoɔdenfo ne atuatewfo,wɔn a wonni Onyankopɔn nokware wɔ wɔn koma muna woyɛ honhom mu atorofo ma no no.
english:
They would not be like their ancestors—
    a stubborn and rebellious generation,
whose hearts were not loyal to God,
    whose spirits were not faithful to him.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na Efraim mmarima kurakura agyan,nanso ɔko da no woguanee;
english:
The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows,
    turned back on the day of battle;

twi: Wɔanni Onyankopɔn apam no so,wɔampɛ sɛ wodi ne mmara no so.
english:
they did not keep God’s covenant
    and refused to live by his law.

twi: Wɔn werɛ fii nea wayɛ,anwonwade a wayɛ akyerɛ wɔn no.
english:
They forgot what he had done,
    the wonders he had shown them.

twi: Ɔyɛɛ anwonwade wɔ wɔn nenanom anim,wɔ Soan mantam a ɛwɔ Misraim asase so.
english:
He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors
    in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

twi: Ɔkyɛɛ po mu na ɔde wɔn faa mu.Ɔmaa nsu no gyinaa sɛ afasu.
english:
He divided the sea and led them through;
    he made the water stand up like a wall.

twi: Ɔde omununkum dii wɔn anim awiana ɔde ogyatɛn dii wɔn anim anadwo nyinaa.
english:
He guided them with the cloud by day
    and with light from the fire all night.

twi: Ɔpaee ɔbotan mu wɔ sare so,na ɔmaa wɔn nsu a ɛdɔɔso sɛ po;
english:
He split the rocks in the wilderness
    and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

twi: Ɔmaa asuti fii abotan muna ɔmaa nsu sen sɛ nsubɔnten.
english:
he brought streams out of a rocky crag
    and made water flow down like rivers.

twi: Nanso wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa no,wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ sare no so.
english:
But they continued to sin against him,
    rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.

twi: Wɔhyɛɛ da kaa aduan a wɔpɛ,de sɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe.
english:
They willfully put God to the test
    by demanding the food they craved.

twi: Wɔkasa tiaa Onyankopɔn se,“Onyankopɔn betumi ato pon wɔ sare so ana?
Ɔde ade bɔɔ ɔbotan mu no, nsu tue fii mu,na nsuwa sen buu so.Na obetumi ama yɛn aduan nso?Obetumi ama ne nkurɔfo nam ana?”
english:
True, he struck the rock,
    and water gushed out,
    streams flowed abundantly,
but can he also give us bread?
    Can he supply meat for his people?”

twi: Bere a Awurade tee nea wɔreka no, ne bo fuw yiye;ne gya beguu Yakob so,na nʼabufuwhyew sɔre tiaa Israel,
efisɛ na wonni Onyankopɔn mu gyidianaasɛ ne nkwagye mu ahotoso.
english:
for they did not believe in God
    or trust in his deliverance.

twi: Nanso ɔkasa kyerɛɛ ɔsoro wɔ ɔhyɛ so;na obuee ɔsorosoro apon.
english:
Yet he gave a command to the skies above
    and opened the doors of the heavens;

twi: Ɔtɔɔ mana guu fam maa nnipa no sɛ wunni,ɔmaa wɔn ɔsoro aduan.
english:
he rained down manna for the people to eat,
    he gave them the grain of heaven.

twi: Nnipa dii abɔfo aduan;ɔmaa wɔn aduan a wobetumi adi nyinaa.
english:
Human beings ate the bread of angels;
    he sent them all the food they could eat.

twi: Ogyaa apuei mframa fi ɔsoro,na ofi ne tumi mu bɔɔ atɔe mframa.
english:
He let loose the east wind from the heavens
    and by his power made the south wind blow.

twi: Ɔtɔɔ nam sɛ mfutuma guu wɔn so,nnomaa a wotu bebree sɛ mpoano nwea.
english:
He rained meat down on them like dust,
    birds like sand on the seashore.

twi: Ɔma wɔbaa fam kɔɔ wɔn atenae,ne wɔn ntamadan ho nyinaa.
english:
He made them come down inside their camp,
    all around their tents.

twi: Wodidi maa aduan no boroo wɔn soefisɛ ɔmaa wɔn nea wɔhwehwɛ.
english:
They ate till they were gorged—
    he had given them what they craved.

twi: Nanso ansa na wobefi aduan a wɔhwehwɛ no ho,bere a ɛhyehyɛ wɔn anom mpo no,
english:
But before they turned from what they craved,
    even while the food was still in their mouths,

twi: Onyankopɔn abufuw sɔree wɔn so;okum ahoɔdenfo a wɔwɔ wɔn mutwitwaa Israel mmerante gui.
Eyinom nyinaa akyi, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne;nʼanwonwade akyi no, wɔannye anni.
english:
In spite of all this, they kept on sinning;
    in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

twi: Enti otwaa wɔn nna so te sɛ ahuruyɛɛ wɔn mfe awiei huhuuhu.
english:
So he ended their days in futility
    and their years in terror.

twi: Bere biara a Onyankopɔn bekum wɔn no, wɔhwehwɛ nona wɔpere wɔn ho san ba ne nkyɛn.
english:
Whenever God slew them, they would seek him;
    they eagerly turned to him again.

twi: Wɔkaee sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ wɔn botan,sɛ Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no yɛ wɔn Gyefo.
english:
They remembered that God was their Rock,
    that God Most High was their Redeemer.

twi: Nanso wɔde wɔn ano bɛdaadaa no,na wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma atwa atoro akyerɛ no;
english:
But then they would flatter him with their mouths,
    lying to him with their tongues;

twi: wɔn koma nni no nokware,na wonni nʼapam no so.
english:
their hearts were not loyal to him,
    they were not faithful to his covenant.

twi: Nanso na ɔyɛ ahummɔbɔ;ɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ kyɛɛ wɔna wansɛe wɔn.Mpɛn pii, ɔtwentwɛn nʼabufuw sona wanhwie nʼabufuwhyew nyinaa.
english:
Yet he was merciful;
    he forgave their iniquities
    and did not destroy them.
Time after time he restrained his anger
    and did not stir up his full wrath.

twi: Ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ ɔhonam ara kwa,mframa bi a ɛbɔ twa mu na ɛnsan nʼakyi.
english:
He remembered that they were but flesh,
    a passing breeze that does not return.

twi: Mpɛn ahe na wɔansɔre antia no wɔ sare no so hɔ,na mpɛn ahe na wɔamma ne werɛ anhow wɔ asase wosee no so!
english:
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness
    and grieved him in the wasteland!

twi: Wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ bere biara;na woyii Israel Ɔkronkronni no abufuw.
english:
Again and again they put God to the test;
    they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Wɔn werɛ fii ne tumi no,da a ogyee wɔn fii wɔn nhyɛsofo nsam no,
english:
They did not remember his power—
    the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,

twi: da a ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne nwonwaso wɔ Misraim none nʼanwonwade wɔ Soan mantam mu no.
english:
the day he displayed his signs in Egypt,
    his wonders in the region of Zoan.

twi: Ɔmaa wɔn nsubɔnten dan mogya;wɔantumi annom wɔn nsuten mu nsu.
english:
He turned their river into blood;
    they could not drink from their streams.

twi: Ɔmaa nwansenadɔm baa wɔn so bɛhaw wɔnna mpɔtorɔ nso bɛsɛee wɔn asase.
english:
He sent swarms of flies that devoured them,
    and frogs that devastated them.

twi: Ɔmaa tɛwtɛw bedii wɔn mfuw so aduanna ɔde wɔn nnɔbae nso maa mmoadabi.
english:
He gave their crops to the grasshopper,
    their produce to the locust.
