twi: Ɔde mparuwbo sɛee wɔn bobena ɔde sukyerɛmma sɛee wɔn ankye nnua.
english:
He destroyed their vines with hail
    and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

twi: Ɔde sukyerɛmma kum wɔn anantwiɔde anyinam kum wɔn nyɛmmoa.
english:
He gave over their cattle to the hail,
    their livestock to bolts of lightning.

twi: Ohwiee nʼabufuwhyew guu wɔn so,abufuw, anibere ne ɔtan;abɔfo asɛefo kuw no.
english:
He unleashed against them his hot anger,
    his wrath, indignation and hostility—
    a band of destroying angels.

twi: Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa nʼabufuw;na wamfa wɔn nkwa ankyɛ wɔn,mmom, ɔde wɔn maa ɔyaredɔm.
Okunkum Misraimfo mmakan nyinaa,Ham ntamadan mu nnipa mu abakan.
english:
He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt,
    the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

twi: Nanso oyii ne nkurɔfo fii mu sɛ nguankuw;odii wɔn anim sɛ nguan wɔ sare no so.
english:
But he brought his people out like a flock;
    he led them like sheep through the wilderness.

twi: Odii wɔn anim dwoodwoo, enti wɔansuro;nanso wɔn atamfo de, po asorɔkye bu faa wɔn so.
english:
He guided them safely, so they were unafraid;
    but the sea engulfed their enemies.

twi: Sɛɛ na ɔyɛ de wɔn baa nʼasase kronkron no ahye so,bepɔw asase a ɔde ne nsa nifa gyee no.
english:
And so he brought them to the border of his holy land,
    to the hill country his right hand had taken.

twi: Ɔpam amanaman a wɔwɔ wɔn anim nona ɔkyekyɛɛ wɔn nsase no mu maa wɔn sɛ wɔn agyapade;ɔbɔɔ Israel mmusuakuw no atenase wɔ wɔn afi mu.
Nanso wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe,na wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no;na wɔanni ne mmara so.
Wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔn agyanom, wɔanni nokware na wɔannya gyidi,ahotoso nni wɔn mu na wɔte sɛ agyan a asɛe.
english:
Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless,
    as unreliable as a faulty bow.

twi: Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea hyɛɛ no abufuwna wɔn ahoni maa ne ninkutwe mu yɛɛ den.
english:
They angered him with their high places;
    they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

twi: Onyankopɔn tee wɔn nka no, ne bo fuwii;na ɔpoo Israel korakora.
english:
When God heard them, he was furious;
    he rejected Israel completely.

twi: Ogyaw nʼatenae a ɛwɔ Silo no,ntamadan a wasi wɔ nnipa mu no.
english:
He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh,
    the tent he had set up among humans.

twi: Ɔde Apam Adaka a ɛyɛ ne tumi no kɔɔ nnommum mu,nʼanuonyam kɔɔ atamfo nsam.
english:
He sent the ark of his might into captivity,
    his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

twi: Ɔde ne nkurɔfo maa afoa;ne bo fuw nʼagyapade yiye.
english:
He gave his people over to the sword;
    he was furious with his inheritance.

twi: Ogya hyew wɔn mmerante kum wɔn,na wɔn mmabaa annya ayeforohyia dwom anto;
english:
Fire consumed their young men,
    and their young women had no wedding songs;

twi: Wɔn asɔfo wuwuu afoa ano,na wɔn akunafo antumi ansu.
english:
their priests were put to the sword,
    and their widows could not weep.

twi: Afei Awurade sɔree sɛnea ofi nna mu no,sɛnea ɔbarima a wabow nsa nyan fi nnahɔɔ mu no.
english:
Then the Lord awoke as from sleep,
    as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.

twi: Ɔbobɔɔ nʼatamfo ma woguan kɔɔ wɔn akyi;ɔhyɛɛ wɔn aniwu afebɔɔ.
english:
He beat back his enemies;
    he put them to everlasting shame.

twi: Afei ɔpoo Yosef ntamadan no,na wamfa Efraim abusuakuw no nso;
english:
Then he rejected the tents of Joseph,
    he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

twi: Na mmom, ɔfaa Yuda abusuakuw no,Bepɔw Sion a ɔdɔ no no.
english:
but he chose the tribe of Judah,
    Mount Zion, which he loved.

twi: Osii ne kronkronbea te sɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea,te sɛ asase a etim hɔ daa.
english:
He built his sanctuary like the heights,
    like the earth that he established forever.

twi: Oyii ne somfo Dawid,ɔfrɛɛ no fii nguannan mu;
english:
He chose David his servant
    and took him from the sheep pens;

twi: fii nguan akyi na ɔde no baese ɔmmɛyɛ oguanhwɛfo mma ne nkurɔfo Yakob,mma Israel a wɔyɛ nʼagyapade.
english:
from tending the sheep he brought him
    to be the shepherd of his people Jacob,
    of Israel his inheritance.

twi: Na Dawid de koma pa hwɛɛ wɔn sona ɔde ne nimdeɛ dii wɔn anim.
english:
And David shepherded them with integrity of heart;
    with skillful hands he led them.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Ao Onyankopɔn, amanaman no atow ahyɛ wʼagyapade so;wɔagu wʼasɔredan kronkron no ho fi,wɔama Yerusalem adan nnwiriwii.
Wɔde wʼasomfo afunu ayɛ aduanama wim nnomaa,na wɔde wʼahotefo nam ama asase so mmoa.
english:
They have left the dead bodies of your servants
    as food for the birds of the sky,
    the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.

twi: Wɔahwie mogya agu te sɛ nsuwɔ Yerusalem ho nyinaa,na obiara nni hɔ a obesie awufo no.
english:
They have poured out blood like water
    all around Jerusalem,
    and there is no one to bury the dead.

twi: Yɛayɛ animtiaabude ama yɛn mfɛfo,fɛwdi ne nsopa ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.
english:
We are objects of contempt to our neighbors,
    of scorn and derision to those around us.

twi: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn? Wo bo befuw afebɔɔ ana?Wo ninkunu bɛdɛw sɛ ogya akosi da bɛn?
english:
How long, Lord? Will you be angry forever?
    How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

twi: Hwie wʼabufuw gu amanamana wonnye wo nto mu no so,ahenni awɔmmɔ wo din no;
english:
Pour out your wrath on the nations
    that do not acknowledge you,
on the kingdoms
    that do not call on your name;

twi: efisɛ wɔakum Yakobna wɔasɛe nʼatenae.
english:
for they have devoured Jacob
    and devastated his homeland.

twi: Mfa yɛn agyanom bɔne so asotwe mma yɛn;ma wo mmɔborɔhunu mmra yɛn so ntɛm,na yɛwɔ ahohiahia mu.
Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa, boa yɛn,wo din no anuonyam nti;gye yɛn na fa yɛn bɔne kyɛ yɛnwo din nti.
english:
Help us, God our Savior,
    for the glory of your name;
deliver us and forgive our sins
    for your name’s sake.

twi: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ amanaman ka se,“Wɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”Yɛn anim ha ara, ma wonhu wɔ amanaman mu sɛwotɔ wʼasomfo mogya a wɔahwie agu no so werɛ.
english:
Why should the nations say,
    “Where is their God?”
Before our eyes, make known among the nations
    that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

twi: Ma nneduafo no apinisi nnu wʼanim;fa wo basa ahoɔden nokora wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.
english:
May the groans of the prisoners come before you;
    with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.

twi: Awurade, ahohora a yɛn mfɛfo asum agu wo so no,tua wɔn so ka mpɛn ason.
english:
Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times
    the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.

twi: Na yɛn a yɛyɛ wo nkurɔfo, wʼadidibea nguan no,beyi wo ayɛ daa nyinaa;efi awo ntoatoaso kosi awo ntoatoaso,yɛbɛkɔ so aka wʼayeyi akyerɛ.
english:
Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture,
    will praise you forever;
from generation to generation
    we will proclaim your praise.

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Israel guanhwɛfo, tie yɛn,wo a wudii Yosef anim sɛnea wodi nguankuw anim;wo a wote ahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam no, hyerɛn
english:
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel,
    you who lead Joseph like a flock.
You who sit enthroned between the cherubim,
    shine forth

twi: wɔ Efraim, Benyamin ne Manase anim.Kanyan wo tumi;bra begye yɛn nkwa.
Ao Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio;ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.
Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn,wʼabufuw bɛdɛw akosi da bɛn,wʼabufuw a etia wo nkurɔfo mpaebɔ no?
english:
How long, Lord God Almighty,
    will your anger smolder
    against the prayers of your people?

twi: Wode nusu yɛɛ aduan maa wɔn dii;wode nusu kuruwama maa wɔn nomee.
english:
You have fed them with the bread of tears;
    you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

twi: Wode yɛn ayɛ nea yɛn mfɛfo ko ho,na yɛn atamfo serew yɛn.
english:
You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors,
    and our enemies mock us.

twi: Asafo Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio;ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.
Wutuu bobe fi Misraim beduae;wopam amanaman no na wuduae.
english:
You transplanted a vine from Egypt;
    you drove out the nations and planted it.

twi: Wosiesiee asase no baabi maa no,egyee ntin na ɛtrɛw asase no so.
english:
You cleared the ground for it,
    and it took root and filled the land.

twi: Ne nwini kataa mmepɔw no sone mman kataa sida akɛse no so.
english:
The mountains were covered with its shade,
    the mighty cedars with its branches.

twi: Ɛdennan trɛw kɔɔ Po no so,na ɛfefɛw trɛw koduu Asubɔnten no ho.
english:
Its branches reached as far as the Sea,
    its shoots as far as the River.

twi: Adɛn nti na woabubu nʼafasuama wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no tetew ne bobe aba no?
english:
Why have you broken down its walls
    so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

twi: Kɔkɔte fi wuram bɛsɛe no pasaana mmoadoma a wɔwɔ sare so de yɛ wɔn aduan.
english:
Boars from the forest ravage it,
    and insects from the fields feed on it.

twi: Asafo Nyankopɔn, san bra yɛn nkyɛn!fi ɔsoro hɔ hwɛ na wubehu!Hwɛ saa bobe yi so,
english:
Return to us, God Almighty!
    Look down from heaven and see!
Watch over this vine,

twi: ntin a wo nsa nifa adua no,ɔbabarima a woatetew no ama wo ho no.
english:
the root your right hand has planted,
    the son you have raised up for yourself.

twi: Wɔatwa wo bobe no ato fam, ato mu gya ama ahyew;wʼanimka ma wo nkurɔfo ase tɔre.
english:
Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire;
    at your rebuke your people perish.

twi: Fa wo nsa kata ɔbarima a ɔwɔ wo nifa no so,onipa ba a woatetew no ama wo ho no.
english:
Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand,
    the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

twi: Afei yɛrentwe yɛn ho mfi wo nkyɛn;kanyan yɛn, na yɛbɛbɔ wo din.
english:
Then we will not turn away from you;
    revive us, and we will call on your name.

twi: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio,na ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.
Dwom Asaf dwom.Monto ahurusi dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden;mommɔ ose mma Yakob Nyankopɔn no!
english:
Sing for joy to God our strength;
    shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

twi: Momma nnwom no so na monwosow akasaa.Mommɔ sanku ne bɛnta dɛdɛ no.
english:
Begin the music, strike the timbrel,
    play the melodious harp and lyre.

twi: Monhyɛn mmentia ɔsram foforo da no,ne ne kurokumatwa mu, yɛn Aponto da no;
english:
Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon,
    and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;

twi: Eyi yɛ Israelfo ahyɛde,Yakob Nyankopɔn mmara.
english:
this is a decree for Israel,
    an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

twi: Otintimii sɛ nhyehyɛe maa Yosefbere a ɔsɔre tiaa Misraim no,faako a yɛtee kasa a yɛnte ase no.
english:
When God went out against Egypt,
    he established it as a statute for Joseph.
I heard an unknown voice say:

twi: Ɔka se, “Miyii adesoa no fii wɔn mmati so,ne wɔn nsa fii kɛntɛn ho.
english:
“I removed the burden from their shoulders;
    their hands were set free from the basket.

twi: Mo ahohiahia mu mofrɛɛ me na migyee mo,migyee mo so wɔ aprannaa mu;mesɔɔ mo hwɛɛ wɔ Meriba nsu ho.
“Me nkurɔfo, muntie me kɔkɔbɔ yi,Israel, sɛ mubetie me a!
english:
Hear me, my people, and I will warn you—
    if you would only listen to me, Israel!

twi: Ɛnsɛ sɛ munya anyame foforo bi wɔ mo mu;ɛnsɛ sɛ mokotow ananafo anyame.
english:
You shall have no foreign god among you;
    you shall not worship any god other than me.

twi: Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn amiyii mo fii Misraim asase so no.Mummue mo anom tɛtrɛɛ na mɛhyɛ mu ma.
english:
I am the Lord your God,
    who brought you up out of Egypt.
Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

twi: “Nanso me nkurɔfo rentie me;Israel remmrɛ ne ho ase mma me.
english:
“But my people would not listen to me;
    Israel would not submit to me.

twi: Enti migyaa wɔn maa wɔn komadensɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔpɛ biara.
english:
So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts
    to follow their own devices.

twi: “Sɛ me nkurɔfo tie me,na Israel nantew mʼakwan so a,
english:
“If my people would only listen to me,
    if Israel would only follow my ways,

twi: anka medi wɔn atamfo so ama wɔn ntɛmna mama me basa so atia wɔn a wokyi wɔn!
english:
how quickly I would subdue their enemies
    and turn my hand against their foes!

twi: Wɔn a wɔtan Awurade no de osuro bɛkotow no,na wɔn asotwe to rentwa da.
english:
Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him,
    and their punishment would last forever.

twi: Nanso wɔde atoko mu atoko papa bɛma mo adi;mede ɔbotan mu wo bɛma mo amee.”
english:
But you would be fed with the finest of wheat;
    with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”

twi: Dwom Asaf dwom.Onyankopɔn di hene wɔ ɔsoro asafo mu;obu atɛn wɔ “anyame” mu.
english:
God presides in the great assembly;
    he renders judgment among the “gods”:

twi: “Wobɛbɔ wɔn a wɔnteɛ ho banna woayɛ nhwɛanim ama amumɔyɛfo akosi da bɛn?
english:
“How long will you defend the unjust
    and show partiality to the wicked?

twi: Monka mmɔborɔfo ne ayisaa asɛm mma wɔn;mommɔ ahiafo ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so yiyedi ho ban.
english:
Defend the weak and the fatherless;
    uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.

twi: Munnye ɔbrɛfo ne ahiafo;munnye wɔn mfi amumɔyɛfo nsam.
english:
Rescue the weak and the needy;
    deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

twi: “Anyame no nnim de, na wɔnte hwee ase.Wokyinkyin wɔ sum mu;na asase fapem nyinaa wosow.
“Mekae se, ‘Moyɛ “anyame;”mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.’
english:
“I said, ‘You are “gods”;
    you are all sons of the Most High.’

twi: Nanso mubewuwu sɛ nnipa pɛ;na moahwe ase sɛ ɔsodifo biara.”
english:
But you will die like mere mortals;
    you will fall like every other ruler.”

twi: Ao Onyankopɔn, sɔre, bu wiase atɛn;efisɛ amanaman nyinaa yɛ wo de.
english:
Rise up, O God, judge the earth,
    for all the nations are your inheritance.

twi: Dwom Asaf Dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, ntena hɔ komm;mmua wʼano, Ao, Onyankopɔn, keka wo ho.
Hwɛ sɛnea wʼatamfo keka wɔn ho fa,na wɔn a wɔmpɛ wʼasɛm nso ama wɔn ti so.
english:
See how your enemies growl,
    how your foes rear their heads.

twi: Wɔde anifere repam atia wo nkurɔfo,wɔrepam atia wɔn a wo koma da wɔn so no.
english:
With cunning they conspire against your people;
    they plot against those you cherish.

twi: Wɔka se, “Mommra na yɛnsɛe wɔn sɛ ɔman,sɛnea wɔrenkae Israel din bio.”
english:
“Come,” they say, “let us destroy them as a nation,
    so that Israel’s name is remembered no more.”

twi: Wɔde adwene koro bɔ pɔw;na wɔpam tia wo,
english:
With one mind they plot together;
    they form an alliance against you—

twi: Edom ntamadan ne Ismaelfo,Moabfo ne Hagarfo,
english:
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites,
    of Moab and the Hagrites,

twi: Gebalfo ne Amonfo ne Amalekfo,Filistifo ne Tirofo.
english:
Byblos, Ammon and Amalek,
    Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

twi: Asiria mpo akɔka wɔn hode wɔn ahoɔden akɔhyɛ Lot asefo de no mu den.
english:
Even Assyria has joined them
    to reinforce Lot’s descendants.

twi: Yɛ wɔn sɛnea woyɛɛ Midian,sɛnea woyɛɛ Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asubɔnten Kison ho no,
english:
Do to them as you did to Midian,
    as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

twi: wɔn a wɔsɛe wɔ En-Dorna wɔdan nwura no.
english:
who perished at Endor
    and became like dung on the ground.

twi: Yɛ wɔn atitiriw sɛ Oreb ne Seeb,ne wɔn mmapɔmma nyinaa sɛ Seba ne Salmuna,
english:
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,
    all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

twi: a wɔkae se, “Momma yɛmfaOnyankopɔn adidibea nsase no no.”
english:
who said, “Let us take possession
    of the pasturelands of God.”

twi: Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ mfɛtɛ mu mfutuma,sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu.
english:
Make them like tumbleweed, my God,
    like chaff before the wind.

twi: Sɛnea ogya hyew kwae,na ogyatannaa so nkoko mu hyew no no,
english:
As fire consumes the forest
    or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

twi: saa ara na fa wʼahum taa wɔnna fa wo mframa a ano yɛ den no hunahuna wɔn.
english:
so pursue them with your tempest
    and terrify them with your storm.

twi: Ma animguase nka wɔn,na ama nnipa ahwehwɛ wo din akyi kwan, Awurade.
english:
Cover their faces with shame, Lord,
    so that they will seek your name.

twi: Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wonni yaw;ma wonwuwu wɔ animguase mu.
english:
May they ever be ashamed and dismayed;
    may they perish in disgrace.

twi: Ma wonhu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no,wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase nyinaa so.
english:
Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord—
    that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Awurade Asafo,wʼatenae hɔ yɛ ahomeka!
english:
How lovely is your dwelling place,
    Lord Almighty!

twi: Me kra pere, mpo ɛtɔ beraw,sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Awurade adiwo;me koma ne me honam teɛ mufrɛ Onyankopɔn teasefo.
english:
My soul yearns, even faints,
    for the courts of the Lord;
my heart and my flesh cry out
    for the living God.

twi: Mpo akasanoma anya ofi,na asomfena nso anwen ne berebuw,faako a obesow ne mmawɔ beae bi a ɛbɛn wʼafɔremuka,Awurade Asafo, me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn.
english:
Even the sparrow has found a home,
    and the swallow a nest for herself,
    where she may have her young—
a place near your altar,
    Lord Almighty, my King and my God.

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔte wo fi;na wɔkamfo wo din daa.
english:
Blessed are those who dwell in your house;
    they are ever praising you.

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔwɔ wo mu ahoɔden,na wɔde wɔn koma fi akwantu ase kɔhwehwɛ wo.
english:
Blessed are those whose strength is in you,
    whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

twi: Sɛ wɔfa Baka Bon no mu awɔma hɔ yɛ nsuwansuwa;asusow bere nsu so taataa hɔ.
Wɔkɔ no ahoɔden so bere nyinaa,kosi sɛ wɔn mu biara bepue Onyankopɔn anim wɔ Sion.
english:
They go from strength to strength,
    till each appears before God in Zion.

twi: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ;Yakob Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma me.
english:
Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty;
    listen to me, God of Jacob.

twi: Ao, Onyankopɔn, hwɛ yɛn nkatabo;fa ahummɔbɔ hwɛ nea woasra no ngo no.
english:
Look on our shield, O God;
    look with favor on your anointed one.

twi: Wʼadiwo hɔ da koro tenaye sen nnafua apem wɔ baabi foforo;mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ ɔponanohwɛfo wɔ Onyankopɔn fisen sɛ mɛtena amumɔyɛfo ntamadan mu.
english:
Better is one day in your courts
    than a thousand elsewhere;
I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God
    than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

twi: Efisɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn yɛ owia ne kyɛm;Awurade hu mmɔbɔ na ɔhyɛ anuonyam;ɔmmfa ade pa biara nkamewɔn a wɔteɛ.
Asafo Awurade,nhyira nka onipa a ɔde ne ho to wo so.
english:
Lord Almighty,
    blessed is the one who trusts in you.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Wo Awurade, wodom wʼasase;wode Yakob ahonyade san maa no.
english:
You, Lord, showed favor to your land;
    you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

twi: Wode wo nkurɔfo bɔne kyɛɛ wɔnna wokataa wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa so.
english:
You forgave the iniquity of your people
    and covered all their sins.

twi: Wode wʼabufuw nyinaa too nkyɛnna wodan fii wʼabufuwhyew ho.
english:
You set aside all your wrath
    and turned from your fierce anger.

twi: San gye yɛn bio, Onyankopɔn, yɛn Gyefo,na ma wʼani nnye yɛn ho.
english:
Restore us again, God our Savior,
    and put away your displeasure toward us.

twi: Wo bo befuw yɛn akosi daa ana?Wʼabufuw bɛtoa so akɔ awo ntoantoaso nyinaa so ana?
english:
Will you be angry with us forever?
    Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

twi: Worenhyɛ yɛn den bio,na ama wo nkurɔfo asɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ wo mu ana?
english:
Will you not revive us again,
    that your people may rejoice in you?

twi: Awurade, kyerɛ yɛn wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no,na ma yɛn wo nkwagye no.
english:
Show us your unfailing love, Lord,
    and grant us your salvation.

twi: Metie nea Awurade Nyankopɔn bɛka;ɔde asomdwoe hyɛ ne nkurɔfo, ahotefo no bɔ,enti ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsan kɔ agyimisɛm ho.
Ampa ara, ne nkwagye bɛn wɔn a wosuro no,na nʼanuonyam bɛtena yɛn asase so.
english:
Surely his salvation is near those who fear him,
    that his glory may dwell in our land.

twi: Ɔdɔ ne nokwaredi behyia,na trenee ne asomdwoe befew wɔn ho wɔn ho ano.
english:
Love and faithfulness meet together;
    righteousness and peace kiss each other.

twi: Nokwaredi bepue afi asase no so,na trenee ahwɛ afi ɔsoro.
english:
Faithfulness springs forth from the earth,
    and righteousness looks down from heaven.

twi: Awurade bɛma yɛn nea eye ampa arana yɛn asase bɛma ne nnɔbae.
english:
The Lord will indeed give what is good,
    and our land will yield its harvest.

twi: Trenee di nʼanimsiesie ɔkwan ma nʼanammɔntu.
english:
Righteousness goes before him
    and prepares the way for his steps.

twi: Dwom Dawid mpaebɔ.Awurade, tie me na gye me so,efisɛ meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni.
english:
Hear me, Lord, and answer me,
    for I am poor and needy.

twi: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban, efisɛ mede me ho ama wo.Wo ne me Nyankopɔn, gye wʼakoa aɔde ne ho to wo so.
Awurade, hu me mmɔbɔ,na misu frɛ wo daa nyinaa.
english:
have mercy on me, Lord,
    for I call to you all day long.

twi: Ma wʼakoa ani nnye,na wo Awurade, wo nkyɛnna mema me kra so ba.
english:
Bring joy to your servant, Lord,
    for I put my trust in you.

twi: Awurade, wuye na wode bɔne kyɛ,wowɔ ɔdɔ mmoroso ma wɔn a wosu frɛ wo nyinaa.
english:
You, Lord, are forgiving and good,
    abounding in love to all who call to you.

twi: Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ;tie me mmɔborɔsu.
english:
Hear my prayer, Lord;
    listen to my cry for mercy.

twi: Mɛfrɛ wo mʼahohia da mu,na wubegye me so.
english:
When I am in distress, I call to you,
    because you answer me.

twi: Awurade, onyame bi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ wo;na wɔn nnwuma biara nto wo de.
english:
Among the gods there is none like you, Lord;
    no deeds can compare with yours.

twi: Awurade, aman a woakyekyere nyinaabɛba abɛsom wo wɔ wʼanim;wɔbɛba abɛhyɛ wo din anuonyam.
Woyɛ ɔkɛse na woyɛ anwonwa nnwuma;wo nko ara ne Onyankopɔn.
english:
For you are great and do marvelous deeds;
    you alone are God.

twi: Awurade, kyerɛ me wʼakwan,na mɛnantew wo nokware mu;ma memfa me koma nyinaa mma wona masuro wo din.
english:
Teach me your way, Lord,
    that I may rely on your faithfulness;
give me an undivided heart,
    that I may fear your name.

twi: Mede me koma nyinaa meyi wo ayɛ, Awurade me Nyankopɔnna mahyɛ wo din anuonyam daa nyinaa.
english:
I will praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart;
    I will glorify your name forever.

twi: Efisɛ ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no so;woayi me afi owu amoa mu tɔnn.
Ao, Onyankopɔn, ahomasofo atow ahyɛ me so;basabasayɛfo kuw rehwehwɛ me akum me,nnipa a wɔmmfa wo nyɛ hwee no.
Nanso wo, Awurade, woyɛ mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔdomfo Nyankopɔn,wo bo kyɛ fuw, na wʼadɔe ne wo nokware dɔɔso.
english:
But you, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God,
    slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

twi: Dan wʼani hwɛ me na dom me;fa wʼahoɔden ma wʼakoana gye wʼafenaa babarima nkwa.
Ma me wo papayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnne,na mʼatamfo nhu na wɔn anim ngu asena wo, Awurade, wo na woaboa me akyekye me werɛ.
english:
Give me a sign of your goodness,
    that my enemies may see it and be put to shame,
    for you, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.

twi: Dwom Koramma dwom.Wato ne fapem wɔ bepɔw kronkron no so;
english: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.

twi: Awurade dɔ Sion apon nosen Yakob atenae nyinaa.
english:
The Lord loves the gates of Zion
    more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.

twi: Wɔka wo ho anuonyamsɛmOnyankopɔn kuropɔn:
english:
Glorious things are said of you,
    city of God:

twi: “Mede Rahab ne Babiloniabɛka wɔn a wɔyɛ osetie ma me no ho,Filistia, Tiro ne Kus nsona maka se, ‘Wɔwoo eyinom wɔ Sion.’ ”
english:
“I will record Rahab and Babylon
    among those who acknowledge me—
Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush—
    and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”

twi: Ampa ara wɔbɛka afa Sion ho se,“Wɔwoo oyi ne ɔno wɔ no mu,na Ɔsorosoroni no ankasa de no betim hɔ.”
english:
Indeed, of Zion it will be said,
    “This one and that one were born in her,
    and the Most High himself will establish her.”

twi: Awurade bɛkyerɛw wɔ nnipa dinkyerɛw nhoma no mu se,“Wɔwoo oyi wɔ Sion.”
english:
The Lord will write in the register of the peoples:
    “This one was born in Zion.”

twi: Na wɔbɛto dwom se,“Me ntin nyinaa wɔ wo mu.”
english:
As they make music they will sing,
    “All my fountains are in you.”

twi: Dwom Esrahini Heman ɔhaw ne amanehunu dwom.Awurade, woyɛ me nkwagye Nyankopɔnmisu wɔ wʼanim adekyee ne adesae.
english:
Lord, you are the God who saves me;
    day and night I cry out to you.

twi: Ma me mpaebɔ nnu wʼanim;brɛ wʼaso ase tie me sufrɛ.
english:
May my prayer come before you;
    turn your ear to my cry.

twi: Ɔhaw ahyɛ me kra mana me nkwa rebɛn owu.
english:
I am overwhelmed with troubles
    and my life draws near to death.

twi: Wɔkan me fra wɔn a wɔrekɔ ɔda mu no;mete sɛ obi a onni ahoɔden.
english:
I am counted among those who go down to the pit;
    I am like one without strength.

twi: Wɔayi me asi nkyɛn wɔ awufo mu,te sɛ atɔfo a wɔdeda ɔda mu,wɔn a wonkae wɔn bio,na wonhwɛ wɔn bio.
english:
I am set apart with the dead,
    like the slain who lie in the grave,
whom you remember no more,
    who are cut off from your care.

twi: Woatow me akyene ɔda ase tɔnn,wɔ sum kabii mu.
english:
You have put me in the lowest pit,
    in the darkest depths.

twi: Wʼabufuwhyew ayɛ duru wɔ me so;woama wʼasorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so.
english:
Your wrath lies heavily on me;
    you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.

twi: Woafa me nnamfonom a wɔbɛn me afi me nkyɛnwoama me ho ayɛ wɔn ahi.Woaka me ahyɛ mu na mintumi nguan;
awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuu.Awurade misu frɛ wo da biara;metrɛw me nsam kyerɛ wo.
Woyɛ anwonwade kyerɛ awufo ana?Wɔn a wɔawuwu no sɔre kamfo wo ana?
english:
Do you show your wonders to the dead?
    Do their spirits rise up and praise you?

twi: Wɔka wʼadɔe ho asɛm wɔ ɔda mu,anaasɛ wo nokware ho asɛm wɔ ɔsɛe kurom ana?
english:
Is your love declared in the grave,
    your faithfulness in Destruction?

twi: Wohu wʼanwonwade wɔ beae a hɔ aduru sum,anaa wo trenee nnwuma no wɔ awerɛfiri asase so ana?
english:
Are your wonders known in the place of darkness,
    or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

twi: Nanso Awurade, misu frɛ wo sɛ boa me;me mpaebɔ du wʼanim adekyee mu.
english:
But I cry to you for help, Lord;
    in the morning my prayer comes before you.

twi: Adɛn, Awurade, na wopo mena wode wʼanim hintaw me?
english:
Why, Lord, do you reject me
    and hide your face from me?

twi: Mahu amane fi me mmofraase na mabɛn owu;wʼahunahuna ama mabrɛ na mapa abaw.
english:
From my youth I have suffered and been close to death;
    I have borne your terrors and am in despair.

twi: Wʼabufuwhyew abu afa me so;wʼahunahuna asɛe me.
english:
Your wrath has swept over me;
    your terrors have destroyed me.

twi: Daa nyinaa wotwa me ho hyia sɛ nsuyiri,na wɔabu afa me so koraa.
english:
All day long they surround me like a flood;
    they have completely engulfed me.

twi: Woafa me yɔnkonom ne mʼadɔfo afi me nkyɛn kɔ;na sum ayɛ mʼadamfo a ɔbɛn me pɛɛ.
english:
You have taken from me friend and neighbor—
    darkness is my closest friend.

twi: Dwom Esrahini Etan ɔhaw ne amanehunu dwom.Mɛto Awurade adɔe ho dwom daa daa;mede mʼano bɛda wo nokwaredi adi awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
Mɛka se wʼadɔe no tim hɔ daa nyinaa,na woatim wo nokwaredi wɔ ɔsoro hɔ ankasa.
english:
I will declare that your love stands firm forever,
    that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

twi: Wokae se, “Mene onipa a mayi no no ayɛ apam;maka ntam akyerɛ me somfo Dawid.
english:
You said, “I have made a covenant with my chosen one,
    I have sworn to David my servant,

twi: ‘Mɛma wʼase atim hɔ daana wʼahengua nso atim wɔ awo ntoantoaso nyinaa mu.’ ”
english:
‘I will establish your line forever
    and make your throne firm through all generations.’”

twi: Awurade, ɔsorosorofo kamfo wʼanwonwade,na wo nokwaredi nso, wɔkamfo wɔ ahotefo asafo mu.
english:
The heavens praise your wonders, Lord,
    your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

twi: Na hena na ɔne wo Awurade sɛ wɔ ɔsoro hɔ?Hena na ɔte sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsoro abɔde mu?
english:
For who in the skies above can compare with the Lord?
    Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings?

twi: Akronkronfo agyinatufo mu, wosuro Onyankopɔn;wɔde osuro kɛse ma Onyankopɔn wɔ akronkronfo nhyiamu ase.
english:
In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared;
    he is more awesome than all who surround him.

twi: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, hena na ɔte sɛ wo?Wo, Awurade, woyɛ ɔkɛse na wo nokwaredi atwa wo ho ahyia.
english:
Who is like you, Lord God Almighty?
    You, Lord, are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.

twi: Wudi po a ɛworo no so;nʼasorɔkye bobɔ kɔ soro a, wobrɛ no ase.
english:
You rule over the surging sea;
    when its waves mount up, you still them.

twi: Wodwerɛw Rahab sɛ atɔfo no mu baako;wode wo basa dennen no bɔɔ wʼatamfo pansamee.
english:
You crushed Rahab like one of the slain;
    with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

twi: Ɔsoro wɔ wo, na asase nso wɔ wo;wiase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa wo na wufii ase.
english:
The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth;
    you founded the world and all that is in it.

twi: Wobɔɔ atifi ne anafo.Tabor ne Hermon de ahosɛpɛw to dwom ma wo din.
english:
You created the north and the south;
    Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

twi: Tumi ayɛ wo basa ma;wo nsam wɔ ahoɔden, woama wo nsa nifa so.
english:
Your arm is endowed with power;
    your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

twi: Wʼahengua no fapem yɛ trenee ne atɛntrenee;adɔe ne nokwaredi di wʼanim.
english:
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne;
    love and faithfulness go before you.

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔasua sɛnea wɔbɔ wo abodin,wɔn a wɔnantew wʼanim hann no mu, Awurade.
english:
Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you,
    who walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

twi: Wogye wɔn ani wɔ wo din mu da mu nyinaa;wodi ahurusi wɔ wo trenee mu.
english:
They rejoice in your name all day long;
    they celebrate your righteousness.

twi: Wone wɔn anuonyam ne ahoɔden,na wʼadom nti yɛyɛ nkonimdifo.
english:
For you are their glory and strength,
    and by your favor you exalt our horn.

twi: Ampa ara, yɛn kyɛm wɔ Awurade,na yɛn hene wɔ Israel Kronkronni no.
english:
Indeed, our shield belongs to the Lord,
    our king to the Holy One of Israel.

twi: Da bi wokasaa wɔ anisoadehu mu,kyerɛɛ wʼahotefo se,“Madom ɔkofo bi ahoɔden;mapagyaw aberante bi afi nnipa no mu.
english:
Once you spoke in a vision,
    to your faithful people you said:
“I have bestowed strength on a warrior;
    I have raised up a young man from among the people.

twi: Mahu Dawid, me somfo;mede me ngo kronkron no asra no.
english:
I have found David my servant;
    with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

twi: Me nsa bɛwowaw no;ampa ara me basa bɛhyɛ no den.
english:
My hand will sustain him;
    surely my arm will strengthen him.

twi: Ɔtamfo biara renhyɛ no sɛ ontua tow;omumɔyɛfo biara rentumi nhyɛ no so.
english:
The enemy will not get the better of him;
    the wicked will not oppress him.

twi: Mɛdwerɛw nʼatamfo wɔ nʼanimna mabobɔ nʼahohiahiafo ahwe fam.
english:
I will crush his foes before him
    and strike down his adversaries.

twi: Me nokware adɔe bɛka ne ho,na me din mu, wɔbɛma nʼabɛn so.
english:
My faithful love will be with him,
    and through my name his horn will be exalted.

twi: Mɛtrɛw nʼahye mu akosi po so,na ɔde ne nsa nifa bɛto nsubɔnten so.
english:
I will set his hand over the sea,
    his right hand over the rivers.

twi: Ɔbɛfrɛ me aka se, ‘Wone mʼagya,me Nyankopɔn, me nkwagye botan.’
english:
He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father,
    my God, the Rock my Savior.’

twi: Mɛyɛ no mʼabakan,asase so ahene nyinaa no mu ɔkɛse.
english:
And I will appoint him to be my firstborn,
    the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

twi: Mɛma mʼadɔe a mewɔ ma no no atena hɔ daa,na apam a me ne no ayɛ nso bɛtena hɔ daa.
english:
I will maintain my love to him forever,
    and my covenant with him will never fail.

twi: Mɛma nʼase atim afebɔɔ,nʼahengua nso betim hɔ akosi sɛ ɔsoro betwa mu.
english:
I will establish his line forever,
    his throne as long as the heavens endure.

twi: “Sɛ ne mmabarima po me mmarana sɛ wɔanni mʼahyɛde so,
english:
“If his sons forsake my law
    and do not follow my statutes,

twi: sɛ wobu mʼahyɛde sona sɛ wɔanni me hyɛ nsɛm so a,
english:
if they violate my decrees
    and fail to keep my commands,

twi: ɛno de mede abaa bɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne hona wɔn amumɔyɛ nso mede mmaatwa atwe wɔn aso;
english:
I will punish their sin with the rod,
    their iniquity with flogging;

twi: Nanso merennyae mʼadɔe a meyɛ ma no nona mɛkɔ so adi no nokware.
english:
but I will not take my love from him,
    nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

twi: Meremmu mʼapam no sona merensesa nea mede mʼano aka no.
english:
I will not violate my covenant
    or alter what my lips have uttered.

twi: Menam me din kronkron no so aka ntam prɛko,na merentwa Dawid atoro da,
english:
Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness—
    and I will not lie to David—

twi: meremma nʼase ntɔre dana nʼahengua nso betim wɔ mʼanim te sɛ owia;
english:
that his line will continue forever
    and his throne endure before me like the sun;

twi: ebetim hɔ daa te sɛ ɔsram,ɔdanseni nokwafo a ɔwɔ wim no.”
english:
it will be established forever like the moon,
    the faithful witness in the sky.”

twi: Nanso woapo no, woapa nʼakyi,wo bo afuw nea woasra no ngo no.
english:
But you have rejected, you have spurned,
    you have been very angry with your anointed one.

twi: Woagu apam a wo ne wo somfo pamee no,woagu nʼahenkyɛw ho fi wɔ mfutuma mu.
english:
You have renounced the covenant with your servant
    and have defiled his crown in the dust.

twi: Woabubu nʼafasu nyinaaama nʼabandennen adan nnwiriwii.
english:
You have broken through all his walls
    and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

twi: Wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ nyinaa fow no fa;na wayɛ aniwude ama ne mfɛfo.
english:
All who pass by have plundered him;
    he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

twi: Woama nʼatamfo nsa nifa so;ama wɔn nyinaa di ahurusi.
english:
You have exalted the right hand of his foes;
    you have made all his enemies rejoice.

twi: Woama nʼafoa ayɛ ɔkwa,na woannyina nʼakyi wɔ ɔko mu.
english:
Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword
    and have not supported him in battle.

twi: Wode nʼanuonyam aba awieina woatow nʼahengua akyene fam.
english:
You have put an end to his splendor
    and cast his throne to the ground.

twi: Woatwa ne mmerantebere nna sona wode animguase nguguso akata no so.
english:
You have cut short the days of his youth;
    you have covered him with a mantle of shame.

twi: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn? Na wode wo ho behintaw?Wʼabufuwhyew bɛkɔ so adɛw akosi da bɛn?
english:
How long, Lord? Will you hide yourself forever?
    How long will your wrath burn like fire?

twi: Kae sɛnea me nkwanna twa mu ntɛm so.Efisɛ woabɔ yɛn nyinaa sɛ ade a etwa mu ntɛm so!
english:
Remember how fleeting is my life.
    For what futility you have created all humanity!

twi: Hena na ɔbɛtena ase a ɔrenwu da?Anaasɛ hena na obetumi agye ne ho afi owu tumi nsam?
english:
Who can live and not see death,
    or who can escape the power of the grave?

twi: Awurade, ɛhe na wo tete adɔe kɛse no wɔ,nea wufi wo nokwaredi mu de kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid no?
english:
Lord, where is your former great love,
    which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

twi: Kae, Awurade, sɛnea wɔadi wo somfo ho fɛwne sɛnea manya koma ama amanaman no akutiabɔ,
english:
Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked,
    how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

twi: Awurade, akutiabɔ a wʼatamfo de adi fɛwde adi nea woasra no ngo no anammɔntu biara ho fɛw.
english:
the taunts with which your enemies, Lord, have mocked,
    with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade daa!Amen, Amen.
english:
Praise be to the Lord forever!
Amen and Amen.

twi: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ANANNnwom –Dwom Onyankopɔn nipa Mose mpaebɔ.Awurade, wo na woayɛ yɛn tenabeaawo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
english:
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
    throughout all generations.

twi: Ansa na wɔrebɛbɔ mmepɔwanaasɛ worebɛda asase ne wiase adi no,na woyɛ Onyankopɔn fi mmeresanten kosi mmeresanten.
english:
Before the mountains were born
    or you brought forth the whole world,
    from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

twi: Woma adesamma san dan mfutuma,ka se, “Mo adesamma, monsan nkɔ mfutuma mu.”
english:
You turn people back to dust,
    saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.”

twi: Mfirihyia apem yɛ wʼani so sɛda koro a abɛsen mprempren,anaasɛ anadwo mu dɔnhwerew kakraa bi.
english:
A thousand years in your sight
    are like a day that has just gone by,
    or like a watch in the night.

twi: Wopra nnipa kɔ, wɔ owu nna mu;wɔte sɛ sare a afefɛw anɔpa,
english:
Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death—
    they are like the new grass of the morning:

twi: ɛfefɛw yɛ frɔmfrɔm anɔpa de,nanso anwummere ɛwo na etwintwam.
english:
In the morning it springs up new,
    but by evening it is dry and withered.

twi: Yɛresa wɔ wʼabufuw anona wʼanibere abɔ yɛn hu.
english:
We are consumed by your anger
    and terrified by your indignation.

twi: Wode yɛn amumɔyɛ asi wʼanim,na yɛn kokoa mu bɔne da wʼanim hann no mu.
english:
You have set our iniquities before you,
    our secret sins in the light of your presence.

twi: Yɛn nna nyinaa twa mu wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu;na yɛde awerɛhowdi na ewie yɛn mfe.
english:
All our days pass away under your wrath;
    we finish our years with a moan.

twi: Yɛn nkwa nna si mfe aduɔson,anaasɛ aduɔwɔtwe, sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden a;na mu ahohoahoade yɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhow,na etwa mu ntɛmntɛm, na yetu kɔ.
english:
Our days may come to seventy years,
    or eighty, if our strength endures;
yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow,
    for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

twi: Sɛ anka yebehu sɛ wʼabufuw mu tumi te ɛ!Wʼabufuwhyew kɛse te sɛnea wo ho suro te.
english:
If only we knew the power of your anger!
    Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.

twi: Ma yenhu yɛn nna kan sɛnea ɛte,na yɛanya nyansa koma.
english:
Teach us to number our days,
    that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

twi: Tɔ wo bo ase, Awurade, enkosi da bɛn?Hu wʼasomfo mmɔbɔ.
english:
Relent, Lord! How long will it be?
    Have compassion on your servants.

twi: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no mmee yɛn adekyee mu,na yɛde anigye ato dwom adi ahurusi yɛn nna nyinaa mu.
english:
Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love,
    that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

twi: Ma yɛn ani nnye nna bebree sɛ nna dodow a wode yɛn kɔɔ amanehunu mu no,sɛ mfirihyia dodow a yehuu ateetee no.
english:
Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us,
    for as many years as we have seen trouble.

twi: Ma wʼasomfo nhu wo nneyɛena wɔn mma nhu wʼanuonyam.
english:
May your deeds be shown to your servants,
    your splendor to their children.

twi: Ma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn adom no ntena yɛn so;na yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yiye mma yɛn;yiw, ma yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yiye.
Dwom Nea ɔte Ɔsorosoroni no hintabea no biarabɛhome wɔ Otumfo no nwini ase.
english:
Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High
    will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

twi: Mese Awurade se, “Ɔyɛ me guankɔbea ne mʼabandennen,me Nyankopɔn a mewɔ no mu ahotoso.”
english:
I will say of the Lord, “He is my refuge and my fortress,
    my God, in whom I trust.”

twi: Ampa ara, obegye wo afi firisumfo afirine owuyare mu.
english:
Surely he will save you
    from the fowler’s snare
    and from the deadly pestilence.

twi: Ɔde ne ntakra bɛkata wo so;na ne ntaban ase na wubenya guankɔbea;ne nokware bɛyɛ wo nkatabo ne wo kyɛm.
Worensuro ɔdasu mu ɔsɛe,anaa bɛmma a etu awia,
english:
You will not fear the terror of night,
    nor the arrow that flies by day,

twi: anaa owuyare a ɛba sum mu,anaa ɔyaredɔm a ɛsɛe ade wɔ owigyinae bere.
english:
nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness,
    nor the plague that destroys at midday.

twi: Apem bɛtotɔ wo nkyɛn mu,na mpem du atotɔ wo nifa a,wo de, ɛremmɛn wo.
english:
A thousand may fall at your side,
    ten thousand at your right hand,
    but it will not come near you.

twi: Wʼaniwa nko ara na wode bɛhwɛna woahu nnebɔneyɛfo asotwe.
english:
You will only observe with your eyes
    and see the punishment of the wicked.

twi: Sɛ woka se, “Awurade ne me guankɔbea,”na wode Ɔsorosoroni no hɔ yɛ wo tenabea a,
english:
If you say, “The Lord is my refuge,”
    and you make the Most High your dwelling,

twi: ɔhaw biara remmunkam wo so,na ɔsɛe biara remmɛn wo ntamadan.
english:
no harm will overtake you,
    no disaster will come near your tent.

twi: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn bɛsoma nʼabɔfo abɛbɔ wo ho banna wɔabɛwɛn wo wʼakwan nyinaa mu;
english:
For he will command his angels concerning you
    to guard you in all your ways;

twi: wɔde wɔn nsa bɛma wo so,na wo nan ampem ɔbo.
english:
they will lift you up in their hands,
    so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

twi: Wubetiatia gyata ne aprammiri so,wobɛnantew gyataforo ne ɔwɔ so.
english:
You will tread on the lion and the cobra;
    you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

twi: Awurade ka se, “Esiane sɛ ɔdɔ me nti, megye no;mɛbɔ ne ho ban, efisɛ ogye me din to mu.
english:
“Because he loves me,” says the Lord, “I will rescue him;
    I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

twi: Ɔbɛfrɛ me na megye ne so;mɛka ne ho wɔ amanehunu mu,megye no na mahyɛ no anuonyam.
Mɛma nkwa nna a ɛware amee nona makyerɛ no me nkwagye.”
english:
With long life I will satisfy him
    and show him my salvation.”

twi: Dwom Dwom a wɔto no Homeda.Eye sɛ wɔkamfo wo Awuradena wɔto dwom de hyɛ wo anuonyam, Ɔsorosoroni,
english:
It is good to praise the Lord
    and make music to your name, O Most High,

twi: na wɔpae mu ka wʼadɔe anɔpane wo nokware anadwo,
english:
proclaiming your love in the morning
    and your faithfulness at night,

twi: wɔ hama du sanku sone sankuten nnwom mu.
english:
to the music of the ten-stringed lyre
    and the melody of the harp.

twi: Awurade, wo nneyɛe ma mʼani gye;mede anigye to nnwom, wo nsa ano nnwuma nti.
english:
For you make me glad by your deeds, Lord;
    I sing for joy at what your hands have done.

twi: Awurade, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛse,na wo nyansa mu dɔ!
english:
How great are your works, Lord,
    how profound your thoughts!

twi: Agyimifo nnimna nkwaseafo nte ase,
english:
Senseless people do not know,
    fools do not understand,

twi: amumɔyɛfo benyin sɛ sarena abɔnefo bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm de,nanso wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.
english:
that though the wicked spring up like grass
    and all evildoers flourish,
    they will be destroyed forever.

twi: Na wo Awurade, wɔayɛ wo ɔkɛse afebɔɔ.
english: But you, Lord, are forever exalted.

twi: Awurade, ampa ara,wʼatamfo bɛyera;na wɔbɛhwete abɔnefo nyinaa.
Woama me ahoɔden te sɛ ɛko;woahwie ngohuam papa agu me so.
english:
You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox;
    fine oils have been poured on me.

twi: Mahu mʼatamfo nkogu a wɔadi,mate sɛnea mʼatamfo atirimɔdenfo aguan afi akono.
english:
My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries;
    my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

twi: Atreneefo bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ abedua,wobenyin sɛ Lebanon sida;
english:
The righteous will flourish like a palm tree,
    they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

twi: nea wɔadua wɔ Awurade fi,wobenyin frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn adiwo hɔ.
english:
planted in the house of the Lord,
    they will flourish in the courts of our God.

twi: Wɔbɛkɔ so asow aba, onyinkyɛ mu mpo,wɔbɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ ahabammono,
english:
They will still bear fruit in old age,
    they will stay fresh and green,

twi: de akyerɛ sɛ, “Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni;ɔyɛ me botan, na atirimɔdensɛm biara nni ne mu.”
english:
proclaiming, “The Lord is upright;
    he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him.”

twi: Dwom Awurade di hene, wɔde tumi ahentade ahyɛ no;wɔde tumi ahentade ahyɛ Awuradena wɔde ahoɔden ayɛ nʼakode.Wɔde wiase atim hɔ pintinn;na wɔrentumi ntutu.
Wʼahengua tim hɔ fi tete;na wowɔ hɔ fi mmeresanten.
english:
Your throne was established long ago;
    you are from all eternity.

twi: Awurade, po ama wɔn ho so,po ama wɔn nne so;po ama wɔn asorɔkye a ɛbɔ dennen no so.
Nea ɔwɔ tumi sen nsu akɛse mmubomu,nea ɔwɔ tumi sen po nworoso,Awurade a ɔte ɔsoro no yɛ ɔkɛse.
english:
Mightier than the thunder of the great waters,
    mightier than the breakers of the sea—
    the Lord on high is mighty.

twi: Awurade, wo nhyehyɛe gyina hɔ pintinn;kronkronyɛ hyɛ wo fi anuonyamdaa nyinaa.
Dwom Awurade, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were,Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were, hyerɛn.
english:
The Lord is a God who avenges.
    O God who avenges, shine forth.

twi: Sɔre, asase so Temmufo,tua ahantanfo ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.
english:
Rise up, Judge of the earth;
    pay back to the proud what they deserve.

twi: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn,amumɔyɛfo nnye wɔn ani nkosi da bɛn?
english:
How long, Lord, will the wicked,
    how long will the wicked be jubilant?

twi: Wɔkasa ahantan so;ahohoahoa ahyɛ abɔnefo nyinaa ma.
english:
They pour out arrogant words;
    all the evildoers are full of boasting.

twi: Awurade, wɔdwerɛw wo nkurɔfo;wɔhyɛ wʼagyapade so.
english:
They crush your people, Lord;
    they oppress your inheritance.

twi: Wokunkum akunafo ne ananafo;na wodi ayisaa awu.
english:
They slay the widow and the foreigner;
    they murder the fatherless.

twi: Wɔka se, “Awurade nhu,Yakob Nyankopɔn ayi nʼani.”
english:
They say, “The Lord does not see;
    the God of Jacob takes no notice.”

twi: Monhwɛ yiye, mo agyimifo a mowɔ nnipa no mu;nkwaseafo, da bɛn na mubehu nyansa?
english:
Take notice, you senseless ones among the people;
    you fools, when will you become wise?

twi: Nea ɔbɔɔ aso no rente asɛm ana?Nea ɔyɛɛ ani no renhu ade ana?
english:
Does he who fashioned the ear not hear?
    Does he who formed the eye not see?

twi: Nea ɔteɛteɛ aman so no rentwe aso ana?Nea ɔkyerɛkyerɛ onipa no nnim nyansa ana?
english:
Does he who disciplines nations not punish?
    Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?

twi: Awurade nim onipa nsusuwii;onim sɛ enkosi hwee.
english:
The Lord knows all human plans;
    he knows that they are futile.

twi: Awurade, nhyira ne onipa a woteɛteɛ no so,onipa a wokyerɛ no wo mmara no;
english:
Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord,
    the one you teach from your law;

twi: Woma ɔhome fi amanehunu nna mu,kosi sɛ wobetu amoa ama amumɔyɛfo.
english:
you grant them relief from days of trouble,
    till a pit is dug for the wicked.

twi: Awurade rempo ne nkurɔfo;na ɔrennyaw nʼagyapade hɔ da.
english:
For the Lord will not reject his people;
    he will never forsake his inheritance.

twi: Atemmu begyina treneeyɛ so bio,na wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew nyinaa bedi so.
english:
Judgment will again be founded on righteousness,
    and all the upright in heart will follow it.

twi: Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia amumɔyɛfo ama me?Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia abɔnefo ama me?
english:
Who will rise up for me against the wicked?
    Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

twi: Sɛ Awurade ammoa me a,anka mekɔɔ owu kommyɛ mu ntɛm so.
english:
Unless the Lord had given me help,
    I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

twi: Bere a mekae se, “Me nan rewatiri” no,Awurade, wo dɔ no soo me mu.
english:
When I said, “My foot is slipping,”
    your unfailing love, Lord, supported me.

twi: Bere a me dadwen dɔɔso no,wʼawerɛkyekye maa me kra abotɔyam.
english:
When anxiety was great within me,
    your consolation brought me joy.

twi: Ahengua a porɔwee ahyɛ no mma no ne wo wɔ ayɔnkofa ana?Ahengua a ne hyɛ nsɛm de amanehunu na ɛba no?
english:
Can a corrupt throne be allied with you—
    a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?

twi: Wɔka bɔ mu tia atreneefona wɔn a wodi bem no, wobu wɔn kumfɔ.
english:
The wicked band together against the righteous
    and condemn the innocent to death.

twi: Nanso Awurade yɛ mʼaban;na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ ɔbotan a ne mu na minya ahintawee.
english:
But the Lord has become my fortress,
    and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

twi: Obetua wɔn nnebɔne no so kana wɔn amumɔyɛ nti wasɛe wɔn;Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛsɛe wɔn.
Dwom Mommra mma yɛnto dwom wɔ anigye so mma Awurade;momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagye Botan no.
english:
Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord;
    let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

twi: Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra nʼanim,na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛw nnwom mma no so.
english:
Let us come before him with thanksgiving
    and extol him with music and song.

twi: Efisɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛse,ɔhenkɛse wɔ anyame nyinaa so.
english:
For the Lord is the great God,
    the great King above all gods.

twi: Ne nsam na asase mu nneɛma nyinaa wɔ,na mmepɔw mpampam wɔ no.
english:
In his hand are the depths of the earth,
    and the mountain peaks belong to him.

twi: Po wɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɔe,na ne nsa na ɛnwenee asase kesee no.
english:
The sea is his, for he made it,
    and his hands formed the dry land.

twi: Mommra, mma yɛnkotow nsom no.Momma yemmu nkotodwe wɔ Awurade yɛn Yɛfo no anim!
english:
Come, let us bow down in worship,
    let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;

twi: Ɔyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn;yɛyɛ ne didibea nnipa,ne nguankuw a ɔhwɛ wɔn so.Nnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,
english:
for he is our God
    and we are the people of his pasture,
    the flock under his care.
Today, if only you would hear his voice,

twi: mummpirim mo koma sɛnea moyɛɛ wɔ Meriba no,sɛnea moyɛɛ da no wɔ Masa, sare no so no,
english:
“Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah,
    as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,

twi: Ɛhɔ no, mo mpanyimfo sɔɔ no hwɛe,a na wonim nea meyɛ maa wɔn.
english:
where your ancestors tested me;
    they tried me, though they had seen what I did.

twi: Me bo fuw saa nnipa no mfe aduananna mekae se, “Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn koma aman afi me ho,na wɔanhu mʼakwan.”
Ɛno nti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuw mu se,“Wɔrenhyɛn mʼahomegye mu da.”
english:
So I declared on oath in my anger,
    ‘They shall never enter my rest.’”

twi: Dwom Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade;asase nyinaa monto dwom mma Awurade.
english:
Sing to the Lord a new song;
    sing to the Lord, all the earth.

twi: Monto dwom mma Awurade, monkamfo ne din;mompae mu nka ne nkwagye no daa daa.
english:
Sing to the Lord, praise his name;
    proclaim his salvation day after day.

twi: Monka nʼanuonyam wɔ amanaman mu,monka nʼanwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.
english:
Declare his glory among the nations,
    his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

twi: Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse na nkamfo fata no;ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no sen anyame nyinaa.
english:
For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise;
    he is to be feared above all gods.

twi: Aman so anyame nyinaa yɛ ahoni bi kwa,nanso Awurade na ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro.
english:
For all the gods of the nations are idols,
    but the Lord made the heavens.

twi: Anuonyam ne kɛseyɛ wɔ nʼanim;ahoɔden ne anuonyam wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.
english:
Splendor and majesty are before him;
    strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

twi: Momfa mma Awurade, amanaman mmusuakuw,momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.
english:
Ascribe to the Lord, all you families of nations,
    ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

twi: Momfa anuonyam ne din a ɛfata mma Awurade;momfa afɔrebɔde nhyɛn nʼadiwo hɔ.
english:
Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name;
    bring an offering and come into his courts.

twi: Monsɔre Awurade wɔ ne kronkronyɛ fɛfɛ mu;asase nyinaa momma mo ho mpopo wɔ nʼanim.
english:
Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness;
    tremble before him, all the earth.

twi: Monka nkyerɛ aman nyinaa se, “Awurade di hene.”Wɔabɔ asase atim hɔ pintinn, wɔrentumi ntutu;ɔde pɛpɛyɛ bebu nnipa atɛn.
Momma ɔsorosoro ani nnye, na asase nni ahurusi;momma po ne mu nneɛma nyinaa nworo;
english:
Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad;
    let the sea resound, and all that is in it.

twi: Momma mfuw ne so nneɛma nyinaa mmɔ ose;momma kwae mu nnua nyinaa mfa ahosɛpɛw nto nnwom.
english:
Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them;
    let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

twi: Momma abɔde nyinaa nni ahurusi wɔ Awurade anim, efisɛ ɔreba,ɔreba abebu asase no atɛn.Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛnna woabu nnipa nso atɛn wɔ ne nokware mu.
english:
Let all creation rejoice before the Lord, for he comes,
    he comes to judge the earth.
He will judge the world in righteousness
    and the peoples in his faithfulness.

twi: Dwom Awurade di hene, ma asase ani nnye;ma akyirikyiri mpoano ahorow no nsɛpɛw wɔn ho.
english:
The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad;
    let the distant shores rejoice.

twi: Omununkum ne sum kabii atwa no ho ahyia;trenee ne atɛntrenee yɛ nʼahengua no fapem.
english:
Clouds and thick darkness surround him;
    righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

twi: Ogya di nʼanimna ɛhyew nʼatamfo wɔ afanan nyinaa.
english:
Fire goes before him
    and consumes his foes on every side.

twi: Nʼanyinam hyerɛn wiase;asase hu na ne ho popo.
english:
His lightning lights up the world;
    the earth sees and trembles.

twi: Mmepɔw nan sɛ nku wɔ Awurade anim,Awurade a asase nyinaa wɔ no no anim.
english:
The mountains melt like wax before the Lord,
    before the Lord of all the earth.

twi: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee kyerɛna aman nyinaa hu nʼanuonyam.
english:
The heavens proclaim his righteousness,
    and all peoples see his glory.

twi: Ahonisomfo nyinaa anim agu ase,wɔn a wɔde abosomhuhuw hoahoa wɔn ho no,anyame nyinaa monsɔre no.
english:
All who worship images are put to shame,
    those who boast in idols—
    worship him, all you gods!

twi: Sion te, na ne ho sɛpɛw nona Yuda nkuraa ani gyeAwurade, esiane wʼatɛntrenee nti.
english:
Zion hears and rejoices
    and the villages of Judah are glad
    because of your judgments, Lord.

twi: Wo, Awurade ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa;wɔama wo so pa ara wɔ anyame nyinaa mu.
english:
For you, Lord, are the Most High over all the earth;
    you are exalted far above all gods.

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ Awurade no nkyi bɔne,ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfo a wɔyɛ nokwafo no ho banna ogye wɔn fi amumɔyɛfo nsam.
english:
Let those who love the Lord hate evil,
    for he guards the lives of his faithful ones
    and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

twi: Hann hyerɛn wɔ atreneefo sona anigye ba wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew no so.
english:
Light shines on the righteous
    and joy on the upright in heart.

twi: Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu, mo a moyɛ atreneefo,na monkamfo ne din kronkron no.
english:
Rejoice in the Lord, you who are righteous,
    and praise his holy name.

twi: Dwom Dwom.Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade,efisɛ wayɛ anwonwade bebree;ne nsa nifa ne ne basa kronkron noanya nkwagye ama no.
english:
Sing to the Lord a new song,
    for he has done marvelous things;
his right hand and his holy arm
    have worked salvation for him.

twi: Awurade ama wɔahu ne nkwagyena wada ne trenee adi akyerɛ amanaman no.
english:
The Lord has made his salvation known
    and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

twi: Wakae nʼadɔene ne nokware a odi kyerɛɛ Israelfo no;asase ano nyinaa ahuyɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye.
english:
He has remembered his love
    and his faithfulness to Israel;
all the ends of the earth have seen
    the salvation of our God.

twi: Asase nyinaa mommɔ ose mma Awurade,momfa nnwonto nni ahurusi;
english:
Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth,
    burst into jubilant song with music;

twi: Momfa sanku nto dwom mma Awurade,sanku ne nnwonto nnyigyei,
english:
make music to the Lord with the harp,
    with the harp and the sound of singing,

twi: momfa torobɛnto ne adwennini mmɛn,nteɛ mu ahosɛpɛw so wɔ Awurade, yɛn hene no anim.
english:
with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn—
    shout for joy before the Lord, the King.

twi: Momma po ne abɔde a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa nhuru so;asase ne wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa.
english:
Let the sea resound, and everything in it,
    the world, and all who live in it.

twi: Momma nsubɔnten mmɔ wɔn nsam,mmepɔw nka mmom nto ahurusi nnwom;
english:
Let the rivers clap their hands,
    let the mountains sing together for joy;

twi: ma wɔnto nnwom wɔ Awurade anim,efisɛ ɔreba abebu wiase atɛn.Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛnna ɔde pɛpɛyɛ abu nnipa atɛn.
english:
let them sing before the Lord,
    for he comes to judge the earth.
He will judge the world in righteousness
    and the peoples with equity.

twi: Dwom Awurade di hene,momma amanaman no ho mpopo;ɔte nʼahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam,ma asase nwosow.
english:
The Lord reigns,
    let the nations tremble;
he sits enthroned between the cherubim,
    let the earth shake.

twi: Awurade a ɔwɔ Sion yɛ ɔkɛse;wɔama no so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.
english:
Great is the Lord in Zion;
    he is exalted over all the nations.

twi: Ma wɔnkamfo wo din a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwonwa no,ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.
english:
Let them praise your great and awesome name—
    he is holy.

twi: Ɔhene no yɛ ɔkɛse, ɔdɔ atɛntrenee,woama pɛpɛyɛ atim;wayɛ nea eye na ɛteɛwɔ Yakob mu.
english:
The King is mighty, he loves justice—
    you have established equity;
in Jacob you have done
    what is just and right.

twi: Momma Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn sona monsɔre no wɔ ne nan ntiaso anim;ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.
Na Mose ne Aaron ka nʼasɔfo no ho,na Samuel ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho;wɔfrɛɛ Awurade,na ogyee wɔn so.
english:
Moses and Aaron were among his priests,
    Samuel was among those who called on his name;
they called on the Lord
    and he answered them.

twi: Ofi omununkum dum mu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn;wodii mmara ne ahyɛde a ɔmaa wɔn no so.
english:
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud;
    they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

twi: Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn,wugyee wɔn so;woyɛɛ bɔnefakyɛ Nyankopɔn maa Israel,nanso wotwee wɔn aso wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.
english:
Lord our God,
    you answered them;
you were to Israel a forgiving God,
    though you punished their misdeeds.

twi: Momma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn sona monsɔre no wɔ ne bepɔw kronkron no so,na Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔkronkron.
english:
Exalt the Lord our God
    and worship at his holy mountain,
    for the Lord our God is holy.

twi: Dwom Ayeyi Dwom.Mommɔ ose mma Awurade, asase nyinaa.
english: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth.

twi: Momfa ahosɛpɛw nsom Awurade;momfa anigye nnwom mmra nʼanim.
english:
Worship the Lord with gladness;
    come before him with joyful songs.

twi: Munhu sɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn;ɔno na ɔyɛɛ yɛn, na yɛyɛ ne de;yɛyɛ ne nkurɔfo ne ne didibea nguan.
Momfa aseda nhyɛn nʼapon mu,na momfa nkamfo nkɔ nʼadiwo;momfa aseda mma no, na monkamfo ne din.
Awurade ye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;ne nokwaredi kodu awo ntoatoaso nyinaa so.
english:
For the Lord is good and his love endures forever;
    his faithfulness continues through all generations.

twi: Dwom Dawid Dwom.Mɛto wo dɔ ne wo trenee ho nnwom;Awurade, mɛto ayeyi nnwom ama wo.
english:
I will sing of your love and justice;
    to you, Lord, I will sing praise.

twi: Mɛhwɛ yiye abu ɔbra a ho tew;da bɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn?Mede koma a afɔdi nni mubɛhwɛ me fi so.
english:
I will be careful to lead a blameless life—
    when will you come to me?
I will conduct the affairs of my house
    with a blameless heart.

twi: Merennye ade a ɛyɛ tanbiara nto mu.Mikyi nnipa a wonni gyidi nneyɛe;meremfa me ho mmata ho.
english:
I will not look with approval
    on anything that is vile.
I hate what faithless people do;
    I will have no part in it.

twi: Nnipa a wɔn koma yɛ kɔntɔnkye remmɛn me;me ne bɔne nni hwee yɛ.
english:
The perverse of heart shall be far from me;
    I will have nothing to do with what is evil.

twi: Obiara a odi ne yɔnko ho nseku wɔ kokoa mu no,ɔno na mɛsɛe;nea ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne ahomaso koma,ɔno na merennyigye no so.
english:
Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret,
    I will put to silence;
whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart,
    I will not tolerate.

twi: Mʼani bɛkɔ anokwafo a wɔwɔ asase no so no sona me ne wɔn atena;nea ne nantew ho nni asɛm noɔno na ɔbɛsom me.
english:
My eyes will be on the faithful in the land,
    that they may dwell with me;
the one whose walk is blameless
    will minister to me.

twi: Nea ɔyɛ ɔdaadaafo biararentena me fi;nea otwa nkontompo norennyina mʼanim.
english:
No one who practices deceit
    will dwell in my house;
no one who speaks falsely
    will stand in my presence.

twi: Adekyee biara,mɛsɛe amumɔyɛfo a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa;na mapam ɔdebɔneyɛni biaraafi Awurade kuropɔn mu.
english:
Every morning I will put to silence
    all the wicked in the land;
I will cut off every evildoer
    from the city of the Lord.

twi: Dwom Aberante mmɔborɔni mpaebɔ. Osu kyerɛ Awurade bere a ɔwɔ ahohia mu.Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ;na ma me mmoa ho sufrɛ nnu wʼanim.
english:
Hear my prayer, Lord;
    let my cry for help come to you.

twi: Mmfa wʼanim nhintaw mebere a mewɔ ahohia mu.Brɛ wʼaso ase ma me;na sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so ntɛm.
english:
Do not hide your face from me
    when I am in distress.
Turn your ear to me;
    when I call, answer me quickly.

twi: Me nkwanna reyera te sɛ wusiw;me nnompe adɔ sɛ nyansramma.
english:
For my days vanish like smoke;
    my bones burn like glowing embers.

twi: Me koma abotow na akisa sɛ sare;na me kɔn nnɔ aduan.
english:
My heart is blighted and withered like grass;
    I forget to eat my food.

twi: Mʼapinisi dennen ntimaka ɔhonam ne nnompe.
english:
In my distress I groan aloud
    and am reduced to skin and bones.

twi: Mete sɛ sare so patu,te sɛ patu a ɔte nnwiriwii mu.
english:
I am like a desert owl,
    like an owl among the ruins.

twi: Meda hɔ a, mʼani gu so; mayɛ sɛanomaa bi a ɔno nko ara si ɔdan atifi.
english:
I lie awake; I have become
    like a bird alone on a roof.

twi: Da mu nyinaa mʼatamfo bɔ me akutia.Wɔn a wodi me ho fɛw no bɔ me din de dome.
english:
All day long my enemies taunt me;
    those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

twi: Mede nsõ ayɛ mʼaduanna mede nusu fra me nsu mu
english:
For I eat ashes as my food
    and mingle my drink with tears

twi: esiane wʼabufuwhyew dennen no nti,woama me so, ayi me asi nkyɛn.
english:
because of your great wrath,
    for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

twi: Me nkwa nna te sɛ anwummere sunsuma;na mehyew sɛ sare.
english:
My days are like the evening shadow;
    I wither away like grass.

twi: Nanso wo Awurade, woyɛ ɔhene daa daa;na wo din a ahyeta no te hɔ daa awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
english:
But you, Lord, sit enthroned forever;
    your renown endures through all generations.

twi: Wobɛsɔre na woahu Sion mmɔbɔ;bere adu sɛ wuhu no mmɔbɔ;bere a wohyɛe no aso.
Nʼabo som bo ma wʼasomfo;ne mfutuma hyɛ wɔn awerɛhow.
english:
For her stones are dear to your servants;
    her very dust moves them to pity.

twi: Amanaman no besuro Awurade din;asase so ahemfo nyinaa bedi wʼanuonyam ni.
english:
The nations will fear the name of the Lord,
    all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.

twi: Awurade bɛkyekyere Sion bio,na wapue wɔ nʼanuonyam mu.
english:
For the Lord will rebuild Zion
    and appear in his glory.

twi: Obetie mmɔborɔfo mpaebɔ;na ɔremmu nʼani ngu wɔn sufrɛ so.
english:
He will respond to the prayer of the destitute;
    he will not despise their plea.

twi: Monkyerɛw eyi mma nkyirimma,sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wonnya nwoo wɔn no bɛkamfo Awurade;
english:
Let this be written for a future generation,
    that a people not yet created may praise the Lord:

twi: “Awurade hwɛɛ fam fi ne kronkronbea wɔ ɔsoro hɔ;ofi ɔsoro hwɛɛ asase,
english:
“The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high,
    from heaven he viewed the earth,

twi: sɛnea ɔbɛte nneduafo apinisi,na wɔagyaa wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.”
english:
to hear the groans of the prisoners
    and release those condemned to death.”

twi: Enti wɔbɛpae mu abɔ Awurade din wɔ Sionna wɔakamfo no wɔ Yerusalem,
english:
So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion
    and his praise in Jerusalem

twi: bere a amanaman ne ahenni ahorowbehyia mu na wɔasom Awurade.
english:
when the peoples and the kingdoms
    assemble to worship the Lord.

twi: Ɔmaa me yɛɛ mmerɛw wɔ bere a merenyin.Otwaa me nkwa nna so.
english:
In the course of my life he broke my strength;
    he cut short my days.

twi: Enti mekae se,“Me Onyankopɔn, mfa me nkɔ, wɔ me nkwa nna mfimfini;wo mfe wɔ hɔ daa kodu awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
Mfiase no wotoo asase fapem,na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.
english:
In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth,
    and the heavens are the work of your hands.

twi: Ne nyinaa betwa mu na wo de, wobɛtena hɔ daa;wɔbɛtetew te sɛ atade.Wobɛsesa wɔn te sɛ ntama,na wɔbɛtow wɔn agu.
english:
They will perish, but you remain;
    they will all wear out like a garment.
Like clothing you will change them
    and they will be discarded.

twi: Nanso wote sɛnea wote,na wo mfe to rentwa da.
english:
But you remain the same,
    and your years will never end.

twi: Wʼasomfo mma bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim;na wɔn asefo ase betim wɔ wʼanim.”
english:
The children of your servants will live in your presence;
    their descendants will be established before you.”

twi: Dwom Dawid de.Me kra, kamfo Awurade;na me mu ade nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no.
english:
Praise the Lord, my soul;
    all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

twi: Me kra, kamfo Awurade,na mma wo werɛ mmfi ne nneyɛe pa nyinaa,
english:
Praise the Lord, my soul,
    and forget not all his benefits—

twi: ɔno na ɔde wo mfomso nyinaa kyɛ wona ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa,
english:
who forgives all your sins
    and heals all your diseases,

twi: ogye wo nkwa fi ɔda mu,na ɔde adɔe ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotiri,
english:
who redeems your life from the pit
    and crowns you with love and compassion,

twi: ɔde nnepa ma wo sɛ wʼapɛde,na wo mmerantebere yɛ foforo sɛ ɔkɔre.
english:
who satisfies your desires with good things
    so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

twi: Awurade yɛ adetrenee,na obu wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nyinaa atɛntrenee.
english:
The Lord works righteousness
    and justice for all the oppressed.

twi: Ɔkyerɛɛ Mose nʼakwan,na ɔmaa Israelfo huu ne nneyɛe.
english:
He made known his ways to Moses,
    his deeds to the people of Israel:

twi: Mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔdomfo ne Awurade,ne bo kyɛ fuw na nʼadɔe dɔɔso.
english:
The Lord is compassionate and gracious,
    slow to anger, abounding in love.

twi: Ɔrenkɔ so mmɔ sobo,na ɔrennya yɛn ho menasepɔw nkosi daa;
english:
He will not always accuse,
    nor will he harbor his anger forever;

twi: Ɔnhwɛ yɛn bɔne ne yɛn nni sɛnea ɛfatana ontua yɛn nnebɔne so ka sɛnea ɛte.
english:
he does not treat us as our sins deserve
    or repay us according to our iniquities.

twi: Na sɛnea ɔsoro ne asase ntam ware no,saa ara na nʼadɔe so wɔ wɔn a wosuro no no so.
english:
For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
    so great is his love for those who fear him;

twi: Sɛnea apuei ne atɔe ntam ware no,saa ara na wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam kwan aware.
english:
as far as the east is from the west,
    so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

twi: Sɛnea agya yam hyehyew no wɔ ne mma ho no,saa ara na Awurade yam hyehye no ma wɔn a wosuro no no;
english:
As a father has compassion on his children,
    so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;

twi: na onim sɛnea wɔyɛɛ yɛn,ɔkae se yɛyɛ mfutuma.
english:
for he knows how we are formed,
    he remembers that we are dust.

twi: Ɔdesani de, ne nna te sɛ sare,ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ nwura mu nhwiren;
english:
The life of mortals is like grass,
    they flourish like a flower of the field;

twi: sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na onni hɔ,na ne sibea nkae no bio.
english:
the wind blows over it and it is gone,
    and its place remembers it no more.

twi: Nanso efi mmeresanten kosi nnasantenAwurade adɔe wɔ wɔn a wosuro no so,na ne trenee wɔ wɔn mma mma so,
english:
But from everlasting to everlasting
    the Lord’s love is with those who fear him,
    and his righteousness with their children’s children—

twi: wɔn a wodi nʼapam no sona wɔkae di ne mmara so.
english:
with those who keep his covenant
    and remember to obey his precepts.

twi: Awurade asi nʼahengua wɔ ɔsoro,na nʼahenni di ade nyinaa so.
english:
The Lord has established his throne in heaven,
    and his kingdom rules over all.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼabɔfo,mo atumfo a moyɛ nʼahyɛde,mo a mutie nʼasɛm.
english:
Praise the Lord, you his angels,
    you mighty ones who do his bidding,
    who obey his word.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa,nʼasomfo a moyɛ nʼapɛde.
english:
Praise the Lord, all his heavenly hosts,
    you his servants who do his will.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade, ne nnwuma nyinaa;nea ɛwɔ nʼahenni mu nyinaa.Me kra, kamfo Awurade!
english:
Praise the Lord, all his works
    everywhere in his dominion.
Praise the Lord, my soul.

twi: Dwom Me kra, kamfo Awurade!Awurade me Nyankopɔn, woyɛ ɔkɛse!Wɔafura wo tumi ne anuonyam.
Ɔde hann akata ne ho sɛ atade;ɔtrɛw ɔsoro mu te sɛ ntamadan,
english:
The Lord wraps himself in light as with a garment;
    he stretches out the heavens like a tent

twi: na ɔde ne mpia mu mpuran sisi nsu so.Ɔde omununkum yɛ ne teaseɛnamna ɔde nantew mframa ntaban so.
english:
and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters.
He makes the clouds his chariot
    and rides on the wings of the wind.

twi: Ɔsoma nʼabɔfo sɛ mframa,na ɔsoma nʼasomfo sɛ ogyaframa.
english:
He makes winds his messengers,
    flames of fire his servants.

twi: Ɔde asase asi ne fapem sona ɛrenhinhim da.
english:
He set the earth on its foundations;
    it can never be moved.

twi: Wode bun kataa so sɛ atadena nsu gyinaa mmepɔw no so.
english:
You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment;
    the waters stood above the mountains.

twi: Nanso wʼanimka maa nsu no guanee,wʼaprannaa nnyigyei maa woguanee;
english:
But at your rebuke the waters fled,
    at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

twi: Wɔsen faa mmepɔw so,kɔɔ aku mu tɔnn,koguu faako a wode ama wɔn no.
english:
they flowed over the mountains,
    they went down into the valleys,
    to the place you assigned for them.

twi: Wotoo ɔhye a wɔrentumi ntra;na wɔammɛkata asase so bio.
english:
You set a boundary they cannot cross;
    never again will they cover the earth.

twi: Ɔma nsuwa sen fa abon mu,ɛsen fa mmepɔw ntam.
english:
He makes springs pour water into the ravines;
    it flows between the mountains.

twi: Wɔma wuram mmoa nyinaa nsu nom;atorɔm de kum wɔn sukɔm.
english:
They give water to all the beasts of the field;
    the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

twi: Wim nnomaa nwen wɔn berebuw wɔ nsu no ho;na wɔto nnwom wɔ nnua no mman so.
english:
The birds of the sky nest by the waters;
    they sing among the branches.

twi: Ofi ne soro mpia mu tɔ nsu gugu mmepɔw so;ne nnwuma so aba mee asase.
english:
He waters the mountains from his upper chambers;
    the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

twi: Ɔma sare fifi ma anantwi,na ɔbɔɔ nnua maa onipa sɛ onnuana ɛmma aduan mfi asase mu:
english:
He makes grass grow for the cattle,
    and plants for people to cultivate—
    bringing forth food from the earth:

twi: nsa a ɛma onipa koma tɔ ne yam,ngo a ɛma onipa anim tɔ so,ne aduan a ekura onipa koma.
english:
wine that gladdens human hearts,
    oil to make their faces shine,
    and bread that sustains their hearts.

twi: Wogugu Awurade nnua no so yiye,Lebanon sida a oduae no.
english:
The trees of the Lord are well watered,
    the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

twi: Ɛsow na nnomaa yɛ wɔn mmerebuw,na asukɔnkɔn nso yɛ nʼatenae wɔ ɔpepaw nnua no mu.
english:
There the birds make their nests;
    the stork has its home in the junipers.

twi: Mmepɔw atenten no yɛ wuram mmirekyi de;na abotan yɛ guankɔbea ma ewi.
english:
The high mountains belong to the wild goats;
    the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.

twi: Ɔsram kyerɛ bere nkyekyɛmu,na owia nim bere a ɔkɔtɔ.
english:
He made the moon to mark the seasons,
    and the sun knows when to go down.

twi: Wode sum ba ma ɛyɛ adesaena kwae mu mmoa nyinaa kɔ ahayɛ.
english:
You bring darkness, it becomes night,
    and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

twi: Gyata bobɔ mu pɛ wɔn hanam,wɔhwehwɛ wɔn aduan fi Onyankopɔn hɔ.
english:
The lions roar for their prey
    and seek their food from God.

twi: Owia pue ma wɔsan wɔn akyi;wɔsan kɔdeda wɔn atu mu.
english:
The sun rises, and they steal away;
    they return and lie down in their dens.

twi: Afei, onipa kɔ nʼadwuma sokɔyɛ adwuma ara kosi anwummere.
english:
Then people go out to their work,
    to their labor until evening.

twi: Awurade, wo nnwuma dɔɔso!Nyansa mu na woyɛɛ ne nyinaa;wʼabɔde ahyɛ asase so ma.
Po na ɛda hɔ tɛtrɛɛ tamaa yi,a abɔde bebree a enni ano;akɛse ne nketewa ahyɛ no ma.
english:
There is the sea, vast and spacious,
    teeming with creatures beyond number—
    living things both large and small.

twi: So na ahyɛn di akɔneaba,na ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn a woyɛɛ no di agoru.
english:
There the ships go to and fro,
    and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.

twi: Wɔn nyinaa hwɛ wo kwansɛ wobɛma wɔn wɔn aduan wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu.
english:
All creatures look to you
    to give them their food at the proper time.

twi: Wode ma wɔn a, wɔtase;wubue wo nsam a nnepa mee wɔn.
english:
When you give it to them,
    they gather it up;
when you open your hand,
    they are satisfied with good things.

twi: Wode wʼanim hintaw wɔn a,wɔbɔ hu;sɛ wugye wɔn home a,wowuwu na wɔsan kɔ mfutuma mu.
english:
When you hide your face,
    they are terrified;
when you take away their breath,
    they die and return to the dust.

twi: Sɛ wode wo Honhom no ma wɔn ana wɔabɔ wɔn,na woyɛ asase ani foforo.
english:
When you send your Spirit,
    they are created,
    and you renew the face of the ground.

twi: Ma Awurade anuonyam ntena hɔ daa;ma Awurade ani nnye ne nnwuma ho,
english:
May the glory of the Lord endure forever;
    may the Lord rejoice in his works—

twi: nea ɔhwɛ asase na ɛwosow,na ɔde ne nsa ka mmepɔw a wusiw fi mu ba.
english:
he who looks at the earth, and it trembles,
    who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

twi: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa;sɛ mete ase yi, mɛto ayeyi dwom ama me Nyankopɔn.
english:
I will sing to the Lord all my life;
    I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

twi: Ɔmma me mpaebɔ nsɔ nʼanibere a meregye mʼani wɔ Awurade mu yi.
english:
May my meditation be pleasing to him,
    as I rejoice in the Lord.

twi: Ma nnebɔneyɛfo nyera wɔ asase so;na amumɔyɛfo ase nhyew.Me kra, kamfo Awurade.Kamfo Awurade.
english:
But may sinners vanish from the earth
    and the wicked be no more.
Praise the Lord, my soul.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Da Awurade ase na da ne kɛseyɛ adi.Ma wiase nyinaa nhu nea wayɛ.
english:
Give praise to the Lord, proclaim his name;
    make known among the nations what he has done.

twi: Monto dwom mma no, monto ayeyi dwom mma no;monka nʼanwonwade no nyinaa.
english:
Sing to him, sing praise to him;
    tell of all his wonderful acts.

twi: Monhoahoa mo ho wɔ ne din kronkron mu;momma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no nnya koma mu anigye.
english:
Glory in his holy name;
    let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

twi: Momma mo ani nna Awurade ne nʼahoɔden no so;na monhwehwɛ nʼanim bere biara.
english:
Look to the Lord and his strength;
    seek his face always.

twi: Monkae anwonwade a wayɛne nsɛnkyerɛnne, ne atɛn a obui,
english:
Remember the wonders he has done,
    his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

twi: Abraham mma, Onyankopɔn asomfo,Yakob mma a wapaw wɔn.
english:
you his servants, the descendants of Abraham,
    his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

twi: Ɔyɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn.Nʼahenni da adi wɔ asase so nyinaa.
english:
He is the Lord our God;
    his judgments are in all the earth.

twi: Ɔkae nʼapam daa nyinaa,asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awo ntoantoaso apem no,
english:
He remembers his covenant forever,
    the promise he made, for a thousand generations,

twi: apam a ɔne Abraham yɛe no,ntam a ɔka kyerɛɛ Isak no.
english:
the covenant he made with Abraham,
    the oath he swore to Isaac.

twi: Ɔhyɛɛ mu den maa Yakob sɛ mmara,de maa Israel sɛ apam a ɛbɛtena hɔ afebɔɔ.
english:
He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree,
    to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

twi: Ɔkae se, “Mede Kanaan asase no bɛma wosɛ kyɛfa a ɛbɛyɛ wʼagyapade.”
english:
“To you I will give the land of Canaan
    as the portion you will inherit.”

twi: Ɔkaa eyi bere a na wɔnnɔɔso,ahɔhokuw ketewa bi a wɔwɔ Kanaan.
english:
When they were but few in number,
    few indeed, and strangers in it,

twi: Wofii aman so kɔɔ aman so;fii ahemman mu kɔɔ ahemman mu.
english:
they wandered from nation to nation,
    from one kingdom to another.

twi: Wamma obi anhyɛ wɔn so;wɔn nti, ɔkaa ahene anim se:
english:
He allowed no one to oppress them;
    for their sake he rebuked kings:

twi: “Mommfa mo nsa nka wɔn a masra wɔn ngo;na monnyɛ mʼadiyifo bɔne bi.”
english:
“Do not touch my anointed ones;
    do my prophets no harm.”

twi: Ɔmaa ɔkɔm baa asase no sona ɔsɛee akwan a wɔfa so nya wɔn aduan nyinaa;
english:
He called down famine on the land
    and destroyed all their supplies of food;

twi: na ɔsomaa ɔbarima bi dii wɔn anim,Yosef a wɔtɔn no sɛ akoa no.
english:
and he sent a man before them—
    Joseph, sold as a slave.

twi: Wɔde mpokyerɛ guu ne nʼanan,na wɔde dade nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn hyɛɛ ne kɔn,
english:
They bruised his feet with shackles,
    his neck was put in irons,

twi: kosii sɛ nea ɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no baa mu,kosii sɛ Awurade asɛm no daa no adi sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo.
english:
till what he foretold came to pass,
    till the word of the Lord proved him true.

twi: Ɔhene no soma ma wokoyii no;aman no sodifo gyaa no.
english:
The king sent and released him,
    the ruler of peoples set him free.

twi: Ɔyɛɛ no ne fi so wuranea ɔwɔ nyinaa sodifo,
english:
He made him master of his household,
    ruler over all he possessed,

twi: sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne mmapɔmma nea ɔpɛna ɔnkyerɛ ne mpanyimfo nyansa.
english:
to instruct his princes as he pleased
    and teach his elders wisdom.

twi: Na Israel kɔɔ Misraim;Yakob kɔtenaa Ham asase so sɛ ɔnanani.
english:
Then Israel entered Egypt;
    Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

twi: Awurade maa ne nkurɔfo ase dɔe;ɔyɛɛ wɔn bebree dodo maa wɔn atamfo,
english:
The Lord made his people very fruitful;
    he made them too numerous for their foes,

twi: wɔn a ɔdan wɔn koma sɛ wɔntan ne nkurɔfona wɔmpam nʼasomfo ti so.
english:
whose hearts he turned to hate his people,
    to conspire against his servants.

twi: Ɔsomaa ne somfo Mose,ne Aaron a na wayi no no.
english:
He sent Moses his servant,
    and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne nwonwaso wɔ wɔn mu,nʼanwonwade wɔ Ham asase so.
english:
They performed his signs among them,
    his wonders in the land of Ham.

twi: Ɔsomaa sum, na ɔmaa asase duruu sum,efisɛ na wɔatew nʼasɛm no so atua.
english:
He sent darkness and made the land dark—
    for had they not rebelled against his words?

twi: Ɔmaa wɔn nsu nyinaa dan mogya,nam so kum mu mpataa.
english:
He turned their waters into blood,
    causing their fish to die.

twi: Mpɔtorɔ bɛhyɛɛ asase no so ma,na wɔhyɛn ɔman no sodifo mpia mu.
english:
Their land teemed with frogs,
    which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

twi: Ɔkasae, na nwansena bebreene ntontom baa ɔman no mu baabiara.
english:
He spoke, and there came swarms of flies,
    and gnats throughout their country.

twi: Ɔmaa wɔn osu dan mparuwboa anyinam nenam mu wɔ ɔman no nyinaa mu;
english:
He turned their rain into hail,
    with lightning throughout their land;

twi: Ɔsɛee wɔn bobe ne borɔdɔma nnuana obubuu ɔman no so nnua pasaa.
english:
he struck down their vines and fig trees
    and shattered the trees of their country.

twi: Ɔkasae, na mmoadabi bae,tɛwtɛw a wontumi nkan wɔn;
english:
He spoke, and the locusts came,
    grasshoppers without number;
