twi: wɔwee ahabammono biara a ɛwɔ wɔn asase no so,na wodii wɔn mfuw so nnuan.
english:
they ate up every green thing in their land,
    ate up the produce of their soil.

twi: Afei okunkum wɔn asase so mmakan nyinaa,wɔn mmarimayɛ mu aba a edi kan nyinaa.
english:
Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land,
    the firstfruits of all their manhood.

twi: Oyii Israel a ɔso dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔfii wɔn mmusuakuw mu a obiara ho antɔ kyima.
english:
He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold,
    and from among their tribes no one faltered.

twi: Misraim ani gyei, bere a wɔkɔe,efisɛ na Israelfo ho hu atɔ wɔn so.
english:
Egypt was glad when they left,
    because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

twi: Ɔtrɛw omununkum mu kataa wɔn so,na ogya maa wɔn hann anadwo.
english:
He spread out a cloud as a covering,
    and a fire to give light at night.

twi: Wobisae, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn mparuwboɔmaa ɔsoro aduan mee wɔn.
english:
They asked, and he brought them quail;
    he fed them well with the bread of heaven.

twi: Obuee ɔbotan mu maa nsu fii mu bae;na ɛsen faa sare no so sɛ asubɔnten.
english:
He opened the rock, and water gushed out;
    it flowed like a river in the desert.

twi: Ɔkaee ne bɔ kronkron bi aɔhyɛɛ ne somfo Abraham no.
english:
For he remembered his holy promise
    given to his servant Abraham.

twi: Oyii ne nkurɔfo maa wɔn ani gyei;wɔn a wapaw wɔn no dii ahurusi;
english:
He brought out his people with rejoicing,
    his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

twi: ɔde amanaman no nsase maa wɔn,na nea ebinom abrɛ anya no bɛyɛɛ wɔn agyapade
english:
he gave them the lands of the nations,
    and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—

twi: na wɔahwɛ nʼahyɛdeadi ne mmara so.Munyi Awurade ayɛ.
english:
that they might keep his precepts
    and observe his laws.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade!Monna Awurade ase na oye;na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
Hena na obetumi aka nneɛma akɛse a Awurade ayɛ?Anaasɛ obetumi aka ne nkamfo awie?
english:
Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord
    or fully declare his praise?

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkɔ so bu atɛntrenee,na daa wɔyɛ nea eye.
english:
Blessed are those who act justly,
    who always do what is right.

twi: Awurade, sɛ wuhu wo nkurɔfo mmɔbɔ a kae me,sɛ wugye wɔn nkwa a, boa me,
english:
Remember me, Lord, when you show favor to your people,
    come to my aid when you save them,

twi: na manya wɔn a wapaw wɔn no yiyedi mu kyɛfa,na manya wo manfo anigye no mu kyɛfa,na me ne wʼagyapade no abɔ mu de nkamfo ama wo.
english:
that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones,
    that I may share in the joy of your nation
    and join your inheritance in giving praise.

twi: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛnea yɛn nenanom yɛe no;yɛayɛ mfomso na yɛadi atirimɔdensɛm.
english:
We have sinned, even as our ancestors did;
    we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

twi: Bere a yɛn nenanom wɔ Misraim no,wɔannwene wo nsɛnkyerɛnne ho;wɔankae wʼadɔe bebrebe no,na wɔtew atua wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho.
english:
When our ancestors were in Egypt,
    they gave no thought to your miracles;
they did not remember your many kindnesses,
    and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.

twi: Nanso ne din nti ogyee wɔn nkwa,sɛnea ɔbɛda ne tumi kɛse no adi.
english:
Yet he saved them for his name’s sake,
    to make his mighty power known.

twi: Ɔteɛɛ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ma ɛyowee;ɔde wɔn faa bun mu te sɛ sare so.
english:
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up;
    he led them through the depths as through a desert.

twi: Ogyee wɔn fii ɔtamfo no nsam;nea ɔtan wɔn no nsam na oyii wɔn fii.
english:
He saved them from the hand of the foe;
    from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

twi: Nsu kataa wɔn atamfo so;na ɔbaako mpo annya nkwa.
english:
The waters covered their adversaries;
    not one of them survived.

twi: Afei wogyee ne bɔhyɛ no diina wɔtoo nʼayeyi nnwom.
english:
Then they believed his promises
    and sang his praise.

twi: Nanso ntɛm so, wɔn werɛ fii nea wayɛna wɔantwɛn nʼagyinatu.
english:
But they soon forgot what he had done
    and did not wait for his plan to unfold.

twi: Akɔnnɔ bɛhyɛɛ wɔn mu wɔ sare so hɔ,asase paradada no so na wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe,
english:
In the desert they gave in to their craving;
    in the wilderness they put God to the test.

twi: enti ɔmaa wɔn nea wobisae,nanso ɔde ɔfɔn yare baa wɔn so.
english:
So he gave them what they asked for,
    but sent a wasting disease among them.

twi: Na nsraban mu hɔ wɔn ani beree Mosene Aaron a Awurade atew ne ho no.
english:
In the camp they grew envious of Moses
    and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord.

twi: Asase mu bue ma ɛmenee Datanna esiee Abiram asafo no.
english:
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan;
    it buried the company of Abiram.

twi: Ogya tɔɔ wɔn akyidifo no mu;ogyatannaa hyew amumɔyɛfo no.
english:
Fire blazed among their followers;
    a flame consumed the wicked.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ nantwi ba wɔ Horebna wɔkotow ohoni a wɔde fagude ayɛ.
english:
At Horeb they made a calf
    and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

twi: Wɔsesaa wɔn Anuonyamwɔde nantwinini, a ɔwe sare nsɛsode.
english:
They exchanged their glorious God
    for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

twi: Wɔn werɛ fii Onyankopɔn a ogyee wɔn nkwa,nea ɔyɛɛ nneɛma akɛse wɔ Misraim no,
english:
They forgot the God who saved them,
    who had done great things in Egypt,

twi: nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Ham asase sone nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ ho no.
english:
miracles in the land of Ham
    and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

twi: Enti ɔkae se ɔbɛsɛe wɔn,nanso Mose a ɔyɛ nea wapaw no no,sɔre gyinaa Onyankopɔn ne nnipa no ntam;ɔsrɛ de dwudwoo nʼabufuwhyew no ano sɛnea ɔrensɛe wɔn.
english:
So he said he would destroy them—
    had not Moses, his chosen one,
stood in the breach before him
    to keep his wrath from destroying them.

twi: Afei wɔn ani ansɔ asase fɛfɛ no;na wɔannye ne bɔhyɛ no anni.
english:
Then they despised the pleasant land;
    they did not believe his promise.

twi: Wonwiinwii wɔ wɔn ntamadan muna wɔanyɛ osetie amma Awurade.
english:
They grumbled in their tents
    and did not obey the Lord.

twi: Enti ɔmaa ne nsa so kaa ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn seɔbɛma wɔatotɔ wɔ sare no so,
english:
So he swore to them with uplifted hand
    that he would make them fall in the wilderness,

twi: ɔbɛma wɔn asefo atotɔ wɔ amanaman muna wabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase nyinaa so.
english:
make their descendants fall among the nations
    and scatter them throughout the lands.

twi: Wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Baal-Peor hona wodii afɔrebɔde a wɔde ama anyame a wonni nkwa;
english:
They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor
    and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

twi: wɔde wɔn atirimɔdensɛm hyɛɛ Awurade abufuwna ɔyaredɔm sii wɔn mu.
english:
they aroused the Lord’s anger by their wicked deeds,
    and a plague broke out among them.

twi: Na Pinehas sɔre dii akagyinamu,na wosiw ɔyaredɔm no ano.
english:
But Phinehas stood up and intervened,
    and the plague was checked.

twi: Wɔde eyi yɛɛ trenee maa nowɔ awo ntoatoaso a enni awiei a ɛbɛba no mu.
english:
This was credited to him as righteousness
    for endless generations to come.

twi: Meriba nsu ho nso, wɔhyɛɛ Awurade abufuw,na wɔn nti, ɔhaw baa Mose so,
english:
By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord,
    and trouble came to Moses because of them;

twi: efisɛ wɔtew Onyankopɔn Honhom anim atua,na asɛm a wannwene ho fii Mose anom.
english:
for they rebelled against the Spirit of God,
    and rash words came from Moses’ lips.

twi: Wɔansɛe nnipa nosɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no,
english:
They did not destroy the peoples
    as the Lord had commanded them,

twi: nanso wɔde wɔn ho frafraa amanaman noyɛɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no bi.
english:
but they mingled with the nations
    and adopted their customs.

twi: Wɔsom wɔn ahoni,na ɛbɛyɛɛ afide maa wɔn.
english:
They worshiped their idols,
    which became a snare to them.

twi: Wɔde wɔn mmabarimane wɔn mmabea bɔɔ afɔre maa abosom.
english:
They sacrificed their sons
    and their daughters to false gods.

twi: Wɔkaa mogya a edi bem gui,wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea mogya awɔde bɔɔ afɔre maa Kanaan ahoni nomaa asase no ho guu fi.
english:
They shed innocent blood,
    the blood of their sons and daughters,
whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan,
    and the land was desecrated by their blood.

twi: Wɔde nea wɔyɛɛ no guu wɔn ankasa ho fi;wɔnam nea wɔyɛɛ no so bɔɔ aguaman.
english:
They defiled themselves by what they did;
    by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

twi: Enti Awurade bo fuw ne nkurɔfo;na okyii nʼagyapade.
english:
Therefore the Lord was angry with his people
    and abhorred his inheritance.

twi: Ɔdan wɔn maa amanaman no,na wɔn atamfo dii wɔn so.
english:
He gave them into the hands of the nations,
    and their foes ruled over them.

twi: Wɔn atamfo hyɛɛ wɔn sona wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn tumi ase.
english:
Their enemies oppressed them
    and subjected them to their power.

twi: Mpɛn bebree, Awurade gyee wɔn,nanso wɔkɔɔ so tew atuana wɔsɛe wɔ wɔn bɔne mu.
english:
Many times he delivered them,
    but they were bent on rebellion
    and they wasted away in their sin.

twi: Nanso ohuu wɔn ahohiahiabere a wosu frɛɛ no no.
english:
Yet he took note of their distress
    when he heard their cry;

twi: Wɔn nti ɔkaee nʼapam no,na ofii nʼadɔe kɛse no mu huu wɔn mmɔbɔ.
english:
for their sake he remembered his covenant
    and out of his great love he relented.

twi: Ɔmaa asodifo a wɔafa wɔn nnommum nonyaa ahummɔbɔ maa wɔn.
english:
He caused all who held them captive
    to show them mercy.

twi: Gye yɛn, Awurade yɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn,na boaboa yɛn ano fi amanaman so,na yɛada wo din kronkron no ase,na yɛde nkamfo ahyɛ wo anuonyam.
english:
Save us, Lord our God,
    and gather us from the nations,
that we may give thanks to your holy name
    and glory in your praise.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn,emfi mmeresanten nkosi nnasanten.Momma nnipa no nyinaa nka se, “Amen!”Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel,
    from everlasting to everlasting.
Let all the people say, “Amen!”
Praise the Lord.

twi: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ANUMNnwom –Dwom Monna Awurade ase na oye;na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
    his love endures forever.

twi: Momma wɔn a Awurade agye wɔn nka saa,wɔn a wagye wɔn afi ɔtamfo nsam no;
english:
Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story—
    those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,

twi: wɔn a ɔboaboaa wɔn ano fii nsase so no,efi apuei kosi atɔe, atifi kosi anafo.
english:
those he gathered from the lands,
    from east and west, from north and south.

twi: Ebinom kyinkyinii wɔ nsase pradada so,a wɔanhu ɔkwan ankɔ kuropɔn no mu, faako a wobetumi anya atenae.
english:
Some wandered in desert wastelands,
    finding no way to a city where they could settle.

twi: Ɔkɔm ne osukɔm dee wɔnna wɔtotɔɔ beraw.
english:
They were hungry and thirsty,
    and their lives ebbed away.

twi: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu,na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohiahia mu.
english:
Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble,
    and he delivered them from their distress.

twi: Ɔde wɔn faa ɔkwan tee sobaa kuropɔn a wotumi tena mu no mu.
english:
He led them by a straight way
    to a city where they could settle.

twi: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa dane nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho,
english:
Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love
    and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

twi: ɔma wɔn a osukɔm de wɔn nsuna ɔde nnepa hyɛ wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn ma.
english:
for he satisfies the thirsty
    and fills the hungry with good things.

twi: Ebinom tenaa sum ne awerɛhow mu,nneduafo a wɔde dade nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn agu wɔn,
english:
Some sat in darkness, in utter darkness,
    prisoners suffering in iron chains,

twi: efisɛ wɔatew Onyankopɔn nsɛm ho atuana wɔabu Ɔsorosoroni no agyinatu animtiaa.
english:
because they rebelled against God’s commands
    and despised the plans of the Most High.

twi: Enti ogyaa wɔn maa adwumaden;wohintihintiwii, na wɔannya ɔboafo.
english:
So he subjected them to bitter labor;
    they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

twi: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu,na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.
english:
Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,
    and he saved them from their distress.

twi: Oyii wɔn fii sum ne awerɛhow mu,na obubuu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.
english:
He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness,
    and broke away their chains.

twi: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa dane nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho,
english:
Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love
    and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

twi: efisɛ obubu kɔbere mfrafra aponna otwitwa nnadeban mu.
english:
for he breaks down gates of bronze
    and cuts through bars of iron.

twi: Ebinom bɛyɛɛ nkwaseafo, wɔn atuatew nti,na wohuu amane, wɔn nnebɔne nti.
english:
Some became fools through their rebellious ways
    and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

twi: Wokyii aduan nyinaana wotwiw bɛnee owu pon ano.
english:
They loathed all food
    and drew near the gates of death.

twi: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu muna ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.
english:
Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,
    and he saved them from their distress.

twi: Ɔsomaa nʼasɛm na ɔsaa wɔn yare;na ogyee wɔn fii ɔda mu.
english:
He sent out his word and healed them;
    he rescued them from the grave.

twi: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa dane nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho.
english:
Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love
    and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

twi: Momma wɔmmɔ aseda afɔrena wɔmfa ahurusi nnwom nka ne nnwuma ho asɛm.
english:
Let them sacrifice thank offerings
    and tell of his works with songs of joy.

twi: Ebinom tenaa ahyɛn mu wɔ po so;wɔyɛ aguadifo wɔ nsu akɛse so.
english:
Some went out on the sea in ships;
    they were merchants on the mighty waters.

twi: Wohuu Awurade nnwuma,nʼanwonwade a ɛwɔ bun mu.
english:
They saw the works of the Lord,
    his wonderful deeds in the deep.

twi: Ɔkasa maa ahum tuina ekukuru asorɔkye.
english:
For he spoke and stirred up a tempest
    that lifted high the waves.

twi: Wokukuru kɔɔ ɔsorosoro na wosian kɔɔ bun mu tɔnn;wɔn amanehunu mu no wɔn koma tui.
english:
They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths;
    in their peril their courage melted away.

twi: Wokyim totɔɔ ntintan sɛ asabowfo;na wonhu nea wɔnnyɛ bio.
english:
They reeled and staggered like drunkards;
    they were at their wits’ end.

twi: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu,na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.
english:
Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble,
    and he brought them out of their distress.

twi: Ɔmaa ahum no yɛɛ dinn;po so asorɔkye ano brɛɛ ase.
english:
He stilled the storm to a whisper;
    the waves of the sea were hushed.

twi: Wɔn ani gyei, bere a ɛyɛɛ dinn no,na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn ɔkwan de wɔn koduu gyinabea a wɔpɛ.
english:
They were glad when it grew calm,
    and he guided them to their desired haven.

twi: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa dane nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho.
english:
Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love
    and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

twi: Wɔmma no so wɔ asafo no muna wɔnkamfo no wɔ mpanyimfo nhyiamu ase.
english:
Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people
    and praise him in the council of the elders.

twi: Ɔdan nsubɔnten maa no yɛɛ sare,asuten yɛɛ asase wosee,
english:
He turned rivers into a desert,
    flowing springs into thirsty ground,

twi: na asasebere dan nkyenenkyene,wɔn a wɔte asase no so amumɔyɛ nti.
english:
and fruitful land into a salt waste,
    because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

twi: Ɔdan sare so maa no yɛɛ nsuwansuwana nkyɛkyerɛ yɛɛ sɛ nsuten anan mu;
english:
He turned the desert into pools of water
    and the parched ground into flowing springs;

twi: Ɛhɔ na ɔde wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn kɔsoɛe,na wɔkyekyeree kuropɔn tenaa mu.
english:
there he brought the hungry to live,
    and they founded a city where they could settle.

twi: Wɔyɛɛ mfuw ne bobe nturona ɛmaa wɔn nnɔbae bebree.
english:
They sowed fields and planted vineyards
    that yielded a fruitful harvest;

twi: Ohyiraa wɔn na wɔn ase dɔe.Wamma wɔn nyɛmmoa dodow so anhuan.
english:
he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased,
    and he did not let their herds diminish.

twi: Afei wɔn dodow so huaneena nhyɛso, amanehunu ne awerɛhow brɛɛ wɔn ase;
english:
Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled
    by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

twi: nea obu abirɛmpɔn animtiaa noma wokyinkyin asase kesee a ɔkwan nni hɔ so.
english:
he who pours contempt on nobles
    made them wander in a trackless waste.

twi: Nanso ɔmaa ahiafo so fii wɔn ahohia muna ɔmaa wɔn mmusua dɔɔ sɛ nguankuw.
english:
But he lifted the needy out of their affliction
    and increased their families like flocks.

twi: Atreneefo hu ma wɔn ani gye,nanso amumɔyɛfo nyinaa mua wɔn ano.
english:
The upright see and rejoice,
    but all the wicked shut their mouths.

twi: Momma nea ɔyɛ onyansafo no mmu eyinom,na onsusuw Awurade adɔe kɛse no ho.
english:
Let the one who is wise heed these things
    and ponder the loving deeds of the Lord.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Onyankopɔn, me koma asi pi;mede me kra nyinaa bɛto wʼayeyi nnwom.
english:
My heart, O God, is steadfast;
    I will sing and make music with all my soul.

twi: Munnyan, sanku ne bɛnta!Menyan anɔpahema.
english:
Awake, harp and lyre!
    I will awaken the dawn.

twi: Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman mu;mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa no mu.
english:
I will praise you, Lord, among the nations;
    I will sing of you among the peoples.

twi: Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro;wo nokwaredi du wim.
english:
For great is your love, higher than the heavens;
    your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

twi: Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro,na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.
english:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
    let your glory be over all the earth.

twi: Fa wo nsa nifa gye yɛn na boa yɛn,na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.
english:
Save us and help us with your right hand,
    that those you love may be delivered.

twi: Onyankopɔn akasa afi ne kronkronbea se,“Nkonim mu na mɛkyɛ Sekem muna masusuw Sukot Bon.
english:
God has spoken from his sanctuary:
    “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem
    and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

twi: Gilead yɛ me de; Manase nso saa ara;Efraim yɛ me dade kyɛw,Yuda yɛ mʼahempema.
Moab yɛ me guasɛn,Edom so na metow me mpaboa gu;na meteɛ mu nkonimdi so gu Filistifo so.”
Hena na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?Hena na obedi mʼanim akɔ Edom?
english:
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
    Who will lead me to Edom?

twi: Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛnna wo ne yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio ana?
english:
Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us
    and no longer go out with our armies?

twi: Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfo no,na ɔdesani mmoa nka hwee.
english:
Give us aid against the enemy,
    for human help is worthless.

twi: Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yebedi nkonim,na obetiatia yɛn atamfo so.
english:
With God we will gain the victory,
    and he will trample down our enemies.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Me Nyankopɔn a mekamfo wo,nyɛ komm,
english:
My God, whom I praise,
    do not remain silent,

twi: na amumɔyɛfo ne nkontompofoatu wɔn ano agu me so;wɔde atoro tɛkrɛma akasa atia me.
Wɔde nitansɛm atwa me ho ahyiana wɔtow hyɛ me so a menkaa wɔn.
english:
With words of hatred they surround me;
    they attack me without cause.

twi: Wɔka nsɛm to me so de tua mʼadɔeyɛ so ka,nanso meyɛ obi a mepɛ mpaebɔ.
english:
In return for my friendship they accuse me,
    but I am a man of prayer.

twi: Wɔde bɔne tua me papayɛ so ka,na wɔde ɔtan tua mʼadɔeyɛ so ka.
english:
They repay me evil for good,
    and hatred for my friendship.

twi: Ma onipa bɔne bi nsɔre ntia no;na Satan nnyina ne nsa nifa so.
english:
Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy;
    let an accuser stand at his right hand.

twi: Wodi nʼasɛm a, ma onni fɔ,na ne mpaebɔ mmu no kumfɔ.
english:
When he is tried, let him be found guilty,
    and may his prayers condemn him.

twi: Ma ne nkwa nna nyɛ kakraa bi;na ɔfoforo nsi nʼanan mu sɛ ɔkannifo.
english:
May his days be few;
    may another take his place of leadership.

twi: Ma ne mma nyɛ ayisaana ne yere nyɛ okunafo.
english:
May his children be fatherless
    and his wife a widow.

twi: Ma ne mma nkyinkyin nsrɛsrɛ ade;ma wɔmpam wɔn mfi wɔn afi a abubu no mu.
english:
May his children be wandering beggars;
    may they be driven from their ruined homes.

twi: Ma ɔdefirifo bi mfa nea ɔwɔ nyinaa;na ananafo mfom nʼadwuma so aba.
english:
May a creditor seize all he has;
    may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

twi: Mma obiara nhu no,anaa ne ayisaa mmɔbɔ.
english:
May no one extend kindness to him
    or take pity on his fatherless children.

twi: Ma nʼase nhyew,na wɔn din nyera wɔ awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba no mu.
english:
May his descendants be cut off,
    their names blotted out from the next generation.

twi: Ma wɔnkae nʼagyanom nnebɔne wɔ Awurade anim;na ne na bɔne no ntena hɔ daa.
english:
May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord;
    may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

twi: Wɔn bɔne nyinaa nka Awurade anim,na wɔankae wɔn bio wɔ asase so.
english:
May their sins always remain before the Lord,
    that he may blot out their name from the earth.

twi: Efisɛ wannwene da sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adɔe,na mmom ɔtaa ahiafommɔborɔfo ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahow de kɔɔ owu mu.
english:
For he never thought of doing a kindness,
    but hounded to death the poor
    and the needy and the brokenhearted.

twi: Nʼani gyee sɛ ɔbɛdomeenti nnome mmra no so;wampɛ sɛ obehyiraenti nhyira mmɔ no.
english:
He loved to pronounce a curse—
    may it come back on him.
He found no pleasure in blessing—
    may it be far from him.

twi: Ɔhyɛɛ nnome sɛ atade;ɛno kɔɔ ne nipadua mu sɛ nsu,ne ne nnompe mu sɛ ngo.
Ma ɛnyɛ sɛ atade a ɛkyekyere ne ho,ne abɔso a ɛbɔ no daa.
english:
May it be like a cloak wrapped about him,
    like a belt tied forever around him.

twi: Ma eyi nyɛ Awurade akatua a ɔde ma me sobobɔfo,wɔn a wɔka nsɛmmɔne fa me ho no.
english:
May this be the Lord’s payment to my accusers,
    to those who speak evil of me.

twi: Nanso wo Asafo Awurade,wo din nti wo ne me nni no yiye;fi wʼadɔe mu gye me.
Efisɛ meyɛ ohiani ne nea onni bi,na me koma atɔ beraw wɔ me mu.
english:
For I am poor and needy,
    and my heart is wounded within me.

twi: Mitwaa mu sɛ anwummere sunsuma;wopia me kyene sɛ mmoadabi.
english:
I fade away like an evening shadow;
    I am shaken off like a locust.

twi: Mmuadadi ama me nkotodwe mu agugow;mafɔn, na ama aka me nnompe.
english:
My knees give way from fasting;
    my body is thin and gaunt.

twi: Mayɛ aserewde ama wɔn a wɔbɔ me sobo;sɛ wohu me a, wɔwosow wɔn ti.
english:
I am an object of scorn to my accusers;
    when they see me, they shake their heads.

twi: Boa me, Awurade me Nyankopɔn;gye me sɛnea wʼadɔe te.
english:
Help me, Lord my God;
    save me according to your unfailing love.

twi: Ma wonhu sɛ ɛyɛ wo nsa,na wo na woayɛ, Awurade.
english:
Let them know that it is your hand,
    that you, Lord, have done it.

twi: Wɔbɛdome, nanso wubehyira;sɛ wɔtow hyɛ me so a wɔn anim begu ase,nanso wo somfo ani begye.
Mʼatamfo befura animguase;na akyekyere wɔn ho sɛ atade.
english:
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace
    and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

twi: Mede mʼano bɛma Awurade so ayɛ no kɛse;mɛkamfo no wɔ dɔm mu.
english:
With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord;
    in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.

twi: Efisɛ ogyina ohiani nsa nifa sosɛ obegye no nkwa afi wɔn a wobu no kumfɔ nsam.
english:
For he stands at the right hand of the needy,
    to save their lives from those who would condemn them.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me Wura se,“Tena me nifa sokosi sɛ mede wʼatamfobɛyɛ wʼanan ase ntiaso.”
english:
The Lord says to my lord:
“Sit at my right hand
    until I make your enemies
    a footstool for your feet.”

twi: Awurade bɛterɛw wʼahempema dennen mu afi Sion;na wubedi hene wɔ wʼatamfo so.
english:
The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying,
    “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”

twi: Wʼasraafo beyi wɔn koma muda a wobɛkɔ ɔsa.Tumi kronkron bɛyɛ wʼaduradena wo mmabun bɛba wo nkyɛnsɛnea obosu gugu anɔpahema.
english:
Your troops will be willing
    on your day of battle.
Arrayed in holy splendor,
    your young men will come to you
    like dew from the morning’s womb.

twi: Awurade aka ntamna ɔrensesa nʼadwene:“Woyɛ daapem sɔfosɛ Melkisedek sɛso.”
english:
The Lord has sworn
    and will not change his mind:
“You are a priest forever,
    in the order of Melchizedek.”

twi: Awurade wɔ wo nifa so;ɔbɛdwerɛw ahemfo wɔ nʼabufuwhyew da no.
english:
The Lord is at your right hand;
    he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

twi: Obebu amanaman atɛn aboaboa awufo ano;na wadwerɛw asodifo a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa.
english:
He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead
    and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

twi: Ɔbɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɔkwankyɛn mu nsuenti obedi nkonim.Ɔhene no bɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɔkwankyɛn mu nsu,na wanya ahoɔden, na wagyina nkonimdi mu.
english:
He will drink from a brook along the way,
    and so he will lift his head high.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade!Mefi me koma nyinaa mu ama Awurade sowɔ atreneefo aguabɔ ne asafo no mu.
english:
Praise the Lord.
I will extol the Lord with all my heart
    in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

twi: Awurade nnwuma yɛ akɛse;wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho nyinaa susuw ho.
english:
Great are the works of the Lord;
    they are pondered by all who delight in them.

twi: Ne nnwuma yɛ tumi ne anuonyam,na ne trenee wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Glorious and majestic are his deeds,
    and his righteousness endures forever.

twi: Ɔma yɛkae nʼanwonwade;Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne mmɔborɔhunufo.
english:
He has caused his wonders to be remembered;
    the Lord is gracious and compassionate.

twi: Ɔma wɔn a wosuro no no aduan;ɔkae nʼapam no daa.
english:
He provides food for those who fear him;
    he remembers his covenant forever.

twi: Wakyerɛ ne nkurɔfo tumi a ɛwɔ ne nnwuma mu,sɛ ɔde aman afoforo nsase ama wɔn.
english:
He has shown his people the power of his works,
    giving them the lands of other nations.

twi: Ne nsa ano nnwuma yɛ nokware na ɛteɛ;nʼahyɛde nyinaa mu wɔ ahotoso.
english:
The works of his hands are faithful and just;
    all his precepts are trustworthy.

twi: Etim hɔ daa daa,nokware ne trenee mu na ɔyɛe.
english:
They are established for ever and ever,
    enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.

twi: Ɔde ogye maa ne nkurɔfo;ɔde nʼapam sii hɔ afebɔɔ,ne din yɛ kronkron na ɛyɛ hu.
Awurade suro yɛ nyansa mfiase;wɔn a wodi nʼahyɛde so nyinaa wɔ nhumu pa.Ɔno na daa ayeyi wɔ no.
Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Nhyira nka onipa a osuro Awuradena onya nʼahyɛde mu anigye pii.
english:
Praise the Lord.
Blessed are those who fear the Lord,
    who find great delight in his commands.

twi: Ne mma bɛyɛ atumfo wɔ asase no so;atreneefo awo ntoatoaso benya nhyira.
english:
Their children will be mighty in the land;
    the generation of the upright will be blessed.

twi: Ahonya ne sika wɔ ne fi,na ne trenee tena hɔ daa.
english:
Wealth and riches are in their houses,
    and their righteousness endures forever.

twi: Sum mu mpo hann pue ma nnipa a wɔteɛ,ma ɔdomfo, mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔnokwafo.
english:
Even in darkness light dawns for the upright,
    for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

twi: Yiyedi bɛba wɔn a wɔn tirim yɛ mmerɛw na wɔde fɛm kwa,wɔn a wɔde atɛntrenee yɛ wɔn nneɛma no so.
english:
Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely,
    who conduct their affairs with justice.

twi: Ampa ara ɔrenhinhim da biara da;wɔbɛkae onipa trenee daa.
english:
Surely the righteous will never be shaken;
    they will be remembered forever.

twi: Ɔte asɛmmɔne a, ɛmmɔ no hu;ne koma si pi wɔ Awurade mu ahotoso mu.
english:
They will have no fear of bad news;
    their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

twi: Ne koma wɔ bammɔ, na onsuro;awiei no ɔde nkonimdi behyia nʼatamfo.
english:
Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear;
    in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.

twi: Ɔtow nʼakyɛde pete aman so ma ahiafo nea wohia,nʼadɔe no tena hɔ daa;wɔbɛkae wɔn daa na wɔahyɛ wɔn anuonyam.
Omumɔyɛfo behu ama ayɛ no yaw,ɔbɛtwɛre ne se na wafɔn;omumɔyɛfo tirimpɔw bɛyɛ ɔkwa.
Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼasomfo no,monkamfo Awurade din.
Momma wɔnkamfo Awurade din,mprempren ne daa nyinaa.
english:
Let the name of the Lord be praised,
    both now and forevermore.

twi: Efi faako a owia pue kosi faako a ɛkɔtɔ,ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din.
english:
From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets,
    the name of the Lord is to be praised.

twi: Wɔama Awurade so aman nyinaa so,nʼanuonyam tra ɔsorosoro.
english:
The Lord is exalted over all the nations,
    his glory above the heavens.

twi: Hena na ɔte sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn,Ɔbaako no a odi hene wɔ ɔsorosoro,
english:
Who is like the Lord our God,
    the One who sits enthroned on high,

twi: ɔno na ɔbɔ ne mu asehwɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase?
english:
who stoops down to look
    on the heavens and the earth?

twi: Ɔma ahiafo so fi mfutuma muna ɔma onnibi so fi nso siw so;
english:
He raises the poor from the dust
    and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

twi: ɔde wɔn tena mmapɔmma mu,wɔn nkurɔfo mmapɔmma mu.
english:
he seats them with princes,
    with the princes of his people.

twi: Ɔbɔ obonin atenase wɔ ne fisɛ ɔbeatan a nʼani gye.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
He settles the childless woman in her home
    as a happy mother of children.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Bere a Israelfo fii Misraim,na Yakobfifo fii ananafo asase so no,
english:
When Israel came out of Egypt,
    Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

twi: Yuda bɛyɛɛ Awurade kronkronbeana Israel bɛyɛɛ nʼaheman.
english:
Judah became God’s sanctuary,
    Israel his dominion.

twi: Po no hwɛe, na eguanee,Yordan san nʼakyi;
english:
The sea looked and fled,
    the Jordan turned back;

twi: Mmepɔw huruhuruwii sɛ adwennini,nkoko nso huruhuruwii sɛ nguantenmma.
english:
the mountains leaped like rams,
    the hills like lambs.

twi: Dɛn na ɛbae, ɛpo, na wuguanee?Yordan, adɛn, na wosan wʼakyi?
english:
Why was it, sea, that you fled?
    Why, Jordan, did you turn back?

twi: Mmepɔw, adɛn, na muhuruhuruw sɛ adwennini,na mo nkoko, muhuruhuruw sɛ nguantenmma yi?
english:
Why, mountains, did you leap like rams,
    you hills, like lambs?

twi: Asase, ma wo ho mpopo wɔ Awurade anim,wɔ Yakob Nyankopɔn anim,
english:
Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord,
    at the presence of the God of Jacob,

twi: ɔno na ɔmaa ɔbotan no dan asubura,na ɔbotan dennen dan nsuwa aniwa no.
english:
who turned the rock into a pool,
    the hard rock into springs of water.

twi: Dwom Ɛnyɛ yɛn, Awurade, ɛnyɛ yɛn,na wo din na anuonyam nka,wʼadɔe ne wo nokwaredi nti.
english:
Not to us, Lord, not to us
    but to your name be the glory,
    because of your love and faithfulness.

twi: Adɛn nti na aman no bisa se,“Wɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
english:
Why do the nations say,
    “Where is their God?”

twi: Yɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro;nea ɔpɛ biara na ɔyɛ.
english:
Our God is in heaven;
    he does whatever pleases him.

twi: Nanso wɔn ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ awɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.
english:
But their idols are silver and gold,
    made by human hands.

twi: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wontumi nkasa;wɔwɔ ani, nanso wonhu ade.
english:
They have mouths, but cannot speak,
    eyes, but cannot see.

twi: Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm;wɔwɔ hwene, nanso wɔnte hua.
english:
They have ears, but cannot hear,
    noses, but cannot smell.

twi: Wɔwɔ nsa, nanso wɔnte nka;wɔwɔ anan, nanso wɔnnantew.Wontumi mma nnyigyei bi mfi wɔn mene mu.
english:
They have hands, but cannot feel,
    feet, but cannot walk,
    nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

twi: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.
english:
Those who make them will be like them,
    and so will all who trust in them.

twi: Mo Israelfo nyinaa, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
english:
All you Israelites, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

twi: Ao Aaronfi, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
english:
House of Aaron, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

twi: Mo a musuro no, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
english:
You who fear him, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

twi: Awurade kae yɛn na obehyira yɛn:Obehyira Israelfi,obehyira Aaronfi
english:
The Lord remembers us and will bless us:
    He will bless his people Israel,
    he will bless the house of Aaron,

twi: Obehyira wɔn a wosuro Awurade,nketewa ne akɛse nyinaa.
english:
he will bless those who fear the Lord—
    small and great alike.

twi: Awurade mma wʼase nnɔ,wo ne wo mma.
english:
May the Lord cause you to flourish,
    both you and your children.

twi: Awurade nhyira wo,ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.
english:
May you be blessed by the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

twi: Ɔsorosoro tɔnn yɛ Awurade de,nanso asase de, ɔde ama onipa.
english:
The highest heavens belong to the Lord,
    but the earth he has given to mankind.

twi: Ɛnyɛ awufo na wɔkamfo Awuradewɔn a wɔkɔ fam dinn no.
english:
It is not the dead who praise the Lord,
    those who go down to the place of silence;

twi: Yɛn na yɛma Awurade sonnɛ ne daa nyinaa.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
it is we who extol the Lord,
    both now and forevermore.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Medɔ Awurade efisɛ, ɔtee me nne.Ɔtee me mmɔborɔsu.
english:
I love the Lord, for he heard my voice;
    he heard my cry for mercy.

twi: Esiane sɛ ɔbrɛɛ nʼaso ase maa me nti,mɛfrɛ no wɔ bere a mete ase yi.
english:
Because he turned his ear to me,
    I will call on him as long as I live.

twi: Owu ahama bebaree me,ɔda ho yawdi baa me so,ɔhaw ne awerɛhow hyɛɛ me so.
Afei mebɔɔ Awurade din kae se,“Awurade, gye me nkwa!”
english:
Then I called on the name of the Lord:
    “Lord, save me!”

twi: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne ɔtreneeni;ayamhyehye ahyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn ma.
english:
The Lord is gracious and righteous;
    our God is full of compassion.

twi: Awurade bɔ ɔwɛmfo ho ban;bere a mewɔ ahohia mu no, ogyee me.
english:
The Lord protects the unwary;
    when I was brought low, he saved me.

twi: Nya abotɔyam bio, me kra,efisɛ Awurade ne wo adi no yiye.
english:
Return to your rest, my soul,
    for the Lord has been good to you.

twi: Na wo, Awurade, woagye me kra afi owu mu;woamma mʼani amporow nisu,na woamma mʼanan anhintiw
english:
For you, Lord, have delivered me from death,
    my eyes from tears,
    my feet from stumbling,

twi: sɛ mɛnantew Awurade animwɔ ateasefo asase so.
english:
that I may walk before the Lord
    in the land of the living.

twi: Migye dii; ɛno nti mekae se,“Mewɔ ahohia kɛse mu.”
english:
I trusted in the Lord when I said,
    “I am greatly afflicted”;

twi: Na mʼahokyere mu mekae se,“Nnipa nyinaa yɛ atorofo.”
english:
in my alarm I said,
    “Everyone is a liar.”

twi: Dɛn na metumi de atua Awurade kawɔ ne papa a wayɛ me nyinaa?
english:
What shall I return to the Lord
    for all his goodness to me?

twi: Mɛma nkwagye kuruwa no sona mabɔ Awurade din.
english:
I will lift up the cup of salvation
    and call on the name of the Lord.

twi: Medi bɔ a mahyɛ Awurade no nyinaa sowɔ ne nkurɔfo nyinaa anim.
english:
I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
    in the presence of all his people.

twi: Awurade nkoa nokwafo wusom bo wɔ Awurade ani so.
english:
Precious in the sight of the Lord
    is the death of his faithful servants.

twi: Awurade, ampa ara meyɛ wo somfo;meyɛ wo somfo, wʼafenaa babarima;woayi me afi me mpokyerɛ mu.
Mɛbɔ aseda afɔre ama wona mabɔ Awurade din.
english:
I will sacrifice a thank offering to you
    and call on the name of the Lord.

twi: Medi me ntam a maka Awurade no sowɔ ne nkurɔfo nyinaa anim,
english:
I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
    in the presence of all his people,

twi: wɔ adiwo a ɛwɔ Awurade fi no,wɔ wʼanim, Yerusalem.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
in the courts of the house of the Lord—
    in your midst, Jerusalem.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Mo aman nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade;mo nnipa nyinaa, momma ne din so.
english:
Praise the Lord, all you nations;
    extol him, all you peoples.

twi: Na nʼadɔe so wɔ yɛn so,na Awurade nokwaredi wɔ hɔ daa.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
For great is his love toward us,
    and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monna Awurade ase efisɛ oye,na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
    his love endures forever.

twi: Momma Israel nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
english:
Let Israel say:
    “His love endures forever.”

twi: Momma Aaronfi nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
english:
Let the house of Aaron say:
    “His love endures forever.”

twi: Momma wɔn a wosuro Awurade nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
english:
Let those who fear the Lord say:
    “His love endures forever.”

twi: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade;ogyee me so, na ɔma me dee me ho.
english:
When hard pressed, I cried to the Lord;
    he brought me into a spacious place.

twi: Awurade ne me boafo; enti merensuro.Dɛn na onipa betumi ayɛ me?
english:
The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid.
    What can mere mortals do to me?

twi: Awurade ne me wɔ hɔ; ɔyɛ me boafo.Mede nkonimdi bɛhwɛ mʼatamfo.
english:
The Lord is with me; he is my helper.
    I look in triumph on my enemies.

twi: Eye sɛ yebehintaw wɔ Awurade mu,sen sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto onipa so.
english:
It is better to take refuge in the Lord
    than to trust in humans.

twi: Eye sɛ yebehintaw Awurade mu,sen sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto mmapɔmma so.
english:
It is better to take refuge in the Lord
    than to trust in princes.

twi: Amanaman no nyinaa twaa me ho hyiae,nanso Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
english:
All the nations surrounded me,
    but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

twi: Wotwaa me ho hyiaa wɔ baabiara,nanso Awurade din mu, mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
english:
They surrounded me on every side,
    but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

twi: Wɔkyere guu me so sɛ nnowa,nanso wɔhyew ntɛm so sɛ nsɔe a ogya atɔ mu;Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
Wosum me kɔɔ mʼakyi a anka mereyɛ ahwe ase,nanso Awurade boaa me.
english:
I was pushed back and about to fall,
    but the Lord helped me.

twi: Awurade yɛ mʼahoɔden ne me bammɔ;wayɛ me nkwagye.
english:
The Lord is my strength and my defense;
    he has become my salvation.

twi: Osebɔ ne nkonimdigyigye wɔ atreneefo ntamadan mu se,“Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!
english:
Shouts of joy and victory
    resound in the tents of the righteous:
“The Lord’s right hand has done mighty things!

twi: Wɔama Awurade nsa nifa so;Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!”
english:
The Lord’s right hand is lifted high;
    the Lord’s right hand has done mighty things!”

twi: Merenwu, mmom mɛtena asena mapae mu aka nea Awurade ayɛ.
english:
I will not die but live,
    and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

twi: Awurade atwe mʼaso dennen,nanso onyaa me mmaa owu ɛ.
english:
The Lord has chastened me severely,
    but he has not given me over to death.

twi: Bue trenee apon ma me;na mɛhyɛn mu na mede aseda ama Awurade.
english:
Open for me the gates of the righteous;
    I will enter and give thanks to the Lord.

twi: Awurade ponkɛse ni;ɛhɔ na atreneefo bɛfa ahyɛn mu.
english:
This is the gate of the Lord
    through which the righteous may enter.

twi: Mɛda wo ase, efisɛ wugyee me so;na woayɛ me nkwagye.
english:
I will give you thanks, for you answered me;
    you have become my salvation.

twi: Ɔbo a adansifo no poe no,abɛyɛ tweatibo.
english:
The stone the builders rejected
    has become the cornerstone;

twi: Awurade na wayɛ eyi,na ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ yɛn ani so.
english:
the Lord has done this,
    and it is marvelous in our eyes.

twi: Nnɛ yɛ da a Awurade ayɛ.Momma yɛn ani nnye na yenni ahurusi.
english:
The Lord has done it this very day;
    let us rejoice today and be glad.

twi: Awurade, gye yɛn nkwa;Awurade, ma yɛn nkonimdi.
english:
Lord, save us!
    Lord, grant us success!

twi: Nhyira ne nea ɔnam Awurade din mu reba.Yehyira wo fi Awurade fi.
english:
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
    From the house of the Lord we bless you.

twi: Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn,na wama ne hann ahyerɛn yɛn so.Momfa nnua mman nkura na yɛnto afɔrebɔ santennkɔ afɔremuka no mmɛn ho.
english:
The Lord is God,
    and he has made his light shine on us.
With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession
    up to the horns of the altar.

twi: Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn na meyi wo ayɛ;wone me Nyankopɔn na mɛma wo so.
english:
You are my God, and I will praise you;
    you are my God, and I will exalt you.

twi: Monna Awurade ase, efisɛ oye;na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
    his love endures forever.

twi: Dwom Awurade MmaraNhyira nka wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ,na wɔnantew sɛnea Awurade mmara kyerɛ.
english:
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless,
    who walk according to the law of the Lord.

twi: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkora nʼahyɛde,na wofi wɔn koma nyinaa mu hwehwɛ no.
english:
Blessed are those who keep his statutes
    and seek him with all their heart—

twi: Wɔnyɛ mfomso biara;na wɔnam nʼakwan so.
english:
they do no wrong
    but follow his ways.

twi: Woayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ pa ato hɔa ɛsɛ sɛ wodi so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
english:
You have laid down precepts
    that are to be fully obeyed.

twi: Ao, sɛ anka mʼakwan besi pi,ayɛ osetie wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho ɛ!
english:
Oh, that my ways were steadfast
    in obeying your decrees!

twi: Sɛ midwen wo mmaransɛm no nyinaa ho a,ɛno de, anka mʼanim rengu ase.
english:
Then I would not be put to shame
    when I consider all your commands.

twi: Mede koma a mu tew bɛkamfo wobere a meresua wo mmara a ɛteɛ no.
english:
I will praise you with an upright heart
    as I learn your righteous laws.

twi: Medi wo hyɛ nsɛm so;na nnyaw me korakora.
english:
I will obey your decrees;
    do not utterly forsake me.

twi: Awurade Mmara Ho OsetieAberante bɛyɛ dɛn na nʼakwan ho atew?Ɛsɛ sɛ odi wʼasɛm so.
english:
How can a young person stay on the path of purity?
    By living according to your word.

twi: Mede me koma nyinaa hwehwɛ wo;mma me mman mfi wo mmara nsɛm ho.
english:
I seek you with all my heart;
    do not let me stray from your commands.

twi: Mede wʼasɛm asie me koma musɛnea merenyɛ bɔne ntia wo.
english:
I have hidden your word in my heart
    that I might not sin against you.

twi: Awurade, ayeyi nka wo;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
Praise be to you, Lord;
    teach me your decrees.

twi: Mede mʼano ka mmaraa efi wʼanom nyinaa.
english:
With my lips I recount
    all the laws that come from your mouth.

twi: Mʼani gye sɛ midi wʼahyɛde so,sɛnea obi ani gye ahonya bebree ho no.
english:
I rejoice in following your statutes
    as one rejoices in great riches.

twi: Midwinnwen wo nkyerɛkyerɛ hona mehwehwɛ wʼakwan mu.
english:
I meditate on your precepts
    and consider your ways.

twi: Mʼani gye wo hyɛ nsɛm ho;na merentoto wʼasɛm ase.
english:
I delight in your decrees;
    I will not neglect your word.

twi: Awurade Mmara Mu AhotɔYɛ wo somfo yiye;na matena ase adi wʼasɛm so.
english:
Be good to your servant while I live,
    that I may obey your word.

twi: Bue mʼani na minhu anwonwade aɛwɔ wo mmara no mu.
english:
Open my eyes that I may see
    wonderful things in your law.

twi: Meyɛ ɔnanani wɔ asase so;mfa wo mmaransɛm no nhintaw me.
english:
I am a stranger on earth;
    do not hide your commands from me.

twi: Me kra tɔ beraw bere biara,wo mmara ho anigyina nti.
english:
My soul is consumed with longing
    for your laws at all times.

twi: Woka ahantanfo anim, wɔn a wɔadome wɔn,na wɔman fi wo mmaransɛm ho no.
english:
You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed,
    those who stray from your commands.

twi: Yi wɔn animka ne animtiaabu fi me mu,efisɛ midi wʼahyɛde so.
english:
Remove from me their scorn and contempt,
    for I keep your statutes.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ sodifo hyia di me ho nseku,nanso wo somfo bedwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.
english:
Though rulers sit together and slander me,
    your servant will meditate on your decrees.

twi: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼanigyedena ɛyɛ me fotufo.
english:
Your statutes are my delight;
    they are my counselors.

twi: Awurade Mmara Sodi Ho BɔhyɛWoabrɛ me ase ma meda mfutuma mu;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.
english:
I am laid low in the dust;
    preserve my life according to your word.

twi: Mesesee mʼakwan na wugyee me so;kyerɛkyerɛ me wʼahyɛde.
english:
I gave an account of my ways and you answered me;
    teach me your decrees.

twi: Ma mente nea ɛwɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ase;na mesusuw wʼanwonwade ho.
english:
Cause me to understand the way of your precepts,
    that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.

twi: Awerɛhow ama me kra atɔ beraw;hyɛ me den sɛnea wʼasɛm no kyerɛ.
english:
My soul is weary with sorrow;
    strengthen me according to your word.

twi: Yi me fi nnaadaa akwan so;na fa wo mmara so dom me.
english:
Keep me from deceitful ways;
    be gracious to me and teach me your law.

twi: Mafa nokware kwan no so;mede me koma abata wo mmara ho.
english:
I have chosen the way of faithfulness;
    I have set my heart on your laws.

twi: Awurade, mikura wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dennen,mma mʼanim ngu ase.
english:
I hold fast to your statutes, Lord;
    do not let me be put to shame.

twi: Mitu mmirika wɔ wo mmaransɛm kwan no so,efisɛ woama mʼadwene mu adɔ.
english:
I run in the path of your commands,
    for you have broadened my understanding.

twi: Ntease Ho MpaebɔKyerɛkyerɛ me, Awurade, na minni wo hyɛ nsɛm so,na medi so akosi awiei.
english:
Teach me, Lord, the way of your decrees,
    that I may follow it to the end.

twi: Ma me ntease, na medi wo mmara so,na mede me koma nyinaa bedi so.
english:
Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law
    and obey it with all my heart.

twi: Kyerɛ me wo mmaransɛm kwan nona hɔ na minya anigye.
english:
Direct me in the path of your commands,
    for there I find delight.

twi: Dan me koma kɔ wʼahyɛde hona ɛnyɛ pɛsɛmenkominya so mfaso ho.
english:
Turn my heart toward your statutes
    and not toward selfish gain.

twi: Yi mʼani fi nneɛma hunu so;na kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm te.
english:
Turn my eyes away from worthless things;
    preserve my life according to your word.

twi: Di bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no so,na wasuro wo.
english:
Fulfill your promise to your servant,
    so that you may be feared.

twi: Yi animguase a ɛbɔ me hu no fi hɔ,efisɛ wo mmara yɛ papa.
english:
Take away the disgrace I dread,
    for your laws are good.

twi: Mʼani agyina wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no!Kyɛe me nkwa so wɔ wo trenee mu.
english:
How I long for your precepts!
    In your righteousness preserve my life.

twi: Awurade Mmara Mu AhotosoAwurade, ma wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mmra me so,wo nkwagye no, sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
english:
May your unfailing love come to me, Lord,
    your salvation, according to your promise;

twi: Afei mebua nea oyi me ahi no,efisɛ mewɔ wʼasɛm mu ahotoso.
english:
then I can answer anyone who taunts me,
    for I trust in your word.

twi: Nyi nokwasɛm no mfi mʼanom,efisɛ mʼanidaso wɔ wo mmara mu.
english:
Never take your word of truth from my mouth,
    for I have put my hope in your laws.

twi: Medi wo mmara so bere biaraakosi daa apem.
english:
I will always obey your law,
    for ever and ever.

twi: Mede ahofadi bɛnantew,efisɛ mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.
english:
I will walk about in freedom,
    for I have sought out your precepts.

twi: Mɛka wʼahyɛde ho asɛm wɔ ahemfo animna wɔrengu mʼanim ase,
english:
I will speak of your statutes before kings
    and will not be put to shame,

twi: efisɛ mʼani gye wo mmaransɛm ho,na medɔ no.
english:
for I delight in your commands
    because I love them.

twi: Mede nidi ma wo mmaransɛm a medɔ no,na midwinnwen wo hyɛ nsɛm ho.
english:
I reach out for your commands, which I love,
    that I may meditate on your decrees.

twi: Awurade Mmara No Mu AhotosoKae asɛm a woaka akyerɛ wo somfo,efisɛ woama me anidaso.
english:
Remember your word to your servant,
    for you have given me hope.

twi: Mʼawerɛkyekye wɔ mʼamanehunu mu ne sɛ:Wo bɔhyɛ kyɛe me nkwa so.
english:
My comfort in my suffering is this:
    Your promise preserves my life.

twi: Ahantanfo bu me animtiaa bebree,nanso mennan mfi wo mmara ho.
english:
The arrogant mock me unmercifully,
    but I do not turn from your law.

twi: Awurade mekae wo tete mmara no,na minya awerɛkyekye wɔ mu.
english:
I remember, Lord, your ancient laws,
    and I find comfort in them.

twi: Abufuw hyɛ me ma, esiane amumɔyɛfoa wɔapo wo mmara nti.
english:
Indignation grips me because of the wicked,
    who have forsaken your law.

twi: Wo hyɛ nsɛm yɛ me dwom tibanwɔ baabiara a mesoɛ.
english:
Your decrees are the theme of my song
    wherever I lodge.

twi: Awurade, anadwo mekae wo din,na medi wo mmara so.
english:
In the night, Lord, I remember your name,
    that I may keep your law.

twi: Eyi ne ade a meyɛ da biara,midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
english:
This has been my practice:
    I obey your precepts.

twi: Ahofama Wɔ Awurade Mmara Sodi MuAwurade, wo ne me kyɛfa;mahyɛ bɔ sɛ medi wo nsɛm so.
english:
You are my portion, Lord;
    I have promised to obey your words.

twi: Mede me koma nyinaa ahwehwɛ wo;hu me mmɔbɔ sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
english:
I have sought your face with all my heart;
    be gracious to me according to your promise.

twi: Madwene mʼakwan hona madan mʼanammɔntu akyerɛ wʼahyɛde.
english:
I have considered my ways
    and have turned my steps to your statutes.

twi: Mɛyɛ ntɛm, merentwentwɛnsɛ medi wo mmara nsɛm so.
english:
I will hasten and not delay
    to obey your commands.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu, amumɔyɛfo de hama kyekyere me,nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.
english:
Though the wicked bind me with ropes,
    I will not forget your law.

twi: Ɔdasu mu, mesɔre de wʼaseda ma wo,wo mmara a ɛteɛ nti.
english:
At midnight I rise to give you thanks
    for your righteous laws.

twi: Meyɛ wɔn a wosuro wo nyinaa adamfo,wɔn a wodi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so nyinaa.
english:
I am a friend to all who fear you,
    to all who follow your precepts.

twi: Awurade, wʼadɔe ahyɛ asase so ma;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
The earth is filled with your love, Lord;
    teach me your decrees.

twi: Awurade Mmara Sodi So MfasoWo ne wo somfo nni no yiyesɛnea wʼasɛm te, Awurade.
english:
Do good to your servant
    according to your word, Lord.

twi: Kyerɛkyerɛ me nimdeɛ ne atemmu pa,efisɛ migye wo mmara nsɛm no di.
english:
Teach me knowledge and good judgment,
    for I trust your commands.

twi: Mefom ɔkwan ansa na mihuu amane,na mprempren de midi wʼasɛm so.
english:
Before I was afflicted I went astray,
    but now I obey your word.

twi: Wuye, na nea woyɛ nso ye;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
You are good, and what you do is good;
    teach me your decrees.

twi: Ahantanfo de atoro asra me ho de,nanso mede me koma nyinaa di wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
english:
Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies,
    I keep your precepts with all my heart.

twi: Wɔn koma yɛ den na wonni ɔtema,nanso mʼani gye wo mmara ho.
english:
Their hearts are callous and unfeeling,
    but I delight in your law.

twi: Eye sɛ mihuu amanesɛnea mesua wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
It was good for me to be afflicted
    so that I might learn your decrees.

twi: Mmara a efi wʼanom no som bo ma mesen dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ mpem mpem.
english:
The law from your mouth is more precious to me
    than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

twi: Nokware A Ɛwɔ Awurade Mmara MuWo nsa na ɛbɔɔ me na ɛnwenee me;ma me ntease a mede besua wo mmara nsɛm.
english:
Your hands made me and formed me;
    give me understanding to learn your commands.

twi: Sɛ wɔn a wosuro wo no hu me a, ma wɔn ani nnye,efisɛ mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
english:
May those who fear you rejoice when they see me,
    for I have put my hope in your word.

twi: Awurade, minim sɛnea wo mmara te,na nokwaredi mu na woatwe mʼaso.
english:
I know, Lord, that your laws are righteous,
    and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

twi: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nkyekye me werɛsɛnea bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no te no.
english:
May your unfailing love be my comfort,
    according to your promise to your servant.

twi: Ma wʼayamhyehye mmra me so, na minnya nkwa,efisɛ mʼani ka wo mmara ho.
english:
Let your compassion come to me that I may live,
    for your law is my delight.

twi: Ma ahantanfo ani nwu sɛ wɔfom me kwa ntinanso mesusuw wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
english:
May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause;
    but I will meditate on your precepts.

twi: Ma wɔn a wosuro wo no mmra me nkyɛn,wɔn a wɔte wo mmara ase no.
english:
May those who fear you turn to me,
    those who understand your statutes.

twi: Ma me koma nnya bembu wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho,na mʼanim angu ase.
english:
May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees,
    that I may not be put to shame.

twi: Ogye MpaebɔWo nkwagye ho anigyina ama me kra atɔ piti,nanso mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
english:
My soul faints with longing for your salvation,
    but I have put my hope in your word.

twi: Mahwɛ wo bɔhyɛ anim ama mʼani abu;meka se, “Da bɛn na wobɛkyekye me werɛ?”
english:
My eyes fail, looking for your promise;
    I say, “When will you comfort me?”

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ mete sɛ nsa kotoku a ɛsɛn wusiw ano de,nanso me werɛ mfi wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
english:
Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke,
    I do not forget your decrees.

twi: Wo somfo ntwɛn nkosi da bɛn?Da bɛn na wobɛtwe wɔn a wɔtaa me no aso?
english:
How long must your servant wait?
    When will you punish my persecutors?

twi: Ahantanfo atu amoa de asum me afiri,a ɛne wo mmara bɔ abira.
english:
The arrogant dig pits to trap me,
    contrary to your law.

twi: Wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa mu wɔ ahotoso;boa me, efisɛ nnipa taa me kwa.
english:
All your commands are trustworthy;
    help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

twi: Ɛkaa kakraa bi a anka woyii me fii asase so,nanso minnyaee wo nkyerɛkyerɛ sodi.
english:
They almost wiped me from the earth,
    but I have not forsaken your precepts.

twi: Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te,na medi nkyerɛkyerɛ a efi wʼanom no so.
english:
In your unfailing love preserve my life,
    that I may obey the statutes of your mouth.

twi: Awurade Mmara Mu GyidiAwurade, wʼasɛm no wɔ hɔ daa;egyina hɔ pintinn wɔ ɔsorosoro.
english:
Your word, Lord, is eternal;
    it stands firm in the heavens.

twi: Wo nokwaredi kɔ so wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu;wode asase sii hɔ, na etim hɔ.
english:
Your faithfulness continues through all generations;
    you established the earth, and it endures.

twi: Wo mmara wɔ hɔ besi nnɛ,na nneɛma nyinaa som wo.
english:
Your laws endure to this day,
    for all things serve you.

twi: Sɛ mʼani anka wo mmara no ho a,anka mʼamanehunu akum me.
english:
If your law had not been my delight,
    I would have perished in my affliction.

twi: Me werɛ remfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no,efisɛ ɛno so na wonam akyɛe me nkwa so.
english:
I will never forget your precepts,
    for by them you have preserved my life.

twi: Gye me nkwa, na meyɛ wo de;na mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no.
english:
Save me, for I am yours;
    I have sought out your precepts.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo retwɛn sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me,nanso, misusuw wʼahyɛde ho.
english:
The wicked are waiting to destroy me,
    but I will ponder your statutes.

twi: Mahu sɛ pɛyɛ nyinaa wɔ nea ɛkɔpem;nanso wo mmara nsɛm no nni ɔhye.
english:
To all perfection I see a limit,
    but your commands are boundless.

twi: Awurade Mmara Ho DɔAo, medɔ wo mmara no yiye!Midwinnwen ho da mu nyinaa.
english:
Oh, how I love your law!
    I meditate on it all day long.

twi: Wo mmara nsɛm ma mihu nyansa sen mʼatamfo,efisɛ ɛwɔ me nkyɛn daa.
english:
Your commands are always with me
    and make me wiser than my enemies.

twi: Mewɔ nhumu sen mʼakyerɛkyerɛfo nyinaa,efisɛ midwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.
english:
I have more insight than all my teachers,
    for I meditate on your statutes.

twi: Mewɔ ntease sen mpanyimfo,efisɛ midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
english:
I have more understanding than the elders,
    for I obey your precepts.

twi: Memfaa mʼanan nsii ɔkwan bɔne biara sosɛnea metumi ayɛ osetie ama wʼasɛm.
english:
I have kept my feet from every evil path
    so that I might obey your word.

twi: Memman mfii wo mmara ho,efisɛ wʼankasa na woakyerɛkyerɛ me.
english:
I have not departed from your laws,
    for you yourself have taught me.

twi: Wo nsɛm yɛ me dɛ,ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo wɔ mʼanom.
english:
How sweet are your words to my taste,
    sweeter than honey to my mouth!

twi: Minya ntease fi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu;enti mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara.
english:
I gain understanding from your precepts;
    therefore I hate every wrong path.

twi: Awurade Mmara Yɛ KaneaWʼasɛm yɛ mʼanan ase kaneane me kwan so hann.
english:
Your word is a lamp for my feet,
    a light on my path.

twi: Maka ntam ahyɛ mu kena semedi wo trenee mmara no so.
english:
I have taken an oath and confirmed it,
    that I will follow your righteous laws.

twi: Mahu amane bebree;kyɛe me nkwa so, Awurade, sɛnea wʼasɛm te.
english:
I have suffered much;
    preserve my life, Lord, according to your word.

twi: Awurade, ma wʼani nsɔ mʼanom nkamfo a efi me pɛ mu,na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mmara.
english:
Accept, Lord, the willing praise of my mouth,
    and teach me your laws.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ daa metoto me nkwa ase de,nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.
english:
Though I constantly take my life in my hands,
    I will not forget your law.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo asum me afiri,nanso memfom mfii wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
english:
The wicked have set a snare for me,
    but I have not strayed from your precepts.

twi: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼagyapade afebɔɔ;ɛma me koma ani gye.
english:
Your statutes are my heritage forever;
    they are the joy of my heart.

twi: Me koma ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm soakosi awiei.
english:
My heart is set on keeping your decrees
    to the very end.

twi: Awurade Mmara Mu BammɔMikyi nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ wɔn ntanta,na medɔ wo mmara.
english:
I hate double-minded people,
    but I love your law.

twi: Wone me guankɔbea ne me kyɛm;mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
english:
You are my refuge and my shield;
    I have put my hope in your word.

twi: Mumfi me so nkɔ, mo nnebɔneyɛfo,na minni me Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so!
english:
Away from me, you evildoers,
    that I may keep the commands of my God!

twi: Wowaw me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te, na mɛtena nkwa mu;mma mʼanidaso nyɛ ɔkwa.
english:
Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live;
    do not let my hopes be dashed.

twi: So me mu, na menya ogye;na bere biara mɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
english:
Uphold me, and I will be delivered;
    I will always have regard for your decrees.

twi: Wopo wɔn a wɔfom wo hyɛ nsɛm nyinaa,na wɔn nnaadaa no yɛ ɔkwa.
english:
You reject all who stray from your decrees,
    for their delusions come to nothing.

twi: Wotow amumɔyɛfo nyinaa gu sɛ afide;enti medɔ wʼahyɛde.
english:
All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross;
    therefore I love your statutes.

twi: Wo ho suro ma me ho popo;wo mmara abɔ me hu.
english:
My flesh trembles in fear of you;
    I stand in awe of your laws.

twi: Awurade Mmara Ho SetieMayɛ nea ɛteɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ.Nnyaa me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me so!
english:
I have done what is righteous and just;
    do not leave me to my oppressors.

twi: Hwɛ ma wo somfo nni yiye;mma ahantanfo nhyɛ me so.
english:
Ensure your servant’s well-being;
    do not let the arrogant oppress me.

twi: Mahwɛ wo nkwagye anim ama mʼani abu,ɛrehwehwɛ wo bɔhyɛ a ɛteɛ no.
english:
My eyes fail, looking for your salvation,
    looking for your righteous promise.

twi: Wo ne wo somfo nni no sɛnea wʼadɔe te,na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
Deal with your servant according to your love
    and teach me your decrees.

twi: Meyɛ wo somfo; ma me nhumuna mate wʼahyɛde ase.
english:
I am your servant; give me discernment
    that I may understand your statutes.

twi: Awurade, bere aso sɛ woyɛ biribi;wɔrebu wo mmara so.
english:
It is time for you to act, Lord;
    your law is being broken.

twi: Esiane sɛ medɔ wo mmara nsɛmsen sikakɔkɔɔ, anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa,
english:
Because I love your commands
    more than gold, more than pure gold,

twi: na midwen sɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa ye nti,mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara.
english:
and because I consider all your precepts right,
    I hate every wrong path.

twi: Pere Sɛ Wubedi Awurade Mmara SoWʼahyɛde yɛ nwonwa;enti midi so.
english:
Your statutes are wonderful;
    therefore I obey them.

twi: Wo nsɛm asete ma hann;na ɛma ntetekwaa nya ntease.
english:
The unfolding of your words gives light;
    it gives understanding to the simple.

twi: Mibue mʼanom na migu ahome,na mʼani gyina wo mmara nsɛm.
english:
I open my mouth and pant,
    longing for your commands.

twi: Dan wʼani hwɛ me na hu me mmɔbɔsɛnea woyɛ daa ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.
english:
Turn to me and have mercy on me,
    as you always do to those who love your name.

twi: Tutu mʼanammɔn sɛnea wʼasɛm no te;mma bɔne biara nni me so.
english:
Direct my footsteps according to your word;
    let no sin rule over me.

twi: Gye me fi nnipa nhyɛso mu,na madi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
english:
Redeem me from human oppression,
    that I may obey your precepts.

twi: Ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wo somfo sona kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
Make your face shine on your servant
    and teach me your decrees.

twi: Nsuten nisu aguare me,efisɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so.
english:
Streams of tears flow from my eyes,
    for your law is not obeyed.

twi: Awurade Mmara Yɛ PɛƆtreneeni ne wo, Awurade,na wo mmara nso yɛ pɛ.
english:
You are righteous, Lord,
    and your laws are right.

twi: Ahyɛde a woayɛ no yɛ trenee;ɛyɛ nea wonya mu ahotoso pa ara.
english:
The statutes you have laid down are righteous;
    they are fully trustworthy.

twi: Abufuw ahyɛ me ma,efisɛ mʼatamfo bu wɔn ani gu wo nsɛm so.
english:
My zeal wears me out,
    for my enemies ignore your words.

twi: Wɔasɔ wo bɔhyɛ ahorow no ahwɛ pa ara,na wo somfo dɔ wɔn.
english:
Your promises have been thoroughly tested,
    and your servant loves them.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ menka hwee na memfra de,nanso me werɛ mfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.
english:
Though I am lowly and despised,
    I do not forget your precepts.

twi: Wo trenee wɔ hɔ daa,na wo mmara no yɛ nokware.
english:
Your righteousness is everlasting
    and your law is true.

twi: Ɔhaw ne awerɛhow aba me so,nanso wo mmara nsɛm ma me ahosɛpɛw.
english:
Trouble and distress have come upon me,
    but your commands give me delight.

twi: Wʼahyɛde yɛ nokware daa;ma me ntease na manya nkwa.
english:
Your statutes are always righteous;
    give me understanding that I may live.

twi: Ogye MpaebɔAwurade, mede me koma nyinaa mefrɛ wo, gye me so,na medi wo hyɛ nsɛm no so.
english:
I call with all my heart; answer me, Lord,
    and I will obey your decrees.

twi: Misu mefrɛ wo, gye me nkwana midi wʼahyɛde so.
english:
I call out to you; save me
    and I will keep your statutes.

twi: Mesɔre anɔpahema, na misu pɛ mmoa;mede me werɛ ahyɛ wo nsɛm mu.
english:
I rise before dawn and cry for help;
    I have put my hope in your word.

twi: Mʼani gu so anadwo nyinaa,na misusuw wo bɔhyɛ ho.
english:
My eyes stay open through the watches of the night,
    that I may meditate on your promises.

twi: Tie me nne sɛnea wʼadɔe no te;Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara te.
english:
Hear my voice in accordance with your love;
    preserve my life, Lord, according to your laws.

twi: Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ atirimɔdensɛm no abɛn,nanso wɔne wo mmara ntam ware.
english:
Those who devise wicked schemes are near,
    but they are far from your law.

twi: Awurade, wo de, wobɛn me,na wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware.
english:
Yet you are near, Lord,
    and all your commands are true.

twi: Mmere bi a atwa mu no, misuaa wʼahyɛdea wode tim hɔ sɛ ɛntena hɔ daa no.
english:
Long ago I learned from your statutes
    that you established them to last forever.

twi: Mmoa Ho MpaebɔHwɛ mʼamanehunu na gye me nkwaefisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara no.
english:
Look on my suffering and deliver me,
    for I have not forgotten your law.

twi: Di mʼasɛm ma me na gye me;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
english:
Defend my cause and redeem me;
    preserve my life according to your promise.

twi: Nkwagye ne atirimɔdenfo ntam kwan ware,efisɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
english:
Salvation is far from the wicked,
    for they do not seek out your decrees.

twi: Awurade, wʼayamhyehye yɛ kɛse;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara no te.
english:
Your compassion, Lord, is great;
    preserve my life according to your laws.

twi: Atamfo a wɔteetee me dɔɔso,nanso memman mfii wo nhyehyɛe ho.
english:
Many are the foes who persecute me,
    but I have not turned from your statutes.

twi: Mehwɛ wɔn a wonni gyidi no a wɔn ho yɛ me nwini,efisɛ wonni wʼasɛm so.
english:
I look on the faithless with loathing,
    for they do not obey your word.

twi: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼani gye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho;Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te.
english:
See how I love your precepts;
    preserve my life, Lord, in accordance with your love.

twi: Wo nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware;na wo mmara a ɛteɛ no to rentwa da.
english:
All your words are true;
    all your righteous laws are eternal.

twi: Nya Ahofama Ma Awurade MmaraSodifo taataa me kwa,nanso ɛyɛ wʼasɛm nko ara na misuro.
english:
Rulers persecute me without cause,
    but my heart trembles at your word.

twi: Mʼani gye wo bɔhyɛ hote sɛ obi a wanya asade kɛse.
english:
I rejoice in your promise
    like one who finds great spoil.

twi: Mikyi nkontompona medɔ wo mmara.
english:
I hate and detest falsehood
    but I love your law.

twi: Mekamfo wo mpɛn ason da biara,wo mmara a ɛteɛ no nti.
english:
Seven times a day I praise you
    for your righteous laws.

twi: Wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara no wɔ asomdwoe mmoroso,na biribiara rentumi mma wonhintiw.
english:
Great peace have those who love your law,
    and nothing can make them stumble.

twi: Awurade, metwɛn wo nkwagye,na midi wo mmara nsɛm so.
english:
I wait for your salvation, Lord,
    and I follow your commands.

twi: Midi wʼahyɛde sona medɔ no yiye.
english:
I obey your statutes,
    for I love them greatly.

twi: Midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wʼahyɛde so,na wunim mʼakwan nyinaa.
english:
I obey your precepts and your statutes,
    for all my ways are known to you.

twi: Mmoa Ho MpaebɔAwurade, ma me sufrɛ nnu wʼanim;ma me ntease sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.
english:
May my cry come before you, Lord;
    give me understanding according to your word.

twi: Ma me nkotosrɛ nnu wʼanim;na gye me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
english:
May my supplication come before you;
    deliver me according to your promise.

twi: Ma nkamfo nhyɛ mʼanom ma;efisɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
english:
May my lips overflow with praise,
    for you teach me your decrees.

twi: Ma me tɛkrɛma nto wʼasɛm ho dwom,efisɛ wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ trenee.
english:
May my tongue sing of your word,
    for all your commands are righteous.

twi: Ma wo nsa nyɛ krado mmɛboa me,efisɛ maso wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.
english:
May your hand be ready to help me,
    for I have chosen your precepts.

twi: Awurade, mʼani agyina wo nkwagye,na wo mmara yɛ mʼanigyede.
english:
I long for your salvation, Lord,
    and your law gives me delight.

twi: Ma mentena nkwa mu na matumi akamfo wo,na wo mmara nso awowaw me.
english:
Let me live that I may praise you,
    and may your laws sustain me.

twi: Mafom kwan sɛ oguan a wayera.Hwehwɛ wo somfo,efisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara nsɛm no ɛ.
english:
I have strayed like a lost sheep.
    Seek your servant,
    for I have not forgotten your commands.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Misu frɛ Awurade wɔ mʼahohiahia mu,na ogye me so.
english:
I call on the Lord in my distress,
    and he answers me.

twi: Awurade, gye me fi atoro ano,ne nnaadaa tɛkrɛma nsam.
english:
Save me, Lord,
    from lying lips
    and from deceitful tongues.

twi: Dɛn na ɔbɛyɛ wo,na dɛn na ɛka ho bio, wo nnaadaa tɛkrɛma?
english:
What will he do to you,
    and what more besides,
    you deceitful tongue?

twi: Ɔde asraafo bɛmma a ano yɛ nnamne nnyansramma bɛtwe wʼaso.
english:
He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows,
    with burning coals of the broom bush.

twi: Nnome nka me sɛ metena Mesek,na mete Kedar ntamadan mu!
english:
Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek,
    that I live among the tents of Kedar!

twi: Matena wɔn a wokyi asomdwoemu akyɛ dodo.
english:
Too long have I lived
    among those who hate peace.

twi: Meyɛ asomdwoe nipa;nanso sɛ mekasa a, wɔde yɛ ɔko.
english:
I am for peace;
    but when I speak, they are for war.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Mema mʼani so kyerɛ mmepɔw no,ɛhe na me mmoa fi bɛba?
english:
I lift up my eyes to the mountains—
    where does my help come from?

twi: Me mmoa fi Awurade,ɔsoro ne asase yɛfo no.
english:
My help comes from the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

twi: Ɔremma wo nan nwatiri,nea ɔhwɛ wo no rentɔ nko.
english:
He will not let your foot slip—
    he who watches over you will not slumber;

twi: Ampa ara, nea ɔhwɛ Israel norentɔ nko na ɔrenna.
english:
indeed, he who watches over Israel
    will neither slumber nor sleep.

twi: Awurade hwɛ wo so;Awurade ne wo nwini wɔ wo nsa nifa so;
english:
The Lord watches over you—
    the Lord is your shade at your right hand;

twi: Owia rensɛe wo wɔ adekyee mu,na ɔsram nso rensɛe wo anadwo.
english:
the sun will not harm you by day,
    nor the moon by night.

twi: Awurade bɛbɔ wo ho ban afi ɔsɛe nyinaa ho,ɔbɛhwɛ wo nkwa so;
english:
The Lord will keep you from all harm—
    he will watch over your life;

twi: Awurade bɛhwɛ wʼadifi ne wo fieba somprempren ne daa.
english:
the Lord will watch over your coming and going
    both now and forevermore.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Me ne wɔn a wosee me sɛ,“Ma yɛnkɔ Awurade fi” no ani gyei.
english:
I rejoiced with those who said to me,
    “Let us go to the house of the Lord.”

twi: Yegyinagyina wʼaponkɛse ano,Yerusalem.
english:
Our feet are standing
    in your gates, Jerusalem.

twi: Wɔakyekyere Yerusalem yiye sɛ kuropɔnwahyehyɛ mu nneɛma fɛfɛ.
english:
Jerusalem is built like a city
    that is closely compacted together.

twi: Ɛhɔ na mmusuakuw no kɔ,Awurade mmusuakuw no,Wɔkɔkamfo Awurade din,sɛnea nhyehyɛe a wɔde ama Israel no te.
english:
That is where the tribes go up—
    the tribes of the Lord—
to praise the name of the Lord
    according to the statute given to Israel.

twi: Ɛhɔ na atemmu nhengua no sisi,Dawid fi nhengua no.
english:
There stand the thrones for judgment,
    the thrones of the house of David.

twi: Monsrɛ asomdwoe mma Yerusalem se,“Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo no nnya bammɔ.
english:
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
    “May those who love you be secure.

twi: Ma asomdwoe mmra wʼafasu muna bammɔ mmra wʼaban mu.”
english:
May there be peace within your walls
    and security within your citadels.”

twi: Me nuanom ne me nnamfonom nti,mɛka se, “Asomdwoe ntena wo mu.”
english:
For the sake of my family and friends,
    I will say, “Peace be within you.”

twi: Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn fi nti,mɛhwehwɛ wo yiyeyɛ.
english:
For the sake of the house of the Lord our God,
    I will seek your prosperity.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Mema mʼani so kyerɛ wo,wo a wʼahengua si ɔsoro.
english:
I lift up my eyes to you,
    to you who sit enthroned in heaven.

twi: Sɛnea nkoa ani hwɛ wɔn wura nsa no,sɛnea afenaa ani hwɛ nʼawuraa nsa no no,saa ara na yɛn ani hwɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔnkosi sɛ obehu yɛn mmɔbɔ.
english:
As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master,
    as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress,
so our eyes look to the Lord our God,
    till he shows us his mercy.

twi: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, hu yɛn mmɔbɔ,na wɔabu yɛn animtiaa bebree.
english:
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us,
    for we have endured no end of contempt.

twi: Ahomasofo fɛwdi ama yɛabrɛ dodo,ahantanfo animtiaabu afono yɛn.
english:
We have endured no end
    of ridicule from the arrogant,
    of contempt from the proud.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa a,ma Israel nka,
english:
If the Lord had not been on our side—
    let Israel say—

twi: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afabere a nnipa tow hyɛɛ yɛn so,
english:
if the Lord had not been on our side
    when people attacked us,

twi: bere a wɔn abufuw sɔre tiaa yɛn aanka wɔmemenee yɛn anikann;
english:
they would have swallowed us alive
    when their anger flared against us;

twi: anka nsuyiri no bebu afa yɛn so,anka ɔhweam no bɛtwe yɛn akɔ,
english:
the flood would have engulfed us,
    the torrent would have swept over us,

twi: anka nsu a ano yɛ den nobɛpra yɛn kɔ.
english:
the raging waters
    would have swept us away.

twi: Ayeyi nka Awurade awamma ho kwan amma wɔamfa wɔn se antetew yɛn mu.
english:
Praise be to the Lord,
    who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

twi: Yɛaguan sɛ anomaaafi ofirisumfo afiri mu;wɔabubu afiri no,ama yɛaguan.
english:
We have escaped like a bird
    from the fowler’s snare;
the snare has been broken,
    and we have escaped.

twi: Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade din mu,ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.
english:
Our help is in the name of the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no te sɛ Bepɔw Sion,a ɛnwosow na etim hɔ daa no.
english:
Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion,
    which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

twi: Sɛnea mmepɔw atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no,saa ara na Awurade atwa ne nkurɔfo ho ahyiamprempren ne daa.
english:
As the mountains surround Jerusalem,
    so the Lord surrounds his people
    both now and forevermore.

twi: Amumɔyɛfo ahempema renka asase awɔde ama atreneefo no so,sɛ ɛba saa a, atreneefonam wɔn so bɛyɛ bɔne.
english:
The scepter of the wicked will not remain
    over the land allotted to the righteous,
for then the righteous might use
    their hands to do evil.

twi: Awurade wɔn a wɔyɛ papa no, yɛ wɔn papa,wɔn a wɔteɛ wɔ koma mu no, yɛ wɔn papa.
english:
Lord, do good to those who are good,
    to those who are upright in heart.

twi: Na wɔn a wɔman fa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no de,Awurade betwa wɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfo asu.Asomdwoe nka Israel.
english:
But those who turn to crooked ways
    the Lord will banish with the evildoers.
Peace be on Israel.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Bere a Awurade de Sion fi nnommum san bae no,yɛyɛɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsosoo adae.
english:
When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion,
    we were like those who dreamed.

twi: Ɔserew hyɛɛ yɛn anom ma,anigye nnwom hyɛɛ yɛn tɛkrɛma so ma.Na wɔkaa wɔ amanaman no mu se,“Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama wɔn.”
english:
Our mouths were filled with laughter,
    our tongues with songs of joy.
Then it was said among the nations,
    “The Lord has done great things for them.”

twi: Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama yɛn,na anigye ahyɛ yɛn ma.
english:
The Lord has done great things for us,
    and we are filled with joy.

twi: Awurade, san fa yɛn siade ma yɛn,te sɛ nsuwansuwa a ɛwɔ Negeb no.
english:
Restore our fortunes, Lord,
    like streams in the Negev.

twi: Wɔn a wodua no nusu mu node anigye nnwom betwa.
english:
Those who sow with tears
    will reap with songs of joy.

twi: Wɔn a wɔde osu fi adiso aba a wɔrekodua no,de anigye nnwom bɛsan abaa wɔsoso nnɔbae afiafi.
english:
Those who go out weeping,
    carrying seed to sow,
will return with songs of joy,
    carrying sheaves with them.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Salomo de.Sɛ Awurade ansi ɔdan no a,adansifo no yɛ ho adwuma kwa.Sɛ Awurade ammɔ kuropɔn no ho ban a,awɛmfo no wɛn kwa.
english:
Unless the Lord builds the house,
    the builders labor in vain.
Unless the Lord watches over the city,
    the guards stand watch in vain.

twi: Sɛ wosɔre anɔpahemana wotena kosi anadwo,na woyɛ adwumaden pɛ wʼano aduan a,ɛyɛ ɔkwa, efisɛ wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no, ɔma wɔn wɔ wɔn nnae mu.
english:
In vain you rise early
    and stay up late,
toiling for food to eat—
    for he grants sleep to those he loves.

twi: Mma yɛ agyapade a efi Awurade hɔ,na mma yɛ akatua a efi no.
english:
Children are a heritage from the Lord,
    offspring a reward from him.

twi: Mma a wɔwo wɔn mmabun bere mu note sɛ agyan a ɛhyɛ ɔsraani nsam.
english:
Like arrows in the hands of a warrior
    are children born in one’s youth.

twi: Nhyira ne onipa anʼagyan kotoku ayɛ ma.Nʼanim rengu asebere a wahyia nʼatamfo wɔ kurow pon ano no.
english:
Blessed is the man
    whose quiver is full of them.
They will not be put to shame
    when they contend with their opponents in court.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Nhyira ne wɔn a wosuro Awurade,na wɔnantew nʼakwan so.
english:
Blessed are all who fear the Lord,
    who walk in obedience to him.

twi: Wubedi wʼadwuma so aba;nhyira ne yiyedi bɛyɛ wo de.
english:
You will eat the fruit of your labor;
    blessings and prosperity will be yours.

twi: Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛsow abawɔ wo fi;na wo mmabarima ayɛ sɛ ngodua a afifiatwa wo pon ho ahyia.
english:
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine
    within your house;
your children will be like olive shoots
    around your table.

twi: Yiw, sɛɛ ne nea wobehyiraonipa a osuro Awurade no.
english:
Yes, this will be the blessing
    for the man who fears the Lord.

twi: Awurade nhyira wo mfi Sionna ɔmma wunhu Yerusalem yiyeyɛ;wo nkwanna nyinaa.
Ɔmma wo ntena ase nhu wo mma mma.Asomdwoe nka Israel.
english:
May you live to see your children’s children—
    peace be on Israel.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.“Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase,ma Israel nka ɛ.
english:
“They have greatly oppressed me from my youth,”
    let Israel say;

twi: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase,nanso wontumi nnii me so nkonim ɛ.
english:
“they have greatly oppressed me from my youth,
    but they have not gained the victory over me.

twi: Fɛntɛmfo afɛntɛm mʼakyiayɛ wɔn nkɔmoa atenten.
english:
Plowmen have plowed my back
    and made their furrows long.

twi: Nanso Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni;watwitwa amumɔyɛfo hama afi me ho ama made me ho.”
english:
But the Lord is righteous;
    he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.”

twi: Ma wɔn a wɔtan Sion nyinaamfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.
english:
May all who hate Zion
    be turned back in shame.

twi: Ma wɔnnyɛ sɛ sare a ɛwɔ ɔdan atifi,a ennyin na ɛhyew;
english:
May they be like grass on the roof,
    which withers before it can grow;

twi: na nnɔbaetwafo ntumi nnya biribi mfi mu nhyɛ ne nsa ma,na nea ɔboaboa ano nso nnya hwee nhyɛ nʼabasa ma.
english:
a reaper cannot fill his hands with it,
    nor one who gathers fill his arms.

twi: Mma wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no nka se,“Awurade nhyira mmra mo so;yehyira mo wɔ Awurade din mu.”
Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Awurade, mifi bun mu su frɛ wo;
english: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord;

twi: Awurade, tie me nne.Wɛn wʼasoma me nkotosrɛ.
english:
Lord, hear my voice.
Let your ears be attentive
    to my cry for mercy.

twi: Awurade, sɛ wubu yɛn bɔne ho nkontaa a,anka hena na obetumi agyina ano?
english:
If you, Lord, kept a record of sins,
    Lord, who could stand?

twi: Nanso wowɔ bɔnefakyɛ;ɛno nti wosuro wo.
english:
But with you there is forgiveness,
    so that we can, with reverence, serve you.

twi: Metwɛn Awurade, me mu ade nyinaa twɛn,na nʼasɛm mu na mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ.
english:
I wait for the Lord, my whole being waits,
    and in his word I put my hope.

twi: Metwɛn Awuradesen sɛnea awɛmfo twɛn adekyee,sen sɛnea awɛmfo twɛn adekyee.
english:
I wait for the Lord
    more than watchmen wait for the morning,
    more than watchmen wait for the morning.

twi: Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,efisɛ Awurade wɔ adɔe a enni huammɔna ogye ankasa wɔ ne mu.
english:
Israel, put your hope in the Lord,
    for with the Lord is unfailing love
    and with him is full redemption.

twi: Ɔno ankasa begye Israelafi wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu.
english:
