He himself will redeem Israel
    from all their sins.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Awurade, ahomaso nni me koma mu,na mʼani ntraa me ntɔn ɛ;memma nsɛm akɛse nhaw meanaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa dodo ma me.
english:
My heart is not proud, Lord,
    my eyes are not haughty;
I do not concern myself with great matters
    or things too wonderful for me.

twi: Na mmom, mama me kra anya abotɔyamte sɛ akokoaa a ɔda ne na so renum no,te sɛ akokoaa a otua nufu ano no,saa ara na me kra ayɛ wɔ me mu.
Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,mprempren ne daa nyinaa.
english:
Israel, put your hope in the Lord
    both now and forevermore.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Awurade kae Dawidne ɔhaw ahorow a ogyinaa ano no.
english:
Lord, remember David
    and all his self-denial.

twi: Ɔkaa Awurade ntam,na ɔhyɛɛ nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob no bɔ se,
english:
He swore an oath to the Lord,
    he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

twi: “Merenhyɛn me fina merenkɔda me mpa so,
english:
“I will not enter my house
    or go to my bed,

twi: meremma nna mmfa mena meremma mʼani nkum,
english:
I will allow no sleep to my eyes
    or slumber to my eyelids,

twi: kosi sɛ menya baabi ama Awurade,baabi a nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob No bɛtena.”
english:
till I find a place for the Lord,
    a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

twi: Yɛtee wɔ Efrata,yɛbɛtoo so wɔ Yaar mfuw so.
english:
We heard it in Ephrathah,
    we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

twi: “Momma yɛnkɔ nʼatenae;momma yɛnsom wɔ ne nan ntiaso hɔ.
english:
“Let us go to his dwelling place,
    let us worship at his footstool, saying,

twi: ‘Awurade, sɔre bra wʼahomegyebea,wo ne wo tumi adaka no.
english:
‘Arise, Lord, and come to your resting place,
    you and the ark of your might.

twi: Ma trenee nyɛ sɛ ntade mma wʼasɔfo;ma wʼahotefo nto ahurusi nnwom.’ ”
english:
May your priests be clothed with your righteousness;
    may your faithful people sing for joy.’”

twi: Wo somfo Dawid nti,nyi wʼani mfi nea woasra no ngo no so.
english:
For the sake of your servant David,
    do not reject your anointed one.

twi: Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid,nokware ntam a ɔntwe nsan se,“Wʼasefo no mu baakona mede no bɛtena wʼahengua so.
english:
The Lord swore an oath to David,
    a sure oath he will not revoke:
“One of your own descendants
    I will place on your throne.

twi: Sɛ wo mmabarima di mʼapam sona wotie me nkyerɛkyerɛ a,ɛno de wɔn mmabarima bɛtenawʼahengua so afebɔɔ.”
english:
If your sons keep my covenant
    and the statutes I teach them,
then their sons will sit
    on your throne for ever and ever.”

twi: Awurade ayi Sion,ɔde hɔ ayɛ nʼatenae:
english:
For the Lord has chosen Zion,
    he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,

twi: “Ɛha ne mʼahomegyebea daa nyinaa;ɛha na mɛtena adi hene, efisɛ ha na mepɛ,
english:
“This is my resting place for ever and ever;
    here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.

twi: mede nneɛma pa bebree behyira nona mama nʼahiafo adidi amee.
english:
I will bless her with abundant provisions;
    her poor I will satisfy with food.

twi: Mede nkwagye befura nʼasɔfo,na nʼahotewfo ato ahurusi nnwom daa.
english:
I will clothe her priests with salvation,
    and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.

twi: “Mɛma obirɛmpɔn bi apue wɔ Dawid ahenni mu,na mede kanea asi hɔ ama nea masra no ngo no.
english:
“Here I will make a horn grow for David
    and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

twi: Mede aniwu befura nʼatamfo,nanso wɔbɛhyɛ no ahenkyɛw a ɛhyerɛn.”
english:
I will clothe his enemies with shame,
    but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown.”

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Hwɛ oye a eye ne fɛ a ɛyɛsɛ anuanom bɔ mu tena faako!
english:
How good and pleasant it is
    when God’s people live together in unity!

twi: Ɛte sɛ ngo a ɛsom bo a wɔahwie agu apampam,na esian kogu bɔgyesɛ mu,esian kogu Aaron bɔgyesɛ mu,ma bi kogu nʼatade kɔn mu.
english:
It is like precious oil poured on the head,
    running down on the beard,
running down on Aaron’s beard,
    down on the collar of his robe.

twi: Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosu aɛtɔ gu Bepɔw Sion so.Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ ne nhyira,nkwa a to ntwa da no.
english:
It is as if the dew of Hermon
    were falling on Mount Zion.
For there the Lord bestows his blessing,
    even life forevermore.

twi: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Awurade asomfo nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade,mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fi anadwo nyinaa.
english:
Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord
    who minister by night in the house of the Lord.

twi: Momma mo nsa so wɔ kronkronbea hɔna monkamfo Awurade.
english:
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary
    and praise the Lord.

twi: Awurade a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase no,mfi Sion nhyira mo.
english:
May the Lord bless you from Zion,
    he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Monkamfo Awurade din;monkamfo no, mo Awurade asomfo,
mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fi,wɔ adiwo a ɛwɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn fi.
english:
you who minister in the house of the Lord,
    in the courts of the house of our God.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade efisɛ oye;monto ayeyi nnwom mma ne din, na ɛno na ɛyɛ anisɔ.
english:
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good;
    sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

twi: Awurade ayi Yakob sɛ ɔnyɛ ne de,wayi Israel sɛ nʼade a ɛsom bo.
english:
For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own,
    Israel to be his treasured possession.

twi: Minim sɛ Awurade so;Ɔso sen anyame nyinaa.
english:
I know that the Lord is great,
    that our Lord is greater than all gods.

twi: Awurade yɛ nea ɔpɛ biarawɔ ɔsoro ne asase so,po ne mu bun nyinaa.
english:
The Lord does whatever pleases him,
    in the heavens and on the earth,
    in the seas and all their depths.

twi: Ɔma omununkum ma ne ho so fi asase ano ba;ɔsoma anyinam ka osu hona ɔma ahum tu fi ne koradan mu.
Okum Misraim mmakan,nnipa ne mmoa mmakan.
english:
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
    the firstborn of people and animals.

twi: Ɔsomaa ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne nʼanwonwade baa mo mfimfini, Misraim,de tiaa Farao ne nʼasomfo nyinaa.
english:
He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt,
    against Pharaoh and all his servants.

twi: Ɔsɛee amanaman pii,na okunkum ahemfo akɛse,
english:
He struck down many nations
    and killed mighty kings—

twi: Amorifo hene, SihonBasan hene, Ogne Kanaan ahemfo nyinaa,
english:
Sihon king of the Amorites,
    Og king of Bashan,
    and all the kings of Canaan—

twi: na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapadeɔde maa ne nkurɔfo Israelfo.
english:
and he gave their land as an inheritance,
    an inheritance to his people Israel.

twi: Awurade, wo din wɔ hɔ daa.Awurade wo din ahyeta awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
english:
Your name, Lord, endures forever,
    your renown, Lord, through all generations.

twi: Awurade bedi ama ne nkurɔfona obehu nʼasomfo mmɔbɔ.
english:
For the Lord will vindicate his people
    and have compassion on his servants.

twi: Amanaman no ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔa wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.
english:
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
    made by human hands.

twi: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wontumi nkasa,wɔwɔ ani, nanso wonhu ade;
english:
They have mouths, but cannot speak,
    eyes, but cannot see.

twi: wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm,na ɔhome nso nni wɔn anom.
english:
They have ears, but cannot hear,
    nor is there breath in their mouths.

twi: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.
english:
Those who make them will be like them,
    and so will all who trust in them.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade, mo Israelfo nyinaa;monkamfo Awurade, Aaron fi;
english:
All you Israelites, praise the Lord;
    house of Aaron, praise the Lord;

twi: monkamfo Awurade, Lewi fi;monkamfo Awurade, mo a musuro no.
english:
house of Levi, praise the Lord;
    you who fear him, praise the Lord.

twi: Mumfi Sion nkamfo Awurade,monkamfo nea ɔte Yerusalem no.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
Praise be to the Lord from Zion,
    to him who dwells in Jerusalem.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monna Awurade ase na oye.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
His love endures forever.

twi: Monna anyame mu Nyankopɔn no ase.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the God of gods.
His love endures forever.

twi: Monna awuranom mu Awurade no ase.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the Lord of lords:
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwonwade akɛse.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
to him who alone does great wonders,
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na ofi ne ntease mu bɔɔ ɔsoro.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
who by his understanding made the heavens,
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na ɔtrɛw asase mu de kataa nsu so.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
who spread out the earth upon the waters,
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ akanea akɛse no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
who made the great lights—
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔbɔɔ owia sɛ enni adekyee so.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;
english:
the sun to govern the day,
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔbɔɔ sram ne nsoromma sɛ wonni adesae so no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
the moon and stars to govern the night;
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na okunkum Misraimfo mmakan,Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt
His love endures forever.

twi: na oyii Israelfo fii wɔn mu no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and brought Israel out from among them
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔde nsa kɛse ne basa a wateɛ mu.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
with a mighty hand and outstretched arm;
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na ɔpaee Po Kɔkɔɔ no mu no,Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
to him who divided the Red Sea asunder
His love endures forever.

twi: na ɔde Israelfo faa mfimfini no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and brought Israel through the midst of it,
His love endures forever.

twi: Nanso ɔpraa Farao ne nʼasraafo guu Po Kɔkɔɔ mu no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea;
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na odii ne nkurɔfo anim wɔ sare no so.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
to him who led his people through the wilderness;
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na okum ahemfo akɛse no,Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
to him who struck down great kings,
His love endures forever.

twi: na okum ahemfo akunini no.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and killed mighty kings—
His love endures forever.

twi: Okum Amorifo hene, Sihon,Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Sihon king of the Amorites
His love endures forever.

twi: ne Basanhene, Og.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and Og king of Bashan—
His love endures forever.

twi: Na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapade.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and gave their land as an inheritance,
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔde maa ne somfo Israel sɛ agyapade.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
an inheritance to his servant Israel.
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔkaee yɛn, yɛn mmerɛwyɛ mu.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
He remembered us in our low estate
His love endures forever.

twi: Na ogyee yɛn fii yɛn atamfo nsam.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
and freed us from our enemies.
His love endures forever.

twi: Ɔno na ɔma abɔde biara aduan.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
He gives food to every creature.
His love endures forever.

twi: Monna ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no ase.Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
english:
Give thanks to the God of heaven.
His love endures forever.

twi: Dwom Babilonia nsubɔnten ho, ɛhɔ na yɛtena suubere a yɛkaee Sion no.
english:
By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept
    when we remembered Zion.

twi: Ɛhɔ konkɔn so nnua muna yɛde yɛn asanku sensɛnee,
english:
There on the poplars
    we hung our harps,

twi: ɛhɔ na yɛn nnommumfafo kaa se yɛnto nnwom,yɛn ahohiafo hwehwɛɛ anigye nnwom fii yɛn nkyɛn;wɔkae se, “Monto Sion nnwom baako nkyerɛ yɛn!”
Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi ato Awurade nnwom,bere a yɛwɔ ananafo asase so?
english:
How can we sing the songs of the Lord
    while in a foreign land?

twi: Yerusalem, sɛ me werɛ fi wo ama me nsa nifa werɛ mfi sankubɔ.
english:
If I forget you, Jerusalem,
    may my right hand forget its skill.

twi: Sɛ mankae wo a,ma me tɛkrɛma nka ntare mʼanomsɛ mamfa Yerusalemsɛ mʼanigyede kɛse pa ara a.
english:
May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth
    if I do not remember you,
if I do not consider Jerusalem
    my highest joy.

twi: Kae, Awurade, nea Edomfo yɛɛda a Yerusalem hwee ase no.Wɔteɛɛ mu se, “Munnwiriw,munnwiriw ngu fam nkɔka ne fapem!”
english:
Remember, Lord, what the Edomites did
    on the day Jerusalem fell.
“Tear it down,” they cried,
    “tear it down to its foundations!”

twi: Ɔbabea Babilonia, wɔadome wo akɔ ɔsɛe mu,nea otua wo ka bio ani gyewɔ nea wode ayɛ yɛn no ho.
english:
Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction,
    happy is the one who repays you
    according to what you have done to us.

twi: Nea ɔkyere wo nkokoaade wɔn dwiradwira abotan no ani gye.
english:
Happy is the one who seizes your infants
    and dashes them against the rocks.

twi: Dwom Dawid de.Awurade, mede me koma nyinaa ayi wo ayɛ;mɛto wʼayeyi dwom wɔ “anyame” no anim.
english:
I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart;
    before the “gods” I will sing your praise.

twi: Mede mʼani bɛkyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no, akotow wona makamfo wo dinwɔ wʼadɔe a enni huammɔ ne wo nokwaredi nti,efisɛ woama wʼahyɛde no so yiye;ama asen wo titiriwyɛ.
english:
I will bow down toward your holy temple
    and will praise your name
    for your unfailing love and your faithfulness,
for you have so exalted your solemn decree
    that it surpasses your fame.

twi: Bere a misu frɛɛ wo no, wugyee me so;woma minyaa akokoduru ne nnamyɛ.
english:
When I called, you answered me;
    you greatly emboldened me.

twi: Awurade, sɛ ahemfo a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa te nea woahyɛ no a,ma wɔnkamfo wo.
english:
May all the kings of the earth praise you, Lord,
    when they hear what you have decreed.

twi: Ma wɔnto Awurade akwan ho nnwom,na Awurade anuonyam yɛ kɛse.
english:
May they sing of the ways of the Lord,
    for the glory of the Lord is great.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsorosoro de, nanso ɔhwɛ mmɔborɔfo,na ahantanfo de, ohu wɔn wɔ akyirikyiri.
english:
Though the Lord is exalted, he looks kindly on the lowly;
    though lofty, he sees them from afar.

twi: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ menam ɔhaw mu de,nanso wobɔ me nkwa ho ban;woteɛ wo nsa wɔ mʼatamfo abufuw so,na wode wo nsa nifa gye me nkwa.
english:
Though I walk in the midst of trouble,
    you preserve my life.
You stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes;
    with your right hand you save me.

twi: Awurade bɛma nea wahyehyɛ ama me no aba mu;Awurade, wʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa,nnyaa wo nsa ano nnwuma akyidi.
Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, woahwehwɛ me muna woahu me.
english:
You have searched me, Lord,
    and you know me.

twi: Wunim mʼasetena ne me sɔre;wufi akyirikyiri hu mʼadwene mu.
english:
You know when I sit and when I rise;
    you perceive my thoughts from afar.

twi: Wunim mʼadifi ne me nnae mu;wunim mʼakwan nyinaa mu.
english:
You discern my going out and my lying down;
    you are familiar with all my ways.

twi: Ansa na mebue mʼano akasa noAwurade, na wunim ne nyinaa dedaw.
english:
Before a word is on my tongue
    you, Lord, know it completely.

twi: Woakata me ho nyinaa ahyiana wobɔ me ho ban.
english:
You hem me in behind and before,
    and you lay your hand upon me.

twi: Saa nimdeɛ yi yɛ me nwonwa dodo,ɛkɔ soro dodo ma me sɛ medu ho.
english:
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,
    too lofty for me to attain.

twi: Ɛhe na metumi afi wo honhom anim akɔ?Ɛhe na metumi aguan afi wʼanim akɔ?
english:
Where can I go from your Spirit?
    Where can I flee from your presence?

twi: Sɛ meforo soro a, wowɔ hɔ.Na mekɔsɛw me kɛtɛ wɔ asaman a, wo ni.
english:
If I go up to the heavens, you are there;
    if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

twi: Sɛ mede adekyee ntaban tuna mekɔtena po akyi nohɔ a,
english:
If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
    if I settle on the far side of the sea,

twi: mpo hɔ na wo nsa begya me akɔ,na wo nsa nifa beso me mu.
english:
even there your hand will guide me,
    your right hand will hold me fast.

twi: Na meka se, “Ampa ara sum mmɛkata me sona hann nnan adesae ntwa me ho nhyia a,”
english:
If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me
    and the light become night around me,”

twi: sum mpo nyɛ sum mma wo;na anadwo bɛhyerɛn sɛ awia;sum ne hann yɛ wo pɛ.
Na wo na wobɔɔ me honhomwonwen me wɔ me na awotwaa mu.
english:
For you created my inmost being;
    you knit me together in my mother’s womb.

twi: Mekamfo wo, efisɛ woyɛɛ me anwonwakwan so a ɛyɛ hu;wo nnwuma yɛ nwonwa.Minim ɛno yiye pa ara.
Wɔamfa me bɔbea anhintaw wobere a wɔyɛɛ me kokoa mu no;bere a wɔnwenee me wɔ asase bun mu no,
english:
My frame was not hidden from you
    when I was made in the secret place,
    when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

twi: wʼani huu me, bere a meyɛ mogyatɔw no.Nna dodow a woatwa ama me no,wɔakyerɛw ne nyinaa wɔ wo nhoma muansa na mu baako reba mu.
Onyankopɔn, wo nsusuwii som bo ma me!woka ne nyinaa bɔ mu a, ɛtrɛw dodo!
english:
How precious to me are your thoughts, God!
    How vast is the sum of them!

twi: Sɛ mise mɛkan a,ne dodow bɛboro mpoano nwea,sɛ minyan a,me ne wo wɔ hɔ ara.
english:
Were I to count them,
    they would outnumber the grains of sand—
    when I awake, I am still with you.

twi: Sɛ anka, Onyankopɔn, wubekunkum amumɔyɛfo ɛ!Mumfi me so, mo a moyɛ mogyapɛfo!
english:
If only you, God, would slay the wicked!
    Away from me, you who are bloodthirsty!

twi: Wɔde adwemmɔne ka wo ho asɛm;wʼatamfo mmmɔ wo din pa.
english:
They speak of you with evil intent;
    your adversaries misuse your name.

twi: Awurade, metan wɔn a wɔtan wo,na mikyi wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo no ana?
english:
Do I not hate those who hate you, Lord,
    and abhor those who are in rebellion against you?

twi: Minni hwee sɛ ɔtan a mewɔ ma wɔn;mefa wɔn sɛ mʼatamfo.
english:
I have nothing but hatred for them;
    I count them my enemies.

twi: Hwehwɛ me mu, Onyankopɔn, na hu me koma;sɔ me hwɛ, na hu mʼadwene.
english:
Search me, God, and know my heart;
    test me and know my anxious thoughts.

twi: Hwɛ sɛ bɔne bi wɔ me mu a,na di mʼanim fa daa nkwa kwan so.
english:
See if there is any offensive way in me,
    and lead me in the way everlasting.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, gye me fi nnebɔneyɛfo nsam;bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo nsam,
english:
Rescue me, Lord, from evildoers;
    protect me from the violent,

twi: wɔn a wodwen bɔne wɔ wɔn koma muna wɔhwanyan ɔko mu da biara.
english:
who devise evil plans in their hearts
    and stir up war every day.

twi: Wɔsew wɔn tɛkrɛma ano te sɛ ɔwɔ de;nhurutoa bɔre wɔ wɔn ano.
english:
They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent’s;
    the poison of vipers is on their lips.

twi: Awurade, yi me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam;bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo awodwen sɛ wobetwintwan mʼanan mu no ho.
Ahantanfo asum me afiri;wɔatrɛtrɛw wɔn asau ahama muwɔasunsum me mfiri wɔ me kwan so.
Awurade, meka kyerɛ wo se, “Wone me Nyankopɔn.”Awurade, tie me mmɔborɔsu.
english:
I say to the Lord, “You are my God.”
    Hear, Lord, my cry for mercy.

twi: Otumfo Awurade, me gyefo hoɔdenfo,wokata me ti so wɔ ɔko da,
english:
Sovereign Lord, my strong deliverer,
    you shield my head in the day of battle.

twi: nyɛ amumɔyɛfo abisade mma wɔn, Awurade;mma wɔn nhyehyɛe nnyɛ yiye.
english:
Do not grant the wicked their desires, Lord;
    do not let their plans succeed.

twi: Wɔatwa me ho ahyia,nanso, ma amumɔyɛsɛm a efi wɔn anom no nsɛe wɔn.
english:
Those who surround me proudly rear their heads;
    may the mischief of their lips engulf them.

twi: Ma nnyansramma ngu wɔn so;ma wɔntow wɔn ngu ogya mu,ngu dontori amoa mu a wɔrensɔre bio.
Mma dinsɛefo ase ntim asase no so;ma amanehunu ntaataa kitikitiyɛfo.
english:
May slanderers not be established in the land;
    may disaster hunt down the violent.

twi: Minim sɛ Awurade bu ahiafo atɛntreneena odi onnibi asɛm ma no.
english:
I know that the Lord secures justice for the poor
    and upholds the cause of the needy.

twi: Ampa ara, atreneefo bɛkamfo wo dinna wɔn a wɔnam tee no bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim.
english:
Surely the righteous will praise your name,
    and the upright will live in your presence.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, misu frɛ wo, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm so.Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so.
english:
I call to you, Lord, come quickly to me;
    hear me when I call to you.

twi: Ma me mpaebɔ mmra wʼanim sɛ aduhuam;ma me nsa a mema so no nyɛ sɛ anwummere afɔrebɔ.
english:
May my prayer be set before you like incense;
    may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

twi: Awurade, ma ɔwɛmfo nwɛn mʼano;na wɛn mʼano pon.
english:
Set a guard over my mouth, Lord;
    keep watch over the door of my lips.

twi: Mma wɔnntwe me koma nnkɔ nea ɛyɛ bɔne ho,na ankɔyɛ nea amumɔyɛfo yɛ no bi,mma me ne abɔnefonni wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwade.
english:
Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil
    so that I take part in wicked deeds
along with those who are evildoers;
    do not let me eat their delicacies.

twi: Ma ɔtreneeni mmɔ me, ɛyɛ ayamye;ma ɔnka mʼanim, ɛyɛ me ti so ngo.Me ti rempo.Me mpaebɔ da so tia abɔnefo nneyɛe daa.
english:
Let a righteous man strike me—that is a kindness;
    let him rebuke me—that is oil on my head.
My head will not refuse it,
    for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.

twi: Wɔbɛtow wɔn sodifo afi ɔbotan so abɛhwe fam;na amumɔyɛfo behu sɛ me nsɛm no yɛ nokware.
english:
Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs,
    and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

twi: Wɔbɛka se, “Sɛnea obi funtum na otutu asase no,saa ara na wɔabɔ yɛn nnompe ahwete ɔda ano.”
english:
They will say, “As one plows and breaks up the earth,
    so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave.”

twi: Nanso Otumfo Awurade, mʼani wɔ wo so;wo mu na mihintaw, nnyaw me mma owu.
english:
But my eyes are fixed on you, Sovereign Lord;
    in you I take refuge—do not give me over to death.

twi: Bɔ me ho ban fi mfiri a wɔasunsum me no ho,mfiri a abɔnefo asunsum no.
english:
Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers,
    from the snares they have laid for me.

twi: Ma amumɔyɛfo no ankasa ɔtan nyi wɔn,bere a mitwa mu kɔ dwoodwoo no.
english:
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
    while I pass by in safety.

twi: Dwom Dawid de. Bere a na ɔwɔ ɔbodan mu no. Mpaebɔ.Meteɛ mu su frɛ Awurade;mema me nne so su frɛ Awurade sɛ onhu me mmɔbɔ.
english:
I cry aloud to the Lord;
    I lift up my voice to the Lord for mercy.

twi: Mihwie mʼahiasɛm gu nʼanim;meka me haw kyerɛ no.
english:
I pour out before him my complaint;
    before him I tell my trouble.

twi: Sɛ me kra tɔ beraw wɔ me mu a,ɛyɛ wo na wunim me kwan.Ɔkwan a menam so nonnipa asum me afiri.
english:
When my spirit grows faint within me,
    it is you who watch over my way.
In the path where I walk
    people have hidden a snare for me.

twi: Hwɛ na hu, obiara nni me nifa so;mʼasɛm mfa obiara ho;minni guankɔbea bi;me nkwa mfa obiara ho.
Awurade, misu frɛ wo;mise, “Wone me guankɔbea,me kyɛfa wɔ ateasefo asase so.”
Tie me sufrɛ,na mewɔ ahohia kɛse mu;gye me fi mʼataafo nsam,efisɛ wɔn ho yɛ den sen me.
english:
Listen to my cry,
    for I am in desperate need;
rescue me from those who pursue me,
    for they are too strong for me.

twi: Yi me fi mʼafiase,na makamfo wo din.Afei atreneefo betwa me ho ahyiaesiane wo papa a woayɛ me no nti.
english:
Set me free from my prison,
    that I may praise your name.
Then the righteous will gather about me
    because of your goodness to me.

twi: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ,tie me mmɔborɔsu;fi wo nokwaredi ne trenee mubra bɛboa me.
english:
Lord, hear my prayer,
    listen to my cry for mercy;
in your faithfulness and righteousness
    come to my relief.

twi: Mfa wʼakoa nkɔ atemmu mu,na ɔteasefo biara nteɛ wɔ wʼanim.
english:
Do not bring your servant into judgment,
    for no one living is righteous before you.

twi: Ɔtamfo no taa me,ɔbɔ me hwe fam;ɔma me tena sum mute sɛ wɔn a wowuwuu dedaada.
english:
The enemy pursues me,
    he crushes me to the ground;
he makes me dwell in the darkness
    like those long dead.

twi: Ɛno nti me honhom atɔ beraw wɔ me mu;na me koma di yaw wɔ me mu.
english:
So my spirit grows faint within me;
    my heart within me is dismayed.

twi: Mekae tete nna no;midwinnwen wo nnwumane nea wo nsa ayɛ nyinaa ho.
Mema me nsa so kyerɛ wo;wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase kesee.
english:
I spread out my hands to you;
    I thirst for you like a parched land.

twi: Awurade, gye me so ntɛm;me honhom tɔ piti.Mfa wʼanim nhintaw meanyɛ saa a mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ amoa mu no.
english:
Answer me quickly, Lord;
    my spirit fails.
Do not hide your face from me
    or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

twi: Ma mente wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ho asɛm daa anɔpa,na mede me ho ato wo so.Kyerɛ me ɔkwan a memfa so,na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ.
english:
Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love,
    for I have put my trust in you.
Show me the way I should go,
    for to you I entrust my life.

twi: Awurade gye me fi mʼatamfo nsam,na wo mu na mede me ho hintaw.
english:
Rescue me from my enemies, Lord,
    for I hide myself in you.

twi: Kyerɛ me na menyɛ wʼapɛde,na wo ne me Nyankopɔn;ma wo honhom pa nonkogya me asasetaw so.
english:
Teach me to do your will,
    for you are my God;
may your good Spirit
    lead me on level ground.

twi: Awurade, wo din nti, kyɛe me nkwa so;wo trenee mu, yi me fi ɔhaw mu.
english:
For your name’s sake, Lord, preserve my life;
    in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

twi: Fi wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no mu mua mʼatamfo ano;na sɛe wɔn a wokyi me no nyinaa,na meyɛ wo somfo.
Dwom Dawid de.Nkamfo nka Awurade, me Botan,nea ɔma me nsa akodi ho ntetewee,ne me nsateaa ma ɔsa.
english:
Praise be to the Lord my Rock,
    who trains my hands for war,
    my fingers for battle.

twi: Ɔyɛ mʼadɔe Nyankopɔn ne mʼabandennen,me bammɔ ne me gyefo,me kyɛm a mewɔ guankɔbea wɔ no mu,ɔno na ɔka nnipa hyɛ mʼase.
english:
He is my loving God and my fortress,
    my stronghold and my deliverer,
my shield, in whom I take refuge,
    who subdues peoples under me.

twi: Awurade, hena ne onipa a wʼani ku no hoonipa ba a wudwen ne ho yi?
english:
Lord, what are human beings that you care for them,
    mere mortals that you think of them?

twi: Onipa te sɛ ɔhome;ne nna te sɛ sunsuma a ɛretwa mu.
english:
They are like a breath;
    their days are like a fleeting shadow.

twi: Awurade, fi ɔsoro hɔ na sian bra fam;fa wo nsa ka mmepɔw, na emfi wusiw.
english:
Part your heavens, Lord, and come down;
    touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

twi: Soma anyinam na bɔ atamfo no hwete;to wo mmɛmma no ma wonguan.
english:
Send forth lightning and scatter the enemy;
    shoot your arrows and rout them.

twi: Teɛ wo nsa fi ɔsoro bra fam;gye me na yi mefi nsu akɛse ho,fi ananafo nsam,
wɔn a atoro ayɛ wɔn anom ma,na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.
english:
whose mouths are full of lies,
    whose right hands are deceitful.

twi: Onyankopɔn, mɛto dwom foforo ama wo;mɛto dwom wɔ sanku a ahama du gu so so ama wo,
english:
I will sing a new song to you, my God;
    on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,

twi: ama Ɔbaako a ɔde nkonimdi ma ahemfo,na ogye ne somfo Dawid fi afoawerɛmfo ano.
english:
to the One who gives victory to kings,
    who delivers his servant David.
From the deadly sword

twi: Gye me na yi me fiananafo nsam,wɔn a atoro ayɛ wɔn anom mana wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.
english:
deliver me;
    rescue me from the hands of foreigners
whose mouths are full of lies,
    whose right hands are deceitful.

twi: Afei yɛn mmabarima mmerantebere mubɛyɛ sɛ afifide a wɔahwɛ so yiye,na yɛn mmabea bɛyɛ sɛ aduma wɔasen de asiesie ahemfi.
english:
Then our sons in their youth
    will be like well-nurtured plants,
and our daughters will be like pillars
    carved to adorn a palace.

twi: Yɛn asan bɛyɛ amaama;aduan ahorow biara bɛba so.Yɛn nguan dodow so bɛto mpem mpem,wɔn so bɛto mpem du du wɔ yɛn mfuw so;
english:
Our barns will be filled
    with every kind of provision.
Our sheep will increase by thousands,
    by tens of thousands in our fields;

twi: yɛn anantwi bɛtwe nnesoa duruduru.Wɔrennwiriw afasu,yɛrenkɔ nkoasom mu,na agyaadwotwa remma yɛn mmɔnten so.
english:
our oxen will draw heavy loads.
There will be no breaching of walls,
    no going into captivity,
    no cry of distress in our streets.

twi: Nhyira nka nnipa a ɛbɛba mu saa ama wɔn.Nhyira nka nnipa a wɔn Nyankopɔn ne Awurade.
english:
Blessed is the people of whom this is true;
    blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.

twi: Dwom Ayeyi dwom. Dawid de.Mɛma wo so, me Nyankopɔn, Ɔhenkɛse;mɛkamfo wo din daa daa.
english:
I will exalt you, my God the King;
    I will praise your name for ever and ever.

twi: Da biara, mɛkamfo wo;na mama wo din so daa daa.
english:
Every day I will praise you
    and extol your name for ever and ever.

twi: Awurade so, na ɔsɛ nkamfo kɛse;obiara ntumi nsusuw ne kɛseyɛ.
english:
Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise;
    his greatness no one can fathom.

twi: Awo ntoatoaso baako bɛkamfo wo nnwuma akyerɛ afoforo;wɔbɛka wo nnwuma akɛse ho asɛm.
english:
One generation commends your works to another;
    they tell of your mighty acts.

twi: Wɔbɛka wʼanuonyam ne wo tumi a ɛheran no ho asɛm,na mɛdwene wʼanwonwadwuma ho.
english:
They speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty—
    and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

twi: Wɔbɛka wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ hu no mu tumi ho asɛm;na mapae mu aka wo nneyɛe akɛse no akyerɛ.
english:
They tell of the power of your awesome works—
    and I will proclaim your great deeds.

twi: Wɔbɛhyɛ wo papayɛ mmoroso no ho fa,na wɔde anigye ato wo trenee ho dwom.
english:
They celebrate your abundant goodness
    and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

twi: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne mmɔborɔhunufo;ne bo kyɛ fuw na nʼadɔe dɔɔso.
english:
The Lord is gracious and compassionate,
    slow to anger and rich in love.

twi: Awurade ye ma obiara;na ɔwɔ ahummɔbɔ ma nʼabɔde nyinaa.
english:
The Lord is good to all;
    he has compassion on all he has made.

twi: Awurade, wʼabɔde nyinaa bɛkamfo wo;na wʼahotefo bɛma wo so.
english:
All your works praise you, Lord;
    your faithful people extol you.

twi: Wɔbɛka wʼahenni no anuonyam ho asɛmna wɔaka wo mmaninyɛ ho asɛm,
english:
They tell of the glory of your kingdom
    and speak of your might,

twi: sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa behu wo nnwuma akɛsene wʼahenni anuonyam a ɛheran no.
english:
so that all people may know of your mighty acts
    and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

twi: Wʼahenni yɛ daa ahenni,na wo tumidi wɔ hɔ ma awo ntoantoaso nyinaa.Awurade di ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa so,na ɔwɔ ɔdɔ ma biribiara a wayɛ.
english:
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
    and your dominion endures through all generations.
The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises
    and faithful in all he does.

twi: Awurade wowaw wɔn a wɔhwe asena ɔpagyaw wɔn a wɔn nnesoa ama wɔakom.
english:
The Lord upholds all who fall
    and lifts up all who are bowed down.

twi: Aniwa nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan,na woma wɔn, wɔn aduan wɔ ne bere mu.
english:
The eyes of all look to you,
    and you give them their food at the proper time.

twi: Wubue wo nsam,na woma biribiara a ɛwɔ nkwa no nʼapɛde.
english:
You open your hand
    and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

twi: Awurade teɛ wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa mu;na ɔyɛ adɔe ma nea wayɛ nyinaa.
english:
The Lord is righteous in all his ways
    and faithful in all he does.

twi: Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa,wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokware mu nyinaa.
english:
The Lord is near to all who call on him,
    to all who call on him in truth.

twi: Ɔyɛ wɔn a wosuro no no apɛde ma wɔn;otie wɔn sufrɛ na ogye wɔn.
english:
He fulfills the desires of those who fear him;
    he hears their cry and saves them.

twi: Awurade hwɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no no nyinaa so,nanso amumɔyɛfo de, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.
english:
The Lord watches over all who love him,
    but all the wicked he will destroy.

twi: Mʼano bɛkamfo Awurade.Ma abɔde nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron nodaa daa.
english:
My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord.
    Let every creature praise his holy name
    for ever and ever.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Me kra, kamfo Awurade!
english:
Praise the Lord.
Praise the Lord, my soul.

twi: Mɛkamfo Awurade me nkwanna nyinaa;mɛto ayeyi dwom ama me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mete ase yi.
english:
I will praise the Lord all my life;
    I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

twi: Mommfa mo ho nto mmapɔmma so,adesamma a wɔrentumi nnye nkwa.
english:
Do not put your trust in princes,
    in human beings, who cannot save.

twi: Sɛ wɔn honhom tu kɔ a, wɔsan kɔ dɔte mu,saa da no ara wɔn nsusuwii nyinaa yɛ ɔkwa.
english:
When their spirit departs, they return to the ground;
    on that very day their plans come to nothing.

twi: Nhyira ne nea ne boafo ne Yakob Nyankopɔn,nea nʼanidaso wɔ Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn mu.
english:
Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob,
    whose hope is in the Lord their God.

twi: Ɔno ne ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo,po ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu nyinaaAwurade a ɔyɛ nokwafo daa no.
english:
He is the Maker of heaven and earth,
    the sea, and everything in them—
    he remains faithful forever.

twi: Odi ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so,na ɔma wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn aduan.Awurade gyaa nneduafo,
english:
He upholds the cause of the oppressed
    and gives food to the hungry.
The Lord sets prisoners free,

twi: Awurade ma anifuraefo hu ade.Awurade ma wɔn a wɔakom no so,Awurade dɔ atreneefo.
english:
the Lord gives sight to the blind,
the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down,
    the Lord loves the righteous.

twi: Awurade hwɛ ahɔho so,na ɔwowaw ayisaa ne akunafo,na amumɔyɛfo akwan de, ɔdan ani.
english:
The Lord watches over the foreigner
    and sustains the fatherless and the widow,
    but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

twi: Awurade di hene daa daa,Ao, Sion, wo Nyankopɔn, wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa so.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
The Lord reigns forever,
    your God, O Zion, for all generations.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Eye sɛ wɔto ayeyi nnwom ma yɛn Nyankopɔn,ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛfata dodo sɛ wɔkamfo no!
english:
Praise the Lord.
How good it is to sing praises to our God,
    how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

twi: Awurade kyekyere Yerusalem;Ɔboaboa Israel nnommum ano.
english:
The Lord builds up Jerusalem;
    he gathers the exiles of Israel.

twi: Ɔsa wɔn a wɔn koma abotow no yare,na ɔkyekyere wɔn akuru.
english:
He heals the brokenhearted
    and binds up their wounds.

twi: Ɔkyerɛ nsoromma dodow a ɛwɔ hɔ,na ɔde obiara din frɛ no.
english:
He determines the number of the stars
    and calls them each by name.

twi: Yɛn Awurade so, na ne tumi yɛ kɛse;yɛrente nʼase nwie.
english:
Great is our Lord and mighty in power;
    his understanding has no limit.

twi: Awurade wowaw ahobrɛasefona ɔtotow amumɔyɛfo hwehwe fam.
english:
The Lord sustains the humble
    but casts the wicked to the ground.

twi: Monto aseda nnwom mma Awurade.Momfa sanku nto dwom mma yɛn Nyankopɔn.
english:
Sing to the Lord with grateful praise;
    make music to our God on the harp.

twi: Ɔde omununkum kata ɔsoro ani;ɔma asase osuma sare nyin wɔ nkoko so.
Ɔma anantwi aduan,na sɛ kwaakwaadabimma su a, ɔma wɔn aduan.
english:
He provides food for the cattle
    and for the young ravens when they call.

twi: Ɛnyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ahoɔden na nʼani sɔna ɛnyɛ onipa ahoɔden nso.
english:
His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse,
    nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;

twi: Na mmom, Awurade ani sɔ nnipa a wosuro no,wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no so no.
english:
the Lord delights in those who fear him,
    who put their hope in his unfailing love.

twi: Momma Awurade so, Yerusalem;kamfo wo Nyankopɔn, Sion,
english:
Extol the Lord, Jerusalem;
    praise your God, Zion.

twi: ɔma wʼapon akyi adaban yɛ den,na ohyira wo nkurɔfo a wɔte wo mu.
english:
He strengthens the bars of your gates
    and blesses your people within you.

twi: Ɔma wʼahye so dwo,na ɔde awi ankasa ma wo.
english:
He grants peace to your borders
    and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

twi: Ɔsoma nʼahyɛde kɔ asase so;nʼasɛm tu mmirika ntɛm so.
english:
He sends his command to the earth;
    his word runs swiftly.

twi: Ɔtrɛw sukyerɛmma mu sɛ oguan ho nwi,na ɔpete obosu sukyerɛmma sɛ nsõ.
english:
He spreads the snow like wool
    and scatters the frost like ashes.

twi: Ɔtotow mparuwbo gu fam sɛ mmosea.Hena na obetumi agyina nʼawɔw dennen no ano?
english:
He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
    Who can withstand his icy blast?

twi: Ɔsoma nʼasɛm no ma ɛnan no;ɔhwanyan ne mframa, na nsu sen.
english:
He sends his word and melts them;
    he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

twi: Wada nʼasɛm adi akyerɛ Yakob,ne mmara ne ɔhyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ Israel.
english:
He has revealed his word to Jacob,
    his laws and decrees to Israel.

twi: Ɔnyɛɛ eyi maa ɔman foforo biara ɛ;wonnim ne mmara.Monkamfo Awurade!
Dwom Monkamfo Awurade!Monkamfo Awurade mfi ɔsorosoro,monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro sorɔnsorɔmmea.
Nʼabɔfo nyinaa, monkamfo no,ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, monkamfo no.
english:
Praise him, all his angels;
    praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

twi: Owia ne ɔsram, monkamfo no,nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn nyinaa, monkamfo no.
english:
Praise him, sun and moon;
    praise him, all you shining stars.

twi: Monkamfo no, ɔsoro mu sorone mo nsu a mowɔ ɔsoro atifi.
english:
Praise him, you highest heavens
    and you waters above the skies.

twi: Momma wɔn nyinaa nkamfo Awurade din,efisɛ ɔno na ɔhyɛ ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn.
english:
Let them praise the name of the Lord,
    for at his command they were created,

twi: Ɔde wɔn sisii hɔ afebɔɔ;na ɔmaa ɔhyɛ nsɛm bi a ɛrentwa mu da.
english:
and he established them for ever and ever—
    he issued a decree that will never pass away.

twi: Monkamfo Awurade mfi asase so,mo po kɛse mu abɔde ne po bun nyinaa,
english:
Praise the Lord from the earth,
    you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

twi: anyinam ne mparuwbo, sukyerɛmma ne omununkum,ahum a moyɛ nʼapɛde,
english:
lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
    stormy winds that do his bidding,

twi: mo mmepɔw ne nkoko nyinaa,nnua a ɛsow aba ne sida nyinaa,
english:
you mountains and all hills,
    fruit trees and all cedars,

twi: nwura mu mmoa ne anantwi,abɔde nketewa ne nnomaa a wotu,
english:
wild animals and all cattle,
    small creatures and flying birds,

twi: asase ne amanaman nyinaa so ahemfo,mo mmapɔmma ne asase sodifo nyinaa,
english:
kings of the earth and all nations,
    you princes and all rulers on earth,

twi: mmerante ne mmabaa,mmasiriwa ne mmofra nso.
english:
young men and women,
    old men and children.

twi: Ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din,na ne din so sen din biara;nʼanuonyam korɔn wɔ asase ne ɔsoro so.
Wapagyaw mmɛn bi ama ne nkurɔfo,nʼahotewfo nyinaa nkamfo;Israelfo, nnipa a wɔda ne koma so no nkamfo.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
And he has raised up for his people a horn,
    the praise of all his faithful servants,
    of Israel, the people close to his heart.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade,monkamfo no wɔ ahotefo asafo mu.
english:
Praise the Lord.
Sing to the Lord a new song,
    his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.

twi: Ma Israel ani nnye ne Yɛfo mu.Ma Sion mma ani nnye wɔn Hene mu.
english:
Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;
    let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

twi: Ma wɔmfa asaw nkamfo ne dinna wɔmfa sanku ne akasaa nto dwom mma no.
english:
Let them praise his name with dancing
    and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

twi: Na Awurade ani sɔ ne nkurɔfo;ɔde nkwagye kyɛw hyɛ ahobrɛasefo.
english:
For the Lord takes delight in his people;
    he crowns the humble with victory.

twi: Momma ahotefo nni ahurusi wɔ anuonyam yi mu;na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom wɔ wɔn mpa so.
english:
Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor
    and sing for joy on their beds.

twi: Onyankopɔn nkamfo nhyɛ wɔn anom,na ɛnyɛ afoa anofanu wɔ wɔn nsam,
english:
May the praise of God be in their mouths
    and a double-edged sword in their hands,

twi: sɛ wɔmfa ntɔ were wɔ amanaman no sone asotwe wɔ nnipa no so,
english:
to inflict vengeance on the nations
    and punishment on the peoples,

twi: sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo,ne dade mpokyerɛ ngu wɔn atitiriw,
english:
to bind their kings with fetters,
    their nobles with shackles of iron,

twi: sɛ wɔmfa mmu atɛn, sɛnea wɔakyerɛw atia wɔn no.Eyi ne nʼahotewfo nyinaa anuonyam.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
to carry out the sentence written against them—
    this is the glory of all his faithful people.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Monkamfo Awurade wɔ ne kronkronbea;monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro tumi mu.
Monkamfo no wɔ ne tumi mu nneyɛe ho;monkamfo no wɔ ne kɛseyɛ a ɛboro biribiara so no ho.
english:
Praise him for his acts of power;
    praise him for his surpassing greatness.

twi: Momfa torobɛnto nnyigyei nkamfo no,momfa asanku ne bɛnta nkamfo no,
english:
Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet,
    praise him with the harp and lyre,

twi: momfa akasaa ne asaw nkamfo no,momfa sankuten ne atɛntɛbɛn nkamfo no,
english:
praise him with timbrel and dancing,
    praise him with the strings and pipe,

twi: momfa kyɛnkyɛn mmobɔmu so nkamfo no,momfa kyɛnkyɛn nnyigyei nkamfo no.
english:
praise him with the clash of cymbals,
    praise him with resounding cymbals.

twi: Momma nea ɛhome nyinaa nkamfo Awurade.Monkamfo Awurade.
english:
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.
Praise the Lord.

twi: Elimelek Tutu Kɔtena MoabBere a na atemmufo di Israel so no, ɔkɔm baa asase no so. Ɔbarima bi a ofi Betlehem wɔ Yuda ne ne yere ne ne mmabarima baanu tutu fii asase no so kɔtenaa Moab.
english: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.

twi: Na ɔbarima no din de Elimelek na ne yere nso din de Naomi. Ne mmabarima baanu no nso, na wɔn din de Mahlon ne Kilion. Wɔyɛ Efratifo a wofi Betlehem wɔ Yuda. Wɔkɔɔ Moab kɔtenaa hɔ.
english: The man’s name was Elimelek, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.

twi: Ɛbaa sɛ Naomi kunu Elimelek wu ma ɛkaa ne mmabarima baanu no.
english: Now Elimelek, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.

twi: Wɔwarewaree Moabfo mmea. Na ɔbaako din de Orpa na nea ɔka ho no nso din de Rut. Wɔtenaa hɔ bɛyɛ sɛ mfe du no,
english: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,

twi: Mahlon ne Kilion nso wuwui. Enti ɛmaa Naomi tenaa ase a wahwere ne mmabarima baanu no ne ne kunu.
english: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.

twi: Bere a ɔtee wɔ Moab hɔ sɛ Awurade abɛdom ne nkurɔfo a wɔwɔ Yuda na wama wɔn aduan no, Naomi ne ne nsenom yi yɛɛ ahoboa sɛ wɔrefi Moab asan akɔ ne kurom.
english: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.

twi: Ɔne ne nsenom baanu yi tutu fii beae hɔ faa kwan a ɛde wɔn bɛkɔ akosi Yuda so.
english: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.

twi: Afei, Naomi ka kyerɛɛ ne nsenom yi se, “Monsan nkɔ mo nanom fi. Awurade ne mo nni no yiye sɛnea mo ne awufo ne me dii no yiye no.
english: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you, to your mother’s home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.

twi: Awurade mmoa mo mu biara na onya ɔhome wɔ okunu foforo fi.” Afei, ofifew wɔn ano na wɔn nyinaa maa wɔn nne so sui.
english:
May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband.”
Then she kissed them goodbye and they wept aloud

twi: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Naomi se, “Yɛne wo bɛsan akɔ wo nkurɔfo nkyɛn.”
english: and said to her, “We will go back with you to your people.”

twi: Nanso Naomi kae se, “Me mma, monsan nkɔ fie. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mo ne me kɔ? Merekɔwo mmabarima bio a wobetumi awareware mo ana?
english: But Naomi said, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?

twi: Me mma, monsan nkɔ fie. Manyin, sɛ meware kunu bio a, ɛrenyɛ yiye. Mpo, sɛ midwen sɛ anidaso bi wɔ hɔ ma me sɛ nso anadwo yi ara minya okunu na me ne no wo mmabarima a,
english: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—

twi: mobɛtwɛn kosi sɛ wobenyinyin? Mobɛtena atwɛn wɔn ana? Dabi, me mma. Asɛm no yɛ den ma me sen mo, efisɛ Awurade ayi ne nsa afi me so!”
english: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord’s hand has turned against me!”

twi: Wɔsan twaa adwo bio. Afei, Orpa few nʼase ano de gyaa no kwan, nanso Rut bebaree Naomi sɛ ɔne no bɛtena.
english: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.

twi: Nanso Naomi ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Hwɛ, wo kora asan kɔ ne nkurɔfo ne nʼanyame nkyɛn. Ɛsɛ sɛ wo nso woyɛ saa ara.”
english: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her.”

twi: Na Rut buae se, “Nhyɛ me sɛ mimfi wo nkyɛn nsan nkɔ. Baabiara a wobɛkɔ no, mɛkɔ hɔ bi na baabiara a wobɛtena no nso, mɛtena hɔ bi. Wo nkurɔfo bɛyɛ me nkurɔfo na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Nyankopɔn.
english: But Ruth replied, “Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

twi: Baabi a wubewu no, mewu hɔ bi na wɔasie me hɔ. Sɛ mamma owu antetew me ne wo ntam na ɛnam biribi foforo biara so a, Awurade ntwe mʼaso.”
english: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me.”

twi: Enti Naomi huu sɛ Rut ayɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔne no bɛkɔ no, ogyaa ne pɛ maa no.
english: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

twi: Ɛno nti, wɔn baanu no toaa wɔn akwantu no so. Bere a woduu Betlehem no, wɔn nti kurow mu no nyinaa bɔɔ twi. Mmea no bisae se, “Naomi ni ana?”
english: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, “Can this be Naomi?”

twi: Ɔkae se, “Mommfrɛ me Naomi, na mmom, momfrɛ me Mara, efisɛ Awurade ama asetena ayɛ nwen ama me.
english: “Don’t call me Naomi,” she told them. “Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.

twi: Merefi ha akɔ no na mewɔ biribiara, nanso Awurade de me aba fie nsapan. Adɛn nti na mofrɛ me Naomi wɔ bere a Awurade ama mahu amane na Otumfo de saa abɛbrɛsɛ yi aba me so?”
english: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me.”

twi: Enti Naomi fi Moab bae a, nʼase Rut, Moabni babun ka ne ho. Woduu Betlehem atokotwa bere mfiase no mu.
english: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.

twi: Rut Di Boas Afuw Mu MpɛpɛƆbarima ɔdefo a na ɔyɛ okunini bi tenaa Betlehem a na wɔfrɛ no Boas. Na ɔyɛ Naomi kunu Elimelek busuani.
english: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.

twi: Da koro bi, Rut, Moabni, ka kyerɛɛ Naomi se, “Ma menkɔ afuw mu na minkodi obiara a menya nʼanim anuonyam akyi nkɔboaboa atoko ase.”Na Naomi kae se, “Eye, me babea, kɔ.”
english:
And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, “Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor.”
Naomi said to her, “Go ahead, my daughter.”

twi: Enti Rut kɔ kodii atwafo no akyi. Na nea ɛbae ne sɛ, ohuu sɛ ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ Boas a ɔyɛ nʼase Elimelek busuani no afuw mu.
english: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.

twi: Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, Boas fi Betlehem bae. Okyiaa atwafo no se, “Awurade ne mo ntena!”Atwafo no gyee so se, “Awurade nhyira wo.”
english:
Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, “The Lord be with you!”
“The Lord bless you!” they answered.

twi: Boas bisaa ne sohwɛfo no se, “Ababaa bɛn na ɔwɔ nohɔ hɔ no?”
english: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, “Who does that young woman belong to?”

twi: Sohwɛfo no buae se, “Ɔyɛ ababaa bi a ofi Moab a ɔne Naomi bae.
english: The overseer replied, “She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.

twi: Anɔpa yi ara na obisaa me se, obetumi adi atwafo no akyi aboaboa atoko ano ana? Ɔyɛ nsiyɛfo a bere kakraa bi na ɔde homee wɔ pata no ase hɔ.”
english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter.”

twi: Boas kɔɔ hɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ Rut se, “Me babea tie. Wo ne yɛn ntena ha ara na boaboa atoko; nkɔ afuw foforo biara mu. Di mmea a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ mʼafuw yi mu no akyi pɛɛ.
english: So Boaz said to Ruth, “My daughter, listen to me. Don’t go and glean in another field and don’t go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.

twi: Hwɛ faako a wɔretwa wɔ afuw no mu na di wɔn akyi. Mabɔ mmerante no kɔkɔ sɛ wɔnnhaw wo. Na sɛ osukɔm de wo a, nom nsu a wɔakɔsaw afi abura no mu no bi.”
english: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled.”

twi: Rut butuwii, de nʼanim kyerɛɛ fam daa no ase. Na ɔkae se, “Adɛn nti na manya saa adom yi wɔ wʼani so, me a meyɛ ɔnanani yi?”
english: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?”

twi: Boas buae se, “Nea woayɛ ama wʼase efi wo kunu wu akyi nyinaa no, wɔaka akyerɛ me, sɛ wufii wʼagya ne wo na ne wo man mu na wo ne nnipa a wunnim wɔn wɔ baabiara bɛtenae no.
english: Boaz replied, “I’ve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.

twi: Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a woanya guankɔbea wɔ ne ntaban ase no nnom wo.”
english: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

twi: Na ɔno nso kae se, “Ma menkɔ so nnya wʼanim adom daa, me wura. Woama me awerɛkyekye na woakasa akyerɛ wʼafenaa ayamye so, me a mensɛ na memfata wo nnwumayɛfo no mu baako mpo no.”
english: “May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord,” she said. “You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants.”

twi: Eduu adidibere no, Boas frɛɛ no se, “Bra ma yennidi. Wutumi de wo brodo no bɔ nsa biara a wopɛ mu.”Enti ɔne nʼawitwafo no tenaa ase na Boas maa no aduan sen sɛnea obetumi adi mpo.
english:
At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar.”
When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.

twi: Bere a Rut san kɔɔ nʼadwuma so bio no, Boas ka kyerɛɛ ne mmerante no se, “Momma no mmoaboa atoko no ano mfi nʼafiafi no mu na munnsiw no kwan.
english: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, “Let her gather among the sheaves and don’t reprimand her.

twi: Na munyiyi afiafi no mu de no bi nnyae mu ngu fam mma no na ɔnsesaw, na monnhaw no.”
english: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don’t rebuke her.”

twi: Enti Rut sesaw atoko no wɔ hɔ da mu no nyinaa na ɔporow atoko no saa anwummere no, onyaa bɛyɛ lita aduonu abien.
english: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.

twi: Ɔsoa de kɔɔ kurom, de kɔkyerɛɛ nʼase. Afei, Rut de nʼawiaduan a ogyaw no maa no.
english: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.

twi: Naomi hui no, ɔteɛɛ mu se, “Ɛdɔɔso yiye! Na ɛhe na nnɛ woboaboaa saa atoko yi nyinaa ano fi? Ɛhe na wokɔyɛɛ adwuma? Awurade nhyira nea ɔboaa wo no!”Rut kaa ɔbarima a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ nʼafum no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nʼase no, ɔtoaa so kae se, “Nea meyɛɛ adwuma wɔ nʼafum no, wɔfrɛ no Boas.”
english:
Her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!”
Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.

twi: Naomi ka kyerɛɛ nʼase no se, “Awurade nhyira no. Ɔrekyerɛ yɛn ne wo kunu a wawu no nʼayamye. Saa ɔbarima no yɛ abusuafo a wɔbɛn yɛn pɛɛ no mu baako a ɔyɛ abusua no mu ogyefo baako.”
english: “The Lord bless him!” Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. “He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead.” She added, “That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers.”

twi: Rut kae se, “Nea ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, mpo, Boas ka kyerɛɛ me se, mensan mmra na me ne nʼawitwafo no mmɛtena nkosi bere a wobewie otwa no.”
english: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’”

twi: Naomi teɛɛ mu se, “Anwonwasɛm ni! Yɛ nea ɔka no. Wo ne nʼadwumayɛfo no ntena nkosi sɛ wobewie otwa no. Wʼasom bedwo wo wɔ hɔ sen afuw biara mu.”
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone else’s field you might be harmed.”

twi: Enti Rut ne mmea a wɔwɔ Boas afum hɔ no yɛɛ adwuma. Ɔne wɔn boaboaa atoko no ano kosii atokotwa no awiei. Afei, ɔne wɔn twaa awi nso. Nanso saa bere no nyinaa na ɔne nʼase na ɛte.
english: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.

twi: Rut Wɔ AwiporowbeaDa bi Naomi ka kyerɛɛ Rut se, “Me babea, bere adu sɛ mehwehwɛ ofi a wobɛtena mu na wubenya nea ehia wo biara.
english: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, “My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.

twi: Boas yɛ yɛn busuani pɛɛ na wayɛ adɔe mmoroso sɛ wama wo ne nʼadwumayɛfo aboaboa atoko ano. Anadwo yi, obehuhuw atoko so wɔ awiporowbea hɔ.
english: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

twi: Enti yɛ nea merekyerɛ wo yi. Guare na tutu aduhuam gu wo ho na fa wo ntade pa bi hyɛ. Afei, kɔ awiporowbea hɔ, nanso mma Boas nhu wo kosi sɛ obedidi awie.
english: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don’t let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

twi: Hwɛ na hu baabi a ɔda hɔ yiye, afei, kɔ na koyi ne nan ho nkataho na da hɔ. Ɔbɛka nea ɔpɛ sɛ woyɛ akyerɛ wo.”
english: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do.”

twi: Rut kae se, “Biribiara a wobɛka akyerɛ me sɛ menyɛ no, mɛyɛ.”
english: “I will do whatever you say,” Ruth answered.

twi: Enti ɔkɔɔ awiporowbea hɔ anadwo no, na ɔyɛɛ nea nʼase kyerɛɛ no no mu biara.
english: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.

twi: Boas didi wiee no a ne honhom aba ne ho no, ɔkyeaa ne ho too atoko mmoano no ho, na ɔfaa mu dae. Rut yɛɛ nwaa koyii ne nan ho nkataho na ɔdaa hɔ.
english: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.

twi: Anadwo dasum no, Boas bɔɔ pitiri dan ne ho. Ɛyɛɛ no nwonwa sɛ ohuu sɛ ɔbea da ne nan ase.
english: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!

twi: Obisae se, “Na hena ni?”Obuae se, “Ɛyɛ me wo somfo Rut. Trɛw wo nkataso no mu kakra gu me so na woyɛ mʼabusua gyefo.”
english:
“Who are you?” he asked.
“I am your servant Ruth,” she said. “Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family.”

twi: Na Boas kae se, “Awurade nhyira wo, me babea! Worekyerɛ abusua dɔ a bi mmaa da sɛ woankodi aberantewa bi akyi, sɛ ɔwɔ sika anaa ɔyɛ ohiani.
english: “The Lord bless you, my daughter,” he replied. “This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

twi: Afei, me babea, mma hwee nhaw wo. Mɛyɛ nea ehia wo nyinaa. Me kurow yi mu nnipa nyinaa nim sɛ woyɛ ɔbea a wudi wo ho ni.
english: And now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.

twi: Nanso akwanside baako wɔ hɔ. Ɛyɛ nokware turodoo sɛ meyɛ mo abusua agyefo mu baako de, nanso ɔbarima foforo bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ obusuani titiriw sen me.
english: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.

twi: Tena ha anadwo yi na sɛ ade kye a, me ne no bɛkasa. Sɛ ɛyɛ ne pɛ sɛ obegye wo a, ɛno de ma ho kwan na ɔnware wo. Na sɛ ɛnyɛ ne pɛ nso a, ɛno de, ɔkwan biara so, sɛ Awurade te ase yi, mɛware wo! Enti da ha ma ade nkye.”
english: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning.”

twi: Enti Rut daa ne nan ho kosii adekyee nanso ɔsɔree ansa na anim tetew. Na Boas ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ɛnsɛ sɛ obi hu sɛ ɔbea bi bɛdaa awiporowbea ha.”
english: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, “No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor.”

twi: Boas toaa so kae se, “Fa wʼatade nguguso no bra na trɛw mu.” Ɔsesaw atoko no susukoraa asia guu mu na ɔboaa no ma ɔde hyɛɛ nʼakyi. Na Boas san kɔɔ kurow no mu.
english: He also said, “Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.” When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.

twi: Rut baa nʼase Naomi nkyɛn no, obisaa no se, “Me babea, ekosii dɛn?”Rut kaa biribiara a Boas yɛ maa no no kyerɛɛ Naomi,
english:
When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, “How did it go, my daughter?”
Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her

twi: na ɔtoaa so se, “Ɔmaa me atoko susukoraa asia kae se, ‘Mfa nsapan nkɔ wʼase nkyɛn.’ ”
english: and added, “He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’”

twi: Afei, Naomi kae se, “Me ba, twɛn kosi sɛ wubehu nea ebesi. Ɔbarima no renna so kosi sɛ asɛm no besi nnɛ yi ara.”
english: Then Naomi said, “Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today.”

twi: Boas Ware RutBoas kɔɔ kurow no pon ano kɔtenaa ase wɔ hɔ. Bere a obusuani gyefo titiriw a ɔkaa ne ho asɛm no baa hɔ no, Boas frɛɛ no kae se, “Mʼadamfo, mesrɛ wo bra na mepɛ sɛ me ne wo twetwe nkɔmmɔ.” Enti wɔtenaa ase.
english: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.

twi: Na Boas frɛɛ kurow no mu ntuanofo du sɛ wɔmmɛtena ase sɛ nnansefo.
english: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.

twi: Na Boas ka kyerɛɛ obusuani gyefo titiriw no se, “Wunim Naomi a ofi Moab bae no. Ɔretɔn asase a na ɛyɛ yɛn busuani Elimelek dea no.
english: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, “Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.

twi: Misusuw sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ, me ne wo di ho nkɔmmɔ na sɛ wopɛ a, woagye. Sɛ wopɛ asase no a, tɔ no ha yi ara wɔ saa nnansefo yi anim. Na sɛ wompɛ nso a, ma mente no mprempren ara, efisɛ sɛ woantumi annye a, me ne onipa a midi wʼakyi wɔ abusua no mu a ɛsɛ sɛ migye.”Na ɔbarima no buae se, “Megye.”
english:
I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line.”
“I will redeem it,” he said.

twi: Afei, Boas ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Sɛ wotɔ asase no fi Naomi nkyɛn a, na ɛsɛ sɛ woware Moabni okunafo Rut no. Sɛ ɛba saa a, ɔbɛwo mma a ne kunu din bɛda wɔn so na asase no bɛtena abusua no mu.”
english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property.”

twi: Ɛhɔ ara na abusua mu gyefo titiriw no kae se, “Ɛno de, merentumi ntɔ asase no, efisɛ ɛbɛhaw mʼankasa mʼagyapade. Tɔ asase no na merentumi ntɔ.”
english: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, “Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it.”

twi: Saa bere no, na ɛyɛ Israel amanne sɛ, sɛ obiara redan nʼade bi a watɔ no ɔkwan pa so ama obi foforo a, ɔworɔw ne mpaboa de ma nea ɔtɔ no. Wɔyɛ saa wɔ bagua mu de hyɛ adetɔ no mu den.
english: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)

twi: Enti abusua gyefo titiriw no worɔw ne mpaboa ka kyerɛɛ Boas se, “Wo ara tɔ asase no.”
english: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, “Buy it yourself.” And he removed his sandal.

twi: Na Boas ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no ntuanofo no ne dɔm a wɔatwa ahyia hɔ no se, “Nnɛ matɔ Elimelek, Kilion ne Mahlon agyapade a ɛwɔ Naomi nsam, na moyɛ ɛho nnansefo.
english: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, “Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.

twi: Menam asase no tɔ so afa Rut a ɔyɛ Moabni a ɔyɛ Mahlon kunafo no sɛ me yere. Ne saa nti, sɛ ɔwo ɔbabarima a, ɔbɛfa ne kunu a wawu no abusua din na wafa abusua agyapade a ɛwɔ ne kurom ha nso. Nnɛ, mo nyinaa moyɛ nnansefo.”
english: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!”

twi: Afei, ntuanofo no ne ɔmanfo no nyinaa sɔre gyina kae se, “Yɛyɛ nnansefo! Awurade mmoa mma ɔbea a afei na ɔreba wo fi no nyɛ sɛ Rahel ne Lea a wɔn mu na Israel aman nyinaa fi no. Wobɛyɛ ɔkɛse wɔ Efrata na woagye din wɔ Betlehem.
english: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, “We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.

twi: Na Awurade mfa ababaa yi so mma wo asefo a wɔbɛyɛ sɛ yɛn agya Peres a ɔyɛ Tamar ne Yuda babarima no.”
english: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah.”

twi: Boas AsefoEnti Boas waree Rut de no kɔɔ ne fi. Afei, ɔkɔɔ ne ho na Awurade ma onyinsɛnee na ɔwoo ɔbabarima.
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

twi: Na kurow no mu mmea ka kyerɛɛ Naomi se, “Anuonyam nka Awurade sɛ nnɛ da yi, wama woanya abusua gyefo! Ɔmmɛyɛ okunini wɔ Israel.
english: The women said to Naomi: “Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!

twi: Akokoaa yi mma wo nsi wo mmabaabere mu na ɔnhwɛ wo wɔ wo mmerewabɔ mu. Efisɛ ɔyɛ wʼase a ɔdɔ wo na ɔsen mmabarima ason ma wo no babarima.”
english: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”

twi: Na Naomi faa akokoaa no, na ɔhwɛɛ no te sɛ ɔno ankasa yafunu ba.
english: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.

twi: Na mmea a wɔne no bɔ ofipam no kae se, “Afei de Naomi anya ɔbabarima bio.” Na wɔtoo no din Obed. Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛɛ Yisai agya ne Dawid nena.
english: The women living there said, “Naomi has a son!” And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

twi: Tete agya Peres awo ntoatoaso ni:Peres woo Hesron.
english:
This, then, is the family line of Perez:
Perez was the father of Hezron,

twi: Hesron woo Ram,na Ram woo Aminadab.
english:
Hezron the father of Ram,
Ram the father of Amminadab,

twi: Aminadab woo Nahson,na Nahson woo Salmon.
english:
Amminadab the father of Nahshon,
Nahshon the father of Salmon,

twi: Salmon woo Boas,na Boas woo Obed.
english:
Salmon the father of Boaz,
Boaz the father of Obed,

twi: Obed woo Yisai,na Yisai woo Dawid.
english:
Obed the father of Jesse,
and Jesse the father of David.

twi: Awurade asɛm a ɛbaa Sefania a ɔyɛ Kusi ba, Gedalia ba, Amaria ba, Hesekia ba nkyɛn ni. Ɛbaa Yudahene Yosia a ɔyɛ Amon ba no bere so.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

twi: Atemmu A Etia Yuda“Mɛpra biribiara afi asase so”nea Awurade se ni,
english:
“I will sweep away everything
    from the face of the earth,”
declares the Lord.

twi: “Mɛpra nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa;mɛpra nnomaa a wɔwɔ wimne mpataa a wɔwɔ po mu nyinaa.Atirimɔdenfo benya wura a esum hɔ nko ara,sɛ mesɛe adesamma a wɔwɔ asase yi so a,”nea Awurade se ni.
english:
“I will sweep away both man and beast;
    I will sweep away the birds in the sky
    and the fish in the sea—
    and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble.”
“When I destroy all mankind
    on the face of the earth,”
declares the Lord,

twi: “Mɛteɛ me nsa wɔ Yudane wɔn a wɔte Yerusalem nyinaa so;na mɛsɛe Baal ho biribiara a aka wɔ ha,na masɛe abosonsomfo ne akɔmfo asɔfo no din
english:
“I will stretch out my hand against Judah
    and against all who live in Jerusalem.
I will destroy every remnant of Baal worship in this place,
    the very names of the idolatrous priests—

twi: wɔn a wɔkotow sɔre wɔn adan atifi,de sɔre abɔde a ɛwɔ wim,wɔn a wɔkotow de Awurade ka ntamna wɔde Molek nso ka ntam,
english:
those who bow down on the roofs
    to worship the starry host,
those who bow down and swear by the Lord
    and who also swear by Molek,

twi: wɔn nso a wogyae Awurade akyidina wɔnhwehwɛ Awurade anaa wommisa nʼase.”
english:
those who turn back from following the Lord
    and neither seek the Lord nor inquire of him.”

twi: Monyɛ komm wɔ Asafo Awurade anim,efisɛ, Awurade da no abɛn.Awurade asiesie afɔrebɔde;wadwira wɔn a wato nsa afrɛ wɔn no ho.
english:
Be silent before the Sovereign Lord,
    for the day of the Lord is near.
The Lord has prepared a sacrifice;
    he has consecrated those he has invited.

twi: “Awurade afɔrebɔ da no,mɛtwe mmapɔmmane ahenemmane wɔn a wɔhyehyɛananafo ntade nyinaa aso.
english:
“On the day of the Lord’s sacrifice
    I will punish the officials
    and the king’s sons
and all those clad
    in foreign clothes.

twi: Saa da no mɛtwe wɔna wɔkwati apongua no nyinaa aso.Wɔn a wɔde akakabensɛmne asisi hyehyɛ wɔn abosomfi amaama no.
english:
On that day I will punish
    all who avoid stepping on the threshold,
who fill the temple of their gods
    with violence and deceit.

twi: “Saa da no,”sɛnea Awurade se ni,“Osu befi Mpataa Pon ano,agyaadwotwa befi Atenae Foforona nnyigyei a ano yɛ den afi nkoko no so aba.
english:
“On that day,”
    declares the Lord,
“a cry will go up from the Fish Gate,
    wailing from the New Quarter,
    and a loud crash from the hills.

twi: Muntwa adwo, mo a mote adetɔnbea hɔ nowɔbɛtɔre wɔn a mo ne wɔn di gua ase,dwetɛ aguadifo nyinaa nso wɔbɛsɛe wɔn.
Mede akanea bekyin ahwehwɛ Yerusalem muna matwe wɔn a wogyaagyaa wɔn ho aso,wɔn a wɔte sɛ bobesa puw no,a wodwen se, ‘Awurade renyɛ hweesɛ ɛyɛ papa anaa bɔne no.’
english:
At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps
    and punish those who are complacent,
    who are like wine left on its dregs,
who think, ‘The Lord will do nothing,
    either good or bad.’

twi: Wɔbɛfom wɔn ahonyade,na wɔabubu wɔn afi agu.Wobesisi afi, nanso wɔrentena muwɔbɛyɛ bobe mfuwnanso wɔrennom mu nsa.”
english:
Their wealth will be plundered,
    their houses demolished.
Though they build houses,
    they will not live in them;
though they plant vineyards,
    they will not drink the wine.”

twi: Awurade Da Kɛse NoAwurade da kɛse no abɛn,abɛn na ɛreba ntɛm so.Tie! Osu a wobesu Awurade da no bɛyɛ yaw,ɔkofo a ɔwɔ hɔ nso nteɛmu bɛyɛ saa ara.
english:
The great day of the Lord is near—
    near and coming quickly.
The cry on the day of the Lord is bitter;
    the Mighty Warrior shouts his battle cry.

twi: Saa da no bɛyɛ abufuw da,ɛyɛ ahoyeraw ne ɔyaw da;ɛyɛ amanehunu ne ɔsɛe da,ɛyɛ esum ne kusukuukuu daɛyɛ omununkum ne kusuuyɛ da,
english:
That day will be a day of wrath—
    a day of distress and anguish,
        a day of trouble and ruin,
    a day of darkness and gloom,
        a day of clouds and blackness—

twi: ɛyɛ ntorobɛntohyɛn ne ɔko nteɛmua etia nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔne ntwɔtwɔw so abantenten da.
english:
a day of trumpet and battle cry
against the fortified cities
    and against the corner towers.

twi: “Mede awerɛhow bɛba nnipa no sona wɔbɛnantew sɛ anifuraefo,efisɛ wɔayɛ bɔne atia Awurade.Wobehwie wɔn mogya agu sɛ mfutuma,na wɔn ayamde nso sɛ atantanne.
english:
“I will bring such distress on all people
    that they will grope about like those who are blind,
    because they have sinned against the Lord.
Their blood will be poured out like dust
    and their entrails like dung.

twi: Wɔn dwetɛ anaa sikakɔkɔɔrentumi nnye wɔn nkwawɔ Awurade abufuw da no.”Ne ninkutwe mu gya nobɛhyew ɔman no nyinaa,na ɔbɛma asase no so tefo nyinaa nkwaaba awiei mpofirim.
english:
Neither their silver nor their gold
    will be able to save them
    on the day of the Lord’s wrath.”
In the fire of his jealousy
    the whole earth will be consumed,
for he will make a sudden end
    of all who live on the earth.

twi: Mommoaboa mo ho ano, mommoaboa mo ho ano,mo, animguaseman,
english:
Gather together, gather yourselves together,
    you shameful nation,

twi: ansa na bere a wɔahyɛ no adu,na da no resen te sɛ ntɛtɛ,ansa na Awurade abufuwhyew noaba mo so,ansa na Awurade abufuw da noaba mo so.
english:
before the decree takes effect
    and that day passes like windblown chaff,
before the Lord’s fierce anger
    comes upon you,
before the day of the Lord’s wrath
    comes upon you.

twi: Monhwehwɛ Awurade, ahobrɛasefo a mowɔ asase so,mo a moyɛ nʼahyɛde.Monhwehwɛ trenee, monhwehwɛ ahobrɛase;ebia ɔbɛkora mo soAwurade abufuw da no.
english:
Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land,
    you who do what he commands.
Seek righteousness, seek humility;
    perhaps you will be sheltered
    on the day of the Lord’s anger.

twi: Atemmu A Etia FilistiaWobegyaw Gasana wɔagyaw Askelon sɛ amamfo.Owigyinae na wɔbɛma Asdod ada mpa muna wɔatutu Ekron ase.
english:
Gaza will be abandoned
    and Ashkelon left in ruins.
At midday Ashdod will be emptied
    and Ekron uprooted.

twi: Munnue, mo a mote mpoano,mo Keretifo;Awurade asɛm tia mo.Kanaan, Filistifo asase.Mɛtɔre mo ase,na obiara renka.
english:
Woe to you who live by the sea,
    you Kerethite people;
the word of the Lord is against you,
    Canaan, land of the Philistines.
He says, “I will destroy you,
    and none will be left.”

twi: Asase a ɛda mpoano, faako a Keretifo tebɛyɛ atenae ama nguanhwɛfone wɔn nguannan.
english:
The land by the sea will become pastures
    having wells for shepherds
    and pens for flocks.

twi: Saa asase no bɛyɛ Yudafi nkae no de;ɛhɔ na wobenya mmoa adidibea.Anwummere, wɔbɛdeda wɔAskelon afi mu.Na Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn bɛhwɛ wɔn,na ɔde wɔn ahonyade nyinaa bɛsan ama wɔn.
english:
That land will belong
    to the remnant of the people of Judah;
    there they will find pasture.
In the evening they will lie down
    in the houses of Ashkelon.
The Lord their God will care for them;
    he will restore their fortunes.

twi: Atemmu A Etia Moab Ne Amon“Mate Moab nsopa neAmonfo atweetwee;wɔn a wɔsopaa me nkurɔfona wohunahunaa wɔn wɔ wɔn asase ho.
english:
“I have heard the insults of Moab
    and the taunts of the Ammonites,
who insulted my people
    and made threats against their land.

twi: Enti sɛ mete ase yi,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade,Israel Nyankopɔn, se ni,“Ampa ara Moab bɛyɛ sɛ Sodom,na Amonfo ayɛ sɛ Gomora,faako a nwura ne nkyene amoa wɔ,bɛyɛ asase a ɛda mpan afebɔɔ.Me man nkae bɛfow wɔn afa;me manfo a wobenya wɔn ti adidi mu no bɛfa wɔn asase.”
english:
Therefore, as surely as I live,”
    declares the Lord Almighty,
    the God of Israel,
“surely Moab will become like Sodom,
    the Ammonites like Gomorrah—
a place of weeds and salt pits,
    a wasteland forever.
The remnant of my people will plunder them;
    the survivors of my nation will inherit their land.”

twi: Wɔn ahantan so akatua a wobenya ni,sɛ wɔyeyaw na wodi Asafo Awurade nkurɔfo ho fɛw nti.
english:
This is what they will get in return for their pride,
    for insulting and mocking
    the people of the Lord Almighty.

twi: Awurade ho suro bɛba wɔn sobere a ɔbɛsɛe asase no so anyame nyinaa.Mpoano aman nyinaa bɛsɔre no,wɔ wɔn ankasa wɔn asase so.
english:
The Lord will be awesome to them
    when he destroys all the gods of the earth.
Distant nations will bow down to him,
    all of them in their own lands.

twi: Atemmu A Etia Kus“Mo Etiopiafo nso,mʼafoa ano na wobekunkum mo.”
english:
“You Cushites, too,
    will be slain by my sword.”

twi: Atemmu A Etia AsiriaAwurade bɛteɛ ne nsa wɔ atifi aman sona wasɛe Asiria,na wama Ninewe ada mpan koraana so awo wosee sɛ nwea pradada so.
english:
He will stretch out his hand against the north
    and destroy Assyria,
leaving Nineveh utterly desolate
    and dry as the desert.

twi: Nguankuw ne anantwi bɛdeda hɔ,mmoadoma nyinaa.Sare so patu ne abonsamnomabɛtena nʼadum no so.Wɔn su begyigye afa mfɛnsere mu,nnwiriwii besisiw apon ano akwan,mpuran a wɔde sida ayɛ no ho bɛdeda hɔ.
english:
Flocks and herds will lie down there,
    creatures of every kind.
The desert owl and the screech owl
    will roost on her columns.
Their hooting will echo through the windows,
    rubble will fill the doorways,
    the beams of cedar will be exposed.

twi: Eyi ne kuropɔn a edi ahurusina ɛte asomdwoe mu.Ɔhoahoaa ne ho se,“Me ne no, obiara nte sɛ me.”Hwɛ sɛnea atetew apansam,na ayɛ nkekammoa atenae!Obiara a otwa mu wɔ hɔ no serew no,him ne nsa fɛwdi so.
english:
This is the city of revelry
    that lived in safety.
She said to herself,
    “I am the one! And there is none besides me.”
What a ruin she has become,
    a lair for wild beasts!
All who pass by her scoff
    and shake their fists.

twi: Yerusalem DaakyeNnome nka nhyɛsofo kuropɔnatuatew kuropɔn a ho agu fi!
english:
Woe to the city of oppressors,
    rebellious and defiled!

twi: Ɔnyɛ osetie mma obiaraonnye nteɛso biara nto mu.Ɔmfa ne ho nto Awurade so.Ontwiw mmɛn ne Nyankopɔn.
english:
She obeys no one,
    she accepts no correction.
She does not trust in the Lord,
    she does not draw near to her God.

twi: Nʼakannifo yɛ gyata a wɔbobɔ mu,ne sodifo yɛ mpataku a wɔnam anadwo,a wonnya biribiara mma adekyee.
english:
Her officials within her
    are roaring lions;
her rulers are evening wolves,
    who leave nothing for the morning.

twi: Ne nkɔmhyɛfo yɛ ahantan;wɔyɛ afatwafo.Nʼasɔfo gu kronkronbea ho fi.Wɔnam mmara no so di nsɛmmɔne.
english:
Her prophets are unprincipled;
    they are treacherous people.
Her priests profane the sanctuary
    and do violence to the law.

twi: Awurade a ɔte ne mu no yɛ ɔtreneeni;ɔnyɛ mfomso biara.Adekyee biara, ɔda ne trenee adi,na onni huammɔ da,nanso amumɔyɛfo de, wonnim aniwu.
english:
The Lord within her is righteous;
    he does no wrong.
Morning by morning he dispenses his justice,
    and every new day he does not fail,
    yet the unrighteous know no shame.

twi: “Masɛe amanaman;madwiriw wɔn abandennen agu.Wɔn mmorɔn so adeda mpan,a obiara ntwa mu hɔ.Wɔasɛe wɔn nkuropɔn;a obiara renka.
Meka kyerɛɛ kuropɔn no se,‘ampa ara wubesuro mena woagye nteɛso ato mu!’Na afei ne tenabea rensɛe,na mʼasotwe biara nso remma no so.Nanso wɔn ho peree wɔnsɛ wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ bɔne, wɔn nneyɛe nyinaa mu.
english:
Of Jerusalem I thought,
    ‘Surely you will fear me
    and accept correction!’
Then her place of refuge would not be destroyed,
    nor all my punishments come upon her.
But they were still eager
    to act corruptly in all they did.

twi: Enti twɛn me,” sɛnea Awurade se ni,“na da no mɛsɔre adi adanse.Mayɛ mʼadwene sɛ mɛboaboa amanamanne ahenni anona mahwie mʼabufuw agu wɔn somʼabufuwhyew nyinaa.Me ninkutwe abufuw gya mu no,asase nyinaa bɛhyew.
english:
Therefore wait for me,”
    declares the Lord,
    “for the day I will stand up to testify.
I have decided to assemble the nations,
    to gather the kingdoms
and to pour out my wrath on them—
    all my fierce anger.
The whole world will be consumed
    by the fire of my jealous anger.

twi: “Afei medwira nnipa no ano,na wɔn nyinaa abɔ Awurade dinna wɔaka abɔ mu asom no.
english:
“Then I will purify the lips of the peoples,
    that all of them may call on the name of the Lord
    and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

twi: Mʼasomfo, me nkurɔfo a wɔabɔ ahwete nobefi nsubɔnten a ɛwɔ Kus nohɔde wɔn afɔrebɔde abrɛ me.
english:
From beyond the rivers of Cush
    my worshipers, my scattered people,
    will bring me offerings.

twi: Saa da no, wo Yerusalem, wɔrengu wʼanim asewɔ nneyɛe bɔne a woayɛ atia me ho,efisɛ meyi afi saa kuropɔn yi mu,wɔn a wodi ahantan mu ahurusi,na worenyɛ ahantan biowɔ me bepɔw kronkron no so.
english:
On that day you, Jerusalem, will not be put to shame
    for all the wrongs you have done to me,
because I will remove from you
    your arrogant boasters.
Never again will you be haughty
    on my holy hill.

twi: Nanso megyaw wɔ wo muwɔn a wodwo na wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase,na wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no.
english:
But I will leave within you
    the meek and humble.
The remnant of Israel
    will trust in the name of the Lord.

twi: Wɔrenyɛ bɔne biara;wɔrenka nkontomposɛm,na wɔn ano renka nnaadaasɛmwobedidi na wɔada,na obiara renyi wɔn hu.”
english:
They will do no wrong;
    they will tell no lies.
A deceitful tongue
    will not be found in their mouths.
They will eat and lie down
    and no one will make them afraid.”

twi: To dwom, Ɔbabea Sion;teɛ mu dennen, Israel!Ma wʼani nnye, na di ahurusi wɔ wo koma nyinaa mu,Ɔbabea Yerusalem!
english:
Sing, Daughter Zion;
    shout aloud, Israel!
Be glad and rejoice with all your heart,
    Daughter Jerusalem!

twi: Efisɛ Awurade ayi wʼasotwe afi wo so,wama wo tamfo asan nʼakyi.Awurade, Israelhene ka wo ho;worensuro ɔhaw biara bio.
english:
The Lord has taken away your punishment,
    he has turned back your enemy.
The Lord, the King of Israel, is with you;
    never again will you fear any harm.

twi: Saa da no, wɔbɛka akyerɛ Yerusalem se,“Nsuro, Sion!Mma wo nsa mu ngow.
english:
On that day
    they will say to Jerusalem,
“Do not fear, Zion;
    do not let your hands hang limp.

twi: Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ne wo wɔ hɔ,Ɔyɛ ogyefo ɔhoɔdenfo.Nʼani begye wo hone dɔ mu, ɔrenka wʼanim bio,ɔde nnwonto bedi wo ho anigye.”
english:
The Lord your God is with you,
    the Mighty Warrior who saves.
He will take great delight in you;
    in his love he will no longer rebuke you,
    but will rejoice over you with singing.”

twi: “Meyi wɔn a wodi awerɛhowwɔ wʼafahyɛnna ahorow a woahwere;a ayɛ adesoa ne animguase ama wo no ho.
english:
“I will remove from you
    all who mourn over the loss of your appointed festivals,
    which is a burden and reproach for you.

twi: Saa bere no me ne wɔna wɔhyɛɛ wo so nyinaa bedi.Megye mmerɛwyɛfona mɛboaboa wɔn a wɔabɔ wɔn ahwete no ano.Mɛkamfo wɔn ahyɛ wɔn anuonyamasase biara a woguu wɔn anim ase wɔ so no so.
english:
At that time I will deal
    with all who oppressed you.
I will rescue the lame;
    I will gather the exiles.
I will give them praise and honor
    in every land where they have suffered shame.

twi: Saa bere no, mɛboaboa mo ano;saa bere no, mede mo bɛba fie.Mɛhyɛ wo anuonyam na makamfo mowɔ asase so nnipa nyinaa mubere a mede mo ahonyade bɛsan ama wona mode mo ani behu no,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
english:
At that time I will gather you;
    at that time I will bring you home.
I will give you honor and praise
    among all the peoples of the earth
when I restore your fortunes
    before your very eyes,”
says the Lord.
